domains.name: claim
domains.description: Core claims processing and adjudication including medical, pharmacy, dental, and vision claims. Manages claim submission (837), editing, pricing, payment processing (835), COB, subrogation, and appeals. Supports CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, DRG, and APC coding standards. Central to payment accuracy and provider reimbursement.

products.name: claim
products.description: Core claim record capturing submission details, member, provider, plan, claim type, total charges, and submission timestamps.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the claim record. Primary key for the claim entity.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique claim number used for tracking and reference by members, providers, and internal staff.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with this claim.

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identification number on the member's insurance card, used for eligibility verification and claim submission.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The employer or group plan identifier under which the member is covered.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rendering or servicing provider who delivered the care.

attributes.name: rendering_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the individual provider who rendered the service.

attributes.name: billing_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the organization or provider submitting the claim for payment.

attributes.name: billing_tin
attributes.description: The Tax Identification Number of the billing provider used for payment and tax reporting.

attributes.name: facility_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the facility where services were rendered (e.g., hospital, clinic).

attributes.name: referring_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the provider who referred the member for services.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan under which the claim is being processed.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The business segment or product line under which the claim is categorized (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The category of claim based on the type of service or provider (e.g., Professional for physician services, Institutional for hospital services).

attributes.name: form_type
attributes.description: The standard claim form type used for submission (e.g., CMS-1500 for professional, UB-04 for institutional).

attributes.name: frequency_code
attributes.description: Code indicating whether the claim is an original submission, replacement, or void (1=Original, 7=Replacement, 8=Void).

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: The method by which the claim was submitted to the payer (e.g., EDI, paper, provider portal).

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the claim was received by the payer for processing.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the claim was received by the payer system.

attributes.name: service_from_date
attributes.description: The start date of the service period for which the claim is submitted.

attributes.name: service_to_date
attributes.description: The end date of the service period for which the claim is submitted.

attributes.name: admission_date
attributes.description: The date the member was admitted to a facility for inpatient or institutional care.

attributes.name: discharge_date
attributes.description: The date the member was discharged from a facility after inpatient or institutional care.

attributes.name: statement_from_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the billing statement period for institutional claims.

attributes.name: statement_to_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the billing statement period for institutional claims.

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: The total amount billed by the provider for all services on the claim before any adjustments or payments.

attributes.name: total_allowed_amount
attributes.description: The total amount approved by the payer as eligible for payment based on contracted rates and benefit plan rules.

attributes.name: total_paid_amount
attributes.description: The total amount paid by the payer to the provider or member for the claim.

attributes.name: total_member_responsibility
attributes.description: The total amount the member is responsible for paying, including deductible, coinsurance, and copayment.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the claim amount applied to the member's deductible.

attributes.name: coinsurance_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the allowed amount the member is responsible for paying as a percentage of covered services.

attributes.name: copayment_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount the member is responsible for paying for a covered service.

attributes.name: cob_paid_amount
attributes.description: The amount paid by other insurance carriers when the member has multiple coverage sources.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The amount reduced from the billed charges due to provider contract discounts or negotiated rates.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of adjustments applied to the claim, including denials, reductions, or other modifications.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the claim in the adjudication workflow.

attributes.name: status_date
attributes.description: The date the claim reached its current status.

attributes.name: adjudication_date
attributes.description: The date the claim was adjudicated and a payment decision was made.

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: The date payment was issued to the provider or member for the claim.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check or electronic payment reference number associated with the claim payment.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method used to remit payment to the provider (e.g., check, electronic funds transfer, ACH).

attributes.name: secondary_diagnosis_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of secondary diagnosis codes (ICD-10) representing additional conditions.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: admitting_diagnosis_code
attributes.description: The diagnosis code (ICD-10) documented at the time of admission for institutional claims.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: The DRG code assigned to the claim for inpatient hospital services, used for payment grouping.

attributes.name: drg_weight
attributes.description: The relative weight assigned to the DRG code, used to calculate payment amounts.

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: The 4-digit code identifying the type of service or accommodation provided in institutional claims.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: The 2-digit code identifying the location where services were rendered (e.g., office, hospital, home).
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set

attributes.name: type_of_bill_code
attributes.description: The 3-digit code on institutional claims indicating the facility type, care type, and billing sequence.

attributes.name: admission_type_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the priority of the admission (e.g., emergency, urgent, elective).

attributes.name: admission_source_code
attributes.description: Code indicating where the patient was located prior to admission (e.g., physician referral, emergency room).

attributes.name: discharge_status_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the patient's status at discharge (e.g., home, transferred, expired).

attributes.name: service_line_count
attributes.description: The total number of service lines or detail records included in the claim.

attributes.name: units_of_service
attributes.description: The total number of units of service provided across all service lines on the claim.

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: The number of days of medication supply dispensed for pharmacy claims.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_number
attributes.description: The authorization number issued by the payer approving the service prior to delivery.

attributes.name: referral_number
attributes.description: The referral authorization number issued for services requiring a referral from a primary care physician.

attributes.name: medical_record_number
attributes.description: The patient's medical record number assigned by the provider or facility.

attributes.name: patient_account_number
attributes.description: The provider's internal account number for the patient associated with the claim.

attributes.name: original_claim_number
attributes.description: The claim number of the original claim when this claim is a replacement, void, or adjustment.

attributes.name: resubmission_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for claim resubmission (e.g., corrected claim, additional information).

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the claim, such as special circumstances or additional information.

attributes.name: accident_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the services were related to an accident (auto, employment, or other).

attributes.name: accident_date
attributes.description: The date of the accident if the claim is accident-related.

attributes.name: accident_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state code where the accident occurred.

attributes.name: emergency_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the services were provided as emergency care.

attributes.name: cob_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim involves coordination of benefits with another insurance carrier.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: cob_payer_responsibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer is primary, secondary, or tertiary in the coordination of benefits sequence.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: subrogation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim is subject to subrogation recovery from a third party.

attributes.name: medicare_secondary_payer_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Medicare is the secondary payer for this claim due to other primary coverage.

attributes.name: filing_indicator_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of insurance plan or payer (e.g., Medicare Part A, Commercial, Medicaid).

attributes.name: payer_claim_control_number
attributes.description: The unique control number assigned by the payer to track the claim internally.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_trace_number
attributes.description: The trace number assigned by the clearinghouse for tracking the claim submission.

attributes.name: processing_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to the claim for processing (e.g., standard, expedited, urgent).

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim has been flagged for potential fraud, waste, or abuse investigation.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: The fraud risk score assigned to the claim by fraud detection algorithms.

attributes.name: payment_accuracy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim has been flagged for payment accuracy review or audit.

attributes.name: appeal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim has been appealed by the provider or member.

attributes.name: appeal_level
attributes.description: The level of appeal if the claim has been appealed (e.g., first level, second level, external review).

attributes.name: appeal_received_date
attributes.description: The date the appeal was received by the payer.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: The date the appeal decision was rendered by the payer.

attributes.name: turnaround_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days between claim receipt and adjudication, used to measure processing efficiency.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The amount of interest paid to the provider for late payment beyond the prompt pay timeframe.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system or platform from which the claim originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with this claim.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identification number on the member's insurance card, used for eligibility verification and claim submission.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.care_plan. Business justification: Claims for chronic/complex conditions are often tied to active care plans. Case managers review claims to monitor care plan adherence and identify gaps in care delivery.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.value_based_agreement. attributes.name: cost_center_id

products.name: line
products.description: Individual service line within a claim, including procedure code (CPT/HCPCS), diagnosis codes (ICD-10), units, charge amount, and line sequence.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual service line within a claim. Primary key for the claim line entity.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent claim to which this service line belongs. Links the line to the overall claim submission.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the order of this service line within the claim. Used to maintain line ordering and uniqueness within a claim.

attributes.name: procedure_code_type
attributes.description: The coding system used for the procedure code. Identifies whether the code is CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-PCS (for inpatient procedures), CDT (dental), or NDC (pharmacy).

attributes.name: modifier_1
attributes.description: First procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed (e.g., bilateral procedure, multiple procedures, assistant surgeon).
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: modifier_2
attributes.description: Second procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: modifier_3
attributes.description: Third procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: modifier_4
attributes.description: Fourth procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_2
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Code 2
attributes.description: Second diagnosis code associated with this service line, providing additional clinical context.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_3
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Code 3
attributes.description: Third diagnosis code associated with this service line, providing additional clinical context.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_4
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Code 4
attributes.description: Fourth diagnosis code associated with this service line, providing additional clinical context.

attributes.name: service_from_date
attributes.description: The start date of the service period for this line item. For single-day services, this is the date of service.

attributes.name: service_to_date
attributes.description: The end date of the service period for this line item. For single-day services, this matches the service from date.

attributes.name: service_units
attributes.description: The quantity of services or units provided for this line item (e.g., number of visits, days, miles, units of anesthesia).

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: The type of unit being measured for service units (e.g., UN=Unit, MJ=Minutes, DA=Days, HR=Hours, MI=Miles, FL=Floor, VS=Visit).

attributes.name: billed_amount
attributes.description: The total amount billed by the provider for this service line before any adjustments or payments.

attributes.name: allowed_amount
attributes.description: The maximum amount the health plan will reimburse for this service line based on contracted rates, fee schedules, or usual and customary charges.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the allowed amount applied to the member's deductible for this service line.

attributes.name: coinsurance_amount
attributes.description: The member's coinsurance responsibility for this service line, calculated as a percentage of the allowed amount.

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed copayment amount the member is responsible for paying for this service line.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount paid by the health plan to the provider for this service line after all adjustments.

attributes.name: member_responsibility_amount
attributes.description: The total amount the member is responsible for paying for this service line, including deductible, coinsurance, and copay.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The amount discounted from the billed amount based on provider contract terms or negotiated rates.

attributes.name: cob_paid_amount
attributes.description: The amount paid by other insurance carriers for this service line when coordination of benefits applies.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Implementation Guide, NAIC COB Guidelines

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of this claim line within the adjudication workflow.

attributes.name: remark_code
attributes.description: Additional remark code providing supplemental information about the line adjudication. Maps to standard remittance advice remark codes.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARC)

attributes.name: rendering_provider_npi
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier of the individual provider who rendered the service for this line.

attributes.name: rendering_provider_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual provider who rendered the service for this line.

attributes.name: rendering_provider_specialty
attributes.description: The medical specialty or taxonomy code of the rendering provider for this service line.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the location where the service was provided (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 22=Outpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room).

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: Four-digit code used primarily for institutional claims (UB-04) to identify the type of accommodation, ancillary service, or billing calculation.

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: The DRG code assigned to this service line for inpatient hospital claims, used for prospective payment system reimbursement.

attributes.name: apc_code
attributes.description: The APC code assigned to this service line for outpatient hospital claims, used for prospective payment system reimbursement.

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: The 11-digit National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product dispensed for pharmacy claims.

attributes.name: drug_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of medication dispensed for pharmacy claims, measured in the appropriate unit (e.g., tablets, milliliters).

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: The number of days the dispensed medication is expected to last for pharmacy claims.

attributes.name: daw_code
attributes.description: Code indicating whether the brand name drug was dispensed as written by the prescriber or if a generic substitution was made.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_number
attributes.description: The authorization number issued for services requiring prior approval before rendering.

attributes.name: referral_number
attributes.description: The referral authorization number for services requiring a referral from the primary care physician.

attributes.name: service_type_code
attributes.description: Code categorizing the type of service provided (e.g., medical, surgical, diagnostic, preventive, emergency).

attributes.name: of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or market segment under which this service line is covered.

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rendering provider is in-network or out-of-network for the member's plan at the time of service.

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine the allowed amount for this service line.

attributes.name: medical_necessity_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the service was determined to be medically necessary based on clinical guidelines and policy criteria.

attributes.name: emergency_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the service was provided as emergency care, which may affect benefit coverage and member cost-sharing.

attributes.name: preventive_service_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the service is classified as preventive care, which may be covered at 100% under ACA requirements.

attributes.name: bundled_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this service line is bundled with another service and not separately reimbursable.

attributes.name: duplicate_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line was identified as a duplicate of a previously processed claim line.

attributes.name: cob_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether coordination of benefits with another insurance carrier applies to this service line.

attributes.name: subrogation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this service line is subject to subrogation recovery from a third party liable for the injury or illness.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this service line has been flagged for potential fraud, waste, or abuse investigation.

attributes.name: appeal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this service line has been appealed by the provider or member.

attributes.name: adjudication_date
attributes.description: The date on which this service line was adjudicated and a payment determination was made.

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was issued to the provider for this service line.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check or electronic funds transfer number associated with the payment for this service line.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method used to remit payment to the provider for this service line.

attributes.name: bill_type_code
attributes.description: Three-digit code used on institutional claims (UB-04) to identify the type of facility, care type, and billing sequence.

attributes.name: service_location_address
attributes.description: The physical address where the service was rendered for this line item.

attributes.name: service_location_city
attributes.description: The city where the service was rendered for this line item.

attributes.name: service_location_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state code where the service was rendered for this line item.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Implementation Guide, USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: service_location_zip_code
attributes.description: The ZIP code where the service was rendered for this line item.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Implementation Guide, USPS ZIP Code Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of sales tax or other applicable taxes charged for this service line, if applicable.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The amount of interest paid on this service line due to late payment or state prompt pay requirements.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The amount of penalty assessed on this service line for late payment or other regulatory violations.

attributes.name: withhold_amount
attributes.description: The amount withheld from payment for this service line as part of a risk-sharing or quality incentive arrangement.

attributes.name: capitation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this service line is covered under a capitated payment arrangement and not separately reimbursable.

attributes.name: claim_adjustment_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the entity responsible for the adjustment (CO=Contractual Obligation, CR=Correction/Reversal, OA=Other Adjustment, PI=Payer Initiated, PR=Patient Responsibility).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Claim Adjustment Group Codes

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Free-text note or comment providing additional information about the adjudication or processing of this service line.

attributes.name: original_line_paid_amount
attributes.description: The original paid amount for this service line before any adjustments, voids, or reprocessing. Used for tracking payment history.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for any adjustment made to the original payment for this service line.

attributes.name: void_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this service line payment has been voided and reversed.

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: The date on which this service line payment was voided, if applicable.

attributes.name: reprocessed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this service line has been reprocessed after initial adjudication.

attributes.name: reprocessed_date
attributes.description: The date on which this service line was reprocessed, if applicable.

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: The HCC code derived from the diagnosis codes for this service line, used for risk adjustment in Medicare Advantage and ACA plans.

attributes.name: raf_score_contribution
attributes.description: The contribution of this service line to the member's overall RAF score for risk adjustment purposes.

attributes.name: hedis_measure_indicator

attributes.name: hedis_measure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Code
attributes.description: The specific HEDIS measure code that this service line contributes to, if applicable.

attributes.name: quality_program_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this service line is associated with a quality improvement or value-based care program.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this claim line record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this claim line record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: The type of claim form used for submission (e.g., CMS-1500 for professional, UB-04 for institutional).

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Records adjustments applied to a claim after initial adjudication, including adjustment reason codes, amount adjustments, and effective dates.

attributes.description: Code indicating the party responsible for the adjustment amount: CO (Contractual Obligation), PR (Patient Responsibility), OA (Other Adjustment), PI (Payer Initiated).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity value associated with the adjustment when applicable (e.g., number of units adjusted).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: original_billed_amount
attributes.description: The original amount billed on the claim before this adjustment was applied.

attributes.name: adjusted_allowed_amount
attributes.description: The allowed amount after applying this adjustment. Represents the maximum reimbursable amount post-adjustment.

attributes.name: adjusted_paid_amount
attributes.description: The actual paid amount after applying this adjustment.

attributes.name: patient_responsibility_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the adjustment amount that is the patient's financial responsibility (copay, coinsurance, deductible).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the adjustment becomes effective and is applied to the claim.

attributes.name: processed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the adjustment was processed by the claims system.

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the adjustment was posted to the financial ledger.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the adjustment record.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: The specific line item number on the claim to which this adjustment applies. Null if adjustment applies to entire claim.

attributes.name: service_line_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the adjustment applies to a specific service line (true) or the entire claim (false).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: procedure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) or Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Code
attributes.description: The CPT or HCPCS procedure code associated with the service line being adjusted.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: procedure_modifier
attributes.description: Two-character modifier code(s) appended to the procedure code to provide additional information about the service.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Code
attributes.description: The ICD-10 diagnosis code associated with the service line being adjusted.

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: Four-digit code used on institutional claims (UB-04) to identify the type of service or accommodation provided.

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: DRG code assigned to the inpatient stay for payment grouping purposes, relevant when adjustment relates to DRG pricing.

attributes.name: apc_code
attributes.description: APC code assigned to the outpatient service for payment grouping purposes, relevant when adjustment relates to APC pricing.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The source or origin that initiated the adjustment (e.g., auto-adjudication, manual review, appeal, audit).

attributes.name: initiator_type
attributes.description: The type of party that initiated or requested the adjustment.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: The method by which the adjustment was applied (automated system rule, manual intervention, or semi-automated).

attributes.name: original_payment_date
attributes.description: The date of the original claim payment that is being adjusted.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: original_check_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Check or Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Number
attributes.description: The check or EFT reference number of the original payment being adjusted.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adjustment Check or Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Number
attributes.description: The check or EFT reference number associated with the adjustment payment if applicable.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: recoupment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment represents a recoupment (recovery of previously paid funds).

attributes.name: recoupment_method
attributes.description: The method used to recover overpaid funds when recoupment is applicable.

attributes.name: appeal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment is the result of an appeal decision.

attributes.name: appeal_level
attributes.description: The level of appeal that resulted in this adjustment if applicable.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeal decision was rendered that led to this adjustment.

attributes.name: audit_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment resulted from an audit finding.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: The type of audit that identified the need for this adjustment.

attributes.name: cob_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment is related to coordination of benefits with another payer.

attributes.name: cob_payer_responsibility
attributes.description: The payer responsibility level (primary, secondary, tertiary) relevant to this COB adjustment.

attributes.name: other_payer_paid_amount
attributes.description: The amount paid by another payer in a COB scenario that affects this adjustment.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: subrogation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment is related to subrogation recovery from a third party.

attributes.name: subrogation_recovery_amount
attributes.description: The amount recovered through subrogation that resulted in this adjustment.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The type of provider contract that governs the payment methodology relevant to this adjustment.

attributes.name: pricing_methodology
attributes.description: The pricing methodology used to calculate the adjusted amount.

attributes.name: allowed_amount_calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to determine the allowed amount that drives the adjustment calculation.

attributes.name: bundling_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment is due to bundling of services under payment policy.

attributes.name: bundling_policy_code
attributes.description: The specific bundling policy code that triggered this adjustment.

attributes.name: medical_necessity_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment is related to medical necessity determination.
attributes.references: CMS National Coverage Determinations (NCD), Local Coverage Determinations (LCD)

attributes.name: timely_filing_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment is due to timely filing limit violations.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: timely_filing_limit_days
attributes.description: The number of days allowed for timely filing under the applicable policy when timely filing is the adjustment reason.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: duplicate_claim_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment is due to identification of a duplicate claim submission.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment is related to suspected or confirmed fraud, waste, or abuse.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, False Claims Act

attributes.name: fraud_case_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Case Number
attributes.description: The case number assigned by the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) when fraud is suspected.

attributes.name: overpayment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment corrects an overpayment on the original claim.

attributes.name: underpayment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment corrects an underpayment on the original claim.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Interest amount paid to provider for delayed payment or adjustment processing as required by state prompt pay laws.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate applied when calculating interest on delayed payments.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Penalty amount assessed as part of the adjustment for regulatory non-compliance or contract violations.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context or explanation for the adjustment.

attributes.name: internal_comments
attributes.description: Internal comments for claims processing staff regarding the adjustment, not shared externally.

attributes.name: provider_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider was notified of the adjustment via remittance advice or other communication.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: member_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member was notified of the adjustment via Explanation of Benefits (EOB) or other communication.

attributes.name: eob_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether an EOB was generated and sent to the member for this adjustment.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a remittance advice (835 transaction) was generated and sent to the provider for this adjustment.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: financial_period
attributes.description: The financial accounting period (e.g., 2023-Q4, 2023-12) to which this adjustment is allocated for financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this adjustment is allocated for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this adjustment amount is posted for financial accounting.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center code associated with this adjustment for internal cost allocation and reporting.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid) associated with the claim being adjusted.
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The insurance product type (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP) associated with the claim being adjusted.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The type of benefit plan (medical, pharmacy, dental, vision) to which this adjustment applies.

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: The type of claim being adjusted (professional, institutional, pharmacy, dental, vision).

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of healthcare service associated with the claim line being adjusted.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the location where the service was rendered (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room).

attributes.name: service_from_date
attributes.description: The start date of the service period for the claim line being adjusted.

attributes.name: service_to_date
attributes.description: The end date of the service period for the claim line being adjusted.

attributes.name: units_of_service
attributes.description: The number of units of service provided for the claim line being adjusted.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment reverses a previous adjustment.

attributes.name: correction_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment corrects an error in a previous adjustment.

attributes.name: system_generated_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment was automatically generated by the claims system versus manually entered.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the adjustment for processing and resolution.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment must be included in regulatory reporting (e.g., MLR, state filings).
attributes.references: ACA MLR Reporting, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: mlr_reporting_category
attributes.description: The MLR reporting category to which this adjustment should be allocated for ACA MLR calculation.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment impacts risk adjustment calculations (HCC, RAF scores).

attributes.name: hcc_impact_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment affects HCC coding and risk scores for Medicare Advantage or ACA plans.

attributes.name: quality_measure_impact_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment impacts quality measure reporting (HEDIS, Stars).

attributes.name: hedis_measure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Code
attributes.description: The HEDIS measure code affected by this adjustment if applicable.

attributes.name: stars_measure_code
attributes.description: The Medicare Stars measure code affected by this adjustment if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment requires supervisory or management approval before being applied.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the adjustment when approval is required.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who approved the adjustment.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the adjustment was approved.

attributes.name: processed_by_user_agent_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the claims examiner or system user who processed the adjustment.

attributes.name: processing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the adjustment was processed in the claims system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system that generated or recorded this adjustment (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: source_system_adjustment_id
attributes.description: The unique adjustment identifier from the source system of record.

attributes.name: transaction_control_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Transaction Control Number
attributes.description: The EDI transaction control number from the 835 remittance advice associated with this adjustment.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: effective_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this adjustment record became effective in the data warehouse for historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this adjustment record was superseded or became inactive in the data warehouse for historical tracking.

attributes.name: current_record_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the current active version of the adjustment record in a slowly changing dimension.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who approved the adjustment.

attributes.name: processed_by_user_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the claims examiner or system user who processed the adjustment.

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.retroactive_adjustment. Business justification: Claim adjustments triggered by retroactive billing changes (premium adjustments, eligibility corrections) must reference the source retroactive adjustment for compliance and audit documentation.

attributes.name: contract_discount_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_discount. Business justification: Claim adjustments apply contracted discounts (prompt pay, volume-based, specialty-specific) defined in provider agreements. Claims repricing engines reference discount schedules to calculate final all

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim. Business justification: Adjustment must reference its parent claim to enable claim‑level aggregation and reporting; claim_id does not exist yet, so create new FK.

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Allocation of a claim payment to individual claim lines and to provider accounts, including allocated amount per line.

attributes.name: payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each claim payment allocation record. Primary key for the claim payment allocation entity.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the parent claim to which this payment allocation belongs. Links payment allocation to the original claim submission.

attributes.name: claim_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the claim identifying the specific service line to which this payment allocation applies. Used to distinguish multiple services on a single claim.

attributes.name: shared_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the payment transaction from which this allocation is derived. Links allocation to the source payment batch or remittance.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the healthcare provider receiving this payment allocation. May represent rendering, billing, or servicing provider depending on payment routing rules.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the healthcare provider receiving payment. Standard identifier for HIPAA transactions.
attributes.references: CMS National Provider Identifier (NPI) Standard, HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Nine-digit Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) of the provider entity receiving payment. Used for tax reporting and payment reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Identification Number Requirements, CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan member for whom services were rendered and payment is being allocated. Links payment to member account.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification, ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Health plan subscriber identification number as it appears on the member's insurance card. May differ from internal member_id.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification, ANSI X12 270/271 Eligibility

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Employer or group policy number under which the member is covered. Used for group billing and reporting.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount allocated from the payment to this specific claim line. Represents the portion of total payment assigned to this service line after all adjustments.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: billed_amount
attributes.description: Original amount billed by the provider for this claim line. Represents the provider's charge before any payer adjustments or contractual allowances.

attributes.name: allowed_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount the health plan will pay for this service based on contracted rates, fee schedules, or regulatory limits. Also known as eligible amount or approved amount.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Fee Schedule, ANSI X12 835

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount paid by the health plan to the provider for this claim line. May differ from allocated_amount if allocation includes member responsibility or other adjustments.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the allowed amount applied to the member's annual deductible. Member is responsible for this amount before plan benefits begin.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC), ANSI X12 835

attributes.name: coinsurance_amount
attributes.description: Member's share of costs calculated as a percentage of the allowed amount after deductible is met. Represents cost-sharing between member and plan.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC), ANSI X12 835

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for a covered service as defined in the benefit plan. Typically collected at time of service.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC), ANSI X12 835

attributes.name: member_responsibility_amount
attributes.description: Total amount the member owes for this claim line, including deductible, coinsurance, copay, and any non-covered amounts. Represents patient liability.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: cob_amount
attributes.description: Amount paid or expected to be paid by another insurance carrier when member has multiple coverage. Used to coordinate benefits between primary and secondary payers.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits, ANSI X12 835

attributes.name: contractual_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Difference between billed amount and allowed amount based on provider contract terms. Represents the write-off amount per contractual agreement.
attributes.references: Provider Network Contracting Standards, ANSI X12 835

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Additional discount applied to the claim beyond standard contractual adjustments. May include prompt payment discounts or special negotiated rates.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: withhold_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from provider payment for risk-sharing arrangements, quality incentives, or other contractual withhold provisions. May be returned based on performance.
attributes.references: Value-Based Care Contracting Standards, CMS Alternative Payment Models

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Interest paid to provider for late payment beyond regulatory or contractual timeframes. Calculated based on state prompt payment laws.
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Penalty amount assessed for late payment or other contractual violations. May be required by state regulations or provider contracts.
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment allocation indicating whether it is a standard payment, adjustment to prior payment, reversal, recoupment of overpayment, or supplemental payment.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the payment allocation. Tracks lifecycle from initial allocation through posting to provider account and final reconciliation.
attributes.references: Payment Processing Standards, Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment amount was allocated to this specific claim line. Represents when the allocation decision was made in the payment processing system.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check or warrant number if payment was made by paper check. Used for payment reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards, Payment Processing Standards

attributes.name: eft_trace_number
attributes.description: Trace number for electronic funds transfer payments. Unique identifier assigned by the Automated Clearing House (ACH) network for payment tracking.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the remittance advice document (835 transaction) that contains this payment allocation. Links allocation to provider payment notification.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: service_date_from
attributes.description: Start date of the service period for which payment is being allocated. For single-day services, matches service_date_to.

attributes.name: service_date_to
attributes.description: End date of the service period for which payment is being allocated. For single-day services, matches service_date_from.

attributes.name: procedure_code
attributes.description: CPT, HCPCS, or other standard procedure code identifying the service rendered. Used for payment allocation and utilization analysis.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards, CMS HCPCS Coding Standards

attributes.name: procedure_code_type
attributes.description: Classification of the procedure code system used. Identifies whether code is CPT (physician services), HCPCS (supplies/equipment), ICD-10-PCS (inpatient procedures), CDT (dental), NDC (pharmacy), or revenue code (facility).
attributes.references: HIPAA Code Set Standards, ANSI X12 837

attributes.name: procedure_modifier_1
attributes.description: First procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed. Affects payment calculation and medical necessity determination.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards, CMS HCPCS Modifiers

attributes.name: procedure_modifier_2
attributes.description: Second procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards, CMS HCPCS Modifiers

attributes.name: procedure_modifier_3
attributes.description: Third procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards, CMS HCPCS Modifiers

attributes.name: procedure_modifier_4
attributes.description: Fourth procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards, CMS HCPCS Modifiers

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: Four-digit code used on institutional claims (UB-04) to identify the type of accommodation, ancillary service, or billing calculation. Used for facility payment allocation.

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: DRG code assigned to inpatient hospital stays for payment grouping. Used for prospective payment system calculations under Medicare and many commercial contracts.

attributes.name: apc_code
attributes.description: APC code assigned to outpatient hospital services for payment grouping under Medicare's Outpatient Prospective Payment System (OPPS).

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the location where services were rendered (office, hospital, home, etc.). Affects payment rates and coverage determination.
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set

attributes.name: type_of_service_code
attributes.description: Code classifying the general category of service (medical, surgical, diagnostic, etc.). Used for utilization reporting and payment categorization.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standard code explaining why the paid amount differs from the billed amount. Provides transparency on payment adjustments and denials.
attributes.references: CMS Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (CARC), ANSI X12 835

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of the adjustment reason code. Provides detailed context for payment variance.

attributes.name: remark_code
attributes.description: Standard code providing additional information or instructions related to the payment allocation. Supplements adjustment reason codes with procedural guidance.
attributes.references: CMS Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARC), ANSI X12 835

attributes.name: remark_description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of the remark code. Provides additional context or instructions to the provider.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Business segment or product line under which the member is covered. Determines applicable regulations, payment rules, and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Health Insurance Model Acts, CMS Program Requirements

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance product (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, etc.). Affects network requirements, payment methodologies, and member cost-sharing.
attributes.references: NAIC Health Insurance Model Acts, ACA Qualified Health Plan Standards

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is in-network or out-of-network for the member's plan. Determines applicable payment rates and member cost-sharing levels.
attributes.references: Provider Network Contracting Standards, ACA Network Adequacy Requirements

attributes.name: par_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the provider has a participating contract with the health plan. True if provider is contracted, false if non-contracted.

attributes.name: capitation_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the provider is paid under a capitation arrangement rather than fee-for-service. True if capitated, false if FFS.
attributes.references: Managed Care Contracting Standards, CMS Alternative Payment Models

attributes.name: bundled_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation is part of a bundled payment arrangement where multiple services are paid as a single episode. True if bundled, false if unbundled.
attributes.references: CMS Bundled Payment Models, Alternative Payment Models

attributes.name: value_based_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation includes value-based payment components such as quality incentives or shared savings. True if value-based, false if standard FFS.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Payment Program, Value-Based Care Standards

attributes.name: primary_payer_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this health plan is the primary payer for this claim. True if primary, false if secondary or tertiary payer in COB scenarios.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: cob_payer_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence indicating the order of payment responsibility when multiple payers exist (1=primary, 2=secondary, 3=tertiary). Used for COB processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: subrogation_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation is subject to subrogation recovery from a third party liable for the member's injury or illness. True if subrogation applies.
attributes.references: ERISA Subrogation Rights, State Subrogation Laws

attributes.name: workers_comp_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether services are related to a workers compensation claim. True if workers comp related, affecting payment responsibility.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Laws, Medicare Secondary Payer Rules

attributes.name: medicare_secondary_payer_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Medicare is the secondary payer due to other primary coverage (employer group health plan, liability, workers comp, etc.). True if MSP applies.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Secondary Payer Rules, 42 CFR 411

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total payment allocated to this specific claim line. Used when payment is distributed proportionally across multiple lines.
attributes.references: Payment Processing Standards, Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: units_paid
attributes.description: Number of service units paid for this claim line. May differ from units billed if payment is reduced or denied. Units represent quantity of service (visits, days, procedures, etc.).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: units_billed
attributes.description: Number of service units originally billed by the provider for this claim line. Represents quantity of service requested for payment.

attributes.name: payment_rate
attributes.description: Per-unit payment rate applied to calculate the paid amount. Derived from fee schedules, contracted rates, or regulatory payment methodologies.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedules, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: fee_schedule_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the fee schedule used to determine payment rates for this allocation. May reference Medicare fee schedule, state Medicaid schedule, or custom contracted schedule.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedules, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: pricing_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to calculate payment for this claim line. Indicates whether payment is based on fee schedule, percentage of charges, per diem, case rate, DRG, APC, capitation, or other methodology.
attributes.references: CMS Payment Methodologies, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: claim_processed_date
attributes.description: Date when the claim was adjudicated and payment decision was made. Used for turnaround time reporting and prompt payment compliance.
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Financial accounting period (month/year) to which this payment allocation is assigned for financial reporting. Format typically YYYY-MM or period name.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this payment allocation is assigned for financial reporting and budgeting purposes.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this payment allocation is posted for financial accounting. Used for expense categorization and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: GAAP Chart of Accounts, Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center or department code for internal cost allocation and management reporting. Used for operational expense tracking.

attributes.name: medical_loss_ratio_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation is included in Medical Loss Ratio calculations for ACA rebate requirements. True if included in MLR numerator.
attributes.references: ACA Medical Loss Ratio Requirements, 45 CFR 158

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this claim contributes to risk adjustment calculations for Medicare Advantage or ACA marketplace programs. True if risk-adjustable.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, HHS-HCC Risk Adjustment

attributes.name: hedis_reportable_indicator

attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this service is reportable for HEDIS quality measures. True if service contributes to HEDIS numerator or denominator.

attributes.name: quality_measure_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this service is relevant for quality measurement programs (HEDIS, Stars, CAHPS, etc.). True if quality-reportable.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS, CMS Star Ratings, CAHPS

attributes.name: fraud_review_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation was flagged for fraud, waste, or abuse review. True if referred to Special Investigations Unit (SIU).
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Requirements, State FWA Regulations

attributes.name: audit_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation was selected for post-payment audit or medical record review. True if audited.
attributes.references: Payment Integrity Standards, CMS Program Integrity

attributes.name: reconsideration_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation was adjusted following provider request for reconsideration. True if reconsidered.
attributes.references: Provider Contract Terms, Claims Processing Standards

attributes.name: corrected_claim_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation is for a corrected or resubmitted claim. True if claim was corrected after initial submission.

attributes.name: void_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation has been voided and should not be included in financial or utilization reporting. True if voided.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards, Payment Processing Standards

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation represents a reversal of a previous payment. True if reversal transaction.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards, Payment Processing Standards

attributes.name: original_allocation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original claim_payment_allocation_id if this record is an adjustment, reversal, or correction of a prior allocation. Null for original allocations.
attributes.references: Payment Processing Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: adjustment_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the order of adjustments to the original payment allocation. First adjustment is 1, second is 2, etc. Null for original allocations.
attributes.references: Payment Processing Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: payment_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system that generated this payment allocation (Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, etc.). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, System Integration Standards

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment batch or cycle in which this allocation was processed. Used for batch reconciliation and payment tracking.
attributes.references: Payment Processing Standards, Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether this payment allocation has been reconciled with provider accounts and financial systems. Tracks reconciliation lifecycle.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards, Payment Processing Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when this payment allocation was successfully reconciled with provider accounts and financial systems. Null if not yet reconciled.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards, Payment Processing Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this payment allocation. May include special handling instructions, exception explanations, or audit findings.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan member for whom services were rendered and payment is being allocated. Links payment to member account.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification, ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Health plan subscriber identification number as it appears on the member's insurance card. May differ from internal member_id.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification, ANSI X12 270/271 Eligibility

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the claim form type indicating whether services were rendered by professional providers (CMS-1500), institutional facilities (UB-04), dental, pharmacy, or vision providers.

attributes.name: claim_frequency_code
attributes.description: Single-digit code indicating whether claim is original, replacement, void, or adjustment. Used to manage claim resubmissions and corrections.

attributes.name: claim_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the claim was originally received by the health plan. Used for prompt payment compliance and turnaround time calculations.
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: claim_paid_date
attributes.description: Date when payment was issued for the claim. Used for prompt payment compliance and financial reporting.
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: payment_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment batch or cycle in which this allocation was processed. Used for batch reconciliation and payment tracking.
attributes.references: Payment Processing Standards, Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_payment. Business justification: Claim payments are allocated from billing payment batches. Payment operations require tracking which billing payment transaction funded each claim payment for reconciliation and cash application.

attributes.name: capitation_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.capitation_plan. Business justification: Capitated payments allocate to specific capitation plans that define per-member-per-month rates. Finance reconciles claim activity against capitation budgets monthly to track utilization and risk.

attributes.name: program_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_payment. Business justification: Claim payments are allocated from government program payments (capitation, FFS, supplemental). Finance reconciles claim-level payments to CMS remittances and capitation funding daily.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Every claim payment must post to general ledger via journal entries. Finance team reconciles claim payments to GL daily for accurate financial reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.payable. Business justification: Claim payments to providers create accounts payable entries. AP team processes these for cash disbursement, vendor reconciliation, and cash flow forecasting.

products.name: procedure
products.description: Master list of CPT/HCPCS procedure codes applicable to claim lines, with code, description, and billing unit.

attributes.name: procedure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the claim procedure record. Primary key for the claim procedure entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) or Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Code
attributes.description: The standard procedure code from CPT or HCPCS code sets used to identify medical services and procedures for billing and reimbursement.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: code_type
attributes.description: The coding system classification indicating whether the code is from CPT, HCPCS, CDT (dental), or ICD-10-PCS (inpatient procedures).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Healthcare Claim, CMS Coding Standards

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated description of the procedure code, typically 28 characters or less, used for display in constrained UI spaces and reports.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Full detailed description of the medical procedure or service represented by the code, including clinical context and specifications.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the procedure type such as Evaluation and Management, Surgery, Radiology, Laboratory, Anesthesia, Medicine, or Durable Medical Equipment (DME).

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the procedure category, providing additional specificity for procedure grouping and analysis.

attributes.name: modifier_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure code can accept CPT or HCPCS modifiers to provide additional information about the service performed.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: bilateral_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the procedure can be performed bilaterally (on both sides of the body) and qualifies for bilateral pricing adjustments.

attributes.name: assistant_surgeon_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether an assistant surgeon is typically allowed for this procedure and eligible for separate reimbursement.

attributes.name: co_surgeon_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether co-surgeons are typically allowed for this procedure with separate reimbursement for each surgeon.

attributes.name: team_surgery_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure qualifies for team surgery billing where multiple surgeons of different specialties work together.

attributes.name: anesthesia_base_units
attributes.description: The base unit value assigned to anesthesia procedures used in calculating anesthesia reimbursement along with time units and modifying factors.

attributes.name: global_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the global surgical package during which follow-up care is included in the procedure payment and not separately billable.

attributes.name: multiple_procedure_indicator
attributes.description: CMS indicator defining payment adjustment rules when multiple procedures are performed during the same session (0=no adjustment, 1=standard rules apply, 2=bilateral adjustment, etc.).

attributes.name: place_of_service_restriction
attributes.description: Restrictions on where the procedure can be performed (e.g., inpatient only, outpatient only, office setting) affecting coverage and reimbursement.

attributes.name: gender_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates if the procedure is gender-specific and should only be performed on male or female patients, or has no gender restriction.

attributes.name: age_restriction_low
attributes.description: Minimum age in years for which this procedure is typically appropriate or covered, used for claims editing and medical necessity validation.

attributes.name: age_restriction_high
attributes.description: Maximum age in years for which this procedure is typically appropriate or covered, used for claims editing and medical necessity validation.

attributes.name: professional_component_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the procedure can be split into professional and technical components for separate billing (common in radiology and laboratory services).

attributes.name: technical_component_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the procedure has a separately billable technical component covering equipment, supplies, and non-physician staff.

attributes.name: work_relative_value_units
attributes.description: The work component of the relative value unit reflecting physician time, skill, and intensity required to perform the procedure.

attributes.name: practice_expense_rvu
attributes.description: The practice expense component of the relative value unit covering overhead costs such as staff, supplies, and equipment.

attributes.name: malpractice_rvu
attributes.description: The malpractice component of the relative value unit reflecting professional liability insurance costs associated with the procedure.

attributes.name: total_rvu
attributes.description: The sum of work, practice expense, and malpractice RVUs used as the basis for Medicare physician fee schedule payment calculations.

attributes.name: facility_pricing_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure has different pricing when performed in a facility setting versus a non-facility setting.

attributes.name: non_facility_pricing_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure has specific pricing for non-facility settings such as physician offices.

attributes.name: ambulatory_payment_classification
attributes.description: The APC group assignment for outpatient hospital services under the Medicare Outpatient Prospective Payment System (OPPS).

attributes.name: diagnosis_related_group
attributes.description: The DRG classification for inpatient hospital services used in the Medicare Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS).

attributes.name: national_drug_code
attributes.description: The NDC number for procedures involving drug administration, linking the procedure to specific pharmaceutical products.

attributes.name: average_wholesale_price
