attributes.description: The average wholesale price for drug-related procedures, used as a benchmark for pharmacy reimbursement calculations.

attributes.name: maximum_allowable_cost
attributes.description: The maximum reimbursement amount established for generic drugs and multi-source brand drugs in pharmacy benefit management.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the procedure code indicating whether it is actively used for billing, inactive, or deprecated.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this procedure code became valid and available for use in claims processing and billing.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this procedure code was retired or became invalid for billing purposes, used for historical claims processing.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: add_on_code_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is an add-on procedure code that can only be billed in conjunction with a primary procedure code.

attributes.name: primary_procedure_code
attributes.description: The primary procedure code that must be present when billing this add-on code, establishing the required code pairing relationship.

attributes.name: medically_unlikely_edit_value
attributes.description: The maximum number of units of service that would typically be reported for this procedure on a single date of service, used for claims editing.

attributes.name: national_correct_coding_initiative_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure code is subject to NCCI edits that prevent inappropriate code combinations from being billed together.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure requires prior authorization approval before the service can be performed and reimbursed.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether step therapy protocols must be followed before this procedure is covered, requiring trial of less intensive treatments first.

attributes.name: site_of_service_differential
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether reimbursement rates differ based on the site where the service is performed (hospital outpatient vs physician office).

attributes.name: preventive_service_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure is classified as a preventive service eligible for coverage without cost-sharing under the Affordable Care Act (ACA).

attributes.name: telehealth_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure can be performed and billed via telehealth or telemedicine modalities.

attributes.name: quantity_qualifier
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for procedure quantity such as units (UN), minutes (MJ), square feet (F2), milliliters (ML), used in claims billing.

attributes.name: billing_unit
attributes.description: The standard unit of measure for billing this procedure such as per visit, per hour, per session, per unit, or per dose.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards (CMS)

attributes.name: conversion_factor
attributes.description: The dollar amount multiplied by the total RVU to calculate the Medicare payment amount for the procedure, updated annually by CMS.

attributes.name: medicare_covered
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure is covered under Medicare fee-for-service programs.

attributes.name: medicaid_covered
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure is covered under state Medicaid programs, subject to state-specific variations.

attributes.name: commercial_covered
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure is typically covered under commercial health insurance plans.

attributes.name: experimental_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure is considered experimental or investigational and may not be covered by insurance.

attributes.name: cosmetic_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure is considered cosmetic and typically not covered by health insurance unless medically necessary.

attributes.name: bundled_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure is included in a bundled payment arrangement and not separately reimbursable.

attributes.name: quality_measure_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this procedure is associated with HEDIS or other quality measurement programs for performance reporting.

attributes.name: specialty_designation
attributes.description: The medical specialty or provider type most commonly associated with performing this procedure such as cardiology, orthopedics, or radiology.

attributes.name: clinical_category
attributes.description: Broad clinical classification of the procedure for analytics and reporting such as cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, or diagnostic imaging.

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: The UB-04 revenue code used by hospitals and institutional providers to classify the type of service or accommodation provided.

attributes.name: type_of_service
attributes.description: CMS type of service classification used for payment and utilization analysis such as medical care, surgery, consultation, or diagnostic test.

attributes.name: pricing_methodology
attributes.description: The reimbursement methodology used for this procedure such as fee schedule, per diem, case rate, or percentage of charges.

attributes.name: outlier_threshold
attributes.description: The cost threshold above which additional outlier payments may be made for extraordinarily expensive cases under prospective payment systems.

attributes.name: sequestration_adjustment
attributes.description: The percentage reduction applied to Medicare payments due to federal budget sequestration requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this procedure code record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this procedure code record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system or application from which this procedure code data originated such as Facets, QNXT, or HealthRules.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier that last modified this procedure code record.

products.name: classification
products.description: Reference table mapping inpatient claim diagnoses to Diagnosis‑Related Group (DRG) or Ambulatory Payment Classification (APC) categories.

attributes.name: classification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the claim classification record mapping diagnoses to payment groupings.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the claim being classified for payment grouping.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of payment classification system applied to the claim (Diagnosis-Related Group, Ambulatory Payment Classification, Healthcare Resource Group, Resource Utilization Group, Enhanced Ambulatory Patient Group).
attributes.references: CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) and Outpatient Prospective Payment System (OPPS)

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: Three-digit code representing the DRG assignment for inpatient hospital stays based on diagnosis, procedures, age, sex, and discharge status.

attributes.name: drg_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the DRG category assigned to the claim.

attributes.name: drg_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the DRG classification system used (e.g., MS-DRG v40, APR-DRG v38).

attributes.name: drg_type
attributes.description: Specific DRG methodology applied: Medicare Severity DRG, All Patient Refined DRG, All Patient DRG, or International Refined DRG.
attributes.references: CMS and 3M Health Information Systems DRG Methodologies

attributes.name: drg_weight
attributes.description: Relative weight assigned to the DRG reflecting the average resources required to treat patients in that group compared to the national average.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS Final Rule DRG Weights

attributes.name: drg_geometric_mean_los
attributes.business_glossary_term: Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) Geometric Mean Length of Stay
attributes.description: Geometric mean length of stay in days for the assigned DRG, used to identify outlier cases.

attributes.name: drg_arithmetic_mean_los
attributes.business_glossary_term: Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) Arithmetic Mean Length of Stay
attributes.description: Arithmetic mean length of stay in days for the assigned DRG.

attributes.name: apc_code
attributes.description: Four-digit code representing the APC assignment for outpatient hospital services based on clinical similarity and resource consumption.

attributes.name: apc_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the APC category assigned to the outpatient claim.

attributes.name: apc_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the APC classification system used for the payment period.

attributes.name: apc_relative_weight
attributes.description: Relative payment weight assigned to the APC reflecting the resource intensity of the service.
attributes.references: CMS OPPS Final Rule APC Weights

attributes.name: apc_payment_rate
attributes.description: National unadjusted payment rate for the assigned APC before geographic and policy adjustments.

attributes.name: apc_status_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating the payment methodology for the APC (e.g., S=Significant Procedure, T=Surgical Procedure, V=Clinic Visit).

attributes.name: major_diagnostic_category
attributes.description: Broad clinical category (00-25) grouping diagnoses by body system or disease etiology, used as first step in DRG assignment.

attributes.name: mdc_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the Major Diagnostic Category (e.g., Diseases and Disorders of the Nervous System).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Classification of patient severity based on secondary diagnoses and complications, used in MS-DRG and APR-DRG assignment.

attributes.name: mortality_risk_level
attributes.description: Classification of patient mortality risk based on clinical factors, primarily used in APR-DRG methodology.

attributes.name: complication_comorbidity_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Complication or Comorbidity (CC) and Major Complication or Comorbidity (MCC) Level
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the claim includes complications or comorbidities (CC) or major complications or comorbidities (MCC) affecting DRG assignment and payment.

attributes.name: principal_diagnosis_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis code representing the condition established after study to be chiefly responsible for the admission, used as primary input for classification.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: principal_procedure_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-PCS procedure code for the principal procedure performed during the inpatient stay, key factor in DRG assignment.
attributes.references: ICD-10-PCS Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: surgical_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the claim includes a surgical procedure, affecting DRG/APC classification pathway.
attributes.references: CMS DRG and APC Grouper Logic

attributes.name: grouper_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the grouper software used to assign the DRG or APC classification.

attributes.name: grouper_return_code
attributes.description: Code returned by the grouper software indicating the result status of the classification process (e.g., success, warning, error).

attributes.name: grouper_error_message
attributes.description: Descriptive error or warning message returned by the grouper software if classification encountered issues.

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: Date when the DRG or APC classification was assigned to the claim.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the DRG or APC classification was assigned to the claim.

attributes.name: discharge_status_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code indicating the patient's discharge disposition (e.g., 01=Home, 20=Expired, 30=Still Patient), used in DRG assignment.
attributes.references: CMS UB-04 Claim Form FL17 Discharge Status Codes

attributes.name: admission_type_code
attributes.description: Single-digit code indicating the priority of admission (1=Emergency, 2=Urgent, 3=Elective, 4=Newborn, 5=Trauma).
attributes.references: CMS UB-04 Claim Form FL14 Admission Type Codes

attributes.name: admission_source_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the source of the admission (e.g., 1=Non-Healthcare Facility, 4=Transfer from Hospital, 7=Emergency Room).
attributes.references: CMS UB-04 Claim Form FL15 Admission Source Codes

attributes.name: patient_age_years
attributes.description: Patient's age in years at the time of admission or service, used as a factor in DRG/APC assignment.

attributes.name: patient_age_days
attributes.description: Patient's age in days for neonates and infants, used in specific DRG assignments for pediatric cases.

attributes.name: patient_sex
attributes.description: Patient's biological sex (Male, Female, Unknown) used in DRG assignment for sex-specific conditions.

attributes.name: birth_weight_grams
attributes.description: Newborn's birth weight in grams, critical factor for neonatal DRG assignment.

attributes.name: length_of_stay_days
attributes.description: Total number of days the patient remained in the facility, used to identify outlier cases for additional payment.

attributes.name: outlier_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the claim qualifies for outlier payment due to extraordinarily high costs or extended length of stay.

attributes.name: outlier_payment_amount
attributes.description: Additional payment amount approved for outlier cases exceeding cost or length of stay thresholds.

attributes.name: transfer_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the claim represents a transfer case, which may result in adjusted DRG payment.

attributes.name: transfer_drg_payment_amount
attributes.description: Adjusted DRG payment amount for transfer cases, calculated based on per diem rates.

attributes.name: base_drg_payment_amount
attributes.description: Standard DRG payment amount before adjustments for outliers, transfers, or other payment policies.

attributes.name: wage_index
attributes.description: Geographic adjustment factor applied to the labor portion of the DRG payment based on the provider's location.

attributes.name: cost_outlier_threshold
attributes.description: Cost threshold amount that must be exceeded for the claim to qualify for outlier payment.

attributes.name: operating_drg_payment
attributes.description: Operating payment component of the DRG payment covering routine operating costs.

attributes.name: capital_drg_payment
attributes.description: Capital payment component of the DRG payment covering capital-related costs.

attributes.name: disproportionate_share_payment
attributes.description: Additional payment for hospitals serving a disproportionate share of low-income patients.

attributes.name: indirect_medical_education_payment
attributes.description: Additional payment for teaching hospitals to account for higher costs associated with medical education programs.

attributes.name: new_technology_addon_payment
attributes.description: Additional payment for new medical technologies and services not adequately reflected in standard DRG payments.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS New Technology Add-On Payment Policy

attributes.name: readmission_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the admission is a readmission within a specified timeframe, potentially subject to payment penalties.

attributes.name: readmission_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Payment reduction amount applied due to excess readmissions under the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program.

attributes.name: value_based_purchasing_adjustment
attributes.description: Payment adjustment (positive or negative) based on hospital performance on quality measures under the VBP program.

attributes.name: hospital_acquired_condition_penalty
attributes.description: Payment reduction applied to hospitals with high rates of hospital-acquired conditions.

attributes.name: present_on_admission_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating whether the principal diagnosis was present at the time of admission (Y=Yes, N=No, U=Unknown, W=Clinically Undetermined, 1=Exempt).
attributes.references: CMS Present on Admission Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: medicare_severity_level
attributes.description: Numeric severity level (0-3) assigned in MS-DRG methodology based on presence and severity of complications and comorbidities.

attributes.name: case_mix_index
attributes.description: Relative value representing the average DRG weight for the claim, used to measure resource intensity and complexity.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment determination based on the assigned classification.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Source or method by which the classification was assigned (automated grouper, manual review, override, appeal decision).

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for manual override of the automated classification assignment.

attributes.name: override_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the automated classification was manually overridden.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the claims analyst or medical coder who reviewed or overrode the classification.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the classification was reviewed or validated by a claims analyst.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the classification assignment becomes effective for payment purposes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the classification assignment expires or is superseded by a revised classification.

attributes.name: active_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this classification record is currently active and applicable for payment processing.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Insurance product line or program under which the claim is being processed (Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, Exchange, Medicare Advantage, etc.).

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance plan under which the claim is covered (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, Special Needs Plan, etc.).
attributes.references: NAIC Health Insurance Plan Type Classifications

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Broad category of healthcare service provided that determines the applicable classification system (inpatient, outpatient, emergency, etc.).

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare facility where services were rendered, affecting classification and payment methodology.
attributes.value_regex: Acute Care Hospital|Critical Access Hospital|Rehabilitation Hospital|Psychiatric Hospital|Long Term Care Hospital|Ambulatory Surgery Center|Outpatient Clinic
attributes.references: CMS Provider of Services File Facility Type Codes

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: Payment approach used for reimbursement (prospective payment, fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payment, etc.).

attributes.name: bundled_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the claim is part of a bundled payment arrangement where multiple services are paid under a single classification.
attributes.references: CMS Bundled Payments for Care Improvement Initiative

attributes.name: quality_reporting_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the classification is subject to quality measure reporting requirements (HEDIS, CAHPS, etc.).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS and CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the classification contributes to risk adjustment calculations for Medicare Advantage or ACA plans.

attributes.name: hcc_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the principal diagnosis maps to a Hierarchical Condition Category for risk adjustment purposes.

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the classification assignment has been flagged for audit or quality review.

attributes.name: audit_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the classification was flagged for audit (e.g., high payment amount, unusual DRG, coding inconsistency).

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or platform from which the classification data originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the classification record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the classification record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: reviewer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the claims analyst or medical coder who reviewed or overrode the classification.

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Type of claim transaction format (837 Institutional, 837 Professional, UB-04, etc.) that determines classification applicability.

products.name: batch
products.description: Metadata for batches of claims processed together, including batch identifier, processing start/end timestamps, and batch status.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the claim batch. Primary key for the claim batch entity.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable batch number assigned to the claim batch for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of claims contained in the batch, indicating the line of business or service category.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Source or channel through which the claim batch was submitted.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method used to submit the claim batch, indicating whether it was electronic, paper-based, or a combination.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_name
attributes.description: Name of the clearinghouse that processed and forwarded the claim batch, if applicable.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clearinghouse that processed the claim batch.

attributes.name: submitter_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity or individual who submitted the claim batch.

attributes.name: submitter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the submitter of the claim batch.

attributes.name: submitter_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the submitter, if the submitter is a healthcare provider.

attributes.name: submitter_tin
attributes.description: Tax Identification Number of the submitter for financial and tax reporting purposes.

attributes.name: receiver_name
attributes.description: Name of the payer or entity receiving the claim batch for processing.

attributes.name: receiver_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the receiver of the claim batch.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the claim batch.

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason or explanation for the current batch status, especially for rejected or suspended batches.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the claim batch was received by the payer.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the claim batch was received by the payer system.

attributes.name: processing_start_date
attributes.description: Date when processing of the claim batch began.

attributes.name: processing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when processing of the claim batch began.

attributes.name: processing_end_date
attributes.description: Date when processing of the claim batch was completed.

attributes.name: processing_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when processing of the claim batch was completed.

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the claim batch passed validation checks.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the claim batch passed validation checks.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all claims in the batch were fully processed and adjudicated.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when all claims in the batch were fully processed and adjudicated.

attributes.name: total_claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of claims included in the batch.

attributes.name: accepted_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of claims in the batch that were accepted for processing.

attributes.name: rejected_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of claims in the batch that were rejected during processing.

attributes.name: pending_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of claims in the batch that are currently pending review or additional information.

attributes.name: suspended_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of claims in the batch that have been suspended for manual review or investigation.

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount billed across all claims in the batch.

attributes.name: total_allowed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount allowed by the payer across all claims in the batch after applying contract rates and fee schedules.

attributes.name: total_paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the payer across all claims in the batch.

attributes.name: total_member_responsibility_amount
attributes.description: Total amount for which members are responsible across all claims in the batch, including copays, coinsurance, and deductibles.

attributes.name: total_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of adjustments applied across all claims in the batch, including denials, reductions, and contractual adjustments.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in the batch.

attributes.name: processing_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the batch for processing, determining the order and speed of adjudication.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business for the claims in the batch, indicating the insurance product type.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health plan associated with the claims in the batch.

attributes.name: service_date_from
attributes.description: Earliest service date among all claims in the batch.

attributes.name: service_date_to
attributes.description: Latest service date among all claims in the batch.

attributes.name: file_name
attributes.description: Name of the file containing the claim batch data, if submitted electronically.

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Format of the file containing the claim batch data.

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the claim batch file in bytes.

attributes.name: control_number
attributes.description: Interchange control number or transaction control number from the EDI transmission, used for tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_set_identifier
attributes.description: ANSI X12 transaction set identifier indicating the type of claim transaction (837I for institutional, 837P for professional, 837D for dental).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the EDI transaction set or file format used for the batch.

attributes.name: validation_error_count
attributes.description: Number of validation errors encountered during batch processing.

attributes.name: validation_warning_count
attributes.description: Number of validation warnings encountered during batch processing that did not prevent acceptance.

attributes.name: error_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of errors encountered during batch processing, if applicable.

attributes.name: resubmission_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is a resubmission of a previously rejected or corrected batch.

attributes.name: original_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original batch if this is a resubmission or correction.

attributes.name: correction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch contains corrected claims from a previous submission.

attributes.name: test_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is a test submission for validation purposes and should not be processed for payment.

attributes.name: duplicate_check_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether duplicate claim checking was performed on the batch.

attributes.name: duplicate_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of duplicate claims identified in the batch.

attributes.name: fraud_screening_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether fraud, waste, and abuse screening was performed on the batch.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud Waste and Abuse Standards

attributes.name: fraud_alert_count
attributes.description: Number of fraud alerts triggered during batch processing.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud Waste and Abuse Standards

attributes.name: auto_adjudication_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of claims in the batch that were automatically adjudicated without manual intervention.

attributes.name: manual_review_count
attributes.description: Number of claims in the batch that required manual review.

attributes.name: processing_system
attributes.description: Name of the claims processing system that handled the batch (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: processing_environment
attributes.description: System environment in which the batch was processed.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: Target number of hours within which the batch should be processed according to service level agreements.

attributes.name: sla_met_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the batch processing met the defined service level agreement targets.

attributes.name: processing_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes taken to process the batch from start to completion.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_sent_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an acknowledgement (997 or 999 transaction) was sent to the submitter confirming receipt of the batch.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date when the acknowledgement was sent to the submitter.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the acknowledgement was sent to the submitter.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_generated_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an 835 remittance advice was generated for the batch.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_date
attributes.description: Date when the remittance advice was generated for the batch.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when payment was issued for the claims in the batch.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to issue payment for the claims in the batch.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number if payment was issued by check.

attributes.name: eft_trace_number
attributes.description: Trace number for electronic funds transfer if payment was issued electronically.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments related to the batch processing.

attributes.name: archived_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the batch has been archived for long-term storage.

attributes.name: archive_date
attributes.description: Date when the batch was archived.

attributes.name: retention_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the batch record is eligible for deletion according to retention policies.

attributes.name: vendor_compliance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.vendor_compliance. Business justification: Claim batches from clearinghouses and third-party administrators must reference vendor compliance records. Operations validates BAA agreements and HIPAA compliance before processing vendor-submitted c

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Claim batches must be assigned to financial periods for period-end close, accrual accounting, and ensuring claims expense matches the correct reporting period.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Claim batches are reported to state regulators for rate filings, MLR calculations, and compliance reporting. Regulatory affairs teams aggregate claim data for mandatory quarterly/annual submissions.

products.name: event
products.description: Record of significant events affecting a claim (e.g., eligibility check, pricing rule applied, manual edit) with event type and timestamp.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the claim event record.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the claim to which this event relates.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of the event that occurred for the claim.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event was recorded.

attributes.name: claim_line_number
attributes.description: Line number of the claim item affected by the event.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date of service rendered for the claim line.

attributes.name: procedure_code
attributes.description: CPT code representing the procedure performed.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Code
attributes.description: ICD-10 code for the diagnosis associated with the claim line.

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: Revenue code indicating the type of service for billing.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the place where service was provided.

attributes.name: line_charge_amount
attributes.description: Billed amount for the claim line before adjustments.

attributes.name: line_allowed_amount
attributes.description: Allowed amount determined by payer for the claim line.

attributes.name: line_paid_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount paid to provider for the claim line.

attributes.name: line_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total adjustments (deductions) applied to the claim line.

attributes.name: line_adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code describing reason for adjustment.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the claim line.

attributes.name: adjudication_status
attributes.description: Result of the adjudication process for the claim line.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to remit payment to provider.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which payment was issued for the claim line.

attributes.name: cob_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if Coordination of Benefits was applied.

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if subrogation rights are applicable to the claim.

attributes.name: appeal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim line is under appeal.

attributes.name: manual_edit_flag
attributes.description: True if the claim line was manually edited.

attributes.name: edit_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for manual edit of the claim line.

attributes.name: pricing_rule_applied
attributes.description: Identifier of the pricing rule applied during adjudication.

attributes.name: pricing_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique ID of the pricing rule.

attributes.name: claim_category
attributes.description: Specific category within claim type, e.g., inpatient, outpatient.

attributes.name: claim_submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when claim was initially submitted.

attributes.name: claim_processing_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when claim entered processing stage.

attributes.name: claim_payment_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when payment was made for the claim.

attributes.name: claim_reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the claim was reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason for claim reversal.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the provider rendering service.

attributes.name: provider_tax_id
attributes.description: Tax identification number of the provider.

attributes.name: provider_specialty_code
attributes.description: Code representing provider's specialty.

attributes.name: provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the contract under which provider is paid.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the network to which provider belongs.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with the claim.

attributes.name: plan_assignment_id
attributes.description: Plan identifier for the member's health plan.

attributes.name: member_group_number
attributes.description: Group number of the member's employer-sponsored plan.

attributes.name: member_relationship_code
attributes.description: Code indicating member's relationship to primary subscriber.

attributes.name: member_birth_date
attributes.description: Member's date of birth.

attributes.name: member_gender
attributes.description: Member's gender.

attributes.name: member_address
attributes.description: Member's mailing address.

attributes.name: member_phone
attributes.description: Member's contact phone number.

attributes.name: member_email
attributes.description: Member's email address.

attributes.name: claim_event_source_system
attributes.description: Source system where the claim event originated.

attributes.name: claim_line_modifier_codes
attributes.description: Modifier codes applied to the claim line (e.g., 25, 59).

attributes.name: claim_line_units
attributes.description: Units of service billed for the claim line.

attributes.name: claim_line_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of items/services for the claim line.

attributes.name: claim_line_service_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of service period for the claim line.

attributes.name: claim_line_service_end_date
attributes.description: End date of service period for the claim line.

attributes.name: claim_line_place_of_service
attributes.description: Place of service code for the claim line.

attributes.name: claim_line_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes associated with the claim line event.

attributes.name: claim_line_adjustment_group_code
attributes.description: Group code for related adjustments.

attributes.name: claim_line_adjustment_group_description
attributes.description: Description of the adjustment group.

attributes.name: claim_line_tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount applied to the claim line.

attributes.name: claim_line_total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount after all adjustments, taxes, and payments.

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Broad category of the claim.

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Overall status of the claim.

attributes.name: claim_submission_method
attributes.description: Method used to submit the claim.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with the claim.

attributes.name: member_plan_id
attributes.description: Plan identifier for the member's health plan.

attributes.name: case_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.care_case_assignment. Business justification: High-cost or complex claims trigger case management workflows. Claim events (denials, high amounts, readmissions) automatically create or update care case assignments for intervention.

attributes.name: dispute_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_dispute. Business justification: Claim events track disputes between payer and provider regarding payment, coding, or contract interpretation. Provider relations teams link disputed claims to formal contract dispute cases for resolut

attributes.name: control_test_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.control_test. Business justification: SOX and SOC2 auditors test claim processing controls by sampling claim events (status changes, approvals, overrides). Each control test references specific claim events as evidence of control effectiv

products.name: fwa_flag
products.description: Lookup of flags used to mark claims for fraud, waste, or abuse review, including flag code, description, and severity level.

attributes.name: fwa_flag_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Claim Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Flag Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fraud, waste, and abuse flag record used to mark claims for special investigation review.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud Prevention System, HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: flag_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Flag Code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the specific type of fraud, waste, or abuse indicator applied to a claim for investigation purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, False Claims Act

attributes.name: flag_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Flag Name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the fraud, waste, or abuse flag for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Flag Description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the fraud, waste, or abuse pattern or behavior that this flag represents, including detection criteria and business rules.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Anti-Kickback Statute

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the FWA flag indicating whether it represents fraud (intentional deception), waste (inefficient resource use), abuse (improper practice), or specific violation type.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, False Claims Act, Stark Law

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Severity Level
attributes.description: Priority classification indicating the seriousness and urgency of investigation required for claims marked with this flag, ranging from critical (immediate investigation) to informational (monitoring only).
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Special Investigations Unit (SIU) Guidelines

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Risk Score
attributes.description: Numerical risk assessment score (0-100) indicating the likelihood and potential financial impact of fraud, waste, or abuse associated with this flag type.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Predictive Analytics Guidelines

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Detection Method
attributes.description: The analytical or investigative technique used to identify and flag potential fraud, waste, or abuse patterns in claims data.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud Prevention System, Cotiviti Payment Accuracy Guidelines

attributes.name: action_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Action Required
attributes.description: The mandatory workflow action or investigation step that must be taken when a claim is marked with this FWA flag.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Special Investigations Unit (SIU) Procedures

attributes.name: auto_deny_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether claims marked with this FWA flag should be automatically denied without manual review.
attributes.references: CMS Claims Processing Manual, Payment Integrity Guidelines

attributes.name: siu_referral_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether claims with this flag must be escalated to the Special Investigations Unit for formal fraud investigation.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Special Investigations Unit (SIU) Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether detection of this FWA pattern requires mandatory reporting to regulatory authorities such as CMS, state insurance departments, or law enforcement.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, False Claims Act, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: financial_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount threshold that must be exceeded for this FWA flag to trigger investigation or escalation actions.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Payment Integrity Guidelines

attributes.name: lookback_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days to retrospectively analyze claims history when this FWA flag is triggered, used to identify patterns and calculate exposure.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Claims Audit Guidelines

attributes.name: applicable_claim_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of claim types (medical, pharmacy, dental, vision, institutional, professional) to which this FWA flag applies.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Transaction Standards, CMS Claims Processing Manual

attributes.name: applicable_service_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of healthcare service categories (inpatient, outpatient, emergency, DME, home health, etc.) where this FWA flag is relevant.
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes, Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS)

attributes.name: provider_specialty_filter
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of provider specialty codes or taxonomy classifications to which this FWA flag specifically applies, used to target detection rules.
attributes.references: National Provider Identifier (NPI) Taxonomy, CMS Provider Specialty Codes

attributes.name: procedure_code_pattern
attributes.description: Regular expression or wildcard pattern defining Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS), or other procedure codes that trigger this FWA flag.
attributes.references: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS)

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_pattern
attributes.description: Regular expression or wildcard pattern defining International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) diagnosis codes that trigger this FWA flag when present on claims.

attributes.name: statistical_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numerical threshold value (e.g., standard deviations, percentile rank, frequency count) that must be exceeded for statistical outlier detection to trigger this FWA flag.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud Prevention System, Statistical Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: peer_comparison_percentile
attributes.description: Percentile threshold (0-100) used in peer comparison analysis; providers exceeding this percentile for specific metrics trigger this FWA flag.
attributes.references: CMS Comparative Billing Reports, Peer Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: recurrence_threshold_count
attributes.description: Number of times a specific pattern or behavior must occur within the lookback period before this FWA flag is triggered.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Pattern Detection Guidelines

attributes.name: status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Flag Status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the FWA flag indicating whether it is actively being applied to claims processing and investigation workflows.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this FWA flag became active and began being applied to claims processing and fraud detection workflows.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this FWA flag was retired or deactivated and is no longer applied to new claims, though historical flagged claims remain marked.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the FWA flag definition, detection rules, and thresholds were last reviewed and validated for continued effectiveness.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Quality Assurance Guidelines

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review and validation of this FWA flag's detection rules and effectiveness.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Quality Assurance Guidelines

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the program integrity analyst or system administrator who created this FWA flag definition.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the supervisor or compliance officer who approved this FWA flag for production use.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific legal or regulatory reference (statute, regulation, or guidance document) that defines or mandates detection of this FWA pattern.
attributes.references: False Claims Act, Anti-Kickback Statute, Stark Law, CMS Regulations

attributes.name: estimated_annual_savings
attributes.description: Projected annual cost savings or loss prevention amount resulting from detection and prevention of this FWA pattern.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Return on Investment (ROI) Analysis

attributes.name: historical_detection_count
attributes.description: Total number of claims that have been flagged with this FWA indicator since its inception, used for effectiveness tracking.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Performance Metrics

attributes.name: false_positive_rate
attributes.description: Percentage (0-100) of flagged claims that were determined upon investigation to be legitimate, indicating the precision of this FWA detection rule.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud Prevention System, Quality Metrics

attributes.name: true_positive_rate
attributes.description: Percentage (0-100) of flagged claims that were confirmed as actual fraud, waste, or abuse upon investigation, indicating detection accuracy.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud Prevention System, Quality Metrics

attributes.name: average_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Mean dollar amount recovered or prevented per confirmed FWA case detected by this flag, used to measure financial impact.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Financial Recovery Tracking

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the predictive analytics model or rules engine configuration used to generate this FWA flag, supporting model governance and traceability.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud Prevention System, Model Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: data_source_systems
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of source systems (claims, pharmacy, provider, member) from which data is analyzed to detect this FWA pattern.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Data Integration Guidelines

attributes.name: notification_template
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the communication template used to notify investigators, providers, or members when this FWA flag is triggered.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Communication Guidelines

attributes.name: escalation_path
attributes.description: Defined workflow or organizational hierarchy for escalating confirmed FWA cases detected by this flag, including Special Investigations Unit (SIU), legal, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Special Investigations Unit (SIU) Procedures

attributes.name: documentation_requirements
attributes.description: Specific medical records, supporting documentation, or evidence that must be requested from providers when claims are flagged with this FWA indicator.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Medical Review Guidelines

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether claims examiners and investigators require specialized training to properly investigate claims marked with this FWA flag.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Training Guidelines

attributes.name: external_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this FWA flag was developed by an external payment integrity vendor (e.g., Cotiviti) versus internal program integrity team.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Vendor Management Guidelines

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external payment integrity or fraud detection vendor that developed or maintains this FWA flag, if applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Vendor Management Guidelines

attributes.name: integration_system
attributes.description: Name of the claims administration or payment integrity system (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Cotiviti) where this FWA flag is implemented and applied during claims processing.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, System Integration Guidelines

attributes.name: case_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.care_case_assignment. Business justification: Fraud/waste/abuse flags on claims trigger special investigation unit (SIU) case assignments. Care domain manages these investigative cases with dedicated teams and workflows.

attributes.name: sanction_screening_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.sanction_screening. Business justification: Fraud, waste, and abuse detection flags claims from sanctioned providers. SIU investigators link FWA alerts to specific sanction screening results to document exclusion violations and trigger payment

attributes.name: investigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.investigation. Business justification: FWA flags on claims trigger investigations. Once an investigation is opened, the flag must reference it to track resolution status and prevent duplicate investigations on the same fraud pattern.

attributes.name: breach_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.breach_incident. Business justification: When FWA investigation reveals unauthorized PHI access or data misuse during claim processing, it triggers a breach incident. Privacy office tracks which claims were involved in the breach.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim. Business justification: FWA flag is generated per claim; adding claim_id links the flag to its claim for traceability and reporting.

products.name: payment_schedule
products.description: Schedule of anticipated claim payments, including due dates, installment amounts, and payment method.

attributes.name: payment_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the claim payment schedule record. Primary key for tracking scheduled payment installments and their associated details.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the parent claim for which this payment schedule is established. Links the payment schedule to the originating claim submission.

attributes.name: payment_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the order of this payment installment within the overall payment schedule (e.g., 1 for first payment, 2 for second payment).

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment installment is scheduled to be processed and disbursed to the provider or member.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount scheduled to be paid in this installment. Represents a portion or full amount of the total claim payment obligation.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: payment_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the payment instrument or mechanism to be used for disbursement (e.g., ACH for Automated Clearing House, EFT for Electronic Funds Transfer, CHECK for paper check).

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of this scheduled payment installment indicating its position in the payment lifecycle from scheduling through final disbursement or cancellation.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment indicating whether it represents a full claim payment, partial payment, installment in a series, advance payment, or final settlement.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recipient entity type receiving this scheduled payment (e.g., healthcare provider, member for reimbursement, facility, third-party vendor).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: payee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the entity receiving the payment. May represent provider NPI, member ID, facility ID, or vendor ID depending on payee type.

attributes.name: payee_tax_id
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number of the payee entity. Required for IRS reporting and payment processing compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1179, CMS Provider Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: payment_address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the mailing address where payment check or correspondence should be sent. Primary street address component.

attributes.name: payment_address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the payment mailing address for suite numbers, apartment numbers, or additional address details.

attributes.name: payment_city
attributes.description: City name component of the payment mailing address.

attributes.name: payment_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the payment mailing address. Uses standard USPS state abbreviations.

attributes.name: payment_zip_code
attributes.description: Five or nine-digit postal code for the payment mailing address. Supports both standard and ZIP+4 formats.

attributes.name: payment_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the payment mailing address. Supports international payment processing.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number for electronic payment disbursement via ACH or EFT. Encrypted and protected per PCI DSS standards.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing transit number identifying the financial institution for electronic payment processing.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules, Federal Reserve ABA Routing Number Standards

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account type for electronic payment disbursement (checking, savings, business accounts).

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code indicating the currency in which the payment will be disbursed (e.g., USD for US Dollars).

attributes.name: original_scheduled_date
attributes.description: The initial date on which this payment was originally scheduled before any modifications or rescheduling occurred. Maintains audit trail of schedule changes.

attributes.name: actual_payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the payment was processed and disbursed. Populated after payment execution for reconciliation and reporting.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: actual_payment_amount
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount disbursed in this payment. May differ from scheduled amount due to adjustments, offsets, or recoupments.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: payment_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of adjustments applied to the scheduled payment amount. Represents the difference between scheduled and actual payment amounts.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: payment_adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standard code indicating the reason for payment adjustment (e.g., offset, recoupment, coordination of benefits, prior overpayment recovery).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (CARC)

attributes.name: payment_adjustment_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description explaining the reason for the payment adjustment. Provides context beyond the standard reason code.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Unique check number assigned when payment method is paper check. Used for payment tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: eft_trace_number
attributes.description: Unique trace number assigned to electronic funds transfer transactions. Enables tracking and reconciliation of ACH and wire payments.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the remittance advice document (835 transaction) associated with this payment. Links payment to detailed claim-level remittance information.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment batch in which this scheduled payment is grouped for processing. Enables batch-level tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment processing batch was executed. Represents the business date of the payment cycle.

attributes.name: hold_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this scheduled payment is currently on hold and should not be processed. Used for payment suspension pending investigation or resolution.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason why the payment is on hold (e.g., fraud investigation, member request, provider dispute, coordination of benefits pending).

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description explaining why the payment is on hold. Provides additional context for hold resolution.

attributes.name: hold_placed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment hold was placed. Used for tracking hold duration and aging analysis.

attributes.name: hold_released_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment hold was released and the payment was cleared for processing.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Interest amount calculated and added to the payment due to delayed payment processing beyond regulatory or contractual timeframes.
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, CMS Prompt Payment Requirements

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to calculate interest on delayed payments. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%).
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, CMS Prompt Payment Requirements

attributes.name: interest_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which interest calculation begins for delayed payment. Typically based on regulatory prompt payment timeframes.
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, CMS Prompt Payment Requirements

attributes.name: interest_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which interest is calculated for delayed payment. Typically the actual payment date.
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, CMS Prompt Payment Requirements

attributes.name: offset_amount
attributes.description: Amount deducted from the scheduled payment to recover prior overpayments or other obligations owed by the payee.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: offset_reason_code
attributes.description: Standard code indicating the reason for payment offset (e.g., prior overpayment recovery, recoupment, third-party liability).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (CARC)

attributes.name: offset_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number of the original claim from which overpayment is being recovered through this offset. Provides audit trail for recoupment.

attributes.name: cob_payer_name
attributes.description: Name of the other insurance carrier responsible for primary or secondary payment under coordination of benefits rules. Impacts payment scheduling and amounts.
attributes.references: NAIC Model COB Regulation, ANSI X12 837

attributes.name: cob_payer_responsibility
attributes.description: Classification of this payers responsibility level in coordination of benefits scenarios (primary, secondary, tertiary).
attributes.references: NAIC Model COB Regulation, ANSI X12 837

attributes.name: cob_amount_paid_by_other
attributes.business_glossary_term: Coordination of Benefits (COB) Amount Paid by Other Payer
attributes.description: Amount paid by another insurance carrier under coordination of benefits. Used to calculate this payers payment obligation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model COB Regulation, ANSI X12 835

attributes.name: subrogation_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment is subject to subrogation recovery from a third party liable for the members injury or illness.
attributes.references: ERISA Subrogation Rules, State Subrogation Laws

attributes.name: subrogation_case_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subrogation case associated with this payment. Links payment to third-party liability recovery efforts.

attributes.name: payment_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this scheduled payment for processing queue management (e.g., urgent for prompt payment compliance, normal for standard processing).

attributes.name: payment_notification_email
attributes.description: Email address to which payment notification and remittance advice should be sent. Used for electronic payment communication.

attributes.name: payment_notification_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for payment notification and inquiry. Used for payee contact regarding payment status and issues.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan member associated with the claim for which this payment is scheduled. Links payment to member eligibility and benefits.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, ANSI X12 834

attributes.name: member_name
attributes.description: Full name of the health plan member associated with the claim. Used for payment reconciliation and member communication.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Employer or group identifier under which the member is enrolled. Used for payment allocation and employer reporting.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance product line under which the claim and payment are processed (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Marketplace).
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the specific health plan under which the member is enrolled and the claim is being paid.

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the service period for which the claim payment is being made. Used for payment period tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the service period for which the claim payment is being made. Used for payment period tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: total_claim_amount
attributes.description: Total approved payment amount for the entire claim. The sum of all scheduled payment installments should equal this amount.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding balance remaining to be paid on the claim after this scheduled payment. Used for tracking payment completion status.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Description of the payment terms and schedule agreed upon for this claim (e.g., Net 30, installment plan details, payment frequency).
attributes.references: Provider Contract Terms, Internal Payment Processing Standards

attributes.name: installment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the installment payment plan under which this scheduled payment is structured. Links multiple payment schedules to a common plan.

attributes.name: total_installments
attributes.description: Total number of payment installments planned for this claim. Used to track payment schedule completion.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this scheduled payment was cancelled. Populated when payment is voided or reversed before processing.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason why the scheduled payment was cancelled (e.g., claim denied on appeal, duplicate payment, member request).

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description explaining why the scheduled payment was cancelled. Provides additional context for audit and reporting.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment has been reversed after initial processing. Used for payment correction and recoupment tracking.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was reversed. Populated when a processed payment is voided and funds are recovered.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason why the payment was reversed (e.g., overpayment identified, duplicate payment, fraud detection).

attributes.name: reversal_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount reversed from the original payment. May be partial or full reversal of the payment.

attributes.name: payment_processor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the payment processor for tracking and reconciliation of this payment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number provided by the payment processor upon successful payment processing. Used for payment verification and inquiry.

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, instructions, or special handling requirements for this scheduled payment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment schedule record was initially created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment schedule record was last modified. Used for tracking changes and data currency.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source claims administration system from which this payment schedule record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this payment schedule record in the source claims administration system. Used for data reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Human-readable claim number assigned by the claims administration system. Used for member and provider communication regarding payment schedules.

attributes.name: payment_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment batch in which this scheduled payment is grouped for processing. Enables batch-level tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan member associated with the claim for which this payment is scheduled. Links payment to member eligibility and benefits.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, ANSI X12 834

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the claim type for which this payment is scheduled (e.g., medical, pharmacy, dental, vision, behavioral health).

attributes.name: contract_payment_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_payment_schedule. Business justification: Claim payments follow contracted payment schedules that define timing, frequency, and method (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly). Accounts payable uses contract payment terms to schedule provider remittances

products.name: submitter
products.description: Master reference table for submitter. Referenced by submitter_id.

attributes.name: submitter_id
attributes.description: Primary key for submitter

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Legal name of the organization or individual submitting claims.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: 10-digit identifier assigned to health care providers for claim submission.

attributes.name: tax_id
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number for the submitter organization.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the submitter.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, floor).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the submitter's address.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code of the submitter's address.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code for the submitter's address.

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the submitter.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the submitter.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic communications with the submitter.

attributes.name: submitter_type
attributes.description: Category of the entity submitting claims.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the submitter in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the submitter became active for claim submissions.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the submitter's ability to submit claims ended, if applicable.

attributes.name: claim_submission_method
attributes.description: Method used by the submitter to submit claims.

attributes.name: claim_format
attributes.description: Standard format used for claim transmission.

attributes.name: remittance_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary address where remittance advices are sent.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Submitter's bank account number for electronic payments.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Routing number for the submitter's bank.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for receiving payments from Health.

products.name: receiver
products.description: Master reference table for receiver. Referenced by receiver_id.

attributes.name: receiver_id
attributes.description: Primary key for receiver

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Legal name of the receiver (e.g., provider or pharmacy).

attributes.name: receiver_type
attributes.description: Category of the receiver indicating the type of entity receiving claim payments.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: 10-digit identifier assigned to health care providers in the  States.

attributes.name: tax_id
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number for the receiver organization.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the receiver.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City component of the receiver's address.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the receiver's address.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code for the receiver's address.

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the receiver.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the receiver.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic communications with the receiver.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for sending payments to the receiver.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number where payments are deposited.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: 9-digit routing number for the receiver's bank.

attributes.name: payment_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for payments to the receiver.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual terms defining when payment is due to the receiver.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the receiver.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the receiver became active in the system.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the receiver's relationship ended or is scheduled to end.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the receiver record was initially created.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
