attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the receiver record.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment made to the receiver.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment made to the receiver.

domains.name: member
domains.description: Central repository for all member demographics, enrollment status, eligibility periods, coverage history, and member identifiers (subscriber, dependent relationships). Serves as SSOT for all party data including individuals, families, and group associations across all LOBs (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid). Supports 834 enrollment transactions.

products.name: member_profile
products.description: Core master entity representing an individual member with personal identifiers, demographic attributes, and core status.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the member profile record. Serves as the primary key for member identification across all systems and LOBs.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, ANSI X12 834 Transaction Set

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the primary subscriber on the health insurance policy. Used for member identification in claims, eligibility, and enrollment transactions.

attributes.name: member_number
attributes.description: Unique member identification number printed on the member ID card. Used by providers for eligibility verification and claims submission.

attributes.name: ssn
attributes.description: Nine-digit Social Security Number issued by the Social Security Administration. Used for member identification, tax reporting, and coordination of benefits.
attributes.references: Social Security Act, HIPAA Privacy Rule, IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: medicare_beneficiary_id
attributes.description: Eleven-character Medicare Beneficiary Identifier assigned by CMS. Replaces the SSN-based HICN for Medicare members.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act (MACRA), 42 CFR 424.516

attributes.name: medicaid_id
attributes.description: State-issued Medicaid identification number for members enrolled in Medicaid or dual-eligible programs.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the member as it appears on official identification documents.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or middle initial of the member.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname) of the member as it appears on official identification documents.

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Generational or professional suffix appended to the member's name (e.g., Jr., Sr., III).

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Member's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used for age calculation, eligibility determination, and member identification.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514, ANSI X12 834

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Member's gender as recorded for insurance and medical purposes. Values: M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown, X=Non-binary/Other.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834, HL7 FHIR Administrative Gender

attributes.name: marital_status
attributes.description: Member's current marital status. Used for dependent eligibility determination and benefits coordination.

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code representing the member's preferred language for communication and materials.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1, ACA Section 1557 Language Access Requirements

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for member communications, EOBs, and digital correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the member, including area code.

attributes.name: secondary_phone_number
attributes.description: Alternate contact phone number for the member.

attributes.name: mobile_phone_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for SMS notifications, appointment reminders, and mobile app access.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and unit/apartment number.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional address details such as building name, suite, or floor.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City name of the member's primary residence address.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or territory code of the member's primary residence address.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit ZIP code of the member's primary residence address.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County name of the member's primary residence. Used for network assignment and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ANSI INCITS 31, CMS County Code Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the member's primary residence address.

attributes.name: mailing_address_same_as_primary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mailing Address Same as Primary Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the mailing address is the same as the primary residence address.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for mailing correspondence if different from residence address.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City name of the mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code of the mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the mailing address.

attributes.name: relationship_to_subscriber
attributes.description: Member's relationship to the primary subscriber on the policy. Self indicates the member is the subscriber.

attributes.name: member_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status of the member. Active members have current coverage; inactive/terminated members do not.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment processing status indicating whether the member is fully enrolled, pending enrollment, or in disenrollment process.

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's health insurance coverage becomes effective and claims can be processed.

attributes.name: coverage_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's health insurance coverage ends. Null if coverage is currently active.

attributes.name: original_effective_date
attributes.description: Date of the member's initial enrollment with the health plan, regardless of coverage gaps or plan changes.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the member was enrolled in the current plan or coverage period.

attributes.name: disenrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the member was disenrolled from the plan.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for coverage termination (e.g., voluntary termination, non-payment, loss of eligibility).

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business classification indicating the type of health insurance product (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace, etc.).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, CMS Program Requirements

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance plan structure (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, etc.) that determines network and coverage rules.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal product code identifying the specific health insurance product the member is enrolled in.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Marketing or business name of the health insurance product.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider network assigned to the member based on geography and plan type.

attributes.name: pcp_npi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) National Provider Identifier (NPI)
attributes.description: Ten-digit NPI of the member's assigned or selected Primary Care Physician. Required for HMO and POS plans.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR 162.406, ANSI X12 834

attributes.name: pcp_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when the current PCP was assigned or selected by the member.

attributes.name: pcp_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the PCP assignment becomes effective for referrals and care coordination.

attributes.name: employer_group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employer group sponsoring the member's coverage. Null for individual/retail members.

attributes.name: employer_group_name
attributes.description: Name of the employer or group sponsor providing health insurance benefits.

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: Type of funding arrangement for the health plan (fully insured, self-funded/ASO, level-funded, etc.).

attributes.name: cobra_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member is enrolled under COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event
attributes.description: Type of qualifying event that triggered COBRA eligibility (termination, divorce, loss of dependent status, etc.).

attributes.name: cobra_effective_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Effective Date
attributes.description: Date when COBRA continuation coverage became effective.

attributes.name: cobra_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Expiration Date
attributes.description: Date when COBRA continuation coverage eligibility expires (typically 18 or 36 months from qualifying event).

attributes.name: medicare_part_a_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's Medicare Part A (hospital insurance) coverage became effective. Used for COB and dual eligibility determination.

attributes.name: medicare_part_b_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's Medicare Part B (medical insurance) coverage became effective. Used for COB and dual eligibility determination.

attributes.name: medicare_part_d_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage.
attributes.references: Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act of 2003

attributes.name: dual_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member is eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid benefits.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_status_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the type of dual eligibility status (full, partial, QMB, SLMB, QI, QDWI).

attributes.name: low_income_subsidy_level
attributes.description: Percentage of Low Income Subsidy (Extra Help) the member receives for Medicare Part D prescription drug costs.
attributes.references: 42 CFR 423.773, CMS Part D LIS Guidelines

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has been diagnosed with End Stage Renal Disease, qualifying for special Medicare eligibility.

attributes.name: disability_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has a qualifying disability status for Medicare or other program eligibility.

attributes.name: hospice_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member is currently enrolled in hospice care.

attributes.name: institutional_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member resides in an institutional setting (nursing home, long-term care facility).

attributes.name: tobacco_use_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member uses tobacco products. Used for premium rating under ACA guidelines.

attributes.name: student_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is a full-time or part-time student. Used for dependent eligibility determination beyond age 18.

attributes.name: vip_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has VIP status requiring special handling or enhanced service.

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Member's preferred method for receiving communications, EOBs, and plan materials.

attributes.name: paperless_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has opted for paperless communications and electronic delivery of documents.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has consented to receive marketing communications.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act, TCPA, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization on File
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a valid HIPAA authorization for disclosure of PHI is on file.

attributes.name: advance_directive_on_file
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has an advance directive (living will, healthcare proxy) on file.

attributes.name: care_management_program_enrolled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member is enrolled in a care management or disease management program.

attributes.name: care_management_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the care management or disease management program the member is enrolled in (e.g., Diabetes Management, CHF Program).

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk adjustment score based on HCC coding and demographic factors. Used for Medicare Advantage payment and care management stratification.
attributes.references: 42 CFR 422.308, CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Categorical risk stratification tier based on clinical complexity, utilization patterns, and predictive modeling.

attributes.name: attribution_method
attributes.description: Method used to attribute the member to a provider, ACO, or care team for value-based care programs.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Attribution Methodology, NCQA PCMH Standards

attributes.name: attributed_provider_npi
attributes.description: NPI of the provider or practice to whom the member is attributed for value-based care arrangements.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule, CMS ACO Program

attributes.name: aco_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Accountable Care Organization the member is attributed to.

attributes.name: group_practice_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) Practice Identifier
attributes.description: Identifier for the NCQA-recognized Patient Centered Medical Home practice the member is assigned to.

attributes.name: pharmacy_benefit_manager
attributes.description: Name of the Pharmacy Benefit Manager administering the member's prescription drug benefits.

attributes.name: rx_group_number
attributes.description: Pharmacy benefit group number printed on the member ID card for pharmacy claims adjudication.

attributes.name: rx_bin_number
attributes.description: Six-digit BIN number identifying the pharmacy benefit processor for electronic claims routing.

attributes.name: rx_pcn_number
attributes.description: Processor Control Number for pharmacy claims routing and benefit plan identification.

attributes.name: behavioral_health_carve_out
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether behavioral health benefits are administered by a separate carve-out vendor.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act

attributes.name: behavioral_health_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the behavioral health carve-out vendor administering mental health and substance use disorder benefits.

attributes.name: dental_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has dental insurance coverage.

attributes.name: vision_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has vision insurance coverage.

attributes.name: hsa_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member's plan is HSA-qualified under IRS guidelines.

attributes.name: hsa_account_number
attributes.description: Account number for the member's Health Savings Account if applicable.

attributes.name: hra_balance
attributes.description: Current balance in the member's Health Reimbursement Arrangement account.

attributes.name: fsa_balance
attributes.description: Current balance in the member's Flexible Spending Account for healthcare expenses.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount the member must meet before insurance begins paying benefits.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, Summary of Benefits and Coverage

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum annual out-of-pocket expense limit for covered services under the member's plan.

attributes.name: copay_tier
attributes.description: Copayment tier or benefit level assigned to the member, determining cost-sharing amounts.

attributes.name: metal_level
attributes.description: ACA marketplace metal tier indicating actuarial value of the plan (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Catastrophic).

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Monthly premium amount charged for the member's health insurance coverage.

attributes.name: premium_subsidy_amount
attributes.description: Monthly premium subsidy or tax credit amount applied to reduce the member's premium (e.g., ACA Advanced Premium Tax Credit).

attributes.name: premium_payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the member's premium is paid (payroll deduction, direct bill, ACH, credit card, etc.).

attributes.name: premium_payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of premium payments (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual).

attributes.name: last_premium_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent premium payment received for the member's coverage.

attributes.name: premium_paid_through_date
attributes.description: Date through which premiums have been paid and coverage is current.
attributes.references: Internal Billing System, Grace Period Rules

attributes.name: grace_period_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member is currently in a premium payment grace period.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the premium payment grace period expires and coverage may be terminated.

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has other health insurance coverage requiring coordination of benefits.
attributes.references: NAIC Model COB Regulation, ANSI X12 837

attributes.name: cob_primary_payer
attributes.description: Indicates which insurance is primary for COB purposes (self, other commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, etc.).

attributes.name: other_insurance_carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the other insurance carrier when COB applies.

attributes.name: other_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy or member number with the other insurance carrier for COB processing.

attributes.name: subrogation_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has a potential subrogation case (auto accident, liability claim, workers compensation).

attributes.name: fraud_alert_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Alert Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has been flagged for potential fraud, waste, or abuse investigation.

attributes.name: special_investigation_unit_case
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member is subject to an active SIU investigation.

attributes.name: member_portal_registered
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has registered for the online member portal.

attributes.name: member_portal_username
attributes.description: Username for the member's online portal account.

attributes.name: mobile_app_user
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has downloaded and registered for the mobile app.

attributes.name: last_portal_login_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the member's most recent login to the member portal or mobile app.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Most recent customer satisfaction score or Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the member.

attributes.name: last_survey_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent member satisfaction survey completed by the member.

attributes.name: grievance_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal grievances filed by the member.

attributes.name: appeal_count
attributes.description: Total number of appeals filed by the member for denied claims or coverage decisions.

attributes.name: last_grievance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent grievance filed by the member.

attributes.name: last_appeal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent appeal filed by the member.

attributes.name: member_since_date
attributes.description: Date when the individual first became a member with the organization, regardless of coverage gaps.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent contact or interaction with the member (phone call, email, portal message, etc.).

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time
attributes.description: Member's preferred time of day for receiving phone calls or outreach.

attributes.name: do_not_contact_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has requested not to be contacted for non-essential communications.
attributes.references: TCPA, State Do Not Call Registries

attributes.name: deceased_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member is deceased.
attributes.references: Social Security Death Master File, State Vital Records

attributes.name: date_of_death
attributes.description: Date of the member's death if deceased.
attributes.references: Social Security Death Master File, State Vital Records

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or platform from which the member record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member in the source system of record.

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current version of the member record became effective.

attributes.name: record_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the current version of the member record was superseded or became inactive. Null for current records.

attributes.name: current_record_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current active version of the member record.

attributes.name: pcmh_practice_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) Practice Identifier
attributes.description: Identifier for the NCQA-recognized Patient Centered Medical Home practice the member is assigned to.

attributes.name: primary_care_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider. Business justification: Member profiles store assigned PCP for care coordination and referral management. Used in eligibility verification, claims processing, and member ID card generation.

products.name: member_identifier
products.description: All identifiers associated with a member such as subscriber ID, SSN, MRN, and external system IDs.

attributes.name: member_identifier_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each member identifier record. Serves as the primary key for the member identifier entity.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the member entity this identifier belongs to. Links identifier records to the core member profile.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the identifier type indicating the source system, purpose, or context of the identifier. Supports multiple identifier types per member across different systems and programs.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The actual identifier value assigned to the member. This is the unique alphanumeric string that identifies the member in the specified context or system.

attributes.name: ssn
attributes.description: Member's Social Security Number used for identity verification, tax reporting, and coordination of benefits. Must comply with HIPAA privacy and security requirements.
attributes.references: Social Security Act, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514(b)

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Primary subscriber identifier assigned by Healthcare. This is the main member identification number used across systems and printed on member ID cards.

attributes.name: member_number
attributes.description: Unique member number assigned to each individual covered under a policy, including dependents. Distinguishes between subscriber and dependent members.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834, Internal Member Management Standards

attributes.name: medicaid_id
attributes.description: State-issued Medicaid identification number for members enrolled in Medicaid managed care programs. Format varies by state.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR 438

attributes.name: medicare_id
attributes.description: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI) assigned by CMS for members enrolled in Medicare Advantage or Part D plans. Replaced SSN-based HICNs in 2019.

attributes.name: hicn
attributes.description: Legacy Health Insurance Claim Number used prior to MBI implementation. Retained for historical claims and transition period processing.

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: Medical Record Number assigned by healthcare providers or health systems. Used for care coordination and medical record linkage.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Patient Resource, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: external_system_id
attributes.description: Identifier assigned by external systems such as employer HR systems, third-party administrators, or partner organizations. Enables cross-system member matching.

attributes.name: external_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the external system that assigned the external system identifier. Examples include employer HRIS, TPA systems, or state exchange platforms.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Employer-assigned employee identification number used for group enrollment and billing. Links member to employer group coverage.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Group policy number identifying the employer or organization providing coverage. Used for eligibility verification and claims processing.

attributes.name: dependent_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned to dependents under a subscriber policy. Subscriber is typically 00 or 01, with dependents numbered sequentially.

attributes.name: alternate_id
attributes.description: Alternative member identifier used for specific purposes such as pharmacy benefits, behavioral health carve-outs, or specialty programs.

attributes.name: legacy_system_id
attributes.description: Member identifier from legacy or acquired systems retained for historical data linkage and migration tracking.

attributes.name: exchange_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by federal or state health insurance exchanges for members enrolled through marketplace platforms.

attributes.name: state_id
attributes.description: State-issued identification number such as driver's license or state ID card number used for identity verification and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: pharmacy_card_id
attributes.description: Pharmacy benefit card identifier used at point of sale for prescription drug claims. May differ from medical member ID.

attributes.name: bin_number
attributes.description: Six-digit Bank Identification Number used in pharmacy claims processing to route transactions to the correct PBM processor.

attributes.name: pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number used in pharmacy claims to identify the specific benefit plan or processing rules to apply.

attributes.name: card_id
attributes.description: Identifier printed on the physical or digital member ID card. May be the same as subscriber ID or a separate card-specific identifier.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier assigned to the member if they are also a healthcare provider. Used for provider-member relationship tracking.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) used for tax reporting, 1095 forms, and financial transactions related to the member.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Regulations, ACA Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: biometric_id
attributes.description: Biometric identifier such as fingerprint hash or facial recognition token used for secure member authentication in digital channels.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312, State Biometric Privacy Laws

attributes.name: device_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for member's registered device used for mobile app access, telehealth, or remote monitoring programs.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule, Mobile Device Management Standards

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the identifier indicating whether it is actively in use, suspended, or terminated. Supports identifier lifecycle management.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the primary identifier for the member. Each member should have one primary identifier per identifier type.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the identifier became active and valid for use. Supports temporal tracking of identifier changes.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834, Internal Data Management Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the identifier was terminated or became invalid. Null if identifier is still active.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834, Internal Data Management Standards

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the identifier was originally issued or assigned to the member.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the identifier was last verified for accuracy and validity through data quality processes or member contact.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify or validate the identifier. Indicates the source and reliability of the identifier data.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of identifier verification indicating whether the identifier has been validated against authoritative sources.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Organization or entity that issued the identifier. Examples include CMS for Medicare IDs, state agencies for Medicaid IDs, or Healthcare for subscriber IDs.

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code indicating the state that issued the identifier. Applicable for state-specific identifiers such as Medicaid IDs or state exchange IDs.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the country that issued the identifier. Supports international member identification.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Description of the identifier format or pattern. Helps with validation and data quality checks.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that created or manages this identifier. Examples include Facets, QNXT, Salesforce, or external partner systems.

attributes.name: usage_context
attributes.description: Business context or use case where this identifier is primarily used. Helps determine which identifier to use in different operational scenarios.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of Business associated with this identifier. Indicates the product or program context for the identifier.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance product associated with this identifier. Provides additional context for identifier usage and eligibility rules.
attributes.references: CMS Product Type Standards, Internal Product Catalog

attributes.name: relationship_to_subscriber
attributes.description: Relationship of the member to the primary subscriber. Used to determine dependent status and coverage rules.

attributes.name: is_subscriber
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this member is the primary subscriber (policyholder) or a dependent. Subscriber is the primary contract holder.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this identifier when multiple identifiers of the same type exist. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this identifier requires special confidentiality protections beyond standard PHI safeguards. Examples include identifiers for sensitive programs.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: masking_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this identifier must be masked or partially hidden in user interfaces and reports to protect member privacy.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, Internal Security Standards

attributes.name: masking_pattern
attributes.description: Pattern used to mask the identifier for display purposes. Example: XXX-XX-1234 for SSN masking.

attributes.name: encryption_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this identifier must be encrypted at rest and in transit to comply with security requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312, PCI DSS

attributes.name: tokenization_enabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this identifier has been tokenized for use in non-production environments or external integrations.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule, Internal Data Protection Standards

attributes.name: token_value
attributes.description: Tokenized representation of the identifier used in place of the actual value for security purposes.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the quality and reliability of this identifier based on validation rules, verification status, and data completeness.

attributes.name: duplicate_check_status
attributes.description: Status of duplicate detection processes for this identifier. Helps identify and resolve duplicate member records.

attributes.name: match_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0-100) for identifier matching algorithms used in member matching and deduplication processes.

attributes.name: cross_reference_id
attributes.description: Identifier used to cross-reference this member identifier with other systems or data sources. Supports data integration and master data management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the identifier. Used to document special circumstances, corrections, or historical context.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Reason for the most recent change to the identifier. Examples include correction, system migration, member request, or regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User ID or system name that made the most recent change to the identifier record.

attributes.name: changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the identifier record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the identifier record was originally created in the system.

attributes.name: source_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the source file or data feed that provided this identifier. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the record in the source system. Enables traceability back to the originating system.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: ANSI X12 EDI transaction set code associated with this identifier. Indicates the EDI transaction type that provided or uses this identifier.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards, HIPAA EDI Standards

attributes.name: edi_sender_id
attributes.description: EDI sender identification from the ISA segment of the EDI transaction that provided this identifier.

attributes.name: edi_receiver_id
attributes.description: EDI receiver identification from the ISA segment of the EDI transaction that provided this identifier.

attributes.name: edi_control_number
attributes.description: EDI interchange control number from the transaction that provided this identifier. Used for transaction tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this identifier meets HIPAA compliance requirements for Protected Health Information (PHI) handling.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164, HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether member consent has been obtained for use of this identifier in accordance with privacy regulations.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date when member consent was obtained for use of this identifier.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has opted out of sharing this identifier with certain parties or for certain purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years this identifier must be retained according to regulatory and business requirements before it can be purged.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention, State Insurance Regulations, Internal Records Management Policy

attributes.name: purge_eligible_date
attributes.description: Date when this identifier becomes eligible for purging or archival based on retention policies.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the member entity this identifier belongs to. Links identifier records to the core member profile.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Primary subscriber identifier assigned by Healthcare. This is the main member identification number used across systems and printed on member ID cards.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Employer-assigned employee identification number used for group enrollment and billing. Links member to employer group coverage.

products.name: relationship
products.description: Defines family or group relationships between a primary member and dependents (spouse, child, etc.).

attributes.name: relationship_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member relationship record. Primary key for the relationship entity.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary member (subscriber) in the relationship. Links to the member who holds the primary coverage.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: dependent_member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the dependent member in the relationship. Links to the member who is covered under the primary member's plan.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the type of relationship between the primary member and dependent. Uses ANSI X12 1069 Individual Relationship Code values (01=Spouse, 19=Child, 20=Employee, 21=Unknown, 22=Organ Donor, 23=Cadaver Donor, 24=Grandparent, 25=Grandchild, 26=Niece/Nephew, 29=Significant Other, 32=Mother, 33=Father, 34=Other Adult, 36=Emancipated Minor, 39=Organ Donor, 40=Cadaver Donor, 41=Injured Plaintiff, 43=Child Where Insured Has No Financial Responsibility, 53=Life Partner, G8=Other Relationship, D2=Domestic Partner).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 1069 Individual Relationship Code, HIPAA EDI 834

attributes.name: type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the relationship type (e.g., Spouse, Child, Domestic Partner, Parent, Sibling).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the relationship record indicating whether the relationship is currently active, inactive, pending approval, terminated, or suspended.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the relationship became effective and the dependent's coverage under the primary member began.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the relationship was terminated and the dependent's coverage under the primary member ended.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for relationship termination (e.g., 01=Death, 02=Divorce/Legal Separation, 03=Dependent Age Limit Reached, 04=Employment Termination, 05=Voluntary Cancellation, 06=Non-Payment of Premium, 07=Loss of Eligibility, 08=Medicare Entitlement, 09=Relocation, 10=Other).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance, ANSI X12 1203 Maintenance Reason Code

attributes.name: termination_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the reason for relationship termination.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: is_primary_dependent
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this dependent is the primary dependent for the subscriber (typically used when multiple dependents exist and one needs to be designated as primary for certain benefits or communications).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: is_financially_responsible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the primary member has financial responsibility for the dependent's healthcare costs and premiums.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: is_custodial_parent
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the primary member is the custodial parent of the dependent child (relevant for divorced or separated parents).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: is_student
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the dependent is a full-time student (relevant for extending coverage beyond standard dependent age limits).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance, ACA Dependent Coverage Extension

attributes.name: student_status_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent's student status became effective.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: student_status_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent's student status ended or is expected to end.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: is_disabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the dependent has a disability that qualifies them for extended coverage beyond standard age limits.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance, ACA Dependent Coverage Extension

attributes.name: disability_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent's disability status became effective for coverage purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: court_order_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the dependent's coverage is mandated by a court order (e.g., Qualified Medical Child Support Order - QMCSO).

attributes.name: court_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the court order mandating coverage for the dependent.

attributes.name: court_order_date
attributes.description: Date when the court order mandating coverage was issued.

attributes.name: adoption_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent was legally adopted by the primary member (relevant for establishing relationship and coverage eligibility).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: guardianship_date
attributes.description: Date when the primary member became the legal guardian of the dependent.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: marriage_date
attributes.description: Date when the primary member and dependent spouse were married (relevant for spouse relationships).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: divorce_date
attributes.description: Date when the primary member and dependent spouse were divorced (relevant for terminating spouse relationships).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance, COBRA

attributes.name: domestic_partnership_date
attributes.description: Date when the domestic partnership between the primary member and dependent was established.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the relationship termination constitutes a COBRA qualifying event that entitles the dependent to continuation coverage.

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event Date
attributes.description: Date when the COBRA qualifying event occurred.

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event Type
attributes.description: Type of COBRA qualifying event (e.g., termination of employment, reduction in hours, divorce, legal separation, death of covered employee, Medicare entitlement, dependent child losing eligibility).

attributes.name: age_limit_override_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the standard dependent age limit has been overridden for this relationship (e.g., due to disability or student status).
attributes.references: ACA Dependent Coverage Extension, HIPAA EDI 834

attributes.name: age_limit_override_reason
attributes.description: Reason for overriding the standard dependent age limit (e.g., disability, full-time student status, court order, state mandate).
attributes.references: ACA Dependent Coverage Extension, HIPAA EDI 834

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the verification process for the dependent relationship (e.g., verified through documentation, pending verification, verification failed, not required, verification expired).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent relationship was last verified through documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the dependent relationship (e.g., birth certificate, marriage certificate, adoption papers, court order, tax return, affidavit).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: verification_document_type
attributes.description: Type of document submitted to verify the dependent relationship.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next verification of the dependent relationship is due (for relationships requiring periodic re-verification).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which the relationship record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, Oracle Health Insurance, Salesforce).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: source_system_relationship_id
attributes.description: Original relationship identifier from the source system of record.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: enrollment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the 834 enrollment transaction that created or modified this relationship record.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: enrollment_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment transaction that created or modified this relationship was processed.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: maintenance_type_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the type of maintenance action for the relationship record (001=Change, 002=Delete, 021=Addition, 024=Cancellation or Termination, 025=Reinstatement, 026=Correction, 030=Audit or Compare, 032=Employee Information Not Applicable). Uses ANSI X12 1069 Maintenance Type Code.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 1069 Maintenance Type Code, HIPAA EDI 834

attributes.name: maintenance_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for the maintenance action on the relationship record. Uses ANSI X12 1203 Maintenance Reason Code.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 1203 Maintenance Reason Code, HIPAA EDI 834

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes about the relationship record, including special circumstances or additional context.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: record_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this version of the relationship record became effective in the data warehouse.

attributes.name: record_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this version of the relationship record was superseded by a new version or became inactive in the data warehouse.

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the current active version of the relationship record in the data warehouse.

attributes.name: primary_member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary member (subscriber) in the relationship. Links to the member who holds the primary coverage.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: member_profile_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the dependent member in the relationship. Links to the member who is covered under the primary member's plan.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

products.name: address
products.description: Historical address records for a member, including address type, start/end dates, and geocode.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the address record. Primary key for the address entity.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with this address. Links address to member entity.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the address indicating its purpose or usage (e.g., home, mailing, billing, work).

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line containing street number, street name, and unit/apartment number if applicable.

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location information such as suite, building, floor, or department.

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for additional location details if needed for complex addresses.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Name of the city or municipality where the address is located.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: Name of the county or parish where the address is located. Used for geographic analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code (e.g., CA, NY, TX) following USPS standards.

attributes.name: state_name
attributes.description: Full name of the state or province where the address is located.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit (ZIP+4) postal code for the address location.

attributes.name: zip_code_extension
attributes.description: Four-digit extension to the five-digit ZIP code providing more precise geographic location (ZIP+4).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX) identifying the country of the address.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address location in decimal degrees format. Used for geocoding and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the address location in decimal degrees format. Used for geocoding and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: Indicates the precision level of the geocoded coordinates (e.g., rooftop, range interpolated, geometric center).

attributes.name: geocode_source
attributes.description: Name of the geocoding service or system that provided the latitude and longitude coordinates.

attributes.name: geocode_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was geocoded to obtain latitude and longitude coordinates.

attributes.name: standardized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been validated and standardized against USPS or other postal authority standards.

attributes.name: standardization_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was last validated and standardized against postal authority standards.

attributes.name: delivery_point_barcode
attributes.description: Two-digit code assigned by USPS that identifies a specific delivery point within a ZIP+4 code.

attributes.name: carrier_route
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the USPS carrier route for mail delivery to this address.

attributes.name: congressional_district
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the U.S. Congressional district where the address is located.

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: Census tract identifier for the address location used for demographic and socioeconomic analysis.

attributes.name: census_block_group
attributes.description: Census block group identifier providing finer geographic granularity than census tract.

attributes.name: metropolitan_statistical_area
attributes.description: Code identifying the Metropolitan Statistical Area where the address is located, used for urban/rural classification.

attributes.name: urban_rural_indicator
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the address is in an urban, suburban, or rural area.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this address became effective and active for the member.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this address ceased to be effective for the member. Null indicates current active address.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the address record indicating whether it is active, inactive, pending verification, or undeliverable.

attributes.name: primary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary or default address for the member.

attributes.name: seasonal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a seasonal address used only during specific times of the year.

attributes.name: seasonal_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal address becomes active each year.

attributes.name: seasonal_end_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal address becomes inactive each year.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the address has been verified against postal authority databases.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was last verified against postal authority databases.

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: Name of the service or system used to verify the address (e.g., USPS, Melissa Data, SmartyStreets).

attributes.name: deliverability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) indicating the likelihood that mail can be successfully delivered to this address.

attributes.name: residential_commercial_indicator
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the address is a residential or commercial location.

attributes.name: po_box_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is a post office box rather than a physical street address.

attributes.name: military_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is a military address (APO, FPO, DPO).

attributes.name: foreign_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is located outside the  States.

attributes.name: ncoa_processed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Change of Address (NCOA) Processed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been processed through USPS National Change of Address database.

attributes.name: ncoa_processed_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Change of Address (NCOA) Processed Date
attributes.description: Date when the address was last processed through USPS National Change of Address database.

attributes.name: ncoa_move_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Change of Address (NCOA) Move Type
attributes.description: Type of move identified by NCOA processing (individual, family, or business move).

attributes.name: ncoa_move_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Change of Address (NCOA) Move Date
attributes.description: Date when the member moved from this address according to USPS NCOA records.

attributes.name: bad_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been marked as bad or undeliverable based on returned mail or validation failures.

attributes.name: bad_address_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the address was marked as bad or undeliverable (e.g., returned mail, invalid format, does not exist).

attributes.name: bad_address_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was marked as bad or undeliverable.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application that provided this address record (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Salesforce).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this address record in the source system.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of transaction that created or modified this address record (add, change, delete, correction).

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date when the address transaction was processed in the source system.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the address information was received from the member, employer, or other source.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when this address record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes about the address, such as special delivery instructions or address clarifications.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with this address. Links address to member entity.

products.name: contact
products.description: Phone, email, and other contact channels for a member with preference flags and validation status.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member contact record. Primary key for the contact data product.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this contact record to the member in the member management domain. References the member this contact information belongs to.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type or category of contact method (phone, email, address, fax, SMS, portal, mobile app, emergency contact).

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: The business purpose or use case for this contact method (primary, billing, correspondence, emergency, claims, care coordination, marketing, provider communication).

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: The telephone number for the member. May include country code, area code, and extension. Used for voice communication and SMS notifications.

attributes.name: phone_type
attributes.description: The classification of the phone number (mobile, home, work, fax, other).

attributes.name: phone_extension
attributes.description: The extension number for the phone contact, typically used for work numbers.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: The electronic mail address for the member. Used for digital correspondence, EOB delivery, and member portal notifications.

attributes.name: email_type
attributes.description: The classification of the email address (personal, work, other).

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: The primary street address line for the member, including street number and name.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: The secondary address line for apartment, suite, unit, or building information.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The city or municipality name for the member's address.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state or province code for the member's address (e.g., CA, NY, TX).

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: The postal ZIP code for the member's address. May include 5-digit or 9-digit (ZIP+4) format.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: The county or parish code for the member's address. Used for geographic rating and network assignment.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code for the member's address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: The classification of the address (residential, mailing, billing, work, temporary, other).

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary or default contact method for the member. Used to determine which contact to use when multiple exist.

attributes.name: is_preferred_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has explicitly designated this as their preferred contact method for communications.

attributes.name: preference_rank
attributes.description: The priority ranking of this contact method relative to other contact methods for the member (1 = highest priority).

attributes.name: opt_in_marketing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive marketing communications via this contact method.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act, TCPA, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: opt_in_surveys
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive survey requests (e.g., CAHPS surveys) via this contact method.

attributes.name: opt_in_care_reminders
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive care reminders and preventive care notifications via this contact method.

attributes.name: opt_in_claims_notifications
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive claims processing and EOB notifications via this contact method.

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has requested not to be contacted via this method. Overrides other preferences.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current operational status of this contact method (active, inactive, invalid, unverified, bounced, blocked, pending verification).

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: The verification status of this contact information (verified, unverified, failed, pending, not applicable). Indicates whether the contact has been confirmed as accurate.

attributes.name: validation_method
attributes.description: The method used to validate this contact information (member confirmed, third-party verification, automated check, manual review, not validated).

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact information was last validated or verified.

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: The system or entity that performed the validation of this contact information (e.g., USPS CASS, email verification service, member portal).

attributes.name: is_verified_usps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Verified USPS ( States Postal Service) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been verified against USPS CASS (Coding Accuracy Support System) standards.

attributes.name: delivery_point_validation
attributes.description: The USPS delivery point validation status for the address (valid, invalid, vacant, not checked).

attributes.name: ncoa_status
attributes.description: The National Change of Address status indicating whether the member has filed a change of address with USPS.

attributes.name: email_bounce_count
attributes.description: The number of times email communications to this address have bounced or failed delivery.

attributes.name: last_bounce_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent email bounce or delivery failure for this contact.

attributes.name: bounce_type
attributes.description: The type of the most recent email bounce (hard bounce for permanent failures, soft bounce for temporary issues, block, complaint, none).

attributes.name: undeliverable_mail_count
attributes.description: The number of times physical mail to this address has been returned as undeliverable.

attributes.name: last_undeliverable_date
attributes.description: The date when physical mail was most recently returned as undeliverable for this address.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The two-letter ISO language code indicating the preferred language for communications via this contact method (e.g., en, es, zh).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The time zone associated with this contact location, used for scheduling communications and respecting contact hours (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles).

attributes.name: best_time_to_contact
attributes.description: The member's preferred time of day to be contacted via this method (morning, afternoon, evening, anytime).

attributes.name: restriction_start_time
attributes.description: The start time of the daily window when the member should NOT be contacted via this method (24-hour format HH:mm).

attributes.name: restriction_end_time
attributes.description: The end time of the daily window when the member should NOT be contacted via this method (24-hour format HH:mm).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact information became effective and valid for use.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact information is no longer effective or valid. Null indicates currently active contact.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: The date when the member was last successfully contacted via this method.

attributes.name: last_contact_type
attributes.description: The type of the most recent contact interaction via this method (outbound call, inbound call, email, mail, SMS, portal message).

attributes.name: last_update_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: last_update_source
attributes.description: The system or channel that last updated this contact information (e.g., member portal, customer service, 834 transaction, broker feed).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system of record for this contact information (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Salesforce Health Cloud, member portal).

attributes.name: source_transaction_type
attributes.description: The type of transaction or process that created or updated this contact record (834 EDI transaction, member portal, customer service, broker feed, employer file, manual entry, data migration).

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date when the member provided consent to be contacted via this method.

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The method by which consent was obtained to contact the member via this method (written, verbal, electronic, implied, not obtained).

attributes.name: consent_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the member's consent to be contacted via this method expires and must be renewed.

attributes.name: privacy_restriction_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any special privacy restrictions or confidentiality requirements for this contact method (e.g., confidential address for domestic violence victims).

attributes.name: is_confidential_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is marked as confidential and should have restricted access (e.g., for members in witness protection or domestic violence situations).

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: The full name of the emergency contact person associated with this contact record.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the emergency contact to the member (spouse, parent, child, sibling, friend, other).

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: A calculated score (0-100) representing the quality and reliability of this contact information based on validation, usage, and delivery success.

attributes.name: standardized_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been standardized according to USPS or other postal authority standards.

attributes.name: geocode_latitude
attributes.description: The latitude coordinate of the address location, used for geographic analysis and provider network proximity calculations.

attributes.name: geocode_longitude
attributes.description: The longitude coordinate of the address location, used for geographic analysis and provider network proximity calculations.

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy level of the geocoded coordinates (rooftop for exact location, range interpolated, geometric center, approximate).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this contact method, including special instructions or historical context.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this contact record to the member in the member management domain. References the member this contact information belongs to.

products.name: language_preference
products.description: Member's preferred language for communications and documentation.

attributes.name: language_preference_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member's language preference record. Serves as the primary key for tracking language communication preferences across all member touchpoints.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this language preference to a specific member in the member management domain. References the member who has this language preference.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, Internal Member Management Standards

attributes.name: primary_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639 language code representing the member's primary preferred language for all communications (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish, 'zh' for Chinese). This is the default language for all member-facing materials.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1/639-2 Language Codes, CMS Language Access Standards

attributes.name: primary_language_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the member's primary preferred language (e.g., 'English', 'Spanish', 'Mandarin Chinese'). Used for display and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 639 Language Names, CMS Language Access Standards

attributes.name: secondary_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639 language code for the member's secondary preferred language, if applicable. Used when primary language materials are unavailable or member requests alternate language support.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1/639-2 Language Codes, CMS Language Access Standards

attributes.name: secondary_language_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the member's secondary preferred language. Provides additional language support option for member communications.
attributes.references: ISO 639 Language Names, CMS Language Access Standards

attributes.name: written_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639 language code for written communications specifically (EOB, letters, policy documents). May differ from spoken language preference for members with different literacy preferences.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1/639-2 Language Codes, CMS Language Access Standards, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: spoken_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639 language code for verbal communications (phone calls, interpreter services, video consultations). May differ from written language preference.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1/639-2 Language Codes, CMS Language Access Standards, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: interpreter_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member requires professional interpreter services for healthcare interactions. Critical for care coordination and compliance with language access requirements.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1557, CMS Language Access Standards, Title VI Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: interpreter_type
attributes.description: Type of interpreter service preferred or required by the member (in-person, telephonic, video, sign language). Supports care management and utilization management workflows.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1557, CMS Language Access Standards, Americans with Disabilities Act

attributes.name: sign_language_type
attributes.description: Specific sign language system preferred by the member (ASL for American Sign Language, BSL for British Sign Language, etc.). Critical for deaf and hard-of-hearing member support.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: braille_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member requires written materials in Braille format. Supports accessibility compliance for visually impaired members.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: large_print_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member requires written materials in large print format for visual accessibility. Typically 16-point font or larger.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: audio_format_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member requires materials in audio format (CD, MP3, phone-based audio). Supports accessibility for visually impaired or reading-challenged members.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: digital_accessible_format_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member requires digital materials in accessible formats (screen reader compatible, WCAG compliant). Supports web and mobile accessibility requirements.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act, ACA Section 1557, WCAG 2.1 Standards

attributes.name: communication_channel_preference
attributes.description: Member's preferred channel for receiving communications in their preferred language. Supports omnichannel member engagement strategy.

attributes.name: eob_language_code
attributes.description: Specific language code for Explanation of Benefits documents. May differ from general communication preference due to regulatory or member-specific requirements.
attributes.references: CMS EOB Requirements, ACA Section 1557, ERISA Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: sbc_language_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Language Code
attributes.description: Language code for Summary of Benefits and Coverage documents. Must comply with ACA requirements for language access in plan documents.

attributes.name: spd_language_code
attributes.description: Language code for Summary Plan Description documents. Must comply with ERISA requirements for plan disclosure in member's preferred language.

attributes.name: marketing_language_code
attributes.description: Language code for marketing materials and promotional communications. Supports targeted marketing campaigns and CMS marketing compliance.
