attributes.name: customer_service_language_code
attributes.description: Language code for customer service interactions. Routes member calls to appropriate language-capable representatives or interpreter services.
attributes.references: CMS Language Access Standards, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: care_management_language_code
attributes.description: Language code for care management and disease management program communications. Ensures culturally and linguistically appropriate care coordination.
attributes.references: CMS Care Management Standards, NCQA HEDIS Requirements

attributes.name: prior_authorization_language_code
attributes.description: Language code for prior authorization communications and decisions. Ensures members understand utilization management decisions in their preferred language.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Standards, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: appeals_grievances_language_code
attributes.description: Language code for appeals and grievances communications. Critical for member rights and regulatory compliance with appeal notification requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Appeals and Grievances Requirements, ACA Section 1557, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: language_proficiency_level
attributes.description: Member's self-reported or assessed proficiency level in their primary language. Helps determine appropriate communication complexity and support needs.

attributes.name: english_proficiency_level
attributes.description: Member's proficiency level in English, regardless of primary language preference. Used to determine language access service requirements and compliance with LEP (Limited English Proficiency) standards.
attributes.references: Title VI Civil Rights Act, ACA Section 1557, CMS LEP Standards

attributes.name: limited_english_proficiency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has Limited English Proficiency, triggering mandatory language access services and protections under federal civil rights law.
attributes.references: Title VI Civil Rights Act, ACA Section 1557, Executive Order 13166

attributes.name: cultural_preference
attributes.description: Member's cultural background or preference that may influence communication style, health beliefs, or care preferences. Supports culturally competent care delivery.
attributes.references: CLAS Standards (Culturally and Linguistically Appropriate Services), CMS Cultural Competency Requirements

attributes.name: dialect_variant
attributes.description: Specific dialect or regional variant of the preferred language (e.g., Castilian Spanish vs. Latin American Spanish, Mandarin vs. Cantonese). Ensures accurate and culturally appropriate communication.
attributes.references: CMS Language Access Standards, CLAS Standards

attributes.name: reading_level_preference
attributes.description: Preferred reading complexity level for written materials. Supports health literacy initiatives and plain language requirements.
attributes.references: Plain Writing Act, CMS Health Literacy Standards, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: health_literacy_level
attributes.description: Member's assessed or self-reported ability to understand health information and navigate the healthcare system. Influences communication strategy and care management approach.
attributes.references: CMS Health Literacy Standards, AHRQ Health Literacy Guidelines

attributes.name: translation_service_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the contracted translation or interpreter service vendor assigned to support this member's language needs. Used for vendor management and quality tracking.

attributes.name: language_line_account_number
attributes.description: Account or reference number for telephonic interpreter services (e.g., LanguageLine Solutions). Used for billing and service tracking.

attributes.name: preference_source
attributes.description: Source from which the language preference was obtained. Critical for data quality assessment and compliance with self-attestation requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Data Collection Standards, 834 EDI Transaction Standards

attributes.name: preference_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the language preference was last verified or confirmed with the member. Supports data quality and compliance with periodic verification requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Data Quality Standards, Internal Data Governance Policies

attributes.name: preference_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the language preference with the member. Supports audit trail and data quality documentation.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this language preference becomes effective for member communications. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this language preference is no longer effective. Null indicates current active preference. Supports historical tracking and preference change management.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of this language preference record. Active indicates currently in use; superseded indicates replaced by newer preference.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for language preference change or update. Supports audit trail and trend analysis of preference changes.

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for language preference change. Supplements change reason code with specific details.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a confirmation notification was sent to the member regarding their language preference. Supports member communication tracking.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when confirmation notification was sent to member regarding language preference. Used for communication tracking and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: consent_for_language_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether member has provided explicit consent for language assistance services. May be required for certain interpreter services or third-party language vendors.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date when member provided consent for language assistance services. Supports compliance documentation and audit requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: family_language_preference_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this language preference applies to the entire family unit or subscriber group. Supports family-level communication preferences.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this language preference overrides system defaults or inherited preferences. Used for exception handling and preference hierarchy management.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this language preference overrides standard rules or inherited preferences. Supports audit trail and exception documentation.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Calculated score (0-100) representing the completeness and accuracy of this language preference record. Based on verification status, source reliability, and data completeness.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this language preference record was last updated in the system. Supports data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that last updated this language preference record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_updated_source_system
attributes.description: Source system that provided the most recent update to this language preference record (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Salesforce, Member Portal). Supports data lineage and integration tracking.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this language preference record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage and historical analysis.

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created this language preference record. Supports audit trail and data provenance.

attributes.name: source_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the source transaction that created or updated this language preference (e.g., 834 transaction control number, enrollment batch ID). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Standards, Internal Data Integration Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, special instructions, or details about the member's language preference. May include cultural considerations or specific communication needs.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this language preference to a specific member in the member management domain. References the member who has this language preference.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, Internal Member Management Standards

products.name: consent
products.description: Records of member consents for data sharing, marketing, and electronic communications.

attributes.name: consent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member consent record. Primary key for the consent data product.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member who provided or revoked consent. Links to the member master data.

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identifier associated with the member providing consent. Used for policy and group linkage.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The category or type of consent provided by the member. Defines the scope and purpose of the consent.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, TCPA Compliance

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the consent record indicating whether the consent is in effect, revoked, or expired.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: The member's decision regarding the consent request - whether they opted in, opted out, or did not provide a response.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope or extent of information covered by the consent. Specifies what data or activities the consent applies to.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific purpose for which the consent was obtained. Explains how the member's information will be used.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: The method or channel through which the consent was obtained from the member.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, ESIGN Act

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language in which the consent was presented to and obtained from the member. Uses ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.520, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent form or agreement presented to the member. Tracks changes to consent language over time.

attributes.name: form_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific consent form or template used to obtain the consent.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or reference to the stored consent document or signed authorization form.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent becomes effective and enforceable.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent expires and is no longer valid. May be null for consents without expiration.

attributes.name: granted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member granted or provided the consent.

attributes.name: granted_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the member granted consent. Provides audit trail for consent capture.

attributes.name: revoked_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member revoked or withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been revoked.

attributes.name: revoked_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the member revoked their consent. Null if consent has not been revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the member for revoking their consent. Free text field for member explanation.

attributes.name: revocation_method
attributes.description: The method through which the member revoked their consent.

attributes.name: is_renewable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent can be renewed upon expiration. True if renewable, false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_revocable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has the right to revoke this consent. True if revocable, false otherwise.

attributes.name: requires_signature
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent type requires a member signature for validity. True if signature required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: signature_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether a member signature was captured for this consent. True if signature obtained, false otherwise.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, ESIGN Act

attributes.name: signature_type
attributes.description: The type of signature captured for the consent authorization.
attributes.references: ESIGN Act, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member signed the consent authorization.

attributes.name: witness_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a witness signature is required for this consent. True if witness required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: witness_name
attributes.description: Name of the witness who attested to the member providing consent. Null if no witness required.

attributes.name: witness_signature_date
attributes.description: The date on which the witness signed the consent form. Null if no witness required.

attributes.name: authorized_recipient
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, organization, or entity authorized to receive the member's information under this consent.

attributes.name: authorized_recipient_type
attributes.description: The type or category of the authorized recipient who may receive the member's information.

attributes.name: authorized_recipient_npi
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier of the healthcare provider authorized to receive information. Applicable when recipient is a provider.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, NPI Final Rule

attributes.name: disclosure_purpose
attributes.description: Specific purpose for which the member's Protected Health Information (PHI) may be disclosed under this consent.

attributes.name: information_disclosed
attributes.description: Description of the specific information or categories of information that may be disclosed under this consent.

attributes.name: phi_category
attributes.description: Category of Protected Health Information covered by this consent. Certain categories require special authorization.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, 42 CFR Part 2

attributes.name: special_category_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent involves specially protected health information such as mental health, substance abuse, or HIV/AIDS records. True if special category, false otherwise.
attributes.references: 42 CFR Part 2, State mental health privacy laws

attributes.name: marketing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive marketing communications. True if consented, false otherwise.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508(a)(3), TCPA, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: research_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to use of their information for research purposes. True if consented, false otherwise.

attributes.name: fundraising_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to be contacted for fundraising purposes. True if consented, false otherwise.

attributes.name: sale_of_phi_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sale of Protected Health Information (PHI) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent authorizes the sale of the member's Protected Health Information. Requires specific authorization under HIPAA. True if authorized, false otherwise.

attributes.name: psychotherapy_notes_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent covers disclosure of psychotherapy notes. Requires separate specific authorization. True if authorized, false otherwise.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business or product type associated with the member's coverage at the time consent was obtained.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The type of health plan the member is enrolled in at the time of consent.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The source system or application from which the consent record originated.

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier for the consent event. Used for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the member provided electronic consent. Used for audit and fraud detection.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the member to provide consent electronically.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or application user agent string captured when consent was provided electronically. Used for audit purposes.

attributes.name: geolocation
attributes.description: Geographic location coordinates where consent was provided. Used for audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_text
attributes.description: The full text of the consent acknowledgement or authorization that was presented to the member.

attributes.name: right_to_revoke_notice
attributes.description: Text of the notice provided to the member regarding their right to revoke consent and the process for doing so.

attributes.name: consequences_of_refusal
attributes.description: Description of any consequences to the member if they refuse to provide consent, as disclosed in the authorization.

attributes.name: treatment_conditioning_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether treatment, payment, enrollment, or eligibility is conditioned on providing this consent. True if conditioned, false otherwise.

attributes.name: redisclosure_notice
attributes.description: Notice provided to the member that information disclosed under this consent may be subject to redisclosure and may no longer be protected.

attributes.name: parent_consent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent or previous consent record if this consent supersedes or amends a prior consent. Null if this is an original consent.

attributes.name: superseded_by_consent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the consent record that supersedes this consent. Null if this consent is still current or has not been superseded.

attributes.name: renewal_count
attributes.description: Number of times this consent has been renewed by the member. Zero for initial consent.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent was last verified or confirmed with the member.

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the consent should be re-verified with the member. Null if no periodic verification required.

attributes.name: verification_frequency_months
attributes.description: The frequency in months at which this consent should be re-verified with the member. Null if no periodic verification required.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: The specific regulatory requirement or legal mandate that necessitates this consent.
attributes.references: HIPAA, TCPA, CAN-SPAM Act, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: compliance_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction or state whose regulations govern this consent. Uses standard state or country codes.

attributes.name: state_specific_requirements
attributes.description: Description of any state-specific consent requirements that apply to this consent record.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: minor_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent was provided on behalf of a minor. True if minor consent, false otherwise.

attributes.name: guardian_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the guardian to the member for whom consent was provided.

attributes.name: legal_representative_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether consent was provided by a legal representative rather than the member directly. True if legal representative, false otherwise.

attributes.name: power_of_attorney_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the person providing consent holds power of attorney for the member. True if power of attorney, false otherwise.

attributes.name: advance_directive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent is associated with an advance directive or living will. True if associated, false otherwise.

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent constitutes a valid HIPAA authorization for use and disclosure of Protected Health Information. True if valid HIPAA authorization, false otherwise.

attributes.name: notice_of_privacy_practices_provided
attributes.business_glossary_term: Notice of Privacy Practices Provided Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was provided with the Notice of Privacy Practices at the time of consent. True if provided, false otherwise.

attributes.name: notice_of_privacy_practices_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Notice of Privacy Practices that was provided to the member.

attributes.name: opt_out_instructions
attributes.description: Instructions provided to the member on how to opt out or revoke this consent.
attributes.references: TCPA, CAN-SPAM Act, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: contact_preference_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to be contacted via email. True if consented, false otherwise.

attributes.name: contact_preference_phone
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to be contacted via phone. True if consented, false otherwise.

attributes.name: contact_preference_sms
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contact Preference Short Message Service (SMS) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive SMS text messages. True if consented, false otherwise.

attributes.name: contact_preference_mail
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to be contacted via postal mail. True if consented, false otherwise.

attributes.name: contact_preference_automated_call
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive automated or pre-recorded phone calls. True if consented, false otherwise.

attributes.name: third_party_disclosure_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to disclosure of their information to third parties. True if allowed, false otherwise.

attributes.name: data_retention_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which the consent record must be retained per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.530(j), State record retention laws

attributes.name: audit_trail_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complete audit trail is available for this consent record. True if available, false otherwise.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the consent. May include special circumstances or clarifications.

attributes.name: created_by_user_id

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or agent who last modified the consent record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the consent record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member who provided or revoked consent. Links to the member master data.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identifier associated with the member providing consent. Used for policy and group linkage.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.interaction. Business justification: HIPAA and marketing consents are often captured during service interactions. Compliance requires tracking which interaction obtained consent, who captured it, and the exact context.

products.name: group

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: employer_tin

attributes.name: relationship_type

attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Classification of coverage level for premium rating purposes (e.g., employee only, family).

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status of the member within the group plan.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_date

attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: enrollment_termination_date

attributes.name: original_effective_date

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance product line (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care).

attributes.name: product_code

attributes.name: product_name

attributes.name: plan_type

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: Indicates how the group plan is funded (e.g., fully insured by carrier, self-funded by employer).

attributes.name: aso_indicator

attributes.name: cobra_indicator

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event

attributes.name: cobra_election_date

attributes.name: cobra_max_months

attributes.name: division_code

attributes.name: division_name

attributes.name: location_code

attributes.name: class_code

attributes.name: class_description

attributes.name: benefit_package_id

attributes.name: rate_group

attributes.name: premium_amount

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount

attributes.name: premium_frequency

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: pcp_assignment_required

attributes.name: pcp_npi

attributes.name: plan_network_id

attributes.name: network_name

attributes.name: service_area_code

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's eligibility was last verified with the employer or group.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 270/271 Eligibility Inquiry and Response

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the member must wait before coverage becomes effective after hire or enrollment date.

attributes.name: waiting_period_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waiting period was waived for the member (e.g., due to prior creditable coverage).

attributes.name: prior_coverage_credit_months
attributes.description: Number of months of prior creditable coverage applied to reduce waiting periods or pre-existing condition exclusions.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for termination of the member's enrollment in the group plan.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: termination_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason for termination of enrollment.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: rehire_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member is a rehired employee returning to the group.

attributes.name: rehire_date
attributes.description: Date when the member was rehired by the employer group.

attributes.name: leave_of_absence_indicator

attributes.name: leave_of_absence_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's leave of absence began.
attributes.references: FMLA Family and Medical Leave Act

attributes.name: leave_of_absence_end_date
attributes.description: Expected or actual date when the member's leave of absence ends.
attributes.references: FMLA Family and Medical Leave Act

attributes.name: disability_indicator

attributes.name: medicare_secondary_payer_indicator

attributes.name: cob_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has other insurance coverage requiring coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: cob_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan is primary, secondary, or tertiary in the coordination of benefits hierarchy.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Source or trigger event that initiated the member's enrollment in the group plan.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member completed their enrollment (e.g., employer portal, broker, call center).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance broker or agent who facilitated the group enrollment.

attributes.name: broker_name

attributes.name: employer_group_size
attributes.description: Total number of eligible employees in the employer group, used for rating and regulatory classification.

attributes.name: small_group_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the employer qualifies as a small group (typically 1-50 employees) under state or federal regulations.

attributes.name: large_group_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the employer qualifies as a large group (typically 51+ employees) under state or federal regulations.

attributes.name: sbc_version

attributes.description: Version identifier of the Summary of Benefits and Coverage document provided to the member.

attributes.name: sbc_delivery_date

attributes.description: Date when the Summary of Benefits and Coverage was delivered to the member.

attributes.name: spd_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Summary Plan Description document provided to the member under ERISA requirements.

attributes.name: spd_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date when the Summary Plan Description was delivered to the member.

attributes.name: hipaa_notice_delivery_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Notice Delivery Date
attributes.description: Date when the HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices was delivered to the member.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number or reference code generated when the member's enrollment was processed.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: last_834_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent HIPAA 834 enrollment transaction received for this member-group association.

attributes.name: last_834_transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of the most recent HIPAA 834 enrollment transaction (e.g., enrollment, change, termination).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: active_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member currently has active coverage under this group association.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 270/271 Eligibility Inquiry and Response

attributes.name: retroactive_effective_date
attributes.description: Date to which coverage was retroactively applied, if applicable (e.g., for late enrollments or corrections).

attributes.name: retroactive_termination_date
attributes.description: Date to which termination was retroactively applied, if applicable (e.g., for late notifications or corrections).
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: coverage_continuation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member is eligible for or enrolled in coverage continuation (e.g., COBRA, state continuation).

attributes.name: retiree_indicator

attributes.name: subsidy_eligible_indicator

attributes.name: tobacco_user_indicator

attributes.name: wellness_program_participant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member is enrolled in employer-sponsored wellness programs.

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member's plan is HSA-qualified and the member is eligible to contribute to an HSA.

attributes.name: hra_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member is eligible for a Health Reimbursement Arrangement.

attributes.name: fsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member is eligible to participate in a Flexible Spending Account.

attributes.name: dependent_care_fsa_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member is eligible for a Dependent Care FSA.

attributes.name: commuter_benefits_eligible

attributes.name: dental_coverage_indicator

attributes.name: vision_coverage_indicator
