attributes.name: life_insurance_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has life insurance coverage through the employer group.

attributes.name: std_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has Short Term Disability coverage through the employer group.

attributes.name: ltd_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has Long Term Disability coverage through the employer group.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this member-group association record was initially created in the system.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this member-group association record was last updated in the system.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this member-group association data originated.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subscriber (primary member) within the health plan. Links the member to their coverage.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: billing_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the billing group used to consolidate premium invoicing for multiple members or divisions.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider network associated with the member's plan.

products.name: provider_assignment
products.description: Primary Care Physician or other provider assignments for a member, including effective dates.

attributes.name: provider_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider assignment record. Primary key for the provider assignment entity.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member to whom the provider is assigned. Links to the member entity.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the assigned provider. Links to the provider entity.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned to the provider by CMS. Standard unique health identifier for healthcare providers.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry, HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The 9-digit Tax Identification Number of the provider organization or individual provider for billing and payment purposes.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: The type of provider assignment indicating the role of the provider in the member's care. Common types include Primary Care Physician (PCP), specialist, behavioral health provider, facility, or ancillary services.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: The reason or trigger for the provider assignment. Indicates whether the assignment was due to new enrollment, member request, automatic assignment, provider change, plan change, or other business reason.

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the provider was assigned to the member. Indicates whether the member selected the provider, the system auto-assigned, a care manager assigned, or other method.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider assignment becomes effective and active for the member. Used to determine provider responsibility for care coordination and claims adjudication.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider assignment ends or is terminated. Null if the assignment is currently active.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for terminating the provider assignment. Indicates whether termination was due to member request, provider leaving network, plan disenrollment, relocation, or other reason.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the provider assignment. Indicates whether the assignment is active, inactive, pending approval, terminated, or suspended.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business or product type under which the provider assignment exists. Indicates whether the member is enrolled in Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace, or other product.
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The type of health plan under which the provider assignment is made. Common types include Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Special Needs Plan (SNP).
attributes.references: ACA Qualified Health Plan Standards, CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider network to which the assigned provider belongs. Used to validate network participation and benefit coverage.

attributes.name: practice_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific practice location or service location where the provider sees the member. A provider may have multiple practice locations.

attributes.name: is_accepting_new_patients
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned provider is currently accepting new patients at the time of assignment. True if accepting, false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_pcp_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member's plan requires a Primary Care Physician assignment. True for HMO and some POS plans, false for PPO and EPO plans.

attributes.name: is_referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member requires a referral from this assigned provider to see specialists. Typically true for HMO plans with PCP gatekeeping.
attributes.references: Plan Benefit Design Standards, Utilization Management Policies

attributes.name: assignment_source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system that created or last updated the provider assignment record. Examples include Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, member portal, care management system.

attributes.name: assignment_source_transaction_id
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier from the source system that created or updated the provider assignment. Used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: assignment_channel
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the provider assignment was initiated or submitted. Examples include web portal, mobile app, call center, broker, enrollment file, care manager, or system default.

attributes.name: assignment_request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider assignment was requested by the member or initiated by the system. May differ from the effective date.

attributes.name: assignment_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider assignment was approved or confirmed by the system or administrator. Null if no approval process is required.

attributes.name: assignment_processed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider assignment was fully processed and recorded in the system of record.

attributes.name: previous_provider_provider_profile_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the provider who was previously assigned to the member before this assignment. Null if this is the first assignment.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: A coded value indicating the specific reason for changing from the previous provider to the current provider. Used for analytics and quality monitoring.

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: A free-text description providing additional detail about the reason for the provider change.

attributes.name: is_continuity_of_care_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether continuity of care provisions apply to this provider assignment, allowing the member to continue seeing a previous provider for a transition period. True if applicable, false otherwise.
attributes.references: ACA Continuity of Care Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: continuity_of_care_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the continuity of care transition period ends, after which the member must use the newly assigned provider. Null if continuity of care does not apply.

attributes.name: assignment_priority
attributes.description: A numeric priority or ranking of this provider assignment when a member has multiple concurrent provider assignments. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for claims routing and care coordination.

attributes.name: is_primary_assignment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary provider assignment for the member. True if this is the primary assignment, false if secondary or supplemental.

attributes.name: care_team_role
attributes.description: The specific role this provider plays in the member's care team. Examples include primary care physician, care coordinator, case manager, specialist consultant, etc.
attributes.references: PCMH Patient Centered Medical Home Standards

attributes.name: attribution_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to attribute the member to this provider for quality measurement and value-based care programs. Common methods include claims-based, enrollment-based, prospective, retrospective, or hybrid.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Payment Program, NCQA HEDIS Attribution

attributes.name: attribution_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member attribution to this provider becomes effective for quality measurement and value-based care programs. May differ from the assignment effective date.

attributes.name: attribution_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member attribution to this provider ends for quality measurement and value-based care programs. Null if attribution is currently active.

attributes.name: vbc_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the value-based care program or alternative payment model under which this provider assignment is managed. Examples include ACO, PCMH, bundled payment programs.

attributes.name: aco_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Accountable Care Organization to which the assigned provider belongs, if applicable. Used for ACO attribution and shared savings programs.

attributes.name: pcmh_recognition_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) Recognition Level
attributes.description: The NCQA Patient Centered Medical Home recognition level of the assigned provider's practice. Levels include Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, or not recognized.

attributes.name: quality_tier
attributes.description: The quality performance tier or rating of the assigned provider based on quality metrics and outcomes. Used for tiered network designs and member incentives.
attributes.references: NCQA Quality Ratings, Internal Quality Programs

attributes.name: cost_efficiency_tier
attributes.description: The cost efficiency tier or rating of the assigned provider based on cost and utilization metrics. Used for tiered network designs and value-based contracting.

attributes.name: member_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: The member satisfaction or patient experience score for the assigned provider, typically derived from CAHPS surveys or other patient feedback. Scale varies by measurement methodology.
attributes.references: CAHPS Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the provider assignment. May include special instructions, member preferences, or administrative notes.

attributes.name: is_telehealth_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned provider offers telehealth or virtual visit services to the member. True if telehealth is available, false otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Services, State Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: The primary language(s) spoken by the assigned provider, used to match member language preferences for culturally competent care.
attributes.references: CLAS Culturally and Linguistically Appropriate Services Standards

attributes.name: gender_preference_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned provider's gender matches the member's stated provider gender preference. True if matched, false otherwise.

attributes.name: distance_from_member_miles
attributes.description: The calculated distance in miles between the member's primary address and the assigned provider's practice location. Used for network adequacy and access monitoring.
attributes.references: State Network Adequacy Standards, CMS Access to Care Requirements

attributes.name: assignment_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider assignment meets regulatory and contractual compliance requirements. Statuses include compliant, non-compliant, pending review, or exempt.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, CMS Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: assignment_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider assignment has been flagged for audit or review due to unusual patterns, compliance concerns, or quality issues. True if flagged, false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider assignment was last verified or validated for accuracy and currency. Used for data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the provider assignment should be re-verified or updated. Used for proactive data quality management.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider contract under which this assignment is made. Links to the provider contracting system for rate and benefit determination.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the provider contract under which this assignment is made. Used to validate assignment timing and payment rates.

attributes.name: contract_termination_date
attributes.description: The termination date of the provider contract under which this assignment is made. Null if the contract is currently active.

attributes.name: reimbursement_method
attributes.description: The payment or reimbursement method used for the assigned provider. Common methods include fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payment, shared savings, or other alternative payment models.
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Payment Models, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: The capitation payment rate per member per month paid to the assigned provider for managing the member's care. Applicable only when reimbursement method is capitation.
attributes.references: Provider Contract Terms, Internal Payment Standards

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: The risk adjustment factor or risk score for the member at the time of provider assignment. Used for capitation rate adjustment and care management prioritization.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, HCC Hierarchical Condition Categories

attributes.name: hcc_count
attributes.description: The number of active Hierarchical Condition Categories for the member at the time of provider assignment. Used for risk stratification and care management.

attributes.name: care_management_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the care management or disease management program associated with this provider assignment, if applicable. Examples include diabetes management, heart failure program, behavioral health program.

attributes.name: is_high_risk_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is classified as high-risk at the time of provider assignment, requiring enhanced care coordination. True if high-risk, false otherwise.

attributes.name: assignment_version
attributes.description: Version number for this provider assignment record, incremented with each update or change. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: record_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this version of the provider assignment record became effective in the system. Used for temporal data management and historical analysis.

attributes.name: record_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this version of the provider assignment record was superseded or became inactive. Null if this is the current active version.

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active version of the provider assignment record. True if current, false if historical.

attributes.name: provider_provider_profile_id
attributes.description: FK to provider.provider_profile

attributes.name: provider_profile_provider_profile_id
attributes.description: FK to provider.provider_profile

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: FK to provider.provider_profile

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member to whom the provider is assigned. Links to the member entity.

attributes.name: provider_specialty
attributes.description: The medical specialty or area of practice of the assigned provider. Examples include family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, cardiology, behavioral health, etc.
attributes.references: CMS Specialty Taxonomy, NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: provider_taxonomy_code
attributes.description: The Healthcare Provider Taxonomy Code that classifies the provider type, classification, and specialization. A 10-character alphanumeric code maintained by NUCC.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: The full name of the assigned provider (individual or organization). Used for member communication and identification purposes.

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned provider is an individual practitioner, organization, facility, or group practice.

attributes.name: practice_address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the street address for the provider's practice location where the member receives care.

attributes.name: practice_address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the street address for the provider's practice location (suite, floor, building, etc.).

attributes.name: practice_city
attributes.description: The city where the provider's practice location is located.

attributes.name: practice_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state code where the provider's practice location is located.

attributes.name: practice_zip_code
attributes.description: The ZIP code or ZIP+4 code for the provider's practice location.

attributes.name: practice_country
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code for the provider's practice location.

attributes.name: practice_phone_number
attributes.description: The primary phone number for the provider's practice location where the member can schedule appointments or contact the provider.

attributes.name: previous_provider_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the provider who was previously assigned to the member before this assignment. Null if this is the first assignment.

attributes.name: previous_provider_npi
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier of the provider who was previously assigned to the member. Used for continuity of care tracking.

attributes.name: plan_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_network. Business justification: Provider assignments must reference the plan's network to validate in-network status. Claims processing uses this daily to determine coverage levels and cost-sharing amounts.

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.care_team. Business justification: Members with assigned PCPs may have those providers included in their care team. Care coordination requires linking primary care providers to care teams.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Provider assignments must reference the specific contract/agreement that governs the provider-member relationship. Used daily by care coordination teams to validate network participation and coverage

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Provider assignments must reference credentialed providers only. Member services validates provider credentials daily when processing PCP assignments and specialist referrals to ensure network complia

attributes.name: provider_program_participation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.provider_program_participation. Business justification: Member-provider assignments must verify the provider participates in the government program (Medicare/Medicaid). Care coordination teams use this to ensure members are assigned only to program-eligibl

products.name: benefit_election
products.description: Members elected optional benefits (dental, vision, HSA, etc.) with election dates and plan codes.

attributes.name: benefit_election_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each benefit election record. Primary key for the benefit election entity.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member who made the benefit election. Links to the member entity.

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identifier for the primary member on the policy. Used for member identification across systems.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The employer or group identifier associated with the member's coverage. Used to identify the sponsoring organization.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan being elected. Links to the benefit plan catalog.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_code
attributes.description: The standardized code representing the specific benefit plan elected (e.g., dental, vision, HSA, FSA).

attributes.name: benefit_plan_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the benefit plan elected by the member.

attributes.name: benefit_type
attributes.description: The category of benefit being elected. Classifies the benefit into major types such as dental, vision, health savings accounts, etc.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The level of coverage elected indicating who is covered under the benefit (e.g., employee only, employee plus spouse, family).

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member made the benefit election. This is the date the member submitted their election choice.

attributes.name: election_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the elected benefit coverage becomes active and enforceable.

attributes.name: election_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the elected benefit coverage terminates or expires.

attributes.name: election_status
attributes.description: The current status of the benefit election indicating whether it is pending approval, active, terminated, or cancelled.

attributes.name: election_method
attributes.description: The method or channel through which the member submitted their benefit election (e.g., online portal, phone, paper form).

attributes.name: election_reason
attributes.description: The reason or qualifying event that allowed the member to make this benefit election (e.g., new hire, open enrollment, qualifying life event).
attributes.references: COBRA Regulations, HIPAA Special Enrollment Rights

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date
attributes.description: The date of the qualifying life event that triggered the benefit election, if applicable (e.g., marriage date, birth date).

attributes.name: enrollment_period_type
attributes.description: The type of enrollment period during which the benefit election was made (e.g., open enrollment, special enrollment period).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1311, HIPAA Special Enrollment Rights

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: The premium amount associated with the elected benefit. This is the cost charged to the member or employer for the benefit coverage.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the premium amount that the employee is responsible for paying.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the premium amount that the employer contributes on behalf of the employee.

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which premium contributions are collected (e.g., monthly, biweekly, annual).

attributes.name: annual_election_amount
attributes.description: The total annual amount elected by the member for contribution-based benefits such as Health Savings Account (HSA) or Flexible Spending Account (FSA).

attributes.name: per_pay_period_amount
attributes.description: The amount deducted from the member's paycheck each pay period for the elected benefit.

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: The total coverage or benefit amount provided under the elected benefit (e.g., life insurance coverage amount, disability benefit amount).

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: The deductible amount associated with the elected benefit plan. The amount the member must pay out-of-pocket before coverage begins.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC)

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: The maximum out-of-pocket amount the member will pay during the benefit period before the plan pays 100% of covered expenses.

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed copayment amount the member pays for specific services under the elected benefit plan.

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of costs the member is responsible for paying after the deductible is met under the elected benefit plan.

attributes.name: waiver_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has waived or declined the benefit coverage. True if waived, false if elected.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the member for waiving or declining the benefit coverage (e.g., covered under spouse's plan, cost, not needed).

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member waived or declined the benefit coverage.

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary beneficiary designated by the member for benefits such as life insurance or death benefits.

attributes.name: beneficiary_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the beneficiary to the member (e.g., spouse, child, parent).

attributes.name: beneficiary_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the benefit amount allocated to the designated beneficiary.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: The number of dependents covered under the elected benefit.

attributes.name: tobacco_user_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is a tobacco user. This may affect premium rates for certain benefit plans.

attributes.name: pre_existing_condition_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has disclosed a pre-existing medical condition that may affect benefit eligibility or coverage terms.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is required to provide evidence of insurability (medical underwriting) for the elected benefit.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_status
attributes.description: The status of the evidence of insurability review process (e.g., pending, approved, denied).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit election was approved by the plan administrator or underwriter.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person or system that approved the benefit election.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit election was cancelled by the member or plan administrator.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason for cancelling the benefit election (e.g., member request, non-payment, termination of employment).

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit coverage was terminated.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for terminating the benefit coverage (e.g., employment termination, voluntary cancellation, non-payment).

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon termination of the benefit.

attributes.name: cobra_election_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Date
attributes.description: The date on which the member elected COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business under which the benefit election is categorized (e.g., commercial, Medicare, Medicaid).

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The plan year during which the benefit election is effective. Typically a 12-month period defined by the employer or plan.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number associated with the elected benefit coverage.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The certificate number issued to the member for the elected benefit coverage.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: The confirmation number provided to the member upon successful submission of the benefit election.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which the benefit election data originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: The EDI transaction set type used to transmit the benefit election data (e.g., 834 for benefit enrollment and maintenance).

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: The name of the employer or group sponsor associated with the benefit election.

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: The name of the insurance broker or agent who assisted with the benefit election, if applicable.

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the insurance broker or agent who assisted with the benefit election.

attributes.name: election_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the benefit election, such as special instructions or member requests.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit election record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person or system that last modified the benefit election record.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member who made the benefit election. Links to the member entity.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identifier for the primary member on the policy. Used for member identification across systems.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan being elected. Links to the benefit plan catalog.

attributes.name: rider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rider. Business justification: Members elect optional riders (dental, vision, supplemental) during enrollment. Benefits administration uses this to track add-on coverage selections and calculate premiums.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Benefit elections must tie to the governing agreement to validate available options and pricing. Enrollment systems use this to ensure members only elect benefits permitted under their employer's or i

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.formulary. Business justification: Member benefit elections for pharmacy plans reference specific formularies. Pharmacy benefit managers use this to determine drug coverage and member cost-sharing at point of sale.

products.name: tax_info
products.description: Tax identification details for a member, including TIN, filing status, and tax exemption flags.

attributes.name: tax_info_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member tax information record.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The member's tax identification number, which may be a Social Security Number (SSN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) used for tax reporting purposes including 1095 forms and premium tax credit reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1075, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: The type of tax identification number provided: Social Security Number (SSN), Employer Identification Number (EIN), Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN), Adoption Taxpayer Identification Number (ATIN), or Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN).

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: The member's federal tax filing status used for premium tax credit calculations and subsidy eligibility determination under the Affordable Care Act.

attributes.name: tax_household_size
attributes.description: The number of individuals in the member's tax household, used to determine Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) thresholds for subsidy eligibility and premium tax credit calculations.

attributes.name: claimed_dependents_count
attributes.description: The number of dependents the member claims on their tax return, affecting premium tax credit eligibility and household income calculations.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is exempt from the individual mandate penalty or premium tax obligations due to religious exemptions, hardship exemptions, or other qualifying circumstances.

attributes.name: exemption_type
attributes.description: The specific type of exemption from the individual mandate or tax obligations, such as religious conscience exemption, hardship exemption, income below filing threshold, short coverage gap, incarceration, or membership in a federally recognized tribe.

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number issued by the Health Insurance Marketplace for members who received an exemption from the individual mandate requirement.

attributes.name: aptc_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible to receive Advanced Premium Tax Credits based on household income, tax filing status, and enrollment in a Qualified Health Plan through the Health Insurance Marketplace.

attributes.name: aptc_monthly_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC) Monthly Amount
attributes.description: The monthly dollar amount of Advanced Premium Tax Credit applied to reduce the member's premium payment, calculated based on household income and the second lowest cost Silver plan benchmark.

attributes.name: csr_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for Cost Sharing Reductions that lower out-of-pocket costs for deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance based on household income and enrollment in a Silver-level Qualified Health Plan.

attributes.name: csr_variant
attributes.description: The specific Cost Sharing Reduction plan variant assigned based on Federal Poverty Level (FPL) percentage: 73% actuarial value (250-400% FPL), 87% (200-250% FPL), 94% (100-200% FPL), or limited (Native Americans).

attributes.name: household_income_amount
attributes.description: The member's reported annual household income used to determine subsidy eligibility, premium tax credit amounts, and Cost Sharing Reduction qualification. This is typically Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI).

attributes.name: income_verification_status
attributes.description: The status of income verification through the Federal Data Services Hub or manual documentation review, indicating whether reported household income has been confirmed for subsidy eligibility.

attributes.name: income_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the member's household income was last verified through the Federal Data Services Hub, IRS data matching, or manual documentation review.

attributes.name: fpl_percentage
attributes.description: The member's household income expressed as a percentage of the Federal Poverty Level, used to determine eligibility for premium tax credits, Cost Sharing Reductions, and Medicaid expansion.

attributes.name: medicaid_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for Medicaid coverage based on household income, state expansion status, and categorical eligibility criteria, which affects Marketplace subsidy eligibility.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2001, CMS Medicaid Eligibility Standards

attributes.name: chip_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dependent children in the household are eligible for the Children's Health Insurance Program based on household income and state-specific CHIP guidelines.
attributes.references: Title XXI of the Social Security Act, CMS CHIP Standards

attributes.name: form_1095a_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 1095-A (Health Insurance Marketplace Statement) has been issued to the member for the tax year, required for premium tax credit reconciliation on Form 8962.

attributes.name: form_1095a_issue_date
attributes.description: The date when IRS Form 1095-A was issued to the member, typically by January 31st following the coverage year.

attributes.name: form_1095b_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 1095-B (Health Coverage) has been issued to the member for minimum essential coverage reporting to satisfy individual mandate requirements.

attributes.name: form_1095b_issue_date
attributes.description: The date when IRS Form 1095-B was issued to the member for health coverage reporting.

attributes.name: form_1095c_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 1095-C (Employer-Provided Health Insurance Offer and Coverage) has been issued for members with employer-sponsored coverage, used for employer mandate compliance.

attributes.name: form_1095c_issue_date
attributes.description: The date when IRS Form 1095-C was issued to the member for employer-sponsored coverage reporting.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which the tax information applies, used for annual tax reporting, premium tax credit reconciliation, and 1095 form generation.

attributes.name: reconciliation_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Premium Tax Credit Reconciliation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member must reconcile Advanced Premium Tax Credits received during the year with actual premium tax credits calculated on their tax return using Form 8962.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current status of premium tax credit reconciliation, indicating whether the member owes repayment of excess APTC or is due an additional refund based on actual household income.

attributes.name: excess_aptc_repayment_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Excess Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC) Repayment Amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount the member must repay to the IRS if actual household income exceeded estimated income and resulted in excess Advanced Premium Tax Credits being paid on their behalf.

attributes.name: additional_ptc_refund_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Additional Premium Tax Credit (PTC) Refund Amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount the member is entitled to receive as an additional premium tax credit refund if actual household income was lower than estimated and they received less APTC than eligible for.

attributes.name: slcsp_premium_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Second Lowest Cost Silver Plan (SLCSP) Premium Amount
attributes.description: The monthly premium amount for the Second Lowest Cost Silver Plan available in the member's rating area, used as the benchmark for calculating premium tax credit amounts.

attributes.name: enrollment_premium_amount
attributes.description: The monthly premium amount for the member's actual enrolled Qualified Health Plan before application of Advanced Premium Tax Credits.

attributes.name: tobacco_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: The additional monthly premium amount charged due to tobacco use, which is not eligible for premium tax credit subsidies and must be paid by the member.

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: The member's citizenship or immigration status, which affects eligibility for premium tax credits, Cost Sharing Reductions, and Medicaid coverage under the Affordable Care Act.

attributes.name: citizenship_verification_status
attributes.description: The status of citizenship or immigration status verification through the Department of Homeland Security SAVE system or Social Security Administration data matching.

attributes.name: citizenship_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the member's citizenship or lawful presence status was last verified through federal data matching systems.

attributes.name: incarceration_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is currently incarcerated, which affects eligibility for premium tax credits and Marketplace coverage but not Medicaid eligibility.

attributes.name: native_american_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is a member of a federally recognized Indian tribe, Alaska Native, or Native Hawaiian, which provides special exemptions and limited Cost Sharing Reductions.
attributes.references: ACA Section 5000A, Indian Health Care Improvement Act

attributes.name: tribal_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member qualifies for exemption from the individual mandate and special Cost Sharing Reductions as a member of a federally recognized Indian tribe or Alaska Native.

attributes.name: hardship_exemption_reason
attributes.description: The specific hardship circumstance that qualifies the member for exemption from the individual mandate, such as homelessness, eviction, domestic violence, death of family member, or natural disaster.

attributes.name: affordability_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is exempt from the individual mandate because the lowest cost Bronze plan premium exceeds 8% of household income, making coverage unaffordable.

attributes.name: religious_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is exempt from the individual mandate due to membership in a recognized religious sect with objections to health insurance.

attributes.name: coverage_gap_months
attributes.description: The number of consecutive months the member was without minimum essential coverage during the tax year. Gaps of less than 3 months qualify for short coverage gap exemption.

attributes.name: minimum_essential_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member had minimum essential coverage for the tax year, satisfying the individual mandate requirement and affecting penalty calculations.

attributes.name: employer_coverage_offered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was offered employer-sponsored health coverage that meets minimum value and affordability standards, which affects Marketplace subsidy eligibility.

attributes.name: employer_coverage_affordable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employer-sponsored coverage offered to the member meets the affordability standard (employee contribution for self-only coverage does not exceed 9.5% of household income), affecting premium tax credit eligibility.

attributes.name: employer_coverage_minimum_value_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employer-sponsored coverage offered to the member provides minimum value (covers at least 60% of total allowed costs), affecting premium tax credit eligibility.

attributes.name: marketplace_application_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the member's Health Insurance Marketplace application used for eligibility determination and subsidy calculations.

attributes.name: eligibility_determination_date
attributes.description: The date when the member's eligibility for premium tax credits, Cost Sharing Reductions, and Marketplace coverage was determined by the Health Insurance Marketplace.

attributes.name: annual_redetermination_date
attributes.description: The date when the member's eligibility for subsidies and coverage must be redetermined annually, typically during open enrollment or at the coverage anniversary.

attributes.name: income_change_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member reported a change in household income during the coverage year that may affect subsidy amounts and require mid-year eligibility redetermination.

attributes.name: income_change_reported_date
attributes.description: The date when the member reported a change in household income that triggered a mid-year eligibility redetermination and potential subsidy adjustment.

attributes.name: household_composition_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member reported a change in household composition (marriage, divorce, birth, adoption, death) that affects tax household size and subsidy eligibility.

attributes.name: household_composition_change_date
attributes.description: The date when a qualifying life event changed the member's household composition, triggering eligibility redetermination and potential special enrollment period.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The source system or platform from which the tax information was captured, such as Marketplace application, member portal, enrollment system, or IRS data matching.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this tax information record becomes effective for the member, typically aligned with coverage effective date or tax year start.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this tax information record is no longer effective, typically at the end of the tax year or when superseded by updated information.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current status of the tax information record, indicating whether it is the active record, has been superseded by newer information, or has been archived.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the tax information record was last updated in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to member.member_profile. Business justification: tax_info is currently siloed with no FK to member_profile. Tax information (TIN, filing status, APTC eligibility, household income) belongs to a specific member. This FK establishes the ownership rela

attributes.name: tax_detail_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.tax_detail. Business justification: Member tax information references standardized tax details for 1095 forms and premium tax credits. Finance teams generate annual tax documents using member-specific tax detail linkages.

products.name: emergency_contact
products.description: Emergency contact person for a member with relationship, phone, and address details.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the emergency contact record. Primary key for the emergency contact entity.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the member to whom this emergency contact is associated. Links the emergency contact to the member record.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: The relationship of the emergency contact to the member (e.g., spouse, parent, child, sibling, guardian, friend).

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: The first name of the emergency contact person.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The middle name or initial of the emergency contact person.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: The last name or surname of the emergency contact person.

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: The suffix of the emergency contact's name (e.g., Jr., Sr., II, III).

attributes.name: primary_phone_number
attributes.description: The primary phone number to reach the emergency contact. This is the first number to call in case of emergency.

attributes.name: primary_phone_type
attributes.description: The type of the primary phone number (e.g., mobile, home, work).

attributes.name: secondary_phone_number
attributes.description: An alternate phone number to reach the emergency contact if the primary number is unavailable.

attributes.name: secondary_phone_type
attributes.description: The type of the secondary phone number (e.g., mobile, home, work).

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: The email address of the emergency contact for electronic communication.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the emergency contact's street address (e.g., street number and name).

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the emergency contact's street address (e.g., apartment, suite, unit number).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The city where the emergency contact resides.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state or province code where the emergency contact resides (e.g., CA, NY, TX).

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: The postal ZIP code of the emergency contact's address.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code where the emergency contact resides (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emergency contact is the primary contact to be reached first in case of emergency.

attributes.name: contact_priority
attributes.description: The priority order in which this emergency contact should be reached (1 = first contact, 2 = second contact, etc.).

attributes.name: can_make_medical_decisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emergency contact is authorized to make medical decisions on behalf of the member.

attributes.name: has_power_of_attorney
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emergency contact has legal power of attorney for the member.

attributes.name: is_legal_guardian
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emergency contact is the legal guardian of the member (typically for minor or dependent members).

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: The preferred language for communication with the emergency contact.

attributes.name: best_time_to_call
attributes.description: The preferred time of day to contact the emergency contact person.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or special instructions regarding the emergency contact (e.g., availability, special circumstances).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the emergency contact record (e.g., active, inactive, suspended, deleted).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this emergency contact record became effective and active.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this emergency contact record was terminated or became inactive.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: The date when the emergency contact information was last verified or confirmed as accurate.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the emergency contact information (e.g., phone call, email, mail, in-person, member portal).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this emergency contact record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Salesforce Health Cloud).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this emergency contact record in the source system.

attributes.name: consent_to_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the emergency contact has provided consent to be contacted regarding the member's health information.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date when the emergency contact provided consent to be contacted.

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed HIPAA authorization form is on file allowing disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI) to this emergency contact.

attributes.name: authorization_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the HIPAA authorization to disclose PHI to this emergency contact expires.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this emergency contact record was originally created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this emergency contact record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the member to whom this emergency contact is associated. Links the emergency contact to the member record.

products.name: member_note
products.description: Free‑form notes captured by care managers or service agents about a member.

attributes.name: member_note_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member note record. Primary key for the member note entity.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Free-form text content of the note captured by care managers, service agents, or other authorized personnel regarding member interactions, care plans, or service issues.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the note based on its purpose or functional area (e.g., care management, customer service, claims inquiry, prior authorization).

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief subject or title summarizing the main topic or purpose of the note.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the note in its lifecycle (e.g., draft, active, completed, archived, pending review).

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the note indicating urgency or importance of the documented issue or interaction.

attributes.name: sensitivity_level
attributes.description: Classification indicating the sensitivity of the note content for access control and privacy purposes.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the note was originally created in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the note was originally created in the system.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the user (care manager, service agent, clinician) who created the note.

attributes.name: created_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the user who created the note for audit and reference purposes.

attributes.name: created_by_role

products.name: group_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between member_group and agreement. It captures the specific terms, rates, and enrollment parameters that apply when a particular employer group is covered under a provider or payer agreement. Each record links one member_group to one agreement with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, such as group-specific rate tiers, contribution amounts, and effective dates.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, employer groups (member_groups) can be covered under multiple provider or payer agreements simultaneously or over time (e.g., different agreements for different service categories, geographic regions, or renewal periods). Conversely, a single master agreement (especially association plans, multi-employer trusts, or network agreements) can cover multiple employer groups with group-specific rate tiers, contribution levels, and effective dates. The business actively manages these group-agreement relationships as distinct operational entities with their own lifecycle, rates, and terms.

products.name: program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between a member and a care or wellness program. It captures the member's participation lifecycle including enrollment dates, participation status, assigned care coordinators, and outcome metrics. Each record links one member to one program with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship, supporting care management operations, quality reporting (HEDIS/Stars), and program effectiveness analysis.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, members routinely enroll in multiple concurrent programs (e.g., a diabetic member may be enrolled in Diabetes Management, Wellness Coaching, and Medication Adherence programs simultaneously), and each program serves thousands of members. Care management teams actively manage these enrollments as operational entities, tracking enrollment dates, participation status, assigned care coordinators, and outcome metrics for each member-program combination to support quality reporting (HEDIS/Stars) and program effectiveness analysis.
