attributes.name: urgent_care_services
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location provides urgent care services for non-emergency acute conditions.

attributes.name: preventive_care_services
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location provides preventive care services such as wellness visits, screenings, and immunizations.

attributes.name: lab_services_onsite
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location has on-site laboratory services for diagnostic testing.

attributes.name: imaging_services_onsite
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location has on-site imaging services such as X-ray, ultrasound, or MRI.

attributes.name: pharmacy_onsite
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location has an on-site pharmacy for prescription dispensing.

attributes.name: patient_portal_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location offers an online patient portal for appointment scheduling, medical records access, and secure messaging.

attributes.name: ehr_system_name
attributes.description: The name of the Electronic Health Record system used at the practice location for clinical documentation.

attributes.name: edi_capability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location has the capability to submit claims and receive remittances electronically via EDI.

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: The overall quality rating score for the practice location based on HEDIS measures, patient satisfaction, and clinical outcomes (scale 0.00 to 5.00).

attributes.name: patient_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: The patient satisfaction score for the practice location based on CAHPS surveys and member feedback (scale 0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The network tier classification of the practice location indicating cost-sharing levels and member access priority.

attributes.name: pcmh_recognized
attributes.business_glossary_term: Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) Recognized Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location has achieved NCQA Patient-Centered Medical Home recognition.

attributes.name: aco_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location participates in an Accountable Care Organization for value-based care arrangements.

attributes.name: value_based_contract
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location operates under a value-based care contract with quality and cost performance incentives.

attributes.name: risk_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The type of financial risk arrangement between Healthcare and the practice location.

attributes.name: medicaid_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location accepts Medicaid patients and participates in state Medicaid programs.

attributes.name: medicare_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location accepts Medicare patients and participates in Medicare programs.

attributes.name: medicare_advantage_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location accepts Medicare Advantage plan members.

attributes.name: commercial_insurance_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location accepts commercial health insurance plans.

attributes.name: self_pay_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location accepts self-pay patients without insurance coverage.

attributes.name: sliding_fee_scale
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location offers a sliding fee scale based on patient income for uninsured or underinsured patients.

attributes.name: fqhc_designation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) Designation Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location is designated as a Federally Qualified Health Center.

attributes.name: rural_health_clinic
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location is certified as a Rural Health Clinic serving underserved rural areas.

attributes.name: teaching_facility
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location serves as a teaching facility for medical residents, fellows, or students.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: The date when the practice location information was last verified for accuracy in the provider directory.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or method by which the practice location data was obtained (e.g., CAQH, provider attestation, site visit).

attributes.name: directory_listing_status
attributes.description: The publication status of the practice location in the member-facing provider directory.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider_profile. Business justification: Links practice locations to the provider master record. Locations belong to providers. The name attribute in location can be retrieved from provider_profile via JOIN.

attributes.name: group_practice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.group_practice. Business justification: Links locations to group practices. Locations can be operated by group practices. The medical_group_name attribute in location can be retrieved from group_practice via JOIN.

attributes.name: taxonomy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.taxonomy. Business justification: Links locations to taxonomy reference table. Locations have taxonomy_code attribute that should reference the taxonomy master table for standardized classification.

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Links locations to specialty reference table. Locations have specialty attribute that should reference the specialty master table for standardized classification.

products.name: specialty
products.description: Standardized specialty codes that classify provider clinical expertise.

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider specialty classification.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the provider specialty classification used for provider directory, credentialing, and network management.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the provider specialty (e.g., Cardiology, Orthopedic Surgery, Family Medicine).
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the clinical expertise, scope of practice, and services associated with this specialty classification.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: taxonomy_code
attributes.description: National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) 10-character taxonomy code that classifies provider type, classification, and specialization area.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: taxonomy_classification
attributes.description: The classification level within the taxonomy hierarchy (e.g., Allopathic & Osteopathic Physicians, Behavioral Health & Social Service Providers).
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: taxonomy_specialization
attributes.description: The specialization level within the taxonomy hierarchy providing granular detail on the area of clinical expertise.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the specialty for network management and utilization reporting (e.g., primary care, specialty care, surgical, diagnostic).

attributes.name: board_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether board certification is required for providers practicing in this specialty for network participation.

attributes.name: board_certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the recognized board certification organization for this specialty (e.g., American Board of Internal Medicine, American Board of Surgery).

attributes.name: primary_care_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty qualifies as a Primary Care Provider (PCP) designation for member assignment and referral management.

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a referral from a Primary Care Provider (PCP) is required to see providers in this specialty under certain plan types (HMO, EPO).

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether services provided by this specialty typically require prior authorization for coverage under utilization management protocols.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_category
attributes.description: Classification of the specialty for network adequacy assessment and regulatory reporting to ensure sufficient provider access.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: time_distance_standard_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum travel time in minutes required for network adequacy compliance for this specialty type in urban/rural settings.

attributes.name: provider_to_member_ratio_standard
attributes.description: Required provider-to-member ratio for network adequacy compliance for this specialty (e.g., 1:2000 for primary care).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: credentialing_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this specialty for provider credentialing and recredentialing processes based on network needs.

attributes.name: recredentialing_cycle_months
attributes.description: Standard recredentialing cycle period in months for providers in this specialty (typically 24 or 36 months).

attributes.name: telehealth_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether services provided by this specialty are eligible for telehealth delivery and reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Services, State Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: behavioral_health_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is classified as behavioral health or mental health for parity compliance and reporting.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA)

attributes.name: substance_use_disorder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty provides substance use disorder treatment services for parity compliance and network adequacy.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA)

attributes.name: hedis_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether services provided by this specialty are included in HEDIS quality measure reporting and performance evaluation.

attributes.name: quality_measure_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is subject to quality measurement programs and performance-based reimbursement models.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Payment Program, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: value_based_care_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this specialty are eligible to participate in value-based care arrangements and alternative payment models.

attributes.name: preventive_care_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty primarily provides preventive care services that are covered at 100% under ACA preventive care mandates.
attributes.references: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Preventive Services Requirements

attributes.name: medicare_advantage_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is eligible for Medicare Advantage network participation and reimbursement.

attributes.name: medicaid_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is eligible for Medicaid managed care network participation and reimbursement.

attributes.name: commercial_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is eligible for commercial insurance product network participation.

attributes.name: marketplace_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is eligible for ACA marketplace qualified health plan (QHP) network participation.

attributes.name: dme_provider_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty classification includes durable medical equipment providers.

attributes.name: facility_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty represents a facility-based provider type (hospital, SNF, clinic) rather than an individual practitioner.

attributes.name: ancillary_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty provides ancillary services (lab, imaging, therapy) rather than direct patient care.

attributes.name: high_cost_specialty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is classified as high-cost for utilization management and cost containment strategies.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether services provided by this specialty contribute to risk adjustment factor (RAF) scoring and hierarchical condition category (HCC) coding.

attributes.name: care_management_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this specialty are eligible to participate in care management and disease management programs.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_focus_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty primarily treats chronic conditions for special needs plan (SNP) network adequacy and care coordination.

attributes.name: emergency_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty provides emergency services subject to prudent layperson standard and No Surprises Act protections.
attributes.references: No Surprises Act, Prudent Layperson Standard

attributes.name: out_of_network_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is eligible for out-of-network reimbursement under certain plan designs (PPO, POS).

attributes.name: directory_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty should be displayed in member-facing provider directories and search tools.

attributes.name: search_keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of search keywords and synonyms to improve provider directory search functionality for this specialty.

attributes.name: parent_specialty_code
attributes.description: Code of the parent specialty in a hierarchical specialty classification structure for rollup reporting.

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Grouping of related specialties for network planning, contracting, and reporting purposes (e.g., Surgical Specialties, Medical Specialties).

attributes.name: reimbursement_tier
attributes.description: Reimbursement tier classification for this specialty used in tiered network designs and differential payment strategies.

attributes.name: relative_value_unit_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to relative value units for reimbursement calculation specific to this specialty classification.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the specialty code in the system indicating whether it is actively used for provider classification.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this specialty classification became effective and available for use in provider credentialing and network management.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this specialty classification was terminated or deprecated and is no longer available for new provider assignments.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the specialty classification record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this specialty classification was derived (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: external_code
attributes.description: External specialty code used by partner systems, clearinghouses, or regulatory bodies for data exchange and reporting.

attributes.name: cms_specialty_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Specialty Code
attributes.description: Two-digit CMS specialty code used for Medicare claims submission and provider enrollment.

products.name: taxonomy
products.description: Taxonomy codes describing provider type and classification for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: taxonomy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider taxonomy code record.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: The 10-digit alphanumeric Healthcare Provider Taxonomy Code that classifies the provider type, classification, and specialization. Format is 10 characters ending in X.
attributes.references: National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: The broad classification category of the provider taxonomy, such as Physician, Hospital, Behavioral Health, or Ancillary Service Provider.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: specialization
attributes.description: The specific area of specialization within the classification, such as Cardiology, Orthopedic Surgery, or Family Medicine.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: definition
attributes.description: The official definition and description of the taxonomy code as defined by the National Uniform Claim Committee.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: grouping
attributes.description: The high-level grouping category for the taxonomy code, such as Allopathic & Osteopathic Physicians, Dental Providers, or Hospitals.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The human-readable display name for the taxonomy code used in provider directories and member-facing materials.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the taxonomy code indicating whether it is active for use, inactive, deprecated, or pending approval.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the taxonomy code became effective and available for use in provider credentialing and network management.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when the taxonomy code was terminated or deprecated and is no longer valid for new provider assignments.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a professional license is required for providers classified under this taxonomy code.

attributes.name: board_certification_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether board certification is available for this taxonomy specialization through recognized medical boards.

attributes.name: primary_specialty_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy code can be designated as a provider's primary specialty for credentialing and network participation purposes.

attributes.name: pcp_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are eligible to serve as Primary Care Physicians for Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) and Point of Service (POS) members.

attributes.name: specialist_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy code represents a specialist provider type that typically requires referrals or prior authorization.

attributes.name: behavioral_health_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy code represents a behavioral health or mental health provider subject to Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA) requirements.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA)

attributes.name: telehealth_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are eligible to provide telehealth services under current regulatory guidelines.

attributes.name: dme_provider_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy code represents a Durable Medical Equipment provider subject to specific billing and coverage rules.

attributes.name: facility_based_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy code represents a facility-based provider such as a hospital, skilled nursing facility, or ambulatory surgery center.

attributes.name: ancillary_service_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy code represents an ancillary service provider such as laboratory, radiology, or home health services.

attributes.name: medicare_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are eligible to participate in Medicare Advantage (MA) and Medicare Part D networks.

attributes.name: medicaid_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are eligible to participate in Medicaid managed care networks.

attributes.name: aca_essential_health_benefit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Essential Health Benefit Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether services provided under this taxonomy code are considered Essential Health Benefits under the Affordable Care Act for Qualified Health Plan (QHP) network adequacy.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_category
attributes.description: The network adequacy category used for regulatory reporting to state departments of insurance and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) to ensure sufficient provider access.
attributes.references: NAIC Network Adequacy Model Act, CMS Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: hedis_reporting_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Reporting Category
attributes.description: The Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set reporting category for quality measure attribution and National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) accreditation.

attributes.name: credentialing_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned for credentialing and recredentialing activities based on provider type and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether encounters with providers of this taxonomy code are eligible for Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk adjustment coding and Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) score calculation.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether services from providers with this taxonomy code typically require prior authorization or utilization management review.

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must obtain a referral from their Primary Care Physician (PCP) to see providers with this taxonomy code under Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) and Point of Service (POS) plans.

attributes.name: directory_display_priority
attributes.description: The display priority ranking for this taxonomy code in member-facing provider directories and search results, with lower numbers indicating higher priority.

attributes.name: claims_processing_category
attributes.description: The claims processing category that determines which adjudication rules and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transaction formats apply to claims from providers with this taxonomy code.

attributes.name: npi_enumeration_type
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier enumeration type applicable to this taxonomy code: NPI-1 for individual providers, NPI-2 for organizational providers, or both.

attributes.name: caqh_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code can use the Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) ProView system for credentialing data collection.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) Healthcare Provider Taxonomy Code Set from which this code is derived.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: The date when the taxonomy code record was last updated in the system to reflect changes from the National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) or internal business rules.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the taxonomy code, including special handling instructions, regulatory considerations, or business rule exceptions.

products.name: network_affiliation
products.description: Transactional record of a provider's participation status in a specific network, including effective dates, tier, and termination flags.

attributes.name: network_affiliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network affiliation record representing a provider's participation in a specific network.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the healthcare provider participating in the network.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider network to which the provider is affiliated.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the healthcare provider.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry, HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The 9-digit Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) used for provider payment and tax reporting purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Regulations, CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's participation in the network indicating whether they are actively accepting patients and claims.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The tier or classification level of the provider within the network, typically affecting member cost-sharing and reimbursement rates.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract governing the terms of the provider's network participation.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The type of contractual arrangement governing the provider's network participation and reimbursement methodology.

attributes.name: reimbursement_method
attributes.description: The payment methodology used to reimburse the provider for services rendered to network members.
attributes.references: CMS Payment Methodologies, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patients from the network.
attributes.references: Provider Directory Standards, NCQA Network Adequacy

attributes.name: pcp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is designated as a Primary Care Physician eligible for member assignment in HMO and POS plans.

attributes.name: specialist_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is classified as a specialist requiring referral or prior authorization for certain plan types.

attributes.name: hospital_affiliation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has admitting privileges or is affiliated with a hospital in the network.

attributes.name: telehealth_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is enabled to deliver services via telehealth or virtual care platforms.
attributes.references: Telehealth Policy Standards, CMS Telehealth Guidelines

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's credentialing verification process required for network participation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, URAC Provider Credentialing

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider was initially credentialed for network participation.

attributes.name: recredentialing_date
attributes.description: The date by which the provider must complete recredentialing to maintain network participation status.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business or product type for which the provider is participating in the network.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The type of health plan product for which the network affiliation applies.

attributes.name: geographic_service_area
attributes.description: The geographic region or service area where the provider is authorized to serve network members.
attributes.references: NCQA Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: service_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific practice location or facility where the provider delivers services under this network affiliation.

attributes.name: par_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is a participating provider who has agreed to accept network reimbursement rates.
attributes.references: Medicare Participation Standards, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: risk_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The type of financial risk-sharing arrangement between the payer and provider under this network affiliation.
attributes.references: Value-Based Care Contract Standards, CMS APM Framework

attributes.name: quality_tier_designation
attributes.description: The quality performance tier assigned to the provider based on clinical quality metrics and outcomes.
attributes.references: HEDIS Quality Measures, NCQA Quality Standards

attributes.name: center_of_excellence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is designated as a Center of Excellence for specific high-complexity procedures or conditions.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: The coded reason for termination of the provider's network affiliation.

attributes.name: termination_initiated_by
attributes.description: Indicates which party initiated the termination of the network affiliation.

attributes.name: auto_assignment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is eligible to receive auto-assigned members in HMO or managed care plans.

attributes.name: panel_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current capacity status of the provider's patient panel for accepting new member assignments.
attributes.references: Provider Directory Standards, Network Adequacy Requirements

attributes.name: panel_size_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of members that can be assigned to the provider's panel.

attributes.name: current_panel_count
attributes.description: The current number of members assigned to the provider's panel.

attributes.name: directory_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider should be displayed in public-facing provider directories and search tools.
attributes.references: Provider Directory Standards, Transparency in Coverage Rule

attributes.name: claims_submission_method
attributes.description: The method by which the provider submits claims for services rendered to network members.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 EDI Standards, HIPAA Transaction Standards

attributes.name: edi_payer_id
attributes.description: The unique payer identifier used in EDI transactions for claims submission and remittance.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the provider receives reimbursement payments from the payer.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Payment Standards, Provider Payment Standards

attributes.name: eft_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is enrolled to receive payments via electronic funds transfer.

attributes.name: era_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is enrolled to receive electronic remittance advice for claim payments.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether services from this provider require prior authorization for coverage under the network terms.

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must obtain a referral to see this provider under certain plan types.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_category
attributes.description: The provider category used for network adequacy analysis and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: aco_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider participates in an Accountable Care Organization arrangement.

attributes.name: accountable_care_organization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Accountable Care Organization in which the provider participates.

attributes.name: pcmh_recognition_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) Recognition Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has achieved Patient Centered Medical Home recognition from NCQA or equivalent body.

attributes.name: cultural_competency_language
attributes.description: Languages in which the provider or practice staff can deliver culturally competent care to members.
attributes.references: NCQA Cultural Competency Standards, CLAS Standards

attributes.name: weekend_hours_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers services during weekend hours.

attributes.name: evening_hours_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers services during evening hours.

attributes.name: affiliation_source_system
attributes.description: The source system or platform from which the network affiliation record originated.

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's network affiliation information was last verified for accuracy.
attributes.references: Provider Directory Accuracy Standards, CMS Directory Requirements

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the provider's network affiliation information must be re-verified.
attributes.references: Provider Directory Accuracy Standards, CMS Directory Requirements

attributes.name: contract_amendment_count
attributes.description: The number of amendments made to the provider's network contract since the original effective date.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent amendment to the provider's network contract.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's contract includes performance guarantees or quality-based incentives.

attributes.name: exclusion_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has been excluded from participation in federal healthcare programs by OIG or GSA.
attributes.references: OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE), GSA System for Award Management (SAM)

attributes.name: exclusion_check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider was last checked against federal and state exclusion lists.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE, GSA SAM, State Medicaid Exclusion Lists

attributes.name: malpractice_insurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider maintains current malpractice insurance coverage as required by the network contract.
attributes.references: Provider Credentialing Standards, State Medical Board Requirements

attributes.name: malpractice_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the provider's current malpractice insurance policy.

attributes.name: license_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's professional license was last verified as current and in good standing.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, State Medical Board Requirements

attributes.name: dea_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's DEA registration was last verified for prescribing controlled substances.
attributes.references: DEA Registration Requirements, NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: board_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is board certified in their specialty by a recognized medical board.
attributes.references: ABMS Board Certification Standards, Provider Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: hospital_privileges_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has admitting privileges at one or more hospitals in the network.

attributes.name: claims_payment_tier
attributes.description: The payment tier that determines the reimbursement rate schedule applied to the provider's claims.
attributes.references: Provider Contract Terms, Payment Integrity Standards

attributes.name: prompt_payment_discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount percentage applied if the provider accepts prompt payment terms under the contract.

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of payments withheld for quality performance or risk-sharing arrangements.

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The dollar threshold above which stop-loss protection applies for risk-bearing providers.

attributes.name: affiliation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the provider's network affiliation, restrictions, or special arrangements.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the healthcare provider participating in the network.

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Links network affiliations to specialty reference table. Network_affiliation has specialty_type attribute that should reference the specialty master table for standardized classification.

products.name: service_area
products.description: Geographic service area definitions for providers, used for network adequacy, routing, and member search.

attributes.name: service_area_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider service area record. Primary key for the provider service area entity.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider associated with this service area. Links to the provider master record.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the healthcare provider.
attributes.references: CMS National Provider Identifier Standard, HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The Tax Identification Number for the provider organization or practice, used for payment and tax reporting purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the geographic service area (e.g., 'Greater Chicago Metro', 'Northern California Region').

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the service area indicating the level of service coverage (primary, secondary, tertiary, extended, or limited).

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic granularity of the service area definition (national, regional, state, county, zip code, or custom boundary).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the service area location.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the service area.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county included in the service area.

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code uniquely identifying the county within the  States.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau FIPS County Codes

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: Name of the city or municipality included in the service area.

attributes.name: zip_code

attributes.name: zip_code_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ZIP codes covered by this service area, used for multi-ZIP service area definitions.

attributes.name: metropolitan_statistical_area
attributes.description: Name of the Metropolitan Statistical Area as defined by the US Census Bureau, used for urban service area classification.

attributes.name: msa_code

attributes.name: cbsa_code
attributes.description: Five-digit code identifying the Core Based Statistical Area, which includes both metropolitan and micropolitan areas.

attributes.name: region_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal business region or market area (e.g., 'Northeast Region', 'Pacific Northwest').

attributes.name: market_name
attributes.description: Name of the commercial market or service market within which the provider operates.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider network to which this service area applies (e.g., HMO network, PPO network, EPO network).

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: Name of the provider network (e.g., 'Healthcare Choice Plus', 'Healthcare Options PPO').

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Type of provider network: Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Accountable Care Organization (ACO), Special Needs Plan (SNP), or other.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business for which this service area applies: commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, marketplace (ACA exchange), Administrative Services Only (ASO), government programs, or other.
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Specific insurance product type associated with the service area (e.g., 'Medicare Advantage', 'Medicaid Managed Care', 'Individual ACA').

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Category of healthcare services provided within this service area: primary care, specialty care, hospital, urgent care, emergency, behavioral health, dental, vision, pharmacy, ancillary services, or other.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare facility for which the service area applies: hospital, clinic, ambulatory surgery center, skilled nursing facility, home health, hospice, laboratory, imaging center, or other.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's participation in the service area: active, inactive, pending, suspended, terminated, or excluded.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patients within this service area.

attributes.name: telehealth_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers telehealth or virtual care services within this service area.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Services, State Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: after_hours_care_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers after-hours care services within this service area.

attributes.name: weekend_availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers services on weekends within this service area.

attributes.name: language_services_available
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages in which the provider offers services within this service area (e.g., 'English,Spanish,Mandarin').
attributes.references: CMS Culturally and Linguistically Appropriate Services (CLAS) Standards

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's facilities within this service area are compliant with Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessibility requirements.

attributes.name: travel_distance_miles
attributes.description: Maximum travel distance in miles from the service area boundary to the provider location, used for network adequacy calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: travel_time_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum travel time in minutes from the service area boundary to the provider location, used for network adequacy calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: urban_rural_designation
attributes.description: Classification of the service area as urban, suburban, rural, or frontier based on population density and geographic characteristics.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau Urban-Rural Classification, HRSA Rural Health Definitions

attributes.name: medically_underserved_area_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service area is designated as a Medically Underserved Area by HRSA.

attributes.name: health_professional_shortage_area_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service area is designated as a Health Professional Shortage Area by HRSA.
attributes.references: HRSA Health Professional Shortage Area (HPSA) Designations

attributes.name: network_adequacy_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service area meets CMS and state regulatory network adequacy requirements for provider access.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: member_to_provider_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of members to providers within this service area, used for network adequacy and capacity planning.

attributes.name: capacity_status
attributes.description: Current capacity status of the provider within this service area: available, limited, at capacity, or over capacity.

attributes.name: appointment_availability_days
attributes.description: Average number of days until the next available appointment with the provider in this service area.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider contract governing services within this service area.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider contract for this service area became effective.

attributes.name: contract_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider contract for this service area terminates or terminated.

attributes.name: contract_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider contract for this service area is scheduled for renewal.

attributes.name: reimbursement_method
attributes.description: Method by which the provider is reimbursed for services in this area: fee-for-service, capitation, per diem, case rate, bundled payment, value-based, or other.
attributes.references: CMS Payment Models, Internal Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the fee schedule applicable to services provided within this service area.

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Provider tier level within the network for this service area, affecting member cost-sharing: tier 1, tier 2, tier 3, tier 4, preferred, standard, or out-of-network.

attributes.name: quality_tier_designation
attributes.description: Quality-based tier designation for the provider within this service area based on performance metrics.
attributes.references: NCQA Quality Standards, Internal Quality Management

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: Quality star rating for the provider within this service area, typically on a scale of 1.0 to 5.0.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings, NCQA Quality Standards

attributes.name: center_of_excellence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is designated as a Center of Excellence for specialized services within this service area.

attributes.name: patient_centered_medical_home_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is recognized as a Patient Centered Medical Home within this service area.

attributes.name: aco_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider participates in an Accountable Care Organization within this service area.

attributes.name: value_based_contract_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has a value-based care contract for services within this service area.
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Payment Models, Internal Contract Management

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the provider for this service area: credentialed, pending, expired, suspended, or revoked.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, URAC Provider Credentialing

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider was credentialed for services within this service area.

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider is due for recredentialing review for this service area.

attributes.name: exclusion_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the provider is excluded from federal healthcare programs: not excluded, excluded, or pending review.
attributes.references: OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE), SAM.gov Exclusions

attributes.name: exclusion_check_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider was last checked against federal exclusion lists.

attributes.name: directory_listing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is listed in the member-facing provider directory for this service area.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements, No Surprises Act

attributes.name: directory_last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider directory information for this service area was last updated.

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a referral is required for members to access this provider within the service area.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization is required for services from this provider within the service area.

attributes.name: pcp_assignment_allowed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) Assignment Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can select this provider as their Primary Care Physician within this service area.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider service area record became effective.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider service area record was terminated or is scheduled for termination.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider service area information was last verified for accuracy.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or process from which the provider service area data originated (e.g., 'Facets', 'QNXT', 'Manual Entry', 'Provider Portal').

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider service area record: active, inactive, pending, deleted, or archived.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider service area record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider service area record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the provider service area, used for additional context or special instructions.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider associated with this service area. Links to the provider master record.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Links provider service areas to specialty reference table. Provider_service_area has specialty_type attribute that should reference the specialty master table for standardized classification.

Claims processing validates geographic eligibility by matching provider service area to contract service area for payment authorization

products.name: quality_metric
products.description: Quality performance metrics captured for each provider, such as HEDIS scores, outcome measures, and star ratings.

attributes.name: quality_metric_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality metric record. Primary key for the quality metric entity.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider to whom this quality metric applies. Links to the provider entity.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the healthcare provider.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The 9-digit Tax Identification Number for the provider organization or individual.

attributes.name: measure_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific quality measure being reported (e.g., HEDIS measure code, CMS star rating measure code).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications, CMS Star Ratings Technical Notes

attributes.name: measure_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the quality measure (e.g., Breast Cancer Screening, Diabetes HbA1c Control).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications, CMS Quality Measures

attributes.name: measure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quality measure by type: process measures (actions performed), outcome measures (health status results), structure measures (capacity and systems), patient experience measures (satisfaction and engagement), efficiency measures (cost-effectiveness), or intermediate outcome measures (clinical indicators).
attributes.references: NCQA Quality Measure Framework, CMS Quality Measure Taxonomy

attributes.name: measure_category
attributes.description: HEDIS domain category for the quality measure: effectiveness of care, access/availability of care, experience of care, utilization, health plan descriptive information, or measures reported using electronic health records.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the measurement period for which the quality metric was calculated (typically calendar year or reporting year).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Reporting Guidelines, CMS Star Ratings Measurement Period

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the measurement period for which the quality metric was calculated.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Reporting Guidelines, CMS Star Ratings Measurement Period

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which the quality metric is being reported to regulatory bodies or for internal performance tracking.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Reporting Guidelines, CMS Star Ratings Reporting

attributes.name: numerator
attributes.description: The count of members or events that meet the quality measure criteria (e.g., number of members who received the recommended service).

attributes.name: denominator
attributes.description: The count of eligible members or events for the quality measure (e.g., total number of members eligible for the service).

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: The count of members or events excluded from the denominator due to valid clinical or administrative reasons as defined by the measure specification.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The calculated performance rate for the quality measure, expressed as a percentage (numerator divided by denominator minus exclusions, multiplied by 100).

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: The standardized quality score assigned to the provider based on the measure rate, often normalized or weighted according to program specifications (e.g., CMS Star Rating score).
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings Technical Notes, NCQA Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: The star rating assigned to the provider for this quality measure, typically on a scale of 1 to 5 stars (with half-star increments allowed), used in CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings.

attributes.name: percentile_rank
attributes.description: The percentile rank of the provider's performance on this quality measure compared to all providers in the comparison population (0-100 scale).

attributes.name: benchmark_rate
attributes.description: The benchmark or target performance rate for this quality measure, established by the payer, regulatory body, or industry standard.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Benchmarks, CMS Quality Benchmarks

attributes.name: national_average_rate
attributes.description: The national average performance rate for this quality measure across all reporting providers, used for comparative analysis.
attributes.references: NCQA Quality Compass, CMS National Quality Data

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Classification of the provider's performance relative to the benchmark: exceeds benchmark, meets benchmark, below benchmark, not applicable, or insufficient data.

attributes.name: improvement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's performance on this measure has improved compared to the prior measurement period (true if improved, false otherwise).

attributes.name: prior_period_rate
attributes.description: The provider's performance rate for this quality measure in the immediately preceding measurement period, used for trend analysis.

attributes.name: rate_change
attributes.description: The percentage point change in the provider's performance rate compared to the prior measurement period (current rate minus prior period rate).

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business or product type for which this quality metric is reported: commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, marketplace, dual eligible, individual, or group.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The specific health plan product type: Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Special Needs Plan (SNP), Dual Eligible SNP (D-SNP), Chronic Condition SNP (C-SNP), Institutional SNP (I-SNP), Private Fee-For-Service (PFFS), or other.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The network tier classification of the provider for which this quality metric applies: tier 1 (highest value), tier 2, tier 3, preferred, standard, out of network, or not applicable.

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: The type of provider entity: individual practitioner, group practice, facility, hospital, ancillary provider, or other.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: The type of healthcare facility if the provider is a facility: acute care hospital, critical access hospital, ambulatory surgery center, skilled nursing facility, home health agency, hospice, dialysis center, imaging center, laboratory, other, or not applicable.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or market area where the provider practices and for which this quality metric is reported.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code where the provider is located and for which this quality metric applies.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: The county name where the provider is located, used for geographic quality analysis and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: The ZIP code of the provider's primary practice location for which this quality metric is reported.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The primary data source used to calculate this quality metric: administrative claims, electronic health record (EHR), hybrid (combination of claims and medical record), survey, registry, or other.

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: The specific method used to collect the data for this quality metric: administrative data processing, medical record review, patient-reported outcomes, provider-reported data, automated EHR extraction, or other.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: The audit status of this quality metric submission: not audited, audit scheduled, audit in progress, audit passed, audit failed, or audit findings pending.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The date when the quality metric data was audited by an external auditor (e.g., NCQA-certified HEDIS auditor).

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: The name of the auditing organization or individual who performed the quality metric audit.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: The certification status of the quality metric submission: certified (meets all requirements), provisional (conditional approval), not certified, certification expired, or certification pending.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date when the quality metric data was submitted to the regulatory body, accreditation organization, or internal quality department.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Reporting Deadlines, CMS Star Ratings Submission Deadlines

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: The status of the quality metric submission: draft, submitted, accepted, rejected, resubmission required, or finalized.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Reporting Process, CMS Star Ratings Submission Process

attributes.name: reporting_entity
attributes.description: The name of the health plan, provider organization, or entity responsible for reporting this quality metric.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the CMS contract or internal provider contract associated with this quality metric (e.g., Medicare Advantage contract number).

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the health plan or benefit plan associated with this quality metric.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Identifiers, Internal Plan Codes

attributes.name: incentive_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality metric performance makes the provider eligible for quality-based incentive payments or bonuses (true if eligible, false otherwise).

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of quality-based incentive payment earned by the provider for achieving this quality metric performance level.

attributes.name: penalty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality metric performance results in a financial penalty or withhold for the provider (true if penalty applied, false otherwise).
attributes.references: Internal Value-Based Care Programs, CMS Quality Payment Programs

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of financial penalty or withhold applied to the provider due to substandard performance on this quality metric.
attributes.references: Internal Value-Based Care Programs, CMS Quality Payment Programs

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: The risk adjustment factor applied to this quality metric to account for differences in patient population health status and complexity.

attributes.name: case_mix_index
attributes.description: The case mix index representing the average complexity and resource intensity of the provider's patient population for this quality measure.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: The number of members or cases included in the sample used to calculate this quality metric (for measures using sampling methodology).

attributes.name: confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: The lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for the quality metric rate, indicating statistical precision.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: The upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for the quality metric rate, indicating statistical precision.

attributes.name: statistical_significance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the difference between the provider's performance and the benchmark is statistically significant (true if significant, false otherwise).

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality metric result has been suppressed from public reporting due to small sample size, privacy concerns, or data quality issues (true if suppressed, false otherwise).
attributes.references: NCQA Data Suppression Guidelines, CMS Data Suppression Policy

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this quality metric result was suppressed: small sample size (below minimum threshold), privacy protection, data quality issue, not applicable, or other.
attributes.references: NCQA Data Suppression Guidelines, CMS Data Suppression Policy

attributes.name: public_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality metric is included in public reporting (e.g., CMS Plan Finder, provider directories) or is for internal use only (true if publicly reported, false otherwise).

attributes.name: accreditation_program
attributes.description: The accreditation or quality program under which this quality metric is reported: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), URAC, Joint Commission, CMS Star Ratings, other, or not applicable.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Standards, Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: measure_steward
attributes.description: The organization responsible for developing and maintaining the quality measure specification (e.g., NCQA, CMS, AMA-PCPI).

attributes.name: nqf_number
attributes.description: The National Quality Forum endorsement number for this quality measure, if applicable.

attributes.name: cms_measure_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Measure Identifier
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned identifier for this quality measure, used in Medicare quality reporting programs.

attributes.name: measure_version
attributes.description: The version number or year of the quality measure specification used to calculate this metric (e.g., HEDIS 2023, CMS v5.0).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications, CMS Measure Specifications

attributes.name: age_stratification
attributes.description: The age group or stratification for which this quality metric is reported (e.g., 18-44, 45-64, 65+, pediatric, adult).

attributes.name: gender_stratification
attributes.description: The gender stratification for which this quality metric is reported: male, female, all genders, other, or not applicable.

attributes.name: race_ethnicity_stratification
attributes.description: The race and ethnicity stratification for which this quality metric is reported, used for health equity analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Health Equity Standards, NCQA Health Equity Accreditation

attributes.name: language_stratification
attributes.description: The primary language stratification for which this quality metric is reported, used for health equity and access analysis.

attributes.name: social_determinants_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality metric incorporates social determinants of health factors in its calculation or risk adjustment (true if SDOH-adjusted, false otherwise).

attributes.name: health_equity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality metric is designated as a health equity measure, focusing on reducing disparities in care (true if health equity measure, false otherwise).
attributes.references: NCQA Health Equity Accreditation, CMS Health Equity Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this quality metric, including data quality issues, special circumstances, or explanatory information.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A composite score (0-100) representing the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the data used to calculate this quality metric.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this quality metric record became effective and valid for use in reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current status of this quality metric record: active (current and valid), inactive (no longer in use), archived (historical), pending review (awaiting validation), or superseded (replaced by newer record).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this quality metric record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider to whom this quality metric applies. Links to the provider entity.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the health plan or benefit plan associated with this quality metric.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Identifiers, Internal Plan Codes

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Links quality metrics to specialty reference table. Quality metrics are often stratified by specialty. The specialty STRING attribute can be replaced with FK to specialty reference table.

attributes.name: performance_metric_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.performance_metric. Business justification: Quality metrics track provider performance against contractual performance metrics. Value-based care teams use this to calculate quality bonuses and contract compliance for pay-for-performance program

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.program. Business justification: Quality metrics are tracked within specific quality improvement programs (HEDIS, Stars). Quality reporting teams use this to aggregate provider performance by program for regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: destination_provider_npi

attributes.name: destination_provider_tin

attributes.name: destination_provider_taxonomy_code

attributes.name: destination_provider_specialty
attributes.description: Medical specialty or practice area of the receiving provider.

attributes.name: destination_provider_type

attributes.name: referral_date

attributes.name: referral_timestamp

attributes.name: referral_effective_date

attributes.name: referral_expiration_date

attributes.name: referral_reason_code

attributes.name: referral_reason_description

attributes.name: referral_type

attributes.name: referral_status

attributes.name: referral_priority

attributes.name: referral_authorization_number

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether prior authorization is required for the referred service under the member's benefit plan.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_status
attributes.description: Current status of the prior authorization request associated with the referral.

attributes.name: member_profile_id

attributes.name: edi_receiver_id

attributes.name: language_preference

attributes.name: communication_frequency_preference

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag

attributes.name: newsletter_subscription_flag

attributes.name: urgent_notification_method

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag

attributes.name: do_not_contact_date

attributes.name: do_not_contact_reason

attributes.name: secure_messaging_required_flag

attributes.name: communication_consent_form_signed_flag

attributes.name: communication_consent_expiration_date

attributes.name: preference_last_updated_date

attributes.name: preference_last_updated_by

attributes.name: preference_source

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: status_reason

attributes.name: status_change_date

attributes.name: notes
