products.name: credential_summary
products.description: Aggregated credentialing status and verification summary for a provider, sourced from the credentialing domain, including license, board certification, and malpractice coverage.

attributes.name: credential_summary_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credential summary record, serving as the primary key for tracking aggregated credentialing status and verification data for a provider.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the healthcare provider across all payers and systems.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The 9-digit Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) used for billing and payment purposes, linking the provider to their tax entity.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current overall credentialing status of the provider indicating whether they have successfully completed the credentialing process and are approved to participate in the network.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, URAC Provider Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: credentialing_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's credentialing status became effective, marking when they were approved to begin providing services under the network.

attributes.name: credentialing_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's current credentialing approval expires and requires renewal or re-credentialing to maintain network participation.

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the provider must complete the recredentialing process to avoid lapse in credentialing status, typically 90-120 days before expiration.

attributes.name: initial_credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date when the provider was first credentialed with the organization, establishing the baseline for tracking credentialing history and tenure.

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which primary source verification was completed for the provider's credentials, licenses, and certifications.

attributes.name: next_verification_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next primary source verification cycle to ensure ongoing compliance with credentialing requirements.

attributes.name: primary_license_number
attributes.description: The license number for the provider's primary professional license in their main state of practice, verified through primary source verification.

attributes.name: primary_license_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state code where the provider holds their primary professional license to practice medicine or provide healthcare services.

attributes.name: primary_license_type
attributes.description: The type or category of the provider's primary professional license, such as MD, DO, RN, DDS, indicating their scope of practice.

attributes.name: primary_license_status
attributes.description: The current status of the provider's primary professional license as verified through primary source verification with the state licensing board.

attributes.name: primary_license_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's primary professional license was originally issued by the state licensing authority.

attributes.name: primary_license_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's primary professional license expires and requires renewal to maintain active status.

attributes.name: additional_license_count
attributes.description: The total number of additional professional licenses held by the provider in states other than their primary license state, supporting multi-state practice.

attributes.name: board_certification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider holds current board certification in their primary specialty from a recognized specialty board.

attributes.name: primary_board_certification
attributes.description: The name of the provider's primary board certification specialty, such as Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Cardiology.

attributes.name: primary_board_name
attributes.description: The name of the certifying board that issued the provider's primary board certification, such as American Board of Internal Medicine.

attributes.name: primary_board_certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider achieved their primary board certification, demonstrating specialized training and competency.

attributes.name: primary_board_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's primary board certification expires and requires recertification through examination or maintenance of certification.

attributes.name: additional_certification_count
attributes.description: The total number of additional board certifications or subspecialty certifications held by the provider beyond their primary certification.

attributes.name: dea_registration_number
attributes.description: The DEA registration number assigned to the provider authorizing them to prescribe controlled substances, verified through primary source verification.

attributes.name: dea_status
attributes.description: The current status of the provider's DEA registration as verified with the Drug Enforcement Administration.

attributes.name: dea_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's DEA registration expires and requires renewal to maintain prescribing authority for controlled substances.

attributes.name: cds_registration_number
attributes.description: The state-level controlled substance registration number for providers in states that require separate state CDS registration beyond DEA.

attributes.name: cds_status
attributes.description: The current status of the provider's state-level controlled substance registration.

attributes.name: cds_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's state CDS registration expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: malpractice_insurance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider currently maintains active professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage meeting network requirements.

attributes.name: malpractice_carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the insurance company providing the provider's professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage.

attributes.name: malpractice_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number for the provider's professional liability insurance, used for verification and claims coordination.

attributes.name: malpractice_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's current malpractice insurance policy became effective and coverage began.

attributes.name: malpractice_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's current malpractice insurance policy expires and requires renewal to maintain coverage.

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The total coverage amount (per occurrence and aggregate) of the provider's professional liability insurance policy, typically expressed in millions.

attributes.name: malpractice_per_occurrence_limit
attributes.description: The maximum amount the malpractice insurance policy will pay for a single claim or occurrence.

attributes.name: malpractice_aggregate_limit
attributes.description: The maximum total amount the malpractice insurance policy will pay for all claims during the policy period.

attributes.name: malpractice_tail_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has tail coverage (extended reporting endorsement) for claims-made malpractice policies to cover incidents after policy termination.

attributes.name: hospital_privileges_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider currently holds active hospital admitting or clinical privileges at one or more facilities.

attributes.name: hospital_affiliation_count
attributes.description: The total number of hospitals where the provider holds active clinical privileges or admitting rights.

attributes.name: primary_hospital_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary hospital where the provider holds admitting privileges and most frequently admits patients.

attributes.name: education_verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's medical school or professional education has been verified through primary source verification with the educational institution.

attributes.name: medical_school_name
attributes.description: The name of the medical school or professional school where the provider completed their primary professional degree.

attributes.name: graduation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider graduated from medical school or professional school with their primary degree.

attributes.name: training_verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's residency, fellowship, and other post-graduate training has been verified through primary source verification.

attributes.name: residency_program_name
attributes.description: The name of the residency program where the provider completed their primary post-graduate medical training.

attributes.name: residency_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider completed their residency training program.

attributes.name: work_history_verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's work history for the required lookback period (typically 5 years) has been verified through primary source verification.

attributes.name: work_history_gap_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether there are unexplained gaps in the provider's work history that require additional documentation or explanation.

attributes.name: npdb_query_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent query was performed against the National Practitioner Data Bank to check for adverse actions, malpractice payments, and disciplinary actions.

attributes.name: npdb_query_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Status
attributes.description: The result status of the most recent NPDB query indicating whether any reportable adverse actions or malpractice payments were found.

attributes.name: npdb_reportable_action_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Reportable Action Count
attributes.description: The total number of reportable actions found in the NPDB query, including malpractice payments, license actions, and clinical privilege restrictions.

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider appears on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE), which would prohibit participation in federal healthcare programs.

attributes.name: oig_check_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Check Date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent check was performed against the OIG exclusion list to verify the provider is not excluded from federal programs.

attributes.name: sam_exclusion_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Exclusion Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider appears on the SAM exclusion list, which identifies entities excluded from receiving federal contracts or assistance.

attributes.name: sam_check_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Check Date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent check was performed against the SAM exclusion database.

attributes.name: state_exclusion_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider appears on any state Medicaid exclusion lists, which would prohibit participation in state Medicaid programs.

attributes.name: state_exclusion_check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent check was performed against state Medicaid exclusion lists.

attributes.name: sanctions_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether any sanctions, disciplinary actions, or adverse actions have been identified against the provider during the credentialing process.

attributes.name: sanctions_count
attributes.description: The total number of sanctions, disciplinary actions, or adverse actions identified against the provider across all verification sources.

attributes.name: peer_reference_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required peer references have been obtained and reviewed as part of the credentialing process.

attributes.name: peer_reference_count
attributes.description: The total number of peer references obtained for the provider during the credentialing process, typically requiring 2-3 references.

attributes.name: attestation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider signed and submitted their attestation statement affirming the accuracy and completeness of their credentialing application.

attributes.name: attestation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current, valid attestation statement has been received from the provider.

attributes.name: caqh_provider_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) Provider Identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to the provider in the CAQH ProView system, used for standardized credentialing data exchange.

attributes.name: caqh_profile_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) Profile Status
attributes.description: The current status of the provider's CAQH ProView profile, indicating whether their credentialing data is current and accessible.

attributes.name: caqh_last_update_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) Last Update Date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider last updated their CAQH ProView profile with current credentialing information.

attributes.name: credentialing_committee_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credentialing committee reviewed and made a determination on the provider's credentialing application.

attributes.name: credentialing_committee_decision
attributes.description: The final decision made by the credentialing committee regarding the provider's application for network participation.

attributes.name: credentialing_decision_rationale
attributes.description: The documented rationale or reason for the credentialing committee's decision, particularly important for denials or conditional approvals.

attributes.name: medicare_participation_status
attributes.description: Indicates the provider's participation status in the Medicare program, affecting reimbursement rates and assignment of benefits.

attributes.name: medicaid_participation_status
attributes.description: Indicates the provider's participation status in state Medicaid programs, affecting eligibility to serve Medicaid beneficiaries.

attributes.name: cultural_competency_training_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has completed required cultural competency training to serve diverse patient populations.

attributes.name: hipaa_training_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Training Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has completed required HIPAA privacy and security training.

attributes.name: hipaa_training_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Training Completion Date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider completed their most recent HIPAA training.

attributes.name: fraud_waste_abuse_training_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Training Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has completed required fraud, waste, and abuse prevention training, mandatory for Medicare and Medicaid participation.

attributes.name: fwa_training_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Training Completion Date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider completed their most recent fraud, waste, and abuse prevention training.

attributes.name: credentialing_application_source
attributes.description: The source or method through which the provider's credentialing application and supporting documentation were received.

attributes.name: credentialing_cycle_type
attributes.description: Indicates the type of credentialing cycle this summary represents, such as initial credentialing, routine recredentialing, or interim review.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: The assessed risk level of the provider based on credentialing findings, sanctions history, and verification results, used for monitoring and oversight.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the provider's credentials and compliance status are monitored between full recredentialing cycles.

attributes.name: last_monitoring_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent ongoing monitoring check was performed for the provider's credentials and compliance status.

attributes.name: next_monitoring_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next ongoing monitoring check of the provider's credentials and compliance status.

attributes.name: credentialing_specialist_name
attributes.description: The name of the credentialing specialist or coordinator responsible for managing this provider's credentialing file.

attributes.name: credentialing_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting important information, exceptions, or special circumstances related to the provider's credentialing status.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential summary record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential summary record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider_profile. Business justification: Links credential summaries to provider master record. Credential summaries are provider-specific aggregated credentialing data that should be associated with provider_profile.

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_record. Business justification: Provider credentialing requires verification of compliance training completion. Credentialing staff references specific training records to validate providers meet regulatory and network participation

products.name: network_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation contract between a healthcare provider and a health insurance product plan. It captures the terms, conditions, and status of each provider's participation in each plan's network. Each record links one provider to one plan with attributes that define the specific participation arrangement including network tier placement, reimbursement terms, effective dates, and acceptance status.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, providers participate in multiple plan networks simultaneously (a cardiologist may be in-network for Medicare Advantage, Commercial PPO, and Medicaid plans), and each plan has thousands of participating providers. Network participation is an actively managed operational entity with specific contract terms, tier assignments, reimbursement schedules, and acceptance statuses that vary by provider-plan combination. Claims adjudication, member cost-sharing calculations, and provider directory services all depend on this participation relationship.
