attributes.business_glossary_term: Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) Contribution Amount
attributes.description: The amount the employer contributes to the member's Health Savings Account (HSA).

attributes.name: hra_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage includes a Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA).

attributes.name: fsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage is eligible for a Flexible Spending Account (FSA).

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: The total premium amount charged for this coverage.

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which premiums are paid (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annual).

attributes.name: premium_employee_contribution
attributes.description: The portion of the premium paid by the employee.

attributes.name: premium_employer_contribution
attributes.description: The portion of the premium paid by the employer.

attributes.name: premium_subsidy_amount
attributes.description: The amount of government subsidy applied to the premium (e.g., Affordable Care Act (ACA) premium tax credit).

attributes.name: rating_area
attributes.description: The geographic rating area used for premium calculation.

attributes.name: tobacco_user_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is a tobacco user, which may affect premium rates.

attributes.name: age_rated
attributes.description: The member's age used for premium rating calculations.

attributes.name: metal_level
attributes.description: The metal level tier of the plan (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Catastrophic) indicating actuarial value.

attributes.name: actuarial_value
attributes.description: The percentage of total average costs for covered benefits that the plan will cover, expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: qhp_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage is a Qualified Health Plan (QHP) offered through a health insurance marketplace.

attributes.name: marketplace_enrollment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member enrolled through a health insurance marketplace (Federally Facilitated Marketplace (FFM) or State Based Marketplace (SBM)).

attributes.name: exchange_assigned_policy_id
attributes.description: The policy identifier assigned by the health insurance exchange.

attributes.name: exchange_subscriber_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identifier assigned by the health insurance exchange.

attributes.name: aptc_amount
attributes.description: The amount of Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC) applied to reduce the member's premium.

attributes.name: csr_variant
attributes.description: The Cost Sharing Reduction (CSR) variant code indicating the level of cost-sharing assistance (01-06).

attributes.name: snp_type
attributes.description: The type of Special Needs Plan (SNP): Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP), Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan (C-SNP), or Institutional Special Needs Plan (I-SNP).

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has End Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), which affects Medicare eligibility and plan options.

attributes.name: lis_level
attributes.description: The level of Low Income Subsidy (LIS) assistance for Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage (none, partial, full).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Low Income Subsidy Requirements

attributes.name: part_d_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage includes Medicare Part D prescription drug benefits.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The source or channel through which the member enrolled in coverage (e.g., employer, marketplace, broker, direct).

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: The method used to complete the enrollment (e.g., online, phone, paper application, in-person).

attributes.name: auto_assignment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was automatically assigned to this plan (common in Medicaid managed care).
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Managed Care Auto-Assignment Requirements

attributes.name: grace_period_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the coverage is currently in a grace period due to non-payment of premiums.

attributes.name: grace_period_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the grace period began.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the grace period ends.

attributes.name: retroactive_effective_date
attributes.description: The retroactive effective date if coverage was backdated after enrollment.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Retroactive Coverage Rules

attributes.name: retroactive_termination_date
attributes.description: The retroactive termination date if coverage was terminated retroactively.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Retroactive Termination Rules

attributes.name: reinstatement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage is a reinstatement of previously terminated coverage.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date when the coverage was reinstated.

attributes.name: waiting_period_waived_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waiting period for coverage was waived.

attributes.name: pre_existing_condition_exclusion_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether pre-existing condition exclusions apply to this coverage (generally prohibited under Affordable Care Act (ACA)).

attributes.name: creditable_coverage_months
attributes.description: The number of months of creditable coverage the member had prior to this coverage, used for portability calculations.

attributes.name: continuation_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is continuation coverage under Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA), state continuation, or Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) portability.

attributes.name: conversion_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage is a conversion from group to individual coverage.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member enrolled during an open enrollment period.

attributes.name: special_enrollment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member enrolled during a special enrollment period due to a qualifying life event.

attributes.name: sep_qualifying_event
attributes.description: The qualifying life event that triggered the special enrollment period (e.g., loss of coverage, marriage, birth, adoption).

attributes.name: sep_event_date
attributes.description: The date of the qualifying life event that triggered the special enrollment period.

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this coverage is effective.

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the plan year, which may differ from the calendar year.

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the plan year.

attributes.name: benefit_begin_date
attributes.description: The date when benefits under this coverage begin, which may differ from the effective date due to waiting periods.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the coverage record was last updated in the system.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this coverage record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this coverage record in the source system.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with this coverage record.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the primary subscriber who holds the policy. May differ from member_id for dependents.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan associated with this coverage.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: pcp_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member's assigned Primary Care Physician (PCP).

attributes.name: network_inclusion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.network_inclusion. Business justification: Member coverage is tied to specific network inclusions defined in contracts. Eligibility verification must check which provider networks the member can access based on their contracted network inclusi

attributes.name: plan_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_network. Business justification: Member coverage is tied to specific provider networks (HMO, PPO, EPO). Provider eligibility checks and claims processing verify network participation based on member's active coverage network.

attributes.name: program_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_eligibility. Business justification: Member coverage records for government programs (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care) must link to program eligibility to determine active enrollment status and benefit entitlement.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.contract. Business justification: Member coverage is governed by employer/group contracts. Each coverage record must reference the master contract defining benefits, rates, and terms negotiated with the employer or government entity.

attributes.name: risk_score_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.risk_score. Business justification: Medicare Advantage and ACA plans require HCC risk scoring per member coverage. Risk scores drive CMS payments and premium adjustments, calculated from diagnosis codes and updated throughout coverage p

attributes.name: status_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to eligibility.status_code. Business justification: Standardizing eligibility status via status_code eliminates duplicated free‑text status values and enables consistent reporting.

products.name: status_code
products.description: Standardized codes representing eligibility status (active, pending, terminated, suspended).

attributes.name: status_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the eligibility status code record. Primary key for the eligibility status code reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code representing the eligibility status. Used in eligibility verification transactions and member enrollment systems.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance, HIPAA Transaction Standards

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the eligibility status code. Provides clear business terminology for the status.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the eligibility status code, including business rules, conditions, and usage context.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the eligibility status. Used for reporting and business logic segmentation.

attributes.name: is_active_coverage
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status represents active insurance coverage. True means member has active benefits; false means coverage is not in effect.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: allows_claims_processing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether claims can be processed and adjudicated for members with this eligibility status.

attributes.name: requires_prior_authorization
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether prior authorization is required for services when member has this eligibility status.
attributes.references: Utilization Management Standards, NCQA Utilization Management Accreditation

attributes.name: edi_transaction_code
attributes.description: EDI transaction code used in ANSI X12 270/271 eligibility inquiry and response transactions. Maps internal status to standard EDI format.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 270/271 Eligibility Inquiry and Response, HIPAA EDI Standards

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status are eligible for COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: hipaa_continuation_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Continuation Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status are eligible for HIPAA special enrollment or continuation rights.

attributes.name: premium_payment_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether premium payment is required to maintain this eligibility status.
attributes.references: Premium Billing Standards, ACA Premium Payment Regulations

attributes.name: grace_period_applicable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a premium payment grace period applies to this eligibility status.
attributes.references: ACA Premium Payment Grace Period Regulations, 45 CFR 156.270

attributes.name: retroactive_coverage_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether retroactive coverage adjustments are permitted for this eligibility status.
attributes.references: Medicaid Retroactive Eligibility Regulations, State Insurance Department Guidelines

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business category to which this eligibility status applies. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and business rules.
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: plan_type_applicability
attributes.description: Health plan types to which this eligibility status applies. Indicates whether status is specific to certain plan designs or universal.
attributes.references: NAIC Health Insurance Model Acts, State Insurance Department Guidelines

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_priority
attributes.description: Priority order for coordination of benefits processing when member has this eligibility status. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits, ANSI X12 837 COB Segments

attributes.name: provider_eligibility_verification_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether providers must verify eligibility before rendering services for members with this status.
attributes.references: Provider Contract Requirements, CMS Medicare Provider Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this eligibility status code became effective and available for use in the system.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this eligibility status code was terminated and is no longer available for new assignments. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence for ordering eligibility status codes in user interfaces and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: system_generated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status is automatically assigned by system processes versus manually assigned by users.

attributes.name: requires_manual_review
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether eligibility records with this status require manual review by enrollment specialists.

attributes.name: notification_trigger
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether assignment of this status should trigger automated member notification communications.
attributes.references: Member Communication Standards, ERISA Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: Category used for regulatory reporting and compliance submissions. Maps internal status to required reporting classifications.
attributes.references: CMS Reporting Requirements, State Insurance Department Reporting Standards

attributes.name: hedis_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Reportable Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this eligibility status should be included in HEDIS quality measure reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications, HEDIS Eligibility Criteria

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status are eligible for risk adjustment factor (RAF) scoring and Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) coding.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, Medicare Advantage Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Requirements

attributes.name: medical_loss_ratio_inclusion
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status should be included in Medical Loss Ratio calculations for ACA compliance.
attributes.references: ACA Medical Loss Ratio Requirements, 45 CFR Part 158

attributes.name: special_enrollment_period_trigger
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status change triggers a special enrollment period for the member or dependents.
attributes.references: ACA Special Enrollment Period Regulations, 45 CFR 155.420

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_related
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this eligibility status is associated with a qualifying life event that permits enrollment changes.
attributes.references: ACA Qualifying Life Event Standards, ERISA Special Enrollment Rights

attributes.name: subsidy_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status are eligible for premium tax credits or cost-sharing reductions.
attributes.references: ACA Premium Tax Credit Regulations, 26 CFR 1.36B

attributes.name: dual_eligible_applicable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status applies to dual eligible members (Medicare and Medicaid).
attributes.references: CMS Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP) Requirements

attributes.name: pharmacy_benefits_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether pharmacy benefits are active for members with this eligibility status.
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Requirements, PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: behavioral_health_coverage_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether behavioral health and mental health services are covered under this eligibility status.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA), 42 CFR Part 438 Subpart K

attributes.name: dental_vision_coverage_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dental and Vision Coverage Active Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether supplemental dental and vision benefits are active for members with this eligibility status.

attributes.name: out_of_network_benefits_allowed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Out of Network Benefits Allowed Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether out-of-network provider services are covered for members with this eligibility status.
attributes.references: Provider Network Contract Standards, No Surprises Act Requirements

attributes.name: emergency_services_coverage
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether emergency services are covered regardless of network status for members with this eligibility status.
attributes.references: ACA Emergency Services Requirements, 45 CFR 147.138, No Surprises Act

attributes.name: preventive_care_coverage
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether preventive care services are covered without cost-sharing for members with this eligibility status.

attributes.name: telehealth_coverage_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether telehealth and telemedicine services are covered for members with this eligibility status.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Flexibilities, State Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: care_management_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status are eligible for care management and disease management programs.
attributes.references: NCQA Case Management Accreditation Standards, CMS Care Management Requirements

attributes.name: wellness_program_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status can participate in wellness and health promotion programs.
attributes.references: ACA Wellness Program Regulations, HIPAA Wellness Program Rules

attributes.name: member_portal_access_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status have access to online member portals and digital tools.

attributes.name: id_card_issuance_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a member ID card should be issued when this eligibility status is assigned.
attributes.references: Internal Member Services Standards, State Insurance Department Requirements

attributes.name: explanation_of_benefits_generation
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Explanation of Benefits statements should be generated for members with this eligibility status.

attributes.name: fraud_waste_abuse_monitoring
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Monitoring Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether claims for members with this status should be subject to fraud, waste, and abuse monitoring.
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Requirements, False Claims Act, Anti-Kickback Statute

attributes.name: third_party_liability_check_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Third Party Liability (TPL) Check Required Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether third party liability verification is required for members with this eligibility status.
attributes.references: Medicaid Third Party Liability Requirements, 42 CFR 433 Subpart D

attributes.name: subrogation_rights_applicable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the health plan retains subrogation rights for members with this eligibility status.
attributes.references: ERISA Subrogation Rights, State Insurance Subrogation Laws

attributes.name: appeals_rights_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status have active rights to appeal coverage and claims decisions.
attributes.references: ACA Internal Claims and Appeals Requirements, 45 CFR Part 147, ERISA Claims Procedure Regulation

attributes.name: external_review_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status are eligible for external independent review of adverse benefit determinations.

attributes.name: grievance_filing_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status can file grievances regarding service quality or administrative issues.
attributes.references: CMS Grievance and Appeals Requirements, State Insurance Department Grievance Standards

attributes.name: status_reason_code
attributes.description: Optional code providing additional context or reason for the eligibility status. Used for detailed tracking and reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Business Rules, ANSI X12 834 Maintenance Reason Codes

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status meets all applicable federal and state regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Compliance Requirements, State Insurance Department Regulations

attributes.name: audit_trail_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether changes to this eligibility status require detailed audit trail logging for compliance purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule Audit Controls, 45 CFR 164.312(b)

attributes.name: data_retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days that eligibility records with this status must be retained to meet regulatory and legal requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention Requirements, State Insurance Department Retention Standards, ERISA Record Retention

attributes.name: legacy_system_code
attributes.description: Eligibility status code from legacy systems prior to current platform implementation. Used for data migration and historical reconciliation.

attributes.name: external_system_mapping
attributes.description: Mapping code used for integration with external systems such as pharmacy benefit managers, third party administrators, or state exchanges.
attributes.references: EDI Implementation Guides, HL7 FHIR Coverage Resource

products.name: benefit_package
products.description: Catalog of benefit packages linked to health plans, detailing covered services, limits, and cost‑share structures.

attributes.name: benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit package within the health insurance system.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: package_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the benefit package for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: package_name
attributes.description: Marketing or business name of the benefit package displayed to members and providers.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: package_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the benefit package including covered services, limitations, and key features.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the health plan structure determining network requirements and cost-sharing models. HMO (Health Maintenance Organization), PPO (Preferred Provider Organization), EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization), POS (Point of Service), HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan), CDHP (Consumer Directed Health Plan), SNP (Special Needs Plan), D-SNP (Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan), C-SNP (Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan), I-SNP (Institutional Special Needs Plan).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Plan Types, NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Business segment classification indicating the market and regulatory framework. LOB (Line of Business), ASO (Administrative Services Only), TPA (Third Party Administrator).
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the benefit package by service type. LTSS (Long Term Services and Supports).

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: Financial structure determining risk assumption and premium handling. ASO (Administrative Services Only).
attributes.references: ERISA Plan Funding Requirements, DOL Regulations

attributes.name: metal_tier
attributes.description: ACA (Affordable Care Act) marketplace metal tier classification representing actuarial value and cost-sharing level.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, CMS Actuarial Value Calculator

attributes.name: actuarial_value_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total average costs for covered benefits that the plan pays, used for ACA (Affordable Care Act) metal tier classification.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, CMS Actuarial Value Standards

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Tiered network classification determining cost-sharing levels based on provider participation and performance.

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package qualifies for HSA (Health Savings Account) contributions under IRS regulations.

attributes.name: hra_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package supports HRA (Health Reimbursement Arrangement) funding by employers.

attributes.name: fsa_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package allows FSA (Flexible Spending Account) participation for healthcare expenses.

attributes.name: deductible_individual_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount that an individual member must pay before the plan begins cost-sharing for covered services.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits, ERISA Plan Document Requirements

attributes.name: deductible_family_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount that a family must collectively pay before the plan begins cost-sharing for covered services.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits, ERISA Plan Document Requirements

attributes.name: deductible_embedded_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether individual deductibles are embedded within the family deductible, allowing individual members to reach their deductible independently.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_individual_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Individual Out of Pocket (OOP) Maximum Amount
attributes.description: Maximum annual amount an individual member pays for covered services before the plan pays 100% of covered expenses. OOP (Out of Pocket).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, CMS Annual OOP Limits

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_family_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family Out of Pocket (OOP) Maximum Amount
attributes.description: Maximum annual amount a family collectively pays for covered services before the plan pays 100% of covered expenses. OOP (Out of Pocket).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, CMS Annual OOP Limits

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of covered service costs that the member pays after meeting the deductible, with the plan paying the remainder.
attributes.references: ACA Cost-Sharing Standards, ERISA Plan Documents

attributes.name: copay_primary_care_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for a primary care physician office visit. PCP (Primary Care Physician).

attributes.name: copay_specialist_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for a specialist physician office visit.

attributes.name: copay_emergency_room_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for an emergency room visit. ER (Emergency Room).

attributes.name: copay_urgent_care_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for an urgent care facility visit.

attributes.name: copay_inpatient_hospital_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount or per-day amount the member pays for inpatient hospital admission.

attributes.name: copay_outpatient_surgery_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for outpatient surgical procedures.

attributes.name: pharmacy_benefit_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether prescription drug coverage is included in this benefit package.
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Requirements, ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: pharmacy_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount specific to prescription drug coverage before cost-sharing begins.
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Cost-Sharing, PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Manager) Standards

attributes.name: pharmacy_tier_structure
attributes.description: Number of cost-sharing tiers in the prescription drug formulary determining member copayments or coinsurance.
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Formulary Requirements, PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Manager) Standards

attributes.name: dental_benefit_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether dental coverage is included in this benefit package.
attributes.references: ACA Pediatric Dental Requirements, NAIC Dental Standards

attributes.name: vision_benefit_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether vision coverage is included in this benefit package.
attributes.references: ACA Pediatric Vision Requirements, NAIC Vision Standards

attributes.name: behavioral_health_benefit_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether mental health and substance use disorder services are included. BH (Behavioral Health).
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA), ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: preventive_care_coverage_level
attributes.description: Cost-sharing level for preventive services as defined by ACA (Affordable Care Act) and USPSTF ( States Preventive Services Task Force) guidelines.

attributes.name: maternity_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether maternity and newborn care services are covered as essential health benefits.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits, Pregnancy Discrimination Act

attributes.name: pediatric_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether pediatric services including dental and vision are included as required by ACA (Affordable Care Act).

attributes.name: durable_medical_equipment_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether durable medical equipment is covered under this benefit package. DME (Durable Medical Equipment).
attributes.references: Medicare DME Coverage Standards, ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: home_health_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether home health services are covered under this benefit package.
attributes.references: Medicare Home Health Standards, ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: skilled_nursing_facility_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether skilled nursing facility services are covered. SNF (Skilled Nursing Facility).
attributes.references: Medicare SNF Coverage Standards, ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: hospice_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether hospice care services are covered under this benefit package.
attributes.references: Medicare Hospice Benefit, ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: rehabilitation_services_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy services are covered.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits, Medicare Therapy Standards

attributes.name: chiropractic_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether chiropractic services are covered under this benefit package.
attributes.references: State Insurance Mandates, Medicare Chiropractic Coverage

attributes.name: acupuncture_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether acupuncture services are covered under this benefit package.
attributes.references: State Insurance Mandates, Medicare Acupuncture Coverage

attributes.name: telehealth_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether telehealth and telemedicine services are covered with parity to in-person visits.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Regulations, State Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package provides any coverage for out-of-network providers.
attributes.references: No Surprises Act, State Balance Billing Laws

attributes.name: out_of_network_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount for out-of-network services, typically higher than in-network deductible.

attributes.name: out_of_network_coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of covered service costs the member pays for out-of-network services after meeting the deductible.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether certain services require prior authorization approval before coverage. PA (Prior Authorization).
attributes.references: Utilization Management Standards, URAC UM Accreditation

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether members must obtain referrals from their PCP (Primary Care Physician) to see specialists.

attributes.name: lifetime_maximum_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the plan will pay over the member's lifetime. Note: ACA (Affordable Care Act) prohibits lifetime limits on essential health benefits.

attributes.name: annual_maximum_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the plan will pay in a single plan year. Note: ACA (Affordable Care Act) prohibits annual limits on essential health benefits.

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit package becomes active and coverage begins for enrolled members.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834, ERISA Plan Document Requirements

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the 12-month period for benefit accumulations, deductibles, and out-of-pocket maximums.
attributes.references: ERISA Plan Year Definition, ACA Plan Year Requirements

attributes.name: open_enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the annual period when members can enroll or change benefit packages without qualifying events.
attributes.references: ACA Open Enrollment Period, ERISA Enrollment Requirements

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the benefit package determining availability for enrollment and claims processing.

attributes.name: grandfathered_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package is grandfathered under ACA (Affordable Care Act), exempting it from certain ACA requirements.

attributes.name: qualified_health_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package is certified as a QHP (Qualified Health Plan) for ACA (Affordable Care Act) marketplace sale.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1301, CMS QHP Certification Standards

attributes.name: marketplace_type
attributes.description: Type of ACA (Affordable Care Act) health insurance marketplace where the plan is offered. FFM (Federally Facilitated Marketplace), SBM (State Based Marketplace).
attributes.references: ACA Marketplace Regulations, CMS Exchange Standards

attributes.name: cost_sharing_reduction_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package is eligible for ACA (Affordable Care Act) cost-sharing reductions for qualifying low-income members. CSR (Cost Sharing Reduction).

attributes.name: premium_tax_credit_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether members enrolled in this benefit package are eligible for ACA (Affordable Care Act) premium tax credits. PTC (Premium Tax Credit).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1401, IRS Premium Tax Credit Regulations

attributes.name: minimum_essential_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package meets ACA (Affordable Care Act) minimum essential coverage requirements. MEC (Minimum Essential Coverage).

attributes.name: minimum_value_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package provides minimum value (60% actuarial value) as required by ACA (Affordable Care Act) employer mandate. MV (Minimum Value).
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H, IRS Minimum Value Calculator

attributes.name: affordability_safe_harbor_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package meets ACA (Affordable Care Act) employer affordability safe harbor thresholds.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H, IRS Affordability Safe Harbor

attributes.name: cobra_continuation_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Continuation Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package is subject to COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) continuation coverage requirements.

attributes.name: hipaa_portability_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) Portability Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package complies with HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) portability and creditable coverage requirements.

attributes.name: medicare_secondary_payer_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package coordinates with Medicare as the secondary payer. MSP (Medicare Secondary Payer).
attributes.references: Medicare Secondary Payer Act, CMS MSP Regulations

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_method
attributes.description: Method used to coordinate benefits when a member has coverage under multiple plans. COB (Coordination of Benefits).

attributes.name: subrogation_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the plan retains subrogation rights to recover payments from third parties liable for member injuries.
attributes.references: ERISA Subrogation Rights, State Insurance Laws

attributes.name: medical_loss_ratio_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of premium revenue that must be spent on medical claims and quality improvement as required by ACA (Affordable Care Act). MLR (Medical Loss Ratio).
attributes.references: ACA Section 2718, CMS MLR Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the benefit package participates in CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) risk adjustment programs for payment calibration.
attributes.references: ACA Risk Adjustment Program, CMS HHS-HCC Model

attributes.name: quality_rating_stars
attributes.description: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) star rating (1-5 scale) reflecting plan quality and performance on HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set) and CAHPS (Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems) measures.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings Program, NCQA HEDIS Standards

attributes.name: ncqa_accreditation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance) Accreditation Status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status from NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance) indicating quality and compliance standards met.

attributes.name: urac_accreditation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: URAC (Utilization Review Accreditation Commission) Accreditation Status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status from URAC (Utilization Review Accreditation Commission) for utilization management and quality standards.

attributes.name: state_filing_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the state insurance department for regulatory filing and approval of the benefit package.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate and Form Filing Requirements, State Insurance Codes

attributes.name: cms_contract_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) Contract Number
attributes.description: Five-character contract identifier assigned by CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) for Medicare Advantage and Part D plans.

attributes.name: cms_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) Plan Identifier
attributes.description: Three-digit plan identifier assigned by CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) within a contract for Medicare plans.

attributes.name: hios_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIOS (Health Insurance Oversight System) Plan Identifier
attributes.description: 14-character standard plan identifier assigned by CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) for ACA (Affordable Care Act) marketplace plans. HIOS (Health Insurance Oversight System).
attributes.references: CMS HIOS Plan ID Standards, 45 CFR 156.20

attributes.name: service_area_description
attributes.description: Geographic description of counties, ZIP codes, or regions where the benefit package is available for enrollment.
attributes.references: NAIC Network Adequacy Standards, CMS Service Area Requirements

attributes.name: language_support
attributes.description: Languages in which member materials, customer service, and provider directories are available for this benefit package.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1557 Language Access, CMS Multi-Language Requirements

attributes.name: member_services_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary phone number for member inquiries, eligibility verification, and customer support for this benefit package.

attributes.name: provider_services_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary phone number for provider inquiries, eligibility verification, and claims support for this benefit package.

attributes.name: summary_of_benefits_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) URL
attributes.description: Web address where the standardized ACA (Affordable Care Act) Summary of Benefits and Coverage document is published. SBC (Summary of Benefits and Coverage).
attributes.references: ACA Section 2715, CMS SBC Template Requirements

attributes.name: formulary_url
attributes.description: Web address where the current prescription drug formulary and covered medications list is published.
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Formulary Requirements, CMS Transparency Rules

attributes.name: provider_directory_url
attributes.description: Web address where the searchable provider network directory is published for member and provider access.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements, No Surprises Act

attributes.name: transparency_in_coverage_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transparency in Coverage Machine-Readable Files URL
attributes.description: Web address where machine-readable files containing negotiated rates and allowed amounts are published as required by federal transparency rules.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the benefit package record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the benefit package record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking changes and amendments to the benefit package configuration over time.

attributes.name: benefit_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.benefit_design. Business justification: Government program benefit packages must reference CMS-approved benefit designs to ensure compliance with Medicare/Medicaid regulations. Used by benefit configuration teams when setting up plan offeri

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.formulary. Business justification: Benefit packages define which drug formulary applies to members. Pharmacy benefits require linking to specific formulary lists to determine covered medications and member cost-sharing at point of serv

products.name: cobro_event
products.description: Transactional record of COBRA continuation elections, including election date, coverage extension period, and payment terms.

attributes.name: cobro_event_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Event ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the COBRA continuation event record.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member electing COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identification number associated with the original health plan coverage.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The employer or group policy number under which the original coverage was provided.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The insurance policy number associated with the COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: qualifying_event_type
attributes.description: The type of qualifying event that triggered COBRA eligibility, such as termination of employment, reduction in hours, divorce, or loss of dependent status.

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the qualifying event occurred that made the member eligible for COBRA continuation.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Notification Date
attributes.description: The date on which the COBRA election notice was sent to the qualified beneficiary.

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Election Date
attributes.description: The date on which the qualified beneficiary elected to continue coverage under COBRA.

attributes.name: election_deadline_date
attributes.description: The deadline date by which the qualified beneficiary must elect COBRA continuation coverage, typically 60 days from the later of the qualifying event or notification date.

attributes.name: election_status
attributes.description: The current status of the COBRA election indicating whether the beneficiary has elected, declined, or is pending decision.

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which COBRA continuation coverage becomes effective, typically the day after the original coverage would have ended.

attributes.name: coverage_termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which COBRA continuation coverage is scheduled to terminate or has terminated.

attributes.name: maximum_coverage_period_months
attributes.description: The maximum number of months for which COBRA continuation coverage is available, typically 18, 29, or 36 months depending on the qualifying event.

attributes.name: extended_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the COBRA coverage period has been extended beyond the standard period due to disability or second qualifying event.

attributes.name: extension_reason
attributes.description: The reason for extending COBRA coverage beyond the initial maximum period, such as disability determination or occurrence of a second qualifying event.

attributes.name: disability_determination_date
attributes.description: The date on which a qualified beneficiary was determined to be disabled by the Social Security Administration, allowing for extended COBRA coverage.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: The monthly premium amount charged for COBRA continuation coverage, typically 102% of the applicable premium cost.

attributes.name: premium_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the applicable premium that the qualified beneficiary must pay, typically 102% for standard COBRA or 150% for disability extensions.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which COBRA premium payments are due, such as monthly, quarterly, or annually.

attributes.name: first_premium_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the first COBRA premium payment is due, typically 45 days from the election date.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after the premium due date during which payment can be made without termination of coverage, typically 30 days.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the qualified beneficiary pays COBRA premiums, such as check, electronic funds transfer, or credit card.

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the plan year for the health plan being continued under COBRA.

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the plan year for the health plan being continued under COBRA.

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: The name of the employer or group sponsor that provided the original health coverage.

attributes.name: employer_tin
attributes.description: The Tax Identification Number of the employer or group sponsor.

attributes.name: beneficiary_type
attributes.description: The type of qualified beneficiary electing COBRA coverage, such as employee, spouse, dependent child, or domestic partner.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: The number of dependents included in the COBRA continuation coverage election.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for termination of COBRA continuation coverage, such as non-payment, reaching maximum coverage period, obtaining other coverage, or Medicare entitlement.

attributes.name: subsidy_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the qualified beneficiary is eligible for premium subsidy assistance under federal programs such as the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA).

attributes.name: subsidy_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the COBRA premium covered by federal subsidy assistance, if applicable.

attributes.name: subsidy_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which premium subsidy assistance begins for the qualified beneficiary.

attributes.name: subsidy_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which premium subsidy assistance ends for the qualified beneficiary.

attributes.name: notice_method
attributes.description: The method by which the COBRA election notice was delivered to the qualified beneficiary, such as mail, email, or electronic portal.

attributes.name: notice_language
attributes.description: The language in which the COBRA election notice was provided to the qualified beneficiary.

attributes.name: administrator_name
attributes.description: The name of the COBRA administrator or Third Party Administrator (TPA) responsible for managing the continuation coverage.

attributes.name: administrator_contact_phone
attributes.description: The contact phone number for the COBRA administrator or Third Party Administrator (TPA).

attributes.name: administrator_contact_email
attributes.description: The contact email address for the COBRA administrator or Third Party Administrator (TPA).

attributes.name: state_continuation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the continuation coverage is provided under state continuation laws (mini-COBRA) rather than federal COBRA.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state code where the COBRA or state continuation coverage is governed.

attributes.name: conversion_option_available_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the qualified beneficiary has the option to convert COBRA coverage to an individual policy at the end of the continuation period.

attributes.name: conversion_deadline_date
attributes.description: The deadline date by which the qualified beneficiary must exercise the option to convert COBRA coverage to an individual policy.

attributes.name: retroactive_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether COBRA coverage was elected retroactively to cover the period between the qualifying event and the election date.

attributes.name: retroactive_premium_amount
attributes.description: The total premium amount due for retroactive coverage from the qualifying event date to the election date.

attributes.name: election_form_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the completed COBRA election form was received by the plan administrator.

attributes.name: election_confirmation_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which confirmation of COBRA election was sent to the qualified beneficiary.

attributes.name: last_premium_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent COBRA premium payment was received.

attributes.name: last_premium_payment_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the most recent COBRA premium payment received.

attributes.name: outstanding_premium_balance
attributes.description: The total outstanding premium balance owed by the qualified beneficiary for COBRA coverage.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: The current payment status of COBRA premiums, indicating whether payments are current, past due, or delinquent.

attributes.name: termination_notice_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which notice of COBRA coverage termination was sent to the qualified beneficiary.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the qualified beneficiary has filed an appeal regarding COBRA eligibility, coverage, or termination.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: The date on which an appeal was filed by the qualified beneficiary regarding COBRA coverage.

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeal regarding COBRA coverage was resolved.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the appeal filed by the qualified beneficiary regarding COBRA coverage.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which the COBRA event record originated, such as Facets, QNXT, or HealthRules.

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this COBRA event record in the source system.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the COBRA event transaction was recorded in the source system.

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this COBRA event record is effective for business purposes.

attributes.name: record_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this COBRA event record is no longer effective for business purposes.

attributes.name: current_record_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active record for the COBRA event or a historical version.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member electing COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identification number associated with the original health plan coverage.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to eligibility.coverage. Business justification: COBRA events represent continuation of original coverage after qualifying events. Adding coverage_id FK enables linking to the original coverage record being continued, consolidating coverage details

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: COBRA continuation events create new billing relationships. Eligibility system establishes billing accounts for members transitioning from employer-sponsored to self-pay COBRA coverage.

attributes.name: program_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_payment. Business justification: Coordination of benefits events for dual-eligible members must track government program payments (Medicare/Medicaid) to determine primary/secondary payer responsibility. Used daily in claims adjudicat

attributes.name: audit_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.audit_log. Business justification: Coordination of benefits determinations (primary vs secondary payer) are high-risk for payment errors. Audit logs track COB decisions for regulatory audits and fraud investigation when incorrect payer

attributes.name: cob_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to eligibility.cob_rule. Business justification: Linking cobro_event to cob_rule captures the rule that determined COB eligibility, supporting audit and rule‑maintenance processes.

products.name: termination_event
products.description: Record of coverage termination actions, capturing reason, effective termination date, and related member identifiers.

attributes.name: termination_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the coverage termination event record.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member whose coverage is being terminated.

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: External subscriber identifier assigned by the health plan for the primary policyholder.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Employer or group identifier associated with the coverage being terminated.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Unique policy or contract number for the coverage being terminated.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of health coverage being terminated.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Business segment under which the terminated coverage was provided.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal code identifying the specific health plan product being terminated.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the health plan product being terminated.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the health plan structure being terminated.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the coverage termination becomes effective.

attributes.name: termination_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reason for coverage termination.

attributes.name: termination_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the termination reason.

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Party that initiated the coverage termination.

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: Date on which the termination was requested or initiated.

attributes.name: processed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the termination was processed in the system.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which termination notification was sent to the member.

attributes.name: last_coverage_date
attributes.description: Final date on which the member had active coverage before termination.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the premium payment grace period expires, if applicable.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: cobra_election_deadline_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Deadline Date
attributes.description: Date by which the member must elect COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: cobra_notification_sent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Notification Sent Date
attributes.description: Date on which COBRA election notice was sent to the member.

attributes.name: hipaa_special_enrollment_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Special Enrollment Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination qualifies the member for HIPAA special enrollment rights.

attributes.name: certificate_of_coverage_issued_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Creditable Coverage Issued Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a certificate of creditable coverage was issued to the member.

attributes.name: certificate_of_coverage_issued_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Creditable Coverage Issued Date
attributes.description: Date on which the certificate of creditable coverage was issued.

attributes.name: retroactive_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination is retroactive to a date prior to processing.

attributes.name: premium_refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount of premium to be refunded to the member or employer due to termination.

attributes.name: premium_refund_processed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premium refund has been processed.

attributes.name: outstanding_premium_balance
attributes.description: Amount of unpaid premium owed at the time of termination.

attributes.name: claims_runout_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after termination during which claims for services rendered before termination will be accepted.

attributes.name: claims_runout_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which claims for services rendered before termination will no longer be accepted.

attributes.name: reinstatement_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for coverage reinstatement.

attributes.name: reinstatement_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which the member must request reinstatement of coverage.

attributes.name: marketplace_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination applies to a Qualified Health Plan (QHP) purchased through a health insurance marketplace.

attributes.name: marketplace_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketplace enrollment transaction associated with this termination.

attributes.name: aptc_reconciliation_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC) Reconciliation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Advanced Premium Tax Credit reconciliation is required for this termination.

attributes.name: medicare_termination_reason_code
attributes.description: CMS-specific termination reason code for Medicare Advantage or Part D plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Enrollment Guidance

attributes.name: cms_transaction_control_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Transaction Control Number
attributes.description: CMS-assigned control number for Medicare enrollment transactions.

attributes.name: medicaid_termination_reason_code
attributes.description: State Medicaid agency termination reason code.

attributes.name: state_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination has been reported to the state insurance department or Medicaid agency.

attributes.name: state_reporting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the termination was reported to the state agency.

attributes.name: irs_1095_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Form 1095 Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination impacts IRS Form 1095-B or 1095-C reporting.

attributes.name: employer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer must be notified of this termination.

attributes.name: employer_notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which termination notification was sent to the employer.

attributes.name: dependent_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination applies to a dependent rather than a subscriber.

attributes.name: dependent_relationship_code
attributes.description: Relationship of the dependent to the subscriber, if applicable.

attributes.name: age_out_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination is due to a dependent reaching the maximum age for coverage.

attributes.name: death_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination is due to the death of the member.

attributes.name: date_of_death
attributes.description: Date of death of the member, if applicable.

attributes.name: non_payment_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination is due to non-payment of premiums.

attributes.name: grace_period_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a premium payment grace period was applied before termination.

attributes.name: fraud_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination is due to fraud, waste, or abuse.

attributes.name: siu_case_number
attributes.description: Case number from the Special Investigations Unit if termination is fraud-related.

attributes.name: appeal_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible to appeal the termination decision.

attributes.name: appeal_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which the member must file an appeal of the termination.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an appeal has been filed for this termination.

attributes.name: appeal_case_number
attributes.description: Case number assigned to the termination appeal, if filed.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the system of record that originated the termination event.

attributes.name: source_transaction_id

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set_id

attributes.description: Identifier for the EDI 834 transaction set that communicated this termination.

attributes.name: edi_interchange_control_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Interchange Control Number
attributes.description: Control number for the EDI interchange containing the termination transaction.

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the termination event.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: Error code if the termination processing failed.

attributes.name: error_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the processing error, if applicable.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination has been reversed or cancelled.

attributes.name: reversal_date

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason for reversing the termination, if applicable.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that processed the termination.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding the termination event.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member whose coverage is being terminated.

attributes.name: subscriber_id

attributes.name: processed_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that processed the termination.

attributes.name: contract_termination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_termination. Linking to contract termination provides audit trail and reason codes for cov

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Termination events trigger final billing calculations. Eligibility system notifies billing to generate final invoices, process refunds, or apply pro-rated adjustments to the billing account.

attributes.name: breach_incident_id

Required for OCR reporting, member notification, and tracking breach-related covera

attributes.name: case_id

products.name: history
products.description: Chronological log of all eligibility status changes for a member, supporting audit and retrospective analysis.

attributes.name: history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each eligibility history record, serving as the primary key for tracking individual eligibility status change events.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member whose eligibility status is being tracked in this history record.

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to the primary subscriber on the health insurance policy, used for eligibility verification and claims processing.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The employer or sponsor group number under which the member is enrolled, used to identify the benefit plan and coverage terms.

attributes.name: policy_number
