attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or market segment under which the member is enrolled, determining regulatory requirements and benefit structures.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The specific health plan product type that defines the network structure and coverage model for the member's benefits.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: The internal code identifying the specific benefit plan configuration, including coverage levels, cost-sharing, and network access rules.

attributes.name: benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific benefit package that defines the covered services, cost-sharing amounts, and coverage limitations for the member.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: coverage_level
attributes.description: The tier of coverage indicating who is covered under the policy, affecting premium amounts and benefit eligibility.

attributes.name: relationship_code
attributes.description: The member's relationship to the primary subscriber, determining dependent eligibility and coverage rights.

attributes.name: eligibility_status
attributes.description: The current eligibility status of the member indicating whether they have active coverage and can access benefits.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 270/271 Eligibility Inquiry and Response

attributes.name: status_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the specific reason for the eligibility status change, such as termination reason or suspension cause.

attributes.name: status_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description explaining the reason for the eligibility status change, providing context for audit and member inquiry purposes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the eligibility status change became effective, marking the start of the new coverage status period.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when the member's coverage ended or will end, marking the last day of active eligibility for benefits.

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: The original date when the member's coverage under this plan first began, used for calculating continuous coverage and waiting periods.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date when the eligibility transaction was processed and recorded in the enrollment system.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: The type of enrollment transaction that triggered this eligibility history record, indicating the nature of the status change.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the eligibility change, such as life event, open enrollment, or involuntary termination.

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason for the eligibility change, providing additional context beyond the standardized code.

attributes.name: qualifying_event_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the qualifying life event that triggered a special enrollment period or coverage change outside of open enrollment.

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date
attributes.description: The date when the qualifying life event occurred, used to determine special enrollment period eligibility and coverage effective dates.

attributes.name: cobra_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member is enrolled under COBRA continuation coverage following a qualifying event such as job loss or reduction in hours.

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event
attributes.description: The specific qualifying event that entitled the member to elect COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: cobra_election_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Date
attributes.description: The date when the member elected to continue coverage under COBRA following a qualifying event.

attributes.name: cobra_max_months
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Maximum Months
attributes.description: The maximum number of months the member is entitled to COBRA continuation coverage based on the qualifying event type.

attributes.name: medicare_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has Medicare coverage, affecting coordination of benefits and secondary payer determination.

attributes.name: medicare_part_a_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the member's Medicare Part A hospital insurance coverage became effective.

attributes.name: medicare_part_b_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the member's Medicare Part B medical insurance coverage became effective.

attributes.name: medicaid_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has Medicaid coverage, affecting dual eligibility determination and coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member is eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid, qualifying for special dual eligible plans and benefits.

attributes.name: subsidy_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member receives premium subsidies or cost-sharing reductions through the health insurance marketplace.

attributes.name: subsidy_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of premium costs covered by government subsidies for marketplace enrollees based on income level.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_reduction_level
attributes.description: The actuarial value level of cost-sharing reductions provided to eligible marketplace enrollees, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the member's assigned primary care physician, required for HMO and POS plan types.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Primary Care Access Measures

attributes.name: primary_care_physician_npi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) National Provider Identifier (NPI)
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier for the member's assigned primary care physician, used for claims processing and care coordination.

attributes.name: pcp_assignment_date
attributes.description: The date when the primary care physician was assigned to the member, establishing the care coordination relationship.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Primary Care Access Measures

attributes.name: plan_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider network to which the member has access under their benefit plan.

attributes.name: service_area_code
attributes.description: Geographic service area code indicating where the member can access in-network benefits, typically defined by county or ZIP code.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Service Area Requirements

attributes.name: rating_area
attributes.description: Geographic rating area used to determine premium rates based on the member's location, as defined by state insurance regulations.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: The monthly premium amount charged for the member's coverage during this eligibility period.

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: The billing frequency for premium payments during this eligibility period.

attributes.name: premium_paid_through_date
attributes.description: The last date through which premiums have been paid, determining active coverage status and grace period eligibility.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: The annual deductible amount the member must pay before the plan begins to pay for covered services.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: The maximum amount the member will pay for covered services in a plan year, after which the plan pays 100% of covered expenses.

attributes.name: copay_primary_care
attributes.description: The fixed copayment amount the member pays for primary care physician office visits.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: copay_specialist
attributes.description: The fixed copayment amount the member pays for specialist physician office visits.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: copay_emergency_room
attributes.description: The fixed copayment amount the member pays for emergency room visits.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of covered service costs the member is responsible for paying after meeting the deductible.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member's plan is HSA-qualified, allowing contributions to a tax-advantaged health savings account.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employer or sponsor group providing coverage to the member.

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the employer or sponsor organization providing group health coverage.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific division or subsidiary of the employer organization for multi-division groups.

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the employee class or category determining benefit eligibility and plan design, such as full-time, part-time, or union.

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: The financial arrangement under which the health plan is funded, determining risk assumption and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the plan year for benefit accumulations, deductibles, and out-of-pocket maximums.

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the plan year when benefit accumulations reset and new plan year begins.

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days the member must wait before coverage becomes effective after enrollment, subject to ACA 90-day maximum.

attributes.name: prior_coverage_credit_months
attributes.description: The number of months of creditable prior coverage applied to reduce waiting periods or pre-existing condition exclusions under HIPAA portability rules.

attributes.name: exchange_assigned_policy_id
attributes.description: The unique policy identifier assigned by the health insurance marketplace for members enrolled through federal or state exchanges.

attributes.name: exchange_subscriber_id
attributes.description: The unique subscriber identifier assigned by the health insurance marketplace for tracking enrollment and subsidy eligibility.

attributes.name: aptc_amount
attributes.description: The monthly amount of advanced premium tax credit paid directly to the insurer on behalf of the member to reduce premium costs.

attributes.name: tobacco_use_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member uses tobacco products, which may affect premium rating under ACA regulations.

attributes.name: age_at_effective_date
attributes.description: The member's age as of the coverage effective date, used for premium rating and benefit eligibility determination.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The member's gender, used for certain benefit determinations and regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: The member's residential ZIP code used for service area determination, network assignment, and premium rating.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: The FIPS county code for the member's residence, used for service area and network eligibility determination.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Service Area Requirements

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state code for the member's residence, determining applicable state insurance regulations and mandated benefits.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: The member's preferred language for communications and member materials, supporting culturally and linguistically appropriate services.

attributes.name: special_needs_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has special healthcare needs qualifying them for Special Needs Plan enrollment or care management programs.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_category
attributes.description: The chronic condition category qualifying the member for Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan enrollment, such as diabetes or cardiovascular disease.
attributes.references: CMS C-SNP Model of Care Requirements

attributes.name: institutional_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member resides in an institutional setting such as a nursing home, qualifying them for Institutional Special Needs Plan enrollment.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Transaction Set Identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the EDI 834 enrollment transaction that created or modified this eligibility record.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system that originated this eligibility record, such as Facets, QNXT, or HealthRules.

attributes.name: source_system_record_id
attributes.description: The unique record identifier from the source system, enabling traceability back to the originating transaction.

attributes.name: record_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this eligibility history record became effective in the data warehouse, supporting temporal queries and audit trails.

attributes.name: record_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this eligibility history record was superseded by a newer record, supporting slowly changing dimension type 2 tracking.

attributes.name: current_record_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the most current eligibility history record for the member, simplifying queries for current state.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member whose eligibility status is being tracked in this history record.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to the primary subscriber on the health insurance policy, used for eligibility verification and claims processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 270/271 Eligibility Inquiry and Response

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the member's assigned primary care physician, required for HMO and POS plan types.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Primary Care Access Measures

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider network to which the member has access under their benefit plan.

attributes.name: employer_group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employer or sponsor group providing coverage to the member.

products.name: cob_rule
products.description: Reference data defining COB hierarchies, primary payer determination, and secondary payer processing logic.

attributes.name: cob_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the coordination of benefits rule. Primary key for the COB rule reference data.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the COB rule for system processing and reference.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the COB rule for business user identification and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the COB rule logic, including conditions, hierarchy determination, and processing instructions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the COB rule indicating its purpose in the coordination process (e.g., primary payer determination, secondary processing logic).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: priority_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric order in which this COB rule should be evaluated within the hierarchy determination process. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: payer_position
attributes.description: The position in the payment hierarchy that this rule determines (primary, secondary, tertiary, or quaternary payer).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: applies_to_relationship
attributes.description: The member relationship type(s) to which this COB rule applies (e.g., dependent children for birthday rule).

attributes.name: applies_to_coverage_type
attributes.description: The type of health coverage to which this COB rule applies (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy, etc.).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: applies_to_lob
attributes.description: The line of business to which this COB rule applies (commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, etc.).

attributes.name: payment_calculation_method
attributes.description: The specific calculation method used to determine secondary payer liability under this COB rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: allows_duplicate_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COB rule permits duplicate payment that could result in the member receiving more than 100% of covered charges.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: requires_other_coverage_info
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COB rule requires information about other insurance coverage to be collected and maintained.

attributes.name: birthday_rule_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether the birthday rule (parent with earlier birthday in calendar year is primary) applies under this COB rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: gender_rule_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gender rule (father's plan is primary) applies under this COB rule. Note: This rule is largely obsolete due to gender discrimination concerns.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: active_inactive_rule_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether the active/inactive employment rule (active employee coverage is primary over retiree/COBRA coverage) applies under this COB rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: continuation_coverage_rule
attributes.description: Specifies how continuation coverage (COBRA, state continuation) is treated in the COB hierarchy under this rule.

attributes.name: court_order_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether a court decree or divorce settlement can override the standard COB determination under this rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: custodial_parent_rule
attributes.description: Specifies how custody arrangements affect COB determination for dependent children under this rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: longer_shorter_length_rule
attributes.business_glossary_term: Longer Shorter Length of Coverage Rule Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan that has covered the member for a longer period is considered primary under this COB rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: right_of_recovery_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan has the right to recover overpayments made due to incorrect COB determination under this rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: medicare_coordination_rule
attributes.description: Specifies how Medicare coordinates with other coverage under this COB rule, including working aged, ESRD, and disability provisions.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Secondary Payer Regulations 42 CFR 411

attributes.name: medicaid_coordination_rule
attributes.description: Specifies how Medicaid coordinates with other coverage under this COB rule, typically as payer of last resort.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Third Party Liability Regulations 42 CFR 433

attributes.name: workers_comp_coordination
attributes.description: Specifies how workers' compensation coverage coordinates with health insurance under this COB rule.

attributes.name: auto_insurance_coordination
attributes.description: Specifies how automobile insurance (including no-fault coverage) coordinates with health insurance under this COB rule.

attributes.name: liability_insurance_coordination
attributes.description: Specifies how third-party liability insurance coordinates with health insurance under this COB rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: subrogation_rights
attributes.description: Defines the plan's subrogation rights to recover payments from third parties under this COB rule.

attributes.name: claim_filing_time_limit_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Claim Filing Time Limit in Days
attributes.description: The number of days within which a claim must be filed with the secondary payer under this COB rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: requires_primary_eob
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires Primary Explanation of Benefits (EOB) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the secondary payer requires the primary payer's EOB before processing the claim under this COB rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: max_combined_benefit_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum percentage of covered charges that can be paid by all payers combined under this COB rule (typically 100%).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: applies_to_in_network
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COB rule applies to in-network provider services.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: applies_to_out_of_network
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COB rule applies to out-of-network provider services.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: applies_to_service_type
attributes.description: The specific type of healthcare service to which this COB rule applies (inpatient, outpatient, emergency, etc.).

attributes.name: state_specific_rule
attributes.description: Two-letter state code if this COB rule is specific to a particular state's regulations, or ALL if applicable nationwide.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation to the specific regulation, statute, or model law that mandates or authorizes this COB rule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this COB rule becomes active and applicable to claims processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this COB rule is no longer active. Null if the rule is currently active.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: superseded_by_rule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Coordination of Benefits (COB) Rule ID
attributes.description: Reference to the COB rule that replaces this rule if it has been superseded by a newer version.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this COB rule, supporting version control and change tracking.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status indicating whether this COB rule has been reviewed and approved for production use.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the business user or role who approved this COB rule for production use.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this COB rule was approved for production use.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this COB rule was reviewed for accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this COB rule.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: The number of months between scheduled reviews of this COB rule to ensure continued accuracy and compliance.

attributes.name: business_owner
attributes.description: The business unit, department, or individual responsible for maintaining and updating this COB rule.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record from which this COB rule originates (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthEdge).

attributes.name: external_rule_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this COB rule in the source system, used for reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_support
attributes.description: Indicates which EDI transaction sets are supported by this COB rule (270/271 eligibility, 837 claims, 835 remittance).

attributes.name: supports_real_time_adjudication
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COB rule can be applied in real-time eligibility verification and claims adjudication processes.

attributes.name: exception_handling_rule
attributes.description: Describes how exceptions or edge cases should be handled when this COB rule cannot be applied as written.

attributes.name: manual_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether claims subject to this COB rule require manual review by claims examiners.

attributes.name: complexity_score
attributes.description: A numeric score (1-10) indicating the complexity of this COB rule, used for training and resource allocation purposes.

attributes.name: usage_frequency
attributes.description: Indicates how frequently this COB rule is applied in claims processing (high, medium, low, rare).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to the application of this COB rule.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this COB rule record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this COB rule record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Coordination of benefits rules are contractually defined between payers. COB rules reference specific agreements that dictate primary/secondary payer determination and payment coordination when member

attributes.name: plan_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_type. Business justification: Coordination of benefits rules vary by plan type. Claims systems apply different COB logic when members have multiple coverages based on plan type hierarchies.

products.name: plan_benefit_map
products.description: Lookup table linking health plans to their associated benefit packages and eligibility rules.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_map_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the plan benefit map record linking a health plan to its benefit package configuration.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health insurance plan. References the specific plan product offered to members.

attributes.name: benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit package configuration that defines covered services, cost-sharing, and limitations.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Marketing or official name of the health insurance plan as presented to members and providers.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the health plan structure. HMO (Health Maintenance Organization), PPO (Preferred Provider Organization), EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization), POS (Point of Service), HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan), CDHP (Consumer Directed Health Plan).

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Business segment classification indicating the market and regulatory framework. ASO (Administrative Services Only), TPA (Third Party Administrator).

attributes.name: benefit_package_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the benefit package configuration identifying the coverage tier or option level.

attributes.name: benefit_package_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used for operational identification of the benefit package in claims and eligibility systems.

attributes.name: coverage_level
attributes.description: Tier of coverage indicating whether the plan covers individual only or includes dependents.

attributes.name: metal_tier
attributes.description: ACA marketplace plan classification indicating actuarial value and cost-sharing level. Bronze (60%), Silver (70%), Gold (80%), Platinum (90%).

attributes.name: plan_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider network associated with this plan-benefit combination, determining in-network vs out-of-network coverage.

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: Name of the provider network (e.g., National Network, Regional Network, Narrow Network) associated with the plan.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the drug formulary list associated with this plan-benefit combination for pharmacy benefit management.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this plan-benefit package mapping becomes active and eligible for member enrollment and claims adjudication.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this plan-benefit package mapping ends and is no longer available for new enrollments or coverage.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the plan-benefit mapping indicating availability for eligibility verification and enrollment.

attributes.name: eligibility_rule_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the collection of eligibility rules governing member qualification, enrollment periods, and continuation rights for this plan-benefit combination.

attributes.name: requires_pcp_selection
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must select a Primary Care Physician for this plan-benefit combination, typically required for HMO plans.

attributes.name: requires_referral
attributes.description: Indicates whether members need a referral from their PCP to see specialists under this plan-benefit configuration.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether certain services require prior authorization approval under this plan-benefit combination.

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan-benefit combination provides any coverage for out-of-network providers, typically applicable to PPO and POS plans.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-benefit combination is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage after qualifying events.

attributes.name: hipaa_continuation_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Continuation Eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-benefit combination qualifies for HIPAA continuation rights and portability protections.

attributes.name: aca_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-benefit combination meets ACA essential health benefits and coverage requirements.

attributes.name: hsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-benefit combination qualifies for Health Savings Account contributions, typically HDHP plans meeting IRS requirements.

attributes.name: fsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-benefit combination can be paired with a Flexible Spending Account for pre-tax healthcare expenses.

attributes.name: hra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-benefit combination can be integrated with an employer-funded Health Reimbursement Arrangement.

attributes.name: medicare_advantage_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a Medicare Advantage plan subject to CMS Part C regulations and Star Ratings.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422

attributes.name: prescription_drug_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-benefit combination includes integrated prescription drug coverage (Part D for Medicare plans).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Standards

attributes.name: dental_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether dental benefits are included in this plan-benefit package or offered separately.

attributes.name: vision_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether vision benefits are included in this plan-benefit package or offered separately.

attributes.name: behavioral_health_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether behavioral health and substance use disorder services are covered under this plan-benefit combination.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act

attributes.name: preventive_care_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether preventive care services are covered at 100% without cost-sharing as required by ACA.

attributes.name: maternity_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether maternity and newborn care are covered as essential health benefits under this plan-benefit combination.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits Maternity Coverage

attributes.name: pediatric_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether pediatric services including dental and vision are covered as essential health benefits.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits Pediatric Coverage

attributes.name: telehealth_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether telehealth and virtual care services are covered under this plan-benefit combination.

attributes.name: dme_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether durable medical equipment is covered under this plan-benefit combination.

attributes.name: snf_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether skilled nursing facility services are covered under this plan-benefit combination.

attributes.name: home_health_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether home health services are covered under this plan-benefit combination.

attributes.name: hospice_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether hospice care services are covered under this plan-benefit combination.

attributes.name: emergency_services_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency department and ambulance services are covered, typically without prior authorization.

attributes.name: annual_deductible_individual
attributes.description: The annual deductible amount that an individual member must pay out-of-pocket before the plan begins cost-sharing.

attributes.name: annual_deductible_family
attributes.description: The annual deductible amount that a family must collectively pay out-of-pocket before the plan begins cost-sharing.

attributes.name: oop_max_individual
attributes.business_glossary_term: Out of Pocket (OOP) Maximum Individual Amount
attributes.description: The maximum amount an individual member will pay out-of-pocket in a plan year, after which the plan pays 100% of covered services.

attributes.name: oop_max_family
attributes.business_glossary_term: Out of Pocket (OOP) Maximum Family Amount

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Parent‑child relationships between plans (e.g., family plans, group plans, supplemental riders).

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product hierarchy relationship record.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent product in the hierarchy relationship (e.g., family plan, group plan, base plan).

attributes.name: child_product_product_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the child product in the hierarchy relationship (e.g., individual member plan, supplemental rider, dependent coverage).

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of hierarchical relationship between parent and child products (e.g., family plan structure, supplemental rider attachment, dependent coverage linkage).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the product hierarchy tree where this relationship exists (e.g., 1 for top-level, 2 for second tier, 3 for third tier).

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the product hierarchy relationship indicating whether the parent-child linkage is currently valid and enforceable.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the product hierarchy relationship becomes active and enforceable for enrollment and benefits administration.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the product hierarchy relationship ends and is no longer valid for new enrollments or benefit coordination.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business classification for the product hierarchy relationship indicating the market segment and regulatory framework.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards, CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Coverage tier designation for the hierarchy relationship defining who is covered under the parent-child product structure.

attributes.name: dependency_type
attributes.description: Nature of the dependency between parent and child products indicating whether the child product requires the parent, is optional, or has conditional rules.

attributes.name: enrollment_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order in which products must be enrolled when multiple products exist in the hierarchy (e.g., base plan first, then riders).

attributes.name: is_primary_coverage
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the child product serves as primary coverage in the hierarchy or is supplemental/secondary.
attributes.references: COB (Coordination of Benefits) Standards, NAIC Model COB Regulation

attributes.name: cob_priority
attributes.description: Priority order for coordination of benefits when multiple products in the hierarchy provide overlapping coverage.
attributes.references: NAIC Model COB Regulation, CMS COB Guidelines

attributes.description: Method used to allocate premium amounts between parent and child products in the hierarchy for billing and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards, Internal Billing Standards

attributes.name: premium_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total premium allocated to the child product when using proportional allocation method (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.description: Rule governing how benefits are coordinated between parent and child products in the hierarchy for claims adjudication.
attributes.references: NAIC Model COB Regulation, Internal Claims Processing Standards

attributes.description: Method for coordinating deductible accumulation between parent and child products in the hierarchy.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, Internal Benefits Design Standards

attributes.name: oop_coordination_type
attributes.description: Method for coordinating out-of-pocket maximum accumulation between parent and child products in the hierarchy.

attributes.description: Rule defining whether the child product inherits the provider network from the parent product or maintains an independent network.

attributes.references: CMS Part D Regulations, Internal PBM Standards

attributes.name: eligibility_inheritance_rule
attributes.description: Rule defining how eligibility criteria are inherited or derived from the parent product to the child product.

attributes.name: age_restriction_applies
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether age-based restrictions apply to the product hierarchy relationship (e.g., dependent child age limits).

attributes.description: Minimum age required for enrollment in the child product within the hierarchy relationship.

attributes.name: maximum_age
attributes.description: Maximum age allowed for enrollment in the child product within the hierarchy relationship (e.g., 26 for dependent children under ACA).

attributes.description: Standardized code representing the type of relationship between parent and child products for system processing and reporting.

attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the product hierarchy relationship explaining the business purpose and rules.

attributes.name: requires_separate_application
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether enrollment in the child product requires a separate application form beyond the parent product application.

attributes.name: termination_coordination_rule
