attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this benefit type was terminated or deprecated and is no longer available for new plan designs.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit type record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether plan designs including this benefit type require state Department of Insurance or CMS regulatory approval before implementation.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, CMS Plan Approval Requirements

attributes.name: hipaa_privacy_rule_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy Rule Category
attributes.description: Classification of this benefit type under HIPAA Privacy Rule permitted uses and disclosures of Protected Health Information (PHI).

attributes.name: data_retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years that records related to this benefit type must be retained to comply with regulatory and legal requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention Requirements, State Insurance Regulations, ERISA

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence for displaying benefit types in user interfaces, reports, and member-facing documents (e.g., Summary of Benefits and Coverage).

attributes.name: icon_identifier
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the visual icon or symbol used to represent this benefit type in digital applications and member portals.

attributes.name: member_facing_label
attributes.description: Simplified, consumer-friendly label for this benefit type used in member communications, ID cards, and self-service tools.
attributes.references: Plain Language Standards, ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal operational notes, implementation guidance, or special considerations related to this benefit type.

products.name: cost_sharing_type
products.description: Lookup for cost‑sharing mechanisms: deductible, copay, coinsurance, out‑of‑pocket max.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost sharing type. Primary key for the cost sharing type lookup table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the cost sharing mechanism (e.g., DED, COPAY, COINS, MOOP). Used for system integration and reporting.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost sharing mechanism (e.g., Deductible, Copayment, Coinsurance, Out-of-Pocket Maximum).
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of how this cost sharing mechanism works, including member responsibility and when it applies in the benefit lifecycle.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the cost sharing type into standard categories for regulatory reporting and benefit design.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the member's cost sharing amount: fixed dollar amount, percentage of allowed amount, tiered structure, or combination.
attributes.references: NAIC Uniform Health Carrier External Review Model Act

attributes.name: applies_to_moop_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether amounts paid under this cost sharing type count toward the member's annual maximum out-of-pocket limit.

attributes.name: applies_to_deductible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether amounts paid under this cost sharing type count toward satisfying the member's deductible requirement.

attributes.name: member_responsibility_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type represents a direct financial obligation for the member at point of service.
attributes.references: HIPAA Transaction and Code Set Standards

attributes.name: network_tier_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type varies based on provider network tier (in-network, out-of-network, preferred, etc.).

attributes.name: service_type_specific_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type is defined differently for specific service categories (e.g., office visit copay vs. specialist copay).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Bid Pricing Tool

attributes.name: accumulator_type
attributes.description: Defines how cost sharing amounts accumulate: individual member level, family aggregate, embedded (individual within family), or other structure.

attributes.name: reset_frequency
attributes.description: Defines how often the cost sharing accumulator resets (e.g., annually on plan renewal, calendar year, per benefit period).

attributes.name: aca_compliant_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type structure meets ACA requirements for qualified health plans and essential health benefits.

attributes.name: medicare_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type is used in Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, or Part D plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Managed Care Manual Chapter 4

attributes.name: medicaid_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type is permitted under Medicaid managed care regulations and state plan requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR 438

attributes.name: commercial_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type is used in commercial fully-insured or self-funded employer group plans.

attributes.name: exchange_qhp_applicable_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchange Qualified Health Plan (QHP) Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type is used in Qualified Health Plans offered on federal or state-based marketplaces.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1311 Qualified Health Plan Standards

attributes.name: preventive_care_waived_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Preventive Care Cost Sharing Waived Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type is waived for ACA-mandated preventive services with A or B USPSTF rating.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether services subject to this cost sharing type require prior authorization before the cost sharing applies.

attributes.name: transparency_reporting_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type must be disclosed in machine-readable files per Transparency in Coverage Rule.

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display order of cost sharing types in member-facing materials and benefit summaries.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this cost sharing type definition becomes active and available for use in benefit plan designs.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this cost sharing type definition is no longer active and cannot be used in new benefit plan designs.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost sharing type definition in the product catalog system.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the state insurance department filing that approved this cost sharing type structure.
attributes.references: NAIC System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing (SERFF)

attributes.name: cms_plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Plan Benefit Package Identifier
attributes.description: CMS-assigned identifier linking this cost sharing type to approved Medicare Advantage or Part D plan benefit packages.

attributes.name: actuarial_value_impact_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated percentage impact this cost sharing type has on the overall actuarial value calculation for metal tier classification.

attributes.name: member_communication_label
attributes.description: Consumer-friendly label used in member-facing documents, EOBs, and digital tools to describe this cost sharing type.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Communications and Marketing Guidelines

attributes.name: eob_display_code
attributes.description: Standardized code used on Explanation of Benefits statements to identify this cost sharing type in claim payment details.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

attributes.name: claim_adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: CARC code used in 835 remittance advice to indicate claim payment adjustment due to this cost sharing type.
attributes.references: CARC Code List maintained by Washington Publishing Company

attributes.name: claim_adjustment_group_code
attributes.description: Group code indicating financial responsibility party for this cost sharing type: PR (Patient Responsibility), CO (Contractual Obligation), OA (Other Adjustment), PI (Payer Initiated), CR (Correction).

attributes.name: hios_cost_sharing_type_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS) Cost Sharing Type Code
attributes.description: Standardized code used in HIOS plan data submissions to CMS for Qualified Health Plan certification and oversight.
attributes.references: CMS HIOS Plan Data Submission Requirements

attributes.name: sbc_glossary_term
attributes.business_glossary_term: Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Glossary Term
attributes.description: Standardized term from the ACA-mandated SBC glossary used to describe this cost sharing type in uniform benefit summaries.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2715 SBC Template and Glossary

attributes.name: pharmacy_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type applies to pharmacy benefits and prescription drug coverage.

attributes.name: medical_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type applies to medical services including professional, facility, and ancillary services.

attributes.name: dental_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type applies to dental services and pediatric dental essential health benefits.
attributes.references: ACA Pediatric Dental Essential Health Benefit Requirements

attributes.name: vision_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type applies to vision services and pediatric vision essential health benefits.
attributes.references: ACA Pediatric Vision Essential Health Benefit Requirements

attributes.name: behavioral_health_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type applies to mental health and substance use disorder services with parity requirements.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA)

attributes.name: dme_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type applies to durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics, and supplies.
attributes.references: CMS DME Coverage and Payment Rules

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type structure is compatible with HSA-qualified high deductible health plans per IRS requirements.

attributes.name: fsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether amounts paid under this cost sharing type are eligible for reimbursement from health flexible spending accounts.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 502 Medical and Dental Expenses

attributes.name: hra_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether amounts paid under this cost sharing type are eligible for reimbursement from health reimbursement arrangements.

attributes.name: cobra_applicable_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type applies to COBRA continuation coverage with same terms as active employees.

attributes.name: erisa_disclosure_required_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Disclosure Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type must be disclosed in Summary Plan Descriptions for ERISA-covered group health plans.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 102 Summary Plan Description Requirements

attributes.name: no_surprises_act_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost sharing type is subject to No Surprises Act protections for emergency and out-of-network services.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost sharing type record was initially created in the product catalog system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost sharing type record was most recently updated or modified in the product catalog system.

products.name: rate_schedule_type
products.description: Classification of rate schedule methodology (e.g., age‑band, geographic, group size).

attributes.name: rate_schedule_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rate schedule type classification. Primary key for the rate schedule type entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the rate schedule type for system processing and integration (e.g., AGE_BAND, GEO_AREA, GROUP_SIZE, COMPOSITE, TIER).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the rate schedule type methodology (e.g., Age-Banded Rating, Geographic Area Rating, Group Size Rating, Composite Rating, Tiered Rating).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the rate schedule methodology, including how premiums are calculated and what factors are considered in the rating structure.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the rate schedule type indicating the primary rating methodology category (demographic factors, geographic factors, group characteristics, composite approach, experience-based, community-rated, adjusted community-rated, or custom).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1201, NAIC Model Rating Law

attributes.name: rating_methodology
attributes.description: Specific methodology used to determine premium rates within this schedule type (age bands, geographic rating areas, group size factors, industry classification, participation rates, employer contribution levels, composite rates, tier structures, experience modification, manual rates, or custom factors).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1201, NAIC Rate Filing Standards

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business to which this rate schedule type applies (commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, individual market, small group, large group, Administrative Services Only, government programs, or exchange/marketplace).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, ACA Marketplace Standards

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Specific market segment for which this rate schedule type is designed (individual, small group 1-50, large group 51+, jumbo group 1000+, government programs, exchange/marketplace, or off-exchange).
attributes.references: ACA Market Reform Rules, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance product to which this rate schedule applies (Health Maintenance Organization, Preferred Provider Organization, Exclusive Provider Organization, Point of Service, High Deductible Health Plan, Indemnity, Medicare Advantage, Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug, Prescription Drug Plan, Special Needs Plan, Dual Eligible SNP, Chronic Condition SNP, Institutional SNP, or Medicaid Managed Care).

attributes.name: aca_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate schedule type adheres to ACA rating requirements including age curve restrictions (3:1 ratio), tobacco use factors (1.5:1 ratio), and prohibited rating factors.

attributes.name: age_rating_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium variation based on age is permitted under this rate schedule type, subject to regulatory constraints (e.g., ACA 3:1 age ratio limit).

attributes.name: age_band_structure
attributes.description: Structure of age bands used in age-based rating (single-year increments, five-year bands, ten-year bands, custom bands, or not applicable if age rating is not used).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1201, State Insurance Department Guidelines

attributes.name: minimum_age
attributes.description: Minimum age for which this rate schedule type applies, typically 0 for dependent coverage or 18 for individual coverage.

attributes.name: maximum_age
attributes.description: Maximum age for which this rate schedule type applies, often capped at 64 for ACA-compliant plans (65+ transitions to Medicare) or unlimited for certain products.

attributes.name: tobacco_rating_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium surcharges for tobacco use are permitted under this rate schedule type, subject to regulatory limits (e.g., ACA 1.5:1 tobacco ratio).

attributes.name: tobacco_surcharge_max_ratio
attributes.description: Maximum allowable ratio for tobacco use surcharges (e.g., 1.50 represents a 50% surcharge limit under ACA regulations).

attributes.name: geographic_rating_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium variation based on geographic location (rating areas, ZIP codes, counties) is permitted under this rate schedule type.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1201, State Insurance Department Rating Area Definitions

attributes.name: geographic_granularity
attributes.description: Level of geographic detail used for rating purposes (state-level, rating area, county, ZIP code, Metropolitan Statistical Area, multi-state region, or not applicable).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1201, State Insurance Department Rating Area Definitions

attributes.name: family_tier_structure
attributes.description: Structure of family coverage tiers used in rating (two-tier: employee/family; three-tier: employee/employee+spouse/employee+children/family; four-tier: employee/employee+spouse/employee+children/family; five-tier or six-tier for more granular structures; composite for single blended rate; or not applicable).
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards, Employer Group Rating Practices

attributes.name: group_size_rating_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium variation based on employer group size (number of enrolled employees or eligible employees) is permitted under this rate schedule type.
attributes.references: State Small Group Market Regulations, NAIC Model Rating Law

attributes.name: group_size_threshold_min
attributes.description: Minimum group size (number of employees) for which this rate schedule type applies, often 1 for small group or 51 for large group markets.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, ACA Small Group Definition

attributes.name: group_size_threshold_max
attributes.description: Maximum group size (number of employees) for which this rate schedule type applies, often 50 for small group or unlimited for large group markets.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, ACA Small Group Definition

attributes.name: industry_class_rating_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium variation based on employer industry classification (SIC or NAICS codes) is permitted under this rate schedule type.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, NAIC Rate Filing Standards

attributes.name: participation_rate_factor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employee participation rate (percentage of eligible employees enrolling) is used as a rating factor in this schedule type.
attributes.references: Group Underwriting Guidelines, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: contribution_strategy_factor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employer contribution level (percentage of premium paid by employer) is used as a rating factor in this schedule type.

attributes.name: experience_rating_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium rates can be adjusted based on the group's historical claims experience (typically allowed for large groups, restricted for small groups under ACA).
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, ACA Small Group Market Reforms

attributes.name: community_rating_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate schedule uses pure community rating where all members in a geographic area pay the same rate regardless of health status, age (except ACA-permitted factors), or other characteristics.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1201, State Community Rating Laws

attributes.name: adjusted_community_rating_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate schedule uses adjusted community rating where base community rates are modified by permissible factors such as age, tobacco use, geography, and family composition.

attributes.name: composite_rating_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate schedule uses composite rating where a single blended rate applies to all covered members regardless of age, family status, or other demographic factors.
attributes.references: Group Rating Practices, Employer Benefit Design Standards

attributes.name: rate_guarantee_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months for which rates under this schedule type are guaranteed without change, typically 12 months for annual contracts or 24 months for multi-year agreements.
attributes.references: Group Contract Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: rate_adjustment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which rates under this schedule type can be adjusted (monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, annually, every two years, only at renewal, or not applicable for guaranteed rates).
attributes.references: Group Contract Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: manual_rate_basis
attributes.description: Basis for calculating manual rates in this schedule type (Per Member Per Month, Per Employee Per Month, per contract, per subscriber, per covered life, or not applicable).
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice, NAIC Rate Filing Standards

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_method
attributes.description: Method used for risk adjustment in rate calculations (Hierarchical Condition Category, prescription drug-based, concurrent model, prospective model, none, or custom methodology).
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Methodology, ACA Section 1343

attributes.name: raf_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Risk Adjustment Factor scoring is applied in this rate schedule type, typically used for Medicare Advantage and ACA marketplace plans.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, ACA Section 1343

attributes.name: rate_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether rates under this schedule type must be filed with and approved by state insurance departments or CMS before use.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Rate Review Requirements, ACA Section 2794

attributes.name: rate_review_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage increase threshold that triggers regulatory rate review (e.g., 10% annual increase under ACA rate review provisions).
attributes.references: ACA Section 2794, State Rate Review Standards

attributes.name: actuarial_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an actuarial certification is required for rates developed under this schedule type, typically required for filed rates and ACA-compliant products.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Opinion Requirements, ACA Rate Filing Standards

attributes.name: credibility_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum credibility factor (0.00 to 1.00) required for experience rating, indicating the statistical reliability of the group's claims experience for rate-setting purposes.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice No. 25, Credibility Theory

attributes.name: pooling_point_amount
attributes.description: Dollar threshold above which individual large claims are pooled and excluded from experience rating calculations to protect against catastrophic claim volatility.
attributes.references: Group Underwriting Standards, Stop-Loss Insurance Practices

attributes.name: trend_factor_percentage
attributes.description: Annual medical cost trend percentage applied in rate projections for this schedule type, reflecting expected healthcare cost inflation.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice, CMS Trend Assumptions

attributes.name: administrative_load_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of premium allocated to administrative expenses, commissions, and profit margin in this rate schedule type.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards, MLR Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: commission_percentage
attributes.description: Standard broker or agent commission percentage included in rates under this schedule type.
attributes.references: Broker Compensation Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rate schedule type becomes active and available for use in premium calculations.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rate schedule type is discontinued and no longer available for new business or renewals.
attributes.references: Rate Filing Standards, Product Discontinuation Requirements

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the rate schedule type (active and in use, inactive, pending regulatory approval, temporarily suspended, retired/discontinued, or draft/under development).

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: State insurance department or CMS approval number or SERFF tracking number for this rate schedule type, if regulatory filing was required.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Filing Requirements, SERFF System

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which regulatory approval was granted for this rate schedule type by the applicable state insurance department or CMS.

attributes.name: approved_states
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of state postal codes where this rate schedule type has been approved for use (e.g., 'CA,NY,TX,FL').

attributes.name: cms_approved_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Approved Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate schedule type has been approved by CMS for use with Medicare Advantage, Part D, or federally facilitated marketplace products.

attributes.name: exchange_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate schedule type is certified for use with ACA health insurance exchange/marketplace products.

attributes.name: metal_tier
attributes.description: ACA metal tier classification if this rate schedule type is specific to exchange products (Bronze 60% AV, Silver 70% AV, Gold 80% AV, Platinum 90% AV, Catastrophic, or not applicable for non-exchange products).

attributes.name: actuarial_value_percentage
attributes.description: Actuarial value percentage representing the average share of covered healthcare expenses paid by the plan under this rate schedule type, used for ACA metal tier classification.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_reduction_variant
attributes.description: Cost-sharing reduction variant for ACA marketplace silver plans (standard, 73% AV, 87% AV, 94% AV for low-income enrollees, or not applicable).

attributes.name: aptc_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether rates under this schedule type are eligible for federal Advanced Premium Tax Credits on ACA marketplaces.

attributes.name: rate_development_method
attributes.description: Primary actuarial method used to develop rates under this schedule type (manual rate from book rates, experience-rated from group claims, blended manual and experience, prospective projection, retrospective adjustment, or custom methodology).

attributes.name: underwriting_class
attributes.description: Underwriting approach associated with this rate schedule type (guaranteed issue with no health questions, medical underwriting with health screening, simplified issue with limited questions, or not applicable).
attributes.references: ACA Guaranteed Issue Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: pre_existing_condition_exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether pre-existing condition exclusions are permitted under this rate schedule type (prohibited for ACA-compliant plans, may be allowed for grandfathered or excepted benefit plans).

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Maximum waiting period in days before coverage becomes effective under this rate schedule type, capped at 90 days for ACA-compliant group plans.

attributes.name: renewal_rating_method
attributes.description: Method by which rates are adjusted at renewal (guaranteed renewable with rate class adjustments only, conditionally renewable with individual adjustments, optionally renewable, non-renewable, or not applicable).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Rating Law, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: rate_stability_mechanism
attributes.description: Mechanism used to stabilize rates and manage volatility (rate cap limiting increases, rate collar with min/max bounds, experience refund for favorable claims, retrospective premium adjustment, or none).
attributes.references: Group Contract Standards, Large Group Rating Practices

attributes.name: rate_cap_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum percentage by which rates can increase at renewal under this schedule type, if a rate cap mechanism is in place.
attributes.references: Group Contract Terms, State Rate Increase Limitations

attributes.name: minimum_premium_amount
attributes.description: Minimum total premium amount required for a group to qualify for this rate schedule type, often used for small group minimum premium requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of enrolled members required for a group to qualify for this rate schedule type.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rate schedule type record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this rate schedule type record.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rate schedule type record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who most recently modified this rate schedule type record.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this rate schedule type configuration, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit history.

products.name: attribute
products.description: Flexible key‑value pairs for extensible plan characteristics not covered by fixed columns.

attributes.name: attribute_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product attribute record. Primary key for the product attribute entity.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan product to which this attribute applies. Links to the parent product catalog entry.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: The name or key of the attribute being defined. Represents the extensible characteristic not covered by fixed product columns (e.g., telehealth_coverage, wellness_program_included, maternity_waiting_period_days).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value assigned to the attribute key. Stored as string to support flexible data types (numeric values, text, dates, boolean flags).

attributes.name: data_type
attributes.description: The data type of the attribute value to enable proper interpretation and validation (string, integer, decimal, boolean, date, timestamp).

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Logical grouping or category of the attribute for organization and filtering (e.g., coverage_extension, cost_sharing_detail, network_feature, compliance_requirement, member_service).

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name for the attribute key, used in user interfaces and member-facing documentation.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the attribute represents and how it should be interpreted or applied to the product.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business to which this attribute applies. Indicates whether the attribute is specific to Commercial, Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicaid, Individual, Small Group, Large Group, Government Programs, or Exchange products.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations, State Medicaid Managed Care Regulations, ACA Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this product attribute becomes active and applicable to the health plan product.
attributes.references: CMS Benefit Plan Effective Date Requirements, State Insurance Department Regulations

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this product attribute ceases to be active and applicable to the health plan product. Null indicates no expiration.
attributes.references: CMS Benefit Plan Termination Requirements, State Insurance Department Regulations

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute is mandatory for the product configuration or optional. True if required by regulation or business policy, false if optional.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits Requirements, CMS Medicare Advantage Coverage Requirements

attributes.name: is_member_visible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute should be displayed to members in benefit summaries, Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC), or member portals.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements, CMS Member Communication Standards

attributes.name: is_regulatory_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute is required by federal or state regulatory mandates (e.g., ACA essential health benefits, CMS coverage requirements).
attributes.references: ACA Compliance Requirements, CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, State Insurance Department Mandates

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the specific regulation, statute, or guidance that mandates or governs this attribute (e.g., ACA Section 1302, 42 CFR 422.100).
attributes.references: ACA Regulations, CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations, State Insurance Laws

attributes.name: compliance_standard
attributes.description: The compliance or quality standard associated with this attribute (e.g., NCQA accreditation requirement, HEDIS measure, CMS Star Rating component).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, HEDIS Technical Specifications, CMS Star Ratings Methodology

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The source or origin of the attribute definition (e.g., product management, actuarial, compliance, sales, external vendor).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this attribute was sourced (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthEdge HealthRules, Oracle Health Insurance).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for numeric attribute values (e.g., days, dollars, percentage, visits, months). Null for non-numeric attributes.

attributes.name: minimum_value
attributes.description: The minimum allowable value for numeric attributes, used for validation and business rule enforcement.

attributes.name: maximum_value
attributes.description: The maximum allowable value for numeric attributes, used for validation and business rule enforcement.

attributes.name: default_value
attributes.description: The default value assigned to this attribute if no explicit value is provided during product configuration.

attributes.name: allowed_values
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allowed values for enumerated attributes, used for validation and dropdown lists in configuration interfaces.

attributes.name: validation_rule
attributes.description: Business rule or validation logic applied to this attribute to ensure data quality and compliance (e.g., regex pattern, range check, cross-attribute dependency).

attributes.name: is_searchable

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: The sequence order in which this attribute should be displayed in user interfaces, reports, and member-facing documents.

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Logical grouping of related attributes for display and reporting purposes (e.g., preventive_care, specialty_services, pharmacy_benefits, cost_sharing).

attributes.name: is_aca_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute aligns with Affordable Care Act (ACA) requirements for essential health benefits, coverage standards, or consumer protections.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits Requirements, ACA Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: is_cms_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute must be reported to Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) for Medicare Advantage, Part D, or Medicaid managed care programs.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Reporting Requirements, CMS Part D Reporting Requirements, Medicaid Managed Care Reporting

attributes.name: hedis_measure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Code
attributes.description: The Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) measure code associated with this attribute, if applicable for quality reporting and NCQA accreditation.
attributes.references: HEDIS Technical Specifications, NCQA Quality Measurement Standards

attributes.name: star_rating_domain
attributes.description: The CMS Star Rating domain or category to which this attribute contributes (e.g., Staying Healthy, Managing Chronic Conditions, Member Experience, Drug Safety).
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings Methodology, Medicare Advantage and Part D Quality Measures

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The provider network tier to which this attribute applies, indicating different cost-sharing levels based on provider network participation (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, Preferred, Standard, Out-of-Network).
attributes.references: Internal Network Configuration Standards, ACA Network Adequacy Requirements

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: The category of healthcare service to which this attribute applies (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, emergency, preventive, specialty, pharmacy, behavioral_health, durable_medical_equipment).
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits Categories, CMS Service Category Classifications

attributes.name: benefit_code
attributes.description: Internal benefit code or identifier that this attribute modifies or extends, linking to the core benefit structure in the product catalog.

attributes.name: coverage_level
attributes.description: The coverage level to which this attribute applies (Individual, Family, Employee plus Spouse, Employee plus Children, Employee plus Family).
attributes.references: ACA Coverage Level Standards, ERISA Plan Design Requirements

attributes.name: age_range_minimum
attributes.description: The minimum age for which this attribute applies, used for age-specific benefits or restrictions (e.g., pediatric dental, adult preventive care).
attributes.references: ACA Age-Based Coverage Requirements, CMS Medicare Eligibility Standards

attributes.name: age_range_maximum
attributes.description: The maximum age for which this attribute applies, used for age-specific benefits or restrictions. Null indicates no upper age limit.
attributes.references: ACA Age-Based Coverage Requirements, CMS Medicare Eligibility Standards

attributes.name: gender_applicability
attributes.description: The gender to which this attribute applies, used for gender-specific benefits (e.g., maternity, prostate screening). All indicates no gender restriction.
attributes.references: ACA Non-Discrimination Requirements, CMS Coverage Standards

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic area or market to which this attribute applies (e.g., state code, county, service area, national). Used for state-specific mandates or regional product variations.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Regulations, CMS Service Area Requirements

attributes.name: state_mandate_code
attributes.description: Code or identifier for state-specific insurance mandates that require this attribute (e.g., state-mandated benefits, coverage requirements).
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Mandated Benefits, NAIC State Mandate Database

attributes.name: employer_group_size
attributes.description: The employer group size category to which this attribute applies (Small Group 1-50, Large Group 51+, Jumbo Group 1000+, Individual). Used for group-specific product features.
attributes.references: ACA Small Group Market Definitions, State Insurance Department Group Size Classifications

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: The funding arrangement to which this attribute applies. Includes Fully Insured, Administrative Services Only (ASO), Level Funded, Self-Funded. Used for funding-specific product configurations.
attributes.references: ERISA Self-Funded Plan Requirements, State Insurance Department Fully Insured Regulations

attributes.name: metal_tier
attributes.description: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) metal tier classification to which this attribute applies (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Catastrophic), indicating actuarial value levels.
attributes.references: ACA Metal Tier Actuarial Value Requirements, ACA Marketplace Plan Standards

attributes.name: actuarial_value_percentage
attributes.description: The actuarial value percentage associated with this attribute, representing the percentage of total average costs for covered benefits that the plan pays.
attributes.references: ACA Actuarial Value Calculator, ACA Metal Tier Standards

attributes.name: cost_sharing_reduction_level
attributes.description: The Cost Sharing Reduction (CSR) level for ACA marketplace plans, indicating enhanced cost-sharing for eligible low-income members (Standard, CSR 73%, CSR 87%, CSR 94%).
attributes.references: ACA Cost Sharing Reduction Requirements, CMS Marketplace Plan Standards

attributes.name: is_hsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute applies to Health Savings Account (HSA) eligible High Deductible Health Plans (HDHP) that meet IRS requirements.
attributes.references: IRS HSA Eligibility Requirements, IRS Publication 969

attributes.name: is_fsa_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute is compatible with Flexible Spending Account (FSA) arrangements for pre-tax healthcare expense reimbursement.

attributes.name: is_hra_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute is compatible with Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) employer-funded accounts for healthcare expense reimbursement.
attributes.references: IRS HRA Requirements, ACA Individual Coverage HRA Regulations

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute requires Prior Authorization (PA) or pre-certification before services can be rendered and covered.
attributes.references: Internal Utilization Management Standards, CMS Prior Authorization Requirements

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute requires step therapy protocols, where members must try lower-cost treatments before higher-cost alternatives are covered.
attributes.references: Internal Pharmacy Benefit Management Standards, CMS Part D Step Therapy Requirements

attributes.name: quantity_limit
attributes.description: The maximum quantity or number of services, visits, or units covered under this attribute within a specified time period.
attributes.references: Internal Benefit Design Standards, CMS Coverage Limitation Requirements

attributes.name: quantity_limit_period
attributes.description: The time period over which the quantity limit applies (Per Day, Per Week, Per Month, Per Quarter, Per Year, Per Lifetime).
attributes.references: Internal Benefit Design Standards, CMS Coverage Limitation Requirements

attributes.name: waiting_period_days

attributes.references: ACA Waiting Period Limitations, State Insurance Department Waiting Period Regulations

attributes.name: exclusion_description
attributes.description: Description of services, conditions, or circumstances excluded from coverage under this attribute.
attributes.references: ACA Coverage Exclusion Standards, CMS Medicare Advantage Coverage Exclusions

attributes.name: limitation_description
attributes.description: Description of limitations or restrictions applied to coverage under this attribute (e.g., frequency limits, dollar limits, service-specific restrictions).
attributes.references: ACA Coverage Limitation Standards, CMS Medicare Advantage Coverage Limitations

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: The pharmacy formulary tier to which this attribute applies, indicating different cost-sharing levels for prescription drugs (Tier 1-5, Specialty, Preferred Generic, Generic, Preferred Brand, Non-Preferred Brand).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements, Internal Pharmacy Benefit Management Standards

attributes.name: is_preventive_care
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute represents preventive care services that must be covered at 100% with no cost-sharing under ACA requirements.
attributes.references: ACA Preventive Services Requirements, USPSTF Preventive Services Recommendations

attributes.name: is_essential_health_benefit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute is part of the ten Essential Health Benefit (EHB) categories required by the Affordable Care Act (ACA).
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits Requirements, State EHB Benchmark Plans

attributes.name: transparency_in_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute must be included in Transparency in Coverage machine-readable files for price transparency compliance.
attributes.references: Transparency in Coverage Rule, CMS Price Transparency Requirements

attributes.name: no_surprises_act_applicable

attributes.name: mental_health_parity_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute is subject to Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA) requirements for equivalent coverage of behavioral health and substance use disorder services.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA), CMS Mental Health Parity Compliance

products.name: lifecycle_event
products.description: Audit record of creation, amendment, or termination events for a plan.

attributes.name: lifecycle_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the plan lifecycle event record. Primary key for tracking creation, amendment, or termination events.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan product that this lifecycle event applies to. Links to the plan catalog.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of lifecycle event being recorded for the plan. Indicates whether the plan is being created, modified, terminated, renewed, reinstated, or suspended.

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lifecycle event occurred or was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the lifecycle event was recorded in the system, including time zone information.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the lifecycle event becomes effective for the plan. May differ from the event date for future-dated changes.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lifecycle event or its effects end. Applicable for amendments with defined duration or termination events.

attributes.name: reason_code

attributes.name: reason_description

attributes.name: initiated_by

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: lob

Includes HMO (Health Maintenance Organization), PPO (Preferred Provider Organization), EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization), POS (Point of Service), HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan), MA (Medicare Advantage), MA-PD (Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug), PDP (Prescription Drug Plan), and SNP (Special Needs Plan) variants.

attributes.name: plan_year

attributes.name: market_segment

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
