products.name: eligibility_criteria
products.description: Reference data defining criteria such as age ranges, income brackets, or employer size that drive eligibility_rule evaluation.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the eligibility criteria record. Primary key for the eligibility criteria reference data.

attributes.name: criteria_code
attributes.description: Unique business code identifying the specific eligibility criteria type (e.g., AGE_RANGE, INCOME_BRACKET, EMPLOYER_SIZE, GEOGRAPHIC_AREA).

attributes.name: criteria_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the eligibility criteria for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: criteria_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the eligibility criteria type to group similar criteria for configuration and reporting.

attributes.name: criteria_type
attributes.description: Specific type of eligibility criteria that defines the nature of the evaluation rule (e.g., age range for Medicare eligibility, income bracket for Medicaid, employer size for group plans).
attributes.references: CMS Eligibility Standards, ACA Marketplace Requirements

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the eligibility criteria, including business purpose and how it is applied in eligibility determination.

attributes.name: data_type
attributes.description: Data type of the criteria value used for validation and rule evaluation (e.g., numeric for age, string for geographic code, range for income brackets).

attributes.name: value_format
attributes.description: Format specification or pattern for valid criteria values (e.g., 'MIN-MAX' for ranges, 'ISO-3166' for country codes, 'FIPS' for county codes).

attributes.name: minimum_value
attributes.description: Minimum numeric value for range-based criteria (e.g., minimum age of 18 for adult plans, minimum income threshold for subsidy eligibility).

attributes.name: maximum_value
attributes.description: Maximum numeric value for range-based criteria (e.g., maximum age of 64 for non-Medicare plans, maximum income for Medicaid eligibility).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for numeric criteria values (e.g., years for age, dollars for income, percent for Federal Poverty Level (FPL), employees for employer size).

attributes.name: allowed_values
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of valid enumerated values for categorical criteria (e.g., 'US_CITIZEN|PERMANENT_RESIDENT|REFUGEE' for citizenship status).
attributes.references: CMS Eligibility Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: comparison_operator
attributes.description: Logical operator used to evaluate the criteria against member or applicant data in eligibility rules (e.g., 'between' for age ranges, 'in' for geographic areas).

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this criteria must be satisfied for eligibility (true) or is optional/conditional (false). Mandatory criteria are required for all applicants.

attributes.name: is_inclusive
attributes.description: For range-based criteria, indicates whether boundary values are included (true) or excluded (false) in the evaluation (e.g., age 65 included or excluded from age range).

attributes.name: priority_order
attributes.description: Numeric order in which this criteria should be evaluated within a rule set. Lower numbers are evaluated first to optimize rule processing.

attributes.name: applicable_lob
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of Lines of Business (LOB) where this criteria applies (e.g., 'COMMERCIAL|MEDICARE|MEDICAID|EXCHANGE'). Determines which product lines can use this criteria.

attributes.name: applicable_plan_types
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of plan types where this criteria applies (e.g., 'HMO|PPO|EPO|POS|HDHP|MA|MA-PD|PDP|SNP'). Restricts criteria usage to specific plan designs.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Type Standards, Internal Product Configuration

attributes.name: applicable_market_segments
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of market segments where this criteria applies (e.g., 'INDIVIDUAL|SMALL_GROUP|LARGE_GROUP|ASO|GOVERNMENT'). Defines market applicability.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic level at which this criteria is defined and applied (e.g., state-level for Medicaid eligibility, county-level for exchange subsidies, service area for network plans).
attributes.references: CMS Service Area Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where this criteria applies, if criteria is state-specific (e.g., 'CA' for California Medicaid income thresholds). Null for national criteria.

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the county where this criteria applies, if criteria is county-specific (e.g., for county-level subsidy calculations).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this eligibility criteria becomes active and can be used in eligibility rule evaluation. Supports temporal versioning of criteria definitions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this eligibility criteria is no longer valid for use in eligibility rule evaluation. Null indicates criteria is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this criteria definition to track changes over time (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Supports criteria versioning and change management.

attributes.name: superseded_by_criteria_id
attributes.description: Reference to the eligibility_criteria_id that replaces this criteria when it is retired or updated. Maintains criteria lineage and version history.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Governing body or regulatory authority that mandates or influences this eligibility criteria (e.g., CMS for Medicare, State DOI for state-specific requirements, ACA for marketplace plans).
attributes.references: CMS Regulations, State Insurance Departments, ACA Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Specific regulation, statute, or policy reference that defines or requires this eligibility criteria (e.g., '42 CFR 435.119' for Medicaid income standards, 'ACA Section 1312' for QHP eligibility).
attributes.references: Code of Federal Regulations, State Statutes, ACA Legislation

attributes.name: cms_compliance_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this criteria is required for CMS compliance (true) for Medicare Advantage, Part D, or Medicaid programs. Used for regulatory reporting and audit.

attributes.name: aca_compliance_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this criteria is required for ACA compliance (true) for Qualified Health Plans (QHP) or marketplace products. Used for regulatory reporting and audit.

attributes.name: validation_rule
attributes.description: Business rule or expression used to validate criteria values during configuration or rule setup (e.g., 'minimum_value < maximum_value', 'effective_date < expiration_date').

attributes.name: error_message_template
attributes.description: Template for error messages displayed when this criteria is not met during eligibility evaluation. Supports member communication and customer service.

attributes.name: documentation_url
attributes.description: URL link to detailed documentation, policy guidelines, or regulatory references for this eligibility criteria. Supports configuration and compliance teams.

attributes.name: business_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business unit or role responsible for defining and maintaining this eligibility criteria (e.g., 'Product Management', 'Compliance', 'Medicare Operations').

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the eligibility criteria. Active criteria are available for use in eligibility rules; inactive or retired criteria are historical only.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for new or modified criteria. Tracks governance approval process before criteria can be activated for production use.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who approved this criteria for production use. Supports audit trail and governance accountability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this criteria was approved for production use through the governance approval process.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this criteria was last reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and regulatory compliance. Supports periodic governance review cycles.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this criteria. Ensures criteria remain current with regulatory and business changes.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of active eligibility rules that currently reference this criteria. Indicates criteria importance and impact of changes.

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this criteria can be configured or customized by product managers (true) or is a fixed regulatory requirement (false).

attributes.name: configuration_level
attributes.description: Level at which this criteria can be configured or overridden (e.g., national standard, state-specific, plan-specific). Defines configuration flexibility.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence for displaying this criteria in user interfaces, reports, or member communications. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: is_visible_to_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether this criteria should be displayed to members in eligibility communications, plan documents, or self-service portals (true) or is for internal use only (false).

attributes.name: member_facing_label
attributes.description: User-friendly label or description for this criteria to be displayed in member communications, plan documents, or self-service portals.

attributes.name: program_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_eligibility. Business justification: Product eligibility criteria must reference government program eligibility rules for Medicare/Medicaid plans. Enrollment systems validate member eligibility against government program requirements in

products.name: product_plan
products.description: Master record for each health insurance product offering, including plan name, type (HMO, PPO, HDHP), market segment, benefit design, cost-sharing structure, eligibility rules, pricing tiers, effective dates, and high-level attributes. Serves as the comprehensive catalog of health plan offerings across all lines of business.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for the health insurance product offering in the system.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code used to uniquely identify the plan across systems and business processes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Marketing name and human-readable name of the health insurance product offering.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the plan when revisions are made to benefits or terms.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the health plan structure defining network access and care coordination requirements (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP).

attributes.name: market
attributes.description: Target market and specific market classification for the plan such as individual, group, small group, large group, Medicare, Medicaid, or exchange.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Primary market segment and regulatory category for the plan under which it is offered (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Exchange).

attributes.name: metal_level
attributes.description: ACA-defined actuarial value category indicating the level of coverage (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum) or equivalent tier classification.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the plan becomes effective and available for enrollment and member coverage.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the plan is terminated, expires, or is no longer available for new enrollment.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date the plan is scheduled for renewal with updated terms or benefits.

attributes.name: enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: First date when eligible individuals can enroll in the plan during open enrollment or initial offering period.

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: Last date when eligible individuals can enroll in the plan during the enrollment period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the plan record.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the plan in the product catalog (e.g., Active, Inactive, Pending, Terminated, Suspended).

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: Calendar or fiscal year for which the plan design, benefits, and rates apply.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Base monthly premium amount charged for individual coverage under the plan.

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: How often the premium is billed (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annually).

attributes.name: premium_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premium is paid by employee, employer, or shared, and the contribution structure.

attributes.name: premium_rate_family
attributes.description: Monthly premium amount charged for family coverage under the plan.

attributes.name: premium_rate_employee_plus_spouse
attributes.description: Monthly premium amount charged for employee plus spouse coverage tier.

attributes.name: premium_rate_employee_plus_children
attributes.description: Monthly premium amount charged for employee plus children coverage tier.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount contributed by the employer toward the premium.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount contributed by the employee toward the premium.

attributes.name: deductible_individual
attributes.description: Dollar amount an individual member must pay out-of-pocket before insurance benefits begin to pay for covered services.

attributes.name: deductible_family
attributes.description: Dollar amount a family must collectively pay out-of-pocket before insurance benefits begin to pay for covered services.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_individual
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount an individual member pays for covered in-network services in a plan year, after which the plan pays 100%.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_family
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount a family collectively pays for covered in-network services in a plan year, after which the plan pays 100%.

attributes.name: copay_primary_care
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for a primary care provider office visit.

attributes.name: copay_specialist
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for a specialist provider office visit.

attributes.name: copay_emergency
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for an emergency department visit.

attributes.name: urgent_care_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for an urgent care facility visit.

attributes.name: inpatient_hospital_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount or per-day amount the member pays for inpatient hospital admission and stay.

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of allowed charges the member pays for covered services after the deductible is met.

attributes.name: pharmacy_copay_generic
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount for Tier 1 generic prescription drugs.

attributes.name: pharmacy_copay_brand
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount for Tier 2 preferred brand name prescription drugs.

attributes.name: pharmacy_copay_specialty
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount or coinsurance for Tier 3 or Tier 4 specialty prescription drugs.

attributes.name: rx_tier_4_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount or coinsurance for Tier 4 prescription drugs, typically non-preferred specialty medications.

attributes.name: pharmacy_coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Coinsurance rate applied to pharmacy claims after deductible, typically for higher-tier drugs.

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan provides any coverage for services received from out-of-network providers.

attributes.name: out_of_network_deductible_individual
attributes.description: Dollar amount an individual member must pay for out-of-network services before benefits apply.

attributes.name: out_of_network_deductible_family
attributes.description: Dollar amount a family must collectively pay for out-of-network services before benefits apply.

attributes.name: out_of_network_coinsurance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of allowed charges the member pays for out-of-network services after deductible.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider network associated with the plan for in-network benefits.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the prescription drug formulary linked to the plan, defining covered medications and tier placement.

attributes.name: formulary_version
attributes.description: Version of the drug formulary in effect for the plan during the coverage period.

attributes.name: is_hsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan qualifies for Health Savings Account (HSA) contributions under IRS guidelines.

attributes.name: hsa_contribution_limit
attributes.description: Maximum annual contribution allowed to a Health Savings Account under the plan.

attributes.name: is_fsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is eligible for a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare expenses.

attributes.name: fsa_contribution_limit
attributes.description: Maximum annual contribution allowed to a Flexible Spending Account under the plan.

attributes.name: is_hra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is eligible for a Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA).

attributes.name: hra_contribution_limit
attributes.description: Maximum annual contribution allowed to a Health Reimbursement Arrangement under the plan.

attributes.name: is_medicare_advantage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is a Medicare Advantage (Part C) product.

attributes.name: is_medicaid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is a Medicaid managed care product.

attributes.name: is_prescription_drug_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether prescription drug benefits are integrated into the plan.

attributes.name: is_dental_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether dental benefits are included or integrated into the plan.

attributes.name: is_vision_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether vision benefits are included or integrated into the plan.

attributes.name: hearing_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes hearing aid and audiology services coverage.

attributes.name: is_wellness_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether wellness programs and incentives are part of the plan benefits.

attributes.name: is_telehealth_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether telehealth and virtual healthcare services are covered under the plan.

attributes.name: is_behavioral_health_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether behavioral health, mental health, and substance abuse services are covered.

attributes.name: is_maternity_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether maternity services including prenatal care, delivery, and postnatal care are covered.

attributes.name: is_preventive_care_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether preventive care services are covered, typically at no cost-sharing per ACA requirements.

attributes.name: durable_medical_equipment_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan covers medically necessary durable medical equipment (DME) such as wheelchairs and oxygen.

attributes.name: home_health_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan covers skilled nursing and therapy services provided in the member's home.

attributes.name: skilled_nursing_facility_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan covers short-term rehabilitation and skilled nursing care in a facility setting.

attributes.name: hospice_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan covers end-of-life palliative care and hospice services.

attributes.name: chiropractic_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan covers chiropractic manipulation and related services.

attributes.name: acupuncture_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan covers acupuncture services for pain management or other conditions.

attributes.name: is_chronic_condition_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether chronic condition management programs are included in the plan benefits.

attributes.name: is_case_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether case management services are provided to coordinate complex care needs.

attributes.name: is_prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization is required for certain services, procedures, or medications under the plan.

attributes.name: prior_auth_exceptions
attributes.description: Text description of services exempt from prior authorization requirements.

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must obtain a referral from their PCP to see specialists.

attributes.name: pcp_selection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must designate a Primary Care Physician (PCP) for care coordination.

attributes.name: utilization_management_program
attributes.description: Name or code of the utilization management program applied to the plan for cost and quality control.

attributes.name: medical_loss_ratio
attributes.description: Percentage of premium revenue spent on medical claims and quality improvement, as required by ACA reporting.

attributes.name: actuarial_value
attributes.description: Percentage of total average healthcare costs the plan is expected to cover for a standard population, used for metal tier classification.

attributes.name: lifetime_maximum_benefit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the plan will pay over the member's lifetime (typically prohibited under ACA for essential health benefits).

attributes.name: annual_maximum_benefit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the plan will pay in a plan year (typically prohibited under ACA for essential health benefits).

attributes.name: eligibility_age_min
attributes.description: Minimum age of members eligible to enroll in the plan.

attributes.name: eligibility_age_max
attributes.description: Maximum age of members eligible to enroll in the plan.

attributes.name: eligibility_employment_status
attributes.description: Employment status required for eligibility (e.g., full-time, part-time, retired, unemployed).

attributes.name: eligibility_income_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum household income for subsidy eligibility or Medicaid qualification.

attributes.name: eligibility_residency_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the member must reside to be eligible for the plan.

attributes.name: eligibility_residency_country
attributes.description: Country code of residency required for eligibility in the plan.

attributes.name: eligibility_citizenship
attributes.description: Citizenship or immigration status required for eligibility (e.g., U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident).

attributes.name: eligibility_medicare_status
attributes.description: Indicates if the member must be Medicare eligible or enrolled to qualify for the plan.

attributes.name: eligibility_medicaid_status
attributes.description: Indicates if the member must be Medicaid eligible or enrolled to qualify for the plan.

attributes.name: eligibility_other_programs
attributes.description: Text list of any additional programs influencing eligibility (e.g., CHIP, TRICARE, VA).

attributes.name: service_area
attributes.description: Geographic region, counties, or ZIP codes where the plan is available and network providers operate.

attributes.name: is_subsidized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes a premium subsidy or tax credit for eligible members.

attributes.name: subsidy_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the premium subsidy or tax credit applied to the plan for eligible members.

attributes.name: subsidy_type
attributes.description: Type of subsidy provided (e.g., premium tax credit, cost-sharing reduction, voucher, state subsidy).

attributes.name: is_aca_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan meets Affordable Care Act (ACA) requirements for essential health benefits and consumer protections.

attributes.name: aca_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status with ACA regulations (e.g., Compliant, Non-Compliant, Grandfathered, Transitional).

attributes.name: grandfathered_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is grandfathered under the ACA, exempt from certain consumer protection requirements.

attributes.name: is_cms_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan complies with Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) rules and regulations.

attributes.name: cms_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status with CMS regulations for Medicare and Medicaid products.

attributes.name: state_filing_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by state insurance department for rate and form filing approval.

attributes.name: cms_contract_number
attributes.description: Five-character identifier assigned by CMS for Medicare Advantage and Part D contracts.

attributes.name: cms_plan_id
attributes.description: Three-digit plan benefit package identifier assigned by CMS within a contract number.

attributes.name: hios_plan_id
attributes.description: 14-digit unique identifier assigned by CMS for Marketplace (Exchange) plans in the Health Insurance Oversight System.

attributes.name: medicare_star_rating
attributes.description: CMS quality rating for Medicare Advantage and Part D plans on a 1-5 star scale based on quality and performance measures.

attributes.name: ncqa_accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status from National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) indicating quality standards compliance.

attributes.name: urac_accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status from URAC (formerly Utilization Review Accreditation Commission) indicating quality and utilization management standards.

attributes.name: age_rating_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium rates vary by member age within regulatory limits (typically 3:1 ratio under ACA).

attributes.name: tobacco_rating_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium rates include tobacco use surcharge within regulatory limits (typically up to 50% under ACA).

attributes.name: geographic_rating_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium rates vary by geographic rating area based on local healthcare costs.

attributes.name: minimum_enrollment_size
attributes.description: Minimum number of eligible employees or members required for a group to qualify for the plan.

attributes.name: maximum_enrollment_size
attributes.description: Maximum number of eligible employees or members allowed for a group under the plan.

attributes.name: minimum_participation_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of eligible employees that must enroll for the group to qualify for coverage.

attributes.name: minimum_employer_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of premium that employer must contribute toward employee coverage to qualify for the plan.

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days new employees must wait before becoming eligible for coverage (maximum 90 days under ACA).

attributes.name: special_enrollment_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan allows enrollment outside open enrollment due to qualifying life events.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Narrative description of plan benefits, features, and key selling points for marketing and member communication.

attributes.name: summary_of_benefits_url
attributes.description: Web address where the standardized Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) document can be accessed.

attributes.name: summary_of_coverage_url
attributes.description: Web link to the Summary of Coverage document detailing plan benefits and limitations.

attributes.name: evidence_of_coverage_url
attributes.description: Web address where the complete Evidence of Coverage (EOC) legal plan document can be accessed.

attributes.name: provider_directory_url
attributes.description: Web address where members can search for in-network providers, facilities, and pharmacies.

attributes.name: marketing_material_url
attributes.description: Link to marketing brochure, flyer, or plan comparison materials for sales and enrollment purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: Channel through which members can enroll (e.g., online portal, phone, broker, employer, exchange).

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary distribution channel through which the plan is sold (e.g., direct, broker, exchange, employer group).

attributes.name: current_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Number of members currently enrolled in the plan as of the last reporting period.

attributes.name: max_enrollment_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of members allowed for the plan based on network capacity or business constraints.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Factor used to adjust payments based on member health status and predicted healthcare costs under CMS risk adjustment models.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor_type
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate the risk adjustment factor (e.g., HCC, RxHCC, CDPS).

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor_source
attributes.description: Source system or data set used for risk adjustment calculation (e.g., claims, encounter data, RAPS, EDPS).

attributes.name: target_demographic
attributes.description: Description of the intended member population for the plan (e.g., young adults, families, seniors, low-income).

attributes.name: value_based_design
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan incorporates value-based insurance design principles with differential cost-sharing based on service value.

attributes.name: wellness_program_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes wellness incentives, health assessments, or disease prevention programs.

attributes.name: care_management_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes proactive care management services for high-risk or complex members.

attributes.name: nurse_hotline_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether members have access to a 24-hour nurse advice hotline for health questions.

attributes.name: member_portal_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can access plan information, claims, and benefits through an online member portal.

attributes.name: mobile_app_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan offers a mobile application for member self-service and digital health tools.

attributes.name: product_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the product manager responsible for this plan's design, pricing, and performance.

attributes.name: underwriting_company
attributes.description: Legal name of the insurance company entity that underwrites and assumes financial risk for the plan.

attributes.name: reinsurance_arrangement
attributes.description: Type of reinsurance agreement in place to transfer catastrophic risk to a reinsurer (e.g., excess of loss, quota share).

attributes.name: aso_arrangement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an Administrative Services Only (ASO) arrangement where the employer self-funds and the insurer provides administrative services.

attributes.name: stop_loss_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether stop-loss insurance is in place to protect self-funded employers from catastrophic claims.

attributes.name: plan_document_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the legal plan document and Summary Plan Description (SPD).

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the plan catalog record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the plan was first added to the product catalog system.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commission structure and payment schedule for brokers and agents selling this plan.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center for financial reporting and cost allocation of plan operations.

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_type reference table for standardized plan type classification.

attributes.name: status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_status reference table for standardized lifecycle status values.

attributes.name: service_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to authorization.service_type for covered service categories and authorization requirements.

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Premium billing and revenue collection including group billing, individual billing, premium calculation (PMPM/PEPM), payment processing, grace periods, retroactive adjustments, and accounts receivable. Manages ASO billing, capitation payments, and commission processing.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Invoice issued to members or groups for premium charges, includes line items, taxes, due dates, and total amount due.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the invoice record. Primary key for the invoice entity.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique invoice number displayed to members and groups for reference and payment tracking.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice based on billing purpose: premium billing for insured products, ASO for self-funded employer services, capitation for provider payments, commission for broker/agent compensation, adjustment for retroactive changes, or refund for overpayments.
attributes.references: NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual

attributes.name: billing_level
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice is issued at the group (employer), individual (direct member), subscriber (primary member), or dependent level.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The product line or market segment for which the invoice is generated: commercial group plans, Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicaid managed care, individual marketplace (ACA), ASO arrangements, or D-SNP programs.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was generated and issued to the member or group.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the coverage period for which premiums or charges are being billed.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the coverage period for which premiums or charges are being billed.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be received to avoid late fees or coverage termination. Typically includes grace period considerations per ACA and state regulations.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The final date of the grace period during which coverage remains active despite non-payment. ACA marketplace plans require a 90-day grace period for members receiving advance premium tax credits.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date payment was received and posted to the invoice. Null if invoice remains unpaid.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employer group or organization being billed. Applicable for group billing scenarios.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Legal or business name of the employer group or organization being billed.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique member identifier for the primary subscriber (policyholder) associated with this invoice.

attributes.name: subscriber_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the primary subscriber (policyholder) responsible for payment.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for invoice delivery and payment correspondence.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City name for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or territory code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_zip_code
attributes.description: Five or nine-digit postal code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the billing address.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic invoice delivery and payment notifications.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for billing inquiries and payment reminders.

attributes.name: total_amount_due
attributes.description: Total invoice amount including all charges, taxes, fees, and adjustments. This is the final amount the member or group must pay.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium charges for health insurance coverage during the billing period. Calculated based on PMPM or PEPM rates multiplied by enrolled members.

attributes.name: administrative_fee_amount
attributes.description: Administrative services fees charged for ASO arrangements or plan management services.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Late payment penalty charges assessed for payments received after the due date.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Retroactive adjustments to the invoice amount due to enrollment changes, rate corrections, or billing errors. Positive values increase the amount due; negative values decrease it.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discounts applied to the invoice, such as early payment discounts, promotional credits, or negotiated rate reductions.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: Credits applied from previous overpayments, refunds, or account balances that reduce the current invoice amount due.

attributes.name: previous_balance_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding balance carried forward from previous billing periods that remains unpaid.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid against this invoice. May be partial or full payment.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice after applying all payments and credits.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts on the invoice (typically USD for  States operations).

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The interface or channel through which payment was submitted: web portal, mobile app, phone (IVR or agent), mail, in-person, automatic recurring payment, or employer group remittance.

attributes.name: payment_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation or transaction reference number issued when payment is received and processed.

attributes.name: enrolled_member_count
attributes.description: Total number of members (subscribers and dependents) enrolled and covered during the billing period. Used for PMPM premium calculations.

attributes.name: subscriber_count
attributes.description: Number of primary subscribers (policyholders) covered during the billing period.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under subscriber policies during the billing period.

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: Premium rate charged per enrolled member per month. Standard pricing metric in health insurance for calculating total premium charges.

attributes.name: pepm_rate
attributes.description: Premium or administrative fee rate charged per employee per month, commonly used in group billing and ASO arrangements.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the health plan structure: HMO (Health Maintenance Organization), PPO (Preferred Provider Organization), EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization), POS (Point of Service), HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan), Indemnity, Medicare Advantage, or Medicaid Managed Care.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The enrollment tier or family composition category that determines premium rates: individual, individual plus spouse, individual plus children, family, employee only, employee plus one, or employee plus family.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Unique policy identifier for the insurance contract under which coverage is provided.

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance broker or agent associated with the sale and servicing of this policy. Used for commission tracking.

attributes.name: broker_agent_name
attributes.description: Full name of the insurance broker or agent of record for this policy.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission amount payable to the broker or agent for this billing period, typically calculated as a percentage of premium.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to premium to calculate broker or agent commission.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The recurring schedule on which invoices are generated and issued: monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, weekly, or bi-weekly.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic recurring payment is enabled for this invoice. True if auto-pay is active, false otherwise.

attributes.name: paperless_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member or group has opted for electronic invoice delivery only (no paper statements). True if paperless, false if paper delivery is required.

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice includes retroactive adjustments for prior billing periods due to enrollment changes, rate corrections, or billing errors. True if retroactive adjustments are present, false otherwise.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for invoice adjustments: enrollment change, rate correction, billing error, coverage termination, coverage reinstatement, plan change, address correction, payment reversal, or other.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reason for invoice adjustments, providing context beyond the standardized code.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was cancelled or voided. Null if invoice has not been cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for invoice cancellation: billing error, duplicate invoice, coverage terminated, payment received in full, member request, system error, or other.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount refunded to the member or group due to overpayment, cancellation, or retroactive adjustments.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: The date the refund was processed and issued to the member or group. Null if no refund has been issued.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: The method used to issue the refund: check, ACH bank transfer, credit to account balance, credit card reversal, or wire transfer.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the invoice balance written off as uncollectible bad debt.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date the outstanding balance was written off as uncollectible. Null if no write-off has occurred.

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for writing off the invoice balance: bankruptcy, deceased member, unable to locate, small balance waiver, settlement agreement, or other.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: The current collection notice level or stage in the dunning process for overdue invoices. Higher numbers indicate escalated collection efforts (e.g., 1=first reminder, 2=second notice, 3=final notice, 4=collections referral).

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: The date the most recent collection notice or payment reminder was sent for this overdue invoice.

attributes.name: collections_agency_referral_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was referred to an external collections agency for recovery of unpaid balance. Null if not referred to collections.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number for the group or organization being billed. Used for tax reporting and IRS Form 1095 compliance.

attributes.name: form_1095_reporting_flag

attributes.name: marketplace_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the coverage was purchased through a health insurance marketplace: federally facilitated marketplace (FFM), state-based marketplace (SBM), off-exchange (direct purchase), or not applicable (employer-sponsored).

attributes.name: aptc_amount
attributes.description: The amount of advance premium tax credit applied to reduce the member's premium payment for marketplace coverage. Paid directly to the insurer by the federal government.

attributes.name: csr_amount
attributes.description: The amount of cost-sharing reduction subsidy applied to reduce out-of-pocket costs for eligible marketplace members. Reimbursed to the insurer by the federal government.

attributes.name: member_responsibility_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the total premium amount that is the member's financial responsibility after applying employer contributions, subsidies, and tax credits.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the premium paid by the employer on behalf of the employee for group coverage.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The method used to deliver the invoice to the member or group: email, postal mail, web portal access, mobile app notification, fax, or EDI electronic transmission.

attributes.name: sent_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was delivered or made available to the member or group through the specified delivery method.

attributes.name: viewed_date
attributes.description: The date the member or group first accessed and viewed the invoice through electronic channels (web portal or mobile app). Null if not viewed electronically.

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member or group is enrolled in an installment payment plan for this invoice. True if payment plan is active, false otherwise.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment plan or installment agreement associated with this invoice. Null if no payment plan exists.

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: The sequential installment number for invoices that are part of a payment plan (e.g., 1 of 4, 2 of 4). Null if not part of a payment plan.

attributes.name: total_installments
attributes.description: The total number of installments in the payment plan. Null if not part of a payment plan.

attributes.name: billing_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the source billing system that generated this invoice: Facets, QNXT, HealthEdge, Oracle Health Insurance, SAP S/4HANA, or other.

attributes.name: external_invoice_id
attributes.description: Invoice identifier from the source billing system, used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this invoice revenue is posted for financial accounting and reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center or business unit code for internal financial tracking and allocation of revenue.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue from this invoice is recognized in financial statements per GAAP revenue recognition principles.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM format) to which this invoice is assigned for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this invoice belongs for financial reporting and budgeting purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or explanatory notes related to the invoice.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique member identifier for the primary subscriber (policyholder) associated with this invoice.

attributes.name: broker_agent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance broker or agent associated with the sale and servicing of this policy. Used for commission tracking.

attributes.name: commission_plan_id

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_cycle. Business justification: Invoices are generated for billing cycles. Need to link invoices to the billing cycle for batch processing and reconciliation. Cannot remove billing_period dates as they are displayed on invoice.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_method. Business justification: Invoices track payment method. Replace STRING payment_method with proper FK to payment_method reference table. Remove payment_method string as it can be retrieved from payment_method table.

attributes.name: status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_status. Business justification: Invoices have billing status. Replace STRING status with proper FK to billing_status reference table. Remove status string as it can be retrieved from billing_status table.

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Invoices have grace periods. Need to link to the grace period policy for tracking payment deadlines. Cannot remove grace_period_end_date as it is execution-specific value calculated from the policy.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to eligibility.coverage. Business justification: Invoices bill for specific coverage periods. Billing department references coverage daily to determine premium amounts, effective dates, and benefit levels for accurate invoice generation.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Invoices itemize charges by product plan for multi-plan employers or members with supplemental coverage. Required for detailed billing statements and revenue allocation.

attributes.name: request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to authorization.request. Business justification: Invoices for authorized services must reference the authorization request that approved the service. Billing department validates authorization exists before generating invoices to ensure services wer

attributes.name: receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.receivable. Business justification: Every invoice generates an accounts receivable entry in the general ledger. Finance department tracks outstanding receivables for financial reporting and cash flow management daily.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.contract. Business justification: Every invoice is generated under a specific insurance contract (group, individual, Medicare Advantage). Billing department references contract terms daily for premium amounts, coverage periods, and bi

attributes.name: tax_detail_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.tax_detail. Business justification: Invoices must apply correct state/local premium taxes and fees based on member location. Finance and billing departments reference tax details for accurate invoice generation and regulatory remittance

products.name: premium
products.description: Calculated premium amount for a member or group for a billing period, based on plan rates, rating factors, and member attributes.

attributes.name: premium_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the premium record. Primary key for the premium data product.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with this premium calculation.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employer group or organization associated with this premium.

attributes.name: sales_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance policy under which this premium is calculated.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period for which this premium is calculated.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period for which this premium is calculated.

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when insurance coverage begins for this premium period.

attributes.name: coverage_termination_date
attributes.description: The date when insurance coverage ends for this premium period, if applicable.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or market segment for this premium (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid).

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: The internal code identifying the specific benefit plan design.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: The marketing or display name of the benefit plan.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: metal_tier
attributes.description: The ACA metal tier classification for individual and small group plans (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Catastrophic).

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: The financial arrangement type for the group (Fully Insured, ASO, Self-Funded, etc.).

attributes.name: rating_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate premium rates (Community Rated, Experience Rated, Age Banded, etc.).
attributes.references: ACA Rating Rules and State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: rate_basis
attributes.description: The unit basis for premium calculation (PMPM - Per Member Per Month, PEPM - Per Employee Per Month, etc.).

attributes.name: base_premium_amount
attributes.description: The base premium amount before adjustments, surcharges, or discounts.

attributes.name: age_rating_factor
attributes.description: The age-based rating factor applied to the base premium for individual or small group plans.

attributes.name: tobacco_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Additional premium charged for tobacco use, where permitted by state law.

attributes.name: geographic_rating_factor
attributes.description: The geographic area rating factor applied based on member location.

attributes.name: family_tier
attributes.description: The coverage tier indicating who is covered under the policy (Employee Only, Family, etc.).

attributes.name: family_tier_factor
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to base premium based on family tier coverage.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: The risk adjustment factor based on member health status and HCC scores, used primarily in Medicare Advantage.

attributes.name: hcc_score
attributes.description: The member's HCC risk score reflecting chronic conditions and expected healthcare costs.

attributes.name: wellness_discount_amount
attributes.description: Premium discount applied for participation in wellness programs.

attributes.name: group_discount_amount
attributes.description: Premium discount applied based on group size or favorable claims experience.

attributes.name: subsidy_amount
attributes.description: Government subsidy or premium tax credit amount applied to reduce member premium (e.g., ACA APTC).

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The portion of premium paid by the employer on behalf of the employee.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The portion of premium paid by the employee through payroll deduction or direct payment.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: The total calculated premium amount for the billing period after all adjustments, surcharges, and discounts.

attributes.name: member_responsibility_amount
attributes.description: The total amount the member is responsible to pay (employee contribution minus subsidies).

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Premium adjustment amount applied retroactively due to coverage changes, corrections, or reconciliations.

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_reason
attributes.description: The reason for the retroactive premium adjustment.

attributes.name: retroactive_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period affected by the retroactive adjustment.

attributes.name: retroactive_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period affected by the retroactive adjustment.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: The current payment status of the premium (Pending, Paid, Overdue, Grace Period, etc.).

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the premium payment is due.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date when the premium payment was received.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the premium payment was submitted (Web Portal, Mobile App, Phone, etc.).

attributes.name: grace_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the grace period for late premium payment.
attributes.references: ACA Grace Period Requirements (90 days for subsidized plans)

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the grace period after which coverage may be terminated for non-payment.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which premiums are billed (Monthly, Quarterly, Annual, etc.).

attributes.name: billing_type
attributes.description: The type of billing arrangement (List Bill, Self Bill, Direct Bill, etc.).

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the premium invoice was generated.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the premium amount (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The currency exchange rate applied if premium is calculated in a non-base currency.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: The commission amount payable to brokers or agents for this premium.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The commission rate percentage applied to calculate broker or agent commission.

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the broker or agent associated with this premium.

attributes.name: administrative_fee_amount
attributes.description: Administrative fee charged for plan management, typically in ASO arrangements.

attributes.name: stop_loss_premium_amount
attributes.description: Premium amount for stop-loss insurance coverage in self-funded arrangements.

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium_amount
attributes.description: Premium amount ceded to reinsurance carriers for risk transfer.

attributes.name: medical_loss_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of claims and quality improvement expenses to premium revenue, used for ACA rebate calculations.

attributes.name: mlr_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Rebate amount owed to member or group if MLR thresholds are not met.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount applied to the premium (e.g., state premium tax, federal fees).
attributes.references: State Premium Tax Regulations and ACA Health Insurance Tax

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The tax rate percentage applied to calculate premium taxes.

attributes.name: coverage_level
attributes.description: The level of coverage provided (Individual, Family, Group, etc.).

attributes.name: member_age
attributes.description: The age of the member at the time of premium calculation, used for age-based rating.

attributes.name: member_gender
attributes.description: The gender of the member. Note: ACA prohibits gender-based rating for most plans.

attributes.name: member_zip_code
attributes.description: The ZIP code of the member's primary residence, used for geographic rating.

attributes.name: rating_area
attributes.description: The geographic rating area code used for premium calculation under ACA rules.

attributes.name: tobacco_use_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member uses tobacco products, affecting premium surcharges.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The source or channel through which the member enrolled (Open Enrollment, Special Enrollment, etc.).

attributes.name: marketplace_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan was purchased through a federal or state health insurance marketplace.

attributes.name: subsidy_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for premium subsidies or tax credits.
attributes.references: ACA Premium Tax Credit Eligibility Rules

attributes.name: cost_sharing_reduction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for cost-sharing reductions under ACA.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The date when the premium was calculated.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this premium amount becomes effective.

attributes.name: rate_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the rate table used for premium calculation.

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the rate table used for this premium calculation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the premium record (Active, Pending, Cancelled, etc.).

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date when the premium was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason for premium cancellation.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The amount refunded to the member or group due to overpayment or cancellation.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: The date when the premium refund was processed.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The premium amount written off as uncollectible.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date when the premium amount was written off.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM) to which this premium is assigned for financial reporting.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date when the premium revenue is recognized in financial statements.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account

attributes.name: cost_center

attributes.name: product_line

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this premium record in the source system.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the premium calculation was performed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this premium record was last modified.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with this premium calculation.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance policy under which this premium is calculated.

attributes.name: rate_id

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_method. Business justification: Premiums track payment method used. Replace STRING payment_method with proper FK to payment_method reference table. Remove payment_method string as it can be retrieved from payment_method table.

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Premiums have grace periods. Need to link to the grace period policy for tracking payment deadlines. Cannot remove grace_period dates as they are execution-specific values calculated from the policy.

products.name: premium_rate
products.description: Master table of rate schedules for different plan types, tiers, and rating factors used in premium calculations.

attributes.name: premium_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the premium rate record. Primary key for the premium rate master table.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the rate schedule. Used for rate lookup and premium calculation processes.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business to which this rate applies, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual, or Group coverage.
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, NAIC Market Segment Standards

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health plan for which the rate applies, including Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), or Special Needs Plan (SNP) variants.
attributes.references: ACA Plan Type Standards, CMS Medicare Advantage Plan Types

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the specific insurance product offering to which this rate applies.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the insurance product for business user identification and member communication.

attributes.name: rating_area_code
attributes.description: Geographic rating area code used for location-based premium rating as defined by state insurance regulations and ACA requirements.
attributes.references: ACA Rating Area Standards, State Insurance Department Geographic Rating Rules

attributes.name: age_band
attributes.description: Age range bracket used for age-based premium rating, typically expressed as ranges such as 18-24, 25-29, 30-34, or 65+.
attributes.references: ACA Age Rating Standards, CMS Medicare Age Band Requirements

attributes.name: tobacco_use_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rate applies to tobacco users or non-tobacco users, as tobacco use is a permitted rating factor under ACA.

attributes.name: rate_amount
attributes.description: The premium rate amount for the specified rating factors. This is the base rate used in premium calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards, State Insurance Department Rate Approval Requirements

attributes.name: rate_basis
attributes.description: The time period basis for the rate amount, such as Per Member Per Month (PMPM), Per Employee Per Month (PEPM), Annual, Monthly, Quarterly, or Semi-Annual.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rating methodology used, such as Base Rate, Composite Rate, Age-Rated, Tier-Rated, Experience-Rated, Community-Rated, or Adjusted Community-Rated.
attributes.references: NAIC Rating Methodology Standards, ACA Community Rating Requirements

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this premium rate expires and is no longer valid for new premium calculations. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: rate_filing_number
attributes.description: The regulatory filing number assigned by the state insurance department or CMS for this rate schedule, used for compliance tracking and audit purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards, State Insurance Department Filing Requirements

attributes.name: rate_filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rate filing was submitted to the regulatory authority for approval.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards, State Insurance Department Filing Requirements

attributes.name: rate_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rate filing was approved by the regulatory authority, allowing the rates to be used.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards, State Insurance Department Approval Process

attributes.name: rate_approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the rate filing, indicating whether rates are pending, approved, rejected, withdrawn, or under review.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards, State Insurance Department Approval Process

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code indicating the state jurisdiction for which this rate applies, as rates are often state-specific due to regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC State Code Standards, ANSI INCITS 38 State Codes

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: County FIPS code for county-level rating granularity where applicable, used in geographic rating methodologies.
attributes.references: FIPS County Code Standards, ACA Rating Area Requirements

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit ZIP code for ZIP-level rating granularity where applicable, used in geographic rating methodologies.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standards, ACA Rating Area Requirements

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The provider network tier to which this rate applies, such as Tier 1, Tier 2, Standard, Premium, Narrow, or Broad network configurations.

attributes.name: benefit_design_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific benefit design configuration associated with this rate, linking rates to benefit structures.

attributes.name: metal_level
attributes.description: ACA metal level classification indicating the actuarial value of the plan: Bronze (60%), Silver (70%), Gold (80%), Platinum (90%), or Catastrophic.

attributes.name: actuarial_value
attributes.description: The percentage of total average costs for covered benefits that the plan will cover, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.70 for 70% actuarial value).

attributes.name: rate_guarantee_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which the rate is guaranteed not to change, commonly used in group contracts.

attributes.name: minimum_group_size
attributes.description: The minimum number of eligible employees or members required for this rate to apply, used in group rating methodologies.
attributes.references: State Small Group Market Standards, ACA Small Group Definitions

attributes.name: participation_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of eligible employees that must enroll for the group to qualify for this rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 for 75%).

attributes.name: contribution_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of premium that the employer must contribute for the group to qualify for this rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.50 for 50%).
attributes.references: State Group Insurance Contribution Standards, ACA Employer Mandate Requirements

attributes.name: industry_code
attributes.description: NAICS or SIC industry classification code used for industry-based rating adjustments in experience-rated or composite-rated groups.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit SIC code for industry classification, used in legacy systems for industry-based rating.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Risk adjustment factor applied to the base rate to account for member health status and risk profile, commonly used in Medicare Advantage and ACA risk adjustment.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, ACA Risk Adjustment Standards

attributes.name: hcc_score
attributes.description: HCC risk score used in Medicare Advantage risk adjustment to adjust premium rates based on member diagnoses and health conditions.

attributes.name: gender_rating_factor
attributes.description: Rating factor based on gender, where permitted by state law. Note: ACA prohibits gender rating in individual and small group markets.
attributes.references: State Insurance Rating Laws, ACA Gender Rating Prohibition

attributes.name: family_size_factor
attributes.description: Rating factor based on family size for family coverage tiers, used to adjust rates based on the number of covered dependents.

attributes.name: geographic_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Factor applied to adjust rates based on geographic cost variations, reflecting differences in healthcare costs across regions.
attributes.references: CMS Geographic Adjustment Standards, Internal Geographic Rating Methodology

attributes.name: wellness_program_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the premium rate for participation in wellness programs, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.10 for 10% discount).
attributes.references: ACA Wellness Program Standards, HIPAA Wellness Program Rules

attributes.name: rate_increase_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage increase from the previous rate version, used for rate change tracking and regulatory reporting, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5% increase).
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards, ACA Rate Review Requirements

attributes.name: medical_trend_factor
attributes.description: Factor representing expected medical cost trend used in rate development, reflecting anticipated increases in healthcare costs.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice, NAIC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: pharmacy_trend_factor
attributes.description: Factor representing expected pharmacy cost trend used in rate development, reflecting anticipated increases in prescription drug costs.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice, NAIC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: administrative_cost_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of premium allocated to administrative costs, used in rate development and Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) calculations, expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: ACA MLR Standards, NAIC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: profit_margin_percentage
attributes.description: Target profit margin percentage included in the premium rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.03 for 3% margin).
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Requirements, Internal Financial Standards

attributes.name: commission_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of premium allocated for broker or agent commissions, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5% commission).
attributes.references: State Insurance Commission Standards, Internal Compensation Standards

attributes.name: rate_manual_reference

attributes.name: rate_status

attributes.name: projection_period_months

attributes.name: agreement_id

attributes.name: benefit_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.benefit_design. Business justification: Government program premium rates are directly tied to approved benefit designs (Medicare Advantage plans, Medicaid managed care). Rating engine uses this to calculate compliant premiums.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_id

attributes.name: billing_rule_id

products.name: cycle
products.description: Definition of billing cycle frequencies (monthly, quarterly, annual) and associated start/end dates.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing cycle record. Primary key for the billing cycle entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the billing cycle for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the billing cycle for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: The recurrence pattern of the billing cycle indicating how often billing occurs (monthly, quarterly, annual, etc.).

attributes.name: frequency_interval
attributes.description: Numeric value representing the interval count for the billing frequency (e.g., 1 for monthly, 3 for quarterly).

attributes.name: start_date
