attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the billing cycle period ends. Used to determine coverage period for premium calculation.

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: The date when invoices or premium statements are generated and issued to members or groups for this billing cycle.

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: grace_period_days

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the billing cycle indicating whether it is active, closed, pending processing, cancelled, or suspended.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The insurance product line or business segment to which this billing cycle applies (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace, ASO, Individual).

attributes.name: billing_type

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate premiums for this billing cycle (Per Member Per Month, Per Employee Per Month, flat rate, tiered, usage-based).

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: The premium rate charged per member per month for this billing cycle. Used in capitation and individual billing calculations.

attributes.name: pepm_rate

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: The total premium amount calculated for this billing cycle before adjustments, representing the gross revenue expected.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of retroactive adjustments applied to this billing cycle due to eligibility changes, rate corrections, or other modifications.

attributes.name: net_premium_amount
attributes.description: The net premium amount for this billing cycle after all adjustments, representing the actual amount billed to the customer.

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: fee_amount

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: The total amount billed to the customer for this billing cycle, including net premium, taxes, and fees.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: member_count

attributes.name: employee_count

attributes.name: subscriber_count
attributes.description: Total number of primary subscribers (policyholders) in this billing cycle, excluding dependents.

attributes.name: dependent_count

attributes.name: retroactive_flag

attributes.name: retroactive_period_end_date

attributes.name: payment_channel

attributes.name: auto_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this billing cycle, allowing for automated premium collection.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Unique invoice or statement number generated for this billing cycle, used for payment reconciliation and customer reference.

attributes.name: invoice_generation_date
attributes.description: The date when the invoice or premium statement was generated for this billing cycle.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: The method by which the invoice or premium statement is delivered to the customer (email, mail, portal, electronic, paper).

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date when payment for this billing cycle was received and posted to the account.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount of payment received for this billing cycle, which may differ from the billed amount due to partial payments or overpayments.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance for this billing cycle after applying received payments, representing accounts receivable.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the billing cycle indicating whether it is paid in full, partially paid, unpaid, overdue, refunded, or written off.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount

attributes.name: late_fee_applied_flag

attributes.name: commission_amount

attributes.name: commission_rate

attributes.name: aso_admin_fee

attributes.name: capitation_amount

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_amount

attributes.name: subsidy_amount

attributes.name: reinsurance_amount

attributes.name: mlr_applicable_flag

attributes.name: mlr_rebate_amount

attributes.name: billing_run_id

attributes.name: billing_run_timestamp

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this billing cycle, used to document special circumstances, adjustments, or customer communications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing cycle record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing cycle record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing cycle was closed and finalized, preventing further modifications.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this billing cycle in the source operational system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: billing_rule_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.discount_application. Business justification: Adjustments may reference discount applications, such as when correcting or reversing a discount. This FK links adjustments to the discounts they modify.

products.name: write_off
products.description: Write-off entries for uncollectible amounts, with justification, amount, and date of write-off.

attributes.name: write_off_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the write-off entry. Primary key for the write-off data product.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with the write-off. Used when write-off is related to individual member premium or cost-sharing amounts.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The employer or group identifier for group billing write-offs. Used to track write-offs at the group level for Administrative Services Only (ASO) or fully insured group accounts.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The insurance policy number associated with the write-off. Identifies the specific health insurance policy contract.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business category for the write-off. Indicates the product type and regulatory framework governing the premium billing and write-off treatment.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: The date when the write-off was officially recorded in the financial system. This is the accounting date for the write-off transaction.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount being written off as uncollectible. Represents the reduction in accounts receivable for premium billing or other revenue.

attributes.name: original_billed_amount
attributes.description: The original amount that was billed before the write-off. Provides context for the magnitude of the write-off relative to the initial receivable.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The remaining balance on the account after the write-off is applied. May be zero if the entire balance is written off, or positive if partial write-off.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the write-off. Used for categorization and reporting of write-off causes.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Policy and NAIC Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the reason for the write-off. Provides business justification and context for the uncollectible determination.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the write-off type. Groups write-offs into major categories for financial reporting and analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310 and NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the write-off request. Indicates whether the write-off has been authorized per internal financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls and Segregation of Duties

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who approved the write-off. Required for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the write-off was approved by the authorized approver. Part of the audit trail for financial controls.

attributes.name: requested_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who initiated the write-off request. Establishes accountability for the write-off initiation.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date when the write-off was requested. Tracks the timeline from request to approval to posting.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period for which the write-off applies. Used to associate write-offs with specific coverage periods.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period for which the write-off applies. Defines the coverage period associated with the uncollectible premium.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The original due date for the payment that is being written off. Used to calculate aging and determine grace period expiration.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the grace period for premium payment expired. Relevant for ACA marketplace plans with 90-day grace periods and other products with grace period provisions.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of days the payment was overdue at the time of write-off. Used for aging analysis and bad debt reserve calculations.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: The accounts receivable aging category at the time of write-off. Classifies receivables by how long they have been outstanding.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310 and NAIC Statutory Accounting

attributes.name: collection_attempts
attributes.description: The number of collection attempts made before the write-off. Documents collection efforts for regulatory compliance and internal policy adherence.

attributes.name: last_collection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent collection attempt before write-off. Demonstrates due diligence in collection efforts.

attributes.name: collection_agency
attributes.description: The name of the third-party collection agency used, if applicable. Tracks external collection efforts before write-off determination.

attributes.name: sent_to_collections_date
attributes.description: The date when the account was sent to a collection agency. Part of the collection timeline documentation.

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off is due to member or group bankruptcy filing. Bankruptcy write-offs have specific legal and accounting treatment.
attributes.references: US Bankruptcy Code and GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: bankruptcy_case_number
attributes.description: The court case number for the bankruptcy filing, if applicable. Required for legal documentation and potential recovery tracking.

attributes.name: bankruptcy_filing_date
attributes.description: The date when the bankruptcy was filed. Establishes the legal timeline for write-off and potential recovery.

attributes.name: deceased_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off is due to member death. Deceased member write-offs follow specific policy and regulatory guidelines.

attributes.name: date_of_death
attributes.description: The date of member death, if applicable. Used to determine coverage termination and write-off eligibility for outstanding premiums.
attributes.references: State Vital Records and Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: policy_termination_date
attributes.description: The date when the insurance policy was terminated. Relevant for write-offs related to policy cancellations and coverage lapses.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations and Policy Contract Terms

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for policy termination. Provides context for write-offs related to coverage cessation.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off has been reversed. Write-offs may be reversed if payment is subsequently received or if the write-off was made in error.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310 and Internal Financial Policy

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date when the write-off was reversed, if applicable. Part of the audit trail for write-off adjustments.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of why the write-off was reversed. Documents the business justification for the reversal transaction.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: The amount recovered after write-off, if any. Tracks post-write-off collections for bad debt recovery reporting.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: The date when a recovery payment was received after write-off. Used for bad debt recovery accounting and reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_number
attributes.description: The general ledger account number to which the write-off is posted. Links the write-off to the chart of accounts for financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP and NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center or department code responsible for the write-off. Used for internal management reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or division associated with the write-off. Enables write-off analysis by organizational segment.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: The geographic region where the write-off originated. Used for regional performance analysis and regulatory reporting by state or market.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state code where the policy or account is domiciled. Required for state-level regulatory reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: tax_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off has tax implications. Bad debt write-offs may be tax-deductible under certain conditions.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The tax year in which the write-off is claimed for tax purposes. May differ from the accounting period due to tax timing rules.

attributes.name: mlr_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off impacts Medical Loss Ratio calculations. Premium write-offs affect MLR numerator and denominator calculations for ACA compliance.

attributes.name: aca_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off must be included in ACA regulatory reporting. Marketplace and individual market write-offs have specific reporting requirements.

attributes.name: cms_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reporting Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off must be reported to CMS. Medicare Advantage and Part D write-offs have specific CMS reporting requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off affects risk adjustment calculations. Premium write-offs for Medicare Advantage or ACA marketplace plans may impact risk adjustment payments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes or comments about the write-off. Provides supplementary context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which the write-off record originated. Identifies whether the write-off came from Facets, QNXT, Oracle Health Insurance, or other billing systems.

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the write-off record in the source system. Enables traceability back to the originating system for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the write-off was posted to the general ledger. May differ from write-off date due to period-end closing processes.
attributes.references: GAAP and Internal Financial Close Procedures

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (e.g., 2024-01, Q1-2024) in which the write-off is recorded. Used for period-based financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the write-off is recorded. Enables year-over-year write-off trend analysis.

attributes.name: journal_entry_number
attributes.description: The journal entry number in the general ledger system for the write-off transaction. Links the write-off to the financial accounting entry.

attributes.name: auto_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account was enrolled in automatic payment at the time of write-off. Auto-pay accounts typically have lower write-off rates.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member or group disputed the charges before write-off. Disputed amounts may require special handling and documentation.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations and Internal Appeals Process

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date when the dispute was resolved, if applicable. Part of the timeline for disputed write-offs.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations and Internal Appeals Process

attributes.name: cob_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off is related to coordination of benefits issues. COB write-offs occur when primary coverage determination affects premium liability.

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off is related to a retroactive premium adjustment. Retroactive changes in eligibility or coverage can create write-off situations.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations and Policy Contract Terms

attributes.name: subsidy_amount
attributes.description: The amount of premium subsidy (e.g., ACA Advanced Premium Tax Credit) associated with the written-off premium. Relevant for marketplace plans.
attributes.references: ACA Premium Tax Credit Requirements 26 USC 36B

attributes.name: subsidy_reconciliation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off affects premium subsidy reconciliation. Marketplace write-offs may trigger subsidy recapture or adjustment processes.
attributes.references: ACA Premium Tax Credit Reconciliation 26 USC 36B

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with the write-off. Used when write-off is related to individual member premium or cost-sharing amounts.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Write-offs are recorded against billing accounts for uncollectible amounts. Replace STRING account number with proper FK. Remove account_number as it can be retrieved from billing_account.

attributes.name: invoice_id

attributes.name: cycle_id

attributes.name: grace_period_id

attributes.name: authorization_denial_reason_id

Finance and compliance teams use this to categorize write-offs, track denial patterns, and ensure write-o

attributes.name: enrollment_id

attributes.name: investigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.investigation. Business justification: Write-offs from unrecoverable fraud losses must link to investigations for financial reporting, loss tracking, and demonstrating recovery efforts to regulators and auditors.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Write-offs must comply with regulatory policies governing bad debt treatment, grace period requirements, and member liability limits. Finance teams validate each write-off against applicable state and

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Write-offs of uncollectible premiums require journal entries to reduce receivables and record bad debt expense. Finance posts these for accurate financial statements and MLR reporting.

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.retroactive_adjustment. Business justification: Write-offs may be related to retroactive adjustments, such as when a retroactive adjustment results in an uncollectible amount. This FK supports tracking the relationship.

attributes.name: premium_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium. Business justification: Write-offs are applied to specific premiums that are deemed uncollectible. This FK links write-offs to the premium calculations they affect.
