attributes.name: adjustment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the retroactive adjustment becomes effective, typically within the original billing period.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member whose coverage or premium is being adjusted retroactively.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the primary subscriber or policyholder responsible for the premium payment being adjusted.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net financial impact of the retroactive adjustment, calculated as the difference between adjusted and original premium amounts. Positive values indicate additional charges; negative values indicate credits.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_cycle. Business justification: Retroactive adjustments reference original billing cycles. Need to link to the cycle being adjusted for proper accounting. Cannot remove billing_period dates as they represent the original period bein

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_method. Business justification: Retroactive adjustments track payment method. Replace STRING payment_method with proper FK to payment_method reference table. Remove payment_method string as it can be retrieved from payment_method ta

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Retroactive adjustments track grace period. Need to link to the grace period policy for adjustment validation. Cannot remove grace_period_end_date as it is execution-specific value.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim. Business justification: Retroactive adjustments frequently originate from claim reprocessing due to eligibility changes, coordination of benefits updates, or appeals. Billing operations require direct claim linkage for audit

attributes.name: history_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to eligibility.eligibility_history. Business justification: Retroactive adjustments are triggered by eligibility changes. Billing operations reference eligibility history to recalculate premiums when coverage dates or benefit levels change retroactively.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Retroactive adjustments require exact plan version to recalculate premiums accurately for past periods when plan terms, rates, or benefits were different.

attributes.name: plan_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.plan_enrollment. Business justification: Retroactive adjustments occur when enrollment changes are backdated (e.g., dependent added retroactively). Billing must reference the enrollment to recalculate premiums for past periods.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.amendment. Business justification: Retroactive billing adjustments are triggered by contract amendments (e.g., rate changes, coverage changes). Billing must adjust prior invoices when contracts are amended retroactively.

attributes.name: program_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_eligibility. Business justification: Retroactive eligibility changes from Medicaid/Medicare require billing adjustments for prior months. Operations processes these weekly when government updates member eligibility retroactively.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Retroactive premium adjustments (enrollment changes, rate corrections) require journal entries to correct revenue in prior periods. Finance uses these for accurate revenue recognition and audit trails

attributes.name: appeal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.appeal. Business justification: Retroactive billing adjustments often result from successful member appeals (coverage disputes, eligibility corrections). Appeals and billing departments coordinate to apply approved adjustments to me

attributes.name: discount_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.discount_application. Business justification: Retroactive adjustments may affect discounts, such as applying a discount retroactively. This FK links retroactive adjustments to discount applications.

products.name: account
products.description: Master record for the entity responsible for premium payments (member or group), includes balance, status, and billing preferences.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing account entity responsible for premium payments.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique account number assigned to the billing entity for premium payment tracking and customer service reference.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Health Insurance

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account indicating whether it is an individual member account, employer group account, Administrative Services Only (ASO) arrangement, or other billing structure.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The legal or business name of the entity responsible for premium payments (individual member name or employer group name).

attributes.name: status_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the current account status (e.g., non-payment, voluntary termination, employer group cancellation).

attributes.name: status_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of the reason for the current billing account status.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or market segment to which this billing account belongs (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR 422, State Medicaid Regulations

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: The financial arrangement structure indicating how the employer or group funds healthcare benefits (fully insured risk transfer vs. self-funded employer risk retention).

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The recurring interval at which premium invoices are generated and payment is expected for this billing account.

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which premium billing is executed (e.g., list bill where carrier invoices employer, self-bill where employer calculates and remits, direct bill to individual members).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The contractual terms specifying when premium payment is due relative to the invoice date or coverage period.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after the premium due date during which coverage remains active despite non-payment, as required by regulation or contract.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The net outstanding balance on the billing account representing total charges minus payments and adjustments. Positive values indicate amounts owed; negative values indicate credit balances.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The total amount of unpaid premium charges currently due and payable on the billing account.

attributes.name: past_due_balance
attributes.description: The portion of the outstanding balance that is overdue beyond the payment terms and grace period.

attributes.name: credit_balance
attributes.description: The amount of overpayment or credit available on the billing account that can be applied to future premium charges.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which premium amounts are denominated and billed.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Social Security Number (SSN) used for tax reporting and IRS Form 1095 generation.

attributes.name: billing_address_line_1
attributes.description: The primary street address line where premium invoices and billing correspondence are sent.
attributes.references: USPS Address Standards, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: billing_address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, apartment, or building information for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: The city name component of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state or province code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: The ZIP or postal code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person responsible for billing and payment matters for this account.

attributes.name: billing_contact_phone
attributes.description: The primary phone number for the billing contact person.

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address for the billing contact person where electronic invoices and payment notifications are sent.

attributes.name: electronic_invoice_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the account holder has opted to receive invoices electronically rather than via postal mail.

attributes.name: auto_pay_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this billing account.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules, Payment Processing Standards

attributes.name: paperless_billing_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the account holder has enrolled in paperless billing to receive all billing communications electronically.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: The current stage in the collections process indicating the number and severity of payment reminders sent (0=current, 1=first notice, 5=final notice before termination).

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent premium payment was received and posted to the billing account.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the most recent premium payment received.

attributes.name: next_invoice_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which the next premium invoice will be generated for this billing account.

attributes.name: next_payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next premium payment must be received to avoid late fees or grace period activation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the billing account was established and became active for premium billing.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the billing account was terminated and premium billing ceased.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for billing account termination (e.g., non-payment, voluntary cancellation, employer group termination, death).

attributes.name: termination_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of the reason for billing account termination.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously terminated or suspended billing account was reinstated to active status.

attributes.name: premium_calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate premium amounts for this billing account (Per Member Per Month, Per Employee Per Month, composite rates, age-banded rates, etc.).
attributes.references: ACA Rating Rules, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: rate_guarantee_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which the current premium rates are guaranteed without increase, as specified in the group contract.

attributes.name: rate_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which premium rates are scheduled for renewal or renegotiation.

attributes.name: minimum_participation_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of eligible employees that must enroll in coverage for a group billing account to remain active, as required by underwriting rules.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of premium costs that the employer contributes on behalf of employees for group billing accounts.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of premium costs that employees are responsible for paying through payroll deduction or direct payment.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of premium revenue paid as commission to brokers or agents for this billing account.
attributes.references: Broker Agreement Terms, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: administrative_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fixed or variable administrative fee charged for Administrative Services Only (ASO) arrangements or other self-funded billing accounts.

attributes.name: stop_loss_premium_amount
attributes.description: The premium amount charged for stop-loss insurance coverage that protects self-funded employers from catastrophic claims.

attributes.name: cobra_premium_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Premium Percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the full premium amount (typically 102%) that COBRA continuation coverage participants must pay.

attributes.name: subsidy_amount
attributes.description: The amount of premium tax credit or other subsidy applied to reduce the net premium owed by the account holder (applicable to Marketplace/Exchange plans).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1401 Premium Tax Credits, IRS Publication 974

attributes.name: subsidy_eligibility_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the billing account is eligible for premium subsidies or tax credits.

attributes.name: payment_plan_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the account holder is enrolled in an installment payment plan for past due balances.

attributes.name: payment_plan_installment_amount
attributes.description: The fixed amount due for each installment payment under an active payment plan arrangement.

attributes.name: late_payment_fee_amount
attributes.description: The standard fee assessed when premium payment is received after the due date and grace period.

attributes.name: returned_payment_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee assessed when a payment is returned due to insufficient funds or other payment processing failures.

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the billing account has pending or recent retroactive premium adjustments due to enrollment changes, rate corrections, or other backdated modifications.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current status of premium reconciliation activities comparing billed amounts to enrollment records and payments received.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent premium reconciliation process was completed for this billing account.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_day
attributes.description: The day of the month on which recurring premium invoices are generated for this billing account.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: The method by which premium invoices are delivered to the account holder.

attributes.name: statement_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which detailed account statements summarizing charges, payments, and balances are provided to the account holder.

attributes.name: parent_account_number
attributes.description: The account number of the parent billing account for hierarchical account structures (e.g., subsidiary companies under a master corporate account).

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level in the account hierarchy structure where this billing account resides (0=master, 1=subsidiary, 2=division, etc.).

attributes.name: consolidated_billing_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account receives consolidated invoices that combine charges from multiple subsidiary accounts or divisions.

attributes.name: broker_npi
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier assigned to the insurance broker or agency servicing this billing account.

attributes.name: broker_commission_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether broker commissions are payable on premiums collected for this billing account.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: The four-digit SIC code representing the primary industry classification of the employer group for this billing account.
attributes.references: US SIC Manual, OSHA Industry Classification

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: The six-digit NAICS code representing the primary industry classification of the employer group for underwriting and risk assessment.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: The total number of employees in the employer group associated with this billing account, used for group size classification and rating.
attributes.references: ACA Employer Mandate, Small Group Market Definition

attributes.name: enrolled_member_count
attributes.description: The current number of members enrolled and actively covered under this billing account.

attributes.name: subscriber_count
attributes.description: The number of primary subscribers (employees or individual policyholders) associated with this billing account, excluding dependents.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: The number of dependent members (spouses, children, etc.) covered under this billing account.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: The calculated risk score for the billing account population used for premium rating and risk adjustment in Medicare Advantage and other risk-adjusted programs.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, HCC Coding

attributes.name: medical_loss_ratio
attributes.description: The percentage of premium revenue spent on medical claims and quality improvement activities for this billing account, used for MLR rebate calculations.

attributes.name: mlr_rebate_eligible_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) Rebate Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this billing account is eligible to receive MLR rebates if the carrier's MLR falls below regulatory thresholds.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2718, CMS MLR Rebate Rules

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the master group insurance contract or policy associated with this billing account.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The unique policy number assigned to individual insurance policies associated with this billing account.

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the current plan year for this billing account, used for benefit year tracking and renewal processing.
attributes.references: ERISA Plan Year Definition, ACA Regulations

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the current plan year for this billing account.
attributes.references: ERISA Plan Year Definition, ACA Regulations

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: The current status of the contract renewal process for this billing account.

attributes.name: special_billing_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field containing any special instructions or notes regarding billing, invoicing, or payment processing for this account.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing account record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing account record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_method. Business justification: Billing accounts have default payment methods. Replace STRING payment_method with proper FK to payment_method reference table. Remove payment_method string as it can be retrieved from payment_method t

attributes.name: status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_status. Business justification: Billing accounts have status. Replace STRING status with proper FK to billing_status reference table. Remove status string as it can be retrieved from billing_status table.

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Billing accounts have grace period policies. Need to link to the grace period definition for the account. Cannot remove grace_period_days as it may be account-specific override.

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.broker. Business justification: Billing accounts for broker-sold policies must track which broker sold the policy for commission attribution and customer service routing. Critical for broker commission calculations and account owner

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.sla. Business justification: Large group billing accounts have contractual SLAs for billing accuracy, invoice delivery, and payment processing. Account management and billing operations monitor SLA compliance for enterprise clien

attributes.name: premium_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_rate. Business justification: Billing accounts use specific premium rates for calculating premiums. This FK links billing accounts to the premium rate schedules that apply to them.

attributes.name: billing_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_rule. Business justification: Billing accounts are governed by billing rules that define grace periods, late fees, discounts, and other account-level business logic. This FK links billing accounts to their governing rules.

products.name: status
products.description: Standard status codes for invoices and accounts (e.g., pending, paid, overdue, cancelled, on hold).

attributes.name: status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing status code. Primary key for the billing status reference data.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the billing status (e.g., PEND, PAID, OVRD, CNCL, HOLD). Used for system processing and integration.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards, Internal Billing System Standards

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the billing status (e.g., Pending, Paid, Overdue, Cancelled, On Hold).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the billing status, including business rules and conditions under which this status applies.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the billing status (e.g., invoice status, account status, payment status, adjustment status, collection status).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing status code is currently active and available for use in billing operations.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices or accounts with this status are considered billable and eligible for payment collection.

attributes.name: is_collectible
attributes.description: Indicates whether amounts with this status are eligible for collection activities and accounts receivable (AR) management.

attributes.name: is_reversible
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions with this status can be reversed or adjusted through standard billing processes.

attributes.name: is_final
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status represents a final state in the billing lifecycle with no further status transitions expected.

attributes.name: requires_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status requires payment action from the member or group to resolve.

attributes.name: allows_grace_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices or accounts with this status are eligible for grace period provisions before termination or penalty.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, ACA Grace Period Requirements

attributes.name: triggers_termination
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing status can trigger member coverage termination or account closure if not resolved.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, Internal Termination Policy

attributes.name: triggers_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status triggers automated member or group notifications (e.g., payment reminders, overdue notices).

attributes.name: impacts_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing status affects member eligibility for healthcare services and benefits.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations

attributes.name: impacts_claims
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing status affects claims processing, adjudication, or payment for the associated member or group.

attributes.name: aging_category
attributes.description: Aging bucket classification for accounts receivable associated with this billing status, used for AR reporting and collection prioritization.
attributes.references: GAAP Accounting Standards, Internal AR Management Policy

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Escalation level for collection activities associated with this billing status (0 = no dunning, 1-5 = increasing urgency).

attributes.name: payment_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for payment collection efforts associated with this billing status.

attributes.name: accounting_treatment
attributes.description: Accounting treatment classification for revenue and receivables associated with this billing status (e.g., recognized as receivable, deferred, written off, reserved).
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards, SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_status
attributes.description: Revenue recognition status for premiums and fees associated with this billing status, per GAAP accounting standards.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: mlr_inclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether premiums associated with this billing status are included in Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) calculations for ACA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2718, CMS MLR Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: line_of_business_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lines of business where this billing status is applicable (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, ASO).

attributes.name: product_type_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product types where this billing status applies (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, ASO).

attributes.name: billing_frequency_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of billing frequencies where this status applies (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annual, semi-annual).

attributes.name: customer_segment_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer segments where this billing status applies (e.g., large_group, small_group, individual, government).

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence for ordering billing status codes in user interfaces, reports, and dropdown lists.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing status code became effective and available for use in billing operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing status code expires and is no longer available for new billing transactions. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing status code definition was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this billing status code definition, used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that originated or maintains this billing status code (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Oracle Health Insurance).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Original status code from the source system, preserved for mapping and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: external_code
attributes.description: Code used for external system integration and EDI transactions (e.g., 837, 835 transaction status codes).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_code
attributes.description: Code used for regulatory reporting to CMS, state departments of insurance, and other governing bodies.
attributes.references: CMS Reporting Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: parent_status_code
attributes.description: Code of the parent billing status in a hierarchical status structure, if applicable. Null for top-level statuses.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Level in the billing status hierarchy (1 = top level, 2+ = sub-levels). Used for hierarchical reporting and rollup.

attributes.name: workflow_stage
attributes.description: Stage in the billing workflow lifecycle where this status typically occurs (e.g., initiation, processing, review, approval, payment, completion).

attributes.name: next_status_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of billing status codes that can follow this status in the billing workflow state machine.

attributes.name: previous_status_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of billing status codes that can precede this status in the billing workflow state machine.

attributes.name: auto_transition_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status can automatically transition to another status based on system rules (e.g., pending to overdue after grace period).

attributes.name: auto_transition_days
attributes.description: Number of days after which this status automatically transitions to the next status, if auto-transition is enabled.

attributes.name: auto_transition_target_status
attributes.description: Target billing status code for automatic transition when auto-transition conditions are met.

attributes.name: manual_intervention_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing status requires manual review or intervention by billing operations staff.

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing status requires escalation to management or specialized teams for resolution.

attributes.name: sla_hours
attributes.description: Number of business hours within which invoices or accounts with this status must be processed or resolved per SLA requirements.

attributes.name: notification_template_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the communication template used for member or group notifications when this billing status is assigned.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for notifications related to this billing status (e.g., email, mail, SMS, member portal).

attributes.name: dispute_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices or charges with this billing status are eligible for member or group dispute and appeal processes.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, Internal Appeals Policy

attributes.name: write_off_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether amounts with this billing status are eligible for write-off or bad debt classification.
attributes.references: GAAP Accounting Standards, Internal Write-Off Policy

attributes.name: refund_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether payments associated with this billing status are eligible for refund processing.

attributes.name: adjustment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices or charges with this billing status can be adjusted through retroactive billing adjustments.

attributes.name: commission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether premiums with this billing status are eligible for broker or agent commission calculation and payment.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Risk score (0-100) indicating the likelihood of non-payment or collection difficulty for accounts with this billing status.

attributes.name: collection_probability_percent
attributes.description: Estimated probability (0-100%) of successfully collecting payment for invoices or accounts with this billing status.

attributes.name: reserve_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of receivables with this billing status that should be reserved for potential non-collection, per accounting policy.
attributes.references: GAAP Accounting Standards, Internal Reserve Policy

attributes.name: icon_name
attributes.description: Name of the icon or visual indicator used to represent this billing status in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used for visual representation of this billing status in dashboards and reports (e.g., #FF0000 for overdue).

attributes.name: user_role_visibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of user roles that have visibility to invoices or accounts with this billing status (e.g., billing_admin, collections_agent, finance_analyst).

attributes.name: audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether status changes to or from this billing status require audit logging and compliance review.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance Requirements, Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assigning this billing status requires managerial or supervisory approval.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Minimum authority level required to approve status changes to this billing status (e.g., supervisor, manager, director).

attributes.name: help_text
attributes.description: User-facing help text or tooltip content explaining this billing status to members, groups, or customer service representatives.

attributes.name: legal_hold_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing status places accounts under legal hold, preventing collection activities due to litigation or regulatory investigation.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing status is associated with suspected fraud, waste, or abuse (FWA) requiring special investigations unit (SIU) review.
attributes.references: Internal FWA Detection Policy, False Claims Act

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing status requires special compliance monitoring or reporting to regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: CMS Compliance Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: external_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts with this billing status must be reported to external parties (e.g., credit bureaus, regulatory agencies).
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act, State Insurance Regulations

products.name: payment_method
products.description: Supported payment methods (ACH, credit card, check, electronic) and related attributes such as processing fees.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment method record. Primary key for the payment method entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the payment method type for system processing and reporting (e.g., ACH, CC, CHK, EFT, WIRE).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI 835 Payment Method Codes

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the payment method as displayed to members and internal users (e.g., Automated Clearing House, Credit Card, Paper Check).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the payment method indicating the fundamental processing mechanism.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the payment method including processing characteristics, typical use cases, and member-facing information.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the payment method indicating whether it is available for new transactions and enrollments.

attributes.name: is_electronic
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method is processed electronically (true) or requires manual/paper processing (false).

attributes.name: requires_bank_account
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method requires bank account information (routing number and account number) for processing.

attributes.name: requires_card_details
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method requires credit or debit card information (card number, expiration, CVV) for processing.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: supports_recurring
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method supports automated recurring payments for premium billing cycles.

attributes.name: supports_one_time
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method supports single one-time payment transactions.

attributes.name: supports_refunds
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method supports refund transactions for overpayments or policy cancellations.

attributes.name: processing_time_days
attributes.description: Typical number of business days required for payment to clear and be applied to member accounts.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, Federal Reserve Payment Processing Guidelines

attributes.name: settlement_time_days
attributes.description: Number of business days required for funds to settle in Healthcare bank accounts after payment initiation.

attributes.name: transaction_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount charged per transaction for processing payments through this method. Used for cost analysis and fee recovery calculations.

attributes.name: transaction_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of transaction amount charged as a processing fee (e.g., 0.0250 represents 2.5%). Used for variable fee calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount required for a transaction to be processed through this payment method. Null indicates no minimum.

attributes.name: maximum_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount allowed for a single transaction through this payment method. Null indicates no maximum limit.
attributes.references: Internal Premium Billing Business Rules, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Regulations

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency supported by this payment method (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party payment processor or financial institution that handles transactions for this payment method.

attributes.name: processor_code
attributes.description: Internal or external code identifying the payment processor in system integrations and transaction routing.

attributes.name: gateway_name
attributes.description: Name of the payment gateway service used to facilitate secure transmission of payment information between systems.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: merchant_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Healthcare merchant account associated with this payment method at the payment processor.

attributes.name: ach_company_id
attributes.description: Ten-digit company identification number assigned by NACHA for ACH transactions. Required for ACH payment methods.

attributes.name: ach_standard_entry_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automated Clearing House (ACH) Standard Entry Class Code
attributes.description: Three-letter code indicating the ACH transaction type and authorization method (e.g., PPD for Prearranged Payment and Deposit, WEB for Internet-Initiated Entry).

attributes.name: card_network
attributes.description: Name of the credit or debit card network that processes card-based payments (e.g., Visa, Mastercard). Applicable only to card payment methods.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Classification of the card payment instrument indicating whether it is a credit card, debit card, prepaid card, or charge card.

attributes.name: requires_signature
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method requires a physical or electronic signature for authorization and compliance.
attributes.references: Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (ESIGN)

attributes.name: requires_authorization
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method requires explicit member authorization before processing (e.g., signed authorization form for ACH).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, Electronic Funds Transfer Act (EFTA)

attributes.name: authorization_form_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a formal authorization form must be completed and retained for compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, Internal Compliance Standards

attributes.name: pci_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry (PCI) Compliance Requirement Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method requires PCI DSS compliance for secure handling of cardholder data.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: encryption_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether payment data must be encrypted during transmission and storage for security and compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule, Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: tokenization_supported
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method supports tokenization to replace sensitive payment data with non-sensitive tokens for enhanced security.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: available_for_individual
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method is available for individual members purchasing direct or marketplace plans.

attributes.name: available_for_group
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method is available for employer group billing and premium collection.

attributes.name: available_for_medicare
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method is available for Medicare Advantage and Part D premium payments.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Payment Guidelines

attributes.name: available_for_medicaid
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method is available for Medicaid managed care premium payments where applicable.

attributes.name: available_for_marketplace
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method is available for Affordable Care Act marketplace plan premium payments.
attributes.references: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Marketplace Payment Standards

attributes.name: lob_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of line of business codes where this payment method is restricted or not available. Null indicates no restrictions.

attributes.name: state_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of US state codes where this payment method is not available due to regulatory or operational constraints. Null indicates available in all states.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where this payment method is available (e.g., USA, CAN).

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of fraud and payment risk associated with this payment method based on historical fraud patterns and security characteristics.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Standards

attributes.name: chargeback_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether payments made through this method can be disputed and charged back by the payer (typically true for credit cards).

attributes.name: reversal_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days after payment processing during which the payment can be reversed or returned (e.g., ACH return window).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, Payment Card Industry Standards

attributes.name: grace_period_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether payments made through this method are eligible for premium grace period provisions under policy terms.
attributes.references: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Grace Period Requirements

attributes.name: auto_pay_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment method can be enrolled in automatic payment programs for recurring premium billing.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel or interface through which members can initiate payments using this method (e.g., web portal, mobile app, IVR).

attributes.name: icon_url
attributes.description: URL path to the graphical icon or logo representing this payment method in digital interfaces.

attributes.name: help_text
attributes.description: Member-facing help text or instructions displayed when selecting or using this payment method in self-service channels.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this payment method became or will become available for use in premium billing transactions.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this payment method was or will be discontinued and no longer available for new transactions. Null indicates currently active.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment method configuration or attributes were last modified in the system.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking changes to payment method configuration over time for audit and change management purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether state insurance department or other regulatory approval is required before offering this payment method.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Regulations, National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC)

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field documenting specific compliance requirements, regulatory constraints, or audit considerations for this payment method.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the vendor contract governing the terms and conditions of payment processing services for this method.

attributes.name: sla_processing_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Processing Time in Hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours guaranteed by the payment processor to complete transaction processing per service level agreement.

attributes.name: failure_retry_attempts
attributes.description: Number of automatic retry attempts the system will make if a payment transaction fails initially.

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether members must receive notification (email, mail, SMS) when payments are processed through this method.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Service Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: confirmation_method
attributes.description: Method used to send payment confirmation to members after successful transaction processing.

attributes.name: receipt_generation_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a formal payment receipt must be generated and made available to the member for this payment method.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether payments made through this method must be included in tax reporting documents (e.g., 1095 forms for premium tax credits).
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Reporting Requirements, Affordable Care Act (ACA)

attributes.name: audit_trail_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether detailed audit trail logging is required for all transactions processed through this payment method.

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which payments processed through this method are reconciled with bank deposits and financial records.
attributes.references: Internal Finance and Accounting Standards, Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code used for posting premium revenue collected through this payment method in the financial system.
attributes.references: Internal Chart of Accounts, Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code used for allocating payment processing fees and operational costs associated with this payment method.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the default payment method pre-selected for members in payment interfaces.

attributes.name: popularity_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of payment method usage frequency based on transaction volume, used for analytics and interface optimization.

attributes.name: success_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Historical percentage of successful transactions for this payment method, calculated as successful transactions divided by total attempts.

attributes.name: average_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Average dollar amount of transactions processed through this payment method, used for financial planning and analysis.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.payment_term. Business justification: Payment methods must align with contracted payment terms. Contracts specify acceptable payment methods and timing, which billing enforces during payment processing.

attributes.name: billing_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_rule. Business justification: Payment methods are governed by billing rules that define processing fees, transaction limits, and other payment-related business logic. This FK links payment methods to their governing rules.

products.name: billing_rule
products.description: Business rules governing premium calculations, discounts, grace periods, late fees, and other billing logic.

attributes.name: billing_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing rule. Primary key for the billing rule entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the billing rule for business reference and system integration.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the billing rule for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the billing rule's purpose, logic, and application conditions.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing rule indicating its functional purpose within the premium billing and revenue collection process.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The mathematical or logical method used to compute the billing amount or adjustment governed by this rule.

attributes.name: calculation_formula
attributes.description: The specific formula or expression used to calculate billing amounts, discounts, or fees. May contain proprietary business logic.

attributes.name: base_amount
attributes.description: The fixed base amount used in billing calculations when the rule applies a fixed or minimum charge.

attributes.name: percentage_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied in billing calculations for discount, surcharge, or commission rules. Stored as decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%).

attributes.name: minimum_amount
attributes.description: The minimum billing amount enforced by this rule, ensuring charges do not fall below a specified threshold.

attributes.name: maximum_amount
attributes.description: The maximum billing amount enforced by this rule, capping charges at a specified threshold.

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: The numeric threshold that triggers the application of this billing rule, such as a minimum balance or usage level.

attributes.name: threshold_operator
attributes.description: The comparison operator used to evaluate whether the threshold condition is met for rule application.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days allowed as a grace period before late fees or penalties are applied under this rule.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fixed late fee amount charged when payment is not received within the grace period.

attributes.name: late_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage-based late fee applied to outstanding balances when payment is not received within the grace period.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The fixed discount amount applied when this rule is triggered, reducing the billed premium.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage-based discount applied to premiums when this rule is triggered.

attributes.name: applies_to_lob
attributes.description: The line of business to which this billing rule applies, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or Marketplace plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, State Medicaid Regulations

attributes.name: applies_to_plan_type
attributes.description: The health plan type to which this billing rule applies, such as HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, or HDHP.

attributes.name: applies_to_group_size
attributes.description: The employer group size category to which this billing rule applies, such as small group, large group, or individual market.
attributes.references: ACA Market Reform Rules, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: applies_to_funding_type
attributes.description: The funding arrangement type to which this billing rule applies, such as fully insured, ASO (Administrative Services Only), or level funded.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing rule becomes active and begins to be applied to billing transactions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing rule ceases to be active and is no longer applied to billing transactions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the billing rule indicating whether it is actively being applied.

attributes.name: priority_order
attributes.description: The sequence order in which this rule is evaluated and applied when multiple billing rules are applicable to the same transaction.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing rule must be applied without exception when conditions are met, or if it can be overridden.

attributes.name: is_overridable
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorized users can manually override the application of this billing rule in specific circumstances.

attributes.name: override_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether managerial or supervisory approval is required to override this billing rule.

attributes.name: proration_method
attributes.description: The method used to prorate premium charges when coverage begins or ends mid-period under this billing rule.

attributes.name: rounding_method
attributes.description: The method used to round calculated billing amounts to the appropriate precision.

attributes.name: rounding_precision
attributes.description: The number of decimal places to which billing amounts are rounded when this rule is applied.

attributes.name: applies_to_new_business_only
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing rule applies only to newly enrolled groups or members, excluding renewals.

attributes.name: applies_to_renewals_only
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing rule applies only to renewing groups or members, excluding new business.

attributes.name: retroactive_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing rule can be applied retroactively to past billing periods for adjustments.
attributes.references: Internal Billing Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: retroactive_limit_months
attributes.description: The maximum number of months into the past that this billing rule can be applied retroactively.
attributes.references: Internal Billing Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: tax_treatment
attributes.description: Indicates the tax treatment of amounts calculated under this billing rule for premium tax and sales tax purposes.
attributes.references: State Premium Tax Regulations, IRS Guidelines

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to recognize revenue for amounts billed under this rule, ensuring compliance with revenue recognition standards.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which transactions governed by this billing rule are posted for financial reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which revenue or expenses from this billing rule are allocated for internal management reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory requirement, statute, or compliance mandate that necessitates this billing rule.
attributes.references: ACA, State Insurance Regulations, CMS Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes documenting compliance considerations, regulatory constraints, or audit requirements related to this billing rule.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: The business rationale and strategic justification for implementing this billing rule.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The role, title, or department authorized to approve the creation, modification, or retirement of this billing rule.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the individual who approved this billing rule for implementation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing rule was formally approved for implementation.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version identifier for this billing rule, tracking changes and updates over time.

attributes.name: supersedes_rule_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the previous billing rule that this rule replaces or supersedes.

attributes.name: communication_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether member or employer communication is required when this billing rule is applied.
attributes.references: ERISA Disclosure Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: communication_template_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the communication template used to notify members or employers when this billing rule is applied.

attributes.name: system_source
attributes.description: The source system or platform where this billing rule is configured and maintained (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Oracle Health Insurance).

attributes.name: external_rule_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for this billing rule in external systems, partner platforms, or regulatory filings.

attributes.name: testing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal testing and validation are required before this billing rule is activated in production.

attributes.name: testing_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which testing and validation of this billing rule were completed and approved.

attributes.name: impact_assessment_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial and operational impact assessment was completed before implementing this billing rule.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_impact_amount
attributes.description: The estimated annual financial impact (revenue or cost) of implementing this billing rule.

attributes.name: affected_member_count
attributes.description: The estimated number of members affected by the application of this billing rule.

attributes.name: affected_group_count
attributes.description: The estimated number of employer groups affected by the application of this billing rule.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Billing rules differ by product plan (grace periods, payment schedules, late fees). System applies plan-specific billing logic for compliant premium collection and processing.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Billing rules are contract-specific (e.g., billing frequency, grace periods, payment terms). Each agreement defines unique billing requirements that billing operations must follow.

attributes.name: pricing_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.pricing_rule. Business justification: Billing rules implement enterprise pricing rules that determine premium calculations, discounts, and surcharges. Product configuration and billing systems apply these rules consistently across all bil

products.name: billing_exception
products.description: Exception types for billing anomalies (e.g., coordination of benefits conflict, eligibility lapse, rate mismatch).

attributes.name: billing_exception_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing exception record.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the type of billing exception encountered, such as Coordination of Benefits (COB) conflict, eligibility lapse, rate mismatch, premium calculation error, retroactive adjustment, grace period violation, payment reversal, capitation error, commission discrepancy, Administrative Services Only (ASO) billing error, duplicate billing, missing enrollment, invalid group, coverage gap, subsidy mismatch, age rating error, tier assignment error, dependent eligibility issue, Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) billing error, or late enrollment penalty.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment/Remittance Advice, CMS Premium Billing Guidelines

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the billing exception in the resolution workflow.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the billing exception based on financial impact and urgency.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for exception resolution, with lower numbers indicating higher priority.

attributes.name: detected_date
attributes.description: Date when the billing exception was first detected by the system or billing operations team.

attributes.name: detected_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the billing exception was first detected, including time zone information.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method by which the billing exception was identified, such as automated system check, manual review, member inquiry, provider dispute, internal audit, reconciliation process, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) validation, or payment posting.

attributes.name: detection_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the system or application that detected the billing exception (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Oracle Health Insurance).

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period affected by the exception.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period affected by the exception.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle during which the exception occurred.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with the billing exception.

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the primary subscriber on the health plan policy.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the employer or group associated with the billing exception.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Health insurance policy number affected by the billing exception.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) category for the affected policy, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicaid, Individual Marketplace, Administrative Services Only (ASO), Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA), TRICARE, or Dual Eligible.
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific health insurance product (e.g., Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP)).

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific benefit plan design associated with the exception.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Coverage tier for the policy (e.g., Employee Only, Employee + Spouse, Employee + Children, Family, Individual, Individual + One).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the billing discrepancy or exception.

attributes.name: expected_amount
attributes.description: Expected or correct billing amount based on policy terms and rating rules.

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount that was billed or processed, which differs from the expected amount.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Calculated difference between expected and actual amounts (variance = actual - expected).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the exception amounts.

attributes.name: premium_type
attributes.description: Type of premium affected by the exception (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annual, Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA), retroactive, adjustment).

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Rate code that was applied or should have been applied in the billing calculation.

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the rate that should apply to the billing period.

attributes.name: eligibility_status_at_billing
attributes.description: Member eligibility status at the time the billing was processed.

attributes.name: eligibility_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when member eligibility became effective for the coverage period.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: eligibility_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when member eligibility was terminated, if applicable to the exception.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Coordination of Benefits (COB) applies to this billing exception.

attributes.name: primary_payer_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary insurance payer in Coordination of Benefits (COB) scenarios.

attributes.name: secondary_payer_name
attributes.description: Name of the secondary insurance payer in Coordination of Benefits (COB) scenarios.

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception involves a retroactive adjustment to prior billing periods.

attributes.name: retroactive_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period affected by retroactive adjustments.

attributes.name: retroactive_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period affected by retroactive adjustments.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of grace period days allowed for premium payment before termination.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Original due date for the premium payment associated with the exception.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date when payment was received, if applicable to the exception.

attributes.name: payment_reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception involves a payment reversal or chargeback.

attributes.name: subsidy_amount
attributes.description: Amount of government subsidy (e.g., Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC)) applied to the premium.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1401, IRS Premium Tax Credit Regulations

attributes.name: subsidy_type
attributes.description: Type of subsidy applied, such as Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC), Cost Sharing Reduction (CSR), state subsidy, employer contribution, or none.

attributes.name: subsidy_eligibility_status
attributes.description: Status of member eligibility for premium subsidies at the time of billing.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1411, CMS Eligibility Verification Standards

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount contributed by the employer toward the premium.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount contributed by the employee toward the premium.

attributes.name: age_rating_factor
attributes.description: Age-based rating factor applied in premium calculation.

attributes.name: tobacco_rating_factor
attributes.description: Tobacco use rating factor applied in premium calculation.

attributes.name: geographic_rating_area
attributes.description: Geographic rating area code used for premium calculation.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2701, State Rating Area Definitions

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under the policy at the time of the exception.

attributes.name: dependent_eligibility_issue_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception involves a dependent eligibility issue (e.g., age-out, loss of student status).
attributes.references: ACA Dependent Coverage Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: capitation_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception involves capitation payments to providers.

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Per Member Per Month (PMPM) capitation rate associated with the exception.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Rate Setting Standards

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission amount associated with the billing exception, if applicable.

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the broker or agent associated with the policy and exception.

attributes.name: aso_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception involves an Administrative Services Only (ASO) arrangement.

attributes.name: aso_fee_amount
attributes.description: Administrative Services Only (ASO) fee amount associated with the exception.

attributes.name: duplicate_billing_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception involves duplicate billing for the same coverage period.

attributes.name: original_invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number of the original billing if this exception involves a duplicate or adjustment.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the billing exception and circumstances.

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the root cause of the billing exception.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the root cause analysis findings.

attributes.name: assigned_to_user_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the billing operations staff member assigned to resolve the exception.

attributes.name: assigned_to_team
attributes.description: Name of the team or department assigned to resolve the exception.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date when the exception was assigned to a user or team for resolution.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the billing exception was resolved.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the billing exception was resolved, including time zone information.

attributes.name: resolution_action_code
attributes.description: Code representing the action taken to resolve the exception (e.g., corrected billing, refund issued, credit applied, rate adjusted, eligibility corrected, manual override, escalated to supervisor, no action required, cancelled).

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting the resolution actions and outcomes.

attributes.name: corrected_amount
attributes.description: Corrected billing amount after resolution of the exception.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the billing adjustment made to resolve the exception.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount refunded to the member or group as a result of the exception resolution.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: Amount credited to the member or group account as a result of the exception resolution.

attributes.name: sla_target_resolution_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Resolution Hours
attributes.description: Target number of hours for exception resolution per Service Level Agreement (SLA) standards.

attributes.name: sla_actual_resolution_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Actual Resolution Hours
attributes.description: Actual number of hours taken to resolve the exception.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception was resolved within Service Level Agreement (SLA) targets.

attributes.name: escalation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception was escalated to higher-level management or specialized teams.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the exception was escalated.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for escalating the exception to higher-level management or specialized teams.

attributes.name: financial_impact_category
attributes.description: Category describing the financial impact of the exception (e.g., revenue loss, overpayment, underpayment, compliance risk, member satisfaction risk, no financial impact).

attributes.name: compliance_risk_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception poses a regulatory compliance risk.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_indicator
