attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.retroactive_adjustment. Business justification: AR line items may have retroactive adjustments that modify the line amount for prior periods. This FK links AR line items to retroactive adjustments.

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.accounts_receivable. Business justification: AR lines belong to AR records. This FK links AR line items to their parent AR records, establishing the line-item relationship.

products.name: grace_period
products.description: Definition of grace period lengths and conditions for premium payments before late fees apply.

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the grace period configuration record.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance plan to which this grace period applies, such as individual, group, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, marketplace, COBRA, retiree, or student plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations, ACA Marketplace Standards

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business category for the grace period, indicating whether it applies to commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, dual eligible, or exchange products.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, CMS Program Requirements

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: Funding arrangement for the plan, such as fully insured, Administrative Services Only (ASO), level funded, or self-funded, which may affect grace period terms.
attributes.references: ERISA Regulations, State Insurance Department Guidelines

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days allowed for premium payment after the due date before late fees, penalties, or coverage termination actions are initiated.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1312(c), State Insurance Regulations, CMS Guidance

attributes.name: marketplace_duration_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Marketplace Grace Period Duration in Days
attributes.description: Specific grace period duration for Qualified Health Plans (QHP) sold through federally facilitated or state-based marketplaces, typically 90 days per ACA requirements for members receiving advance premium tax credits.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this grace period configuration becomes effective and applicable to premium billing cycles.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this grace period configuration expires and is no longer applicable, allowing for time-bound grace period rules.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the grace period configuration, indicating whether it is active, inactive, pending implementation, or superseded by a newer configuration.

attributes.name: applies_to_new_enrollments
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grace period applies to newly enrolled members or only to existing members with established payment history.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Guidelines, Internal Underwriting Policy

attributes.name: applies_to_renewals
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grace period applies to policy renewals or only to initial enrollment periods.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Guidelines, Internal Underwriting Policy

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount charged as a late fee if premium payment is not received within the grace period.

attributes.name: late_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the outstanding premium amount charged as a late fee if payment is not received within the grace period.

attributes.name: coverage_continues_during_grace
attributes.business_glossary_term: Coverage Continues During Grace Period Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether health coverage remains active and claims are paid during the grace period, or if coverage is suspended pending payment.

attributes.name: claims_pended_during_grace
attributes.business_glossary_term: Claims Pended During Grace Period Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether claims incurred during the grace period are pended (held) pending premium payment resolution, or processed normally.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1312(c), Internal Claims Processing Policy

attributes.name: retroactive_termination_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether coverage can be retroactively terminated to the end of the last paid period if premium is not received by the end of the grace period.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: retroactive_termination_date
attributes.description: Specific date to which coverage is retroactively terminated if premium payment is not received within the grace period, typically the last day of the last paid coverage period.

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer is required to notify the member when they enter a grace period due to non-payment of premium.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, NAIC Model Laws, ACA Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: notification_timing_days
attributes.description: Number of days before or after the grace period begins that the member must be notified of their grace period status.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the member is notified of grace period status, such as mail, email, phone, member portal, or SMS.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: reinstatement_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a member whose coverage was terminated due to non-payment can have their coverage reinstated if they pay outstanding premiums within a specified timeframe.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, Internal Policy Administration Standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after termination during which a member can reinstate coverage by paying outstanding premiums and any applicable fees.

attributes.name: minimum_payment_required
attributes.description: Minimum payment amount that must be received during the grace period to avoid termination, which may be less than the full premium due.
attributes.references: Internal Billing Policy, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: partial_payment_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether partial premium payments are accepted during the grace period to extend coverage or prevent termination.
attributes.references: Internal Billing Policy, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: payment_plan_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members in grace period status are eligible to establish a payment plan to bring their account current.
attributes.references: Internal Billing Policy, Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code indicating the jurisdiction whose regulations govern this grace period configuration, as grace period requirements vary by state.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Regulations, NAIC Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the specific state or federal regulation that mandates or governs this grace period configuration.
attributes.references: State Insurance Codes, ACA Regulations, CMS Guidelines

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal product code identifying the specific insurance product or plan design to which this grace period applies.
attributes.references: Internal Product Catalog, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the insurance product or plan to which this grace period configuration applies.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Type of provider network associated with the plan, such as Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), or indemnity.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: employer_group_size_min
attributes.description: Minimum employer group size (number of employees) for which this grace period configuration applies, as grace periods may differ for small vs. large groups.
attributes.references: ACA Small Group Market Definitions, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: employer_group_size_max
attributes.description: Maximum employer group size (number of employees) for which this grace period configuration applies.
attributes.references: ACA Small Group Market Definitions, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: aptc_recipient_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advance Premium Tax Credit (APTC) Recipient Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grace period configuration applies specifically to members receiving Advance Premium Tax Credits through the health insurance marketplace, who are subject to special 90-day grace period rules.

attributes.name: aptc_liability_month_1
attributes.description: For marketplace plans with APTC, indicates whether the insurer is liable for claims incurred during the first month of the 90-day grace period.

attributes.name: aptc_liability_month_2_3
attributes.description: For marketplace plans with APTC, indicates whether the insurer is liable for claims incurred during the second and third months of the 90-day grace period, or if providers are responsible for collection.

attributes.name: provider_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers must be notified when a member is in grace period status, particularly relevant for marketplace plans where provider liability may apply.

attributes.name: cobra_continuation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grace period configuration applies to Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) continuation coverage.

attributes.name: medicare_secondary_payer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Medicare Secondary Payer rules apply during the grace period, affecting coordination of benefits and claims processing.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Secondary Payer Regulations, 42 CFR 411

attributes.name: premium_payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which premiums are billed and due, which may affect grace period application and duration.

attributes.name: auto_termination_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether coverage is automatically terminated by the system at the end of the grace period if payment is not received, or if manual review is required.

attributes.name: extension_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the grace period can be extended under special circumstances such as natural disasters, military deployment, or other hardship situations.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, Internal Exception Policy

attributes.name: extension_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of additional days that the grace period can be extended under approved circumstances.
attributes.references: Internal Exception Policy, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: hardship_exemption_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members in this plan type are eligible for hardship exemptions that may affect grace period terms or termination procedures.
attributes.references: ACA Hardship Exemption Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: special_enrollment_period_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether grace period rules are modified for members who enrolled during a Special Enrollment Period rather than open enrollment.
attributes.references: ACA Special Enrollment Period Rules, CMS Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grace period configuration record was created in the system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grace period configuration record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this grace period configuration, incremented with each modification to maintain audit trail and configuration history.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this grace period configuration, indicating whether it is in draft, pending review, approved for use, or rejected.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who approved this grace period configuration for production use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grace period configuration was approved for production use.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this grace period configuration, including rationale for specific settings, special circumstances, or implementation guidance.

products.name: late_fee
products.description: Late fee structures applied after grace periods, based on overdue amount and days past due.

attributes.name: late_fee_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the late fee record.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insured member associated with the late fee.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number of the member's health insurance coverage.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the billing account to which the late fee is applied.

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Category of the fee applied after the grace period.

attributes.name: fee_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the late fee assessment.

attributes.name: fee_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the late fee.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the late fee before taxes.

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the fee amount.

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.description: Tax applied to the late fee amount.

attributes.name: tax_currency

attributes.name: total_amount_due

attributes.description: Sum of fee amount and tax amount.

attributes.name: total_currency

attributes.name: grace_period_days

attributes.name: days_past_due

attributes.name: overdue_amount

attributes.name: fee_applied_date

attributes.name: fee_posted_timestamp

attributes.name: fee_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the late fee.

attributes.name: waiver_applied_flag

attributes.name: waiver_reason

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the total amount due must be paid.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Status of the payment for the late fee.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the payment was made.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the late fee record was created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the late fee record.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the late fee becomes effective.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the late fee is no longer applicable.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for any additional comments or remarks regarding the late fee.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insured member associated with the late fee.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_method. Business justification: Late fees track payment method. Replace STRING payment_method with proper FK to payment_method reference table. Remove payment_method string as it can be retrieved from payment_method table.

attributes.name: finance_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_account. Business justification: Late fees generate additional revenue posted to specific GL accounts. Finance tracks late fee revenue separately for income statement reporting and revenue analysis.

attributes.name: billing_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_rule. Business justification: Late fees are governed by billing rules that define fee amounts, grace periods, and other late fee-related business logic. This FK links late fees to their governing rules.

attributes.name: premium_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium. Business justification: Late fees may be applied to premiums for overdue premium payments. This FK links late fees to the premiums they are charged against.

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_flag

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: product_plan_id

attributes.name: contract_discount_id

attributes.name: finance_account_id

attributes.name: program_id

attributes.name: billing_rule_id

attributes.name: premium_rate_id

products.name: discount_application
products.description: Application of a discount to a specific premium calculation or invoice, including amount and reason.

attributes.name: discount_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the discount application record. Primary key for the discount application entity.

attributes.name: premium_calculation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the premium calculation to which this discount is applied. Links discount to the specific premium computation instance.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice to which this discount is applied. Links discount to the billing document.

attributes.name: group_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the group policy associated with this discount application. Identifies the employer or group receiving the discount.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual member receiving the discount. Used for individual billing scenarios.

attributes.name: discount_type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the category or type of discount being applied. Classifies the discount by its business purpose and eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: discount_reason_code
attributes.description: Specific reason code explaining why the discount was applied. Provides detailed justification for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: discount_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the reason for applying the discount. Provides human-readable explanation for business users and members.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the discount applied to the premium or invoice. Expressed in the billing currency.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate of the discount applied to the premium or invoice. Used when discount is calculated as a percentage of the base amount.

attributes.name: original_premium_amount
attributes.description: The premium amount before the discount was applied. Provides baseline for discount calculation and audit trail.

attributes.name: discounted_premium_amount
attributes.description: The final premium amount after the discount has been applied. Represents the actual amount billed to the customer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the discount and premium amounts. Identifies the monetary unit used in the transaction.

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: Method by which the discount was applied to the premium or invoice. Indicates whether the discount was system-generated, manually entered, or triggered by a promotional code.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the discount application. Tracks whether the discount has been authorized for application.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount requires managerial or system approval before being applied. Used for governance and control purposes.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the discount application. Provides audit trail for discount authorization.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_name
attributes.description: Full name of the user who approved the discount application. Human-readable identifier for audit and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the discount application was approved. Provides temporal audit trail for discount authorization.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the discount becomes effective and applicable to premium calculations. Defines the beginning of the discount period.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the discount expires and is no longer applicable to premium calculations. Defines the end of the discount period.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period to which this discount applies. Links discount to specific billing cycle.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period to which this discount applies. Links discount to specific billing cycle.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the discount was applied to the premium calculation or invoice. Records when the discount transaction occurred.

attributes.name: application_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the discount was applied to the premium calculation or invoice. Provides detailed temporal audit trail.

attributes.name: promo_code
attributes.description: The promotional or coupon code entered by the member or group to trigger the discount. Used for marketing campaign tracking.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign associated with this discount. Links discount to promotional initiatives for ROI analysis.

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: Name of the marketing campaign associated with this discount. Provides human-readable campaign reference.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business to which this discount applies. Categorizes discount by market segment and product type.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific insurance product to which the discount applies. Links discount to product catalog.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance product to which the discount applies. Provides human-readable product reference.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health plan to which the discount applies. Identifies the network and benefit structure model.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The coverage tier to which the discount applies. Identifies the number and type of covered individuals.

attributes.name: discount_tier
attributes.description: Tiered level of the discount based on volume, loyalty, or other criteria. Used for graduated discount structures.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Textual description of the criteria that must be met for the discount to be applicable. Documents business rules for discount qualification.

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the eligibility criteria for the discount have been verified. Used for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the eligibility for the discount was verified. Provides audit trail for compliance.

attributes.name: max_discount_amount
attributes.description: The maximum monetary value that can be applied as a discount. Used to cap discount amounts based on business rules.

attributes.name: min_discount_amount
attributes.description: The minimum monetary value that must be applied as a discount. Used to enforce minimum discount thresholds.

attributes.name: discount_cap_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount amount was capped at the maximum allowed value. Used for reporting and analysis of discount limitations.

attributes.name: recurring_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount is recurring across multiple billing periods or is a one-time application. Used for ongoing discount management.

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the discount recurs if it is a recurring discount. Defines the periodicity of discount application.

attributes.name: retroactive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount is being applied retroactively to prior billing periods. Used for retroactive adjustments and corrections.

attributes.name: retroactive_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period for which the discount is being applied retroactively. Defines the beginning of the retroactive adjustment window.

attributes.name: retroactive_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period for which the discount is being applied retroactively. Defines the end of the retroactive adjustment window.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any adjustment to the discount amount. Used for retroactive corrections and audit trail.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason for any adjustment to the discount amount. Provides human-readable explanation for adjustments.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which the discount application originated. Tracks system of record for data lineage.

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the source system. Enables traceability back to the originating system record.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the discount amount is posted. Links discount to financial accounting structure.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Method used for recognizing the revenue impact of the discount. Defines accounting treatment for financial reporting.

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the tax treatment of the discount. Defines whether the discount affects taxable premium amounts.

attributes.name: commission_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount affects agent or broker commission calculations. Used for commission processing.

attributes.name: mlr_impact_flag

attributes.name: aca_reportable_flag

attributes.name: state_regulatory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying state-specific regulatory requirements applicable to the discount. Used for state insurance department compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number

attributes.name: applied_by_user_id

attributes.name: applied_by_user_name
attributes.description: Full name of the user who applied the discount. Human-readable identifier for audit and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: status_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for the current status of the discount application. Provides context for status transitions.

attributes.name: status_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the current status became effective. Tracks status change history.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the discount application record was created in the system. Provides audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the discount application record was last modified. Tracks most recent update to the record.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual member receiving the discount. Used for individual billing scenarios.

attributes.name: drug_id

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description explaining the reason for the adjustment applied during reconciliation.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment reconciliation indicating whether the payment was fully matched, partially matched, or remains unreconciled.

attributes.name: reconciliation_type
attributes.description: The method by which the reconciliation was performed, such as automatic system matching, manual review, or system-assisted processing.

attributes.name: match_confidence_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the system's confidence level in the payment-to-invoice match, typically expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100.

attributes.name: match_criteria
attributes.description: Description of the criteria or rules used to match the payment to the invoice, such as invoice number, member ID, or payment reference.

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the entity making the payment, which could be a member, employer group, or third-party administrator.

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or organization making the payment, used for identification and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: payer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity making the payment, such as individual member, employer group, or third-party administrator (TPA).

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan member associated with the payment and invoice being reconciled.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employer group or organization associated with the payment, applicable for group billing scenarios.
attributes.references: ERISA Employee Retirement Income Security Act

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The insurance policy number associated with the payment and invoice being reconciled.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or business segment to which the payment and invoice belong, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage (MA), or Medicaid.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period covered by the invoice being reconciled.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period covered by the invoice being reconciled.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the invoice payment was due, used to determine timeliness and potential late fees.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The final date of the grace period during which payment can be received without penalty or coverage termination.

attributes.name: payment_timeliness_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the payment was received on time, late, within the grace period, or past the grace period.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of days the payment was overdue relative to the invoice due date at the time of reconciliation.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: The amount of late payment fees assessed and included in the reconciliation due to payment received after the due date.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the payment and invoice amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The currency exchange rate applied if the payment was received in a different currency than the invoice currency.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The bank account number from which the payment was drawn or to which it was deposited, masked for security purposes.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The American Bankers Association (ABA) routing number identifying the financial institution involved in the payment transaction.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check number if the payment was made by paper check, used for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the payment processor or financial institution for the payment transaction.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code provided by the payment processor confirming approval of the payment transaction.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the reconciliation results were posted to the general ledger and accounts receivable systems.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the reconciliation results have been successfully posted to the financial systems.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which the reconciled payment was posted for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_account
attributes.description: The accounts receivable account code from which the invoice balance was cleared upon successful reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The organizational cost center associated with the payment reconciliation for internal financial tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the batch processing run during which this payment reconciliation was performed, used for audit and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the reconciliation resulted in an exception requiring manual review or intervention.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of exception encountered during reconciliation, such as no match found, amount mismatch, or duplicate payment.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the exception encountered during the reconciliation process.

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether any exceptions or issues identified during reconciliation have been resolved.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date when any exceptions or issues identified during reconciliation were resolved.

attributes.name: resolved_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system operator who resolved any exceptions or issues in the reconciliation.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the actions taken to resolve exceptions or issues during the reconciliation process.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this reconciliation record has been reversed due to error correction or payment reversal.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date when the reconciliation was reversed, if applicable.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for reversing the reconciliation, such as payment returned, error correction, or duplicate processing.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description explaining why the reconciliation was reversed.

attributes.name: original_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payment reconciliation record if this record represents a reversal or correction.

attributes.name: processor_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party payment processor or financial institution that handled the payment transaction.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: processor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the payment processor or financial institution in the organization's systems.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: lockbox_number
attributes.description: The lockbox number if the payment was received through a bank lockbox service for automated payment processing.

attributes.name: cleared_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment cleared through the banking system and funds became available.

attributes.name: nsf_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the payment was returned due to non-sufficient funds in the payer's account.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for payment return, such as Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF), account closed, or stop payment.

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment was returned by the financial institution.

attributes.name: chargeback_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the payment was subject to a chargeback dispute initiated by the payer.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: chargeback_date
attributes.description: The date when the chargeback was initiated against the payment.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: chargeback_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code provided by the card network indicating the reason for the chargeback dispute.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: refund_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a refund was issued as a result of the reconciliation identifying an overpayment.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount refunded to the payer as a result of overpayment identified during reconciliation.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: The date when the refund was processed and issued to the payer.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: The method used to issue the refund, such as returning to original payment method, issuing a check, or crediting the account.

attributes.name: credit_balance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the reconciliation resulted in a credit balance on the account due to overpayment.

attributes.name: credit_balance_amount
attributes.description: The amount of credit balance remaining on the account after reconciliation, available for application to future invoices.

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether any portion of the invoice balance was written off as uncollectible during reconciliation.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the invoice balance that was written off as uncollectible during the reconciliation process.

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for writing off the balance, such as bankruptcy, deceased member, or small balance adjustment.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The amount of discount applied during reconciliation, such as early payment discount or negotiated settlement discount.

attributes.name: discount_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for applying a discount during reconciliation, such as early payment or settlement agreement.

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the payment is part of an installment payment plan arrangement.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the payment plan arrangement if the payment is part of an installment agreement.

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: The sequential number of this payment within the payment plan, indicating which installment this represents.

attributes.name: autopay_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the payment was processed automatically through an autopay enrollment.

attributes.name: recurring_payment_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this payment is part of a recurring payment schedule.

attributes.name: payment_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application from which the payment data originated, such as billing system or payment gateway.

attributes.name: reconciliation_system
attributes.description: Name of the system or application that performed the payment reconciliation process.

attributes.name: reconciled_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system operator who performed or approved the reconciliation, applicable for manual or system-assisted reconciliations.

attributes.name: audit_trail
attributes.description: Comprehensive audit trail documenting all actions, changes, and decisions made during the reconciliation process for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, explanations, or special instructions related to the payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Human-readable invoice number displayed on billing statements and used for customer reference during payment submission.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date when the invoice was generated and issued to the member or group.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan member associated with the payment and invoice being reconciled.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_method. Business justification: Reconciliation tracks payment method. Replace STRING payment_method with proper FK to payment_method reference table. Remove payment_method string as it can be retrieved from payment_method table.

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Reconciliation tracks grace period. Need to link to the grace period policy for timeliness tracking. Cannot remove grace_period_end_date as it is execution-specific value.

attributes.name: cash_management_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cash_management. Business justification: Payment reconciliation matches billing receipts to bank deposits. Finance uses this for daily cash positioning, bank reconciliation, and cash flow statement preparation.

attributes.name: write_off_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.write_off. Business justification: Payment reconciliation may result in write-offs when unmatched amounts are deemed uncollectible. This FK links payment reconciliation to write-offs.

attributes.name: late_fee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.late_fee. Business justification: Payment reconciliation may involve late fees, such as when reconciling late payments. This FK links payment reconciliation to late fees.

attributes.name: discount_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.discount_application. Business justification: Payment reconciliation may apply discounts when matching payments to invoices. This FK links payment reconciliation to discount applications.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_payment. Business justification: Payment reconciliation links to payments being reconciled. This FK connects payment reconciliation records to the billing payments they process.

products.name: surcharge
products.description: Additional charges applied to premiums (e.g., high‑risk surcharge, tobacco use surcharge) with amount and eligibility rules.

attributes.name: surcharge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the surcharge record. Primary key for the surcharge data product.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Business code identifying the type of surcharge (e.g., TOBACCO, HIGHRISK, LATEPAY, ADMIN).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the surcharge (e.g., Tobacco Use Surcharge, High Risk Surcharge, Late Payment Fee).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the surcharge, including the reason for application and calculation methodology.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the surcharge type (risk-based, behavioral, administrative, regulatory, penalty, adjustment).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount of the surcharge when surcharge_type is flat. Null for percentage-based surcharges.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to the base premium when surcharge_type is percentage. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 25.00 for 25%).

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The base value used to calculate the surcharge amount (e.g., base premium, total premium, member count, claims experience).

attributes.name: minimum_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount that can be charged for this surcharge, regardless of calculation method.

attributes.name: maximum_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that can be charged for this surcharge, used to cap calculated amounts.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business to which this surcharge applies (commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, individual, group, ASO, fully insured).

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The insurance product type to which this surcharge applies (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, Indemnity, SNP, MA-PD, PDP).

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Business rules defining when this surcharge should be applied to a member or group (e.g., tobacco use attestation, age range, geographic location).
attributes.references: ACA Rating Rules, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: tobacco_use_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this surcharge is specifically for tobacco use, subject to ACA rating rules (maximum 50% surcharge allowed).

attributes.name: age_based_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this surcharge varies based on member age.

attributes.name: geographic_based_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this surcharge varies based on member geographic location or rating area.
attributes.references: ACA Rating Rules, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this surcharge is related to risk adjustment factors or HCC scores.

attributes.name: regulatory_mandated_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this surcharge is mandated by federal or state regulations.

attributes.name: taxable_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this surcharge amount is subject to premium taxes or other taxation.

attributes.name: mlr_included_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this surcharge is included in the Medical Loss Ratio calculation for ACA compliance.

attributes.name: waivable_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this surcharge can be waived under certain conditions (e.g., wellness program participation).
attributes.references: ACA Wellness Program Rules, HIPAA Nondiscrimination Rules

attributes.name: waiver_criteria
attributes.description: Business rules defining the conditions under which this surcharge can be waived (e.g., completion of smoking cessation program).
attributes.references: ACA Wellness Program Rules, HIPAA Nondiscrimination Rules

attributes.name: proration_method
attributes.description: Method used to prorate the surcharge for partial coverage periods (daily, monthly, none, custom).

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Billing frequency for the surcharge (monthly, quarterly, annual, one-time, per occurrence).

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Timing of surcharge billing relative to coverage period (current month, advance, arrears).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for revenue recognition of this surcharge in the financial system.
attributes.references: GAAP Chart of Accounts, Internal Accounting Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this surcharge definition becomes active and can be applied to policies.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this surcharge definition expires and can no longer be applied to new policies. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the surcharge definition (active, inactive, pending approval, suspended, retired).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for the surcharge definition (draft, pending review, approved, rejected).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this surcharge definition.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this surcharge definition was approved for use.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where this surcharge is applicable. Null indicates national applicability.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations, NAIC State Codes

attributes.name: rating_area
attributes.description: Geographic rating area code where this surcharge applies, as defined by state or federal regulations.
attributes.references: ACA Rating Area Definitions, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Market segment to which this surcharge applies (small group, large group, individual, Medicare, Medicaid).

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Regulatory rate filing number associated with this surcharge, submitted to state insurance departments.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the rate filing containing this surcharge was submitted to regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: filing_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory authority approved the rate filing containing this surcharge.

attributes.name: regulatory_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments related to regulatory compliance, filing requirements, or special conditions for this surcharge.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this surcharge definition, incremented with each modification.

attributes.name: superseded_by_surcharge_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the surcharge definition that replaces this one. Null if this is the current version.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Source system from which this surcharge definition originated (Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, Oracle Health Insurance, manual entry).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this surcharge in the source system of record.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surcharge record was last modified in the source system.

attributes.name: premium_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_rate. Business justification: Surcharges are applied to premium rates, such as tobacco surcharges or high-risk surcharges. This FK links surcharges to the premium rates they modify.

attributes.name: billing_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_rule. Business justification: Surcharges are governed by billing rules that define when and how surcharges are applied. This FK links surcharges to their governing rules.

products.name: auth_status
products.description: Standardized status values (e.g., pending, approved, denied, on‑hold) used across the authorization lifecycle.

attributes.name: auth_status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the authorization status record. Primary key for the authorization status reference data.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the authorization status (e.g., PEND, APPR, DENY, HOLD, CANC). Used as a standardized identifier across systems for authorization workflow states.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the authorization status (e.g., Pending, Approved, Denied, On Hold, Cancelled). Used for display in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the authorization status, including business meaning, workflow implications, and usage context. Provides clarity on when and how this status is applied in the prior authorization lifecycle.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the status indicating its position in the authorization lifecycle. Initial statuses represent new requests, in-progress statuses indicate active review, final statuses represent completed determinations, and terminal statuses indicate closed or cancelled requests.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization status is currently active and available for use in authorization workflows. Inactive statuses are retained for historical reference but cannot be assigned to new authorizations.

attributes.name: is_final
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status represents a final determination in the authorization process (e.g., Approved, Denied). Final statuses typically trigger downstream actions such as notification generation and claims processing enablement.

attributes.name: is_appealable
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status can be appealed by the member or provider. Typically true for denied or partially approved statuses, enabling members to exercise their appeal rights under regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: requires_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether a status change to this value requires notification to the member, provider, or both. Used to trigger automated notification workflows and ensure compliance with regulatory notification timeframes.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, State Prompt Pay Laws

attributes.name: notification_timeframe_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours allowed for notification to be sent after an authorization reaches this status. Used to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements for timely notification of authorization decisions.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR 422.568, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: allows_partial_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status supports partial approval scenarios where some requested services are approved while others are denied. Used in complex authorization requests involving multiple services or units.

attributes.name: requires_clinical_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status require clinical review by a medical professional (e.g., nurse, physician). Used to route cases to appropriate review queues and ensure medical necessity determinations are made by qualified personnel.
attributes.references: URAC Utilization Management Standards, NCQA UM Standards

attributes.name: requires_peer_to_peer
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status requires or allows peer-to-peer consultation between the requesting provider and a plan medical director. Typically applicable to statuses where initial clinical review suggests denial but provider input is needed before final determination.
attributes.references: URAC Utilization Management Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display order of authorization statuses in user interfaces, reports, and dropdown lists. Lower values appear first, enabling logical presentation of statuses in workflow sequence.

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used for visual representation of the status in dashboards, reports, and user interfaces. Enables consistent color-coding across applications (e.g., green for approved, red for denied, yellow for pending).

attributes.name: icon_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the icon used to represent this status in user interfaces. References a standard icon library to ensure consistent visual representation across applications.

attributes.name: sla_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours an authorization can remain in this status before breaching service level agreement commitments. Used for monitoring turnaround time performance and ensuring regulatory compliance with prompt determination requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR 422.568, State Prompt Pay Laws

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status require escalation to senior clinical staff or management. Used for complex cases, high-risk determinations, or situations requiring additional oversight.

attributes.name: auto_approval_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations can automatically transition to this status based on predefined rules and criteria without manual review. Used for low-risk, routine services that meet auto-approval criteria.

attributes.name: denial_reason_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a denial reason code and explanation must be provided when an authorization is assigned this status. Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements for transparent denial communications.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2719, CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations

attributes.name: allows_retro_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status can be applied to retrospective authorization requests (authorizations requested after service delivery). Used to distinguish between prospective and retrospective authorization workflows.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this authorization status became active and available for use in authorization workflows. Used for temporal tracking of status reference data changes.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this authorization status was retired or became inactive. Null for currently active statuses. Used for temporal tracking and historical analysis of authorization workflows.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this authorization status record was initially created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this authorization status record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: x12_278_status_code
attributes.description: Standard ANSI X12 278 transaction set status code corresponding to this authorization status. Used for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transactions with providers and ensures interoperability with industry-standard authorization request and response formats.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 278 Health Care Services Review Information

attributes.name: hl7_status_code
attributes.description: HL7 standard status code corresponding to this authorization status. Used for integration with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and Health Information Exchange (HIE) platforms supporting HL7 messaging standards.

attributes.name: ncpdp_status_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Status Code
attributes.description: NCPDP standard status code for pharmacy prior authorization transactions. Used when this status applies to pharmacy benefit management authorization workflows and ensures compliance with pharmacy industry EDI standards.

attributes.name: cms_status_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Status Category
attributes.description: CMS-defined status category for Medicare Advantage and Part D authorization reporting. Used for regulatory reporting and compliance with CMS organization determination and coverage determination requirements.

attributes.name: state_reporting_code
attributes.description: State-specific authorization status code used for regulatory reporting to state departments of insurance. Varies by state and supports compliance with state-specific utilization management reporting requirements.

attributes.name: ncqa_hedis_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Reportable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status should be included in HEDIS quality measure reporting. Used to ensure accurate quality reporting and NCQA accreditation compliance.

attributes.name: impacts_medical_loss_ratio
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status impact Medical Loss Ratio calculations for ACA compliance. Final approved statuses typically impact MLR as they represent committed medical expenses.

attributes.name: triggers_claims_processing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status enables or triggers claims processing for the authorized services. Approved statuses typically trigger claims processing, while denied or pending statuses prevent claim payment.

attributes.name: allows_concurrent_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status are eligible for concurrent review (ongoing review during service delivery, typically for inpatient stays). Used to manage continued stay reviews and ensure appropriate length of stay.

attributes.name: allows_retrospective_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status can undergo retrospective review after service delivery. Used for post-service medical necessity determinations and payment recovery scenarios.

attributes.name: member_portal_visible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status should be displayed to members in self-service portals and mobile applications. Some internal workflow statuses may be hidden from member view to avoid confusion.

attributes.name: provider_portal_visible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status should be displayed to providers in provider portals and through Availity or other provider-facing systems. Used to control information sharing with network providers.

attributes.name: interqual_status_mapping
attributes.description: Mapping to corresponding status values in InterQual clinical decision support system. Used for integration with InterQual medical necessity guidelines and automated determination workflows.

attributes.name: mcg_status_mapping
attributes.description: Mapping to corresponding status values in MCG (Milliman Care Guidelines) clinical decision support system. Used for integration with MCG care guidelines and evidence-based determination workflows.

attributes.name: pega_status_code
attributes.description: Status code used in Pegasystems Healthcare platform for care management and utilization management workflows. Enables integration with Pega case management and business process automation.

attributes.name: facets_status_code
attributes.description: Status code used in TriZetto Facets claims administration system. Enables integration with Facets authorization module and ensures consistent status representation across core administration platforms.

attributes.name: qnxt_status_code
attributes.description: Status code used in TriZetto QNXT core administration platform. Supports integration with QNXT membership, claims, and provider network modules for end-to-end authorization processing.

attributes.name: requires_supervisor_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether transitioning an authorization to this status requires supervisor or manager approval. Used for high-risk determinations, large dollar amounts, or sensitive cases requiring additional oversight.

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status should be flagged for quality assurance auditing. Used to ensure determination accuracy, regulatory compliance, and adherence to clinical guidelines.
attributes.references: URAC Utilization Management Standards, NCQA UM Standards

attributes.name: external_review_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status are eligible for external independent review by an Independent Review Organization (IRO). Typically applicable to final adverse determinations under ACA external review requirements.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2719, State External Review Regulations

attributes.name: grievance_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status can trigger member grievance filing. Used to identify statuses that may result in member dissatisfaction and require grievance tracking.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: expedited_review_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations in this status can be processed through expedited review timeframes when the standard timeframe could seriously jeopardize the member's life, health, or ability to regain maximum function.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR 422.572, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: standard_review_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours allowed for standard (non-expedited) review when an authorization is in this status. Used to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements for timely authorization determinations.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR 422.568, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: expedited_review_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours allowed for expedited review when an authorization is in this status and meets expedited criteria. Typically 72 hours or less per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR 422.572, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: system_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status is automatically assigned by system rules and automation rather than manual user selection. Used to distinguish between automated and manual determination workflows.

attributes.name: user_selectable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status can be manually selected by users in authorization workflows. Some statuses may be system-only and not available for manual assignment.

attributes.name: subcategory

attributes.name: clinical_guideline_source

attributes.name: hcpcs_code_applicability

attributes.name: drg_applicability

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: standard_tat_hours

attributes.name: expedited_tat_hours

attributes.name: requires_peer_to_peer

attributes.name: appeal_eligible

attributes.name: external_review_eligible

attributes.name: notification_required

attributes.name: notification_method

attributes.name: documentation_requirements

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: retirement_reason

attributes.name: replacement_reason_code

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display order of approval reasons in user interfaces and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: system_source

attributes.name: external_code

attributes.name: reporting_category

attributes.name: hedis_reportable

attributes.name: cms_reportable

attributes.name: state_reportable

attributes.name: audit_flag

attributes.name: fraud_risk_indicator

attributes.name: cost_impact_level
attributes.description: The typical cost impact level of services approved using this reason. Used for financial forecasting and utilization management prioritization.

attributes.name: utilization_threshold_flag

attributes.name: concurrent_review_required

attributes.name: retrospective_review_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether services approved with this reason are eligible for retrospective review after service delivery. True if post-service review may occur.

attributes.name: network_restriction

attributes.name: provider_specialty_requirement

attributes.name: facility_type_requirement
attributes.description: Required facility type or accreditation for services approved with this reason. Examples: acute care hospital, ambulatory surgery center (ASC), skilled nursing facility (SNF).

attributes.name: authorization_duration_days
attributes.description: Standard duration in days for authorizations approved with this reason. Defines how long the approval remains valid.

attributes.name: max_units_per_authorization
attributes.description: Maximum number of service units (visits, procedures, days) that can be approved in a single authorization using this reason. Null if no limit applies.
attributes.references: Internal UM Policies, Benefit Plan Rules

attributes.name: extension_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorizations using this approval reason can be extended beyond the initial duration. True if extensions are permitted.

attributes.name: reconsideration_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers can request reconsideration of authorization decisions using this approval reason. True if reconsideration process is available.
attributes.references: Internal UM Policies, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: member_cost_share_impact
attributes.description: Indicates how this approval reason affects member cost-sharing (copay, coinsurance, deductible). Used for benefit determination and member communication.

attributes.name: prior_auth_waiver_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval reason can be used to waive prior authorization requirements in specific circumstances. True if PA waiver is possible.
attributes.references: Internal UM Policies, Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: gold_card_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval reason is eligible for gold card or auto-approval programs for high-performing providers. True if gold card benefits apply.

attributes.name: care_coordination_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether care coordination or case management involvement is required for services approved with this reason. True if care management engagement is needed.

attributes.name: disease_management_program
attributes.description: Name of the disease management or care management program associated with this approval reason. Used to link authorizations to population health initiatives.

attributes.name: quality_measure_impact
attributes.description: Description of how this approval reason impacts quality measures, star ratings, or performance metrics. Used for quality improvement tracking.
attributes.references: HEDIS Measures, Medicare Star Ratings, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: value_based_care_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval reason is associated with value-based care arrangements, alternative payment models (APM), or accountable care organizations (ACO). True if VBC alignment exists.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when this approval reason was last reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next review of this approval reason. Used for periodic maintenance and validation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: The department or business unit responsible for maintaining and governing this approval reason. Examples: Utilization Management, Medical Policy, Clinical Operations.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level

attributes.references: Internal UM Delegation of Authority Standards

attributes.name: edi_transaction_code
attributes.description: The EDI transaction code used when transmitting this approval reason in ANSI X12 278 authorization transactions. Used for electronic prior authorization exchange.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 278 Healthcare Services Review Standards

attributes.name: hl7_code
attributes.description: The HL7 or FHIR code used when transmitting this approval reason in interoperability exchanges. Used for health information exchange (HIE) and EHR integration.

products.name: plan
