attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.survey. Business justification: Health risk assessments and care needs evaluations use standardized survey instruments (HRA, PHQ-9, SDOH screening). Survey defines questions; assessment captures member-specific responses and scoring

attributes.name: assessment_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.assessment_type. Business justification: Linking assessment to assessment_type normalizes the assessment taxonomy and removes duplicated type, name, and version fields from assessment.

products.name: assessment_type
products.description: Reference list of assessment types (e.g., HRA, PHQ-9, ADL), with codes, descriptions, and scoring methodology.

attributes.name: assessment_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the assessment type. Primary key for the assessment type reference data.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the assessment type (e.g., HRA, PHQ9, GAD7, ADL, IADL). Used for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the assessment type (e.g., Health Risk Assessment, Patient Health Questionnaire-9, Activities of Daily Living).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the assessment purpose, scope, and clinical application. Explains what the assessment measures and when it should be used.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the assessment type by clinical domain or purpose (e.g., health risk, behavioral health, functional status, chronic condition management).

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the assessment category (e.g., depression screening, diabetes management, mobility assessment).

attributes.name: clinical_domain
attributes.description: Primary clinical domain addressed by the assessment (e.g., physical health, mental health, behavioral health, social determinants of health).

attributes.name: scoring_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to calculate and interpret assessment results (e.g., numeric sum, weighted score, categorical classification, risk stratification algorithm).

attributes.name: scoring_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum possible score for assessments using numeric scoring methodology. Null for non-numeric assessments.

attributes.name: scoring_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum possible score for assessments using numeric scoring methodology. Null for non-numeric assessments.

attributes.name: interpretation_guidance
attributes.description: Clinical guidance for interpreting assessment scores and results, including risk level thresholds and recommended actions based on score ranges.

attributes.name: risk_stratification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment type supports risk stratification of members into low, medium, high risk categories for care management prioritization.

attributes.name: standard_code_system
attributes.description: Industry-standard coding system used to classify this assessment type (e.g., LOINC for clinical observations, CPT for procedures, proprietary for internal assessments).

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: The specific code value from the standard code system that represents this assessment type (e.g., LOINC code 44249-1 for PHQ-9).

attributes.name: standard_code_description
attributes.description: Official description from the standard code system for the assigned code.

attributes.name: administration_method
attributes.description: Primary method by which the assessment is administered to members (e.g., self-administered online, telephonic interview, in-person clinical assessment).

attributes.name: target_population
attributes.description: Description of the member population for which this assessment is designed or most appropriate (e.g., Medicare Advantage members, members with diabetes, behavioral health population).

attributes.name: age_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum age in years for which this assessment is clinically appropriate. Null if no minimum age restriction.

attributes.name: age_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum age in years for which this assessment is clinically appropriate. Null if no maximum age restriction.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Insurance line of business for which this assessment type is applicable (e.g., Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial, Dual Eligible).

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Type of care management or disease management program that utilizes this assessment (e.g., Chronic Care Management, Transitional Care, Complex Case Management, Behavioral Health Integration).

attributes.name: hedis_measure_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment type is used for HEDIS quality measure reporting and performance evaluation.

attributes.name: hedis_measure_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of HEDIS measure codes that utilize this assessment type (e.g., CBP, CDC, COL, BCS).

attributes.name: stars_rating_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment type contributes to CMS Medicare Stars quality rating calculations.

attributes.name: stars_measure_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CMS Stars measure codes that utilize this assessment type.

attributes.name: value_based_care_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment type is used in value-based care contracts, alternative payment models, or accountable care organization quality measures.
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Payment Models, Value Based Care Standards

attributes.name: hcc_coding_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Coding Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assessment results can support or validate HCC diagnosis coding for risk adjustment purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, HCC Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: frequency_recommendation
attributes.description: Recommended frequency for administering this assessment type based on clinical guidelines and care management protocols.
attributes.references: Clinical Practice Guidelines, Care Management Standards

attributes.name: estimated_completion_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average time in minutes required to complete the assessment, used for care management resource planning and member communication.

attributes.name: question_count
attributes.description: Total number of questions or items included in the assessment instrument.

attributes.name: validated_instrument
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment is a clinically validated instrument with established reliability and validity in peer-reviewed literature.

attributes.name: validation_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the clinical validation study or published research supporting the assessment instrument.

attributes.name: copyright_holder
attributes.description: Organization or entity holding copyright or intellectual property rights for the assessment instrument (e.g., Pfizer for GAD-7, public domain).

attributes.name: license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a license or permission is required to use this assessment instrument.

attributes.name: license_terms
attributes.description: Summary of licensing terms, restrictions, or usage conditions for the assessment instrument.

attributes.name: language_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages in which the assessment is available (e.g., English, Spanish, Chinese, Vietnamese) to support diverse member populations.
attributes.references: Cultural and Linguistic Appropriateness Standards, CLAS Standards

attributes.name: cultural_adaptation_notes
attributes.description: Notes on cultural adaptations or considerations for administering the assessment to diverse populations.
attributes.references: Cultural and Linguistic Appropriateness Standards, CLAS Standards

attributes.name: requires_clinical_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether assessment results require review by a licensed clinical professional (nurse, physician, behavioral health specialist) before care plan development.

attributes.name: triggers_intervention
attributes.description: Indicates whether certain assessment results automatically trigger care management interventions, outreach, or escalation protocols.

attributes.name: intervention_threshold
attributes.description: Description of score thresholds or result criteria that trigger care management interventions or escalation (e.g., PHQ-9 score >= 10 triggers depression care management).
attributes.references: Care Management Protocols, Clinical Practice Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment is required by federal or state regulations (e.g., CMS-mandated Health Risk Assessment for Medicare Advantage).

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of specific regulatory requirement, CMS guidance, or state mandate requiring this assessment type.

attributes.name: accreditation_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment is required for NCQA, URAC, or Joint Commission accreditation.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Standards, Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Accreditation organization requiring this assessment type (e.g., NCQA, URAC, Joint Commission).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Standards, Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: data_collection_system
attributes.description: Primary system or platform used to collect and store assessment data (e.g., Pegasystems Care Management, Salesforce Health Cloud, proprietary assessment portal).

attributes.name: integration_method
attributes.description: Technical method for integrating assessment data with core systems (e.g., HL7 interface, FHIR API, EDI transaction, manual data entry).
attributes.references: HL7 Standards, FHIR Standards, Integration Architecture

attributes.name: phi_data_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protected Health Information (PHI) Data Included Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment collects or contains Protected Health Information subject to HIPAA Privacy Rule requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, 45 CFR Part 160 and Part 164

attributes.name: consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit member consent is required before administering this assessment, beyond standard care management authorization.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: data_retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years assessment data must be retained per regulatory, legal, and business requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention, State Insurance Regulations, CMS Requirements

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the assessment type in the care management system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this assessment type became or will become available for use in care management programs.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this assessment type was discontinued or retired from active use. Null for currently active assessments.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the assessment instrument, used to track updates and revisions to the assessment content or scoring methodology.
attributes.references: Clinical Assessment Standards, Version Control Standards

attributes.name: version_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the assessment was released or implemented.
attributes.references: Clinical Assessment Standards, Version Control Standards

attributes.name: supersedes_assessment_type_code
attributes.description: Code of the previous assessment type that this version replaces or supersedes, used to track assessment evolution and maintain historical continuity.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Business department or functional area responsible for maintaining and governing this assessment type (e.g., Care Management, Clinical Quality, Behavioral Health).

attributes.name: subject_matter_expert
attributes.description: Name or role of the clinical subject matter expert responsible for clinical oversight of this assessment type.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this assessment type was last reviewed for clinical appropriateness, regulatory compliance, and operational effectiveness.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this assessment type.

attributes.name: usage_notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, special instructions, or considerations for care managers administering this assessment.

products.name: intervention
products.description: Transactional record of a specific care intervention delivered to a member (e.g., education, counseling, device training).

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the care intervention record. Primary key for the intervention entity.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member receiving the intervention. Links to the member management domain.

attributes.name: care_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the care management or disease management program under which this intervention was delivered.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the member-specific care plan that prescribed this intervention.

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the case management episode associated with this intervention, if applicable.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the intervention in its lifecycle (e.g., scheduled, completed, cancelled, no-show).

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The documented outcome or result of the intervention (e.g., successful, member declined, unable to reach).

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intervention was originally scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the intervention was scheduled to begin.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the intervention was scheduled to end.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the intervention began.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the intervention was completed or ended.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration of the intervention in minutes, calculated from actual start and end times.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The method or modality through which the intervention was delivered (e.g., in-person, telephone, video conference, secure messaging).

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: The channel or setting through which the intervention was accessed (e.g., office, home, telephonic, digital platform).

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: The physical or virtual location where the intervention was delivered (e.g., clinic address, member home, telehealth platform).

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the healthcare provider or facility where the intervention was delivered, if applicable.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier for the healthcare provider associated with the intervention.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the care manager or case manager who delivered or coordinated the intervention.

attributes.name: care_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the care manager or case manager who delivered the intervention.

attributes.name: care_manager_role
attributes.description: The professional role or credential of the care manager who delivered the intervention (e.g., RN, social worker, health educator).

attributes.name: care_manager_credential
attributes.description: Professional credentials or certifications held by the care manager (e.g., RN, LCSW, CCM, CDE).

attributes.name: primary_diagnosis_code
attributes.description: The primary ICD-10 diagnosis code that the intervention is addressing or related to.

attributes.name: primary_diagnosis_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the primary diagnosis associated with the intervention.

attributes.name: secondary_diagnosis_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of secondary ICD-10 diagnosis codes relevant to the intervention.

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: The HCC code associated with the chronic condition being addressed by the intervention, used for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_category
attributes.description: The category of chronic condition that the intervention is targeting (e.g., diabetes, heart failure, COPD).

attributes.name: risk_stratification_level
attributes.description: The member's risk stratification level at the time of the intervention (e.g., low, moderate, high, critical).

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: The member's risk adjustment factor score at the time of the intervention, used for Medicare Advantage risk adjustment.

attributes.name: goal
attributes.description: The specific goal or objective that the intervention is designed to achieve (e.g., improve medication adherence, reduce hospital readmissions).

attributes.name: target_metric
attributes.description: The measurable metric or outcome that the intervention is targeting (e.g., HbA1c level, blood pressure, medication adherence rate).

attributes.name: baseline_value
attributes.description: The baseline measurement or value of the target metric before the intervention was delivered.

attributes.name: post_intervention_value
attributes.description: The measurement or value of the target metric after the intervention was delivered, used to assess effectiveness.

attributes.name: member_engagement_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the member's level of engagement and participation during the intervention.

attributes.name: member_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the member's satisfaction with the intervention, typically on a scale (e.g., 1-5 or 1-10).

attributes.name: member_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text feedback or comments provided by the member about the intervention experience.

attributes.name: barriers_identified
attributes.description: Documentation of barriers to care or intervention success identified during the interaction (e.g., transportation, financial, health literacy).

attributes.name: action_plan
attributes.description: The action plan or next steps agreed upon with the member following the intervention.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether follow-up intervention or contact is required.

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for follow-up intervention or contact with the member.

attributes.name: follow_up_type
attributes.description: The type of follow-up intervention or contact planned (e.g., phone call, visit, assessment).

attributes.name: referral_made_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a referral to another provider, specialist, or service was made as part of the intervention.

attributes.name: referral_type
attributes.description: The type of referral made (e.g., specialist, behavioral health, social services, community resources).

attributes.name: referral_provider_npi
attributes.description: The NPI of the provider or organization to which the member was referred.

attributes.name: referral_reason
attributes.description: The clinical or care management reason for making the referral.

attributes.name: educational_materials_provided
attributes.description: List or description of educational materials, resources, or tools provided to the member during the intervention.

attributes.name: language_of_service
attributes.description: The language in which the intervention was delivered to the member.

attributes.name: interpreter_used_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a language interpreter was used during the intervention.

attributes.name: interpreter_type
attributes.description: The type of interpreter service used (e.g., in-person, telephonic, video).

attributes.name: cultural_considerations
attributes.description: Documentation of cultural, religious, or personal preferences considered during the intervention delivery.

attributes.name: accessibility_accommodations
attributes.description: Description of accessibility accommodations provided (e.g., wheelchair access, hearing assistance, large print materials).

attributes.name: cost_to_member
attributes.description: The out-of-pocket cost to the member for the intervention, if any (e.g., copay, coinsurance).

attributes.name: cost_to_plan
attributes.description: The cost incurred by the health plan for delivering the intervention.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the associated claim if the intervention resulted in a billable service or claim submission.

attributes.name: request_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the prior authorization associated with the intervention, if applicable.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: The status of prior authorization for the intervention (e.g., approved, denied, pending, not required).

attributes.name: hedis_measure_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this intervention contributes to HEDIS quality measure reporting.

attributes.name: hedis_measure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Code
attributes.description: The specific HEDIS measure code that this intervention supports (e.g., CDC, CBP, COL).

attributes.name: stars_measure_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this intervention contributes to Medicare Stars quality rating measures.

attributes.name: stars_measure_code
attributes.description: The specific Medicare Stars measure code that this intervention supports.

attributes.name: value_based_care_program
attributes.description: The value-based care or alternative payment model program associated with the intervention (e.g., ACO, PCMH, bundled payment).

attributes.name: quality_improvement_initiative
attributes.description: The quality improvement or population health initiative that this intervention supports.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The health plan line of business for the member receiving the intervention (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid).

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The type of health insurance product the member is enrolled in (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, SNP).

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: The CMS contract identifier for Medicare Advantage or Part D plans, if applicable.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: The plan benefit package identifier for Medicare Advantage plans, if applicable.

attributes.name: consent_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether member consent was obtained for the intervention and data collection.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which member consent was obtained for the intervention.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The type of consent obtained from the member (e.g., verbal, written, electronic).

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the intervention was delivered in compliance with HIPAA privacy and security requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The source system or application from which the intervention record originated (e.g., Pegasystems, Salesforce Health Cloud).

attributes.name: source_record_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the intervention record in the source system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intervention record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intervention record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intervention was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason why the intervention was cancelled (e.g., member request, scheduling conflict, clinical reason).

attributes.name: rescheduled_from_intervention_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original intervention record if this intervention is a rescheduled version.

attributes.name: contact_attempt_number
attributes.description: The sequential number of contact attempts made to reach the member for this intervention.

attributes.name: contact_successful_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether contact with the member was successfully established.

attributes.name: no_show_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the member failed to attend a scheduled intervention without prior notice.

attributes.name: documentation_complete_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether all required documentation for the intervention has been completed.

attributes.name: documentation_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which all intervention documentation was completed.

attributes.name: audit_trail
attributes.description: Audit trail or change log documenting modifications to the intervention record for compliance and quality assurance.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member receiving the intervention. Links to the member management domain.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the care manager or case manager who delivered or coordinated the intervention.

attributes.name: authorization_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the prior authorization associated with the intervention, if applicable.

attributes.name: assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.assessment. Business justification: Interventions are often triggered by assessments that identify care needs, gaps, or risks. Linking intervention to the triggering assessment enables tracking of assessment-to-intervention workflows an

attributes.name: program_goal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.program_goal. Business justification: Interventions are designed to achieve specific program goals such as HbA1c reduction, smoking cessation, or medication adherence. Linking intervention to program_goal enables tracking of intervention

attributes.name: benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to eligibility.benefit_package. Business justification: Care interventions must reference benefit packages to verify the intervention is a covered service and determine any member cost-sharing or authorization requirements before delivery.

attributes.name: drug_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.drug. Business justification: Medication-based interventions (adherence programs, therapy management) must reference specific drugs. Care teams track which medications are part of clinical interventions for chronic disease managem

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Clinical interventions (home visits, telephonic coaching) incur costs that must be allocated to specific cost centers. Finance uses this for activity-based costing and to calculate per-member-per-mont

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.diagnosis_code. Business justification: Interventions target specific diagnoses (diabetes, CHF, COPD). Care managers document interventions tied to ICD-10 codes for clinical tracking and to support diagnosis validation for risk adjustment s

attributes.name: improvement_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.improvement_plan. Business justification: Care interventions execute quality improvement plans. When quality identifies gaps (low medication adherence rates), care teams deploy specific interventions to improve performance on quality measures

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.fee_schedule. Business justification: Care interventions (care coordination, health coaching) have associated reimbursement rates. Fee schedule defines payment amounts for billable care management activities under value-based contracts.

attributes.name: intervention_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.intervention_type. Business justification: Linking intervention to intervention_type centralizes intervention classification and eliminates redundant descriptive columns.

products.name: intervention_type
products.description: Reference catalog of intervention categories and codes, including description, modality, and associated clinical guidelines.

attributes.name: intervention_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intervention type record. Primary key for the intervention type reference catalog.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code representing the intervention type. Used for system integration and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the intervention type. Human-readable label used in care management workflows and member communications.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the intervention type including purpose, scope, and clinical context. Provides comprehensive information for care managers and clinical staff.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the intervention type grouping similar interventions for reporting and program management purposes.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing more granular categorization within the primary intervention category.

attributes.name: modality
attributes.description: Method or channel through which the intervention is delivered to the member. Indicates the communication or engagement approach used.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth and Remote Care Standards

attributes.name: clinical_focus
attributes.description: Specific clinical condition, disease state, or health concern that the intervention addresses. May reference specific ICD-10 codes or condition categories.

attributes.name: target_population
attributes.description: Description of the member population or demographic group for which this intervention type is designed. May include age ranges, condition criteria, or risk stratification levels.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Requirements

attributes.name: complexity_level
attributes.description: Indicates the level of clinical complexity and resource intensity required to deliver the intervention. Used for care manager workload planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Typical or expected duration of a single intervention session measured in minutes. Used for scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: frequency_recommendation
attributes.description: Recommended frequency or cadence for delivering this intervention type to members. May specify intervals such as weekly, monthly, or as-needed.

attributes.name: clinical_guideline_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical practice guideline, evidence-based protocol, or medical necessity criteria that supports this intervention type. May include guideline name and version.

attributes.name: hedis_measure_alignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Alignment
attributes.description: Identifies which HEDIS quality measures this intervention type supports or contributes to. Used for quality reporting and performance tracking.

attributes.name: stars_rating_impact
attributes.description: Indicates which Medicare Stars rating measures this intervention type may impact. Used for Medicare Advantage quality improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: vbc_program_alignment
attributes.description: Identifies value-based care programs or alternative payment models that this intervention type supports. May reference specific ACO or PCMH initiatives.

attributes.name: hcc_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intervention type is relevant for HCC risk adjustment documentation and coding. Identifies specific HCC categories if applicable.

attributes.name: requires_clinical_license
attributes.description: Indicates whether delivery of this intervention type requires a clinically licensed professional such as RN, LCSW, or physician. Used for care team assignment and compliance.

attributes.name: required_credential_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of professional credential or certification required to deliver this intervention. May include RN, LCSW, CCM, CHW, or other designations.

attributes.name: requires_prior_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intervention type requires prior authorization or medical necessity review before delivery. Used for utilization management workflows.

attributes.name: billable_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intervention type represents a billable service that may generate claims or reimbursement. Used for financial tracking and revenue cycle management.

attributes.name: cpt_code
attributes.description: Five-digit CPT code associated with this intervention type if it represents a billable clinical service. Used for claims processing and reimbursement.

attributes.name: hcpcs_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Code
attributes.description: HCPCS Level II code associated with this intervention type if applicable. Used for billing non-physician services and supplies.

attributes.name: reimbursement_rate
attributes.description: Standard reimbursement rate or payment amount for this intervention type when delivered as a billable service. Amount in US dollars.
attributes.references: Internal Fee Schedule and Reimbursement Policies

attributes.name: lob_applicability
attributes.description: Identifies which lines of business this intervention type applies to. May include Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or multiple LOBs.

attributes.name: medicare_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intervention type is applicable for Medicare Advantage members. Used for program eligibility and compliance.

attributes.name: medicaid_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intervention type is applicable for Medicaid managed care members. Used for program eligibility and state compliance.

attributes.name: commercial_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intervention type is applicable for commercial group and individual members. Used for program eligibility and benefit design.

attributes.name: snp_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intervention type is specifically designed for or applicable to Special Needs Plan members including D-SNP, C-SNP, or I-SNP populations.

attributes.name: member_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit member consent is required before delivering this intervention type. Used for compliance with privacy and consent regulations.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule and State Consent Laws

attributes.name: phi_disclosure_level
attributes.description: Indicates the level of PHI that may be disclosed or discussed during delivery of this intervention type. Used for HIPAA compliance and privacy protection.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 160 and 164

attributes.name: documentation_template
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized documentation template or form used to record delivery of this intervention type. Ensures consistent clinical documentation.

attributes.name: outcome_measure
attributes.description: Primary outcome measure or metric used to evaluate the effectiveness of this intervention type. May include clinical, functional, or satisfaction measures.

attributes.name: success_criteria
attributes.description: Defines the criteria or thresholds that indicate successful completion or effectiveness of this intervention type. Used for quality monitoring and program evaluation.

attributes.name: escalation_pathway
attributes.description: Describes the escalation pathway or next-level intervention if this intervention type is unsuccessful or member needs intensify. Supports care progression planning.

attributes.name: integration_system

products.name: program_goal

attributes.name: is_hcc_relevant

attributes.name: frequency_limit_per_period

attributes.name: provider_credential_required
attributes.description: Specific credentials or certifications required for the provider conducting this care event type (e.g., CCM, CDMS, CHC).

attributes.name: documentation_required

attributes.name: documentation_template

attributes.name: outcome_tracking_required

attributes.name: is_preventive

attributes.name: is_chronic_care

attributes.name: is_transitional_care

attributes.name: is_behavioral_health

attributes.name: is_remote_monitoring

attributes.name: technology_platform

attributes.name: integration_system

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant

attributes.description: Indicates whether this care event type and its delivery method are HIPAA compliant for protected health information (PHI) transmission.

attributes.name: language_support

attributes.name: accessibility_accommodations

attributes.name: cost_per_event

attributes.name: reimbursement_amount

attributes.name: roi_category
attributes.description: The primary ROI category that this care event type contributes to (e.g., cost avoidance, quality improvement, readmission reduction).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current operational status of this care event type in the catalog.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this care event type became or will become active and available for use.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this care event type was or will be terminated and no longer available for use.

attributes.name: version

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date

attributes.name: regulatory_reference

products.name: note
products.description: Free‑text or structured clinical note attached to a case, assessment, or care event, capturing observations, plan, and provider signature.

attributes.name: note_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical or care management note record.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the note indicating its purpose and context within care management workflows.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title or subject line summarizing the content or purpose of the note.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Free-text or structured body of the note containing clinical observations, assessments, care plans, member interactions, and provider recommendations. May contain Protected Health Information (PHI).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the note indicating its approval and finalization state.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the note indicating urgency of review or action required.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Confidentiality classification of the note content, indicating special handling requirements for sensitive health information such as substance abuse treatment or mental health records.

attributes.name: author_name
attributes.description: Full name of the care manager, clinician, or staff member who authored the note.

attributes.name: author_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the healthcare provider or care manager who authored the note, if applicable.

attributes.name: author_role
attributes.description: Professional role or job function of the individual who authored the note.

attributes.name: author_department
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit to which the note author belongs.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the note was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the note was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the note was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the note was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date when the note was electronically signed or approved by the author or reviewing provider.

attributes.name: signed_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the note was electronically signed or approved by the author or reviewing provider.

attributes.name: signed_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who electronically signed or approved the note.

attributes.name: signed_by_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the healthcare provider who signed or approved the note.

attributes.name: encounter_date
attributes.description: Date of the clinical encounter, member interaction, or care event to which this note pertains.

attributes.name: encounter_type
attributes.description: Type of clinical encounter or member interaction documented in the note.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date when the care management service or clinical activity documented in the note was performed.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member to whom this note pertains.

attributes.name: member_name
attributes.description: Full name of the health plan member documented in the note.

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the care management case to which this note is attached.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the care plan associated with this note.

attributes.name: assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health risk assessment or clinical assessment associated with this note.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Name of the care management or disease management program under which this note was created (e.g., Diabetes Management, CHF Program, Behavioral Health).

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Type or category of care management program associated with the note.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.description: Primary ICD-10-CM diagnosis code documented in the note, representing the member's condition or reason for care management.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: diagnosis_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the primary diagnosis or health condition documented in the note.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: Hierarchical Condition Category code associated with the documented diagnosis, used for risk adjustment in Medicare Advantage and other value-based care programs.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Risk adjustment factor score calculated based on the member's documented conditions, used to predict healthcare costs and resource needs.

attributes.name: chief_complaint
attributes.description: Primary reason for the member's contact or the main health concern documented in the note.

attributes.name: subjective_findings
attributes.description: Subjective information reported by the member, including symptoms, concerns, and self-reported health status.

attributes.name: objective_findings
attributes.description: Objective clinical observations, measurements, and assessment findings documented by the care manager or provider.

attributes.name: assessment_summary
attributes.description: Clinical assessment and evaluation of the member's condition, including diagnosis and clinical judgment.

attributes.name: plan_of_care
attributes.description: Documented care plan, treatment recommendations, interventions, and follow-up actions for the member.

attributes.name: interventions
attributes.description: Specific care management interventions, actions, or services provided to the member as documented in the note.

attributes.name: goals
attributes.description: Documented care goals and objectives established for the member's treatment and health improvement.

attributes.name: barriers_to_care
attributes.description: Identified barriers or obstacles affecting the member's ability to access care or adhere to treatment plans, such as transportation, financial constraints, or social determinants of health.

attributes.name: member_engagement_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the member's level of engagement and participation in care management activities as documented in the note.

attributes.name: adherence_status
attributes.description: Member's adherence to prescribed medications, treatment plans, or care recommendations as documented in the note.

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicator of whether follow-up action or contact with the member is required based on the note content.

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for follow-up contact or action with the member as documented in the note.

attributes.name: next_contact_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next scheduled contact or interaction with the member.

attributes.name: contact_method
attributes.description: Method of communication or contact used for the member interaction documented in the note.

attributes.name: contact_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the member contact or interaction in minutes, used for time tracking and billing purposes.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the care management service or member interaction took place.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the healthcare facility, hospital, or care setting where the documented service or encounter occurred.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the healthcare provider or physician involved in the care event documented in the note.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the healthcare provider involved in the care event documented in the note.

attributes.name: provider_specialty
attributes.description: Medical specialty or area of practice of the healthcare provider documented in the note.

attributes.name: referral_made
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a referral to another provider, specialist, or service was made as documented in the note.

attributes.name: referral_to_specialty
attributes.description: Medical specialty or service type to which the member was referred as documented in the note.

attributes.name: authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicator of whether prior authorization is required for services or treatments documented in the note.

attributes.name: authorization_number
attributes.description: Authorization or approval number for services requiring prior authorization as documented in the note.

attributes.name: medication_list
attributes.description: List of current medications documented in the note, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and supplements.

attributes.name: medication_changes
attributes.description: Documentation of any changes to the member's medication regimen, including new prescriptions, discontinuations, or dosage adjustments.

attributes.name: allergies
attributes.description: Documented allergies or adverse reactions to medications, foods, or environmental factors.

attributes.name: vital_signs
attributes.description: Documented vital signs measurements such as blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation.

attributes.name: lab_results
attributes.description: Summary of relevant laboratory test results documented in the note.

attributes.name: hedis_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure
attributes.description: HEDIS quality measure associated with the care documented in the note, used for quality reporting and performance evaluation.

attributes.name: quality_measure_met
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a quality measure or performance metric was met based on the care documented in the note.

attributes.name: gap_in_care
attributes.description: Identified gap in care or missed preventive service documented in the note, such as overdue screenings or immunizations.

attributes.name: social_determinants
attributes.description: Documentation of social determinants of health factors affecting the member, such as housing instability, food insecurity, transportation barriers, or social isolation.

attributes.name: behavioral_health_concerns
attributes.description: Documented behavioral health or mental health concerns, including depression, anxiety, substance use, or other psychological conditions.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act

attributes.name: functional_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the member's functional status and ability to perform activities of daily living (ADL) and instrumental activities of daily living (IADL).
attributes.references: Long-Term Services and Supports Assessment Standards

attributes.name: caregiver_involvement
attributes.description: Documentation of caregiver or family member involvement in the member's care, including their role and level of support.

attributes.name: discharge_plan
attributes.description: Documented discharge plan for members transitioning from inpatient or facility-based care to home or community settings.

attributes.name: transition_of_care
attributes.description: Documentation of care transitions between care settings, providers, or levels of care, including coordination activities.

attributes.name: readmission_risk
attributes.description: Assessed risk level for hospital readmission based on the member's condition and documented factors.

attributes.name: emergency_department_visit
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the note documents an emergency department visit or encounter.

attributes.name: hospitalization
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the note documents an inpatient hospitalization or admission.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health insurance line of business or product type for the member documented in the note.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application from which the note was created or imported (e.g., Pegasystems, Salesforce Health Cloud).

attributes.name: external_note_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the note in the source system, used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.

attributes.name: document_format
attributes.description: Format or structure of the note content, indicating whether it is plain text, structured data, or a specific clinical document standard.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the documentation template or form used to create the note, if applicable.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the note, incremented with each amendment or revision.

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Reason for amending or revising the note after initial creation and signature.

attributes.name: addendum
attributes.description: Additional information or clarification added to the note after initial completion, documented separately from the original content.

attributes.name: reviewed_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who reviewed the note for quality assurance or supervisory purposes.

attributes.name: reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when the note was reviewed by a supervisor or quality assurance reviewer.

attributes.name: cosigned_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who cosigned the note, typically a supervising provider or clinical reviewer.

attributes.name: cosigned_date
attributes.description: Date when the note was cosigned by a supervising provider or clinical reviewer.

attributes.name: deleted_date
attributes.description: Date when the note was marked as deleted or voided in the system.

attributes.name: deleted_reason
attributes.description: Reason for deleting or voiding the note, such as duplicate entry or entered in error.

attributes.name: archived_date
attributes.description: Date when the note was archived for long-term retention and removed from active use.

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years the note must be retained according to regulatory and organizational retention policies.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention Requirements, State Regulations

attributes.name: legal_hold
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the note is subject to a legal hold or preservation order, preventing deletion or modification.

attributes.name: audit_trail
attributes.description: Summary of audit trail information tracking all access, modifications, and actions performed on the note for compliance and security purposes.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member to whom this note pertains.

attributes.name: care_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.care_event. Business justification: Note can be attached to a care_event (as stated in note description: 'attached to a case, assessment, or care event'). This enables documentation of care delivery events including home visits, telehea

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.intervention. Business justification: Notes can document interventions delivered to members (education, counseling, care coordination). Linking note to intervention enables comprehensive documentation of intervention delivery and outcomes

attributes.name: event_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.care_event_type. Business justification: Notes can reference care_event_type for standardized documentation templates and clinical guidelines. This enables consistent documentation across care event types and supports quality measure reporti

attributes.name: documented_by_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider. Business justification: Clinical notes must identify the documenting provider for legal, compliance, and clinical communication purposes. Essential for care coordination and medical record integrity.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.interaction. Business justification: Care managers document notes referencing service interactions when members contact customer service about care programs, creating audit trail linking service and care activities.

attributes.name: breach_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.breach_incident. Business justification: Clinical notes involved in unauthorized PHI access/disclosure must link to breach incident for investigation. Privacy officers track which records were compromised during breach response.

products.name: risk_score_type
products.description: Reference list of risk score categories (HCC, CMS-HCC, VBP risk), with codes and description.

attributes.name: risk_score_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk score type. Primary key for the risk score type reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the risk score type. Used as a business key for system integration and reporting (e.g., HCC, CMS-HCC-V24, CMS-HCC-V28, RxHCC, VBP).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the risk score type. Human-readable label used in reports and user interfaces.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the risk score type, including its purpose, calculation methodology, and use cases within care management and value-based care programs.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the risk score type based on the domain or data source used for calculation (e.g., clinical conditions, pharmacy utilization, behavioral health, social determinants of health, composite scores, predictive models).

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the risk adjustment model or scoring algorithm (e.g., V24, V28 for CMS-HCC models, or year-based versions like 2024). Critical for ensuring correct risk score calculation and CMS compliance.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk score type became active and available for use in risk adjustment calculations and care management programs.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk score type was retired or superseded by a newer version. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the risk score type. Indicates whether the score type is actively used in production systems, deprecated, or pending implementation.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Health insurance program or line of business (LOB) for which this risk score type is applicable (e.g., Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial, ACA Marketplace, Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans, ESRD, PACE, Value-Based Care programs).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: population_segment
attributes.description: Member population segment for which this risk score type is designed (e.g., community, institutional, new enrollee, continuing enrollee, aged, disabled, ESRD, dual eligible). Used to ensure appropriate risk adjustment model application.

attributes.name: calculation_frequency
attributes.description: How often risk scores of this type are calculated or updated (e.g., annual for CMS-HCC, quarterly for care management programs, real-time for predictive models).
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary data source used to calculate risk scores of this type (e.g., claims, encounters, EHR data, pharmacy claims, lab results, health risk assessments, member surveys, administrative data).

attributes.name: coding_system
attributes.description: Medical coding system or classification standard used as input for risk score calculation (e.g., ICD-10-CM for diagnoses, HCPCS for procedures, NDC for pharmacy, RxNorm, SNOMED CT, LOINC for lab results).

attributes.name: hcc_model_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this risk score type is based on the CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk adjustment model. True for CMS-HCC, RxHCC, and HHS-HCC models.

attributes.name: prospective_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this risk score type is used for prospective (forward-looking) risk adjustment and payment calculations, as opposed to concurrent or retrospective scoring.

attributes.name: normalization_factor
attributes.description: Numeric factor used to normalize or calibrate risk scores to a standard baseline (typically 1.0 represents average population risk). Applied by CMS annually to ensure budget neutrality.
attributes.references: CMS Rate Announcement and Call Letter

attributes.name: minimum_score
attributes.description: Minimum allowable risk score value for this score type. Used for validation and to identify data quality issues or outliers.

attributes.name: maximum_score
attributes.description: Maximum allowable risk score value for this score type. Used for validation and to identify data quality issues or outliers.

attributes.name: average_score
attributes.description: Average or mean risk score value across the applicable population for this score type. Used as a benchmark for comparison and population health analytics.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which risk scores of this type are used to determine capitated payments or reimbursement rates. Critical for Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: diagnosis_year
attributes.description: Calendar year from which diagnosis data is collected and used to calculate risk scores of this type. Typically one year prior to payment year for prospective models.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: cms_model_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Model Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this risk score type is an official CMS-published risk adjustment model (e.g., CMS-HCC, RxHCC) versus a proprietary or custom model developed internally or by a third party.

attributes.name: vbc_program_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this risk score type is used in value-based care programs, alternative payment models (APMs), or quality-based reimbursement arrangements.

attributes.name: hedis_measure_alignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Alignment
attributes.description: HEDIS quality measures or domains that this risk score type supports or aligns with (e.g., Comprehensive Diabetes Care, Controlling High Blood Pressure, Care for Older Adults). Used to link risk stratification with quality improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: star_rating_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk score type directly or indirectly impacts CMS Star Ratings for Medicare Advantage plans. Direct impact means the score is used in Star Rating calculations; indirect means it supports quality measures that affect ratings.

attributes.name: care_management_use_case
attributes.description: Specific care management or disease management program use cases for this risk score type (e.g., chronic condition identification, high-risk member stratification, care gap closure, transitional care management, preventive care outreach).

attributes.name: predictive_model_type
attributes.description: Type of predictive modeling or statistical methodology used to generate risk scores of this type (e.g., regression analysis, machine learning, actuarial methods, clinical algorithms, hybrid approaches). Applicable for predictive risk scores.
attributes.references: Society of Actuaries Predictive Modeling Standards

attributes.name: risk_stratification_tiers
attributes.description: Number of risk stratification tiers or levels defined for this risk score type (e.g., 3 tiers: low/medium/high, or 5 tiers: very low/low/moderate/high/very high). Used for care management program assignment and resource allocation.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether risk scores of this type must be submitted to regulatory agencies (e.g., CMS RAPS/EDPS submissions for Medicare Advantage, state Medicaid agencies for managed care). Critical for compliance and payment reconciliation.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: audit_risk_level
attributes.description: Level of audit scrutiny or regulatory oversight associated with this risk score type. High or critical levels indicate scores subject to frequent CMS audits, RADV (Risk Adjustment Data Validation) reviews, or fraud/waste/abuse investigations.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: documentation_requirements
attributes.description: Summary of clinical documentation standards and requirements needed to support risk scores of this type (e.g., face-to-face encounter requirements, diagnosis specificity, medical record documentation standards). Critical for RADV audit compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: coefficient_count
attributes.description: Number of coefficients, condition categories, or variables included in the risk score calculation model. Indicates model complexity and granularity.

attributes.name: interaction_terms_included
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the risk score model includes interaction terms that account for the combined effect of multiple conditions or demographic factors (e.g., diabetes + congestive heart failure interaction in CMS-HCC models).

attributes.name: demographic_factors_included
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether demographic factors (age, gender, Medicaid/disability status, institutional status) are incorporated into the risk score calculation for this score type.

attributes.name: pharmacy_data_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether pharmacy claims or prescription drug data is required as input for calculating risk scores of this type (e.g., true for RxHCC models, false for medical-only HCC models).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: lab_data_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether laboratory test results or clinical measurements are required as input for calculating risk scores of this type. Applicable for clinical risk scores and predictive models.

attributes.name: assessment_data_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Risk Assessment Data Required Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether health risk assessment (HRA) or member survey data is required as input for calculating risk scores of this type. Common for care management and population health risk scores.

attributes.name: recapture_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether diagnoses contributing to this risk score type must be recaptured annually through face-to-face encounters to remain valid for payment year risk adjustment. True for CMS-HCC prospective models.

attributes.name: hierarchical_logic_applied
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether hierarchical logic is applied in the risk score calculation, where more severe conditions supersede less severe conditions within the same disease category (e.g., severe diabetes supersedes uncomplicated diabetes in HCC models).

attributes.name: external_vendor
attributes.description: Name of external vendor or third-party organization that developed or maintains this risk score type, if applicable (e.g., Optum, Milliman, Johns Hopkins ACG System). Null for internally developed or CMS-published models.

attributes.name: license_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a commercial license or subscription is required to use this risk score type. True for proprietary vendor models, false for CMS-published public domain models.

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk score type was first implemented in production systems at Healthcare. Used for tracking model adoption and version history.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk score type reference record was last modified or updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Business department or functional area responsible for maintaining and governing this risk score type (e.g., Care Management, Actuarial, Quality, Medicare Operations). Used for data stewardship and accountability.

attributes.name: technical_documentation_url
attributes.description: URL or hyperlink to detailed technical documentation, model specifications, or reference materials for this risk score type. Supports user self-service and knowledge management.

products.name: cohort_membership
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment of a member into a population health cohort for targeted care management programs. It captures the member's entry into and exit from cohorts, their risk stratification at the time of enrollment, and the current status of their participation. Each record links one member_profile to one cohort with temporal and clinical attributes that exist only in the context of this membership relationship.. Existence Justification: In Healthcare's population health management operations, members are routinely assigned to multiple cohorts simultaneously based on their clinical conditions, risk profiles, and program eligibility (e.g., a member can be in both a 'diabetic' cohort and a 'high-risk' cohort at the same time). Each cohort contains thousands of members who meet the defined inclusion criteria. The business actively manages these memberships through care management teams who track when members enter cohorts, their risk scores at entry, enrollment reasons, and current participation status for program effectiveness reporting and targeted interventions.

attributes.name: estimated_cost

attributes.name: awp_price

attributes.name: mac_price

attributes.name: approval_number

attributes.name: approved_quantity

attributes.name: approved_days_supply

attributes.name: approved_refills
