products.name: drug
products.description: Authoritative catalog of all drugs identified by NDC, including name, strength, dosage form, and manufacturer.

attributes.name: drug_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the drug record in the enterprise data warehouse.

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: The FDA-assigned 11-digit National Drug Code that uniquely identifies the drug product, including labeler, product, and package size. This is the primary industry standard identifier for drugs in the  States.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory, 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: ndc_format
attributes.description: The segment format of the NDC indicating the labeler-product-package configuration (e.g., 5-4-2, 5-3-2, 4-4-2).

attributes.name: labeler_code
attributes.description: The first segment of the NDC identifying the manufacturer or labeler of the drug product.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The second segment of the NDC identifying the specific drug product (strength, dosage form, formulation).

attributes.name: package_code
attributes.description: The third segment of the NDC identifying the package size and type.

attributes.name: proprietary_name
attributes.description: The brand or trade name of the drug as marketed by the manufacturer (e.g., Lipitor, Advil).

attributes.name: non_proprietary_name
attributes.description: The generic or non-proprietary name of the drug, typically the active ingredient name (e.g., atorvastatin, ibuprofen).
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory, USAN ( States Adopted Names)

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The physical form in which the drug is administered (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, cream, inhaler).
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory, USP Dosage Form Standards

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical, subcutaneous, inhalation).
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory, FDA Route of Administration Standards

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The amount of active ingredient per dosage unit (e.g., 10mg, 500mg/5mL, 0.5%).

attributes.name: active_ingredient
attributes.description: The chemical substance in the drug responsible for its therapeutic effect.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory, USP-NF ( States Pharmacopeia-National Formulary)

attributes.name: inactive_ingredients
attributes.description: The non-therapeutic components of the drug formulation (e.g., binders, fillers, preservatives, colorants).

attributes.name: labeler_name
attributes.description: The name of the entity responsible for labeling and distributing the drug, which may differ from the manufacturer.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: The therapeutic or pharmacological classification of the drug (e.g., antihypertensive, antibiotic, analgesic).
attributes.references: AHFS (American Hospital Formulary Service) Drug Classification

attributes.name: therapeutic_category
attributes.description: The broad therapeutic category indicating the primary medical use of the drug (e.g., cardiovascular, anti-infective, central nervous system).
attributes.references: AHFS Therapeutic Classification, WHO ATC Classification

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification indicating the drug's potential for abuse and accepted medical use (Schedule I through V, or Non-Controlled).
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act, 21 CFR Part 1308

attributes.name: rx_otc_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug requires a prescription (Rx) or is available over-the-counter (OTC).

attributes.name: generic_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is a generic formulation (true) or brand-name product (false).

attributes.name: multi_source_code
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug has generic equivalents available: Y (multi-source, generics available), N (single source, no generics), O (originator brand with generics available).

attributes.name: orange_book_code
attributes.description: The FDA Orange Book code indicating therapeutic equivalence rating (e.g., AB, AA, BX) for generic drugs compared to brand reference products.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book (Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations)

attributes.name: awp
attributes.description: The average wholesale price of the drug, commonly used as a benchmark for pharmacy reimbursement calculations. Expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: wac
attributes.description: The manufacturer's list price for the drug to wholesalers or direct purchasers, excluding discounts or rebates. Expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: mac_price
attributes.description: The maximum reimbursement amount established by the payer for multi-source generic drugs. Expressed in US dollars.
attributes.references: PBM MAC Pricing Lists, CMS MAC Pricing

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The price per individual unit of the drug (e.g., per tablet, per milliliter). Expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: The quantity of drug units contained in the package (e.g., 30 tablets, 100 mL, 1 vial).

attributes.name: package_quantity
attributes.description: The numeric quantity of dosage units in the package.

attributes.name: package_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the package quantity (e.g., tablet, capsule, mL, gram, vial).

attributes.name: billing_unit
attributes.description: The standardized unit used for pharmacy claims billing and reimbursement (e.g., each, milliliter, gram).

attributes.name: gpi
attributes.description: The 14-digit Medispan Generic Product Identifier used to group drugs by therapeutic class and chemical composition.

attributes.name: gpi_description
attributes.description: The human-readable description of the GPI classification.

attributes.name: ahfs_code
attributes.description: The AHFS therapeutic classification code used to categorize drugs by pharmacological and therapeutic properties.
attributes.references: AHFS Drug Information, American Society of Health-System Pharmacists

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: The WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code used internationally to classify drugs by organ system and therapeutic properties.

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: The drug's status on the health plan formulary indicating coverage level and restrictions.

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: The formulary tier assignment determining member cost-sharing (copay/coinsurance) levels.

attributes.name: specialty_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is classified as a specialty medication requiring special handling, administration, or monitoring.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires prior authorization approval before dispensing.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires trial of alternative medications before approval.

attributes.name: quantity_limit
attributes.description: The maximum quantity of the drug that can be dispensed per prescription or time period under plan coverage rules.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_period
attributes.description: The time period over which the quantity limit applies (e.g., per fill, per 30 days, per year).

attributes.name: days_supply_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of days supply that can be dispensed per prescription fill.

attributes.name: maintenance_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is used for chronic condition management and eligible for mail order or extended supply.

attributes.name: mail_order_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug can be dispensed through mail order pharmacy services.

attributes.name: compound_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is a compounded medication prepared by combining multiple ingredients.

attributes.name: repackaged_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has been repackaged from bulk containers into smaller units by a repackager.

attributes.name: biosimilar_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is a biosimilar product approved as highly similar to an FDA-approved reference biologic.
attributes.references: FDA Purple Book (Biosimilar and Interchangeable Products)

attributes.name: reference_biologic_ndc
attributes.description: The NDC of the reference biologic product for which this drug is a biosimilar.

attributes.name: interchangeable_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the biosimilar is designated as interchangeable with its reference biologic, allowing pharmacy-level substitution.

attributes.name: vaccine_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is a vaccine product.

attributes.name: blood_product_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is derived from human blood or plasma.
attributes.references: FDA Blood and Blood Products Regulations

attributes.name: refrigeration_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires refrigerated storage conditions.

attributes.name: hazardous_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is classified as hazardous requiring special handling and disposal procedures.

attributes.name: black_box_warning_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has an FDA-mandated black box warning for serious or life-threatening risks.

attributes.name: rems_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires participation in an FDA Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy program.

attributes.name: pregnancy_category
attributes.description: The FDA pregnancy category indicating potential risks to fetus (A=safest, X=contraindicated, N=not classified). Note: FDA replaced this with pregnancy and lactation labeling in 2015.
attributes.references: FDA Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLR)

attributes.name: lactation_risk_category
attributes.description: The classification of risk for use during breastfeeding.
attributes.references: FDA Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLR)

attributes.name: pediatric_use_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is approved for use in pediatric populations.

attributes.name: geriatric_use_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has specific considerations or warnings for geriatric use.

attributes.name: beers_criteria_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is listed in the American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria as potentially inappropriate for older adults.
attributes.references: AGS Beers Criteria for Potentially Inappropriate Medication Use in Older Adults

attributes.name: narrow_therapeutic_index
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has a narrow therapeutic index requiring careful dosing and monitoring.
attributes.references: FDA Narrow Therapeutic Index Drug List

attributes.name: high_alert_medication
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is classified as a high-alert medication with heightened risk of causing significant patient harm when used in error.

attributes.name: look_alike_sound_alike
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has been identified as having look-alike or sound-alike name confusion risks.
attributes.references: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

attributes.name: fda_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Approval Date
attributes.description: The date the drug received FDA approval for marketing in the  States.

attributes.name: patent_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the drug's patent protection expires, allowing generic competition.

attributes.name: exclusivity_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the drug's FDA-granted market exclusivity period expires.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: The date the drug was discontinued from the market by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: market_status
attributes.description: The current market availability status of the drug product.

attributes.name: shortage_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is currently experiencing a supply shortage.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Shortages Database, ASHP Drug Shortages List

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: The FDA recall classification if the drug is subject to a recall (Class I=most serious, Class III=least serious).

attributes.name: daw_code
attributes.description: The NCPDP Dispense As Written code indicating the reason for dispensing a brand drug when a generic is available (0=no product selection indicated, 1=substitution not allowed by prescriber, etc.).

attributes.name: therapeutic_equivalent_group
attributes.description: A grouping identifier for drugs that are therapeutically equivalent and may be substituted for one another.

attributes.name: interaction_severity
attributes.description: The highest severity level of known drug-drug interactions for this medication.
attributes.references: First DataBank Drug Interaction Database, Micromedex

attributes.name: food_interaction_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has clinically significant interactions with food or beverages.

attributes.name: alcohol_interaction_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has contraindications or warnings for concurrent alcohol use.

attributes.name: renal_dosing_adjustment_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires dose adjustment for patients with renal impairment.

attributes.name: hepatic_dosing_adjustment_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires dose adjustment for patients with hepatic impairment.

attributes.name: therapeutic_duplication_class
attributes.description: A classification code used to identify drugs with similar therapeutic effects for detecting therapeutic duplication in drug regimens.

attributes.name: unit_dose_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is packaged in unit-dose format for institutional use.

attributes.name: preservative_free_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug formulation is preservative-free.

attributes.name: latex_free_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug packaging and delivery devices are latex-free.

attributes.name: gluten_free_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug formulation is certified gluten-free.

attributes.name: dye_free_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug formulation is free of artificial dyes and colorants.

attributes.name: sugar_free_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug formulation is sugar-free, relevant for diabetic patients.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has kosher certification.

attributes.name: halal_certified_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has halal certification.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this drug record became effective in the enterprise system.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this drug record was terminated or became inactive in the enterprise system.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: The date when this drug record was last updated with new information from source systems.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this drug record was sourced (e.g., Optum Pharmacy Solutions, First DataBank, Medispan).

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.formulary. Business justification: Each drug must be assigned to a formulary for coverage determination. Pharmacy benefits teams use this daily for eligibility checks, prior authorization decisions, and member cost-share calculations.

attributes.name: manufacturer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.manufacturer. Business justification: Drug records should reference the manufacturer entity rather than storing free‑text name, enabling consistent manufacturer data and removal of redundant column.

products.name: drug_price
products.description: Historical record of drug price values (AWP, MAC) over time for audit and trend analysis.

attributes.name: drug_price_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each drug price record in the historical pricing table.

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: The 11-digit National Drug Code that uniquely identifies the drug product, package size, and manufacturer. Standard format is 5-4-2 (labeler-product-package).

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: The proprietary or brand name of the drug product as marketed.

attributes.name: generic_name
attributes.description: The non-proprietary or generic name of the drug based on its active pharmaceutical ingredient.

attributes.name: labeler_name
attributes.description: The name of the company that manufactures or distributes the drug product.

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: The quantity and unit of measure for the drug package (e.g., 30 tablets, 100 ml).

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The physical form in which the drug is administered (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection).

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The amount of active ingredient per dosage unit (e.g., 500mg, 10mg/ml).

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the drug is administered into the body.

attributes.name: awp
attributes.description: The average wholesale price of the drug, commonly used as a benchmark for pharmacy reimbursement calculations. Represents the published price at which wholesalers sell to pharmacies.

attributes.name: mac
attributes.description: The maximum allowable cost established by the payer for reimbursing a generic drug, typically used to control costs for multi-source generic medications.
attributes.references: CMS MAC Pricing, PBM Pricing Policies

attributes.name: wac
attributes.description: The manufacturer's list price for the drug to wholesalers or direct purchasers, excluding discounts and rebates.

attributes.name: nadac
attributes.description: The national average drug acquisition cost based on invoice prices paid by retail community pharmacies, published by CMS for Medicaid reimbursement.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The price per individual unit of the drug (e.g., per tablet, per ml), calculated from the package price.

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: The type or category of pricing represented in this record (e.g., AWP, MAC, WAC, NADAC, contract price).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this drug price becomes effective and valid for use in claims adjudication and reimbursement.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this drug price is no longer valid or has been superseded by a new price. Null indicates the price is currently active.

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: The source or vendor from which the pricing data was obtained (e.g., First DataBank, Medi-Span, CMS, internal contract).

attributes.name: price_source_file_date
attributes.description: The date of the source pricing file from which this price record was extracted.

attributes.name: price_change_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price represents an increase, decrease, or no change from the previous price for the same drug.

attributes.name: price_change_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change in price compared to the previous price record for the same drug. Positive values indicate increases, negative values indicate decreases.

attributes.name: previous_price
attributes.description: The price value from the immediately preceding price record for the same drug and price type, used for trend analysis.

attributes.name: drug_class
attributes.description: The therapeutic classification of the drug based on its pharmacological action and clinical use.

attributes.name: gpi
attributes.description: The 14-digit Generic Product Identifier that classifies drugs by therapeutic class and chemical structure, used for drug grouping and analysis.

attributes.name: multi_source_code
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is available from a single source (brand only) or multiple sources (generic available).

attributes.name: generic_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is a generic formulation (true) or a brand/innovator product (false).

attributes.name: desi_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the FDA's evaluation of the drug's effectiveness under the Drug Efficacy Study Implementation program.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification (I through V) indicating the drug's potential for abuse and accepted medical use. Non-controlled substances are not scheduled.

attributes.name: otc_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is available over-the-counter without a prescription (true) or requires a prescription (false).

attributes.name: specialty_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as a specialty medication requiring special handling, administration, or monitoring.

attributes.name: biosimilar_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is a biosimilar product approved as highly similar to an FDA-approved reference biologic.

attributes.name: reference_biologic_ndc
attributes.description: The NDC of the reference biologic product for which this drug is a biosimilar, if applicable.

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: The placement of the drug on the health plan's formulary, indicating coverage tier and member cost-sharing level.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization is required before the drug can be dispensed and covered by the health plan.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols must be followed, requiring trial of alternative medications before this drug is covered.

attributes.name: quantity_limit
attributes.description: The maximum quantity of the drug that can be dispensed per prescription or time period under plan coverage rules.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days over which the quantity limit applies (e.g., 30 days, 90 days).

attributes.name: rebate_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is eligible for manufacturer rebates negotiated by the PBM or health plan.

attributes.name: rebate_amount
attributes.description: The negotiated rebate amount per unit that the manufacturer pays back to the PBM or health plan.

attributes.name: rebate_percentage
attributes.description: The negotiated rebate as a percentage of the drug's price that the manufacturer pays back to the PBM or health plan.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee
attributes.description: The fee paid to the pharmacy for dispensing the medication, separate from the drug cost.

attributes.name: ingredient_cost
attributes.description: The cost of the drug ingredient itself, excluding dispensing fees and other charges.

attributes.name: reimbursement_basis
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate pharmacy reimbursement for this drug (e.g., AWP minus percentage, MAC, WAC plus).

attributes.name: reimbursement_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage applied to the pricing basis for calculating pharmacy reimbursement (e.g., AWP minus 15% would be stored as -15.0000).

attributes.name: member_copay_tier_1
attributes.description: The member copayment amount for tier 1 (typically generic) drugs under standard benefit design.

attributes.name: member_copay_tier_2
attributes.description: The member copayment amount for tier 2 (typically preferred brand) drugs under standard benefit design.

attributes.name: member_copay_tier_3
attributes.description: The member copayment amount for tier 3 (typically non-preferred brand) drugs under standard benefit design.

attributes.name: member_coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of drug cost that the member is responsible for paying as coinsurance.

attributes.name: mail_order_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is eligible for dispensing through mail order pharmacy programs.

attributes.name: maintenance_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as a maintenance medication typically used for chronic conditions requiring ongoing therapy.

attributes.name: compound_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is a compounded medication prepared by combining multiple ingredients.

attributes.name: vaccine_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is a vaccine product used for immunization.

attributes.name: 340b_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is eligible for purchase under the federal 340B Drug Pricing Program for covered entities.

attributes.name: orange_book_code
attributes.description: The therapeutic equivalence code from the FDA Orange Book indicating whether generic drugs are therapeutically equivalent to brand-name drugs.

attributes.name: patent_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug's patent protection expires, potentially allowing generic competition.

attributes.name: market_entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug first became available in the market.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug was discontinued by the manufacturer and is no longer available for purchase.

attributes.name: shortage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is currently experiencing a supply shortage as reported by the FDA or manufacturer.

attributes.name: shortage_reason
attributes.description: The reason for the drug shortage if applicable (e.g., manufacturing issue, increased demand, raw material shortage).

attributes.name: therapeutic_alternative_ndc
attributes.description: The NDC of a therapeutically equivalent alternative drug that can be substituted if this drug is unavailable or not covered.

attributes.name: price_update_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this price record was created or last updated in the system.

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: The current status of this price record indicating whether it is active, inactive, pending implementation, or historical.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the prices in this record (typically USD for  States operations).

attributes.name: pricing_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or market to which this pricing applies, as drug prices may vary by region.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the contract or agreement under which this pricing is established, if applicable.

attributes.name: price_verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price has been verified for accuracy against source data or requires review.

attributes.name: price_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this price record, such as special pricing conditions or data quality issues.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Drug pricing is determined by pharmaceutical manufacturer agreements (rebate contracts) and PBM contracts. Adjudication systems lookup contracted prices during real-time claim processing to calculate

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.fee_schedule. Business justification: Drug reimbursement pricing follows contracted fee schedules (AWP, MAC lists). Claims adjudication applies these schedules real-time to calculate pharmacy reimbursement amounts for each dispensed presc

products.name: contract_pharmacy
products.description: Contractual agreement details between the payer and a pharmacy, including reimbursement rates and performance metrics.

attributes.name: contract_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pharmacy contract agreement between the payer and pharmacy provider.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pharmacy contract based on the type of pharmacy services provided.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pharmacy contract agreement.

attributes.name: location_pharmacy_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Provider Identifier
attributes.description: Seven-digit NCPDP provider identification number used for pharmacy claims processing.

attributes.name: pharmacy_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the contracted pharmacy provider.

attributes.name: pharmacy_dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or doing business as name used by the pharmacy if different from legal name.

attributes.name: pharmacy_tax_location_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (EIN) of the pharmacy organization for payment and tax reporting.

attributes.name: pharmacy_chain_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the pharmacy chain or corporate parent if the pharmacy is part of a larger organization.

attributes.name: pharmacy_address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the contracted pharmacy location.

attributes.name: pharmacy_address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, unit, or additional location details.

attributes.name: pharmacy_city
attributes.description: City where the contracted pharmacy is located.

attributes.name: pharmacy_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the contracted pharmacy is located.

attributes.name: pharmacy_zip_code
attributes.description: Five or nine-digit ZIP code of the pharmacy location.

attributes.name: pharmacy_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the pharmacy location.

attributes.name: pharmacy_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the contracted pharmacy.

attributes.name: pharmacy_fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the contracted pharmacy for prescription and authorization communications.

attributes.name: pharmacy_email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for contract communications with the pharmacy.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification of the pharmacy within the payer's network affecting member cost-sharing.

attributes.name: network_participation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the pharmacy is participating in the payer's pharmacy network.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the pharmacy contract becomes active and enforceable.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the pharmacy contract ends or is terminated.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract is scheduled for renewal or renegotiation.

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the contract term expressed in months.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the contract automatically renews at the end of the term.

attributes.name: reimbursement_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to calculate pharmacy reimbursement for dispensed prescriptions.

attributes.name: awp_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to Average Wholesale Price for drug ingredient cost reimbursement.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed fee paid to the pharmacy for each prescription dispensed, covering professional services.

attributes.name: generic_dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dispensing fee amount specifically for generic drug prescriptions.

attributes.name: brand_dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dispensing fee amount specifically for brand-name drug prescriptions.

attributes.name: specialty_dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dispensing fee amount for specialty pharmacy medications requiring special handling.

attributes.name: compound_dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dispensing fee amount for compounded medications prepared by the pharmacy.

attributes.name: vaccine_administration_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee paid to the pharmacy for administering immunizations and vaccines.

attributes.name: mac_pricing_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether Maximum Allowable Cost pricing applies to this contract.

attributes.name: mac_list_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the MAC pricing list used for reimbursement under this contract.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the contract includes performance guarantees or quality metrics.

attributes.name: generic_fill_rate_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage for generic drug utilization as a performance metric in the contract.

attributes.name: generic_fill_rate_actual_percentage
attributes.description: Actual achieved generic drug utilization rate for performance measurement.

attributes.name: mail_order_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy is eligible to provide mail order pharmacy services.

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy is designated as a specialty pharmacy for high-cost medications.

attributes.name: specialty_accreditation_type
attributes.description: Type of specialty pharmacy accreditation held by the pharmacy.

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_service_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy provides 24-hour prescription services.

attributes.name: drive_through_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy offers drive-through prescription pickup services.

attributes.name: home_delivery_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy provides home delivery of prescriptions.

attributes.name: immunization_services_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy is authorized to provide immunization and vaccination services.

attributes.name: medication_therapy_management_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy provides Medication Therapy Management services.

attributes.name: durable_medical_equipment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy dispenses durable medical equipment.

attributes.name: compounding_services_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy provides prescription compounding services.

attributes.name: sterile_compounding_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy is certified for sterile compounding services.

attributes.name: controlled_substance_license_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) Controlled Substance License Number
attributes.description: DEA registration number authorizing the pharmacy to dispense controlled substances.

attributes.name: state_pharmacy_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued license number authorizing the pharmacy to operate and dispense medications.

attributes.name: pharmacy_license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the state pharmacy license requiring renewal.

attributes.name: medicare_part_d_participation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy participates in Medicare Part D prescription drug plans.

attributes.name: medicaid_participation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy participates in state Medicaid pharmacy programs.

attributes.name: three_forty_b_participation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy participates in the federal 340B drug discount program.

attributes.name: claims_submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the pharmacy submits prescription claims to the payer.

attributes.name: electronic_claims_format
attributes.description: NCPDP standard version used for electronic pharmacy claims submission.

attributes.name: real_time_adjudication_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy uses real-time electronic claims adjudication.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to remit payment to the pharmacy for claims.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from claim submission to payment remittance per contract terms.

attributes.name: prompt_pay_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Discount percentage applied if payment is made within prompt pay timeframe.

attributes.name: audit_rights_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payer has contractual rights to audit pharmacy claims and records.

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the payer may conduct audits of the pharmacy per contract terms.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Status of the pharmacy's credentialing and enrollment process with the payer.

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: Date when the pharmacy was credentialed and approved by the payer.

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the pharmacy must undergo recredentialing review.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for contract termination if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for contract termination by either party.

attributes.name: contract_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the payer employee or department responsible for managing this pharmacy contract.

attributes.name: contract_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the contract owner for communication purposes.

attributes.name: pharmacy_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the pharmacy for contract matters.

attributes.name: pharmacy_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title of the primary pharmacy contact person.

attributes.name: pharmacy_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary pharmacy contact for contract communications.

attributes.name: pharmacy_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary pharmacy contact person.

attributes.name: contract_document_location
attributes.description: File path or document management system location where the signed contract is stored.

attributes.name: contract_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the contract document for tracking amendments and revisions.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of amendments made to the original contract agreement.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent contract amendment.

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was signed by both parties.

attributes.name: payer_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized payer representative who signed the contract.

attributes.name: pharmacy_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized pharmacy representative who signed the contract.

attributes.name: hipaa_business_associate_agreement_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Business Associate Agreement Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement is in place with the pharmacy.

attributes.name: baa_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the HIPAA Business Associate Agreement.

attributes.name: data_sharing_permitted_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the contract permits sharing of member data with the pharmacy.

attributes.name: quality_reporting_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pharmacy is required to submit quality metrics and performance reports.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the pharmacy must submit quality and performance reports.

attributes.name: contract_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total financial value of the contract over its term.

attributes.name: minimum_volume_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum number of prescriptions or transaction volume committed under the contract.

attributes.name: exclusivity_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the contract grants exclusive rights or preferred status to the pharmacy.

attributes.name: non_compete_clause_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the contract includes non-compete provisions.

attributes.name: confidentiality_agreement_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the contract includes confidentiality and non-disclosure provisions.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Method specified in the contract for resolving disputes between parties.

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: State whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the contract.

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the contract includes force majeure provisions for unforeseen circumstances.

attributes.name: liability_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum liability amount specified in the contract for damages or losses.

attributes.name: insurance_requirement_amount
attributes.description: Minimum insurance coverage amount required of the pharmacy under the contract.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_on_file_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a current certificate of insurance is on file for the pharmacy.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date

attributes.name: audited_by

attributes.name: pbm_partner_id

attributes.name: payment_id

attributes.name: program_payment_id

attributes.name: receivable_id

attributes.name: rebate_id

products.name: specialty_pharmacy
products.description: Catalog of specialty drugs and associated handling requirements, including prior‑auth workflow and specialty pharmacy network.

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specialty pharmacy entity in the catalog.

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: The 11-digit National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product, labeler, and package size. Primary identifier for specialty drugs in the catalog.

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: The proprietary or brand name of the specialty drug as marketed by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: generic_name
attributes.description: The non-proprietary or generic name of the specialty drug based on its active pharmaceutical ingredient.

attributes.name: drug_classification
attributes.description: Classification category of the drug indicating whether it is a specialty medication requiring special handling, distribution, or administration.

attributes.name: therapeutic_class
attributes.description: The therapeutic classification of the drug based on its primary clinical use and mechanism of action (e.g., immunosuppressants, oncology agents, biologics).
attributes.references: AHFS Therapeutic Classification, USP Therapeutic Categories

attributes.name: disease_state
attributes.description: The primary disease state or medical condition that the specialty drug is indicated to treat (e.g., multiple sclerosis, rheumatoid arthritis, hepatitis C, oncology).

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: The name of the pharmaceutical manufacturer or labeler responsible for producing and distributing the specialty drug.

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The physical form in which the specialty drug is manufactured and administered (e.g., injection, infusion, oral tablet).

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The concentration or potency of the active ingredient in the specialty drug, typically expressed with units (e.g., 50mg, 100mg/mL).

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The pathway by which the specialty drug is administered into the body.

attributes.name: storage_requirements
attributes.description: Special storage conditions required for the specialty drug, such as refrigeration, freezing, or protection from light, to maintain stability and efficacy.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: The minimum temperature in Celsius required for proper storage of the specialty drug.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_celsius
attributes.description: The maximum temperature in Celsius required for proper storage of the specialty drug.

attributes.name: requires_refrigeration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug must be stored under refrigerated conditions.

attributes.name: requires_freezing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug must be stored in frozen conditions.

attributes.name: light_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug is sensitive to light exposure and requires protection from light during storage and handling.

attributes.name: handling_requirements
attributes.description: Special handling instructions for the specialty drug, including preparation, administration, and disposal requirements (e.g., cytotoxic handling, aseptic technique).
attributes.references: USP Chapter 797, OSHA Hazardous Drug Guidelines

attributes.name: requires_prior_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug requires prior authorization approval from the health plan before dispensing.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Guidelines, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: prior_authorization_criteria
attributes.description: The clinical criteria and documentation requirements that must be met for prior authorization approval of the specialty drug.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Guidelines, Clinical Practice Guidelines

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols must be followed, requiring trial of alternative medications before the specialty drug is approved.
attributes.references: CMS Coverage Policies, State Step Therapy Laws

attributes.name: step_therapy_sequence
attributes.description: The ordered sequence of medications that must be tried before the specialty drug can be approved under step therapy protocols.
attributes.references: Clinical Practice Guidelines, Formulary Management Policies

attributes.name: quantity_limit
attributes.description: The maximum quantity of the specialty drug that can be dispensed per prescription or per time period, as defined by the health plan.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Quantity Limit Guidelines, State Pharmacy Regulations

attributes.name: quantity_limit_period_days
attributes.description: The time period in days over which the quantity limit applies (e.g., 30 days, 90 days).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Quantity Limit Guidelines

attributes.name: limited_distribution_drug
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug is available only through a limited distribution network due to manufacturer restrictions or REMS requirements.
attributes.references: FDA REMS Program, Manufacturer Distribution Policies

attributes.name: rems_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug is subject to FDA Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy requirements to ensure safe use.

attributes.name: rems_program_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Program Name
attributes.description: The name of the specific REMS program associated with the specialty drug, if applicable.

attributes.name: network_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug must be dispensed through a designated specialty pharmacy network rather than retail pharmacies.
attributes.references: NCQA Specialty Pharmacy Standards, Health Plan Policies

attributes.name: mail_order_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug can be dispensed through mail order pharmacy services.

attributes.name: home_infusion_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug can be administered via home infusion services rather than requiring facility-based administration.
attributes.references: CMS Home Infusion Therapy Guidelines, State Regulations

attributes.name: requires_patient_monitoring
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug requires ongoing patient monitoring, laboratory testing, or clinical assessments during therapy.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The recommended frequency for patient monitoring activities (e.g., weekly, monthly, quarterly) when using the specialty drug.

attributes.name: requires_adherence_support
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug requires adherence support programs, such as refill reminders, side effect management, or injection training.

attributes.name: awp_unit_price
attributes.description: The Average Wholesale Price per unit of the specialty drug, used as a benchmark for pricing and reimbursement calculations.

attributes.name: wac_unit_price
attributes.description: The Wholesale Acquisition Cost per unit of the specialty drug, representing the manufacturer's list price to wholesalers.

attributes.name: mac_price
attributes.description: The Maximum Allowable Cost established by the health plan for reimbursement of the specialty drug.
attributes.references: Health Plan Pharmacy Benefit Policies, NADAC

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: The formulary tier placement of the specialty drug, which determines member cost-sharing levels.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements, Health Plan Formulary Policies

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: The coverage status of the specialty drug on the health plan formulary.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements, Health Plan Formulary Policies

attributes.name: preferred_alternative_ndc
attributes.description: The NDC of a preferred alternative drug that may be recommended in place of this specialty drug for cost or clinical reasons.

attributes.name: biosimilar_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a biosimilar version of the specialty biologic drug is available in the market.

attributes.name: biosimilar_ndc

attributes.name: orphan_drug_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug has received FDA orphan drug designation for treatment of rare diseases affecting fewer than 200,000 patients.

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug has received FDA breakthrough therapy designation for serious conditions with preliminary clinical evidence of substantial improvement.

attributes.name: fda_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Approval Date
attributes.description: The date on which the specialty drug received FDA approval for marketing.

attributes.name: patent_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the primary patent protection for the specialty drug expires, potentially allowing generic or biosimilar competition.

attributes.name: exclusivity_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which FDA-granted market exclusivity for the specialty drug expires.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book, FDA Purple Book

attributes.name: black_box_warning
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drug carries an FDA black box warning for serious or life-threatening risks.

attributes.name: black_box_warning_text
attributes.description: The text of the FDA black box warning associated with the specialty drug, if applicable.

attributes.name: contraindications
attributes.description: Medical conditions or situations in which the specialty drug should not be used due to risk of harm.

attributes.name: drug_interactions
attributes.description: Known significant drug-drug interactions that may occur when the specialty drug is used concurrently with other medications.

attributes.name: pregnancy_category
attributes.description: The FDA pregnancy category classification indicating the risk level of the specialty drug when used during pregnancy (legacy classification).

attributes.name: pregnancy_lactation_labeling
attributes.description: Current FDA pregnancy and lactation labeling information for the specialty drug under the Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLR).
attributes.references: FDA Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLR)

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification of the specialty drug, if applicable.

attributes.name: dea_number_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) Number Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a DEA number is required for prescribing the specialty drug due to controlled substance status.

attributes.name: accreditation_required
attributes.description: The type of specialty pharmacy accreditation required for dispensing this specialty drug (e.g., URAC, ACHC, Joint Commission).
attributes.references: URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation, ACHC Standards

attributes.name: clinical_program_eligibility
attributes.description: Eligibility criteria for enrollment in clinical support programs associated with the specialty drug (e.g., disease management, case management).

attributes.name: manufacturer_copay_assistance_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug manufacturer offers copay assistance or patient support programs to reduce out-of-pocket costs.

attributes.name: manufacturer_patient_assistance_program

attributes.name: service_requirements

attributes.name: requires_prescriber_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether prescribers must enroll in a special program or registry before prescribing the specialty drug.
attributes.references: FDA REMS Program, Manufacturer Distribution Policies

attributes.name: requires_patient_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether patients must enroll in a special program or registry before receiving the specialty drug.

attributes.name: requires_pharmacy_certification

attributes.name: waste_disposal_requirements
attributes.description: Special requirements for disposal of unused or expired specialty drug product to ensure environmental safety and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: hazardous_drug_classification

attributes.name: requires_compounding

attributes.name: requires_sterile_preparation

attributes.name: requires_cold_chain

attributes.name: refill_restrictions

products.name: dur_rule
products.description: Clinical rules used to evaluate appropriateness of drug therapy during claim processing.

attributes.name: dur_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the drug utilization review rule used to evaluate appropriateness of drug therapy during pharmacy claim processing.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the DUR rule for system identification and reference.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the drug utilization review rule that clearly identifies its clinical purpose.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the clinical logic, conditions, and criteria evaluated by the DUR rule.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DUR rule based on the type of clinical evaluation performed (e.g., drug-drug interaction, therapeutic duplication, dose range).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the clinical issue identified by the DUR rule, ranging from critical (life-threatening) to informational.

attributes.name: action_required
attributes.description: Action that must be taken when the DUR rule is triggered during claim processing (e.g., reject claim, require prior authorization, pharmacist review).

attributes.name: override_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pharmacist or prescriber can override the DUR rule alert with appropriate justification.

attributes.name: override_reason_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a documented reason is required when overriding the DUR rule alert.
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR/PPS Standards, State Board of Pharmacy Regulations

attributes.name: clinical_rationale
attributes.description: Evidence-based clinical justification and medical literature supporting the DUR rule criteria and thresholds.

attributes.name: rule_category
attributes.description: Temporal category indicating when the DUR rule is applied: prospective (before dispensing), concurrent (during dispensing), or retrospective (after dispensing).

attributes.name: evaluation_scope
attributes.description: Scope of data evaluated by the DUR rule, ranging from single prescription to entire patient medication profile or population-level analysis.

attributes.name: lookback_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of historical prescription data to evaluate when applying the DUR rule (e.g., 30, 60, 90 days).

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value that triggers the DUR rule when exceeded (e.g., maximum daily dose, minimum days between refills).

attributes.name: threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the threshold value (e.g., mg for dose, days for duration, percentage for utilization).
attributes.references: UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure)

attributes.name: comparison_operator
attributes.description: Mathematical operator used to compare actual values against the threshold (e.g., greater than, less than, between).

attributes.name: minimum_age_years
attributes.description: Minimum patient age in years for which the DUR rule applies; null if no minimum age restriction.
attributes.references: FDA Prescribing Information, Pediatric Dosing Guidelines

attributes.name: maximum_age_years
attributes.description: Maximum patient age in years for which the DUR rule applies; null if no maximum age restriction.
attributes.references: FDA Prescribing Information, Geriatric Dosing Guidelines

attributes.name: gender_restriction
attributes.description: Gender for which the DUR rule applies; 'all' indicates no gender restriction.

attributes.name: pregnancy_category
attributes.description: FDA pregnancy risk category that triggers the DUR rule for pregnant patients (A=safest, X=contraindicated).

attributes.name: lactation_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DUR rule evaluates risk for breastfeeding mothers.

attributes.name: formulary_status_filter
attributes.description: Formulary status of drugs to which the DUR rule applies; 'all' indicates no formulary restriction.

attributes.name: drug_class_code
attributes.description: Therapeutic or pharmacologic drug class code to which the DUR rule applies (e.g., GPI, AHFS, therapeutic class).
attributes.references: First DataBank GPI, AHFS Drug Information

attributes.name: ndc_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific NDC codes to which the DUR rule applies; null if rule applies to drug classes rather than specific NDCs.

attributes.name: interaction_drug_class
attributes.description: Drug class that interacts with the primary drug in drug-drug interaction rules.

attributes.name: interaction_severity
attributes.description: Clinical severity of the drug-drug interaction identified by the rule.

attributes.name: disease_state_code
attributes.description: ICD-10 diagnosis code or disease state identifier for drug-disease contraindication rules.

attributes.name: allergy_code
attributes.description: Standardized allergy code or allergen identifier evaluated in drug-allergy rules.

attributes.name: minimum_days_supply
attributes.description: Minimum number of days supply required for the prescription to comply with the DUR rule.

attributes.name: maximum_days_supply
attributes.description: Maximum number of days supply allowed for the prescription under the DUR rule.
attributes.references: NCPDP Standards, State Board of Pharmacy Regulations

attributes.name: minimum_quantity
