domains.name: contract
domains.description: Provider contracting and network agreements including fee schedules, capitation arrangements, value-based contracts (VBC), ACO agreements, risk-sharing models, and contract terms. Manages reimbursement methodologies (DRG, APC, fee-for-service) and network adequacy.
domains.references: CMS, Stark Law, AKS, State DOI

products.name: agreement
products.description: Master record for each contractual agreement with providers, payers, or partners, capturing parties, effective dates, termination dates, and overall status.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contractual agreement record. Primary key for the agreement entity.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique agreement number used for reference and communication with providers and internal stakeholders.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the contractual agreement for easy identification and reference.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the agreement based on its primary purpose and reimbursement methodology (e.g., provider network, capitation, fee-for-service, value-based care, ACO, risk-sharing).

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Further classification or subcategory of the agreement type providing additional granularity (e.g., upside-only shared savings, two-sided risk ACO).

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the agreement was formally executed and signed by all parties.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the agreement terms become effective and enforceable, marking the start of the contract period.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the agreement ends or was terminated, marking the conclusion of the contract period.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the agreement is scheduled for renewal or renegotiation.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the agreement automatically renews at the end of its term without requiring explicit action.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for termination or non-renewal of the agreement as specified in contract terms.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Network tier classification assigned to the provider under this agreement, determining member cost-sharing levels.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business or product line to which this agreement applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid).
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_area
attributes.description: Geographic region, state, county, or service area where this agreement is applicable and provider services are covered.
attributes.references: Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: service_categories_covered
attributes.description: Categories of healthcare services covered under this agreement (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, emergency, preventive).

attributes.name: reimbursement_methodology
attributes.description: Primary payment methodology used to reimburse the provider under this agreement (e.g., fee-for-service, capitation, DRG-based).
attributes.references: CMS Payment Methodologies, AMA Reimbursement Standards

attributes.name: fee_schedule_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the fee schedule document or rate table associated with this agreement for fee-for-service reimbursement.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_version
attributes.description: Version number or effective date identifier of the fee schedule currently in effect for this agreement.

attributes.name: medicare_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of Medicare allowable rates used as the basis for reimbursement under this agreement (e.g., 110% of Medicare).

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment amount per member per month paid to the provider under a capitation arrangement.
attributes.references: Capitation Payment Standards, CMS Managed Care Regulations

attributes.name: risk_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Type of financial risk-sharing arrangement between the payer and provider (e.g., upside-only, two-sided risk, full risk capitation).
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Payment Models, Value-Based Care Standards

attributes.name: quality_incentive_program
attributes.description: Name or description of the quality-based incentive or pay-for-performance program included in this agreement.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Standards, CMS Quality Programs

attributes.name: quality_metrics_applicable
attributes.description: List or description of specific quality metrics (e.g., HEDIS measures, CAHPS scores) that apply to this agreement for performance evaluation.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Standards, CMS Star Ratings

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of payment withheld from provider reimbursement for quality performance, risk pool, or other contractual purposes.

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Dollar threshold amount above which stop-loss protection applies to limit provider financial risk for high-cost cases.

attributes.name: claims_submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the provider is required to submit claims under this agreement (e.g., EDI 837, portal, paper).

attributes.name: claims_payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which claims must be paid after receipt of a clean claim, as specified in the agreement.
attributes.references: State Prompt Payment Laws, CMS Regulations

attributes.name: timely_filing_limit_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days after date of service within which the provider must submit claims to be considered timely filed.
attributes.references: Claims Administration Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: credentialing_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether provider credentialing and ongoing recredentialing is required under this agreement.

attributes.name: credentialing_cycle_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required recredentialing cycles for providers under this agreement (typically 24 or 36 months).

attributes.name: utilization_management_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether utilization management and prior authorization requirements apply to services under this agreement.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_services
attributes.description: List or description of specific services or procedures that require prior authorization under this agreement.
attributes.references: Utilization Management Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: care_coordination_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the provider is required to participate in care coordination and care management programs under this agreement.
attributes.references: CMS Care Coordination Standards, NCQA PCMH Standards

attributes.name: data_reporting_requirements
attributes.description: Description of clinical, quality, or administrative data reporting requirements the provider must fulfill under this agreement.
attributes.references: HEDIS Reporting Standards, CMS Quality Reporting

attributes.name: hipaa_business_associate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Business Associate
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the provider is considered a HIPAA Business Associate requiring a Business Associate Agreement (BAA).
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: hold_harmless_clause_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the agreement includes a hold harmless clause prohibiting the provider from balance billing members.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, No Surprises Act

attributes.name: member_balance_billing_prohibited
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the provider is prohibited from balance billing members beyond applicable cost-sharing amounts.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, No Surprises Act

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Method specified in the agreement for resolving disputes between the parties (e.g., mediation, arbitration).

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: State whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this agreement.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of formal amendments that have been executed to modify the original agreement terms.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent amendment to the agreement was executed.

attributes.name: parent_agreement_number
attributes.description: Agreement number of the parent or master agreement if this is a subsidiary or child agreement.

attributes.name: contract_value_total_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated or maximum financial value of the agreement over its term, if applicable and determinable.

attributes.name: annual_contract_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated annual financial value or payment volume expected under this agreement.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for agreement termination if the contract has been terminated or not renewed.

attributes.name: termination_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description or notes explaining the reason for agreement termination.

attributes.name: exclusivity_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this agreement grants exclusive network participation or service rights to the provider in a specific area or service line.

attributes.name: most_favored_nation_clause
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the agreement includes a most favored nation clause guaranteeing rates equal to or better than those offered to other payers.

attributes.name: silent_ppo_prohibited
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the agreement prohibits the rental or sharing of network rates with third parties (silent PPO arrangements).
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, Network Leasing Laws

attributes.name: network_adequacy_compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this agreement contributes to meeting network adequacy requirements for the applicable service area and line of business.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, CMS Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: aco_participation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this agreement involves participation in an Accountable Care Organization model.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Regulations, Medicare Shared Savings Program

attributes.name: aco_model_type
attributes.description: Specific ACO model type if applicable (e.g., Medicare Shared Savings Program, Next Generation ACO, ACO REACH).

attributes.name: value_based_care_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this agreement includes value-based care arrangements linking payment to quality and outcomes.
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Payment Models, Value-Based Care Standards

attributes.name: bundled_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this agreement includes bundled payment arrangements for episodes of care.

attributes.name: telehealth_services_covered
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether telehealth or telemedicine services are covered and reimbursed under this agreement.
attributes.references: State Telehealth Parity Laws, CMS Telehealth Regulations

attributes.name: contract_administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or department responsible for administering and managing this agreement.

attributes.name: contract_administrator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the contract administrator for communication regarding this agreement.

attributes.name: contract_administrator_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the contract administrator for communication regarding this agreement.

attributes.name: document_storage_location
attributes.description: File path, URL, or system location where the executed agreement document and related materials are stored.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this agreement must be filed with state insurance departments or other regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, NAIC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the agreement was filed with the applicable regulatory authority, if required.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory approval was received for this agreement, if required.

attributes.name: audit_rights_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payer retains audit rights to review provider records and billing practices under this agreement.
attributes.references: Contract Management Best Practices, Fraud Prevention Standards

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of performance guarantee, bond, or financial security required from the provider under this agreement.

attributes.name: insurance_requirements
attributes.description: Description of professional liability, general liability, and other insurance coverage requirements the provider must maintain.

attributes.name: minimum_liability_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount of professional liability insurance coverage the provider must maintain under this agreement.
attributes.references: Risk Management Standards, State Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: claims_made_vs_occurrence
attributes.description: Type of professional liability insurance policy required (claims-made or occurrence-based).

attributes.name: rate_increase_cap_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum percentage by which reimbursement rates can increase annually under this agreement, if a cap is specified.

attributes.name: inflation_adjustment_method
attributes.description: Method used to adjust reimbursement rates for inflation over the agreement term (e.g., CPI, medical CPI, fixed percentage).

attributes.name: confidentiality_clause_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the agreement includes confidentiality provisions restricting disclosure of contract terms.

attributes.name: assignment_permitted_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether either party is permitted to assign the agreement to another entity without consent.

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the agreement includes force majeure provisions excusing performance during extraordinary events.

attributes.name: medicare_secondary_payer_compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the agreement includes provisions ensuring compliance with Medicare Secondary Payer rules.

attributes.name: stark_law_compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the agreement has been reviewed for compliance with Stark Law physician self-referral prohibitions.

attributes.name: anti_kickback_compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the agreement has been reviewed for compliance with federal Anti-Kickback Statute provisions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special provisions related to this agreement.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.approval_workflow. Business justification: Agreements follow defined approval workflows based on contract type, value, and risk. Links agreement to its governing workflow definition for approval tracking.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.contract. Business justification: Provider agreements reference master contract records for tracking lifecycle, status, and cross-domain contract management. Used daily by contract administration teams.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.party. Business justification: Store the party reference centrally; agreement now points to party, allowing removal of duplicated provider and contact fields from agreement.

products.name: term
products.description: Individual terms, conditions, and clauses that compose a contract, such as fee schedule references, service obligations, and performance metrics.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract term. Primary key for the term entity.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business-friendly reference number for the contract term, used for identification and tracking in business communications.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract term indicating its functional purpose within the provider contract (e.g., fee schedule, capitation arrangement, performance metric, service obligation).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the contract term for easy identification and reference.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the contract term, including its purpose, scope, and applicability within the provider agreement.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Complete legal or contractual language of the term as it appears in the provider contract document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contract term indicating whether it is draft, pending approval, active, suspended, terminated, expired, amended, or superseded.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract term becomes effective and enforceable.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract term expires or ceases to be in effect, unless renewed or extended.

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract term was last amended or modified.

attributes.name: reimbursement_methodology
attributes.description: Payment methodology specified in the term, such as fee-for-service, Diagnosis Related Group (DRG), Ambulatory Payment Classification (APC), capitation, per diem, case rate, percentage of charges, bundled payment, value-based, shared savings, or risk-sharing arrangements.

attributes.name: payment_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which payment is calculated under this term (per service, Per Member Per Month (PMPM), per episode, per admission, per day, percentage, flat fee, tiered).

attributes.name: payment_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated payment rate or amount specified in the contract term. May represent a dollar amount, percentage, or multiplier depending on payment basis.

attributes.name: payment_rate_type
attributes.description: Type of payment rate specified (fixed dollar amount, percentage of charges, percentage of Medicare rate, percentage of Medicaid rate, multiplier, tiered structure).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for monetary amounts specified in the contract term.

attributes.name: minimum_payment_amount
attributes.description: Minimum payment amount guaranteed under the contract term, if applicable.

attributes.name: maximum_payment_amount
attributes.description: Maximum payment amount or cap specified under the contract term, if applicable.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Category of healthcare services to which this contract term applies (inpatient, outpatient, emergency, professional, ancillary, pharmacy, behavioral health, Durable Medical Equipment (DME), home health, skilled nursing, all services).

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Specific type or subcategory of healthcare service covered by this term within the broader service category.

attributes.name: procedure_code_type
attributes.description: Type of procedure or service coding system referenced in the term (Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS), International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision Procedure Coding System (ICD-10-PCS), Diagnosis Related Group (DRG), Ambulatory Payment Classification (APC), revenue code, National Drug Code (NDC), all, other).

attributes.name: procedure_code_range_start
attributes.description: Starting procedure or service code in a range of codes to which this term applies.

attributes.name: procedure_code_range_end
attributes.description: Ending procedure or service code in a range of codes to which this term applies.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_type
attributes.description: Type of diagnosis coding system referenced in the term (International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision Clinical Modification (ICD-10-CM), ICD-9-CM, Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC), all, other).

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit place of service code(s) to which this contract term applies, as defined by CMS.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Provider network tier to which this contract term applies (tier 1, tier 2, tier 3, preferred, standard, out-of-network, all tiers).

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health insurance line of business to which this contract term applies (commercial, Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicaid, marketplace, individual, small group, large group, Administrative Services Only (ASO), all, other).

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Health insurance product type to which this term applies (Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), indemnity, all, other).

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope or applicability of the contract term (national, regional, state, county, zip code, service area, all, other).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code(s) to which this contract term applies, if geographically limited.

attributes.name: performance_metric_name
attributes.description: Name of the performance metric or quality measure specified in the term, if applicable (e.g., Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) measure, readmission rate, patient satisfaction score).

attributes.name: performance_metric_type
attributes.description: Type or category of performance metric (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS), Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS), Stars rating, clinical outcome, utilization, cost, patient satisfaction, access, other).

attributes.name: performance_target_value
attributes.description: Target value or threshold for the performance metric that must be achieved to satisfy the contract term.

attributes.name: performance_target_operator
attributes.description: Comparison operator for evaluating performance against the target (greater than, greater than or equal, less than, less than or equal, equal, between, other).

attributes.name: performance_measurement_period
attributes.description: Time period over which performance is measured and evaluated (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, measurement year, other).

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Financial incentive or bonus amount payable if performance targets are met, as specified in value-based or performance-based contract terms.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Financial penalty or withhold amount applicable if performance targets are not met or contract obligations are breached.

attributes.name: risk_sharing_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of financial risk shared between the payer and provider under risk-sharing or value-based contract arrangements.

attributes.name: shared_savings_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of cost savings shared with the provider under shared savings arrangements or Accountable Care Organization (ACO) agreements.

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold
attributes.description: Dollar threshold at which stop-loss protection applies to limit provider financial risk in capitation or risk-sharing arrangements.

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Per Member Per Month (PMPM) capitation rate paid to the provider for covered services under capitated arrangements.

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of payment withheld by the payer pending achievement of performance targets or quality metrics.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contract term automatically renews upon expiration unless terminated by either party.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for termination or non-renewal of the contract term.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for termination of the contract term, if terminated before expiration (mutual agreement, breach, non-performance, expiration, regulatory change, business decision, provider request, payer request, other).

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Reason or justification for amendment of the contract term.

attributes.name: amendment_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of changes made to the contract term through amendment.

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory or compliance requirement specified in the term (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, quality reporting, credentialing, data submission, network adequacy, other).
attributes.references: HIPAA, Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act

attributes.name: data_reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the provider must submit data or reports to the payer as specified in the contract term (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, ad hoc, other).

attributes.name: data_reporting_format
attributes.description: Required format for data submission or reporting (Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) 837, EDI 835, EDI 834, Health Level Seven (HL7), Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), flat file, Extensible Markup Language (XML), JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), other).

attributes.name: credentialing_requirement
attributes.description: Specific credentialing or certification requirements that providers must meet as specified in the contract term.

attributes.name: liability_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum liability amount or cap specified in the contract term for either party.

attributes.name: indemnification_scope
attributes.description: Scope and extent of indemnification obligations specified in the contract term.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Method specified for resolving disputes related to this contract term (negotiation, mediation, arbitration, litigation, other).

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: State whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the contract term.

attributes.name: confidentiality_requirement
attributes.description: Confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations specified in the contract term.

attributes.name: audit_right_indicator
