attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason or trigger for initiating this amendment.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the business rationale and circumstances necessitating this amendment.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the terms and conditions of this amendment become legally effective and enforceable.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which all required parties signed and executed the amendment, making it legally binding.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this amendment expires or ceases to be in effect, if applicable for time-limited amendments.

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which formal notice of the proposed amendment was provided to all affected parties.

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: Date on which the amendment was formally requested or initiated by either party.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the amendment received final internal approval from authorized decision makers.

attributes.name: clauses_modified
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured reference to specific contract clauses, sections, or articles being modified by this amendment.

attributes.name: clauses_added
attributes.description: Reference to new clauses, sections, or provisions being added to the agreement through this amendment.

attributes.name: clauses_deleted
attributes.description: Reference to existing clauses, sections, or provisions being removed from the agreement through this amendment.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated annual financial impact of the amendment in dollars, positive for cost increases and negative for savings.

attributes.name: rate_change_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in reimbursement rates specified in this amendment, if applicable.

attributes.name: reimbursement_methodology
attributes.description: Payment methodology being modified or established through this amendment for provider compensation.

attributes.name: vbc_model_type
attributes.description: Type of value-based care arrangement being implemented or modified through this amendment.

attributes.name: quality_measures_modified
attributes.description: List or reference to Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) or other quality measures being added, removed, or modified.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Provider network tier classification being established or changed through this amendment.

attributes.name: lob_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lines of business (commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, etc.) to which this amendment applies.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic regions, states, or service areas affected by this amendment.

attributes.name: service_categories_affected
attributes.description: Healthcare service categories or specialties impacted by this amendment (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, professional, ancillary).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment is required to comply with regulatory or legal mandates.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference to specific regulations, laws, or mandates driving this amendment (e.g., CMS guidance, state insurance department directive).

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment includes provisions for automatic renewal.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for termination as specified or modified in this amendment.

attributes.name: mutual_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether mutual consent from all parties is required for this amendment to be valid.

attributes.name: initiating_party
attributes.description: Party that initiated or requested this amendment (payer, provider, or mutual agreement).

attributes.name: initiator_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or organization that initiated this amendment request.

attributes.name: initiator_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person who initiated this amendment.

attributes.name: initiator_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person who initiated this amendment.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized individual who provided final approval for this amendment.

attributes.name: approver_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the individual who approved this amendment.

attributes.name: legal_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether legal department review and approval was required for this amendment.

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which legal department completed their review of this amendment.

attributes.name: legal_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal counsel or attorney who reviewed this amendment.

attributes.name: compliance_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether compliance department review was required for this amendment.

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which compliance department completed their review of this amendment.

attributes.name: finance_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether finance department review and approval was required for this amendment.

attributes.name: finance_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which finance department completed their review of this amendment.

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique document control number or reference identifier for the physical or electronic amendment document.

attributes.name: document_storage_location
attributes.description: File path, URL, or repository location where the executed amendment document is stored.

attributes.name: signature_method
attributes.description: Method used to execute and sign this amendment (physical wet signature, electronic signature, or digital signature).
attributes.references: Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (ESIGN)

attributes.name: payer_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized representative who signed this amendment on behalf of the health plan or payer.

attributes.name: payer_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title of the payer representative who signed this amendment.

attributes.name: payer_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payer representative signed this amendment.

attributes.name: provider_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized representative who signed this amendment on behalf of the provider or provider organization.

attributes.name: provider_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title of the provider representative who signed this amendment.

attributes.name: provider_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider representative signed this amendment.

attributes.name: witness_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether witness signatures were required for the execution of this amendment.

attributes.name: notarization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether notarization was required for the execution of this amendment.

attributes.name: supersedes_amendment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of a previous amendment that this amendment supersedes or replaces.

attributes.name: related_amendment_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related amendment identifiers that are associated with or dependent on this amendment.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this amendment for processing and approval workflow.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Classification of the sensitivity and confidentiality requirements for this amendment.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the detailed audit trail or change log for this amendment.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal-only notes and observations about this amendment, not shared with external parties.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.approval_workflow. Business justification: Amendments follow defined approval workflows based on amendment type, financial impact, and risk level. Links amendment to its governing workflow definition.

products.name: document
products.description: Metadata for attached legal documents, PDFs, and supporting files linked to an agreement.

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract document record. Primary key for the document entity.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the document type within the contract lifecycle. Identifies whether the document is a primary agreement, amendment, fee schedule, Value-Based Care (VBC) contract, Accountable Care Organization (ACO) agreement, or supporting documentation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the document as it appears in the document management system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the document content, purpose, and scope within the contract context.

attributes.name: file_name
attributes.description: Original file name of the uploaded or attached document including file extension.

attributes.name: file_extension
attributes.description: File format extension indicating the document type (e.g., PDF, DOCX, XLSX).

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the document file in bytes for storage management and validation purposes.

attributes.name: mime_type
attributes.description: MIME type of the document file indicating the nature and format of the file (e.g., application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document).

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical or logical storage path where the document is stored (e.g., cloud storage URI, file system path, document repository identifier).

attributes.name: storage_container
attributes.description: Name of the storage container, bucket, or repository where the document resides (e.g., Azure Blob container, AWS S3 bucket).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number or identifier of the document to track revisions and changes over time.

attributes.name: version_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential numeric version counter for ordering document versions chronologically.

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document version is the current active version. True if current, false if superseded.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document within the contract management workflow.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Classification level indicating the sensitivity and access restrictions for the document.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.308, Information Security Standards

attributes.name: contains_phi
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document contains Protected Health Information subject to HIPAA privacy and security requirements.

attributes.name: contains_pii
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document contains Personally Identifiable Information requiring special handling and protection.

attributes.name: retention_category
attributes.description: Document retention classification determining how long the document must be retained per regulatory and business requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years the document must be retained before eligible for destruction per regulatory and legal requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is subject to a legal hold and cannot be destroyed or modified due to pending or active litigation.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, Litigation Hold Best Practices

attributes.name: checksum_value
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash value (e.g., MD5, SHA-256) of the document file to verify integrity and detect tampering.

attributes.name: checksum_algorithm
attributes.description: Algorithm used to generate the document checksum (e.g., MD5, SHA-256).

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages in the document for reference and indexing purposes.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the primary language of the document content (e.g., EN for English, ES for Spanish).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes legally effective and enforceable within the contract context.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the document expires or is no longer valid within the contract context.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the document was formally executed or signed by authorized parties.

attributes.name: upload_date
attributes.description: Date when the document was uploaded to the document management system.

attributes.name: upload_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the document was uploaded to the document management system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the document metadata or file was last modified.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the document metadata or file was last modified.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the document was formally approved by authorized reviewers or approvers.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the document was formally approved by authorized reviewers or approvers.

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the document review must be completed.

attributes.name: uploaded_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who uploaded the document to the system.

attributes.name: uploaded_by_user_name
attributes.description: Name of the user who uploaded the document to the system.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the document.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_name
attributes.description: Name of the user who approved the document.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application from which the document originated (e.g., HealthEdge, Facets, SharePoint, DocuSign).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the document in the source system for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: is_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document has been formally signed by required parties.

attributes.name: signature_type
attributes.description: Type of signature applied to the document (e.g., electronic signature via DocuSign, wet signature, digital certificate).
attributes.references: ESIGN Act, UETA, Electronic Signature Standards

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the document was signed by the parties.

attributes.name: signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the document was signed by the parties.

attributes.name: is_amendment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is an amendment to an existing contract or agreement.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number or identifier of the amendment if the document is an amendment to a base contract.

attributes.name: parent_document_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent or base document if this document is an amendment, exhibit, or related attachment.

attributes.name: is_template
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is a template used to generate new contract documents.

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the template used to generate this document if applicable.

attributes.name: ocr_processed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document has been processed through Optical Character Recognition to extract text content.

attributes.name: ocr_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0-100) indicating the accuracy of OCR text extraction from the document.

attributes.name: indexed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document has been indexed for full-text search and retrieval.

attributes.name: index_date
attributes.description: Date when the document was indexed for search and retrieval.

attributes.name: keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of keywords or tags associated with the document for search and categorization.

attributes.name: abstract_summary
attributes.description: Brief abstract or summary of the document content for quick reference and search purposes.

attributes.name: author_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or entity who authored or created the document.

attributes.name: author_organization
attributes.description: Organization or department of the document author.

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary recipient or intended audience for the document.

attributes.name: recipient_organization
attributes.description: Organization of the primary recipient or intended audience for the document.

attributes.name: access_control_list
attributes.description: List of users, roles, or groups authorized to access the document, formatted as a comma-separated or JSON structure.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312, Access Control Standards

attributes.name: encryption_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is encrypted at rest and/or in transit for security purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312, NIST SP 800-111

attributes.name: encryption_algorithm
attributes.description: Cryptographic algorithm used to encrypt the document (e.g., AES-256, RSA).

attributes.name: redaction_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document requires redaction of sensitive information before sharing or disclosure.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, Redaction Standards

attributes.name: redaction_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether required redaction of sensitive information has been completed.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, Redaction Standards

attributes.name: audit_trail_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complete audit trail of document access and modifications is available.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312, Audit Control Standards

attributes.name: compliance_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document requires compliance review before execution or distribution.

attributes.name: compliance_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether required compliance review has been completed.

attributes.name: legal_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document requires legal review before execution or distribution.

attributes.name: legal_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether required legal review has been completed.

attributes.name: financial_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document requires financial review before execution or distribution.

attributes.name: financial_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether required financial review has been completed.

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether notification has been sent to relevant parties regarding this document.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when notification was sent to relevant parties regarding this document.

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier assigned by a third party or external system (e.g., provider-assigned document number).

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document must be filed with regulatory authorities (e.g., state insurance departments, CMS).

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether required regulatory filing has been completed.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the document was filed with regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: destruction_eligible_date
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes eligible for destruction based on retention policy and legal requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: destruction_date
attributes.description: Date when the document was actually destroyed or permanently deleted.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: destruction_method
attributes.description: Method used to destroy or permanently delete the document (e.g., secure deletion, shredding, incineration).

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Documents are attached to specific agreements as supporting legal documents, PDFs, and files. Links document metadata to the agreement it supports. No columns to remove as document contains document-s

products.name: payment_term
products.description: Lookup table defining payment cycles, due dates, discount structures, and late fee rules for contracts.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment term record. Primary key for the payment term lookup table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the payment term for use in contracts and billing systems. Examples: NET30, NET60, NET90, DUE_ON_RECEIPT.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the payment term. Examples: Net 30 Days, Net 60 Days, Due on Receipt, 2/10 Net 30.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the payment term including conditions, discount structures, and applicability. Provides context for contract administrators and finance teams.

attributes.name: payment_cycle_type
attributes.description: The frequency or trigger for payment under this term. Supports various reimbursement models including fee-for-service, capitation, and value-based arrangements.

attributes.name: net_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date or service date within which full payment is due without discount. Standard values include 15, 30, 45, 60, 90 days.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered for early payment within the discount period. Example: 2% discount if paid within 10 days (2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment discount.

attributes.name: due_date_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the payment due date. Determines the starting point for counting net days or discount days.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of additional days after the due date before late fees or penalties are applied. Provides flexibility for payment processing delays.

attributes.name: late_fee_type
attributes.description: Type of late fee structure applied when payment is not received within the net days plus grace period. Supports fixed fees, percentage-based fees, or tiered structures.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount charged as a late fee when applicable. Used when late_fee_type is fixed_amount.

attributes.name: late_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of outstanding balance charged as a late fee. Used when late_fee_type is percentage. Subject to state usury laws.

attributes.name: late_fee_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which late fees are assessed for overdue payments. Determines whether fees compound or are assessed once.

attributes.name: maximum_late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total late fee amount that can be charged regardless of outstanding balance or duration. Ensures compliance with regulatory caps.

attributes.name: interest_rate_annual
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to overdue balances. Expressed as a percentage. Must comply with state usury laws and insurance regulations.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate interest on overdue balances. Determines whether interest compounds and at what frequency.

attributes.name: prepayment_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prepayment or early payment is allowed under this payment term without penalty.

attributes.name: prepayment_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Additional discount percentage offered for prepayment beyond the standard early payment discount. Used in value-based contracts.

attributes.name: partial_payment_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether partial payments are accepted under this payment term or if full payment is required.

attributes.name: minimum_payment_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount required for a partial payment to be accepted. Applicable when partial payments are allowed.

attributes.name: minimum_payment_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of total invoice amount required for a partial payment. Alternative to fixed minimum amount.

attributes.name: payment_method_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allowed or restricted payment methods for this term. Examples: ACH only, wire transfer required, no credit cards.

attributes.name: auto_payment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment term is eligible for automatic payment processing through ACH or recurring payment systems.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_days
attributes.description: Number of days allowed for payment disputes to be raised and resolved before late fees apply. Supports claims adjudication disputes.

attributes.name: contract_type_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of contract types where this payment term is applicable. Examples: fee_for_service, capitation, value_based_care, ACO, bundled_payment, DRG, APC.

attributes.name: line_of_business_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lines of business where this payment term applies. Examples: commercial, medicare_advantage, medicaid, exchange, ASO.

attributes.name: provider_type_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of provider types eligible for this payment term. Examples: hospital, physician, ancillary, pharmacy, behavioral_health, DME.

attributes.name: service_category_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service categories where this payment term applies. Examples: inpatient, outpatient, professional, pharmacy, behavioral_health.

attributes.name: quality_incentive_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment term includes eligibility for quality-based incentive payments tied to HEDIS or other quality metrics.

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of payment withheld for quality performance, risk pool, or other contractual purposes. Common in capitation and value-based contracts.

attributes.name: withhold_release_criteria
attributes.description: Description of criteria that must be met for withheld amounts to be released to the provider. May include quality metrics, utilization targets, or financial performance.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which final settlement or reconciliation occurs for capitation, risk-sharing, or value-based payment arrangements.

attributes.name: reconciliation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic reconciliation of payments against actual utilization or performance is required under this payment term.

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months in the reconciliation period for settlement calculations. Common values are 3, 6, or 12 months.

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount threshold above which stop-loss protection applies in risk-sharing arrangements. Protects providers from catastrophic claims.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payment term. Typically USD for  States operations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this payment term becomes active and available for use in contracts. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this payment term is no longer available for new contracts. Existing contracts may continue using the term. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment term. Active terms are available for use in contracts; deprecated terms are phased out.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment term requires state insurance department or CMS approval before use in contracts.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory approval was obtained for this payment term. Required for terms subject to state or federal oversight. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter state code or federal jurisdiction where this payment term is approved for use. Examples: CA, TX, NY, FED.

attributes.name: cms_approved_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Approved Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment term has been approved by CMS for use in Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or other government programs.

attributes.name: aca_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment term complies with ACA requirements for qualified health plans and marketplace products.

attributes.name: erisa_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment term is subject to ERISA regulations for employer-sponsored health plans.

attributes.name: priority_ranking
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the priority or preference order for this payment term when multiple terms are available. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: default_term_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the default payment term to be used when no specific term is selected for a contract.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this payment term record was created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this payment term record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this payment term record. Incremented with each modification to support version control and audit history.

attributes.name: reimbursement_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.reimbursement_method. Business justification: Payment terms define payment cycles and discount structures that are tied to specific reimbursement methodologies (DRG, APC, fee-for-service, capitation). Links payment term to its reimbursement metho

attributes.name: finance_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_account. Business justification: Contract payment terms must specify the GL account for posting payments. Contract setup team configures this so payments automatically post to correct accounts per accounting policy.

products.name: contract_service_area
products.description: Geographic or market area classifications used in contracts to limit provider participation.

attributes.name: contract_service_area_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract service area record. Primary key for the contract service area entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the service area within the contract. Used for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the service area, typically reflecting geographic or market designation.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the service area boundary definition method (county-based, ZIP code-based, Metropolitan Statistical Area, state-level, regional, or custom-defined).

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Breadth of geographic coverage for the service area (local, regional, statewide, multi-state, or national).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation where the service area is located. Used for regulatory compliance and network adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations, State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: county_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of county names or FIPS codes included in the service area. Used for county-based service area definitions.

attributes.name: zip_code_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ZIP codes included in the service area. Used for ZIP code-based service area definitions.

attributes.name: msa_code
attributes.description: Five-digit code identifying the Metropolitan Statistical Area as defined by the Office of Management and Budget. Used for MSA-based service area definitions.

attributes.name: cbsa_code
attributes.description: Five-digit code identifying the Core Based Statistical Area. Used for metropolitan and micropolitan statistical area definitions.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance product associated with the service area: Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Special Needs Plan (SNP), Private Fee-For-Service (PFFS), or other.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the provider network tier or breadth within the service area (tier 1, tier 2, tier 3, narrow, broad, exclusive, or standard).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the service area within the contract (active, inactive, pending approval, suspended, terminated, or expired).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the service area becomes active and operational under the contract.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the service area is no longer active under the contract. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the service area is scheduled for renewal or renegotiation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the service area was approved by regulatory authorities or internal governance.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_status
attributes.description: Compliance status of the service area against network adequacy requirements (compliant, non-compliant, under review, waiver granted, or pending certification).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: network_adequacy_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the service area received network adequacy certification from regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: minimum_provider_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of providers required in the service area to meet network adequacy standards.

attributes.name: actual_provider_count
attributes.description: Current number of contracted providers actively serving the service area.

attributes.name: pcp_count
attributes.description: Number of Primary Care Physicians contracted within the service area.

attributes.name: specialist_count
attributes.description: Number of specialist physicians contracted within the service area.

attributes.name: hospital_count
attributes.description: Number of hospital facilities contracted within the service area.

attributes.name: member_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Current number of members enrolled in plans associated with this service area.

attributes.name: maximum_enrollment_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of members that can be enrolled in the service area based on network capacity and regulatory limits.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment availability status for the service area (open for new enrollments, closed, limited capacity, or suspended).

attributes.name: time_distance_standard_met
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time and Distance Standard Met Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the service area meets time and distance standards for member access to providers.

attributes.name: maximum_travel_distance_miles
attributes.description: Maximum travel distance in miles that members may need to travel to access in-network providers within the service area.

attributes.name: maximum_travel_time_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum travel time in minutes that members may need to travel to access in-network providers within the service area.

attributes.name: urban_rural_designation
attributes.description: Classification of the service area as urban, suburban, rural, frontier, or mixed based on population density and geographic characteristics.

attributes.name: population_density_category
attributes.description: Categorization of population density within the service area (high, medium, low, or very low).

attributes.name: total_population
attributes.description: Total population count within the service area boundaries based on census data.

attributes.name: medicare_eligible_population
attributes.description: Number of Medicare-eligible individuals within the service area based on demographic data.

attributes.name: medicaid_eligible_population
attributes.description: Number of Medicaid-eligible individuals within the service area based on state program data.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether regulatory approval is required for this service area from state or federal authorities.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by regulatory authorities for the service area filing or approval.

attributes.name: cms_contract_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Contract Number
attributes.description: CMS-assigned contract number for Medicare Advantage or Part D plans associated with the service area.

attributes.name: cms_plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Plan Benefit Package Identifier
attributes.description: CMS-assigned identifier for the plan benefit package associated with the service area.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the service area including geographic boundaries, coverage specifics, and any special considerations.

attributes.name: exclusion_list
attributes.description: List of specific geographic areas, ZIP codes, or counties explicitly excluded from the service area coverage.

attributes.name: special_provisions
attributes.description: Text describing any special provisions, exceptions, or unique terms applicable to the service area.

attributes.name: border_county_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the service area includes counties on state borders, which may have special cross-border access provisions.

attributes.name: out_of_area_coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of coverage provided to members when they are outside the defined service area (emergency only, urgent care, full coverage, or none).

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Risk adjustment factor applied to the service area based on member demographics and health status for Medicare Advantage payment calculations.

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: CMS Star Rating assigned to plans operating in the service area, ranging from 1.0 to 5.0 stars.

attributes.name: benchmark_rate
attributes.description: CMS benchmark payment rate for Medicare Advantage plans in the service area, expressed as a dollar amount.

attributes.name: county_ffs_rate
attributes.description: Average Medicare Fee-For-Service spending rate for the counties in the service area, used for benchmark calculations.

attributes.name: quality_bonus_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage bonus applied to benchmark rates based on Star Ratings quality performance in the service area.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the service area record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the service area record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the service area was last reviewed for network adequacy, compliance, or operational performance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of the service area for network adequacy, compliance, or operational performance.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Provider contracts specify which insurance plans they accept in their service area. Enrollment systems validate member eligibility by checking if provider's contract covers the member's specific plan.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Service areas (counties, zip codes) define geographic coverage within agreements. Eligibility system validates member residence against contract service areas during enrollment.

products.name: specialty_coverage
products.description: Lookup of medical specialties covered or excluded under a contract.

attributes.name: specialty_coverage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specialty coverage record within the contract.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider contract to which this specialty coverage applies.

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the medical specialty (e.g., taxonomy code, internal specialty classification).
attributes.references: National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: specialty_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the medical specialty (e.g., Cardiology, Orthopedic Surgery, Family Medicine).
attributes.references: National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: specialty_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the specialty for network adequacy and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty is covered, excluded, or has limited coverage under the contract.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the specialty coverage applies to in-network, out-of-network, or both provider types.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the specialty coverage becomes effective under the contract.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the specialty coverage ends or is terminated under the contract.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why a specialty is excluded or has limited coverage (e.g., not medically necessary, experimental, out of scope).

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization is required for services within this specialty under the contract.

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a referral from a Primary Care Physician (PCP) is required to access this specialty.

attributes.name: reimbursement_method
attributes.description: Method by which providers are reimbursed for services within this specialty (e.g., Fee-For-Service (FFS), Diagnosis Related Group (DRG), Ambulatory Payment Classification (APC), capitation).

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fee schedule applicable to this specialty coverage.

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment per member for specialty services under capitation arrangements.

attributes.name: case_rate_amount
attributes.description: Fixed payment amount per case or episode of care for this specialty.

attributes.name: risk_sharing_arrangement
attributes.description: Type of financial risk-sharing arrangement between the payer and provider for this specialty (e.g., upside only, two-sided risk, full risk).

attributes.name: quality_incentive_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether quality-based incentive payments apply to this specialty coverage.

attributes.name: quality_measure_set
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the quality measure set used to evaluate performance for this specialty (e.g., Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS), Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS)).

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification of providers within this specialty for tiered network products.

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Fixed copayment amount members pay for specialty services under this contract.

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of allowed amount that members pay for specialty services (e.g., 20% coinsurance).

attributes.name: deductible_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan deductible applies to services within this specialty.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Out of Pocket Maximum (OOP) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialty services count toward the member's annual out-of-pocket maximum.

attributes.name: service_limit_type
attributes.description: Type of service limitation applied to this specialty (e.g., visit limit, dollar limit, unit limit).

attributes.name: service_limit_quantity
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of the service limit (e.g., 20 visits per year, 30 days per admission).

attributes.name: service_limit_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the service limit applies (e.g., per year, per lifetime, per episode).

attributes.name: age_restriction_min
attributes.description: Minimum member age for which this specialty coverage applies.

attributes.name: age_restriction_max
attributes.description: Maximum member age for which this specialty coverage applies.

attributes.name: gender_restriction
attributes.description: Gender-specific restriction for specialty coverage (e.g., obstetrics for female members).

attributes.name: diagnosis_restriction
attributes.description: Specific diagnosis codes or conditions for which this specialty coverage is restricted or required (International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) codes).

attributes.name: procedure_restriction
attributes.description: Specific procedure codes for which this specialty coverage is restricted or required (Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) or Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) codes).

attributes.name: place_of_service_restriction
attributes.description: Specific place of service codes where this specialty coverage applies (e.g., office, hospital, telehealth).
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set

attributes.name: telehealth_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether telehealth services are covered for this specialty under the contract.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business to which this specialty coverage applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicaid, Marketplace, Administrative Services Only (ASO)).

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Type of health plan product to which this specialty coverage applies (e.g., Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP)).

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Market segment to which this specialty coverage applies (e.g., large group, small group, individual, government programs).

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Geographic area or service area where this specialty coverage applies (e.g., state codes, county codes, ZIP codes).

attributes.name: network_adequacy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is subject to network adequacy requirements for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: essential_health_benefit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty coverage is classified as an Essential Health Benefit under the Affordable Care Act (ACA).

attributes.name: preventive_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether services within this specialty are classified as preventive services with no cost-sharing under ACA.

attributes.name: credentialing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers must be credentialed in this specialty to deliver covered services under the contract.

attributes.name: board_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether board certification in the specialty is required for providers under the contract.

attributes.name: center_of_excellence_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty coverage is limited to designated Centers of Excellence for high-quality, specialized care.

attributes.name: value_based_contract_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty coverage is part of a value-based care contract arrangement.

attributes.name: aco_participation_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accountable Care Organization (ACO) Participation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this specialty must participate in an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) arrangement.

attributes.name: bundled_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty coverage uses bundled payment methodology for episodes of care.
attributes.references: CMS Bundled Payments for Care Improvement (BPCI) Standards

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold
attributes.description: Dollar threshold above which stop-loss reinsurance applies for high-cost specialty cases.

attributes.name: carve_out_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is carved out to a separate vendor or Third Party Administrator (TPA) for management.

attributes.name: carve_out_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the vendor or Third Party Administrator (TPA) managing the carved-out specialty services.

attributes.name: claims_processing_system
attributes.description: System or platform used to adjudicate claims for this specialty coverage (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: auto_adjudication_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether claims for this specialty are eligible for automated adjudication without manual review.

attributes.name: medical_policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or name of the medical policy governing coverage decisions for this specialty.

attributes.name: clinical_guideline_reference
attributes.description: Reference to clinical guidelines or criteria used for utilization management of this specialty (e.g., InterQual, Milliman Care Guidelines (MCG)).

attributes.name: fraud_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) risk level for this specialty based on historical patterns.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Detection Standards

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which claims or provider performance for this specialty are audited for compliance and accuracy.

attributes.name: contract_amendment_number
attributes.description: Amendment number if this specialty coverage was added or modified via contract amendment.

attributes.name: amendment_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the contract amendment that introduced or modified this specialty coverage.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether state or federal regulatory approval is required for this specialty coverage.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance and CMS Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory approval was obtained for this specialty coverage.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance and CMS Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding special conditions, exceptions, or clarifications for this specialty coverage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specialty coverage record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specialty coverage record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of this specialty coverage record in the system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this specialty coverage data originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: benefit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.benefit. Business justification: Provider contracts define which specific benefits they cover (e.g., cardiology, orthopedics). Contract management uses this to ensure providers are credentialed for benefits they're contracted to deli

attributes.name: board_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.board_certification. Business justification: Specialty coverage in contracts requires specific board certifications. Contract terms specify which board certifications qualify for specialty reimbursement rates - used in contract configuration and

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.formulary. Business justification: Specialty contracts (oncology, transplant) reference specific formularies for covered medications. Pharmacy benefits and medical management use this for specialty drug authorization.

products.name: exclusion_criteria
products.description: Conditions, procedures, or diagnoses excluded from reimbursement under a contract.

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the exclusion criteria record within the contract management system.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code representing the specific exclusion criteria for quick reference and system processing.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or title of the exclusion criteria for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the exclusion criteria, including the rationale and scope of what is excluded from reimbursement.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the exclusion criteria type, indicating whether it applies to diagnoses, procedures, services, drugs, devices, supplies, facilities, provider types, member conditions, or other categories.

attributes.name: exclusion_type
attributes.description: Specifies the nature of the exclusion: absolute (never covered), conditional (excluded under certain circumstances), partial (some aspects excluded), temporary (time-limited exclusion), or permanent (indefinite exclusion).

attributes.name: icd_10_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Code
attributes.description: ICD-10 diagnosis code that is excluded from reimbursement under the contract terms, if the exclusion is diagnosis-based.

attributes.name: cpt_code
attributes.description: CPT procedure code that is excluded from reimbursement under the contract terms, if the exclusion is procedure-based.

attributes.name: hcpcs_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Code
attributes.description: HCPCS code for services, supplies, or equipment that is excluded from reimbursement under the contract terms.

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: DRG code representing an inpatient stay classification that is excluded from reimbursement under the contract terms.

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: National Drug Code identifying a specific drug product that is excluded from pharmacy benefit reimbursement under the contract.

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: UB-04 revenue code representing a hospital service or accommodation type that is excluded from reimbursement.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the location where services are rendered that are excluded from reimbursement under the contract.

attributes.name: modifier_code
attributes.description: Two-character CPT or HCPCS modifier code that, when applied to a procedure, triggers exclusion from reimbursement.

attributes.name: provider_specialty_code
attributes.description: Taxonomy or specialty code identifying provider types whose services for specific procedures or diagnoses are excluded from reimbursement.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Broad service category (e.g., cosmetic surgery, experimental treatment, infertility services) that is excluded from coverage under the contract.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason or rationale for the exclusion, such as lack of medical necessity, experimental status, cosmetic nature, investigational status, lack of FDA approval, duplicate service, bundled service, contractual limitation, regulatory exclusion, plan design, or other.

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: Specific regulatory statute, rule, or guideline that mandates or supports the exclusion (e.g., ACA Section 1302, CMS NCD reference).

attributes.name: clinical_rationale
attributes.description: Clinical or medical justification for the exclusion, often referencing evidence-based guidelines or lack of clinical efficacy.

attributes.name: applies_to_lob
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lines of business (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Exchange) to which this exclusion criteria applies.

attributes.name: applies_to_plan_type
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of plan types (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP) to which this exclusion criteria applies.

attributes.name: member_age_min
attributes.description: Minimum age of the member for whom this exclusion criteria applies. Null if no minimum age restriction.

attributes.name: member_age_max
attributes.description: Maximum age of the member for whom this exclusion criteria applies. Null if no maximum age restriction.

attributes.name: member_gender
attributes.description: Gender of the member to whom this exclusion criteria applies. Values: male, female, all, other.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Geographic area (state, region, or service area code) where this exclusion criteria applies. Null if no geographic restriction.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the exclusion criteria becomes active and enforceable for claims adjudication.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the exclusion criteria is no longer active. Null if the exclusion is ongoing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the exclusion criteria: active (in force), inactive (not in use), pending (awaiting approval), suspended (temporarily halted), or expired (past termination date).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status of the exclusion criteria: draft, pending review, approved, rejected, or withdrawn.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role who approved the exclusion criteria for use in contracts.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the exclusion criteria, supporting change tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: supersedes_exclusion_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the previous exclusion criteria record that this version replaces or supersedes.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the priority or precedence of this exclusion when multiple exclusions may apply to the same claim.

attributes.name: applies_to_network_tier
attributes.description: Network tier or participation status to which this exclusion applies: in-network, out-of-network, all, or specific tier levels.

attributes.name: frequency_limit_type
attributes.description: Type of frequency limitation associated with the exclusion, if applicable: per day, per week, per month, per year, per lifetime, per episode, or none.

attributes.name: frequency_limit_value
attributes.description: Numeric value representing the maximum allowed occurrences within the frequency limit type period. Null if no frequency limit applies.

attributes.name: dollar_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount allowed for reimbursement before the exclusion takes effect. Null if no dollar limit applies.

attributes.name: dollar_limit_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the dollar limit amount applies: per service, per day, per month, per year, per lifetime, or none.

attributes.name: requires_prior_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether services subject to this exclusion require prior authorization before they can be considered for any exception or appeal.

attributes.name: appeal_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether claims denied based on this exclusion criteria are eligible for member or provider appeal.

attributes.name: exception_process_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether an exception process exists that could override this exclusion under specific circumstances.

attributes.name: exception_criteria
attributes.description: Description of the conditions or criteria under which an exception to this exclusion may be granted.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standard code used in claim denial messages when a claim is rejected based on this exclusion criteria.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Claim Adjustment Reason Codes

attributes.name: denial_message_text
attributes.description: Standard text message provided to members and providers when a claim is denied based on this exclusion criteria.

attributes.name: eob_display_text
attributes.description: Member-friendly text displayed on the Explanation of Benefits when this exclusion is applied to a claim.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal operational notes or comments about the exclusion criteria for use by contract management and claims teams.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or platform from which this exclusion criteria record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this exclusion criteria in the source system of record.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this exclusion criteria record in the source system.

attributes.name: is_medicare_exclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exclusion is mandated by Medicare regulations and applies to Medicare Advantage or Part D plans.

attributes.name: is_medicaid_exclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exclusion is mandated by Medicaid regulations and applies to Medicaid managed care plans.

attributes.name: is_aca_mandated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exclusion is mandated or influenced by Affordable Care Act essential health benefits requirements.

attributes.name: hedis_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Impact
attributes.description: Description of how this exclusion criteria may impact HEDIS quality measure reporting and performance.

attributes.name: quality_measure_impact
attributes.description: Description of how this exclusion criteria may impact quality measures, star ratings, or value-based care performance.

attributes.name: fwa_risk_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Risk Indicator
attributes.description: Risk level indicating the potential for fraud, waste, or abuse related to claims involving this exclusion criteria.

products.name: inclusion_criteria
products.description: Conditions, procedures, or diagnoses required for reimbursement eligibility under a contract.

attributes.name: inclusion_criteria_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inclusion criteria record.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the contract to which this inclusion criteria applies.

attributes.name: criteria_type
attributes.description: Type of criteria such as diagnosis, procedure, medication, service, or lab test.

attributes.name: criteria_code
attributes.description: Standard code representing the diagnosis, procedure, medication, etc.

attributes.name: criteria_code_system
attributes.description: The coding system used for the criteria code.

attributes.name: criteria_description
attributes.description: Human readable description of the inclusion criteria.

attributes.name: inclusion_status
attributes.description: Current status of the inclusion criteria.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the inclusion criteria becomes effective.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the inclusion criteria expires.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the record.

attributes.name: eligibility_flag

attributes.name: required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the criteria is mandatory for claim acceptance.

attributes.name: minimum_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units required for eligibility.

attributes.name: maximum_quantity

attributes.name: frequency_limit
attributes.description: Maximum frequency the service/medication can be provided within a time period.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates if prior authorization is required for the criteria.

attributes.name: prior_auth_code
attributes.description: Code used to request prior authorization.

attributes.name: medical_necessity_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating the service/medication meets medical necessity criteria.

attributes.name: reimbursement_method
attributes.description: Method used to reimburse the service under the contract.

attributes.name: reimbursement_rate
attributes.description: Monetary amount or rate paid per unit of service.

attributes.name: reimbursement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the reimbursement rate.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_type
attributes.description: Type of cost sharing applied to the member.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount the member must pay (e.g., copay).

attributes.name: cost_sharing_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the charge the member is responsible for (e.g., coinsurance).

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Category of provider delivering the service.

attributes.name: provider_specialty_code
attributes.description: Standard code representing the provider's specialty.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic area where the inclusion criteria applies.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the criteria is applicable.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Business line to which the contract belongs.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of health plan contract.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service is in-network or out-of-network.

attributes.name: clinical_guideline_reference
attributes.description: Reference to external clinical guideline supporting the criteria.

attributes.name: clinical_guideline_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the clinical guideline.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Factor used to adjust payments based on patient risk.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the inclusion criteria.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version of the inclusion criteria record.

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates if this record is the latest version.

products.name: performance_metric
products.description: Metrics (e.g., HEDIS, quality scores) tied to value‑based contracts for performance‑based payments.

attributes.name: performance_metric_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance metric record tied to value-based contracts.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this performance metric to the specific provider contract or value-based care (VBC) agreement.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the healthcare provider or provider organization whose performance is being measured.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit unique identification number for the healthcare provider as assigned by CMS.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number for the provider organization used for payment and reporting.

attributes.name: metric_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the performance metric being tracked (e.g., Diabetes HbA1c Control, Breast Cancer Screening Rate).

attributes.name: metric_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the performance metric, often aligned with HEDIS or quality measure sets.

attributes.name: metric_type
attributes.description: Category of the performance metric indicating the measurement framework or domain.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS, CMS Star Ratings, CAHPS Standards

attributes.name: measure_set
attributes.description: The quality measure set or program to which this metric belongs (e.g., HEDIS 2023, Medicare Stars 2024, ACO Quality Measures).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS, CMS Quality Payment Program

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the performance metric is reported to regulatory bodies or used for payment calculations.

attributes.name: numerator
attributes.description: The count or value representing the number of members or events meeting the performance metric criteria.

attributes.name: denominator
attributes.description: The count or value representing the total eligible population or events for the performance metric.

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: The count of members or events excluded from the denominator based on clinical or administrative criteria.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The calculated performance rate expressed as a percentage (numerator divided by denominator).

attributes.name: benchmark_rate
attributes.description: The industry or regional benchmark rate used for comparison, often derived from national or state percentiles.

attributes.name: percentile_rank
attributes.description: The percentile ranking of the provider's performance rate compared to national or regional benchmarks.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: The performance tier assigned based on the achieved rate relative to target and benchmark thresholds, determining payment level.

attributes.name: achievement_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider met, exceeded, or did not meet the target performance rate for this metric.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of financial penalty assessed against the provider for failing to meet the metric target, if applicable.
attributes.references: Value-Based Contract Terms, GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: payment_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is eligible for performance-based payment based on this metric's achievement.
