products.name: approval_workflow
products.description: Configuration of multi‑step approval processes required before a contract becomes active.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the approval workflow configuration. Primary key for the approval workflow entity.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the approval workflow configuration used for identification and reference purposes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the approval workflow purpose, scope, and business context.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Classification of the approval workflow based on the type of contract action requiring approval (e.g., new contract, amendment, renewal, termination).

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of provider contract this workflow applies to, indicating the reimbursement methodology or contract structure (e.g., Fee-for-Service (FFS), Capitation, Value-Based Contract (VBC), Accountable Care Organization (ACO) agreement).
attributes.references: CMS Payment Models, NAIC Model Regulations

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business (LOB) to which this approval workflow applies, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicaid, or Marketplace products.
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The network tier classification this workflow applies to, indicating provider network positioning and reimbursement levels.
attributes.references: Internal Network Management Standards, NCQA Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: The type of healthcare provider this approval workflow applies to (e.g., Physician, Hospital, Ancillary, Behavioral Health (BH), Durable Medical Equipment (DME), Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)).
attributes.references: CMS Provider Taxonomy, NPPES Provider Type Standards

attributes.name: specialty_type
attributes.description: The medical specialty or subspecialty this approval workflow applies to (e.g., Cardiology, Orthopedics, Primary Care).
attributes.references: CMS Specialty Codes, AMA Physician Specialty Codes

attributes.name: contract_value_threshold_min
attributes.description: The minimum contract value amount that triggers this approval workflow. Contracts below this threshold may follow a different or simplified approval process.

attributes.name: contract_value_threshold_max
attributes.description: The maximum contract value amount for which this approval workflow applies. Contracts exceeding this threshold may require escalated approval processes.

attributes.name: threshold_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency code for contract value thresholds, typically USD for  States operations.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: The risk classification level associated with contracts requiring this approval workflow, based on financial exposure, regulatory requirements, or business impact.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Management Framework, Enterprise Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: approval_sequence_count
attributes.description: The total number of sequential approval steps configured in this workflow before a contract can be activated.

attributes.name: parallel_approval_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether multiple approval steps can be executed in parallel (true) or must be completed sequentially (false).

attributes.name: unanimous_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether all approvers in a parallel approval step must approve (true) or if a majority/threshold is sufficient (false).

attributes.name: approval_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of approvers who must approve in a parallel approval step when unanimous approval is not required (e.g., 75.00 means 75% must approve).

attributes.name: auto_escalation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the workflow automatically escalates to a higher authority if approval is not received within the specified timeframe.

attributes.name: escalation_timeout_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours after which an approval request is automatically escalated if no response is received from the assigned approver.

attributes.name: sla_response_hours
attributes.description: The target number of hours within which an approver should respond to an approval request, as defined by internal Service Level Agreement (SLA) standards.

attributes.name: sla_completion_hours
attributes.description: The target number of hours within which the entire approval workflow should be completed from initiation to final approval or rejection.

attributes.name: delegation_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an assigned approver can delegate their approval authority to another authorized individual.

attributes.name: reassignment_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an approval task can be reassigned to a different approver by a workflow administrator or system.

attributes.name: comments_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether approvers must provide comments or justification when approving or rejecting a contract in this workflow.

attributes.name: rejection_comments_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether comments are mandatory specifically when rejecting a contract approval request.

attributes.name: attachment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation or attachments must be provided with the approval request for this workflow.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The method(s) used to notify approvers of pending approval requests (e.g., Email, SMS, Portal, Mobile App).

attributes.name: reminder_frequency_hours
attributes.description: The frequency in hours at which reminder notifications are sent to approvers for pending approval requests.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complete audit trail of all approval actions, timestamps, and approver identities must be maintained for compliance and regulatory purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance, HIPAA Security Rule, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: electronic_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether approvers must provide an electronic signature as part of the approval process for legal and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ESIGN Act, UETA, Internal Legal Standards

attributes.name: two_factor_authentication_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether approvers must use two-factor authentication (2FA) when accessing and approving contracts in this workflow for enhanced security.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule, Internal Information Security Standards

attributes.name: compliance_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dedicated compliance review step is required as part of this approval workflow to ensure regulatory adherence.
attributes.references: HIPAA, ACA, State Insurance Regulations, Internal Compliance Standards

attributes.name: legal_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a legal department review is required as part of this approval workflow to assess contractual terms and legal risks.

attributes.name: finance_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a finance department review is required to assess financial impact, budget availability, and pricing adequacy.

attributes.name: clinical_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a clinical or medical director review is required to assess quality of care, clinical appropriateness, and network adequacy considerations.
attributes.references: NCQA Standards, Internal Clinical Quality Standards

attributes.name: network_adequacy_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a network adequacy assessment is required to ensure the contract supports regulatory network access and availability standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations, CMS Network Adequacy Requirements

attributes.name: credentialing_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether provider credentialing verification must be completed and current before contract approval can proceed.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, URAC Standards, CMS Credentialing Requirements

attributes.name: background_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check on the provider or contracting entity is required as part of the approval process.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Management Standards, Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Prevention

attributes.name: exclusion_screening_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether screening against federal and state exclusion lists (OIG, SAM, state Medicaid exclusions) is required before contract approval.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion List, SAM.gov, State Medicaid Exclusion Lists, Anti-Kickback Statute

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_check_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Conflict of Interest Check Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a conflict of interest assessment must be performed to identify potential conflicts between the provider and approvers or the organization.
attributes.references: Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, Internal Ethics Standards

attributes.name: rate_validation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether contracted rates must be validated against market benchmarks, fee schedules, or internal pricing guidelines before approval.
attributes.references: Internal Pricing Standards, CMS Fee Schedules

attributes.name: budget_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether budget availability and allocation approval is required before the contract can be approved.

attributes.name: executive_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether executive leadership approval (e.g., C-suite, VP-level) is required for this contract approval workflow.

attributes.name: board_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Board of Directors approval is required for high-value or strategically significant contracts.
attributes.references: Corporate Governance Standards, Internal Governance Standards

attributes.name: auto_approval_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether contracts meeting specific criteria can be automatically approved without manual intervention.

attributes.name: auto_approval_criteria
attributes.description: The specific business rules and criteria that must be met for a contract to be automatically approved (e.g., value below threshold, standard terms, pre-approved provider).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version number of this approval workflow configuration, incremented when changes are made to the workflow structure or rules.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the approval workflow configuration (e.g., Draft, Active, Inactive, Suspended, Archived).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this approval workflow configuration becomes effective and begins to be applied to new contract approval requests.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this approval workflow configuration expires and is no longer applied to new contract approval requests.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The date on which this approval workflow configuration was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this approval workflow configuration was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The date on which this approval workflow configuration was most recently modified or updated.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this approval workflow configuration was most recently modified or updated.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this approval workflow configuration itself was approved for use in production.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this approval workflow configuration itself was approved for use in production.

attributes.name: activated_date
attributes.description: The date on which this approval workflow configuration was activated and made available for use.

attributes.name: deactivated_date
attributes.description: The date on which this approval workflow configuration was deactivated and removed from active use.

attributes.name: archived_date
attributes.description: The date on which this approval workflow configuration was archived for historical record-keeping purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval workflow has been validated for compliance with applicable regulatory requirements (HIPAA, ACA, state regulations).

attributes.name: sox_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval workflow meets Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Act requirements for financial controls and audit trails.

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval workflow meets Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) requirements for Protected Health Information (PHI) handling and security.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to approval requests processed through this workflow, affecting processing order and escalation urgency.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or division within Healthcare that owns and manages this approval workflow configuration.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic scope to which this approval workflow applies (e.g., National, Regional, State-specific, Local market).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state code if this approval workflow is specific to a particular state's regulatory or business requirements.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: The market segment this approval workflow applies to (e.g., Individual, Small Group, Large Group, National Accounts, Government Programs).

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: The organizational authority level required for final approval in this workflow (e.g., Manager, Director, Vice President, C-suite, Board).

attributes.name: exception_handling_process
attributes.description: Description of the process for handling exceptions or special cases that do not fit the standard approval workflow criteria.

attributes.name: rollback_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an approval can be rolled back or reversed after it has been granted, subject to specific conditions and authorization.

attributes.name: resubmission_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a rejected contract can be modified and resubmitted through the same approval workflow.

attributes.name: max_resubmission_count
attributes.description: The maximum number of times a rejected contract can be resubmitted through this approval workflow before requiring escalation or alternative handling.

attributes.name: integration_system_name
attributes.description: The name of the external or upstream system that integrates with this approval workflow (e.g., HealthEdge HealthRules, Pegasystems, Salesforce).

products.name: clause
products.description: Reusable clause definitions that can be referenced by multiple contracts, capturing clause type, text, and legal attributes.

attributes.name: clause_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract clause definition. Primary key for the contract clause entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to reference the clause in contracts and documentation. Enables quick lookup and standardized referencing across contract documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name of the contract clause that describes its purpose or subject matter.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Categorization of the clause based on its legal or business function within the contract. Determines the nature of obligations, rights, or terms being defined.
attributes.references: Contract Law Standards, ERISA, ACA Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Full legal text of the contract clause as it appears in contract documents. Contains the complete wording of terms, conditions, obligations, and rights.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Brief plain-language summary of the clause purpose and key provisions for business users who need to understand the clause without reading full legal text.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the clause text to track revisions and updates over time. Follows semantic versioning format (major.minor).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the clause definition indicating whether it is available for use in new contracts.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this clause must be included in all contracts of certain types due to legal, regulatory, or business policy requirements.
attributes.references: Contract Management Best Practices, Regulatory Compliance Standards

attributes.name: is_negotiable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the terms within this clause can be modified or negotiated with providers during contract discussions.

attributes.name: is_standard
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a standard boilerplate clause used across most contracts versus a specialized or custom clause.

attributes.name: applicable_contract_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of contract types where this clause is applicable or commonly used (e.g., provider agreements, ACO contracts, capitation agreements, VBC contracts).

attributes.name: applicable_lob
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lines of business where this clause applies, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or specific product types.

attributes.name: applicable_provider_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of provider types or specialties where this clause is relevant (e.g., hospitals, physicians, ancillary providers, behavioral health).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Reference to specific regulatory or legal requirement that mandates or influences this clause (e.g., HIPAA, ACA, state insurance law, CMS regulations).
attributes.references: HIPAA, ACA, CMS Regulations, State Insurance Laws

attributes.name: legal_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic or legal jurisdiction where this clause is applicable or enforceable. May reference specific states or federal jurisdiction.
attributes.references: Contract Law Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this clause version became available for use in contracts.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this clause version is no longer available for use in new contracts. Null if the clause has no planned expiration.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this clause was last reviewed by legal or compliance teams for accuracy and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Contract Management Best Practices, Compliance Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this clause to ensure continued relevance and compliance.
attributes.references: Contract Management Best Practices, Compliance Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who approved this clause for use in contracts (e.g., Chief Legal Officer, Compliance Director).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this clause version was formally approved for use in contracts.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Business department or functional area responsible for maintaining and updating this clause (e.g., Legal, Network Contracting, Compliance).

attributes.name: owner_contact
attributes.description: Name or email of the primary contact person responsible for this clause definition.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of active contracts currently referencing this clause. Helps assess clause importance and impact of changes.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the legal or financial risk associated with this clause. High-risk clauses require more scrutiny during contract negotiations.
attributes.references: Risk Management Standards, Contract Management Best Practices

attributes.name: financial_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the potential financial impact this clause may have on contract economics or organizational financial exposure.

attributes.name: compliance_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the regulatory or compliance significance of this clause. High-impact clauses are critical for regulatory adherence.

attributes.name: requires_legal_review
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether any modification to this clause requires formal legal department review before use.

attributes.name: requires_compliance_review
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether any modification to this clause requires formal compliance department review before use.

attributes.name: parent_clause_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent clause if this clause is a variant or sub-clause of a broader standard clause. Enables hierarchical clause organization.

attributes.name: supersedes_clause_id
attributes.description: Reference to a previous clause version that this clause replaces or supersedes. Maintains version history and lineage.

attributes.name: related_clauses
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of clause IDs or codes that are commonly used together with this clause or have related subject matter.

attributes.name: keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of keywords or tags for search and categorization purposes. Enables efficient clause discovery and filtering.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code indicating the language in which the clause text is written (e.g., ENG for English, SPA for Spanish).

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the source document, template, or legal precedent from which this clause was derived or adapted.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, guidance, or context about the clause usage, interpretation, or special considerations.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why this clause version was created or modified. Documents the business or legal rationale for changes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this clause record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this clause record was last updated or modified.

products.name: reimbursement_method
products.description: Reference list of reimbursement methodologies (DRG, APC, bundled, fee‑for‑service) used in contracts.

attributes.name: reimbursement_method_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the reimbursement methodology used in provider contracts.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the reimbursement methodology (e.g., DRG, APC, FFS, CAP, BUNDLED).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the reimbursement methodology (e.g., Diagnosis Related Group, Ambulatory Payment Classification, Fee-for-Service).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of how the reimbursement methodology works, including calculation logic and applicability.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the reimbursement approach (prospective, retrospective, capitation, fee-for-service, value-based, bundled, case rate, per diem, percentage of charges).

attributes.name: payment_basis
attributes.description: The unit or basis upon which payment is calculated (per service, per case, per diem, per member per month, per episode, percentage, flat rate).

attributes.name: risk_sharing_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method includes risk-sharing arrangements between payer and provider.

attributes.name: value_based_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method is a value-based care arrangement tied to quality metrics and outcomes.

attributes.name: apm_category
attributes.description: CMS Alternative Payment Model category classification if applicable (Category 1A through 4C based on risk and quality requirements).

attributes.name: applicable_service_types
attributes.description: Types of healthcare services to which this reimbursement method applies (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, professional, facility, pharmacy, ancillary).

attributes.name: applicable_provider_types
attributes.description: Types of healthcare providers for which this reimbursement method is used (e.g., hospital, physician, SNF, DME, home health).

attributes.name: applicable_lob
attributes.description: Lines of business where this reimbursement method is applicable (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Exchange, ASO).

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of how payment amounts are calculated under this reimbursement method, including formulas and adjustment factors.

attributes.name: base_rate_type
attributes.description: The type of base rate used in payment calculation (fixed amount, percentage of charges, percentage of Medicare, percentage of billed, negotiated rate, market-based, cost-based).

attributes.name: adjustment_factors_applicable
attributes.description: List of adjustment factors that may be applied to base rates (e.g., geographic, case mix, outlier, quality, readmission penalties).

attributes.name: outlier_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method includes provisions for outlier payments for unusually high-cost cases.

attributes.name: stop_loss_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method includes stop-loss protection limiting provider financial risk.

attributes.name: quality_incentive_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method includes quality-based incentive payments or penalties.

attributes.name: quality_measures_applicable
attributes.description: List of quality measure sets applicable to this reimbursement method (e.g., HEDIS, CAHPS, clinical quality measures).

attributes.name: bundled_payment_type
attributes.description: If this is a bundled payment method, specifies the type of bundling (retrospective, prospective, acute only, acute and post-acute, post-acute only, episode-based).
attributes.references: CMS Bundled Payments for Care Improvement

attributes.name: episode_duration_days
attributes.description: For episode-based or bundled payment methods, the number of days covered in the payment episode.
attributes.references: CMS Bundled Payments for Care Improvement

attributes.name: capitation_type
attributes.description: If this is a capitation method, specifies the type (full risk, partial risk, primary care only, specialty, facility, global capitation).

attributes.name: pmpm_calculation_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: Per Member Per Month (PMPM) Calculation Basis
attributes.description: For capitation methods, specifies how the member count is determined for PMPM calculation (enrolled, eligible, attributed, active members).

attributes.name: drg_version
attributes.description: If this method uses DRG-based payment, specifies the DRG classification system version (MS-DRG, APR-DRG, AP-DRG, IR-DRG).

attributes.name: apc_version
attributes.description: If this method uses APC-based payment, specifies the APC classification system version (CMS APC, EAPG).

attributes.name: conversion_factor_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a conversion factor is applied to relative value units or other base units to calculate payment amounts.

attributes.name: geographic_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment rates are adjusted based on geographic location or practice cost differences.

attributes.name: case_mix_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment rates are adjusted based on patient acuity or case mix complexity.

attributes.name: hcc_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment rates are adjusted based on HCC risk scores for patient population.

attributes.name: shared_savings_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method includes shared savings arrangements where providers share in cost savings achieved.

attributes.name: shared_savings_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of cost savings that providers receive under shared savings arrangements.

attributes.name: downside_risk_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers bear downside financial risk (potential losses) under this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of payment withheld pending achievement of quality or utilization targets.

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which payment reconciliation occurs for risk-sharing or value-based arrangements (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, per episode).

attributes.name: minimum_volume_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of cases, members, or services required for this reimbursement method to apply.

attributes.name: carve_out_services
attributes.description: List of services excluded or carved out from this reimbursement method and paid separately (e.g., pharmacy, behavioral health, transplants).

attributes.name: carve_in_services
attributes.description: List of services explicitly included or carved into this reimbursement method that might typically be paid separately.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this reimbursement methodology (active, inactive, pending, deprecated, suspended).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this reimbursement method becomes effective for use in contracts.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this reimbursement method is no longer valid for use in new contracts.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory approval from CMS or state insurance departments is required to use this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory approval was obtained for this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: cms_model_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Model Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the CMS payment model or demonstration project this reimbursement method is based on (e.g., BPCI-A, CJR, OCM).

attributes.name: aco_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method is applicable for use in ACO arrangements.

attributes.name: pcmh_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method is applicable for use in PCMH programs.

attributes.name: medicare_advantage_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method is approved for use in Medicare Advantage plans.

attributes.name: medicaid_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method is approved for use in Medicaid managed care plans.

attributes.name: commercial_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method is applicable for use in commercial health insurance products.

attributes.name: aso_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method is applicable for use in ASO arrangements.

attributes.name: network_tier_applicable
attributes.description: Network tiers for which this reimbursement method is applicable (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Preferred, Standard, Out-of-Network).

attributes.name: specialty_specific_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method is designed for specific medical specialties rather than general application.

attributes.name: applicable_specialties
attributes.description: List of medical specialties for which this reimbursement method is designed (e.g., cardiology, oncology, orthopedics).

attributes.name: claims_processing_system_code
attributes.description: Code used in claims adjudication systems to identify and apply this reimbursement method during claims processing.

attributes.name: pricing_engine_code
attributes.description: Code used in pricing engines to identify and apply this reimbursement method during contract pricing and rate setting.

attributes.name: contract_template_reference
attributes.description: Reference to standard contract template or language associated with this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: financial_reporting_category
attributes.description: Category used for financial reporting and medical loss ratio calculation purposes (e.g., capitation, fee-for-service, risk-sharing).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, MLR Reporting

attributes.name: mlr_treatment
attributes.description: How payments under this reimbursement method are treated for MLR calculation purposes (claims expense, quality improvement, excluded, other).

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether risk adjustment factors are applied to payment calculations under this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: risk_corridor_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether risk corridor provisions apply to limit financial gains or losses under this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: reinsurance_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether reinsurance arrangements apply to this reimbursement method for high-cost cases.

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which contracts using this reimbursement method are audited for compliance and accuracy (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, ad-hoc).

attributes.name: documentation_requirements
attributes.description: Specific documentation requirements for claims or payment reconciliation under this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization is typically required for services paid under this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: utilization_management_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether utilization management processes apply to services paid under this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: transparency_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reimbursement method requires public transparency reporting under federal or state regulations.

attributes.name: machine_readable_file_inclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment rates under this reimbursement method must be included in machine-readable transparency files.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this reimbursement method definition to track changes over time.

attributes.name: predecessor_method_code
attributes.description: Code of the previous reimbursement method that this version replaces or supersedes.

attributes.name: successor_method_code
attributes.description: Code of the reimbursement method that replaces or supersedes this version.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of active contracts currently using this reimbursement method.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date this reimbursement method was applied in a contract or payment.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this reimbursement method record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this reimbursement method record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Reimbursement methods (fee schedule, DRG, per diem) are payment terms defined in provider agreements. Claims processing system applies the correct reimbursement method based on agreement.

attributes.name: finance_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_account. Business justification: Each reimbursement method (FFS, DRG, per diem) maps to specific GL accounts for expense classification. Finance uses this for automated posting of claims payments.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.fee_schedule. Business justification: Reimbursement methods (FFS, DRG, per diem) reference specific fee schedules for payment calculation. Claims adjudication system uses this for every provider payment.

products.name: contract_discount
products.description: Master record of discount arrangements applied to contracts, including discount type, percentage, and eligibility rules.

attributes.name: contract_discount_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract discount arrangement record.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to identify the specific discount arrangement for operational reference and tracking.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the discount arrangement for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the discount methodology applied to the contract, determining how the discount is calculated and applied to claims or payments.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Percentage value of the discount applied to eligible charges or payments, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 15.50 for 15.5%).

attributes.name: flat_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount of the discount applied per transaction, claim, or time period when flat amount discount type is used.

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: The base amount or rate to which the discount is applied, defining the calculation foundation for the discount (e.g., billed charges, allowed amount, fee schedule rate).

attributes.name: applies_to_service_category
attributes.description: Healthcare service category or categories to which this discount applies (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, professional services, pharmacy, DME).

attributes.name: applies_to_procedure_codes
attributes.description: Specific CPT, HCPCS, or ICD-10-PCS procedure codes or code ranges to which this discount applies, supporting granular discount application rules.
attributes.references: CPT Coding Standards (AMA), HCPCS Coding Standards, ICD-10-PCS

attributes.name: applies_to_diagnosis_codes
attributes.description: Specific ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes or code ranges to which this discount applies, enabling condition-specific discount arrangements.

attributes.name: applies_to_drg_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Applies to Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) Codes
attributes.description: Specific Diagnosis Related Group codes to which this discount applies for inpatient hospital services reimbursement.

attributes.name: applies_to_revenue_codes
attributes.description: Specific UB-04 revenue codes to which this discount applies, supporting facility-based service discount rules.

attributes.name: applies_to_place_of_service
attributes.description: Place of Service codes indicating where services must be rendered for this discount to apply (e.g., office, hospital inpatient, emergency room).
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set

attributes.name: minimum_volume_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of services, procedures, or members required to qualify for this discount arrangement, supporting volume-based contracting.

attributes.name: maximum_volume_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum number of services, procedures, or members for which this discount rate applies, defining the upper bound of tiered discount arrangements.

attributes.name: volume_measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for volume thresholds (e.g., claims, procedures, members), defining how volume commitments are tracked and measured.

attributes.name: volume_measurement_period
attributes.description: Time period over which volume thresholds are measured and evaluated for discount eligibility determination.

attributes.name: quality_metric_requirement
attributes.description: Specific quality performance metrics or HEDIS measures that must be achieved for this discount to apply, supporting value-based contracting.
attributes.references: HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set), NCQA Quality Standards

attributes.name: quality_threshold_value
attributes.description: Minimum quality performance score or percentage required to qualify for this discount, expressed as a decimal value.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Provider network tier designation to which this discount applies, supporting tiered network benefit designs and steerage strategies.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health insurance product line or lines of business to which this discount applies, enabling product-specific discount arrangements.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Specific health plan product type to which this discount applies (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, Medicare Advantage), supporting product-specific contracting strategies.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic area, region, state, or county where this discount arrangement is applicable, defining the territorial scope of the discount.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where this discount is applicable, supporting state-specific contract and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this discount arrangement becomes active and applicable to claims processing and payment calculations.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this discount arrangement ends and is no longer applicable to claims processing and payment calculations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the discount arrangement, indicating whether it is active, pending, or inactive for operational use.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the discount arrangement, tracking the internal approval process before activation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role who approved this discount arrangement for implementation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this discount arrangement was formally approved for implementation and operational use.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this discount arrangement automatically renews at the end of its term without requiring renegotiation.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to termination date that renewal notice must be provided to continue or terminate the discount arrangement.

attributes.name: compound_discount_allowed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this discount can be combined or compounded with other discount arrangements on the same claim or service.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority or sequence order for applying this discount when multiple discounts are applicable to the same claim or service.

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Specific conditions, services, or scenarios that are explicitly excluded from this discount arrangement, defining what is not covered.

attributes.name: inclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Specific conditions, services, or scenarios that are explicitly included in this discount arrangement, defining what is covered.

attributes.name: risk_sharing_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of financial risk shared between payer and provider under this discount arrangement, applicable to risk-based contracts.

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum financial exposure or loss amount beyond which stop-loss protection applies in risk-sharing discount arrangements.

attributes.name: shared_savings_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of cost savings that is shared with the provider under value-based or accountable care discount arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS Shared Savings Program, ACO Regulations

attributes.name: performance_benchmark
attributes.description: Specific performance benchmark or target against which provider performance is measured to determine discount or incentive eligibility.

attributes.name: benchmark_year
attributes.description: Calendar year used as the baseline or benchmark period for performance measurement and discount calculation purposes.

attributes.name: cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total dollar amount of discount that can be applied under this arrangement within a specified time period, limiting financial exposure.

attributes.name: floor_amount
attributes.description: Minimum total dollar amount of discount guaranteed under this arrangement within a specified time period, ensuring minimum savings.

attributes.name: cap_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the discount cap or floor amount is measured and enforced (e.g., per claim, monthly, annually).

attributes.name: retroactive_application_allowed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this discount can be applied retroactively to claims processed before the discount effective date.

attributes.name: retroactive_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to the effective date for which this discount can be retroactively applied to previously processed claims.

attributes.name: claims_processing_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to claims eligible for this discount during claims adjudication processing workflows.

attributes.name: reporting_requirement
attributes.description: Specific reporting obligations or data submission requirements associated with this discount arrangement for compliance and performance tracking.

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this discount arrangement is subject to internal or external audit for compliance and accuracy verification.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this discount arrangement requires filing with state insurance departments or other regulatory bodies for approval.
attributes.references: NAIC Regulatory Filing Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier assigned by regulatory authority upon approval of this discount arrangement for use in the market.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory approval was granted for this discount arrangement by the applicable state or federal authority.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this discount arrangement for operational reference.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this discount arrangement record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this discount arrangement record was most recently updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this discount arrangement record, supporting change tracking and historical versioning for audit purposes.

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for the most recent amendment or modification to this discount arrangement.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which this discount arrangement data originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this discount arrangement in the source system, supporting data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Contract discounts are discount arrangements applied to specific contracts. Each discount record belongs to an agreement. Child→parent relationship. No columns to remove as contract_discount contains

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.payment_term. Business justification: Contract discounts may have associated payment terms defining when and how discount payments are settled. Links discount to payment term definition.

products.name: incentive
products.description: Master record of incentive or bonus structures tied to contract performance thresholds.

attributes.name: incentive_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract incentive or bonus structure record.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the incentive or bonus program tied to the contract.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the incentive structure based on the performance metric or objective being rewarded.
attributes.references: Value-Based Care Contract Standards, CMS Alternative Payment Models

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance measurement period for the incentive calculation.

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance measurement period for the incentive calculation.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the incentive payment is disbursed to the provider.

attributes.name: threshold_type
attributes.description: Type of performance threshold structure used to determine incentive eligibility and payment amount.

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric value representing the performance threshold that must be met or exceeded to earn the incentive.

attributes.name: threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the threshold value (e.g., percentage, rate per thousand, dollar amount).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount of the incentive payment when the threshold is achieved.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to a base amount (e.g., total payments, savings) to calculate the incentive payment.

attributes.name: maximum_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that can be paid for this incentive regardless of performance level achieved.

attributes.name: minimum_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount that will be paid if the threshold is met, regardless of calculation method.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the incentive payment amount based on performance achievement.

attributes.name: performance_metric_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific performance metric being measured (e.g., HEDIS measure code, CMS quality measure ID).
attributes.references: HEDIS Technical Specifications, CMS Quality Measure Standards

attributes.name: performance_metric_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the performance metric being measured for this incentive.
attributes.references: HEDIS Measure Names, CMS Quality Measure Catalog

attributes.name: performance_metric_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the performance metric measures and how it is calculated.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source of data used to measure performance for this incentive (e.g., claims data, EHR data, patient surveys).

attributes.name: measurement_steward
attributes.description: Organization responsible for developing and maintaining the performance measure (e.g., NCQA, CMS, NQF).

attributes.name: nqf_number
attributes.description: National Quality Forum endorsed measure number if the performance metric is NQF-endorsed.
attributes.references: National Quality Forum Quality Measure Catalog

attributes.name: hedis_measure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Code
attributes.description: HEDIS measure code if the performance metric is a HEDIS measure.

attributes.name: cms_measure_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Measure Identifier
attributes.description: CMS quality measure identifier if the performance metric is a CMS measure.

attributes.name: baseline_value
attributes.description: Baseline performance value used as a reference point for measuring improvement or achievement.

attributes.name: baseline_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period used to establish the baseline performance value.

attributes.name: baseline_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period used to establish the baseline performance value.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Target performance value that represents the desired level of achievement for full incentive payment.

attributes.name: stretch_target_value
attributes.description: Aspirational performance value beyond the standard target that may earn additional incentive payment.

attributes.name: benchmark_source
attributes.description: Source of benchmark data used to set performance thresholds (e.g., NCQA Quality Compass, CMS Star Ratings).

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile
attributes.description: Percentile of benchmark distribution that the provider must achieve to earn the incentive.

attributes.name: eligible_population_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria defining the member population included in the performance measurement (e.g., age range, diagnosis codes, LOB).

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria for excluding members or encounters from the performance measurement calculation.

attributes.name: minimum_denominator_size
attributes.description: Minimum number of eligible members or encounters required in the denominator for the measure to be valid and the incentive to apply.
attributes.references: Statistical Validity Standards for Quality Measures

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_method
attributes.description: Method used to adjust performance results for differences in patient case mix or risk (e.g., HCC risk adjustment).
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, HEDIS Risk Adjustment

attributes.name: attribution_method
attributes.description: Method used to attribute members to the provider for performance measurement purposes.
attributes.references: ACO Attribution Methodology, CMS Attribution Standards

attributes.name: lob_applicability
attributes.description: Lines of business to which this incentive applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Exchange).

attributes.name: product_applicability
attributes.description: Specific product types to which this incentive applies (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP).

attributes.name: geographic_applicability
attributes.description: Geographic regions or service areas where this incentive applies (e.g., state codes, county codes, market regions).

attributes.name: provider_type_applicability
attributes.description: Types of providers eligible for this incentive (e.g., PCP, specialist, hospital, ACO, medical group).

attributes.name: specialty_applicability
attributes.description: Provider specialties to which this incentive applies (e.g., cardiology, endocrinology, primary care).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the incentive structure becomes effective and begins to apply to provider performance.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the incentive structure terminates and no longer applies to provider performance.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the incentive structure.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status of the incentive structure within the organization.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the incentive structure was formally approved for implementation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who approved the incentive structure.

attributes.name: reconciliation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incentive payment requires reconciliation after final performance data is available.

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months after the measurement period during which reconciliation of the incentive payment may occur.

attributes.name: audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the performance data used for this incentive is subject to audit or validation requirements.
attributes.references: HEDIS Audit Standards, Contract Audit Requirements

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Type of audit or validation process applied to the performance data for this incentive.
attributes.references: HEDIS Audit Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which performance results for this incentive are reported to the provider.

attributes.name: reporting_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the reporting period end date before performance results are made available to the provider.

attributes.name: shared_savings_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total cost savings that is shared with the provider as an incentive payment in shared savings arrangements.
attributes.references: ACO Shared Savings Program, Value-Based Contract Terms

attributes.name: shared_risk_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of cost overruns or losses that the provider is responsible for in risk-sharing arrangements.
attributes.references: ACO Shared Risk Program, Value-Based Contract Terms

attributes.name: quality_gate_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider must meet minimum quality performance thresholds to be eligible for cost-based incentives.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Gating Requirements, Value-Based Payment Standards

attributes.name: quality_gate_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum quality performance score or percentile that must be achieved to pass the quality gate and be eligible for incentive payment.

attributes.name: composite_score_weight
attributes.description: Weight or percentage contribution of this incentive metric to an overall composite performance score.

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Performance tier level for tiered incentive structures, where different tiers correspond to different payment amounts.

attributes.name: tier_threshold_lower
attributes.description: Lower boundary of the performance range for this tier level in a tiered incentive structure.

attributes.name: tier_threshold_upper
attributes.description: Upper boundary of the performance range for this tier level in a tiered incentive structure.

attributes.name: tier_payment_amount
attributes.description: Incentive payment amount associated with achieving performance within this tier level.

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of regular payments withheld from the provider that can be earned back through achievement of this incentive.

attributes.name: withhold_pool_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount withheld in the pool that is available for distribution based on incentive achievement.

attributes.name: distribution_method
attributes.description: Method used to distribute incentive payments among eligible providers when multiple providers share a pool.

attributes.name: carryover_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unearned or undistributed incentive amounts can be carried over to subsequent measurement periods.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the incentive structure.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the incentive record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the incentive record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the incentive record originated (e.g., HealthEdge, QNXT, Facets).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the incentive record in the source system.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.payment_term. Business justification: Contract incentives have associated payment terms defining when incentive payments are made. Links incentive to payment term definition.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Incentive programs (quality bonuses, utilization targets) are financial terms within provider agreements. Finance calculates and pays incentives based on agreement terms and performance.

attributes.name: finance_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_account. Business justification: Quality incentive payments and value-based bonuses must post to designated GL accounts. Finance accrues incentive liabilities and posts payments when performance metrics are achieved.

attributes.name: shared_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.payment. Business justification: Contract incentives (quality bonuses, utilization targets) link to actual incentive payments. Provider finance team reconciles earned incentives with disbursed payments quarterly.

products.name: contract_payment_schedule
products.description: Master schedule defining payment milestones, amounts, and due dates for a contract.

attributes.name: contract_payment_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract payment schedule record. Primary key for the payment schedule entity.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the provider contract to which this payment schedule belongs. Links payment schedule to the parent contract agreement.

attributes.name: schedule_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the order of this payment within the overall contract payment schedule. Used to track payment milestones chronologically.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment type within the contract. Indicates whether payment is capitation-based, fee-for-service, value-based incentive, risk-sharing arrangement, or other payment model.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the payment will be disbursed to the provider. Specifies the financial instrument or transfer mechanism.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules, Banking Industry Standards

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this payment is scheduled to occur. Defines the recurring pattern or one-time nature of the payment.

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which this payment is scheduled to be made to the provider according to contract terms.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The final date by which the payment must be made to remain compliant with contract terms and avoid penalties or interest charges.

attributes.name: actual_payment_amount
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount paid to the provider. May differ from scheduled amount due to adjustments, reconciliations, or performance-based modifications.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between scheduled and actual payment amounts. Represents adjustments due to reconciliation, performance metrics, or contract modifications.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for any payment adjustment. Used for tracking and reporting payment variances.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 Claim Adjustment Reason Codes

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of why the payment amount was adjusted from the scheduled amount.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code indicating the currency in which the payment is denominated.

attributes.name: payment_status_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment reached its current status. Used for tracking payment lifecycle progression and audit purposes.

attributes.name: actual_payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the payment was disbursed to the provider. May differ from scheduled date due to processing delays or early payment.

attributes.name: payment_period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the service or performance period covered by this payment. Defines the start of the measurement window for services rendered or metrics achieved.

attributes.name: payment_period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the service or performance period covered by this payment. Defines the end of the measurement window for services rendered or metrics achieved.

attributes.name: performance_period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the performance measurement period for value-based or incentive payments. Used to track quality metrics and performance targets.

attributes.name: performance_period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the performance measurement period for value-based or incentive payments. Used to track quality metrics and performance targets.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or business segment to which this payment schedule applies. Indicates whether payment is for commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, or other product lines.

attributes.name: payment_calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the payment amount. Defines whether payment is fixed, per-member-per-month, percentage-based, or tied to specific reimbursement models.

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: The payment rate per member per month for capitation-based payment arrangements. Used to calculate total capitation payments based on member counts.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: The number of members covered under the contract during the payment period. Used in conjunction with PMPM rates to calculate capitation payments.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: The risk adjustment factor applied to the payment calculation. Used in Medicare Advantage and other risk-adjusted payment models to account for member acuity.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: The quality performance score achieved by the provider during the measurement period. Used to calculate quality-based incentive payments.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings, HEDIS Quality Measures

attributes.name: quality_incentive_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of incentive payment earned based on quality performance metrics. Component of value-based payment arrangements.

attributes.name: shared_savings_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of cost savings that will be shared with the provider under shared savings arrangements. Defines provider's share of achieved savings.

attributes.name: shared_savings_amount
attributes.description: The calculated monetary amount of shared savings payment to be made to the provider based on achieved cost reductions and quality performance.

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of payment withheld from regular payments to be released upon achievement of performance targets or contract milestones.

attributes.name: withhold_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount withheld from payment to be released contingent on performance achievement or contract compliance.

attributes.name: withhold_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which withheld funds are scheduled to be released to the provider, subject to performance criteria being met.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount deducted from payment as a penalty for non-compliance, poor performance, or contract violations.

attributes.name: penalty_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for penalty assessment. Used for tracking and reporting contract compliance issues.

attributes.name: penalty_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of why a penalty was assessed against the payment.

attributes.name: reconciliation_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this payment requires or has undergone reconciliation. Used to track payments that need adjustment based on actual utilization or performance.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment reconciliation was performed or is scheduled to occur. Used for tracking reconciliation cycles.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment reconciliation process. Tracks progression through reconciliation workflow.

attributes.name: payment_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this payment requires explicit approval before processing. Used for high-value or exceptional payments requiring additional oversight.

attributes.name: payment_approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the individual who approved the payment for processing. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: payment_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was approved for processing. Used for tracking approval workflow and compliance.

attributes.name: payment_processed_by
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the individual or system that processed the payment. Used for audit trail and operational tracking.

attributes.name: payment_processing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was submitted for processing through the payment system. Distinct from actual payment date.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned to the payment transaction for tracking and reconciliation purposes. Used for payment tracing across systems.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the remittance advice document sent to the provider explaining the payment details. Links payment to provider communication.

attributes.name: payment_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment batch in which this payment was processed. Used for grouping payments processed together.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the provider receiving the payment. Standard identifier for healthcare providers.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Requirements, CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: provider_tin
attributes.description: The Tax Identification Number of the provider organization receiving payment. Used for tax reporting and payment processing.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the provider or provider organization receiving the payment.

attributes.name: payment_address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the address to which payment is sent. Primary street address for payment delivery.

attributes.name: payment_address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the payment address. Used for suite numbers, building names, or additional address details.

attributes.name: payment_city
attributes.description: City name for the payment address.

attributes.name: payment_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code for the payment address.

attributes.name: payment_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code for the payment address. May include 5-digit or 9-digit ZIP+4 format.

attributes.name: payment_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the payment address.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The provider's bank account number for electronic payment transfer. Used for ACH and wire transfer payments.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The 9-digit ABA routing number for the provider's bank. Used for electronic payment transfer.
attributes.references: ABA Routing Number Standards, NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution where the provider's payment account is held.

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the payment. Used to document special circumstances, instructions, or clarifications.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this payment is currently under dispute by the provider. Used to track contested payments.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment dispute was initiated by the provider.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason for payment dispute. Documents provider's objection to payment amount or terms.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment dispute was resolved. Used for tracking dispute lifecycle.

attributes.name: auto_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this payment is processed automatically without manual intervention. Used for routine scheduled payments.

attributes.name: payment_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this payment is currently on hold and should not be processed. Used to temporarily suspend payments pending investigation or resolution.

attributes.name: payment_hold_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was placed on hold. Used for tracking hold duration.

attributes.name: payment_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which a held payment was released for processing. Used for tracking hold resolution.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to late payments or payment advances. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%).

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The calculated interest amount added to or deducted from the payment based on timing and contract terms.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The monetary penalty assessed for late payment beyond the due date. Separate from interest charges.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount offered for early payment before the scheduled date. Incentive for accelerated payment.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_amount
attributes.description: The calculated monetary discount applied for early payment.

attributes.name: payment_source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the system that originated or calculated this payment schedule entry. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: contract_amendment_number
attributes.description: The amendment number if this payment schedule was modified by a contract amendment. Links payment changes to contract modifications.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment schedule entry becomes effective. Used for tracking payment schedule changes over time.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment schedule entry expires or is superseded. Used for temporal tracking of payment schedules.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this payment schedule entry is currently active and applicable. Used for filtering current payment schedules.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment schedule record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment schedule record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.payment_term. Business justification: Payment schedules follow payment term definitions that specify payment cycles, due dates, and discount structures. Links schedule to its governing payment terms. No columns to remove as schedule conta

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_cycle. Business justification: Contract payment schedules reference operational billing cycles. Contracts specify which billing cycle schedule applies (monthly, quarterly), linking to actual billing cycle execution.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Payment schedules (monthly capitation, quarterly settlements) are defined in provider agreements. Accounts payable processes payments according to the agreement's payment schedule.

attributes.name: shared_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.payment. Business justification: Payment schedules (capitation, periodic settlements) reference actual payment transactions. Accounts payable reconciles scheduled vs. actual payments for provider remittance.

products.name: negotiation
products.description: Transactional record of negotiation events, proposals, counter‑offers, and outcomes for a contract.

attributes.name: negotiation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract negotiation record. Primary key for tracking negotiation events, proposals, and outcomes.

attributes.name: contract_id
