attributes.description: Identifier of the contract being negotiated. Links this negotiation event to the parent contract record.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the healthcare provider participating in the negotiation. References the provider entity.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the healthcare provider in the negotiation.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number of the provider organization participating in the negotiation.

attributes.name: round
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which round of negotiation this event represents (1 for initial proposal, 2 for first counter-offer, etc.).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the negotiation event indicating whether it is an initial proposal, counter-offer, final offer, amendment, or other negotiation activity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of this negotiation event indicating its position in the approval and decision workflow.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date when this negotiation event was initiated or created.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the negotiation proposal or counter-offer was formally submitted for review.

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which a response to this negotiation event is expected or required.

attributes.name: response_received_date
attributes.description: Date when a response to this negotiation event was received from the counterparty.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this negotiation event was approved by the authorized decision-maker.

attributes.name: rejected_date
attributes.description: Date when this negotiation event was rejected by either party.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this negotiation event reached a final state (accepted, rejected, or withdrawn).

attributes.name: initiating_party
attributes.description: Identifies which party initiated this negotiation event (payer, provider, broker, or third-party administrator).

attributes.name: responding_party
attributes.description: Identifies which party is expected to respond to this negotiation event.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of this negotiation event indicating whether it was accepted, rejected, countered, withdrawn, or expired.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of contract being negotiated, such as fee-for-service, capitation, value-based care (VBC), accountable care organization (ACO), bundled payment, or risk-sharing arrangement.

attributes.name: reimbursement_methodology
attributes.description: Payment methodology proposed in this negotiation, such as fee schedule, percentage of charges, Diagnosis Related Group (DRG), Ambulatory Payment Classification (APC), per diem, case rate, capitation, bundled payment, or value-based reimbursement.

attributes.name: proposed_rate_type
attributes.description: Type of rate structure proposed in this negotiation event, such as flat rate, percentage of Medicare, percentage of charges, custom fee schedule, Per Member Per Month (PMPM), case rate, per diem, or bundled rate.

attributes.name: proposed_rate_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the proposed rate in this negotiation event. Interpretation depends on proposed_rate_type (e.g., dollar amount, percentage, PMPM amount).

attributes.name: current_rate_value
attributes.description: Current rate value in effect before this negotiation, used for comparison and variance analysis.

attributes.name: rate_variance_percent
attributes.description: Percentage difference between the proposed rate and the current rate, calculated as ((proposed - current) / current) * 100.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Proposed date when the negotiated terms would become effective if accepted.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Proposed date when the negotiated terms would expire if accepted.

attributes.name: term_length_months
attributes.description: Proposed length of the contract term in months.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proposed contract terms include automatic renewal provisions.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for contract termination under the proposed terms.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business covered by this negotiation, such as commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, marketplace, Administrative Services Only (ASO), or Third Party Administrator (TPA).
attributes.references: NAIC Health Insurance Line of Business Classifications

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Proposed network tier classification for the provider under the negotiated contract (e.g., tier 1, tier 2, tier 3, preferred, standard).

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Category of healthcare services covered by this negotiation, such as inpatient, outpatient, professional, ancillary, pharmacy, behavioral health, Durable Medical Equipment (DME), Long Term Services and Supports (LTSS), or all services.

attributes.name: specialty_type
attributes.description: Medical specialty or provider type covered by this negotiation (e.g., cardiology, orthopedics, primary care, hospital, skilled nursing facility).

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic area or region covered by the proposed contract terms (e.g., state, county, service area, national).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the negotiated contract terms would apply.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Market segment targeted by this negotiation, such as large group, small group, individual, government, or specialty.

attributes.name: quality_incentive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proposed contract includes quality-based incentive payments or performance bonuses.

attributes.name: quality_metric_type
attributes.description: Type of quality metrics included in the proposed contract, such as Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS), Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS), Stars ratings, clinical outcomes, patient safety, cost efficiency, or composite measures.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS and CMS Stars Rating Standards

attributes.name: risk_sharing_model
attributes.description: Type of financial risk-sharing arrangement proposed in the negotiation, such as none, upside only, downside only, two-sided risk, full risk, shared savings, or bundled payment.

attributes.name: risk_corridor_percent
attributes.description: Percentage threshold defining the risk corridor for shared savings or losses in value-based arrangements.

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold
attributes.description: Dollar amount threshold for stop-loss protection in risk-sharing arrangements, limiting provider financial exposure.

attributes.name: minimum_volume_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum number of members, procedures, or encounters required under the proposed contract terms.

attributes.name: estimated_member_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of health plan members who would be covered under the proposed contract.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_claims
attributes.description: Projected total annual claims amount expected under the proposed contract terms.

attributes.name: pmpm_target
attributes.description: Target Per Member Per Month cost or payment amount proposed in the negotiation.

attributes.name: mlr_target_percent
attributes.description: Target Medical Loss Ratio percentage proposed in the negotiation, representing the proportion of premium revenue spent on medical claims and quality improvement.

attributes.name: administrative_fee_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of premium or claims allocated for administrative fees in Administrative Services Only (ASO) or Third Party Administrator (TPA) arrangements.

attributes.name: care_management_fee
attributes.description: Fixed or per-member fee for care management services included in the proposed contract.

attributes.name: credentialing_requirement
attributes.description: Credentialing standards required for providers under the proposed contract, such as National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), URAC, Joint Commission, state license, board certification, or custom requirements.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization is required for services under the proposed contract terms.

attributes.name: utilization_management_level
attributes.description: Level of utilization management oversight proposed in the contract, such as none, basic, standard, comprehensive, or custom.

attributes.name: claims_submission_method
attributes.description: Required method for submitting claims under the proposed contract, such as Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) 837, provider portal, paper, clearinghouse, or direct Application Programming Interface (API).

attributes.name: claims_payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which claims must be paid under the proposed contract terms (e.g., 30 days, 45 days).

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Method for resolving disputes under the proposed contract, such as arbitration, mediation, litigation, internal review, or independent review.

attributes.name: hold_harmless_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proposed contract includes a hold harmless clause protecting members from balance billing.
attributes.references: No Surprises Act and State Balance Billing Laws

attributes.name: exclusivity_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proposed contract includes exclusivity provisions restricting the provider from contracting with competing payers.

attributes.name: most_favored_nation_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proposed contract includes a most favored nation clause guaranteeing the payer receives rates no higher than those offered to other payers.

attributes.name: negotiator_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual representing the payer in this negotiation event.

attributes.name: negotiator_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the payer representative conducting the negotiation.

attributes.name: negotiator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the payer representative conducting the negotiation.

attributes.name: negotiator_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the payer representative conducting the negotiation.

attributes.name: provider_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the provider representative participating in this negotiation event.

attributes.name: provider_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the provider representative participating in the negotiation.

attributes.name: provider_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the provider representative participating in the negotiation.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Level of organizational authority required to approve this negotiation event, such as manager, director, vice president (VP), senior vice president (SVP), chief financial officer (CFO), chief executive officer (CEO), or board.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who approved or is expected to approve this negotiation event.

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Comments or notes provided by the approver regarding this negotiation event.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason this negotiation event was rejected.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why this negotiation event was rejected.

attributes.name: counter_offer_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the counter-offer terms proposed in response to this negotiation event.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting discussions, decisions, and context for this negotiation event.

attributes.name: legal_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this negotiation event requires legal department review before approval.

attributes.name: legal_review_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when legal review of this negotiation event was completed.

attributes.name: compliance_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this negotiation event requires compliance department review before approval.

attributes.name: compliance_review_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when compliance review of this negotiation event was completed.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact (positive or negative) of accepting this negotiation proposal, calculated as the difference in projected costs or revenues.

attributes.name: roi_percent
attributes.description: Estimated return on investment percentage for this negotiation proposal, calculated based on projected financial benefits versus costs.

attributes.name: competitive_benchmark_rate
attributes.description: Market benchmark rate used for comparison when evaluating this negotiation proposal.

attributes.name: variance_from_benchmark_percent
attributes.description: Percentage variance between the proposed rate and the competitive benchmark rate.

attributes.name: strategic_priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this negotiation is designated as a strategic priority for the organization.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of how this negotiation outcome would impact network adequacy requirements and member access to care.

attributes.name: member_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of how this negotiation outcome would impact health plan members in terms of access, cost, and quality.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this negotiation outcome requires filing with state insurance regulators or Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).
attributes.references: State Insurance Department and CMS Filing Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory filing related to this negotiation was submitted.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department and CMS Filing Requirements

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this negotiation event to supporting documents stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this negotiation record, incremented when amendments or revisions are made.

attributes.name: superseded_by_negotiation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the negotiation record that supersedes this one, if applicable.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Classification of the confidentiality level for this negotiation record, determining access restrictions.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this negotiation event to detailed audit trail records tracking all changes and access.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule and Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: document_reference_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this negotiation event to supporting documents stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.amendment. Business justification: Successful contract negotiations result in amendments that formalize the negotiated terms. Links negotiation transaction to the resulting amendment. No columns to remove as negotiation contains negoti

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.case. Business justification: Contract negotiations are tracked as cases for workflow management. Provider contracting team manages negotiation milestones, approvals, and communications through case system.

products.name: dispute
products.description: Transactional record of disputes arising from a contract, including issue description, resolution steps, and outcome.

attributes.name: dispute_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract dispute record. Primary key for the contract dispute entity.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider contract that is the subject of this dispute.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique reference number assigned to the dispute for tracking and communication purposes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of the contract dispute indicating the nature of the disagreement between the payer and provider.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the dispute in its lifecycle from initiation to resolution.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority assigned to the dispute based on financial impact, regulatory risk, or relationship importance.

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Party that initiated the contract dispute.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the provider involved in the contract dispute.

attributes.name: provider_tin
attributes.description: Tax Identification Number of the provider organization involved in the dispute.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the provider or provider organization involved in the contract dispute.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business under which the disputed contract operates.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Type of provider network associated with the disputed contract.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Reimbursement methodology type of the contract under dispute.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the dispute issue, including the provider's or payer's concerns and the specific contract provisions in question.

attributes.name: disputed_amount

attributes.name: disputed_amount_currency
attributes.description: Currency code for the disputed amount.

attributes.name: contract_provision_reference
attributes.description: Specific section, clause, or provision number in the contract that is the subject of the dispute.

attributes.name: filed_date

attributes.name: received_date

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the dispute should be resolved based on contractual or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the dispute was resolved or closed.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the dispute was escalated to a higher authority or external mediation/arbitration.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation level of the dispute resolution process.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal user or team member assigned to manage and resolve the dispute.

attributes.name: assigned_to_department
attributes.description: Department responsible for managing the dispute resolution process.

attributes.name: resolution_method
attributes.description: Method used to resolve the contract dispute.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome

attributes.name: regulation_citation

attributes.name: reporting_frequency

attributes.references: CMS Reporting Requirements, State Filing Schedules

attributes.name: reporting_deadline
attributes.description: Specific deadline or timeframe for submitting compliance reports (e.g., '60 days after quarter end', 'March 31 annually').
attributes.references: CMS HEDIS Reporting Deadlines, State Regulatory Calendars

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code

attributes.name: escalation_contact

attributes.description: Indicates whether an audit trail of compliance activities and changes must be maintained.

attributes.name: training_frequency
attributes.description: How often employees must complete training related to this compliance requirement.

attributes.description: How often attestation of compliance must be provided.

attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm or organization conducting compliance assessments.

attributes.name: last_audit_date

domains.name: enrollment
domains.description: Member enrollment processing including new enrollment, plan changes, qualifying life events (QLE), open enrollment, special enrollment periods (SEP), COBRA continuation, and group enrollment. Manages enrollment through exchanges (FFM/SBM), AEP, and direct channels.

attributes.name: group_id

attributes.name: oop_max_amount

attributes.name: copay_primary_care
attributes.description: Copayment amount for primary care physician office visits.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage Standards

attributes.name: copay_specialist
attributes.description: Copayment amount for specialist physician office visits.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage Standards

attributes.name: copay_emergency_room
attributes.description: Copayment amount for emergency room visits.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage Standards

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is HSA-eligible (typically high-deductible health plans).

attributes.name: hsa_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employer or member contribution amount to the Health Savings Account.

attributes.name: hra_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employer contribution amount to the Health Reimbursement Arrangement.

attributes.name: fsa_election_amount
attributes.description: Annual amount elected by the member for Flexible Spending Account contributions.

attributes.name: tobacco_user_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is a tobacco user, which may affect premium rating.

attributes.name: tobacco_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Additional monthly premium surcharge applied for tobacco users.

attributes.name: age_rated_premium_amount
attributes.description: Premium amount calculated based on the member's age for age-rated plans.

attributes.name: rating_area
attributes.description: Geographic rating area used for premium calculation, typically defined by state insurance departments.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the member's primary residence, used for rating and network assignment.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: County code of the member's primary residence, used for rating and network assignment.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code of the member's primary residence.

attributes.name: medicare_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is for a Medicare Advantage or Medicare Supplement plan.

attributes.name: medicare_beneficiary_identifier
attributes.description: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI) for Medicare enrollments.

attributes.name: medicaid_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is for a Medicaid managed care plan.

attributes.name: medicaid_beneficiary_identifier
attributes.description: State-assigned Medicaid identification number for Medicaid enrollments.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid (dual eligible).
attributes.references: CMS Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan Standards

attributes.name: lis_level
attributes.description: Level of Low Income Subsidy (Extra Help) for Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage.

attributes.name: part_d_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment includes Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage.

attributes.name: snp_type
attributes.description: Type of Medicare Special Needs Plan (Dual Eligible, Chronic Condition, Institutional).

attributes.name: chronic_condition_code
attributes.description: Code representing the chronic condition for Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan (C-SNP) enrollments.

attributes.name: institutional_level_of_care
attributes.description: Level of institutional care for Institutional Special Needs Plan (I-SNP) enrollments.
attributes.value_regex: Nursing Home|Assisted Living|Home and Community Based Services

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Risk adjustment score calculated based on member diagnoses and demographics for Medicare Advantage payments.

attributes.name: hcc_count
attributes.description: Number of Hierarchical Condition Categories (HCCs) assigned to the member for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has End Stage Renal Disease, affecting Medicare eligibility and plan options.

attributes.name: disability_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member qualifies for Medicare due to disability (under age 65).

attributes.name: grace_period_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment is currently in a premium payment grace period.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the premium payment grace period ends.

attributes.name: retroactive_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment has retroactive coverage (effective date in the past).

attributes.name: retroactive_months
attributes.description: Number of months of retroactive coverage provided for this enrollment.

attributes.name: auto_assignment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was auto-assigned to this plan by CMS or state Medicaid agency.

attributes.name: passive_enrollment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was passively enrolled (automatically re-enrolled without active selection).

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the insurance broker or agent who facilitated the enrollment.

attributes.name: broker_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the insurance broker or agent.

attributes.name: agent_commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate paid to the broker or agent for this enrollment.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the EDI 834 transaction that created or updated this enrollment.

attributes.name: edi_sender_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the entity that sent the EDI 834 enrollment transaction.

attributes.name: edi_receiver_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the entity that received the EDI 834 enrollment transaction.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the enrollment record originated.
attributes.value_regex: Facets|QNXT|HealthRules|Oracle Health Insurance|Exchange Portal|Employer Portal|Broker Portal|Call Center|Manual Entry

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this enrollment in the source system.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this enrollment record.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member enrolled in the health plan. Links to the member master record.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: External subscriber identifier assigned by the health plan, often printed on member ID cards.

attributes.name: plan_product_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific health insurance plan in which the member is enrolled.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the primary care physician selected by the member at enrollment.

attributes.name: network_plan_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider network associated with this enrollment.

attributes.name: household_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Group enrollments are allocated to specific cost centers for financial tracking and reporting. Finance teams use this daily to allocate premium revenue and administrative costs by business unit or emp

attributes.name: consent_form_id

Enrollment systems check eligibility determination daily to confirm member qualification and prevent i

attributes.name: contract_id

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id

attributes.name: open_enrollment_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.open_enrollment_window. Business justification: Link enrollment to the open enrollment window so each enrollment can be associated with the exact configuration period; this eliminates the need for ambiguous open_enrollment_indicator only.

attributes.name: group_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.group_enrollment. Business justification: Associate each enrollment with its parent group enrollment record to capture group‑level enrollment context.

products.name: enrollment_status
products.description: Reference table of possible enrollment statuses (active, pending, terminated, suspended).

attributes.name: enrollment_status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the enrollment status record. Primary key for the status reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the enrollment status. Used for system processing and integration (e.g., ACT, PEND, TERM, SUSP, CANC).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the enrollment status (e.g., Active, Pending, Terminated, Suspended, Cancelled).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of what the enrollment status represents, including business rules and conditions that trigger this status.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the status indicating whether the enrollment is active (coverage in force), inactive (no coverage), transitional (pending decision), or suspended (temporarily inactive).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status represents active coverage where benefits are available and claims can be processed.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether premiums should be billed when a member has this enrollment status.

attributes.name: allows_claims
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether claims can be adjudicated and paid when a member enrollment has this status.

attributes.name: requires_approval
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status requires manual review or approval before transitioning to another status.

attributes.name: termination_reason_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a termination reason code must be provided when transitioning to this status.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_code
attributes.description: Standard EDI 834 maintenance type code used when transmitting enrollment status changes to trading partners (e.g., 021 for Change, 024 for Termination, 001 for Change).

attributes.name: cms_transaction_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Transaction Type
attributes.description: CMS-specific transaction type code used for Medicare Advantage and Part D enrollment reporting (e.g., Add, Change, Delete, Reinstate).

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the sort order for displaying enrollment statuses in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this status definition became effective and available for use in enrollment processing.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this status definition expires and should no longer be used for new enrollments. Null indicates the status is currently active.

attributes.name: is_system_generated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status is automatically assigned by system processes (e.g., auto-termination for non-payment) versus manually assigned by enrollment staff.

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members must be notified when their enrollment transitions to this status, per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ACA Notice Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: notification_template
attributes.description: Reference to the communication template that should be used when notifying members of this status change.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days allowed in grace period status before automatic termination, applicable for statuses like pending payment or suspended for non-payment.
attributes.references: ACA Grace Period Requirements, Premium Billing Policies

attributes.name: retroactive_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether enrollment status can be changed retroactively to a prior date when using this status.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this enrollment status are eligible for COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: sep_qualifying
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether transitioning to this status qualifies as a qualifying life event that triggers a special enrollment period.

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: Category used for regulatory reporting and HEDIS metrics to classify enrollment status (e.g., enrolled, disenrolled, pending).
attributes.references: HEDIS Reporting Requirements, CMS Enrollment Reporting

attributes.name: mlr_included
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether member months with this status should be included in Medical Loss Ratio calculations for ACA compliance.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether enrollments with this status are eligible for risk adjustment factor (RAF) scoring and Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) coding.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, HCC Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: member_portal_access
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this enrollment status should have access to the member self-service portal and digital tools.

attributes.name: id_card_issued
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether member ID cards should be issued or remain valid when enrollment has this status.

attributes.name: provider_roster_included
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this status should be included in provider rosters and eligibility files sent to network providers.

attributes.name: care_management_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this enrollment status are eligible for care management and disease management programs.

attributes.name: prior_auth_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether prior authorization requirements apply to members with this enrollment status.

attributes.name: pharmacy_benefits_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether pharmacy benefits are active and prescriptions can be filled when enrollment has this status.

attributes.name: exchange_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether enrollments with this status must be reported to health insurance exchanges (FFM/SBM) for reconciliation.

attributes.name: irs_1095_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Form 1095 Reportable Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether member months with this status should be included in IRS Form 1095-B or 1095-C reporting for minimum essential coverage.

attributes.name: state_reporting_code
attributes.description: State-specific code used for enrollment status reporting to state departments of insurance and Medicaid agencies.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether detailed audit trails and supporting documentation must be maintained when assigning this status.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: workflow_stage
attributes.description: Stage in the enrollment processing workflow that this status represents (e.g., initial, in progress, pending review, approved, completed).

attributes.name: sla_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours within which enrollment requests with this status must be processed to meet service level agreements.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to enrollment processing when in this status (e.g., low, normal, high, urgent).

attributes.name: auto_transition_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the system can automatically transition enrollments from this status to another status based on business rules.

attributes.name: next_status_code
attributes.description: Default status code that enrollments should transition to after this status, used for automated workflow progression.

attributes.name: reversal_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a status change can be reversed or undone after being applied to an enrollment.

attributes.name: financial_impact
attributes.description: Category describing the financial impact when enrollment transitions to this status (e.g., premium due, premium waived, refund due, adjustment required).

attributes.name: subsidy_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this enrollment status are eligible for premium subsidies or advanced premium tax credits (APTC).

attributes.name: cost_sharing_reduction_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members with this enrollment status are eligible for cost sharing reductions under ACA marketplace plans.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_only
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status can only be assigned during open enrollment periods (OEP) or annual election periods (AEP).

attributes.name: qle_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a qualifying life event must be documented to assign this status outside of open enrollment periods.

attributes.name: documentation_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether supporting documentation must be collected and verified before assigning this enrollment status.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify eligibility for this enrollment status (e.g., none, manual review, automated system check, third-party verification).

attributes.name: appeals_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether members can appeal or request reconsideration when their enrollment is assigned this status.

attributes.name: grievance_category
attributes.description: Category code used for tracking member grievances and complaints related to this enrollment status.

products.name: action_type
products.description: Reference of enrollment action types such as new, change, termination, renewal, waiver.

attributes.name: action_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the enrollment action type. Primary key for the action type reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the enrollment action type. Used for system integration and reporting (e.g., NEW, CHG, TERM, RENEW, WAIVE).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the enrollment action type (e.g., New Enrollment, Plan Change, Termination, Renewal, Waiver).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the enrollment action type, including business rules, eligibility criteria, and processing requirements.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the action type to facilitate reporting and analysis (e.g., enrollment, disenrollment, modification, administrative, special).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the action type indicating whether it is available for use in enrollment transactions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the action type became or will become available for use in enrollment processing.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the action type is no longer available for use in enrollment processing. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: requires_prior_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type requires the member to have had prior coverage (e.g., for COBRA continuation or plan changes).

attributes.name: allows_mid_year_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type can be processed outside of open enrollment periods (e.g., for qualifying life events).

attributes.name: requires_qle_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type requires a qualifying life event to be processed outside of standard enrollment periods.

attributes.name: requires_documentation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation must be provided to process this action type (e.g., marriage certificate for QLE, termination notice for COBRA).
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, ACA Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: processing_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority level for processing this action type when multiple actions are pending. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: standard_processing_days
attributes.description: Standard number of business days required to process this action type from submission to completion.

attributes.name: retroactive_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type can be processed with a retroactive effective date.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, State Insurance Department Regulations

attributes.name: max_retroactive_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days in the past that this action type can be processed retroactively. Null indicates no retroactive processing allowed.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, State Insurance Department Regulations

attributes.name: triggers_premium_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type automatically triggers a premium billing adjustment calculation.

attributes.name: triggers_claims_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type automatically triggers termination of claims processing eligibility.

attributes.name: triggers_id_card_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type automatically triggers the generation and mailing of a new member identification card.

attributes.name: triggers_welcome_kit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type automatically triggers the delivery of a member welcome kit with plan materials.

attributes.name: requires_pcp_selection_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires Primary Care Physician (PCP) Selection Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type requires the member to select or confirm a primary care physician.
attributes.references: HMO Network Requirements, Internal Care Management Standards

attributes.name: allows_dependent_changes_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type permits adding, removing, or modifying dependent coverage as part of the action.
attributes.references: ACA Dependent Coverage Requirements, ERISA Regulations

attributes.name: requires_eligibility_verification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type requires real-time eligibility verification before processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI Standards, Internal Eligibility Management Standards

attributes.name: edi_transaction_code
attributes.description: ANSI X12 834 transaction set maintenance type code used for electronic enrollment transactions (e.g., 021 for Change, 024 for Termination, 001 for Cancellation or Termination).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance Transaction Set

attributes.name: cms_transaction_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Transaction Type
attributes.description: CMS-specific transaction type code used for Medicare Advantage and Part D enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Enrollment Guidance

attributes.name: exchange_transaction_type
attributes.description: Transaction type code used for enrollment actions processed through Federally Facilitated Marketplace (FFM) or State-Based Marketplace (SBM) exchanges.

attributes.name: applicable_lob
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lines of business where this action type is applicable (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Exchange).

attributes.name: applicable_product_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product types where this action type is applicable (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP).

attributes.name: applicable_funding_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of funding arrangements where this action type is applicable (e.g., Fully Insured, ASO, Level Funded).

attributes.name: requires_cobra_election_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type requires a formal COBRA continuation election from the member.

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event
attributes.description: Type of COBRA qualifying event associated with this action type, if applicable.

attributes.name: generates_notice_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type automatically generates a member notification letter or email.
attributes.references: ERISA Disclosure Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: notice_template_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard notice template to be used when this action type generates member communications.

attributes.name: notice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Standard delivery method for member notices generated by this action type.
attributes.references: ERISA Disclosure Requirements, Internal Member Communications Standards

attributes.name: requires_medical_underwriting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type requires medical underwriting review (typically not applicable post-ACA for most plans).
attributes.references: ACA Guaranteed Issue Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: impacts_waiting_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type affects or resets any applicable coverage waiting periods.
attributes.references: ACA Waiting Period Limitations, ERISA Requirements

attributes.name: impacts_preexisting_condition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type affects pre-existing condition coverage provisions (primarily for grandfathered plans).
attributes.references: ACA Pre-Existing Condition Provisions, HIPAA Portability Rules

attributes.name: creditable_coverage_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type is relevant for creditable coverage tracking and certification purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Portability Rules, Medicare Part D Creditable Coverage Requirements

attributes.name: triggers_cob_update_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Triggers Coordination of Benefits (COB) Update Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type automatically triggers a coordination of benefits information update or verification.
attributes.references: NAIC Model COB Regulation, Internal Claims Administration Standards

attributes.name: triggers_subrogation_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type triggers a review of potential subrogation or third-party liability cases.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type requires enhanced audit trail logging for compliance or regulatory purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule, SOX Requirements, State Insurance Audit Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_category
attributes.description: Category code used for grouping this action type in regulatory reports to CMS, state insurance departments, or other governing bodies.
attributes.references: CMS Reporting Requirements, NAIC Reporting Standards

attributes.name: hedis_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment actions of this type are included in HEDIS enrollment reporting and quality measure denominators.

attributes.name: mlr_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment actions of this type are included in Medical Loss Ratio calculations and reporting.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type is relevant for risk adjustment factor (RAF) calculations and Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) coding.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, ACA Risk Adjustment Program

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of action types in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: user_selectable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type can be directly selected by end users or is system-generated only.

attributes.name: system_generated_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action type can only be created by automated system processes and not by manual user entry.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this action type reference record was originally created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this action type reference record was last updated or modified.

products.name: channel
products.description: Reference of channels through which enrollment occurs (online portal, broker, call center, exchange).

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the enrollment channel. Primary key for the enrollment channel reference data.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the enrollment channel for system integration and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the enrollment channel (e.g., Online Portal, Broker, Call Center, Exchange).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the enrollment channel indicating the primary distribution model.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the enrollment channel including its purpose, target audience, and operational characteristics.

attributes.name: distribution_method
attributes.description: Specific method or interface through which enrollment is conducted within this channel.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the enrollment channel indicating whether it is available for new enrollments.

attributes.name: is_self_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel allows members to complete enrollment independently without assistance from a representative.

attributes.name: requires_broker
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment through this channel requires involvement of a licensed insurance broker or agent.

attributes.name: supports_individual_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment of individual members (non-group coverage).

attributes.name: supports_group_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment of group members through employer-sponsored plans.

attributes.name: supports_medicare
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment in Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicare Supplement, or Prescription Drug Plans (PDP).

attributes.name: supports_medicaid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment in Medicaid managed care plans.

attributes.name: supports_commercial
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment in commercial health insurance products (employer-sponsored or individual market).

attributes.name: supports_exchange_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment through health insurance exchanges (FFM or SBM) under the Affordable Care Act.

attributes.name: exchange_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federally Facilitated Marketplace (FFM) or State Based Marketplace (SBM) Exchange Type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance exchange associated with this channel if applicable (Federally Facilitated Marketplace, State Based Marketplace, or Partnership).

attributes.name: supports_sep
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment during Special Enrollment Periods triggered by qualifying life events.

attributes.name: supports_aep
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment during the Annual Enrollment Period for Medicare or open enrollment for commercial plans.

attributes.name: supports_oep
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment during the Open Enrollment Period for individual and family plans.

attributes.name: supports_cobra
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Support Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports COBRA continuation coverage enrollment for qualified beneficiaries.

attributes.name: supports_qle
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment triggered by qualifying life events such as marriage, birth, or loss of coverage.

attributes.name: digital_platform
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the digital platform or system used for enrollment through this channel (e.g., Salesforce Health Cloud, custom web portal).

attributes.name: integration_method
attributes.description: Technical integration method used to transmit enrollment data from this channel to core administration systems.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards, HL7 FHIR

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: EDI transaction set code used for enrollment data transmission (e.g., 834 for Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance).

attributes.name: requires_identity_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel requires identity verification of the enrollee before completing enrollment.

attributes.name: requires_eligibility_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel requires real-time eligibility verification before enrollment can be completed.

attributes.name: supports_electronic_signature
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports electronic signature capture for enrollment applications and consent forms.

attributes.name: requires_paper_application
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel requires a paper enrollment application to be submitted in addition to or instead of electronic submission.

attributes.name: average_enrollment_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average time in minutes required to complete an enrollment transaction through this channel.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking of the channel for routing and resource allocation purposes (lower number indicates higher priority).

attributes.name: cost_per_enrollment
attributes.description: Average cost incurred by the organization to process one enrollment through this channel.

attributes.name: commission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollments through this channel are eligible for broker or agent commission payments.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent

attributes.name: target_market_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment that this enrollment channel is designed to serve.

attributes.name: geographic_availability
attributes.description: Geographic scope of availability for this enrollment channel.

attributes.name: supported_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of language codes (ISO 639-1) supported by this enrollment channel for member communication.
attributes.references: ACA Language Access Standards, CLAS Standards

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel meets accessibility standards for individuals with disabilities (e.g., WCAG 2.1 AA for digital channels).

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel meets HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule requirements for handling Protected Health Information (PHI).
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: pci_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel meets PCI DSS requirements for handling payment card information during premium payment collection.

attributes.name: supports_payment_collection
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports collection of initial premium payment at the time of enrollment.

attributes.name: payment_methods_accepted
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of payment methods accepted through this channel (e.g., credit card, debit card, ACH, check).

attributes.name: requires_income_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel requires income verification for subsidy eligibility determination.

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_date_rule
attributes.description: Rule governing when coverage becomes effective for enrollments completed through this channel.
attributes.references: ACA Effective Date Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days allowed for completion of enrollment documentation or payment after initial enrollment submission through this channel.

attributes.name: supports_dependent_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports enrollment of dependents along with the primary subscriber.

attributes.name: max_dependents_allowed
attributes.description: Maximum number of dependents that can be enrolled in a single enrollment transaction through this channel.

attributes.name: supports_plan_comparison
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel provides tools for members to compare multiple plan options before enrollment.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: supports_provider_search
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel provides provider network search functionality to help members find in-network providers.

attributes.name: supports_formulary_search
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel provides drug formulary search functionality for prescription drug plan selection.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Formulary Standards

attributes.name: requires_medical_underwriting
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollments through this channel require medical underwriting or health questionnaires (typically not allowed for ACA-compliant plans).

attributes.name: supports_tobacco_rating
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports collection of tobacco use information for premium rating purposes where allowed by law.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_method
attributes.description: Method used to send enrollment confirmation to members who enroll through this channel.

attributes.name: sla_processing_hours
attributes.description: Service level agreement for processing time in hours from enrollment submission to system confirmation for this channel.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Business unit or department responsible for managing and operating this enrollment channel.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor providing technology or services for this enrollment channel, if applicable.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_number
attributes.description: Contract identifier for the vendor agreement associated with this enrollment channel.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when this enrollment channel was first made available for member enrollments.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when this enrollment channel was or will be retired and no longer available for new enrollments.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the enrollment channel reference data was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the enrollment channel configuration becomes effective.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date until which this version of the enrollment channel configuration remains effective.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active version of the enrollment channel configuration.

products.name: qualifying_life_event
products.description: Reference list of QLEs that trigger special enrollment periods (marriage, birth, loss of coverage).

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the qualifying life event type in the reference list.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1311, CMS Special Enrollment Period Guidelines

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the qualifying life event type for system processing and EDI transactions.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Transaction Set, CMS SEP Guidelines

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the qualifying life event, including conditions and eligibility criteria.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 155.420, CMS Special Enrollment Period Guidelines

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category classification of the qualifying life event type.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory classification providing additional granularity within the QLE category.

attributes.name: sep_duration_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Special Enrollment Period (SEP) Duration in Days
attributes.description: Number of days the special enrollment period remains open following the qualifying life event occurrence.

attributes.name: retroactive_coverage_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether coverage can be made effective retroactively to the date of the qualifying life event.

attributes.name: retroactive_days_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum number of days coverage can be backdated from the enrollment date when retroactive coverage is allowed.

attributes.name: documentation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation must be provided to verify the qualifying life event occurred.

attributes.name: documentation_types
attributes.description: List of acceptable document types that can be submitted to verify the qualifying life event occurrence.

attributes.name: verification_timeframe_days
attributes.description: Number of days allowed for the member to submit required documentation to verify the qualifying life event.

attributes.name: applicable_to_individual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualifying life event applies to individual market health insurance plans.

attributes.name: applicable_to_group
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualifying life event applies to employer-sponsored group health insurance plans.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 701, HIPAA Special Enrollment Rights

attributes.name: applicable_to_medicare
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualifying life event applies to Medicare Advantage or Medicare Part D plans.

attributes.name: applicable_to_medicaid
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualifying life event applies to Medicaid managed care plans.

attributes.name: applicable_to_marketplace
attributes.business_glossary_term: Applicable to Health Insurance Marketplace Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualifying life event applies to Federally Facilitated Marketplace or State-Based Marketplace plans.

attributes.name: plan_change_allowed

attributes.name: coverage_tier_change_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member can change coverage tier (e.g., from individual to family) during the special enrollment period.
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment Rights, ERISA Section 701

attributes.name: dependent_addition_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether dependents can be added to coverage during the special enrollment period triggered by this QLE.

attributes.name: dependent_removal_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether dependents can be removed from coverage during the special enrollment period triggered by this QLE.
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment Rights, Group Plan Guidelines

attributes.name: termination_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member can terminate coverage during the special enrollment period triggered by this QLE.

attributes.name: effective_date_rule
attributes.description: Rule determining when coverage becomes effective following enrollment during the special enrollment period.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 155.420(b), Group Plan Effective Date Rules

attributes.name: effective_date_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days to offset the coverage effective date from the event date or enrollment date based on the effective date rule.

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member must notify the plan or employer within a specific timeframe of the qualifying life event occurrence.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 701, Group Plan SPD Requirements

attributes.name: notification_timeframe_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which the member must notify the plan or employer of the qualifying life event occurrence.
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment Rights, Group Plan Rules

attributes.name: federal_regulation_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the federal regulation or statute that establishes this qualifying life event and special enrollment rights.

attributes.name: state_variation_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether states can modify the rules or eligibility criteria for this qualifying life event in state-based marketplaces.

attributes.name: cms_guidance_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Guidance Reference
attributes.description: Reference to specific CMS guidance documents, bulletins, or FAQs that provide additional clarification on this QLE.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level for processing enrollment requests triggered by this qualifying life event.

attributes.name: fraud_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of fraud risk associated with this qualifying life event type based on historical fraud patterns.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Guidelines

attributes.name: auto_approval_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment requests for this QLE can be automatically approved without manual review when documentation is provided.

attributes.name: manual_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether all enrollment requests for this qualifying life event require manual review by enrollment specialists.

attributes.name: attestation_allowed

attributes.name: third_party_verification_required

attributes.name: edi_transaction_code
attributes.description: Standard EDI transaction code used in ANSI X12 834 transactions to represent this qualifying life event.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence for ordering the display of qualifying life events in user interfaces and member portals.

attributes.name: member_facing_description
attributes.description: Simplified, member-friendly description of the qualifying life event for display in member portals and communications.
attributes.references: Plain Language Guidelines, Member Communication Standards

attributes.name: help_text
attributes.description: Additional help text or guidance to assist members in understanding whether this QLE applies to their situation.

attributes.name: example_scenarios
attributes.description: Concrete examples of situations that would qualify as this type of qualifying life event.

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: Specific situations or conditions that do not qualify as this type of qualifying life event.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 155.420, CMS Special Enrollment Period Guidelines

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this qualifying life event type in the system.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this qualifying life event type became effective and available for use in enrollment processing.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this qualifying life event type is no longer effective and should not be used for new enrollments.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this qualifying life event definition to track changes over time.

attributes.name: superseded_by_qle_qualifying_life_event_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Qualifying Life Event (QLE) Identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the qualifying life event that replaces this one if it has been deprecated or superseded.

attributes.description: Date when this qualifying life event record was last updated in the reference system.

Each QLE type must reference the compliance policy establishing its validity and documentati

Qualifying events like gaining Medicaid/Medicare trigger enrollment windows tied to specific program el
