products.name: enrollment_event
products.description: Transactional record of each enrollment event (new enrollment, change, termination, renewal) with timestamp and user.

attributes.name: enrollment_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each enrollment event transaction. Primary key for the enrollment event record.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of enrollment event being processed. Indicates the nature of the enrollment transaction such as new enrollment, plan change, termination, renewal, COBRA continuation, qualifying life event change, open enrollment, special enrollment period, or annual election period enrollment.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the enrollment event was recorded in the system. Captures the precise moment the event was processed.

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: Business date of the enrollment event. Represents the calendar date on which the enrollment action occurred or was effective.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment change becomes effective for coverage purposes. This is the date coverage begins, changes, or ends based on the event.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment event request was received by the health plan from the member, employer, or exchange.

attributes.name: processed_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment event was fully processed and adjudicated by the enrollment system.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for the enrollment event. Examples include new hire, marriage, birth, divorce, loss of coverage, open enrollment, job termination, retirement, aging out, relocation.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Segment INS03 (Maintenance Reason Code)

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description of the reason for the enrollment event. Provides additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: qle_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualifying life event occurred. Used to determine eligibility for special enrollment period and calculate effective date of coverage.

attributes.name: enrollment_period_type
attributes.description: Type of enrollment period during which the event occurred. Values include initial enrollment, open enrollment, special enrollment period (SEP), annual election period (AEP), or continuous enrollment.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Enrollment Regulations

attributes.name: enrollment_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the enrollment period during which this event was submitted.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Enrollment Regulations

attributes.name: enrollment_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the enrollment period during which this event was submitted.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Enrollment Regulations

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned to the enrollment event by the source system or EDI transaction. Used for tracking and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Segment ST02 (Transaction Set Control Number)

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch in which this enrollment event was processed. Used when events are processed in groups.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the enrollment event was submitted to the health plan. Indicates the format or medium of submission such as online, paper, phone, EDI, API, fax, email, or mobile.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who initiated or submitted the enrollment event. May be a member, employer HR representative, broker, agent, or customer service representative.

attributes.name: initiated_by_user_type
attributes.description: Type or role of the user who initiated the enrollment event. Indicates whether the initiator was a member, employer, broker, agent, customer service representative, system process, or administrator.

attributes.name: processed_by_user_agent_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that processed and adjudicated the enrollment event.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_agent_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who approved the enrollment event, if approval was required.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the enrollment event was approved.

attributes.name: prior_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous enrollment event identifier if this event is a modification, correction, or reversal of a prior event.

attributes.name: is_correction
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this enrollment event is a correction to a previously processed event.

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this enrollment event reverses a previously processed event.

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Qualifying Event
attributes.description: Type of qualifying event that triggered COBRA continuation coverage eligibility. Applicable for COBRA enrollment events.

attributes.name: cobra_election_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Election Date
attributes.description: Date when the member elected COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: cobra_notification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Notification Date
attributes.description: Date when the member was notified of their COBRA continuation rights.

attributes.name: exchange_assigned_policy_id
attributes.description: Policy identifier assigned by the health insurance exchange (FFM or SBM) for marketplace enrollments.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1311 Health Insurance Exchange Standards

attributes.name: exchange_subscriber_code
attributes.description: Subscriber identifier assigned by the health insurance exchange for marketplace enrollments.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1311 Health Insurance Exchange Standards

attributes.name: exchange_type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance exchange through which the enrollment was processed. Values include Federally Facilitated Marketplace (FFM), State-Based Marketplace (SBM), or none for non-exchange enrollments.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1311 Health Insurance Exchange Standards

attributes.name: aptc_amount
attributes.description: Monthly amount of advanced premium tax credit applied to the member's premium for marketplace enrollments. Subsidy amount provided under the Affordable Care Act.

attributes.name: csr_level
attributes.description: Level of cost sharing reduction applied to the member's plan for marketplace enrollments. Values represent the actuarial value percentage (73%, 87%, 94%) or none.

attributes.name: attestation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member provided attestation or certification as part of the enrollment event, such as attestation of eligibility or lawful presence.

attributes.name: attestation_date
attributes.description: Date when the member provided attestation or certification for the enrollment event.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of eligibility verification for the enrollment event. Indicates whether member information has been verified, is pending verification, failed verification, is not required, or has inconsistencies.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when eligibility verification was completed for the enrollment event.

attributes.name: documentation_status
attributes.description: Status of required documentation for the enrollment event. Indicates whether all required documents have been received and are complete, incomplete, pending, not required, or under review.

attributes.name: documentation_received_date
attributes.description: Date when all required documentation for the enrollment event was received.

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the member signed the enrollment application or authorization.

attributes.name: signature_method
attributes.description: Method by which the member provided their signature for the enrollment event. Values include electronic signature, wet signature (physical), voice recorded, or none.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number provided to the member upon successful submission or processing of the enrollment event.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when enrollment confirmation or notification was sent to the member regarding the event.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the member was notified about the enrollment event outcome. Values include email, mail, SMS, phone, portal notification, or none.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the enrollment event for processing. Indicates whether the event requires standard, expedited, urgent, or rush processing.

attributes.name: sla_target_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the enrollment event should be processed according to service level agreement commitments.

attributes.name: sla_met_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the enrollment event was processed within the service level agreement timeframe.

attributes.name: processing_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes taken to process the enrollment event from receipt to completion.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times the enrollment event processing was retried due to failures or errors.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: System error code if the enrollment event processing encountered an error or failure.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message describing the issue encountered during enrollment event processing.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-form text comments or notes related to the enrollment event. May include special instructions, clarifications, or additional context.

attributes.name: audit_trail
attributes.description: Audit trail or log of actions taken during the processing of the enrollment event. Captures key decision points and status changes.

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the source system that originated or processed the enrollment event. Examples include Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, or exchange systems.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the enrollment event in the source system. Used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: EDI transaction set type if the enrollment event was received via EDI. Typically 834 for benefit enrollment and maintenance transactions.

attributes.name: edi_sender_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the sender in the EDI transaction. Used for EDI-based enrollment events.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 ISA06 Interchange Sender ID

attributes.name: edi_receiver_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the receiver in the EDI transaction. Used for EDI-based enrollment events.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 ISA08 Interchange Receiver ID

attributes.name: edi_control_number
attributes.description: Control number from the EDI transaction for tracking and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 ISA13 Interchange Control Number

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the enrollment event was submitted. Used for security and audit purposes.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to submit the enrollment event. Values include desktop, mobile, tablet, phone, or unknown.

attributes.name: browser_type
attributes.description: Web browser type and version used to submit the enrollment event if submitted via web portal.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Session identifier for the user session during which the enrollment event was submitted. Used for security and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for communication related to the enrollment event. Uses ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes.

attributes.name: accessibility_accommodation
attributes.description: Description of any accessibility accommodations provided or requested during the enrollment event process, such as screen reader compatibility, large print, or interpreter services.

attributes.name: initiated_by_user_agent_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who initiated or submitted the enrollment event. May be a member, employer HR representative, broker, agent, or customer service representative.

attributes.name: agent_agent_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that processed and adjudicated the enrollment event.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who approved the enrollment event, if approval was required.

products.name: change_detail
products.description: Line‑item details for enrollment changes, such as plan option modifications, dependents added/removed.

attributes.name: change_detail_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each enrollment change detail line item. Primary key for the change detail entity.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Type of enrollment change being recorded in this detail line. Indicates the specific modification made to the member's enrollment record.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the nature of the enrollment change for reporting and analytics purposes.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the enrollment change. Maps to regulatory and operational reason code sets.

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the reason for the enrollment change, providing context for the modification.

attributes.name: qle_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this change was triggered by a qualifying life event that permits enrollment modification outside standard enrollment periods.

attributes.name: qle_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualifying life event occurred, establishing eligibility for special enrollment period.

attributes.name: field_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific enrollment field or attribute that was modified in this change detail record.

attributes.name: field_label
attributes.description: Business-friendly label for the field that was changed, used for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: previous_value
attributes.description: Value of the field before the change was applied. Stored as string to accommodate various data types.

attributes.name: premium_difference_amount

attributes.name: dependent_sequence_number

products.name: effective_period
products.description: Effective start and end dates for each enrollment instance, supporting mid‑term changes and extensions.

attributes.name: effective_period_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each effective period instance within an enrollment record. Serves as the primary key for tracking distinct coverage periods.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the enrollment coverage period begins. This is the first day the member is eligible for benefits under this enrollment instance.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Segment DTP (Date or Time Period)

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the enrollment coverage period ends. This is the last day the member is eligible for benefits under this enrollment instance. Null indicates ongoing coverage.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Segment DTP (Date or Time Period)

attributes.name: original_start_date
attributes.description: The original start date of the enrollment period before any mid-term changes or adjustments. Used for tracking enrollment history and retroactive adjustments.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: original_end_date
attributes.description: The original end date of the enrollment period before any extensions or early terminations. Used for tracking enrollment modifications and COBRA continuation scenarios.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the enrollment period indicating how it was initiated (initial enrollment, annual renewal, qualifying life event change, COBRA continuation, special enrollment period, etc.).

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the effective period creation or modification (e.g., new hire, marriage, birth, divorce, loss of coverage, open enrollment, termination).

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the reason for the effective period change, providing additional context beyond the standardized code.

attributes.name: qle_event_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the qualifying life event occurred (e.g., marriage date, birth date, loss of coverage date). Used to determine eligibility window for special enrollment.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the enrollment was submitted (Federally Facilitated Marketplace, State-Based Marketplace, employer group, direct enrollment, broker, etc.).

attributes.name: enrollment_period_category
attributes.description: The regulatory enrollment period category under which this effective period was established (Annual Enrollment Period, Open Enrollment Period, Special Enrollment Period, Initial Coverage Election Period, Open Enrollment Initial Period, Continuous Enrollment).

attributes.name: aep_year
attributes.description: The calendar year of the Annual Enrollment Period during which this enrollment was processed, if applicable to Medicare Advantage or Part D plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Annual Enrollment Period

attributes.name: sep_eligibility_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member's eligibility for a Special Enrollment Period was verified and approved by the carrier or exchange.

attributes.name: sep_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the Special Enrollment Period eligibility was verified and approved.

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event
attributes.description: The specific COBRA qualifying event that triggered continuation coverage eligibility (termination of employment, reduction in hours, death of covered employee, divorce, Medicare entitlement, loss of dependent status).

attributes.name: cobra_election_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Date
attributes.description: The date when the member elected COBRA continuation coverage following a qualifying event.

attributes.name: cobra_maximum_period_months
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Maximum Period Months
attributes.description: The maximum number of months of COBRA continuation coverage available based on the qualifying event type (typically 18, 29, or 36 months).

attributes.name: retroactive_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this effective period includes retroactive coverage (start date is in the past relative to the enrollment processing date).
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Retroactive Coverage Rules

attributes.name: retroactive_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why retroactive coverage was granted, including regulatory or contractual justification.

attributes.name: grace_period_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this effective period is currently in a premium payment grace period, allowing continued coverage despite non-payment.

attributes.name: grace_period_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the premium payment grace period began for this enrollment period.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the premium payment grace period ends. Coverage may be terminated if payment is not received by this date.

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days between enrollment and the effective start date, representing any waiting period before coverage begins.

attributes.name: waiting_period_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard waiting period was waived for this enrollment (e.g., due to prior creditable coverage or special circumstances).

attributes.name: prior_coverage_credit_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether credit for prior creditable coverage was applied to reduce or eliminate waiting periods or pre-existing condition exclusions.

attributes.name: prior_coverage_months
attributes.description: The number of months of prior creditable coverage documented and applied to this enrollment period.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The coverage tier indicating who is covered under this enrollment period (individual only, individual plus spouse, individual plus children, family coverage).

attributes.name: coverage_level_code
attributes.description: Standardized three-character code representing the coverage level (e.g., EMP for employee only, ESP for employee and spouse, FAM for family).

attributes.name: benefit_status
attributes.description: The current status of benefits for this effective period (active coverage, suspended due to non-payment, terminated, pending activation, cancelled, lapsed).

attributes.name: voluntary_termination_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the coverage termination was initiated voluntarily by the member or involuntarily by the carrier or employer.

attributes.name: reinstatement_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible to reinstate coverage for this period (e.g., after lapse due to non-payment but within reinstatement window).

attributes.name: reinstatement_deadline_date
attributes.description: The last date by which the member can reinstate coverage for this period without reapplying or undergoing new underwriting.

attributes.name: extension_count
attributes.description: The number of times this effective period has been extended beyond its original end date (e.g., COBRA extensions, disability extensions).

attributes.name: last_extension_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent extension to this effective period was processed.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment period was automatically renewed without explicit member action (passive renewal).

attributes.name: passive_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was passively renewed into the same or similar plan without taking action during open enrollment.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The calendar year or plan year to which this effective period applies, used for benefits administration and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: benefit_end_date
attributes.description: The date when benefits cease to be available, which may differ from the effective end date due to run-out periods or grace periods.

attributes.name: claims_runout_end_date
attributes.description: The final date by which claims for services rendered during this effective period must be submitted for adjudication.

attributes.name: premium_payment_responsibility
attributes.description: Indicates who is responsible for premium payment during this effective period (member, employer, government subsidy, shared responsibility, third-party payer).
attributes.references: ACA Premium Payment and Subsidy Rules

attributes.name: aptc_applied_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC) Applied Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Advanced Premium Tax Credits are being applied to reduce member premium payments during this effective period.

attributes.name: csr_applied_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Cost Sharing Reductions are applied to this enrollment, reducing out-of-pocket costs for eligible members.

attributes.name: subsidy_eligibility_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member's eligibility for premium subsidies or cost-sharing reductions has been verified by the exchange or CMS.

attributes.name: exchange_assigned_policy_id
attributes.description: The unique policy identifier assigned by the health insurance exchange (FFM or SBM) for marketplace enrollments.

attributes.name: exchange_subscriber_code
attributes.description: The unique subscriber identifier assigned by the health insurance exchange for tracking marketplace enrollments.

attributes.name: issuer_assigned_policy_id
attributes.description: The unique policy identifier assigned by the insurance carrier (issuer) for this enrollment period, distinct from exchange-assigned identifiers.

attributes.name: issuer_assigned_member_number
attributes.description: The unique member identifier assigned by the insurance carrier for this enrollment period.

attributes.name: group_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number for the employer group or association under which this enrollment is covered, if applicable.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The contract number associated with this enrollment period, linking to the specific benefit plan contract terms and conditions.

attributes.name: benefit_package_id
attributes.description: The three-digit Plan Benefit Package identifier used in Medicare Advantage to identify the specific benefit design within a contract.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: The three-digit segment identifier used in Medicare Advantage to identify benefit variations within a Plan Benefit Package.

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: The line of business classification for this enrollment period (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace, CHIP, TRICARE, VA, Other).

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: The market segment classification for this enrollment (Large Group, Small Group, Individual, Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, Medicaid Managed Care, Dual Eligible, Exchange).

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: The funding arrangement for this enrollment period (Fully Insured, Self-Funded, Administrative Services Only, Level Funded, Multiple Employer Welfare Arrangement, Voluntary Employees Beneficiary Association, Taft-Hartley).

attributes.name: aso_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is under an Administrative Services Only arrangement where the employer assumes financial risk and the carrier provides administrative services only.

attributes.name: stop_loss_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether stop-loss insurance coverage is in place for this enrollment period, typically applicable to self-funded arrangements.

attributes.name: medicare_secondary_payer_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Medicare is the secondary payer for this enrollment period due to other primary coverage (employer group health plan, liability, workers compensation).

attributes.name: cob_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether coordination of benefits rules apply to this enrollment period due to the member having multiple coverage sources.

attributes.name: cob_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage is primary, secondary, or tertiary in the coordination of benefits hierarchy.

attributes.name: enrollment_source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system from which this effective period record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, Exchange EDI feed).

attributes.name: enrollment_transaction_id
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier from the source enrollment system that created or modified this effective period record.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Transaction Set Control Number

attributes.name: edi_834_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the HIPAA 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance transaction that established or modified this effective period.

attributes.name: enrollment_received_date
attributes.description: The date when the enrollment application or change request was received by the carrier or exchange.

attributes.name: enrollment_processed_date
attributes.description: The date when the enrollment was fully processed and the effective period was established in the system.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmed_date
attributes.description: The date when enrollment confirmation was sent to the member, employer, or exchange.

attributes.name: first_premium_payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the first premium payment must be received to activate coverage for this effective period.

attributes.name: first_premium_payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date when the first premium payment (binder payment) was received, confirming activation of coverage.

attributes.name: binder_payment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a binder payment (first premium payment) is required before coverage can become effective for this enrollment period.

attributes.name: late_enrollment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment was submitted after the standard enrollment deadline, potentially subject to late enrollment penalties or restrictions.
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Late Enrollment Penalty

attributes.name: late_enrollment_penalty_months
attributes.description: The number of months of late enrollment penalty applied to this enrollment, typically for Medicare Part D late enrollment.
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Late Enrollment Penalty Calculation

attributes.name: underwriting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical underwriting was required for this enrollment period (typically not allowed for ACA-compliant plans but may apply to grandfathered or excepted benefit plans).

attributes.name: underwriting_decision
attributes.description: The underwriting decision for this enrollment (approved, declined, modified with exclusions, pending review, not applicable).

attributes.name: underwriting_decision_date
attributes.description: The date when the underwriting decision was made for this enrollment.

attributes.name: pre_existing_condition_exclusion_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether pre-existing condition exclusions apply to this enrollment period (generally prohibited under ACA but may apply to grandfathered plans).

attributes.name: pre_existing_condition_exclusion_end_date
attributes.description: The date when any pre-existing condition exclusion period ends and full coverage becomes effective.

attributes.name: tobacco_user_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is a tobacco user, which may affect premium rating under ACA rules.

attributes.name: tobacco_surcharge_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tobacco use surcharge is applied to premiums for this enrollment period.

attributes.name: wellness_program_participation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is participating in employer or plan-sponsored wellness programs that may affect premium rates or benefits.

attributes.name: wellness_incentive_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether wellness program incentives (premium discounts, reduced cost-sharing) are applied to this enrollment period.

attributes.name: hipaa_special_enrollment_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Special Enrollment Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment qualifies as a HIPAA special enrollment event, allowing enrollment outside normal enrollment periods.

attributes.name: chip_eligibility_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP) Eligibility Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for CHIP coverage during this enrollment period.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is dual eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid during this enrollment period.

attributes.name: lis_level
attributes.description: The level of Low Income Subsidy (Extra Help) for Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage (Full, 75%, 50%, 25%, None).
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Low Income Subsidy

attributes.name: lis_copay_category
attributes.description: The two-digit copay category code for Low Income Subsidy members, determining cost-sharing levels for Part D drugs.

attributes.name: snp_type
attributes.description: The type of Special Needs Plan if applicable (Dual Eligible SNP, Chronic Condition SNP, Institutional SNP, Not Applicable).

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has End Stage Renal Disease, affecting Medicare eligibility and enrollment options.

attributes.name: disability_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member qualifies for coverage based on disability status, affecting Medicare eligibility and enrollment.

attributes.name: hospice_election_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has elected hospice care, which affects Medicare coverage and enrollment status.

attributes.name: institutional_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member resides in an institution (nursing home, assisted living, hospital, prison) or in the community, affecting benefit eligibility and SNP qualification.

attributes.name: ltss_eligibility_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Term Services and Supports (LTSS) Eligibility Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is eligible for Long Term Services and Supports under Medicaid managed care.

attributes.name: mltss_enrollment_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Managed Long Term Services and Supports (MLTSS) Enrollment Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is enrolled in a Managed Long Term Services and Supports program.

attributes.name: pace_enrollment_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) Enrollment Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is enrolled in a PACE program providing comprehensive medical and social services.

attributes.name: data_source_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the original source of the enrollment data for this effective period (employer file, exchange 834 transaction, direct application, broker, etc.).

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current status of this effective period record in the data warehouse (active, inactive, superseded by newer record, deleted, pending verification).

attributes.name: record_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this version of the effective period record became effective in the data warehouse, supporting Type 2 slowly changing dimension tracking.

attributes.name: record_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this version of the effective period record was superseded by a newer version, supporting Type 2 slowly changing dimension tracking. Null indicates current record.

attributes.name: current_record_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active version of the effective period record in the Type 2 slowly changing dimension.

attributes.name: pbp_code

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment. Business justification: Waivers document when eligible employees decline coverage for a specific enrollment period. HR and compliance track waivers to prove employees were offered coverage.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Coverage waivers impact premium revenue recognition and must be tracked within specific financial periods for accurate revenue reporting, MLR calculations, and financial statement preparation. Used in

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.agent. Business justification: Coverage waivers require agent review and approval. Tracking which agent processed the waiver is critical for compliance audits and member service continuity.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.contract. Business justification: Coverage waivers must reference the underlying contract to validate waiver eligibility and document which contractual benefits the member is declining. HR and compliance teams verify contract terms.

products.name: termination_reason
products.description: Reference list of reasons for enrollment termination (non‑payment, voluntary drop, employer termination).

attributes.name: termination_reason_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the enrollment termination reason record.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the termination reason for system processing and reporting.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the termination reason for business user display and reporting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the termination reason including business rules and applicability conditions.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the termination reason grouping similar reasons for analysis and reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity within the termination category.

attributes.name: is_member_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination was initiated by the member versus the employer or carrier.

attributes.name: is_employer_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination was initiated by the employer group.

attributes.name: is_carrier_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination was initiated by the insurance carrier.

attributes.name: requires_notice
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason requires advance notice to the member per regulatory or contractual requirements.

attributes.name: notice_days_required
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required before termination becomes effective for this reason.

attributes.name: allows_cobra_continuation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Continuation Eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether members terminated for this reason are eligible for COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: allows_special_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason qualifies the member for a special enrollment period in another plan.

attributes.name: sep_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days the member has to enroll in a new plan under special enrollment period rules following this termination.
attributes.references: CMS Marketplace Special Enrollment Period Regulations

attributes.name: requires_refund
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason requires refund of unearned premium to the member or employer.

attributes.name: refund_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate premium refund amount when termination occurs mid-period.

attributes.name: impacts_mlr
attributes.description: Indicates whether terminations for this reason impact Medical Loss Ratio calculations and rebate requirements.

attributes.name: is_qualifying_life_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason constitutes a qualifying life event for enrollment purposes.

attributes.name: qle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the qualifying life event type if this termination reason constitutes a QLE.

attributes.name: requires_attestation
attributes.description: Indicates whether member attestation or documentation is required to process termination for this reason.

attributes.name: attestation_type
attributes.description: Type of attestation or documentation required from the member to support the termination reason.

attributes.name: effective_date_rule
attributes.description: Business rule determining when the termination becomes effective based on this reason.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days grace period allowed before termination becomes effective for this reason.

attributes.name: allows_reinstatement
attributes.description: Indicates whether members terminated for this reason can be reinstated without re-enrollment.

attributes.name: requires_claims_runout
attributes.description: Indicates whether claims incurred before termination can be submitted during a runout period.

attributes.name: claims_runout_days
attributes.description: Number of days after termination during which claims for services rendered before termination can be submitted.

attributes.name: impacts_risk_adjustment
attributes.description: Indicates whether terminations for this reason impact risk adjustment calculations and Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) reporting.

attributes.name: cms_reporting_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reporting Code
attributes.description: Standard code used for reporting this termination reason to CMS for Medicare Advantage and Part D plans.
attributes.references: CMS RAPS and EDPS Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: state_reporting_code
attributes.description: Standard code used for reporting this termination reason to state insurance departments.

attributes.name: applies_to_individual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason applies to individual market plans.

attributes.name: applies_to_small_group
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason applies to small group employer plans.

attributes.name: applies_to_large_group
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason applies to large group employer plans.

attributes.name: applies_to_medicare
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason applies to Medicare Advantage plans.

attributes.name: applies_to_medicaid
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason applies to Medicaid managed care plans.

attributes.name: applies_to_marketplace
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason applies to Qualified Health Plans (QHP) sold through federal or state marketplaces.

attributes.name: requires_subsidy_reconciliation
attributes.description: Indicates whether terminations for this reason require reconciliation of Advanced Premium Tax Credits (APTC) with the marketplace.

attributes.name: triggers_disenrollment_notice
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason automatically triggers generation of a disenrollment notice to the member.

attributes.name: notice_template_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard notice template to be used for member communication regarding this termination reason.

attributes.name: requires_appeal_rights_notice
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must be notified of their appeal rights when terminated for this reason.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2719 Internal Claims and Appeals

attributes.name: appeal_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of days the member has to file an appeal of the termination decision.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2719 Internal Claims and Appeals

attributes.name: is_reportable_to_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination must be reported to the health insurance exchange (FFM or SBM).

attributes.name: exchange_transaction_type
attributes.description: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transaction type used to report this termination to the exchange.

attributes.name: impacts_commission
attributes.description: Indicates whether terminations for this reason impact agent or broker commission calculations.

attributes.name: commission_adjustment_rule
attributes.description: Rule determining how agent commissions are adjusted when a member is terminated for this reason.

attributes.name: is_fraud_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Related Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason is related to suspected or confirmed fraud, waste, or abuse.

attributes.name: requires_siu_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether terminations for this reason require review by the Special Investigations Unit.

attributes.name: is_voluntary_disenrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination represents a voluntary disenrollment by the member.

attributes.name: is_involuntary_disenrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination represents an involuntary disenrollment not initiated by the member.

attributes.name: requires_good_cause_determination
attributes.description: Indicates whether a good cause determination is required before processing termination for this reason (primarily for Medicaid).
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR 438.56

attributes.name: priority_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence indicating the priority order when multiple termination reasons could apply to the same enrollment.

attributes.name: is_death_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason is due to the death of the member.

attributes.name: requires_death_certificate
attributes.description: Indicates whether a death certificate must be obtained to process termination for this reason.

attributes.name: triggers_beneficiary_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason triggers notification to designated beneficiaries or estate representatives.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this termination reason code in the system.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this termination reason became available for use in enrollment processing.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this termination reason is no longer available for use in enrollment processing.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this termination reason record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this termination reason record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the display order of termination reasons in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: is_system_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this termination reason can be automatically assigned by system processes versus requiring manual selection.

attributes.name: requires_supervisor_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether use of this termination reason requires supervisor or manager approval before processing.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether enhanced audit logging is required when this termination reason is used.

attributes.name: external_code_mapping
attributes.description: Mapping to equivalent termination reason codes used in external systems or by trading partners.

attributes.name: legacy_code
attributes.description: Termination reason code from legacy systems maintained for historical data reconciliation.

products.name: dependent_enrollment
products.description: Master record linking dependents to a parent enrollment, capturing relationship and coverage details.

attributes.name: dependent_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the dependent enrollment record linking a dependent to a parent subscriber's coverage.

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the primary subscriber (parent) to whom this dependent is linked for coverage.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the dependent member enrolled under the subscriber's plan.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employer or group under which the dependent is enrolled.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan under which the dependent is enrolled.

attributes.name: relationship_code
attributes.description: Standard code indicating the dependent's relationship to the subscriber (e.g., 01=Spouse, 19=Child, 53=Life Partner). Uses ANSI X12 1069 relationship codes.

attributes.name: relationship_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the dependent's relationship to the subscriber (e.g., Spouse, Child, Domestic Partner, Stepchild).

attributes.name: dependent_first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the dependent as it appears on official identification documents.

attributes.name: dependent_middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the dependent.

attributes.name: dependent_last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname) of the dependent as it appears on official identification documents.

attributes.name: dependent_suffix
attributes.description: Name suffix of the dependent (e.g., Jr, Sr, II, III).

attributes.name: dependent_ssn
attributes.description: Social Security Number of the dependent used for tax reporting and identification purposes.
attributes.references: Social Security Act, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502

attributes.name: dependent_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the dependent used for age verification, eligibility determination, and coverage rules.

attributes.name: dependent_gender
attributes.description: Gender of the dependent (M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown, X=Non-binary/Other).

attributes.name: dependent_marital_status
attributes.description: Marital status of the dependent (S=Single, M=Married, D=Divorced, W=Widowed, P=Domestic Partner, U=Unknown).

attributes.name: dependent_student_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent is a full-time student (F), part-time student (P), or not a student (N). Used for extended coverage eligibility determination.

attributes.name: dependent_disabled_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent has a qualifying disability that extends coverage eligibility beyond standard age limits.

attributes.name: dependent_tobacco_user_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent uses tobacco products, which may affect premium calculations under ACA provisions.

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent's coverage under the plan becomes active and benefits are available.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Transaction Set, ERISA Section 609

attributes.name: coverage_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent's coverage under the plan ends and benefits are no longer available.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 834 Transaction Set, ERISA Section 609

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Type of enrollment transaction being processed (new enrollment, plan change, termination, reinstatement, audit correction).

attributes.name: enrollment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standard code indicating the reason for the enrollment transaction (e.g., 01=Birth/Adoption, 02=Marriage, 03=Open Enrollment, 04=Loss of Other Coverage). Uses ANSI X12 1205 reason codes.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 1205 Reason Code, HIPAA EDI 834

attributes.name: enrollment_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the reason for the enrollment transaction (e.g., Birth of Child, Marriage, Open Enrollment Period, Qualifying Life Event).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 1205 Reason Code, HIPAA EDI 834

attributes.name: qle_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment was triggered by a Qualifying Life Event that allows special enrollment outside of open enrollment periods.

attributes.name: qle_event_date
attributes.description: Date when the Qualifying Life Event occurred that triggered the special enrollment eligibility.

attributes.name: sep_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment occurred during a Special Enrollment Period outside of the standard open enrollment window.

attributes.name: sep_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the Special Enrollment Period during which the dependent was enrolled.

attributes.name: sep_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the Special Enrollment Period during which the dependent could be enrolled.

attributes.name: cobra_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependent enrollment is under COBRA continuation coverage following a qualifying event.

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event
attributes.description: Type of qualifying event that triggered COBRA continuation coverage eligibility (termination of employment, reduction in hours, death of covered employee, divorce, legal separation, Medicare entitlement, dependent child losing eligibility).

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event Date
attributes.description: Date when the COBRA qualifying event occurred that triggered continuation coverage eligibility.

attributes.name: cobra_election_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent (or subscriber on their behalf) elected to continue coverage under COBRA.

attributes.name: cobra_max_coverage_months
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Maximum Coverage Months
attributes.description: Maximum number of months the dependent is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage based on the qualifying event type (typically 18, 29, or 36 months).

attributes.name: medicare_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent has Medicare coverage, which affects coordination of benefits and secondary payer rules.

attributes.name: medicare_part_a_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent's Medicare Part A (hospital insurance) coverage became effective.

attributes.name: medicare_part_b_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent's Medicare Part B (medical insurance) coverage became effective.

attributes.name: medicaid_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent has Medicaid coverage, which affects coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: medicaid_beneficiary_identifier
attributes.description: State-issued Medicaid identification number for the dependent.

attributes.name: other_insurance_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent has other health insurance coverage that requires coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: cob_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan is primary, secondary, or tertiary for coordination of benefits when the dependent has multiple coverages.

attributes.name: age_limit_override_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent has an approved override to continue coverage beyond the standard age limit (typically 26) due to disability or other qualifying circumstances.

attributes.name: age_limit_override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the dependent is allowed to continue coverage beyond the standard age limit.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Rating tier that determines premium structure based on who is covered (employee only, employee+spouse, employee+child, employee+children, employee+family).

attributes.name: benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific benefit package or plan design the dependent is enrolled in.

attributes.name: pcp_assignment_required_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) Assignment Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent is required to select a Primary Care Physician under the plan design (typically required for HMO plans).

attributes.name: pcp_npi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) National Provider Identifier (NPI)
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the Primary Care Physician assigned to or selected by the dependent.

attributes.name: pcp_effective_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) Assignment Effective Date
attributes.description: Date when the Primary Care Physician assignment became effective for the dependent.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Monthly premium amount attributable to this dependent's coverage.

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which premiums are collected for the dependent's coverage (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual).

attributes.name: premium_payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which premiums are collected for the dependent's coverage (payroll deduction, direct bill, ACH, credit card, check).

attributes.name: subsidy_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent's coverage is eligible for premium tax credits or subsidies under ACA marketplace rules.

attributes.name: subsidy_amount
attributes.description: Monthly premium subsidy or tax credit amount applied to reduce the dependent's coverage cost.

attributes.name: aptc_amount
attributes.description: Monthly Advanced Premium Tax Credit amount applied to the dependent's coverage through the ACA marketplace.

attributes.name: csr_level
attributes.description: Cost Sharing Reduction level applied to the dependent's coverage (none, 73%, 87%, 94% actuarial value) based on income eligibility.

attributes.name: exchange_assigned_policy_id
attributes.description: Policy identifier assigned by the health insurance exchange (FFM or SBM) for marketplace enrollments.

attributes.name: exchange_subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Subscriber identifier assigned by the health insurance exchange for marketplace enrollments.

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the enrollment application or transaction that created this dependent enrollment record.

attributes.name: enrollment_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment application for the dependent was received by the health plan.

attributes.name: enrollment_processed_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment application for the dependent was processed and approved by the health plan.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number provided to the subscriber upon successful enrollment of the dependent.

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of eligibility verification for the dependent (verified, pending verification, verification failed, not required).

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent's eligibility for coverage was verified.

attributes.name: documentation_status
attributes.description: Status of required documentation for the dependent enrollment (complete, incomplete, pending review, not required).

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Citizenship or immigration status of the dependent, which affects eligibility for certain coverage types and subsidies.

attributes.name: incarceration_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent is currently incarcerated, which affects eligibility for marketplace coverage and Medicaid.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the dependent's residence.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the dependent's residence (apartment, suite, unit number).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the dependent's residence.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code of the dependent's residence.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the dependent's residence (5-digit or 9-digit format).
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standards, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County of the dependent's residence, used for rating and network determination.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the dependent's residence.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the dependent.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address for the dependent, used for communications and digital engagement.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for communications with the dependent (eng=English, spa=Spanish, chi=Chinese, etc.).

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method of communication for the dependent (mail, email, phone, text message, member portal, no preference).

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent (or parent/guardian) has provided HIPAA authorization for disclosure of protected health information.

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Date
attributes.description: Date when HIPAA authorization was provided by the dependent or their legal representative.

attributes.name: notice_of_privacy_practices_provided_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Notice of Privacy Practices Provided Date
attributes.description: Date when the Notice of Privacy Practices was provided to the dependent or their legal representative.

attributes.name: voluntary_termination_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent's coverage termination was voluntary (initiated by subscriber) or involuntary (initiated by plan).

attributes.name: reinstatement_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent is eligible for reinstatement of coverage following termination.

attributes.name: reinstatement_deadline_date
attributes.description: Last date by which the dependent can request reinstatement of coverage without reapplying.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this dependent enrollment record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this dependent enrollment record in the source system.

attributes.name: record_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this version of the dependent enrollment record became effective in the source system.

attributes.name: record_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this version of the dependent enrollment record was superseded or became inactive in the source system.

attributes.name: current_record_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active version of the dependent enrollment record.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the primary subscriber (parent) to whom this dependent is linked for coverage.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the dependent member enrolled under the subscriber's plan.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan under which the dependent is enrolled.

attributes.name: exchange_subscriber_code
attributes.description: Subscriber identifier assigned by the health insurance exchange for marketplace enrollments.

attributes.name: enrollment_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.status. Business justification: Dependent_enrollment enrollment status should reference the status reference table for standardized status management. The enrollment_status STRING column will be replaced by enrollment_status_id FK t

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.qualifying_life_event. Business justification: Dependent_enrollment QLE event type should reference the qualifying_life_event table. The qle_event_type STRING column will be replaced by qle_event_type_id FK to qualifying_life_event.qualifying_life

attributes.name: enrollment_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.source. Business justification: Dependent_enrollment enrollment source should reference the source table. The enrollment_source STRING column will be replaced by enrollment_source_id FK to source.source_id.

attributes.name: termination_reason_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.termination_reason. Business justification: Dependent_enrollment termination reason should reference the termination_reason table. The termination_reason_code and termination_reason_description columns will be replaced by termination_reason_id

attributes.name: plan_option_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.plan_option. Business justification: Dependent_enrollment should reference plan_option for plan details. The hios_plan_id and metal_level columns will be replaced by plan_option_id FK to plan_option.plan_option_id.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Dependent enrollments may have separate billing accounts (divorced parents, adult dependents). System needs billing account reference for premium allocation and collection.

products.name: plan_option
products.description: Reference of available plan options (HMO, PPO, HDHP) and associated benefit structures for enrollment selection.

attributes.name: plan_option_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the plan option. Primary key for the plan option entity.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the plan option for system identification and reference.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Full marketing name of the plan option as displayed to members and employers.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the plan structure indicating network and coverage model. HMO (Health Maintenance Organization), PPO (Preferred Provider Organization), EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization), POS (Point of Service), HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan), CDHP (Consumer Directed Health Plan).

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Business segment or market category for the plan option. LOB (Line of Business), ASO (Administrative Services Only), TPA (Third Party Administrator).

attributes.name: metal_tier
attributes.description: ACA (Affordable Care Act) metal tier classification indicating actuarial value and cost-sharing level for exchange plans.

attributes.name: actuarial_value
attributes.description: Percentage of total average costs for covered benefits that the plan will cover, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 70.00 for 70%).

attributes.name: hsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan option qualifies for Health Savings Account (HSA) contributions under IRS regulations.

attributes.name: fsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan option is compatible with Flexible Spending Account (FSA) enrollment.

attributes.name: hra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan option qualifies for Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) funding.

attributes.name: individual_deductible_in_network
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount that an individual member must pay for in-network covered services before the plan begins cost-sharing.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: individual_deductible_out_of_network
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount that an individual member must pay for out-of-network covered services before the plan begins cost-sharing.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: family_deductible_in_network
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount that a family must collectively pay for in-network covered services before the plan begins cost-sharing.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: family_deductible_out_of_network
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount that a family must collectively pay for out-of-network covered services before the plan begins cost-sharing.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: individual_oop_max_in_network
attributes.description: Maximum annual amount an individual member will pay for in-network covered services. OOP (Out of Pocket).

attributes.name: individual_oop_max_out_of_network
attributes.description: Maximum annual amount an individual member will pay for out-of-network covered services. OOP (Out of Pocket).

attributes.name: family_oop_max_in_network
attributes.description: Maximum annual amount a family will collectively pay for in-network covered services. OOP (Out of Pocket).

attributes.name: family_oop_max_out_of_network
attributes.description: Maximum annual amount a family will collectively pay for out-of-network covered services. OOP (Out of Pocket).

attributes.name: coinsurance_in_network
attributes.description: Percentage of covered service costs that the member pays after meeting the deductible for in-network services (e.g., 20.00 for 20%).
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: coinsurance_out_of_network
attributes.description: Percentage of covered service costs that the member pays after meeting the deductible for out-of-network services (e.g., 40.00 for 40%).
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: pcp_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for a Primary Care Physician (PCP) office visit.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: specialist_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for a specialist physician office visit.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: emergency_room_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for an emergency room visit.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: urgent_care_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for an urgent care facility visit.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: inpatient_hospital_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount or coinsurance the member pays per inpatient hospital admission or per day.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: outpatient_surgery_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for outpatient surgical procedures.

attributes.name: prescription_generic_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for generic prescription drugs.

attributes.name: prescription_preferred_brand_copay

attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for preferred brand-name prescription drugs.

attributes.name: prescription_non_preferred_brand_copay

attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for non-preferred brand-name prescription drugs.

attributes.name: prescription_specialty_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount or coinsurance the member pays for specialty prescription drugs.

attributes.name: preventive_care_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether preventive care services are covered at 100% with no cost-sharing as required by ACA (Affordable Care Act).

attributes.name: dental_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether dental benefits are included in the plan option or offered as a separate rider.
attributes.references: ACA Pediatric Dental Essential Health Benefit

attributes.name: vision_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether vision benefits are included in the plan option or offered as a separate rider.
attributes.references: ACA Pediatric Vision Essential Health Benefit

attributes.name: mental_health_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether mental health and substance use disorder services are covered under the plan. MH (Mental Health).
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA)

attributes.name: maternity_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether maternity and newborn care services are covered under the plan.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits - Maternity and Newborn Care

attributes.name: prescription_drug_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether prescription drug benefits are included in the plan option.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits - Prescription Drugs

attributes.name: telehealth_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether telehealth or telemedicine services are covered under the plan option.

attributes.name: pcp_referral_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) Referral Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan requires a Primary Care Physician (PCP) referral to see specialists.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan requires prior authorization for certain services or procedures. PA (Prior Authorization).

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan provides any coverage for out-of-network providers.

attributes.name: lifetime_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the plan will pay over the member's lifetime. ACA (Affordable Care Act) prohibits lifetime limits on essential health benefits.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2711 Prohibition on Lifetime Limits

attributes.name: annual_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the plan will pay in a plan year. ACA (Affordable Care Act) prohibits annual limits on essential health benefits.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan meets ACA (Affordable Care Act) Minimum Essential Coverage (MEC) requirements.

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member elected to enroll in COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.description: The start date of the 60-day election period during which the member can elect COBRA coverage.

attributes.name: election_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the 60-day election period during which the member can elect COBRA coverage.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which COBRA continuation coverage ends for the member.

attributes.description: The maximum number of months the member is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage (typically 18, 29, or 36 months depending on qualifying event).

attributes.description: Indicates whether the member qualifies for extended COBRA coverage beyond the standard 18 months (e.g., due to disability or second qualifying event).

attributes.name: total_monthly_cost

attributes.name: grace_period_days
