domains.name: quality
domains.description: Quality measurement and reporting including HEDIS measures, CAHPS surveys, CMS Stars ratings, quality improvement programs, and accreditation compliance (NCQA, URAC). Tracks clinical quality metrics, member satisfaction, and regulatory quality reporting.

products.name: measure
products.description: Standardized definition of each HEDIS quality measure including numerator, denominator, specifications, and reporting period.

attributes.name: measure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality measure record.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code identifying the specific HEDIS or quality measure (e.g., CBP, CDC, BCS).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the quality measure (e.g., Controlling High Blood Pressure, Comprehensive Diabetes Care).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the measure based on what it evaluates (process, outcome, structure, patient experience, efficiency, intermediate outcome, or composite).

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the measure category (e.g., Diabetes Care, Cardiovascular Care, Preventive Screening).

attributes.name: steward
attributes.description: Organization responsible for developing and maintaining the measure (e.g., NCQA, CMS, NQF).

attributes.name: nqf_number
attributes.description: Four-digit identifier assigned by the National Quality Forum for endorsed quality measures.

attributes.name: cms_measure_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Measure Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by CMS for measures used in Medicare and Medicaid quality programs.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of what the measure evaluates and its clinical or operational significance.

attributes.name: clinical_rationale
attributes.description: Evidence-based justification explaining why the measure is clinically important and how it impacts patient outcomes.

attributes.name: numerator_definition
attributes.description: Detailed specification of the criteria that members must meet to be included in the numerator (compliant population).

attributes.name: denominator_definition
attributes.description: Detailed specification of the eligible population for the measure (all members who should be evaluated).

attributes.name: denominator_exclusions
attributes.description: Criteria for removing members from the denominator due to valid clinical or administrative reasons.

attributes.name: denominator_exceptions
attributes.description: Circumstances under which members are removed from the denominator due to medical, patient, or system reasons.

attributes.name: numerator_exclusions
attributes.description: Criteria for removing members from the numerator even if they initially met numerator criteria.

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Primary methodology used to collect data for the measure (administrative claims, hybrid with medical record review, survey, EHR, or case management system).

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Type of time period over which the measure is evaluated (calendar year, rolling 12 months, measurement year, or custom).

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the period during which measure performance is evaluated.

attributes.name: lookback_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months prior to the measurement period during which historical data is evaluated for measure compliance.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: How often the measure results must be calculated and reported to regulatory bodies or internal stakeholders.

attributes.name: age_range_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum age in years for members to be included in the measure denominator.

attributes.name: age_range_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum age in years for members to be included in the measure denominator.

attributes.name: age_determination_date
attributes.description: Specific date used to calculate member age for measure eligibility (e.g., end of measurement period, start of measurement period).

attributes.name: continuous_enrollment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must be continuously enrolled during the measurement period to be included in the measure.

attributes.name: continuous_enrollment_months
attributes.description: Number of months of continuous enrollment required for measure eligibility.

attributes.name: allowable_gap_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days a member can have a gap in enrollment and still be considered continuously enrolled.

attributes.name: benefit_type_required
attributes.description: Specific benefit coverage required for measure eligibility (e.g., medical, pharmacy, behavioral health).

attributes.name: product_line_applicability
attributes.description: Lines of business to which the measure applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace).

attributes.name: stratification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measure must be reported with stratified results by demographic or clinical subgroups.

attributes.name: stratification_criteria
attributes.description: Specific dimensions by which measure results must be stratified (e.g., age groups, gender, race/ethnicity, disease severity).

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_method
attributes.description: Statistical methodology used to adjust measure results for differences in patient case mix or severity.

attributes.name: value_set_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the clinical code value sets (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, LOINC, RxNorm) used in measure specifications.

attributes.name: icd10_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ICD-10 diagnosis codes used in numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria.

attributes.name: cpt_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CPT procedure codes used in numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria.

attributes.name: hcpcs_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of HCPCS codes used in numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria.

attributes.name: loinc_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC) Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of LOINC codes for laboratory tests and clinical observations used in measure specifications.

attributes.name: rxnorm_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of RxNorm codes for medications used in numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria.

attributes.name: ndc_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of NDC codes for specific drug products used in measure specifications.

attributes.name: revenue_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UB-04 revenue codes used to identify specific services or accommodations in measure specifications.

attributes.name: place_of_service_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of two-digit codes identifying the location where services were rendered for measure evaluation.
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set

attributes.name: score_type
attributes.description: Type of calculation used to express measure performance (proportion, ratio, continuous variable, or rate).

attributes.name: higher_score_interpretation
attributes.description: Indicates whether a higher measure score represents better performance, worse performance, or is not applicable.

attributes.name: benchmark_source
attributes.description: Organization or entity providing the performance benchmark for comparison (e.g., NCQA, CMS, internal targets).

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile_50th
attributes.description: Median performance rate from the benchmark population, representing the 50th percentile.

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile_75th
attributes.description: Performance rate at the 75th percentile from the benchmark population.

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile_90th
attributes.description: Performance rate at the 90th percentile from the benchmark population, often representing best-in-class performance.

attributes.name: minimum_denominator_size
attributes.description: Minimum number of eligible members required in the denominator for the measure to be reportable and statistically valid.

attributes.name: stars_rating_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measure is included in the CMS Stars rating program for Medicare Advantage and Part D plans.

attributes.name: stars_rating_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor applied to this measure in the overall CMS Stars rating calculation (typically 1, 3, or 5).

attributes.name: stars_rating_domain
attributes.description: CMS Stars rating category to which this measure contributes (e.g., Staying Healthy, Managing Chronic Conditions, Member Experience).

attributes.name: quality_improvement_priority
attributes.description: Internal priority level assigned to this measure for quality improvement initiatives and resource allocation.

attributes.name: accreditation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measure is required for NCQA, URAC, or other accreditation programs.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Organization requiring this measure for accreditation purposes (e.g., NCQA, URAC, Joint Commission).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measure must be reported to state or federal regulatory agencies.

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory agency to which this measure must be reported (e.g., CMS, State Department of Insurance).

attributes.name: reporting_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which measure results must be submitted to regulatory or accreditation bodies.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the measure (active, retired, under development, suspended, or deprecated).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this measure specification became effective and available for use.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when this measure was or will be retired and no longer used for quality reporting.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the measure specification, indicating updates or revisions to measure logic.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the measure specification was last revised or updated.

attributes.name: data_source_systems
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of source systems from which data is extracted for measure calculation (e.g., claims system, EHR, pharmacy system).

attributes.name: calculation_logic_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to detailed technical documentation describing the measure calculation algorithm and business rules.

attributes.name: audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measure is subject to external audit or validation by NCQA, CMS, or other oversight bodies.

attributes.name: medical_record_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether manual medical record review is required as part of the hybrid data collection methodology.

attributes.name: sample_size_required
attributes.description: Number of medical records that must be reviewed for hybrid measures to meet NCQA sampling requirements.

attributes.name: supplemental_data_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether supplemental data (e.g., lab results, biometric data) must be collected beyond administrative claims.

attributes.name: telehealth_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether services delivered via telehealth can be counted toward measure numerator compliance.

attributes.name: health_equity_focus
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measure is prioritized for health equity analysis and disparity reduction initiatives.

attributes.name: social_determinants_of_health_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measure incorporates or is influenced by social determinants of health factors.

products.name: measure_category
products.description: Logical grouping of quality measures (e.g., Preventive Care, Chronic Disease Management).

attributes.name: measure_category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality measure category. Primary key for the measure category entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code representing the measure category for system integration and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name of the quality measure category as defined by the governing quality organization.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the measure category including its purpose, scope, and the types of quality measures it encompasses.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the measure category based on the nature of quality measurement (clinical outcomes, administrative processes, patient satisfaction, etc.).

attributes.name: domain
attributes.description: Broad quality domain or focus area that the measure category addresses within the healthcare quality framework.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the measure category indicating whether it is actively used for quality measurement and reporting.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Strategic priority level assigned to the measure category based on organizational quality improvement goals and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: reporting_program
attributes.description: Primary quality reporting program or initiative that utilizes measures within this category for performance evaluation and public reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether measures in this category are mandated by federal or state regulatory requirements for health plan accreditation or compliance.

attributes.name: accreditation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measure category is required for health plan accreditation by organizations such as National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) or Utilization Review Accreditation Commission (URAC).

attributes.name: stars_rating_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Stars Rating Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether measures in this category directly impact the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Stars quality rating for Medicare Advantage (MA) and Prescription Drug Plan (PDP) products.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings

attributes.name: stars_rating_weight
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Stars Rating Weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight assigned to this measure category in the overall Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Stars rating calculation, expressed as a percentage or multiplier.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings Technical Notes

attributes.name: line_of_business_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of health plan Lines of Business (LOB) to which this measure category applies (e.g., Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicaid, Commercial, Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP)).

attributes.name: product_line_applicability
attributes.description: Specific health plan product lines to which this measure category applies (e.g., Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS)).

attributes.name: population_focus
attributes.description: Target member population or age group that measures within this category are designed to assess and improve health outcomes for.

attributes.name: clinical_specialty
attributes.description: Primary clinical specialty or medical discipline associated with measures in this category (e.g., cardiology, endocrinology, behavioral health).

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Standard time period over which measures in this category are calculated and reported for quality assessment purposes.

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Primary methodology used to collect data for measures within this category as specified by quality reporting requirements.

attributes.name: numerator_definition
attributes.description: Standard definition of the numerator criteria for measures within this category, describing the population that meets the quality standard.

attributes.name: denominator_definition
attributes.description: Standard definition of the denominator criteria for measures within this category, describing the eligible population for quality assessment.

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Standard criteria for excluding members from the denominator of measures in this category based on clinical or administrative reasons.

attributes.name: benchmark_source
attributes.description: Organization or entity that provides performance benchmarks and percentile rankings for measures within this category.

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile_50th
attributes.description: National or regional 50th percentile benchmark value for measures in this category, representing median performance across health plans.

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile_75th
attributes.description: National or regional 75th percentile benchmark value for measures in this category, representing above-average performance across health plans.

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile_90th
attributes.description: National or regional 90th percentile benchmark value for measures in this category, representing top-tier performance across health plans.

attributes.name: target_performance_rate
attributes.description: Organizational target performance rate for measures in this category, expressed as a percentage, representing the quality improvement goal.

attributes.name: minimum_performance_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable performance rate for measures in this category below which corrective action or quality improvement initiatives are triggered.

attributes.name: improvement_priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measure category has been designated as a priority area for focused quality improvement initiatives and resource allocation.

attributes.name: pay_for_performance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether measures in this category are tied to provider pay-for-performance or value-based care incentive programs.

attributes.name: public_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether performance results for measures in this category are publicly reported on websites such as Medicare Plan Finder or state transparency portals.

attributes.name: member_facing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether measures in this category are communicated directly to members through quality report cards, wellness programs, or member portals.

attributes.name: provider_facing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether performance data for measures in this category is shared with network providers for quality improvement and care gap closure initiatives.

attributes.name: care_gap_closure_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether measures in this category support care gap identification and closure activities for proactive member outreach and care coordination.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether measures in this category are subject to risk adjustment methodologies to account for member population health status differences.

attributes.name: stratification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether measures in this category must be stratified by demographic or clinical characteristics (e.g., age, race, ethnicity, disease severity) for reporting purposes.

attributes.name: stratification_dimensions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of demographic or clinical dimensions by which measures in this category should be stratified for health equity and disparity analysis.

attributes.name: audit_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether measures in this category are subject to external audit by National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), or state regulatory agencies for data validation.

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which measures in this category undergo external compliance audits for data accuracy and methodology validation.

attributes.name: data_source_systems
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of operational systems that provide source data for calculating measures in this category (e.g., claims system, Electronic Health Record (EHR), pharmacy system, survey platform).

attributes.name: calculation_engine
attributes.description: Software platform or application used to calculate measure results for this category (e.g., IBM Cognos, Tableau, custom analytics engine).

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which performance results for measures in this category are calculated and reported to internal and external stakeholders.

attributes.name: submission_deadline_month
attributes.description: Month of the year by which performance results for measures in this category must be submitted to external reporting organizations (1=January, 12=December).

attributes.name: submission_deadline_day
attributes.description: Day of the month by which performance results for measures in this category must be submitted to external reporting organizations.

attributes.name: steward_organization
attributes.description: Organization responsible for developing, maintaining, and updating the technical specifications for measures in this category (e.g., National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), National Quality Forum (NQF)).

attributes.name: nqf_endorsement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether measures in this category have received endorsement from the National Quality Forum (NQF) as meeting consensus standards for quality measurement.

attributes.name: nqf_number
attributes.description: Official National Quality Forum (NQF) identification number assigned to measures in this category if they have received National Quality Forum (NQF) endorsement.

attributes.name: cms_measure_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Measure Identifier
attributes.description: Official Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) measure identifier for measures in this category used in Medicare Advantage (MA), Prescription Drug Plan (PDP), or Accountable Care Organization (ACO) reporting programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.description: The total number of CAHPS patient satisfaction surveys completed for the provider during the measurement period.

attributes.name: quality_improvement_program_participation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is actively participating in quality improvement programs sponsored by the health plan or CMS.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Improvement Standards, NCQA QI Program Requirements

attributes.name: value_based_contract_participation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider participates in value-based care contracts or alternative payment models.
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Payment Models, Value-Based Care Standards

attributes.name: apm_participation_type
attributes.description: The type of alternative payment model in which the provider participates (ACO, PCMH, bundled payment, shared savings, capitation, or none).
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Payment Models, MACRA Quality Payment Program

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The network tier classification of the provider based on quality and cost performance (tier 1, tier 2, tier 3, preferred, standard, or out of network).

attributes.name: quality_tier
attributes.description: The quality tier classification of the provider based on composite quality scores (high, medium, low, or not rated).

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: The average risk adjustment factor for the provider's attributed member population, reflecting the complexity and health status of patients.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, HCC Risk Scoring

attributes.name: hcc_capture_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of expected HCC diagnoses that were documented and captured by the provider during the measurement period.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System, HCC Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: quality_bonus_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is eligible for quality-based bonus payments based on performance thresholds.

attributes.name: quality_bonus_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of quality-based bonus payments earned by the provider during the measurement period.

attributes.name: peer_comparison_percentile
attributes.description: The percentile ranking of the provider's quality score compared to peers in the same specialty and geographic area (0-100).

attributes.name: national_benchmark_comparison
attributes.description: Indicates how the provider's quality performance compares to national benchmarks (above, at, below, or not available).
attributes.references: NCQA National Benchmarks, CMS National Quality Benchmarks

attributes.name: data_completeness_score
attributes.description: The score reflecting the completeness and quality of clinical data submitted by the provider for quality measurement.
attributes.references: HEDIS Data Completeness Standards, CMS Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: last_quality_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent quality audit or validation performed for the provider's quality data.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Audit Standards, Internal Quality Audit Procedures

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: The result of the most recent quality audit (passed, failed, conditional, or not audited).

attributes.name: quality_improvement_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is required to submit a quality improvement plan due to performance below thresholds.
attributes.references: Internal Quality Management Standards, CMS Quality Improvement Requirements

attributes.name: quality_improvement_plan_status
attributes.description: The current status of the provider's quality improvement plan (not required, pending, submitted, approved, in progress, or completed).

attributes.name: sanctions_or_exclusions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has any active sanctions or exclusions from federal healthcare programs.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion List, SAM.gov Exclusions, State Medicaid Exclusions

attributes.name: public_reporting_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's quality scores are eligible for public reporting and transparency initiatives.
attributes.references: CMS Public Reporting Requirements, Transparency in Coverage Rule

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business for which the provider quality scores were calculated (commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, marketplace, or dual eligible).

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or service area where the provider practices and quality scores apply.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state code where the provider is located.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the provider quality scores become effective and applicable.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider quality scores expire and are superseded by updated scores.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider quality score record is currently active and applicable.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or platform from which the quality data was extracted (e.g., claims system, clinical registry, HEDIS reporting tool).

attributes.name: score_version
attributes.description: The version identifier for the quality scoring methodology used to calculate the provider scores.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments or notes regarding the provider quality score, including explanations for anomalies or special circumstances.

attributes.name: location_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.location_pharmacy. Business justification: Pharmacy provider quality scores (fill accuracy, customer service, turnaround time) are calculated per pharmacy location for network performance management and preferred pharmacy designation. Network

attributes.name: provider_participation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_participation. Business justification: Provider quality scores are calculated within the context of their contract participation. Network management uses this to evaluate provider performance against contracted quality standards for networ

attributes.name: hcc_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.hcc_category. Business justification: Provider quality scores are stratified by HCC categories to enable fair comparison of providers treating different acuity populations. Network quality teams use this for risk-adjusted provider perform

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Provider quality scores are tracked per credentialed provider. Quality management teams evaluate performance metrics tied to specific provider credentials for network adequacy and performance improvem

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.contract. Business justification: Provider quality scores are tied to network contracts for value-based payment arrangements. Provider relations uses scores to determine performance bonuses and contract renewals.

attributes.name: payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.payable. Business justification: Provider quality scores directly impact value-based payment calculations. Finance creates payables for provider incentive payments based on quality performance metrics, linking quality outcomes to fin

attributes.name: provider_program_participation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.provider_program_participation. Business justification: Provider quality scores are tracked per government program participation. Medicare and Medicaid have distinct quality requirements; providers are scored separately for each program they participate in

attributes.name: accreditation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.accreditation. Business justification: Provider scores reference accreditation status but store these as denormalized strings and dates. Should have FK to accreditation table to retrieve the provider's actual accreditation record, eliminat

attributes.name: report_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.report_submission. Business justification: Provider scores are submitted in quality reports to regulators and accreditation bodies. Should have FK to track which report contains this provider score.

products.name: accreditation
products.description: Master record of an entity's accreditation status (NCQA, URAC) including effective dates and accreditation level.

attributes.name: accreditation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accreditation record. Primary key for the accreditation entity.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare entity receiving accreditation (e.g., health plan, provider organization, hospital, medical group).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Programs

attributes.name: entity_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity receiving accreditation.

attributes.name: entity_identifier
attributes.description: Business identifier for the accredited entity (e.g., NPI, TIN, internal organization ID).
attributes.references: National Provider Identifier (NPI) Standard, IRS Tax Identification Number

attributes.name: accrediting_body
attributes.description: Name of the accrediting organization that granted the accreditation (e.g., NCQA, URAC, Joint Commission).
attributes.references: NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance), URAC (Utilization Review Accreditation Commission), Joint Commission

attributes.name: program
attributes.description: Specific accreditation program or product line under which the entity is accredited (e.g., Health Plan Accreditation, Disease Management, Case Management, Utilization Management).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Programs, URAC Accreditation Programs

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the accreditation (e.g., active, expired, suspended, revoked).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the accreditation became effective and valid.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the accreditation expires and requires renewal or re-evaluation.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date when the accreditation was officially awarded by the accrediting body.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: Date when the on-site or remote accreditation survey was conducted.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the accrediting body made the final accreditation decision.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the accreditation was renewed or is scheduled for renewal.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: cycle_years
attributes.description: Duration of the accreditation cycle in years (typically 3 years for NCQA, varies by program).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification or accreditation number issued by the accrediting body.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: scope_of_accreditation
attributes.description: Description of the scope, services, or product lines covered by the accreditation (e.g., commercial HMO, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: lines_of_business
attributes.description: Specific lines of business covered by the accreditation (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, CHIP, Exchange/Marketplace).
attributes.references: NCQA Health Plan Accreditation, CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic regions, states, or service areas covered by the accreditation.

attributes.name: member_count_at_survey
attributes.description: Number of members or enrollees covered by the entity at the time of the accreditation survey.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Overall numeric score or percentage achieved in the accreditation evaluation.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: standards_met_count
attributes.description: Count of accreditation standards or requirements that were fully met.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: standards_total_count
attributes.description: Total count of accreditation standards or requirements evaluated during the survey.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: deficiencies_count
attributes.description: Count of deficiencies or non-compliance findings identified during the accreditation survey.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required to address deficiencies or maintain accreditation.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which corrective actions must be completed and submitted to the accrediting body.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all required corrective actions were completed and verified.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Type of accreditation survey conducted (e.g., initial, renewal, follow-up, focused, unannounced).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: survey_methodology
attributes.description: Methodology used to conduct the accreditation survey (e.g., on-site visit, remote review, desk review, hybrid).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: lead_surveyor_name
attributes.description: Name of the lead surveyor or reviewer who conducted the accreditation survey.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: survey_team_size
attributes.description: Number of surveyors or reviewers on the accreditation survey team.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: public_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accreditation status and results are publicly disclosed or listed on the accrediting body's website.
attributes.references: NCQA Public Disclosure Policy, URAC Public Disclosure Policy

attributes.name: public_disclosure_date
attributes.description: Date when the accreditation status was publicly disclosed or published.
attributes.references: NCQA Public Disclosure Policy, URAC Public Disclosure Policy

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity filed an appeal of the accreditation decision.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: appeal_decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the accreditation appeal process (e.g., upheld, overturned, modified).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the appeal decision was rendered by the accrediting body.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for suspension of the accreditation (e.g., non-compliance, failure to submit corrective action, quality concerns).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for revocation of the accreditation (e.g., serious non-compliance, fraud, failure to meet standards).
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: voluntary_withdrawal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity voluntarily withdrew from the accreditation program.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date when the entity withdrew from the accreditation program.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: prior_accreditation_level
attributes.description: Accreditation level achieved in the previous accreditation cycle.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: prior_accreditation_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the prior accreditation.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: history_count
attributes.description: Number of times the entity has been accredited by this accrediting body.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: first_accreditation_date
attributes.description: Date when the entity first achieved accreditation with this accrediting body.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: hedis_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity is required to report HEDIS measures as part of the accreditation.

attributes.name: cahps_survey_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) Survey Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity is required to conduct CAHPS surveys as part of the accreditation.
attributes.references: NCQA CAHPS Standards, AHRQ CAHPS Program

attributes.name: quality_improvement_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quality improvement plan is required as part of the accreditation or corrective action.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: quality_improvement_plan_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the quality improvement plan must be submitted to the accrediting body.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee amount paid for the accreditation survey and evaluation.
attributes.references: NCQA Fee Schedule, URAC Fee Schedule

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: Currency in which the accreditation fee was paid.

attributes.name: contact_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the entity for accreditation matters.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: contact_person_title
attributes.description: Job title of the primary contact person for accreditation matters.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, URAC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: contact_person_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person for accreditation matters.

attributes.name: contact_person_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person for accreditation matters.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the official accreditation certificate or decision letter.

attributes.name: survey_report_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed accreditation survey report.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding the accreditation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the accreditation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the accreditation record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application from which the accreditation data originated.

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accreditation record in the source system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Data quality score or completeness percentage for the accreditation record.

attributes.name: record_active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accreditation record is currently active in the system.

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.audit. Business justification: Accreditation status (NCQA, URAC) results from formal audits conducted by accrediting bodies. Compliance teams track audit findings that determine accreditation levels.

attributes.name: star_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.star_rating. Business justification: Accreditation status may be linked to star ratings (both are quality indicators for health plans). Should have FK to associate accreditation with the star rating for the same entity/period.

products.name: improvement_plan

attributes.name: improvement_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality improvement plan. Primary key for the improvement plan entity.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Official name or title of the quality improvement plan initiative.

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the quality improvement plan objectives, scope, and expected outcomes.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category or type of quality improvement initiative being undertaken.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quality improvement plan.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority ranking assigned to the improvement plan based on business impact and urgency.

attributes.name: target_domain

attributes.name: stars_measure_id

attributes.description: Specific CMS Stars measure identifier targeted by the improvement plan.

attributes.name: responsible_executive_name

attributes.name: responsible_executive_title

attributes.name: project_manager_name

attributes.name: project_manager_email

attributes.name: line_of_business

attributes.name: target_population

attributes.name: target_population_size

attributes.name: intervention_strategy
attributes.description: Description of the intervention methods and strategies being implemented to achieve improvement goals.

attributes.name: intervention_type

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO currency code for budget and spend amounts.

attributes.name: roi_target_percentage
attributes.description: Expected return on investment for the quality improvement plan, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the improvement plan is driven by a regulatory or compliance requirement.

attributes.name: regulatory_deadline_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the improvement plan must be completed or compliance achieved.

attributes.name: barrier_description

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: Description of strategies to mitigate identified barriers and risks.

attributes.name: success_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed criteria that define successful completion or achievement of the improvement plan.

attributes.name: evaluation_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to evaluate effectiveness and outcomes of the improvement plan.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Description of data sources used to measure performance and track improvement plan progress.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which improvement plan progress and performance are reported.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of improvement plan progress.

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or committee that approved the improvement plan.

attributes.name: approved_by_title

attributes.name: completion_percentage

attributes.name: risk_level

attributes.name: stakeholder_engagement_level

attributes.name: communication_plan

attributes.name: lessons_learned

attributes.name: best_practices_identified

attributes.name: sustainability_plan

attributes.name: related_initiative_reference

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: revision_date

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the most recent revision to the improvement plan.

attributes.name: document_location

attributes.name: active_flag

attributes.name: archived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the improvement plan has been archived.

attributes.name: archive_date
attributes.description: Date when the improvement plan was archived.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the improvement plan was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason why the improvement plan was cancelled.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the improvement plan.

attributes.name: measure_id

attributes.name: provider_participation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_participation. Business justification: Quality improvement plans are created for providers under specific contracts when performance falls below contracted thresholds. Provider relations teams manage improvement plans tied to contract comp

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Quality improvement plans are created for underperforming credentialed providers. Network management uses these to track corrective actions, with potential impact on recredentialing decisions and netw

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.program. Business justification: Quality improvement plans are created within specific programs (Diabetes Management, Care Coordination). Program managers track improvement initiatives tied to their programs.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Quality improvement initiatives require approved budgets for implementation. Finance tracks allocated funds for each improvement plan, enabling cost control and financial reporting of quality programs

attributes.name: report_submission_id

attributes.name: star_rating_id

attributes.name: hedis_score_id

attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Stars Weight
attributes.description: The weighting factor applied to this metric in the overall CMS Star Ratings calculation (1x, 3x, or 5x).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings

attributes.name: nqf_measure_number
attributes.description: The National Quality Forum endorsed measure number if this metric has NQF endorsement.

attributes.name: clinical_domain
attributes.description: The clinical specialty or disease area that the metric addresses.

attributes.name: target_population
attributes.description: Description of the member population to which this metric applies (e.g., adults with diabetes, children ages 3-18, Medicare beneficiaries).

attributes.name: age_range_min
attributes.description: The minimum age in years for members included in the metric's target population.

attributes.name: age_range_max
attributes.description: The maximum age in years for members included in the metric's target population.

attributes.name: applicable_lob
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lines of business to which this metric applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Exchange).

attributes.name: applicable_product_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product types for which this metric is measured (e.g., HMO, PPO, POS, EPO, HDHP).

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to risk-adjust the metric for differences in member health status and demographics, if applicable.

attributes.name: is_risk_adjusted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the metric calculation includes risk adjustment for member acuity and case mix.

attributes.name: benchmark_source
attributes.description: The source of benchmark or comparison data used to evaluate performance on this metric.

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile_50
attributes.description: The 50th percentile (median) benchmark value for this metric from the benchmark source.

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile_75
attributes.description: The 75th percentile benchmark value for this metric from the benchmark source.

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile_90
attributes.description: The 90th percentile benchmark value for this metric from the benchmark source.

attributes.name: minimum_denominator_size
attributes.description: The minimum number of eligible members or events required in the denominator for the metric to be reportable.

attributes.name: stars_cut_point_2_star
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Stars 2-Star Cut Point
attributes.description: The performance threshold for achieving a 2-star rating on this CMS Stars measure.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings

attributes.name: stars_cut_point_3_star
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Stars 3-Star Cut Point
attributes.description: The performance threshold for achieving a 3-star rating on this CMS Stars measure.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings

attributes.name: stars_cut_point_4_star
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Stars 4-Star Cut Point
attributes.description: The performance threshold for achieving a 4-star rating on this CMS Stars measure.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings

attributes.name: stars_cut_point_5_star
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Stars 5-Star Cut Point
attributes.description: The performance threshold for achieving a 5-star rating on this CMS Stars measure.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: How often the metric is calculated and reported to stakeholders and regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether reporting of this metric is mandatory, voluntary, or required for specific contracts or accreditation.

attributes.name: accreditation_program
attributes.description: The accreditation program(s) for which this metric is required (e.g., NCQA Health Plan Accreditation, URAC).

attributes.name: steward_organization
attributes.description: The organization responsible for maintaining and updating the metric definition and specifications (e.g., NCQA, CMS, NQF).

attributes.name: measure_version
attributes.description: The version number or year of the metric specification currently in use.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the clinical quality metric definition.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the metric was retired or deprecated, if applicable.

attributes.name: value_set_oid
attributes.description: The Object Identifier for the value set(s) used in the metric definition for identifying relevant diagnoses, procedures, or medications.
attributes.references: National Library of Medicine Value Set Authority Center

attributes.name: icd10_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ICD-10 diagnosis codes used in the metric's numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria.

attributes.name: cpt_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CPT procedure codes used in the metric's numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria.

attributes.name: hcpcs_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of HCPCS codes used in the metric's numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria.

attributes.name: loinc_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC)
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of LOINC codes for laboratory tests or clinical observations used in the metric calculation.

attributes.name: ndc_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of NDC codes for medications used in the metric's numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria.

attributes.name: snomed_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine (SNOMED) Clinical Terms Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SNOMED CT codes used in the metric definition for clinical concepts.

attributes.name: lookback_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days prior to the measurement period end date to look back for relevant clinical events or services.

attributes.name: continuous_enrollment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must be continuously enrolled for a specified period to be included in the metric calculation.

attributes.name: continuous_enrollment_months
attributes.description: The number of months of continuous enrollment required for members to be included in the metric denominator.

attributes.name: allowable_gap_days
attributes.description: The maximum number of days a member can have a gap in enrollment and still be considered continuously enrolled for the metric.

attributes.name: pharmacy_benefit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must have pharmacy benefit coverage to be included in the metric calculation.

attributes.name: medical_benefit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must have medical benefit coverage to be included in the metric calculation.

attributes.name: stratification_variables
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of variables by which the metric should be stratified for reporting (e.g., age group, gender, race, ethnicity, geography).

attributes.name: is_composite_measure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric is a composite measure that combines multiple component measures.

attributes.name: component_measures
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of component measure codes that comprise this composite measure, if applicable.

attributes.name: clinical_rationale
attributes.description: The clinical evidence and rationale supporting why this metric is important for quality measurement and improvement.

attributes.name: improvement_notation
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of improvement for the metric (increase in rate is better, decrease in rate is better, or maintain current rate).

attributes.name: data_collection_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date from which data should be collected for calculating this metric.

attributes.name: data_collection_end_date
attributes.description: The latest date through which data should be collected for calculating this metric.

attributes.name: submission_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which metric results must be submitted to the regulatory body or accreditation organization.

attributes.name: audit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric is subject to external audit or validation by NCQA, CMS, or other oversight bodies.

attributes.name: medical_record_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical record review is required as part of the data collection methodology for this metric.

attributes.name: supplemental_data_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether supplemental data beyond administrative claims is required to calculate this metric.

attributes.name: telehealth_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether telehealth encounters can be counted toward numerator compliance for this metric.

attributes.name: quality_improvement_priority
attributes.description: The organizational priority level assigned to this metric for quality improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: incentive_program_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric is included in provider or member incentive programs for quality performance.

attributes.name: public_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether results for this metric must be publicly reported on websites or quality comparison tools.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to the metric definition or calculation.

products.name: clinical_metric_result
products.description: Calculated result of a clinical quality metric for a provider, facility, or member cohort per reporting period.

attributes.name: clinical_metric_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical quality metric result record.

attributes.name: measure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the measure based on what aspect of care quality it evaluates.
attributes.references: NCQA Measure Type Classifications, CMS Quality Measure Framework

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the time period during which the clinical metric was measured and data was collected.

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the time period during which the clinical metric was measured and data was collected.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: Standardized label for the reporting period (e.g., 2023 Measurement Year, Q4 2023, Calendar Year 2023).
attributes.references: HEDIS Reporting Requirements, CMS Stars Ratings Schedule

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Type of entity for which the clinical metric result was calculated (provider, facility, member population cohort, etc.).

attributes.name: entity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific entity (provider NPI, facility ID, cohort ID) for which this metric result applies.
attributes.references: NPI Registry, Internal Entity Master Data

attributes.name: entity_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the entity being measured (provider name, facility name, cohort description).

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier for the healthcare provider associated with this metric result, if applicable.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule, CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Nine-digit Tax Identification Number for the provider organization or practice group associated with this metric result.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare facility if the metric result is facility-specific.
attributes.references: CMS Provider of Services File, State Licensing Classifications

attributes.name: specialty
attributes.description: Medical specialty of the provider for whom this metric result was calculated (e.g., Cardiology, Family Medicine, Endocrinology).
attributes.references: CMS Specialty Codes, NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Health insurance product line or line of business for which this metric result applies.
attributes.references: CMS Contract Types, Internal Product Line Definitions

attributes.name: member_cohort_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the member population cohort for which this metric was calculated (e.g., Diabetic Members Age 18-75, Commercial HMO Members).

attributes.name: numerator_count
attributes.description: Number of members or events that met the quality metric criteria (e.g., members who received the recommended screening or treatment).
attributes.references: HEDIS Technical Specifications, CMS Measure Calculation Guidelines

attributes.name: denominator_count
attributes.description: Total number of eligible members or events in the population for this quality metric (eligible population).
attributes.references: HEDIS Technical Specifications, CMS Measure Calculation Guidelines

attributes.name: exclusion_count
attributes.description: Number of members or events excluded from the denominator based on valid clinical or administrative exclusion criteria.
attributes.references: HEDIS Technical Specifications, CMS Measure Exclusion Criteria

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: Calculated performance rate for the quality metric, expressed as a percentage (numerator divided by denominator minus exclusions, multiplied by 100).
attributes.references: HEDIS Rate Calculation Methodology, CMS Stars Ratings Technical Notes

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Unit or format in which the metric result rate is expressed.

attributes.name: benchmark_source
attributes.description: Source of the benchmark or comparison standard used to evaluate this metric result.
attributes.references: NCQA Quality Compass, CMS Stars Cut Points

attributes.name: benchmark_value
attributes.description: Benchmark or target value for this quality metric against which performance is compared.
attributes.references: NCQA Quality Compass, CMS Stars Cut Points

attributes.name: benchmark_percentile
attributes.description: Percentile ranking of the benchmark value within the comparison population (e.g., 50th percentile, 90th percentile).

attributes.name: performance_level
attributes.description: Categorical assessment of performance relative to the benchmark (below, meets, exceeds).

attributes.name: stars_rating
attributes.description: CMS Stars rating (1.0 to 5.0 scale) assigned to this metric result for Medicare Advantage or Part D plans.

attributes.name: stars_cut_point_tier
attributes.description: Star rating tier into which this metric result falls based on CMS cut point thresholds.

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Method used to collect the data for calculating this quality metric (administrative claims, hybrid with medical record review, EHR data, survey).

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of records or members included in the sample for hybrid or survey-based measures.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for the calculated metric rate, indicating statistical precision.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for the calculated metric rate, indicating statistical precision.

attributes.name: statistical_significance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the difference between the metric result and benchmark is statistically significant (true/false).

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_method
attributes.description: Method used to risk-adjust the metric result to account for differences in member health status and demographics.
attributes.references: CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model, HEDIS Risk Adjustment Specifications

attributes.name: risk_adjusted_rate
attributes.description: Quality metric rate after applying risk adjustment methodology to account for population health differences.

attributes.name: observed_to_expected_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of observed metric result to expected result based on risk adjustment model; values above 1.0 indicate higher than expected performance.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market area for which this metric result applies (e.g., state, county, metropolitan area, service area).
attributes.references: CMS Service Area Definitions, State Geographic Classifications

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the measured entity or member cohort is located.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations, ANSI State Codes

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code identifying the county for geographic analysis.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Network tier classification of the provider or facility for which this metric result was calculated.

attributes.name: incentive_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric result qualifies for quality-based incentive payments or value-based care arrangements.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of quality incentive payment associated with achieving this metric result, if applicable.

attributes.name: penalty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric result triggers a quality-based penalty or withhold under value-based care arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Penalty Programs, Internal VBC Policies

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of quality penalty or payment reduction associated with this metric result, if applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Penalty Programs, Internal VBC Policies

attributes.name: improvement_target
attributes.description: Target performance rate established for quality improvement initiatives for this metric.

attributes.name: prior_period_rate
attributes.description: Quality metric rate from the previous measurement period for trend analysis and improvement tracking.

attributes.name: rate_change
attributes.description: Percentage point change in the quality metric rate compared to the prior measurement period (positive indicates improvement for most metrics).

attributes.name: trend_direction
attributes.description: Directional trend of quality metric performance over time (improving, declining, stable).

attributes.name: outlier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric result is a statistical outlier (significantly above or below expected range) requiring investigation.

attributes.name: outlier_type
attributes.description: Classification of outlier status as high performer (positive outlier) or low performer (negative outlier).

attributes.name: data_completeness_score
attributes.description: Percentage score indicating the completeness of data available for calculating this metric (100% = all required data elements present).

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the underlying data for this metric result passed data quality validation checks.

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric result is suppressed from public reporting due to small sample size or privacy concerns.
attributes.references: NCQA Suppression Rules, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: Reason why this metric result is suppressed from reporting, if applicable.
attributes.references: NCQA Suppression Rules, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external auditing organization that certified this metric result (e.g., NCQA-certified auditor).

attributes.name: audit_findings
attributes.description: Summary of audit findings or recommendations related to this metric result, if audited.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required based on audit findings or quality performance thresholds.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action plan implemented to address quality performance gaps or audit findings.

attributes.name: calculation_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the calculation logic or specification used to compute this metric result (e.g., HEDIS 2023, CMS Stars 2024).
attributes.references: HEDIS Technical Specifications Version, CMS Stars Methodology Version

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about this metric result, calculation methodology, or data issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this clinical metric result record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this clinical metric result record was last updated or modified.

Business justification: Clinical metrics like medication adherence rates, statin therapy compliance, and diabetes medication management directly reference pharmacy claims as source data. attributes.name: provider_participation_id

Quality analytics teams use this to monitor contracted providers' clinical outcomes and trigger contract performan

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment. Business justification: Clinical metrics (preventive screenings, chronic disease management) are tracked per enrollment to measure care quality during active coverage. Used for quality improvement programs and member outreac

attributes.name: member_risk_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.member_risk_profile. Business justification: Clinical quality metrics (HbA1c, blood pressure) are measured and tracked against member risk profiles to assess care effectiveness for high-risk populations. Quality teams use this daily for risk-str

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Clinical quality metrics (diabetes control, preventive screenings) are measured per credentialed provider for HEDIS reporting, value-based contracts, and provider performance scorecards used in networ
