products.name: star_rating
products.description: Star rating assigned by CMS to a health plan based on composite quality and performance measures.

attributes.name: star_rating_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the star rating record assigned by CMS to a health plan.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings

attributes.name: rating_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the star rating is assigned and published by CMS.

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: Calendar year during which the performance data was collected for the star rating calculation.

attributes.name: overall_star_rating
attributes.description: Composite star rating score ranging from 1.0 to 5.0 stars, representing overall plan quality and performance.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Business line category for the rated plan, indicating the primary market segment served.

attributes.name: enrollment_count
attributes.description: Total number of members enrolled in the plan during the measurement period used for star rating calculation.

attributes.name: part_c_summary_rating
attributes.description: Summary star rating for Medicare Part C (health plan) measures, ranging from 1.0 to 5.0 stars.

attributes.name: part_d_summary_rating
attributes.description: Summary star rating for Medicare Part D (prescription drug) measures, ranging from 1.0 to 5.0 stars.

attributes.name: quality_bonus_payment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan qualifies for CMS quality bonus payments based on achieving 4.0 stars or higher.

attributes.name: reward_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to benchmark payments for plans achieving high star ratings, typically ranging from 1.00 to 1.05.

attributes.name: hos_outcome_score
attributes.description: Score from the Medicare Health Outcomes Survey measuring physical and mental health outcomes over time.

attributes.name: improvement_measure_count
attributes.description: Number of measures where the plan demonstrated statistically significant improvement from the prior year.

attributes.name: reward_measure_count
attributes.description: Number of measures eligible for reward points in the star rating calculation.

attributes.name: cut_point_methodology
attributes.description: Statistical method used by CMS to determine star rating thresholds for each measure.

attributes.name: categorical_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan received a categorical adjustment for serving high-risk populations with low-income or disability status.

attributes.name: cai_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Numeric adjustment applied to the overall star rating due to categorical adjustment eligibility.

attributes.name: low_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan has enrollment below CMS minimum thresholds for public star rating display.

attributes.name: new_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is newly established and not yet eligible for full star rating due to insufficient performance history.

attributes.name: rating_status
attributes.description: Current status of the star rating indicating whether it is final, provisional, under appeal, or not rated.

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date when CMS officially published the star rating to the public, typically in October each year.

attributes.name: preview_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the 30-day preview period when plans can review draft ratings before public release.

attributes.name: preview_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the 30-day preview period when plans can review draft ratings before public release.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan filed a formal appeal of the star rating with CMS.

attributes.name: appeal_decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the star rating appeal process if an appeal was filed.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: Date when CMS issued the final decision on the star rating appeal.

attributes.name: parent_organization
attributes.description: Name of the parent organization or holding company that owns the health plan contract.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the plan primarily operates or is headquartered.

attributes.name: service_area_type
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the plan's service area coverage.

attributes.name: snp_type
attributes.description: Type of Special Needs Plan if applicable: Dual Eligible (D-SNP), Chronic Condition (C-SNP), or Institutional (I-SNP).

attributes.name: chronic_condition_focus
attributes.description: Specific chronic condition(s) targeted by a C-SNP plan, such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease, or ESRD.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of plan enrollment that qualifies for both Medicare and Medicaid benefits.

attributes.name: lis_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of plan enrollment receiving Low Income Subsidy assistance for prescription drug costs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Low Income Subsidy Program

attributes.name: disability_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of plan enrollment under age 65 qualifying for Medicare due to disability status.

attributes.name: esrd_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of plan enrollment with End Stage Renal Disease diagnosis.

attributes.name: display_measure_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual measures included in the star rating calculation for this plan.

attributes.name: weighted_mean_score
attributes.description: Weighted average of all measure scores before rounding to the final star rating.

attributes.name: rounding_rule_applied
attributes.description: Type of rounding rule applied to convert the weighted mean score to the final star rating.

attributes.name: change_from_prior_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Star Rating Change from Prior Year
attributes.description: Numeric change in overall star rating compared to the previous rating year (positive or negative).

attributes.name: five_star_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan achieved the highest possible 5.0 star rating.
attributes.references: CMS Five Star Special Enrollment Period

attributes.name: four_star_or_higher_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan achieved 4.0 stars or higher, qualifying for quality bonus payments.

attributes.name: three_five_star_or_lower_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Three Point Five Star or Lower Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan received 3.5 stars or lower, potentially triggering enhanced oversight.

attributes.name: data_completeness_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of required measures with sufficient data for star rating calculation.

attributes.name: missing_measure_count
attributes.description: Number of measures excluded from the star rating due to insufficient data or sample size.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Status of CMS audit or validation of the data underlying the star rating measures.

attributes.name: audit_findings_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether CMS audit identified data quality issues or non-compliance requiring corrective action.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan must submit a corrective action plan to CMS due to low performance or audit findings.

attributes.name: extreme_uncontrollable_circumstance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan was granted relief from star rating penalties due to natural disasters or other extreme circumstances.

attributes.name: disaster_relief_type
attributes.description: Type of disaster or extreme circumstance for which CMS granted star rating relief (e.g., hurricane, pandemic).

attributes.name: ncqa_accreditation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Accreditation Status
attributes.description: Current NCQA accreditation status of the health plan, which may influence star rating eligibility.

attributes.name: urac_accreditation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Utilization Review Accreditation Commission (URAC) Accreditation Status
attributes.description: Current URAC accreditation status of the health plan for utilization management or other programs.

attributes.name: quality_improvement_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan has an active CMS-approved quality improvement program targeting star rating measures.

attributes.name: performance_improvement_project_count
attributes.description: Number of active Performance Improvement Projects the plan is conducting to enhance quality measures.

attributes.name: national_percentile_rank
attributes.description: Percentile ranking of the plan's overall star rating compared to all rated plans nationally.

attributes.name: regional_percentile_rank
attributes.description: Percentile ranking of the plan's overall star rating compared to plans in the same geographic region.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the star rating becomes effective for quality bonus payment calculations and member communications.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings Effective Date Policy

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the star rating is superseded by the next annual rating cycle.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Primary system or platform from which star rating data was extracted (e.g., CMS HPMS, internal analytics platform).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the star rating record was last modified or refreshed in the data product.

attributes.name: benefit_package_id

attributes.name: cohort_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.cohort. Business justification: Medicare Star ratings are calculated for member cohorts by plan type. Quality teams track Star performance by cohort to identify improvement opportunities and maintain CMS compliance.

attributes.name: plan_option_id

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Medicare Advantage Star Ratings include provider-level performance measures. Quality teams track star ratings per credentialed provider to identify high/low performers and support CMS compliance repor

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id

products.name: measure_risk_stratification
products.description: This association product represents the risk stratification configuration between quality measures and HCC categories. It captures the risk adjustment methodology used to ensure fair performance comparison across member populations with different health risk profiles. Each record links one quality measure to one HCC category with stratification rules and adjustment factors that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance quality measurement, quality measures (HEDIS, Star Ratings) must be risk-stratified across multiple HCC categories to ensure fair performance comparison between member populations with different health risk profiles. A single quality measure like 'Controlling High Blood Pressure' applies to multiple HCC categories (diabetes, cardiovascular, renal), and each HCC category is relevant to multiple quality measures. The business actively manages these stratification configurations with specific adjustment factors, weights, and stratification levels for each measure-HCC pairing.

products.name: member_improvement_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment of high-risk members into quality improvement initiatives. It captures the operational relationship between improvement plans and member risk profiles, tracking enrollment status, priority, assigned care managers, and target completion dates for each member-plan combination. Each record links one improvement_plan to one member_risk_profile with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, quality improvement plans (such as care gap closure initiatives, chronic disease management programs, and HEDIS measure improvement campaigns) enroll multiple high-risk members simultaneously based on risk stratification and quality measure targeting. Conversely, high-risk members are frequently enrolled in multiple concurrent improvement initiatives addressing different quality domains (e.g., a diabetic member may be enrolled in both a diabetes management plan and a preventive care gap closure plan). Care management teams actively manage these enrollments as operational entities, tracking enrollment dates, completion status, assigned care managers, and target completion dates for each member-plan combination.

It captures the specific corrective actions, compliance requirements, and monitoring activities mandated for each sanctioned provider. Each record links one provider sanction to one improvement plan with attributes that track remediation progress, compliance deadlines, and completion status.. Each record links one quality measure to one credentialed provider with period-specific performance metrics that exist only in the context of this relationship.. products.name: measure_program_target
products.description: This association product represents the operational tracking relationship between quality measures and care/quality programs. It captures program-specific performance targets, measurement periods, and reporting requirements for each measure-program combination. Each record links one quality measure to one program with attributes that define how that measure is tracked, reported, and targeted within the specific program context.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, quality measures are tracked across multiple programs (Disease Management, Care Coordination, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid), and each program tracks multiple measures with program-specific targets, priorities, and reporting requirements. For example, the 'Controlling High Blood Pressure' measure (CBP) may be tracked in a Hypertension Management program with an 85% target and monthly reporting, while also being tracked in a general Medicare Advantage program with a 75% target and quarterly reporting. The business actively manages these measure-program combinations to optimize HEDIS scores, CMS Star Ratings, and quality outcomes.

products.name: plan_cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the budget allocation relationship between quality improvement plans and cost centers. It captures how improvement plan budgets are distributed across multiple organizational cost centers, with each allocation tracking the specific amount, percentage, and status of funding from each cost center to each plan. Each record links one improvement plan to one cost center with allocation-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this funding relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, quality improvement plans routinely require budget contributions from multiple cost centers across different departments (clinical operations, IT, care management, analytics). Each cost center tracks its specific allocation amount, percentage, and spending against each plan it funds. Conversely, each cost center typically funds multiple improvement plans simultaneously, creating a genuine many-to-many operational relationship where the allocation itself (with amount, dates, status) is actively managed by finance and quality teams.

products.name: measure_policy_mandate
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory mandate relationship between quality measures and compliance policies. It captures the specific requirements, thresholds, and enforcement rules that apply when a compliance policy mandates the tracking and reporting of a quality measure. Each record links one measure to one compliance_policy with attributes that define how that measure must be performed to satisfy that specific policy requirement.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, a single quality measure (e.g., Controlling High Blood Pressure) is mandated by multiple compliance policies simultaneously - CMS Star Ratings, state-specific HEDIS requirements, and NCQA accreditation standards each require the same measure with different thresholds, reporting frequencies, and penalties. Conversely, a single compliance policy (e.g., CMS Medicare Advantage regulations) mandates dozens of different quality measures. Compliance teams actively manage these mandate relationships, tracking which measures satisfy which regulatory requirements with specific performance thresholds and enforcement rules.

products.name: provider_score_audit_citation
products.description: This association product represents the citation or reference of provider quality scores as evidence within audit findings. It captures the specific provider performance metrics documented by auditors during compliance, network adequacy, or quality of care audits. Each record links one provider score to one audit finding with attributes that exist only in the context of this audit citation relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer audit operations, auditors actively cite provider quality scores as evidence across multiple audit findings (network adequacy, quality of care, credentialing, Stars rating compliance). products.name: provider_audit
products.description: Master record of provider audits performed to detect overbilling, duplicate billing, or prohibited services.

attributes.name: provider_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider audit record. Primary key for the provider audit entity.

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique audit reference number assigned to the provider audit for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the provider being audited, as assigned by CMS.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry, HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The Tax Identification Number of the provider or provider organization being audited.

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: The classification of the provider being audited (e.g., individual physician, group practice, facility, ancillary service provider).

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: The specialty or taxonomy code of the provider being audited, indicating their area of practice.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: The type or category of audit being performed (e.g., prepayment review, postpayment audit, focused audit, comprehensive audit).
attributes.references: CMS Program Integrity Manual, Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: The scope or focus area of the audit (e.g., claims review, billing patterns, medical records, coding accuracy, documentation compliance).

attributes.name: audit_reason
attributes.description: The primary reason or trigger for initiating the provider audit (e.g., overbilling detection, duplicate billing, fraud suspicion, outlier analysis, complaint).

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: The current status of the provider audit in its lifecycle (e.g., scheduled, in progress, pending provider response, completed, closed).

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: The date when the provider audit was formally initiated or opened.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: The planned or scheduled date for the audit fieldwork or review to begin.

attributes.name: actual_start_date

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: The planned or target date for completing the audit review and issuing findings.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the audit review was completed and findings were finalized.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date when the audit case was formally closed, including all follow-up actions and recovery activities.

attributes.name: audit_period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the time period under audit review (i.e., the earliest date of claims or activities being examined).

attributes.name: audit_period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the time period under audit review (i.e., the latest date of claims or activities being examined).

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: The number of claims, encounters, or records selected for detailed review in the audit sample.
attributes.references: Statistical Sampling Standards, CMS Program Integrity Manual

attributes.name: sample_method
attributes.description: The statistical or judgmental method used to select the audit sample (e.g., random sampling, stratified sampling, targeted selection).

attributes.name: total_claims_reviewed
attributes.description: The total number of claims reviewed during the audit, including both sampled and additional claims examined.

attributes.name: claims_with_errors
attributes.description: The number of claims reviewed that were found to contain errors, discrepancies, or compliance issues.

attributes.name: error_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The calculated percentage of claims with errors relative to the total claims reviewed, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount billed by the provider for the claims included in the audit review period.

attributes.name: total_paid_amount

attributes.name: overpayment_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of overpayments identified during the audit that must be recovered from the provider.

attributes.name: underpayment_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of underpayments identified during the audit that are owed to the provider.

attributes.name: projected_overpayment_amount
attributes.description: The statistically projected overpayment amount extrapolated from the audit sample to the entire population of claims, when statistical sampling is used.
attributes.references: Statistical Sampling Standards, CMS RAC Auditing Guidelines

attributes.name: recovered_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of overpayments that have been successfully recovered from the provider through recoupment, refund, or offset.

attributes.name: outstanding_recovery_amount

attributes.name: law_enforcement_agency
attributes.description: The name of the law enforcement agency to which the audit case was referred (e.g., FBI, OIG, State Attorney General).

attributes.name: audit_methodology

attributes.name: documentation_requested

attributes.name: icd_codes_reviewed

attributes.description: A list or summary of the ICD diagnosis codes that were reviewed during the audit, if applicable.

attributes.name: drg_codes_reviewed

products.name: overpayment_recovery
products.description: Master record of overpayment recovery actions, including amount, recovery method, and status.

attributes.name: overpayment_recovery_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the overpayment recovery record. Primary key for tracking recovery actions across the fraud detection and payment integrity lifecycle.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the healthcare claim associated with the overpayment. Links recovery action to the original claim transaction.

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fraud, waste, and abuse investigation case that identified the overpayment.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Internal unique identifier for the healthcare provider from whom the overpayment is being recovered.

attributes.description: Ten-digit unique identification number issued by CMS to healthcare providers. Standard identifier for provider involved in overpayment.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number of the provider or organization from whom overpayment is being recovered.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with the claim that resulted in overpayment.

attributes.name: overpayment_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of the overpayment identified for recovery. Represents the excess payment made beyond the correct adjudicated amount.

attributes.name: recovered_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount successfully recovered to date from the overpayment. May be partial or full recovery depending on recovery status.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: Remaining dollar amount yet to be recovered. Calculated as overpayment amount minus recovered amount.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Additional interest charges applied to the overpayment recovery per contractual or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Financial penalty assessed in addition to overpayment recovery, typically for fraudulent or abusive billing practices.

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: Method used to recover the overpayment from the provider or responsible party.

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current status of the overpayment recovery action in the lifecycle from identification through resolution.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method or process by which the overpayment was initially identified.

attributes.name: detection_date
attributes.description: Date when the overpayment was first identified through audit, analytics, or investigation.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider or responsible party was formally notified of the overpayment and recovery demand.

attributes.name: demand_letter_date
attributes.description: Date when formal demand letter was sent to provider requesting repayment of overpayment.

attributes.name: first_recovery_date
attributes.description: Date when the first payment or recovery action was received toward the overpayment balance.

attributes.name: last_recovery_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment or recovery action received toward the overpayment balance.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the overpayment recovery case was closed, either through full recovery, write-off, or other resolution.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider filed a formal appeal or dispute of the overpayment determination.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: Date when a final decision was rendered on the provider's appeal of the overpayment.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any appeal filed by the provider disputing the overpayment determination.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the provider's appeal of the overpayment determination.

attributes.name: original_claim_paid_date
attributes.description: Date when the original claim that resulted in overpayment was paid by the health plan.

attributes.name: original_paid_amount
attributes.description: Original dollar amount paid on the claim before overpayment was identified and recovery initiated.

attributes.name: correct_paid_amount
attributes.description: Correct dollar amount that should have been paid on the claim based on proper adjudication rules.

attributes.name: service_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the service period for the claim associated with the overpayment.

attributes.name: service_to_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period for the claim associated with the overpayment.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health insurance product line or business segment associated with the claim and overpayment.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the location where services were rendered on the overpaid claim.

attributes.name: provider_specialty

attributes.name: recovery_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the recovery action based on amount, fraud risk, or other business factors.

attributes.name: assigned_to

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date when the recovery case was assigned to a recovery specialist or team for action.

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag

attributes.name: payment_plan_terms
attributes.description: Description of the payment plan terms agreed upon with the provider for overpayment recovery.

attributes.name: installment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of each installment payment if a payment plan has been established for recovery.

attributes.name: installment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of installment payments if a payment plan has been established for recovery.

attributes.name: legal_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether legal action has been initiated or is planned to recover the overpayment.

attributes.name: legal_action_date

attributes.name: collections_agency_flag

attributes.name: collections_referral_date

attributes.name: law_enforcement_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the overpayment case has been referred to law enforcement for potential criminal fraud investigation.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_referral_date
attributes.description: Date when the overpayment case was referred to law enforcement authorities for investigation.

attributes.name: write_off_flag

attributes.name: write_off_date

attributes.name: write_off_reason

attributes.name: detection_method

attributes.name: detection_date

attributes.name: review_start_date

attributes.name: review_end_date

attributes.name: review_duration_days

attributes.name: reviewer_id

attributes.name: reviewer_name

attributes.name: reviewer_role

attributes.name: assigned_team

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: provider_npi

attributes.name: provider_tin
attributes.description: Nine-digit Tax Identification Number of the provider organization associated with the claim under review.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Legal or business name of the healthcare provider associated with the claim under review.

attributes.name: provider_specialty

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique internal identifier of the health plan member associated with the claim under review.

attributes.name: member_number

attributes.name: claim_service_date
attributes.description: Date of service for the claim being reviewed, representing when the healthcare service was provided.

attributes.name: claim_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the claim was originally received by the health plan for processing.

attributes.name: claim_paid_date
attributes.description: Date when the claim was paid by the health plan, if payment was issued prior to the fraud review.

attributes.name: claim_amount_billed

attributes.name: claim_amount_allowed

attributes.name: claim_amount_paid

attributes.name: overpayment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of overpayment identified during the claim review that is subject to recovery.

attributes.name: recovery_amount

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current status of the overpayment recovery process following the claim review.

attributes.name: recovery_date

attributes.name: procedure_code

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.description: Primary International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) diagnosis code on the claim under review.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare claim being reviewed, indicating the service category.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health plan line of business for the member associated with the claim under review.

attributes.name: review_findings
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the findings from the claim review investigation, including evidence and rationale.

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments recorded by the reviewer during the investigation process.

attributes.name: evidence_collected
attributes.description: Description of evidence collected during the investigation, such as medical records, billing documentation, or witness statements.

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: Source from which the claim review case was referred or originated.

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: Date when the claim was referred for fraud, waste, or abuse review.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_referral_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the case was referred to law enforcement agencies for criminal investigation.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_referral_date
attributes.description: Date when the case was referred to law enforcement agencies.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_agency
attributes.description: Name of the law enforcement agency to which the case was referred, such as FBI, OIG, or state attorney general.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the case was reported to regulatory agencies such as CMS or state insurance departments.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud, Waste, and Abuse Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_date
attributes.description: Date when the case was reported to regulatory agencies.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud, Waste, and Abuse Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: escalation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the case was escalated to senior management or specialized investigation teams.

attributes.name: escalation_date

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Reason or justification for escalating the case to senior management or specialized teams.

attributes.name: provider_sanction_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether sanctions or corrective actions were imposed on the provider as a result of the review findings.

attributes.name: provider_sanction_type
attributes.description: Type of sanction or corrective action imposed on the provider following the fraud review.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment and Sanctions Guidelines

attributes.name: appeal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the provider or member filed an appeal against the review findings or sanctions.

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: Date when the appeal was filed by the provider or member.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the appeal process regarding the claim review findings.

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the appeal was resolved and a final decision was rendered.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Total financial impact to the health plan resulting from the fraud review, including overpayments, penalties, and recovery costs.

attributes.name: cost_avoidance_amount
attributes.description: Amount of future costs avoided by identifying and preventing fraudulent or abusive billing patterns.

attributes.name: investigation_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours spent by investigators and analysts on the claim review case.

attributes.name: case_complexity
attributes.description: Complexity level of the fraud investigation case based on factors such as evidence volume, number of parties involved, and legal considerations.

attributes.name: related_case_count
attributes.description: Number of related or linked fraud investigation cases involving the same provider, member, or billing pattern.

attributes.name: pattern_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the claim is part of a broader pattern of fraudulent or abusive billing behavior.
attributes.references: CMS Fraud, Waste, and Abuse Guidelines

attributes.name: pattern_description
attributes.description: Description of the identified billing pattern or scheme associated with the claim review.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary data source or system from which the claim review record was generated or extracted.

attributes.name: review_closed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who officially closed the claim review case.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason for closing the claim review case.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the claim review record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Unique internal identifier of the healthcare provider associated with the claim under review.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to eligibility.coverage. Business justification: Fraud analysts review claims against specific coverage records to validate eligibility at service date. Each claim review must verify the member had active, legitimate coverage when services occurred.

attributes.name: benefit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.benefit. Business justification: Fraud analysts review claims against specific benefit definitions to detect improper billing for non-covered services. Each claim review validates service codes against benefit coverage rules and limi

attributes.name: auth_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to authorization.request. Business justification: Claims flagged for fraud review must reference the authorization request to verify services rendered matched approved services. Discrepancies between authorized and billed services are primary fraud i

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.care_plan. Business justification: Claims flagged for fraud review often involve care management billing codes. Reviewers verify that care plan documentation supports the billed services, checking for phantom care coordination or infla

attributes.name: claim_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_claim_line. Business justification: Fraud investigators review specific pharmacy claim lines for suspicious patterns (duplicate fills, excessive quantities, inappropriate drugs). SIU teams reference exact claim lines daily during invest

attributes.name: clinical_metric_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.clinical_metric_result. Business justification: Claim reviews validate clinical metrics against actual services - detecting providers billing for quality-based outcomes not supported by documented clinical results.

attributes.name: diagnosis_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.diagnosis_record. Business justification: Fraud claim reviews must validate diagnosis codes on claims match medical records and are clinically appropriate. Investigators verify diagnosis legitimacy to detect billing fraud and phantom diagnose

attributes.name: program_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_claim. Business justification: Claim reviews specifically target government program claims for fraud detection. Automated and manual reviews screen Medicare/Medicaid claims against fraud rules before payment authorization.

attributes.name: investigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.investigation. Business justification: Claim_review can be part of investigation when specific claims are reviewed as part of broader fraud investigation. This FK links the review to the investigation.

attributes.name: provider_audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.provider_audit. Business justification: Claim_review can be part of provider_audit when claims are sampled and reviewed during audit. This FK links the review to the audit.

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.fraud_type. Business justification: Claim_review should reference fraud_type for standardized fraud classification when fraud is detected. This FK enables consistent fraud categorization.

attributes.name: severity_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.severity_level. Business justification: Claim_review should reference severity_level for standardized severity and priority classification. Currently uses risk_category and review_priority strings which should be consolidated into severity_

attributes.name: rule_violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.rule_violation. Business justification: Claim_review can be triggered by rule_violation when automated fraud detection rules flag a claim for manual review. This FK links the review to the triggering violation.

products.name: provider_sanction

attributes.name: sanction_duration_days

attributes.name: appeal_date

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: The current status of the provider's appeal of the sanction decision.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date

attributes.name: appeal_outcome

attributes.name: law_enforcement_referral_flag

products.name: payment_hold

products.name: recovery_action

attributes.name: recovery_action_id

attributes.description: Unique identifier of the healthcare claim associated with this recovery action.

attributes.name: provider_npi

attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number of the provider subject to recovery action.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the healthcare provider or facility from whom funds are being recovered.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan member associated with the claim subject to recovery.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recovery method being pursued to reclaim overpaid or improperly paid funds.

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the recovery action in its lifecycle from initiation to closure.

attributes.name: overpayment_amount

attributes.name: recovery_amount_requested

attributes.name: recovery_amount_collected

attributes.name: administrative_fee

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: response_due_date

attributes.name: payment_due_date

attributes.name: last_collection_date

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the recovery action was formally closed either due to full recovery, settlement, or write-off.

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date

attributes.name: collection_method

attributes.name: installment_plan_flag

attributes.name: appeal_date

attributes.name: settlement_flag

attributes.name: legal_action_flag

attributes.name: write_off_flag

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date when the outstanding recovery amount was written off as uncollectible.

attributes.name: write_off_reason

attributes.name: assigned_to_user_id

attributes.name: assigned_department

products.name: type
products.description: Reference table enumerating standardized fraud types (e.g., duplicate billing, upcoding, phantom providers).

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fraud type classification. Primary key for the fraud type reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the fraud type for system processing and reporting (e.g., DUP_BILL, UPCODE, PHANTOM_PROV).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the fraud type (e.g., Duplicate Billing, Upcoding, Phantom Provider).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the fraud type including characteristics, patterns, and typical indicators used by Special Investigations Unit (SIU) teams.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act on Fraud Prevention

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the fraud type by perpetrator or area (provider fraud, member fraud, pharmacy fraud, billing fraud, medical necessity fraud, identity fraud, network fraud).

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity within the fraud category (e.g., within provider fraud: billing schemes, kickback schemes, credential abuse).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification indicating the typical financial impact and urgency of investigation for this fraud type.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Policy

attributes.name: fwa_classification
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether this type represents fraud (intentional deception), waste (overutilization without intent), or abuse (practices inconsistent with standards).
attributes.references: CMS Fraud Waste and Abuse Guidelines

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Primary method typically used to detect this fraud type (automated rules, predictive analytics, manual review, provider audit, member complaint, whistleblower, data mining, peer comparison).

attributes.name: typical_indicators
attributes.description: Common red flags and patterns that indicate potential occurrence of this fraud type, used by investigators and automated detection systems.

attributes.name: claim_type_applicability
attributes.description: Types of claims where this fraud type is typically observed (e.g., professional claims, institutional claims, pharmacy claims, dental claims).

attributes.name: lob_applicability
attributes.description: Lines of business where this fraud type is commonly encountered (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual Exchange).

attributes.name: provider_specialty_risk
attributes.description: Provider specialties or types that are at higher risk for this fraud type (e.g., DME suppliers, home health agencies, pain management clinics).

attributes.name: average_financial_impact
attributes.description: Average dollar amount of financial loss per occurrence of this fraud type, used for risk prioritization and resource allocation.

attributes.name: investigation_priority
attributes.description: Standard priority level assigned to investigations of this fraud type by the Special Investigations Unit (SIU).

attributes.name: requires_law_enforcement_referral
attributes.description: Indicates whether confirmed cases of this fraud type typically require referral to law enforcement agencies or regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: State Insurance Fraud Bureau Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: mandatory_reporting_threshold
attributes.description: Dollar threshold above which cases of this fraud type must be reported to external authorities per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_years
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statute of Limitations Period in Years
attributes.description: Number of years within which legal action can be taken for this fraud type, based on applicable federal and state laws.
attributes.references: False Claims Act and State Fraud Statutes

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to recover overpayments for this fraud type (offset against future payments, demand letter, payment plan, legal action, write-off).

attributes.name: prevention_strategy
attributes.description: Recommended prevention strategies and controls to reduce occurrence of this fraud type (e.g., prepayment edits, provider education, enhanced credentialing).

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific laws, regulations, or statutes that define or prohibit this fraud type (e.g., False Claims Act 31 USC 3729, Anti-Kickback Statute 42 USC 1320a-7b).
attributes.references: Federal and State Healthcare Fraud Laws

attributes.name: cms_program_integrity_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Program Integrity Category
attributes.description: CMS program integrity category classification for Medicare and Medicaid fraud types, used for federal reporting and coordination.

attributes.name: naic_fraud_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Fraud Code
attributes.description: NAIC standardized fraud classification code for industry-wide reporting and benchmarking.

attributes.name: involves_organized_crime
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fraud type is commonly associated with organized crime rings or sophisticated fraud schemes requiring specialized investigation.

attributes.name: requires_clinical_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether investigation of this fraud type requires clinical expertise or medical director review to assess medical necessity or appropriateness.

attributes.name: data_sources
attributes.description: Key data sources and systems used to detect and investigate this fraud type (e.g., claims data, provider enrollment, pharmacy data, external databases).

attributes.name: historical_prevalence_rate
attributes.description: Historical rate of occurrence for this fraud type as a percentage of total claims or providers, used for risk modeling and resource planning.

attributes.name: conviction_rate
attributes.description: Historical percentage of investigated cases of this fraud type that resulted in criminal conviction or civil settlement, indicating prosecutability.

attributes.name: average_investigation_days
attributes.description: Typical number of days required to complete investigation of this fraud type, used for case planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: requires_external_data

products.name: audit_hcc_finding
products.description: This association product represents the audit finding relationship between provider audits and individual HCC assignments. It captures the validation results, documentation quality assessment, and error identification for each HCC assignment reviewed during a provider audit. Each record links one provider audit to one member HCC assignment with attributes that exist only in the context of this audit review.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, provider audits routinely review multiple HCC assignments across many members to validate diagnosis coding accuracy and documentation quality. Individual HCC assignments can be audited multiple times through different audit types (annual compliance audits, targeted reviews, CMS RADV audits). The business actively manages audit findings as operational records with specific validation statuses, documentation quality scores, error types, and financial impacts for each HCC assignment reviewed.

products.name: audit_interaction
products.description: This association product represents the documented communication events between auditors and providers during the audit lifecycle. It captures the interaction context, audit phase, and documentation exchange that occurs as part of provider audit execution. Each record links one provider_audit to one interaction with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, provider audits generate multiple service interactions throughout their lifecycle (initial notification calls, document request emails, clarification discussions, results presentations). A single interaction can reference multiple concurrent audits when a provider is under review for multiple issues simultaneously. The business actively manages these audit-interaction linkages to track communication history, documentation exchange, and audit phase progression.

products.name: policy_violation
products.description: This association product represents the violation event between investigation and compliance_policy. It captures the specific instance where a fraud investigation identifies a violation of a particular compliance policy. Each record links one investigation to one compliance_policy with attributes that document the violation details, severity, and findings for regulatory reporting and remediation tracking.. Existence Justification: In health insurance fraud investigations, a single investigation routinely identifies violations of multiple compliance policies (HIPAA privacy rules, Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, billing policies, etc.), and each compliance policy can be violated across many different investigations. The business actively manages policy violations as distinct operational records with specific findings, severity assessments, and regulatory reporting requirements for each investigation-policy combination.

products.name: investigation_program_scope
products.description: This association product represents the investigative scope between fraud investigations and provider program participations. It captures the specific government programs under investigation, program-specific violations discovered, investigation status per program, and assigned investigators. Each record links one investigation to one provider program participation with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer fraud operations, a single investigation routinely examines multiple government program participations when providers commit cross-program fraud (e.g., billing fraud across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and CHIP simultaneously). Conversely, a single provider program participation can be subject to multiple concurrent or sequential investigations for different fraud types (billing irregularities, kickback schemes, quality violations). SIU investigators actively manage investigation scope records per program, tracking program-specific violations, findings, status, and assigned investigators.

products.name: investigation_audit
products.description: This association product represents the audit event between investigation and audit. It captures the formal review and examination of fraud investigation cases by internal compliance teams, external auditors, or regulatory bodies. Each record links one investigation to one audit engagement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific audit review, including the scope of review, findings specific to that investigation, and the auditor assigned to review that particular case.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, fraud investigations are subject to multiple types of audits throughout their lifecycle: internal quality assurance reviews, compliance audits, regulatory audits (CMS, state insurance departments), and legal sufficiency reviews. Conversely, a single audit engagement (e.g., annual SIU compliance audit) examines a sample of multiple investigation cases to assess overall program effectiveness, adherence to protocols, and regulatory compliance. The business actively manages this relationship by tracking which investigations were audited, what findings were identified per investigation, and what remediation is required.

attributes.name: training_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the auditor has completed required training for the current period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the auditor record was created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the auditor record.

domains.name: risk
domains.description: Risk adjustment processing including HCC coding, RAF score calculation, RAPS/EDPS submissions for Medicare Advantage, diagnosis capture, chart reviews, and risk score reconciliation. Supports CMS risk adjustment model compliance and risk-based payment.

products.name: member_risk_profile
products.description: Master record for each member's risk characteristics, including demographic, enrollment, and risk-related attributes used for risk adjustment calculations.

attributes.name: member_risk_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member risk profile record, serving as the primary key for risk adjustment tracking and analysis.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with this risk profile.

attributes.name: hicn
attributes.description: Medicare beneficiary identifier used for claims processing and risk adjustment submissions prior to MBI implementation.

attributes.name: mbi
attributes.description: New Medicare beneficiary identifier replacing HICN for improved privacy and security in risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: CMS-assigned contract identifier for the Medicare Advantage plan under which the member is enrolled.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific benefit package within the Medicare Advantage contract.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status of the member in the health plan, affecting risk adjustment eligibility.

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's enrollment in the health plan became effective for risk adjustment purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's enrollment in the health plan ended, affecting risk score calculation periods.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Member's date of birth used for age-based risk adjustment factor calculations.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Member's gender classification used in CMS risk adjustment model calculations.

attributes.name: age_as_of_payment_year
attributes.description: Member's age calculated as of February 1st of the payment year, used for demographic risk factor determination.

attributes.name: medicaid_dual_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is dually eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid benefits, affecting risk adjustment model selection.

attributes.name: institutional_status
attributes.description: Classification of member's residential setting (community vs institutional) used for risk model segmentation.

attributes.name: originally_disabled_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member originally qualified for Medicare due to disability rather than age.

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has End Stage Renal Disease, requiring specialized risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: hospice_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member is enrolled in hospice care, affecting risk adjustment payment calculations.

attributes.name: risk_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the CMS risk adjustment model applied to calculate the member's risk score.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which risk-adjusted payments are calculated based on prior year diagnoses.

attributes.name: data_year
attributes.description: Calendar year during which diagnosis data was collected for risk score calculation.

attributes.name: raf_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk adjustment factor score representing the member's expected cost relative to the average Medicare beneficiary.

attributes.name: demographic_raf_score
attributes.description: Component of RAF score based solely on demographic factors (age, gender, dual status, institutional status).

attributes.name: disease_raf_score
attributes.description: Component of RAF score based on documented chronic conditions and HCC categories.

attributes.name: normalized_raf_score
attributes.description: RAF score adjusted by CMS normalization factor to ensure budget neutrality across the Medicare Advantage program.

attributes.name: hcc_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct HCC categories assigned to the member based on documented diagnoses.

attributes.name: active_hcc_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of HCC codes currently active for the member after hierarchy processing.

attributes.name: interaction_factors
attributes.description: List of interaction terms applied in risk score calculation when specific combinations of conditions or demographics exist.

attributes.name: diagnosis_count
attributes.description: Total number of ICD-10 diagnoses documented for the member during the data collection period.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct chronic conditions identified for the member based on diagnosis history.

attributes.name: risk_score_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the member's risk score calculation and submission to CMS.

attributes.name: raps_submission_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Submission Status
attributes.description: Status of diagnosis data submission to CMS via the RAPS system for risk adjustment payment.

attributes.name: edps_submission_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Encounter Data Processing System (EDPS) Submission Status
attributes.description: Status of encounter data submission to CMS via EDPS for risk adjustment and payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: last_raps_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Submission Date
attributes.description: Most recent date when diagnosis data was submitted to CMS via RAPS for this member.

attributes.name: last_edps_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Encounter Data Processing System (EDPS) Submission Date
attributes.description: Most recent date when encounter data was submitted to CMS via EDPS for this member.

attributes.name: chart_review_status
attributes.description: Current status of medical chart review process for diagnosis validation and HCC capture.

attributes.name: chart_review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the medical chart review was completed for this member's risk adjustment validation.

attributes.name: chart_review_score
attributes.description: Quality score assigned during chart review process indicating documentation completeness and accuracy.

attributes.name: suspected_hcc_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of HCC codes suspected based on claims patterns but not yet documented in medical records.

attributes.name: gap_closure_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned for care gap closure activities to capture undocumented chronic conditions.

attributes.name: prospective_raf_score
attributes.description: Projected RAF score for the upcoming payment year based on current diagnosis patterns and trends.

attributes.name: prior_year_raf_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Year Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) Score
attributes.description: RAF score from the previous payment year used for year-over-year comparison and trend analysis.

attributes.name: raf_score_change_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) Score Change Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in RAF score compared to the prior year, indicating risk profile evolution.

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Categorical classification of member risk level based on RAF score and clinical complexity.

attributes.name: primary_diagnosis_category
attributes.description: Primary disease category driving the member's risk score and care management needs.

attributes.name: comorbidity_index
attributes.description: Calculated index measuring the burden of multiple chronic conditions affecting the member.

attributes.name: frailty_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member meets clinical criteria for frailty based on documented conditions.

attributes.name: pharmacy_risk_score
attributes.description: Risk score component based on prescription drug utilization patterns and medication complexity.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: utilization_risk_score
attributes.description: Risk score component based on healthcare service utilization patterns including inpatient and outpatient visits.

attributes.name: predictive_cost_index
attributes.description: Predicted annual healthcare cost for the member relative to the plan average, based on risk profile.

attributes.name: care_management_program
attributes.description: Name of the care management or disease management program the member is enrolled in based on risk profile.

attributes.name: care_management_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the member was enrolled in a care management program based on their risk assessment.

attributes.name: last_risk_assessment_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when a comprehensive risk assessment was performed for the member.

attributes.name: next_risk_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next comprehensive risk assessment based on member risk tier and program requirements.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of risk assessments based on member risk level and program guidelines.

attributes.name: radv_audit_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Flag
attributes.description: Indicator that the member's risk data has been selected for CMS RADV audit review.

attributes.name: radv_audit_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Year
attributes.description: Payment year for which the member's risk adjustment data is being audited by CMS.

attributes.name: radv_audit_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Status
attributes.description: Current status of the CMS RADV audit process for this member's risk adjustment data.

attributes.name: radv_error_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Error Rate
attributes.description: Percentage of HCC codes that failed validation during RADV audit due to insufficient documentation.

attributes.name: coding_intensity_factor
attributes.description: Adjustment factor applied by CMS to account for differences in diagnosis coding practices across plans.

attributes.name: ma_coding_pattern_adjustment
attributes.description: CMS adjustment factor applied to normalize coding patterns between Medicare Advantage and Fee-for-Service Medicare.

attributes.name: risk_score_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the annual risk score reconciliation process comparing RAPS and encounter data submissions.

attributes.name: reconciliation_payment_adjustment
attributes.description: Dollar amount of payment adjustment resulting from risk score reconciliation between preliminary and final submissions.

attributes.name: data_source_priority
attributes.description: Primary data source used for risk score calculation when multiple sources contain conflicting diagnosis information.

attributes.name: supplemental_diagnosis_source
attributes.description: Type of supplemental data source used to capture additional diagnoses for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: risk_profile_last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's risk profile was last recalculated based on new diagnosis or enrollment information.

attributes.name: risk_profile_version
attributes.description: Version number of the risk profile record, incremented with each recalculation or update.

attributes.name: data_completeness_score
attributes.description: Quality metric indicating the completeness of diagnosis and demographic data available for risk score calculation.

attributes.name: documentation_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality metric assessing the adequacy of medical record documentation supporting reported diagnoses.

attributes.name: risk_capture_opportunity_count
attributes.description: Number of identified opportunities to capture additional HCC codes through improved documentation or assessments.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_revenue
attributes.description: Projected annual revenue from CMS based on the member's risk-adjusted payment rate.

attributes.name: benchmark_rate
attributes.description: CMS county-level benchmark payment rate before risk adjustment for the member's geographic area.

attributes.name: risk_adjusted_payment_rate
attributes.description: Final monthly payment rate from CMS after applying the member's RAF score to the benchmark rate.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS county code for the member's residence, used to determine applicable benchmark rates.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for the member's residence, used in risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Member's residential ZIP code used for geographic risk adjustment and network assignment.

attributes.name: urban_rural_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of member's residence as urban or rural, affecting benchmark rates and risk adjustment.

attributes.name: part_c_premium_category
attributes.description: Premium tier category for the member's Medicare Advantage plan affecting risk adjustment calculations.

attributes.name: part_d_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member has Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage integrated with their MA plan.

attributes.name: low_income_subsidy_level
attributes.description: Level of low-income subsidy assistance the member receives for Part D prescription drug costs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Low Income Subsidy Program

attributes.name: snp_type
attributes.description: Type of Special Needs Plan enrollment (Dual Eligible, Chronic Condition, or Institutional) if applicable.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_snp_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan (C-SNP) Type
attributes.description: Specific chronic condition category for C-SNP enrollment (e.g., diabetes, cardiovascular, chronic heart failure).

attributes.name: model_of_care_status
attributes.description: Compliance status with CMS Model of Care requirements for Special Needs Plan members.
attributes.references: CMS Special Needs Plan Model of Care Requirements

attributes.name: stars_rating_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of how the member's risk profile and care outcomes impact the plan's CMS Stars quality rating.

attributes.name: quality_bonus_payment_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member's plan qualifies for quality bonus payments affecting risk-adjusted rates.

attributes.name: risk_profile_created_date
attributes.description: Date when the initial risk profile record was created for the member in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current risk profile information became effective for payment and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the current risk profile information is no longer effective, typically due to enrollment changes or recalculation.

attributes.name: active_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this risk profile record is currently active and used for payment calculations.

attributes.name: model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.model_version. Business justification: member_risk_profile stores risk_model_version as STRING. Adding FK to model_version reference table establishes authoritative link to CMS risk adjustment model parameters, normalization factors, and c

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment. Business justification: Risk profiles are calculated per enrollment period. When a member re-enrolls or changes plans, a new risk profile is created tied to that specific enrollment. Risk adjustment teams use this to calcula

attributes.name: risk_score_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.risk_score. Business justification: Member risk profiles must reference the calculated risk score used for premium rating and CMS payment reconciliation. Risk adjustment teams use this daily for RAF score validation.

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.status_history. Business justification: Risk profiles transition through statuses (draft, validated, submitted, finalized). Analytics teams track status changes to measure processing times and identify bottlenecks in risk adjustment workflo

products.name: diagnosis_record
products.description: Transactional capture of each diagnosis code reported on a claim or encounter, linked to the member and service date.

attributes.name: diagnosis_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each diagnosis record captured from a claim or encounter submission.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Standards

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Code
attributes.description: The ICD-10-CM diagnosis code reported on the claim or encounter, representing the medical condition diagnosed.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, CMS ICD-10 Standards

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_version
attributes.description: The version of the diagnosis coding system used (ICD-9 or ICD-10).

attributes.name: diagnosis_sequence_number
attributes.description: The sequential position of this diagnosis on the claim (1=primary, 2=secondary, etc.), indicating clinical priority.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Healthcare Claim Transaction Standard

attributes.name: diagnosis_type
attributes.description: Classification of the diagnosis indicating its role in the clinical encounter (e.g., principal diagnosis, secondary diagnosis, admitting diagnosis).
attributes.references: CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: present_on_admission_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the diagnosis was present at the time of inpatient admission (Y=Yes, N=No, U=Unknown, W=Clinically Undetermined, 1=Exempt).
attributes.references: CMS Present on Admission Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: service_from_date
attributes.description: The start date of the service period during which this diagnosis was documented.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Healthcare Claim Transaction Standard

attributes.name: service_to_date
attributes.description: The end date of the service period during which this diagnosis was documented.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Healthcare Claim Transaction Standard

attributes.name: diagnosis_date
attributes.description: The specific date when the diagnosis was clinically established or documented by the provider.

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: The HCC code assigned to this diagnosis for CMS risk adjustment purposes, representing a clinically and financially homogeneous group of conditions.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model Documentation, CMS-HCC Model V24/V28

attributes.name: hcc_description
attributes.description: The descriptive name of the HCC category (e.g., 'Diabetes with Chronic Complications', 'Congestive Heart Failure').

attributes.name: hcc_weight
attributes.description: The risk weight coefficient assigned to this HCC in the CMS risk adjustment model, used to calculate the Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) score.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model Documentation, CMS Rate Announcement

attributes.name: rxhcc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Hierarchical Condition Category (RxHCC) Code
attributes.description: The RxHCC code assigned to this diagnosis for Medicare Part D risk adjustment purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Risk Adjustment Model Documentation

attributes.name: is_risk_adjustable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code is eligible for risk adjustment under the CMS HCC model.

attributes.name: raf_contribution
attributes.description: The incremental contribution of this diagnosis to the member's overall RAF score for payment calculation.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Documentation

attributes.name: diagnosis_source
attributes.description: The source system or method through which this diagnosis was captured (e.g., claim submission, encounter data, chart review, supplemental data).
attributes.references: CMS Encounter Data Processing System (EDPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: The type of claim on which this diagnosis was reported (professional, institutional, etc.).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Healthcare Claim Transaction Standard

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: The two-digit code identifying the location where the service associated with this diagnosis was rendered (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room).
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set

attributes.name: bill_type_code
attributes.description: The three-digit UB-04 bill type code for institutional claims, indicating facility type, care type, and billing sequence.

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: The four-digit revenue code from the UB-04 claim form indicating the specific accommodation, ancillary service, or billing calculation related to this diagnosis.

attributes.name: procedure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) or Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Procedure Code
attributes.description: The CPT or HCPCS procedure code associated with the service line where this diagnosis was reported.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set, CMS HCPCS Level II Code Set

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: The DRG code assigned to the inpatient stay, which is influenced by this diagnosis for payment grouping purposes.

attributes.name: provider_specialty_code
attributes.description: The specialty code of the provider who documented this diagnosis (e.g., cardiology, endocrinology).

attributes.name: rendering_provider_type
attributes.description: The type of healthcare professional who rendered the service and documented this diagnosis.

attributes.name: facility_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit NPI of the facility where the service associated with this diagnosis was provided.

attributes.name: member_member_profile_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the health plan member to whom this diagnosis applies.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the primary subscriber on the health plan policy associated with this diagnosis.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: contract_id
