attributes.description: The CMS contract identifier for the Medicare Advantage or Part D plan under which this diagnosis is being reported for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: The Plan Benefit Package ID identifying the specific benefit plan design under which this diagnosis was incurred.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Plan Benefit Package Requirements

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business or product type under which this diagnosis is being reported (e.g., Medicare Advantage, Commercial, Medicaid).
attributes.references: NAIC Health Insurance Line of Business Reporting

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this diagnosis contributes to risk adjustment payment calculations.

attributes.name: data_collection_period
attributes.description: The time period during which this diagnosis was collected for risk adjustment purposes (typically the prior calendar year).
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis record is an initial submission, replacement, void, or correction.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date when this diagnosis record was submitted to CMS via RAPS or EDPS for risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: submission_file_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the RAPS or EDPS submission file containing this diagnosis record.

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: The current processing status of this diagnosis record in the CMS risk adjustment system.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: The code indicating why this diagnosis record was rejected by CMS, if applicable.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: The descriptive text explaining why this diagnosis record was rejected by CMS.

attributes.name: is_chart_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis has been validated through a medical chart review process.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Protocol

attributes.name: chart_review_date
attributes.description: The date when the medical chart review was completed for this diagnosis.

attributes.name: chart_review_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the chart review process indicating whether the diagnosis was validated or invalidated.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the clinical professional who performed the chart review for this diagnosis.

attributes.name: medical_record_number
attributes.description: The medical record number from the provider's system associated with this diagnosis documentation.

attributes.name: encounter_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the clinical encounter during which this diagnosis was documented.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the claim on which this diagnosis was originally reported.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Healthcare Claim Transaction Standard

attributes.name: claim_line_number
attributes.description: The line number on the claim where this diagnosis was reported.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Healthcare Claim Transaction Standard

attributes.name: claim_received_date
attributes.description: The date when the claim containing this diagnosis was received by the health plan.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 Healthcare Claim Transaction Standard

attributes.name: claim_processed_date
attributes.description: The date when the claim containing this diagnosis was adjudicated and processed.

attributes.name: claim_paid_date
attributes.description: The date when payment was issued for the claim containing this diagnosis.

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: The current adjudication status of the claim on which this diagnosis was reported.

attributes.name: diagnosis_pointer
attributes.description: The letter code (A-L) linking this diagnosis to specific service lines on the CMS-1500 claim form.

attributes.name: is_primary_diagnosis
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary (principal) diagnosis for the encounter or claim.
attributes.references: CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: is_chronic_condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a chronic condition requiring ongoing management.
attributes.references: CMS Chronic Condition Data Warehouse (CCW) Definitions

attributes.name: chronic_condition_category
attributes.description: The category of chronic condition this diagnosis represents (e.g., diabetes, heart disease, COPD).
attributes.references: CMS Chronic Condition Data Warehouse (CCW) Definitions

attributes.name: is_preventable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a potentially preventable condition or complication.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: The clinical severity classification of this diagnosis based on standardized severity scoring systems.
attributes.references: 3M All Patient Refined DRG (APR-DRG) Severity of Illness

attributes.name: mortality_risk_level
attributes.description: The mortality risk classification associated with this diagnosis based on clinical severity systems.
attributes.references: 3M All Patient Refined DRG (APR-DRG) Risk of Mortality

attributes.name: is_complication
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a complication of care or treatment.

attributes.name: is_comorbidity
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a comorbid condition existing alongside the primary diagnosis.
attributes.references: Charlson Comorbidity Index, Elixhauser Comorbidity Measures

attributes.name: is_hospital_acquired
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a hospital-acquired condition that was not present on admission.

attributes.name: quality_measure_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is relevant for HEDIS or other quality measure reporting.

attributes.name: hedis_measure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Code
attributes.description: The HEDIS measure code(s) for which this diagnosis is a qualifying condition or exclusion criterion.

attributes.name: star_rating_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis impacts CMS Star Ratings for Medicare Advantage plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Star Ratings Methodology

attributes.name: gap_in_care_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a gap in care that requires follow-up or intervention.

attributes.name: suspecting_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is suspected but not yet confirmed, which may affect risk adjustment eligibility.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this diagnosis record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this diagnosis record was first created in the data product.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this diagnosis record was last updated in the data product.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis record is currently active and valid for risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the primary subscriber on the health plan policy associated with this diagnosis.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

attributes.name: chart_reviewer_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the clinical professional who performed the chart review for this diagnosis.

attributes.name: provider_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to member.provider_assignment. Business justification: Diagnosis records must link to the member's assigned provider for attribution and chart review validation. Provider assignment determines accountability for diagnosis documentation.

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment. Business justification: Diagnosis records must be tied to active enrollment periods for CMS risk adjustment submissions. Only diagnoses occurring during valid enrollment periods qualify for HCC coding and risk score calculat

attributes.name: audit_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.audit_log. Business justification: Diagnosis records require audit trails for HIPAA compliance and fraud detection. Every diagnosis entry/modification is logged with user, timestamp, and change details for regulatory audits.

products.name: diagnosis_code
products.description: Reference list of all valid ICD-10 diagnosis codes with descriptions and hierarchy.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the diagnosis code record in the data product.

attributes.name: code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric ICD-10-CM diagnosis code representing a specific disease, condition, injury, or health-related problem. Format follows CMS ICD-10-CM coding standards with optional decimal precision.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, CMS

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated clinical description of the diagnosis code, typically used in constrained display contexts and system interfaces.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Complete clinical description of the diagnosis code providing full medical terminology and context for the condition or disease.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Three-character ICD-10 category code representing the broader disease classification to which this diagnosis belongs.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Description of the three-character category code providing context for the disease grouping.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: chapter_code
attributes.description: The ICD-10 chapter code range (e.g., A00-B99) indicating the highest-level classification grouping for this diagnosis.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: chapter_description
attributes.description: Description of the ICD-10 chapter providing the broadest disease classification context (e.g., Certain infectious and parasitic diseases).
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: block_code
attributes.description: The ICD-10 block code range representing a sub-grouping within a chapter (e.g., A00-A09 for intestinal infectious diseases).
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: block_description
attributes.description: Description of the ICD-10 block providing intermediate-level disease classification context.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code is valid for billing and claims submission. Only billable codes can be used as primary or secondary diagnoses on healthcare claims.

attributes.name: is_header
attributes.description: Indicates whether this code is a non-billable header code used for organizational hierarchy purposes only.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: hcc_category
attributes.description: The HCC category code assigned to this diagnosis for Medicare Advantage risk adjustment purposes. Used to calculate Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) scores.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, CMS-HCC Software

attributes.name: hcc_description
attributes.description: Description of the HCC category providing clinical context for the risk adjustment grouping.

attributes.name: hcc_weight
attributes.description: The numeric weight assigned to the HCC category for RAF score calculation. Higher weights indicate greater expected healthcare costs.

attributes.name: rxhcc_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Hierarchical Condition Category (RxHCC) Code
attributes.description: The RxHCC category code assigned to this diagnosis for Medicare Part D risk adjustment purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: rxhcc_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Hierarchical Condition Category (RxHCC) Description
attributes.description: Description of the RxHCC category providing clinical context for Part D risk adjustment.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: rxhcc_weight
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Hierarchical Condition Category (RxHCC) Weight
attributes.description: The numeric weight assigned to the RxHCC category for Part D risk score calculation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: is_chronic_condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a chronic condition requiring ongoing care management and disease management program eligibility.

attributes.name: is_manifestation_code
attributes.description: Indicates whether this code represents a manifestation of an underlying disease and must be sequenced after the underlying condition code per ICD-10 coding guidelines.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: is_etiology_code
attributes.description: Indicates whether this code represents the underlying cause or etiology of a condition and should be sequenced before manifestation codes.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: requires_additional_character
attributes.description: Indicates whether this code requires additional characters (4th, 5th, 6th, or 7th) to be valid for billing purposes.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: seventh_character_options
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of valid seventh character extensions for this diagnosis code (e.g., A|D|S for initial encounter, subsequent encounter, sequela).
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: gender_specific
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code is specific to male patients, female patients, or applicable to both genders.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: age_low
attributes.description: The minimum age in years for which this diagnosis code is clinically applicable. Null indicates no lower age restriction.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: age_high
attributes.description: The maximum age in years for which this diagnosis code is clinically applicable. Null indicates no upper age restriction.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: major_diagnostic_category
attributes.description: The Major Diagnostic Category code used in DRG grouping for inpatient hospital reimbursement.

attributes.name: mdc_description
attributes.description: Description of the Major Diagnostic Category providing context for DRG assignment.

attributes.name: body_system
attributes.description: The primary body system or organ system affected by this diagnosis (e.g., cardiovascular, respiratory, musculoskeletal).
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: clinical_specialty
attributes.description: The primary medical specialty typically associated with treating this diagnosis (e.g., cardiology, orthopedics, oncology).

attributes.name: is_principal_diagnosis_only
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code can only be used as a principal diagnosis and not as a secondary diagnosis on claims.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: is_secondary_diagnosis_only
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code can only be used as a secondary diagnosis and not as a principal diagnosis on claims.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: present_on_admission_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code is exempt from Present on Admission reporting requirements for inpatient claims.
attributes.references: CMS Present on Admission Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: hospital_acquired_condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is classified as a hospital-acquired condition that may affect reimbursement when not present on admission.

attributes.name: complication_comorbidity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is classified as a Complication or Comorbidity (CC), Major Complication or Comorbidity (MCC), or neither for DRG assignment purposes.

attributes.name: quality_measure_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code is used in HEDIS, CAHPS, or other quality measurement and reporting programs.

attributes.name: hedis_measure_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Codes
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of HEDIS measure codes that reference this diagnosis code in their specifications.

attributes.name: cms_star_rating_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Star Rating Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code is used in CMS Star Rating calculations for Medicare Advantage plans.

attributes.name: preventable_admission_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is classified as a potentially preventable hospital admission for care management purposes.

attributes.name: readmission_risk_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is associated with high risk of hospital readmission within 30 days.

attributes.name: care_management_program_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members with this diagnosis are eligible for disease management or care management programs.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether services related to this diagnosis typically require prior authorization or utilization management review.

attributes.name: case_management_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis automatically triggers case management outreach and intervention.

attributes.name: behavioral_health_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is classified as a behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder condition.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act

attributes.name: substance_use_disorder_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a substance use disorder requiring specialized treatment and reporting.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act

attributes.name: maternity_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is related to pregnancy, childbirth, or postpartum care.

attributes.name: pediatric_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is specific to pediatric populations and pediatric care services.

attributes.name: preventive_care_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is associated with preventive care services that may be covered at 100% under ACA requirements.

attributes.name: telehealth_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether services for this diagnosis are eligible for telehealth delivery and reimbursement.

attributes.name: social_determinants_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code represents a social determinant of health factor (e.g., housing insecurity, food insecurity).
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Z-codes for Social Determinants of Health

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this diagnosis code became valid and available for use in claims processing and clinical documentation.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this diagnosis code was retired or became invalid for use. Null indicates the code is currently active.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the diagnosis code indicating whether it is active for use, inactive, deprecated, or pending implementation.

attributes.name: replacement_code
attributes.description: The ICD-10 code that replaces this code if it has been deprecated or retired. Used for code mapping and historical claims analysis.

attributes.name: version_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year of the ICD-10-CM code set version in which this code was defined or last updated.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: The date on which this diagnosis code record was last modified in the reference data system.

products.name: hcc_category
products.description: Reference mapping of diagnosis codes to HCC categories used in risk adjustment.

attributes.name: hcc_category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the HCC category used in CMS risk adjustment models.

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: The standardized HCC code assigned by CMS for risk adjustment (e.g., HCC18, HCC85).

attributes.name: hcc_label
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the HCC category (e.g., Diabetes with Chronic Complications, Major Depressive Disorder).

attributes.name: hcc_description
attributes.description: Detailed clinical description of the conditions included in this HCC category.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version of the CMS risk adjustment model this HCC category belongs to (e.g., V24, V28).

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this HCC category is applicable for risk adjustment payments.

attributes.name: disease_category
attributes.description: High-level disease classification grouping for the HCC (e.g., Cardiovascular, Diabetes, Mental Health, Cancer).

attributes.name: body_system
attributes.description: The primary body system affected by conditions in this HCC category (e.g., Endocrine, Respiratory, Musculoskeletal).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Clinical severity classification of the HCC category indicating disease burden.

attributes.name: coefficient_value
attributes.description: The numeric coefficient assigned to this HCC category used in calculating the RAF score for risk-based payment.

attributes.name: community_coefficient
attributes.description: The coefficient value for community-dwelling beneficiaries in this HCC category.

attributes.name: institutional_coefficient
attributes.description: The coefficient value for institutionalized beneficiaries in this HCC category.

attributes.name: new_enrollee_coefficient
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Enrollee Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) Coefficient
attributes.description: The coefficient value for new Medicare Advantage enrollees in this HCC category.

attributes.name: is_hierarchical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category participates in hierarchical relationships where more severe conditions supersede less severe ones.

attributes.name: superseded_by_hcc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Code
attributes.description: The HCC code that supersedes this category in the hierarchy when both conditions are present.

attributes.name: supersedes_hcc_code
attributes.description: The HCC code(s) that this category supersedes in the hierarchy when both conditions are present.

attributes.name: disease_interaction_group
attributes.description: Identifies disease interaction groups where multiple HCCs together result in additional risk adjustment.

attributes.name: is_interaction_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category is eligible to participate in disease interaction calculations for additional risk adjustment.

attributes.name: rxhcc_mapping
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Hierarchical Condition Category (RxHCC) Mapping
attributes.description: The corresponding RxHCC category code used for Part D risk adjustment if applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: icd10_code_range
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Code Range
attributes.description: Representative range or list of ICD-10 diagnosis codes that map to this HCC category.

attributes.name: diagnosis_count
attributes.description: The total number of distinct ICD-10 diagnosis codes that map to this HCC category.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category represents a chronic condition requiring ongoing management.

attributes.name: aca_model_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category is used in the ACA marketplace risk adjustment model.

attributes.name: medicare_advantage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category is used in the Medicare Advantage risk adjustment model.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category applies to ESRD beneficiaries with specific risk adjustment rules.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the HCC category in the risk adjustment model.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this HCC category became effective for risk adjustment calculations.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when this HCC category was retired or superseded by a new model version.

attributes.name: cms_announcement_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Announcement Date
attributes.description: The date when CMS officially announced this HCC category or changes to it.

attributes.name: documentation_requirements
attributes.description: Specific documentation requirements for chart reviews and diagnosis capture to support this HCC category.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Guidelines

attributes.name: audit_risk_level
attributes.description: The risk level assigned for RADV audits and chart review validation for this HCC category.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Guidelines

attributes.name: coding_guidance
attributes.description: Official coding guidance and best practices for accurately capturing diagnoses in this HCC category.

attributes.name: clinical_validation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category requires clinical validation or chart review before submission.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Guidelines

attributes.name: raps_submission_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Submission Eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category is eligible for submission via the RAPS system.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: edps_submission_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Encounter Data Processing System (EDPS) Submission Eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category is eligible for submission via the EDPS encounter data system.
attributes.references: CMS Encounter Data Processing System (EDPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: revenue_impact_category
attributes.description: Classification of the financial impact this HCC category has on risk-based payments and revenue.

attributes.name: prevalence_rate
attributes.description: The prevalence rate of this HCC category in the Medicare Advantage population (expressed as decimal percentage).

attributes.name: suspect_condition_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category is commonly identified as a suspect condition requiring provider outreach for recapture.

attributes.name: quality_measure_linkage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Quality Measure Linkage
attributes.description: HEDIS or Star Ratings quality measures associated with this HCC category for integrated quality and risk management.

attributes.name: care_gap_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC category is commonly associated with care gaps requiring clinical intervention.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this HCC category mapping was sourced (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this HCC category record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding this HCC category, including special considerations or exceptions.

attributes.name: model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.model_version. Business justification: hcc_category stores model_version as STRING. Adding FK to model_version reference table establishes authoritative link to the CMS model version for which this HCC category and coefficient apply. No co

products.name: member_hcc_assignment
products.description: Transactional record linking a member to HCC categories for a given measurement year based on captured diagnoses.

attributes.name: member_hcc_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Member Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Assignment Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member HCC assignment record. Primary key for tracking individual HCC assignments to members.

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: The specific HCC code assigned to the member based on captured diagnoses. Represents a disease category used in CMS risk adjustment calculations.
attributes.references: CMS HCC Model V24 and V28

attributes.name: hcc_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the HCC category, providing clinical context for the assigned condition category.

attributes.name: hcc_category_version
attributes.description: The version of the CMS HCC risk adjustment model used for this assignment (e.g., V24, V28).

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which the HCC assignment is being captured and reported for risk adjustment purposes.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the risk-adjusted payment will be applied based on this HCC assignment.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Code
attributes.description: The ICD-10 diagnosis code that mapped to this HCC assignment. Represents the specific medical condition documented.

attributes.name: diagnosis_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the diagnosis code, providing clinical detail about the member's condition.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: The date when the medical service was provided that resulted in the diagnosis capture for this HCC assignment.

attributes.name: encounter_type
attributes.description: The type of healthcare encounter during which the diagnosis was captured (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, professional).

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the healthcare provider who documented the diagnosis.

attributes.name: provider_specialty
attributes.description: The medical specialty of the provider who documented the diagnosis (e.g., cardiology, endocrinology, primary care).

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the claim that contained the diagnosis leading to this HCC assignment.

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: The type of claim that contained the diagnosis (institutional, professional, dental, pharmacy).

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or method from which the diagnosis data was captured (claims, encounter data, chart review, EHR, supplemental).

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: The submission method used to report this HCC to CMS: RAPS (Risk Adjustment Processing System) or EDPS (Encounter Data Processing System).

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date when this HCC assignment was submitted to CMS for risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: The current status of the HCC submission to CMS (pending, submitted, accepted, rejected, corrected, deleted).
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing Status Codes

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Acceptance Date
attributes.description: The date when CMS accepted this HCC submission into the risk adjustment system.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by CMS for rejecting this HCC submission, if applicable.

attributes.name: hcc_coefficient
attributes.description: The risk score coefficient associated with this HCC code, used in calculating the member's total Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) score.

attributes.name: raf_score_contribution
attributes.description: The contribution of this specific HCC assignment to the member's overall RAF score for the measurement year.

attributes.name: is_hierarchical_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC was overridden by a higher-severity HCC in the same hierarchy per CMS hierarchical rules.

attributes.name: overridden_by_hcc_code
attributes.description: The HCC code that overrode this HCC assignment due to hierarchical rules, if applicable.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC assignment is currently active and contributing to the member's risk score.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of this HCC assignment within the risk adjustment workflow.

attributes.name: chart_review_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the chart review activity that validated or captured this HCC assignment, if applicable.

attributes.name: chart_review_status
attributes.description: The status of chart review validation for this HCC assignment (not reviewed, pending, validated, invalidated, appealed).

attributes.name: chart_review_date
attributes.description: The date when the medical chart was reviewed to validate this HCC assignment.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: The name of the clinical reviewer who validated this HCC assignment during chart review.

attributes.name: validation_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the chart review validation process for this HCC assignment.

attributes.name: invalidation_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this HCC assignment was invalidated during chart review, if applicable.

attributes.name: is_suspect
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC assignment is flagged as a suspect diagnosis requiring additional validation or documentation.

attributes.name: suspect_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this HCC assignment was flagged as suspect (e.g., lack of supporting documentation, coding pattern anomaly).
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Waste and Abuse (FWA) Detection

attributes.name: is_recaptured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC represents a chronic condition that was recaptured from a prior year.

attributes.name: prior_year_hcc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Year Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Code
attributes.description: The HCC code assigned to this member in the prior measurement year, used for recapture tracking.

attributes.name: diagnosis_priority
attributes.description: The priority or sequence number of the diagnosis on the claim (1=primary, 2=secondary, etc.).

attributes.name: is_primary_diagnosis
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis was the primary (principal) diagnosis on the claim or encounter.

attributes.name: disease_category
attributes.description: The broad disease category or body system associated with this HCC (e.g., cardiovascular, diabetes, cancer).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: The clinical severity level of the condition represented by this HCC assignment.

attributes.name: is_chronic_condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC represents a chronic condition that requires annual recapture.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or line of business for which this HCC assignment applies.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The type of health plan under which this HCC assignment was captured.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Contract Identifier
attributes.description: The CMS contract identifier for the Medicare Advantage or Part D plan associated with this HCC assignment.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: The Plan Benefit Package identifier that specifies the benefit design under which this HCC was captured.

attributes.name: risk_model_type
attributes.description: The specific CMS risk adjustment model applied for this HCC assignment (CMS-HCC, RxHCC, ESRD, Institutional, New Enrollee).

attributes.name: member_age_at_service
attributes.description: The age of the member at the time of the service date when the diagnosis was captured.

attributes.name: member_gender
attributes.description: The gender of the member, used in risk adjustment calculations (M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown).

attributes.name: medicaid_dual_status
attributes.description: The member's Medicaid dual eligibility status at the time of HCC assignment (full, partial, non-dual).

attributes.name: institutional_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was in a community or institutional setting when the diagnosis was captured.

attributes.name: original_reason_for_entitlement
attributes.description: The original reason for Medicare entitlement, used in risk adjustment model selection (OASI=Old Age, DIB=Disability, ESRD=End Stage Renal Disease).

attributes.name: is_new_enrollee
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was a new enrollee in the measurement year, affecting which risk model is applied.
attributes.references: CMS New Enrollee Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: months_enrolled
attributes.description: The number of months the member was enrolled in the plan during the measurement year.

attributes.name: payment_amount_impact
attributes.description: The estimated dollar impact of this HCC assignment on the plan's risk-adjusted payment from CMS.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: The 5-digit FIPS code for the county where the member resides, used in payment rate calculations.

attributes.name: rate_cell
attributes.description: The rate cell classification used for payment calculation, combining demographic and enrollment factors.

attributes.name: diagnosis_capture_method
attributes.description: The method by which the diagnosis was captured for risk adjustment purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Collection Methods

attributes.name: is_supplemental_diagnosis
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis was captured through supplemental data collection efforts rather than standard claims.

attributes.name: health_assessment_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the health risk assessment that captured this diagnosis, if applicable.

attributes.name: coding_accuracy_score
attributes.description: A quality score indicating the accuracy and completeness of the diagnosis coding for this HCC assignment.

attributes.name: documentation_quality_score
attributes.description: A quality score assessing the completeness and specificity of the clinical documentation supporting this HCC.

attributes.name: is_audit_selected
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Selection Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC assignment was selected for CMS RADV audit review.

attributes.name: audit_year
attributes.description: The year in which this HCC assignment was audited by CMS or internal auditors.

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the audit review for this HCC assignment (passed, failed, pending, not audited).

attributes.name: error_rate_impact
attributes.description: The percentage impact of this HCC assignment on the overall contract error rate if invalidated during audit.

attributes.name: correction_date
attributes.description: The date when a correction was made to this HCC assignment, if applicable.

attributes.name: deletion_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this HCC assignment was deleted from the risk adjustment submission.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this HCC assignment became effective for risk adjustment purposes.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when this HCC assignment is no longer effective or was terminated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this HCC assignment record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this HCC assignment record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this HCC assignment data originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this HCC assignment record in the source system.

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment. Business justification: HCC assignments are enrollment-specific because risk scores determine per-member-per-month payments from CMS. When enrollment changes (plan switch, gap in coverage), HCC assignments must be recalculat

attributes.name: audit_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.audit_log. Business justification: HCC assignments directly impact CMS payments and must be auditable. Compliance teams track who assigned HCCs, when, and based on what diagnosis for fraud prevention.

products.name: factor
products.description: Reference table of factor values applied to HCCs and demographic attributes for RAF calculation.

attributes.name: factor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk factor record. Primary key for the risk factor reference table.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version of the CMS risk adjustment model to which this factor applies (e.g., V24, V28). Each model year may have different factor values.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this risk factor applies for payment calculations. Risk factors are updated annually by CMS.
attributes.references: CMS Announcement of Calendar Year Rate Notice

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of risk factor: HCC (Hierarchical Condition Category) for disease-based factors, demographic for age/gender factors, interaction for combined demographic and disease factors, or disease_interaction for multiple HCC combinations.

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: The HCC code to which this factor applies (e.g., HCC18, HCC85). Null for pure demographic factors. HCCs represent clinically and cost-related groupings of diagnoses.

attributes.name: hcc_label
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the HCC code (e.g., 'Diabetes with Chronic Complications', 'Congestive Heart Failure'). Provides clinical context for the condition category.

attributes.name: demographic_category
attributes.description: Demographic classification for this factor: age_gender for standard age/sex combinations, medicaid for dual eligible status, disability for disabled beneficiaries, institutional for nursing home residents, ltimcaid for long-term institutional Medicaid, origds for originally disabled, new_enrollee for first-year enrollees. Null for pure HCC factors.

attributes.name: age_range
attributes.description: Age range bracket for demographic factors. CMS uses specific age bands for risk adjustment. Null for non-demographic factors.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender classification for demographic factors (male or female). Null for non-demographic factors or gender-neutral factors.

attributes.name: medicaid_status
attributes.description: Medicaid dual eligibility status for demographic factors: full_benefit for full dual eligibles, partial_benefit for partial dual eligibles, non_dual for Medicare-only. Null if not applicable to this factor.

attributes.name: originally_disabled_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies to beneficiaries who originally qualified for Medicare through disability (ORIGDS). Originally disabled beneficiaries have different risk profiles even after aging into Medicare.

attributes.name: institutional_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies to community-dwelling or institutionalized (nursing home) beneficiaries. CMS uses separate models for these populations.

attributes.name: coefficient_value
attributes.description: The numeric coefficient value used in RAF score calculation. This value is multiplied by the presence indicator (0 or 1) and summed across all applicable factors to produce the member's total RAF score. Higher values indicate greater expected cost.

attributes.name: interaction_component_1
attributes.description: First component of an interaction factor (e.g., HCC code or demographic category). Interaction factors apply when multiple conditions or characteristics co-occur, capturing additional risk beyond additive effects.

attributes.name: interaction_component_2
attributes.description: Second component of an interaction factor. Null for non-interaction factors.

attributes.name: interaction_component_3
attributes.description: Third component of an interaction factor for three-way interactions. Null for two-way interactions or non-interaction factors.

attributes.name: disease_hierarchy_parent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disease Hierarchy Parent Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC)
attributes.description: Parent HCC in the disease hierarchy. When a more severe condition (child) is present, less severe conditions (parent) are suppressed and their factors are not counted. Implements the hierarchical nature of HCC model.

attributes.name: disease_hierarchy_child
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disease Hierarchy Child Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC)
attributes.description: Child HCC in the disease hierarchy. Represents the more severe condition that suppresses the parent HCC.

attributes.name: model_segment
attributes.description: CMS model segment to which this factor applies: CNA (Community Non-dual Aged), CND (Community Non-dual Disabled), CFA (Community Full-benefit dual Aged), CFD (Community Full-benefit dual Disabled), CPA (Community Partial-benefit dual Aged), CPD (Community Partial-benefit dual Disabled), INS (Institutional), NE (New Enrollee), SNPNE (SNP New Enrollee). Each segment has distinct factor values.

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies to beneficiaries with End Stage Renal Disease. ESRD beneficiaries use a separate risk adjustment model with different factors.

attributes.name: normalization_factor
attributes.description: Normalization factor applied to ensure the average RAF score across the population equals 1.0. CMS adjusts factors annually to maintain budget neutrality.
attributes.references: CMS Announcement of Calendar Year Rate Notice

attributes.name: coding_intensity_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment factor applied by CMS to account for year-over-year increases in diagnosis coding intensity that do not reflect true changes in beneficiary health status. Typically a value less than 1.0 that reduces RAF scores.
attributes.references: CMS Announcement of Calendar Year Rate Notice

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk factor becomes effective for use in RAF calculations. Typically January 1 of the payment year.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk factor is no longer effective. Null for currently active factors. Factors may be retired or replaced in new model versions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the risk factor: active for factors in current use, inactive for retired factors, superseded for factors replaced by newer versions, proposed for factors in draft rate notices not yet finalized.

attributes.name: icd10_mapping_count
attributes.description: Number of ICD-10 diagnosis codes that map to this HCC. Provides indication of the breadth of diagnoses included in the condition category. Null for demographic factors.

attributes.name: prevalence_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of the Medicare Advantage population with this factor present, based on CMS national data. Used for benchmarking and validation. Value between 0 and 1.

attributes.name: average_incremental_cost
attributes.description: Average incremental annual cost (in dollars) associated with this factor, based on CMS regression analysis. Represents the additional expected cost beyond the baseline for a beneficiary with this factor.

attributes.name: clinical_category
attributes.description: High-level clinical category grouping for HCC factors (e.g., cardiovascular, diabetes, respiratory). Facilitates clinical analysis and reporting. Null for demographic factors.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Relative severity classification of the condition represented by this HCC: low, moderate, high, or very_high. Based on coefficient value and clinical judgment. Null for demographic factors.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC represents a chronic condition that typically persists across multiple years. Chronic conditions are expected to recur annually in diagnosis data.

attributes.name: recapture_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC is eligible for recapture in chart review programs. Some HCCs are prioritized for retrospective documentation and coding review to ensure complete risk capture.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Guidelines

attributes.name: radv_audit_frequency
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Frequency
attributes.description: Relative frequency with which this HCC is selected for RADV audits by CMS: high for frequently audited HCCs (high-value, high-risk), medium for moderately audited, low for rarely audited. Null for demographic factors.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Guidelines

attributes.name: documentation_requirements
attributes.description: Summary of clinical documentation requirements for this HCC to be considered valid in RADV audits. Describes what must be present in the medical record to support the diagnosis.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Guidelines

attributes.name: suspect_condition_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCC is flagged as a suspect condition requiring additional documentation or validation. Used in chart review and coding compliance programs.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: ma_only_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies only to Medicare Advantage plans and not to other CMS programs (e.g., ACA marketplace risk adjustment uses different factors).

attributes.name: part_c_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies to Medicare Part C (Medical) risk adjustment.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part C Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: part_d_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies to Medicare Part D (Prescription Drug) risk adjustment. Part D uses a separate RxHCC model with different factors.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: rxhcc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Hierarchical Condition Category (RxHCC) Code
attributes.description: The RxHCC code for Part D risk adjustment factors. RxHCCs are similar to HCCs but specific to pharmacy risk. Null for Part C factors.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: aca_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies to ACA marketplace risk adjustment. ACA uses HHS-HCC model which differs from CMS-HCC model for Medicare Advantage.
attributes.references: HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters

attributes.name: hhs_hcc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health and Human Services Hierarchical Condition Category (HHS-HCC) Code
attributes.description: The HHS-HCC code for ACA marketplace risk adjustment. HHS-HCC categories differ from CMS-HCC categories. Null for Medicare factors.
attributes.references: HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters

attributes.name: adult_model_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies to the adult risk adjustment model (age 21+). CMS uses separate models for adults, children, and infants.

attributes.name: child_model_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies to the child risk adjustment model (age 2-20). Child models have different factors reflecting pediatric conditions.

attributes.name: infant_model_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor applies to the infant risk adjustment model (age 0-1). Infant models include factors for birth complications and congenital conditions.

attributes.name: maturity_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment factor for new or low-enrollment plans to account for incomplete diagnosis capture. Applied as a multiplier to RAF scores for plans below maturity thresholds.

attributes.name: benchmark_county_rate
attributes.description: Average county-level benchmark rate (in dollars) used with this factor for payment calculations. CMS sets county-specific benchmarks that are multiplied by RAF scores to determine plan payments.
attributes.references: CMS Announcement of Calendar Year Rate Notice

attributes.name: star_rating_impact
attributes.description: Relative impact of this condition on CMS Star Ratings quality measures: high for conditions directly measured in Star Ratings (e.g., diabetes control), medium for indirect impact, low for minimal impact, none for no impact.

attributes.name: hedis_measure_linkage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Linkage
attributes.description: HEDIS quality measures associated with this HCC (e.g., 'CDC-Diabetes Care', 'CBP-Controlling High Blood Pressure'). Links risk adjustment to quality reporting requirements.

attributes.name: care_management_program_eligibility
attributes.description: Care management or disease management programs for which members with this HCC are typically eligible (e.g., 'Diabetes Management', 'Heart Failure Program', 'Complex Case Management').

attributes.name: prior_authorization_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether services related to this condition typically require prior authorization. Used to link risk adjustment to utilization management processes.

attributes.name: pharmacy_cost_impact
attributes.description: Relative impact of this condition on pharmacy costs: high for conditions requiring expensive medications, medium for moderate pharmacy utilization, low for minimal pharmacy impact, none for no pharmacy component.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: inpatient_cost_impact
attributes.description: Relative impact of this condition on inpatient hospitalization costs: high for conditions with frequent or expensive hospitalizations, medium for moderate inpatient utilization, low for minimal inpatient impact, none for no inpatient component.

attributes.name: outpatient_cost_impact
attributes.description: Relative impact of this condition on outpatient and professional services costs: high for conditions requiring frequent specialist visits or procedures, medium for moderate outpatient utilization, low for minimal outpatient impact, none for no outpatient component.

attributes.name: version_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing changes to this factor in the current model version compared to prior versions. Documents CMS rationale for coefficient changes, new factors, or retired factors.
attributes.references: CMS Announcement of Calendar Year Rate Notice

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System from which this factor definition was loaded: RAPS (Risk Adjustment Processing System) for legacy Medicare Advantage, EDPS (Encounter Data Processing System) for current MA, ACA_EDGE for marketplace, manual for manually maintained reference data.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) Guidelines

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk factor record was last updated in the reference table. Used for change tracking and data quality validation.

attributes.name: cms_publication_date
attributes.description: Date when CMS officially published this factor in the rate notice or model documentation. Establishes regulatory effective date.
attributes.references: CMS Announcement of Calendar Year Rate Notice

attributes.name: public_comment_period_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor is currently in public comment period (proposed but not finalized). CMS releases draft rate notices for public comment before finalizing.
attributes.references: CMS Announcement of Calendar Year Rate Notice

attributes.name: final_rule_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor has been finalized in a CMS final rule and is ready for operational use. False for proposed factors still under review.
attributes.references: CMS Announcement of Calendar Year Rate Notice

attributes.name: model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.model_version. Business justification: risk_factor stores model_version as STRING. Adding FK to model_version reference table establishes authoritative link to the CMS model version for which this risk factor applies. No columns to remove

products.name: adjustment_submission
products.description: Transactional record of each risk adjustment data file submitted to CMS (e.g., RAPS/EDPS) for a measurement year.

attributes.name: adjustment_submission_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each risk adjustment data submission record to CMS.

attributes.name: submission_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the data file submitted to CMS containing risk adjustment records.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the submission file was transmitted to CMS systems.

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the risk adjustment data applies and HCC diagnoses are being reported.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which CMS will use the submitted risk scores to calculate capitated payments.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Three-digit identifier for the specific benefit plan within the contract for which risk data applies.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Business segment for which risk adjustment data is being submitted - Medicare Advantage, Part D, ACA marketplace, or Medicaid managed care.

attributes.name: submission_batch_id
attributes.description: Internal batch identifier grouping multiple submissions processed together for transmission to CMS.

attributes.name: record_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual risk adjustment records (member-diagnosis combinations) included in the submission file.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique members represented in the submission file.

attributes.name: diagnosis_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique diagnosis codes submitted across all members in the file.

attributes.name: hcc_count
attributes.description: Total number of HCC categories represented in the submission after diagnosis-to-HCC mapping.

attributes.name: file_format_version
attributes.description: Version number of the CMS file layout specification used for the submission (e.g., RAPS v5.0, EDPS v2.1).

attributes.name: transmission_method
attributes.description: Technical method used to transmit the submission file to CMS systems.

attributes.name: cms_acknowledgment_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Acknowledgment Date
attributes.description: Date when CMS acknowledged receipt of the submission file.

attributes.name: cms_acknowledgment_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Acknowledgment Number
attributes.description: Unique tracking number assigned by CMS upon receipt of the submission file.

attributes.name: cms_processing_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Processing Date
attributes.description: Date when CMS completed processing and validation of the submitted risk adjustment data.

attributes.name: accepted_record_count
attributes.description: Number of records from the submission that were accepted by CMS and will be used for risk score calculation.

attributes.name: rejected_record_count
attributes.description: Number of records from the submission that were rejected by CMS due to validation errors or data quality issues.

attributes.name: acceptance_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of submitted records accepted by CMS, calculated as (accepted_record_count / record_count) * 100.

attributes.name: error_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the error report file returned by CMS detailing rejected records and validation failures.

attributes.name: error_file_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the CMS error report file was received and available for review.

attributes.name: primary_error_category
attributes.description: Most common category of errors identified by CMS in rejected records from this submission.

attributes.name: resubmission_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether rejected records require correction and resubmission to CMS.

attributes.name: resubmission_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final date by which corrected records must be resubmitted to CMS to be included in the measurement year risk scores.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary source system or process from which the risk adjustment diagnoses were captured.

attributes.name: chart_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this submission includes diagnoses captured through retrospective chart review activities.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Requirements

attributes.name: supplemental_data_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this submission contains supplemental diagnosis data beyond standard claims and encounters.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Supplemental Data Policy

attributes.name: submission_window
attributes.description: Designated CMS submission period during which this file was transmitted (initial, mid-year, final, or sweep).

attributes.name: risk_model_version
attributes.description: Version of the CMS HCC risk adjustment model applicable to this submission year (e.g., V24, V28).

attributes.name: submission_priority
attributes.description: Internal priority level assigned to the submission based on deadline proximity or business criticality.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of internal pre-submission validation checks performed before transmitting to CMS.

attributes.name: validation_error_count
attributes.description: Number of validation errors identified during internal pre-submission quality checks.

attributes.name: validation_warning_count
attributes.description: Number of validation warnings identified during internal pre-submission quality checks that did not prevent submission.

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the submission file in bytes.

attributes.name: file_checksum
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash value (e.g., MD5, SHA-256) of the submission file used to verify data integrity during transmission.

attributes.name: submitter_organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization submitting the risk adjustment data (typically Healthcare or a delegated entity).

attributes.name: submitter_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual responsible for the submission at the submitting organization.

attributes.name: submitter_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the individual responsible for the submission.

attributes.name: submitter_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the individual responsible for the submission.

attributes.name: cms_response_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Response Code
attributes.description: Standardized code returned by CMS indicating the overall processing result of the submission.

attributes.name: cms_response_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Response Description
attributes.description: Detailed text description of the CMS processing result and any issues encountered.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of internal reconciliation between submitted data and CMS acceptance reports.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when reconciliation between submitted data and CMS acceptance reports was completed.

attributes.name: discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies identified during reconciliation between internal records and CMS acceptance reports.

attributes.name: estimated_raf_impact
attributes.description: Estimated aggregate RAF score impact from the diagnoses included in this submission.

attributes.name: estimated_revenue_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact in dollars from the risk scores generated by this submission.

attributes.name: delete_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this submission contains delete transactions to remove previously submitted diagnoses from CMS records.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Delete Transaction Requirements

attributes.name: correction_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this submission corrects or replaces data from a previous submission.

attributes.name: original_submission_id

attributes.name: audit_flag

attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Requirements

attributes.name: audit_sample_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether records from this submission were included in a CMS RADV audit sample.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Requirements

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes, special handling instructions, or submission-specific context.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the submission record was initially created in the internal system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the submission record was last updated in the internal system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the submission record was last updated in the internal system.

attributes.name: coverage_id

attributes.name: product_plan_id

attributes.name: program_eligibility_id

Used daily in risk adjustment

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id

attributes.name: contract_id

attributes.name: audit_finding_id

attributes.name: raps_submission_id

attributes.description: Unique identifier for each RAPS submission record sent to CMS for Medicare Advantage risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: submission_file_name

attributes.name: submission_date

attributes.name: submission_timestamp

attributes.name: submission_type

attributes.name: submission_status

attributes.name: payment_year

attributes.name: data_collection_period_start_date

attributes.name: file_checksum
