attributes.name: edps_submission_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Encounter Data Processing System (EDPS) Submission ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each EDPS submission record sent to CMS for Medicare Advantage risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: submission_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the EDPS file submitted to CMS, following CMS naming conventions for encounter data files.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the EDPS file was submitted to CMS for processing.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the EDPS file was transmitted to CMS systems.

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Type of EDPS submission indicating whether this is an initial submission, replacement, deletion, or void of previously submitted encounter data.

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the EDPS submission as reported by CMS systems.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: CMS-assigned contract number for the Medicare Advantage plan associated with this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: CMS Plan Benefit Package identifier specifying the specific MA plan benefit design for encounters in this submission.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which risk adjustment payments will be calculated based on the encounter data in this submission.

attributes.name: service_year
attributes.description: Calendar year during which the healthcare services documented in this EDPS submission were provided to members.

attributes.name: data_period_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the service period covered by encounters included in this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: data_period_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the service period covered by encounters included in this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: submission_batch_id
attributes.description: Internal batch identifier used to group and track EDPS submissions processed together within Healthcare systems.

attributes.name: total_encounter_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual encounter records included in this EDPS submission file.

attributes.name: accepted_encounter_count
attributes.description: Number of encounter records from this submission that were accepted by CMS EDPS processing.

attributes.name: rejected_encounter_count
attributes.description: Number of encounter records from this submission that were rejected by CMS EDPS processing due to validation errors.

attributes.name: total_diagnosis_count
attributes.description: Total number of diagnosis codes submitted across all encounters in this EDPS file for risk adjustment consideration.

attributes.name: hcc_eligible_diagnosis_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Eligible Diagnosis Count
attributes.description: Number of diagnosis codes in this submission that map to valid HCC categories for risk score calculation.

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the EDPS submission file in bytes, used for transmission validation and capacity planning.

attributes.name: file_format_version
attributes.description: Version number of the CMS EDPS file format specification used for this submission.
attributes.references: CMS EDPS File Layout Version Control

attributes.name: transmission_method
attributes.description: Technical method used to transmit the EDPS file to CMS systems.

attributes.name: cms_acknowledgment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Acknowledgment ID
attributes.description: Unique acknowledgment identifier returned by CMS upon receipt of the EDPS submission file.

attributes.name: cms_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date when CMS acknowledged receipt of the EDPS submission file.

attributes.name: cms_processing_date
attributes.description: Date when CMS completed processing and validation of the EDPS submission file.

attributes.name: cms_response_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the response file returned by CMS containing acceptance/rejection details for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: cms_response_received_date
attributes.description: Date when Healthcare received the CMS response file for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: validation_error_count
attributes.description: Total number of validation errors identified by CMS in this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: validation_warning_count
attributes.description: Total number of validation warnings identified by CMS in this EDPS submission that did not result in rejection.

attributes.name: submission_window
attributes.description: CMS-defined submission window period during which this EDPS file was submitted (initial, mid-year, final, or sweep).

attributes.name: submission_deadline_date
attributes.description: CMS deadline date by which this EDPS submission must be completed for the applicable submission window.

attributes.name: is_timely_submitted
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this EDPS submission was completed before the CMS deadline for the applicable submission window.

attributes.name: resubmission_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this submission is a resubmission of previously rejected or corrected encounter data.

attributes.name: original_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original EDPS submission ID if this is a resubmission or correction of previously submitted data.

attributes.name: submission_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the internal Healthcare system that generated and prepared this EDPS submission file.

attributes.name: data_extraction_date
attributes.description: Date when encounter data was extracted from source systems to prepare this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: file_generation_date
attributes.description: Date when the EDPS submission file was generated and prepared for transmission to CMS.

attributes.name: submitter_organization_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the Healthcare organization entity submitting this EDPS file to CMS.

attributes.name: submitter_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person responsible for this EDPS submission at Healthcare.

attributes.name: submitter_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: submitter_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_model_version
attributes.description: Version of the CMS HCC risk adjustment model applicable to the payment year for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: encounter_data_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare encounter data included in this EDPS submission (professional, institutional, pharmacy, or durable medical equipment).

attributes.name: total_member_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique Medicare Advantage members represented in the encounters within this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: total_provider_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique healthcare providers represented in the encounters within this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: checksum_value
attributes.description: Cryptographic checksum or hash value of the EDPS submission file used to verify file integrity during transmission.

attributes.name: encryption_method
attributes.description: Encryption method used to secure the EDPS submission file during transmission to CMS.

attributes.name: compression_method
attributes.description: Compression method applied to the EDPS submission file before transmission.

attributes.name: test_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a test submission to CMS EDPS systems rather than a production submission.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of internal reconciliation between submitted encounter data and CMS response for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when reconciliation was completed between submitted encounter data and CMS response for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies identified during reconciliation between submitted data and CMS response for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicator of whether corrective action and resubmission are required based on CMS response for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which corrective action must be completed and data resubmitted for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: submission_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, issues, or context related to this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: cms_feedback_summary
attributes.description: Summary of key feedback, errors, or issues reported by CMS in response to this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: projected_raf_impact
attributes.description: Estimated impact on overall plan Risk Adjustment Factor score from diagnoses included in this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: estimated_payment_impact
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact in dollars on Medicare Advantage payments resulting from this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Internal quality score assigned to this EDPS submission based on completeness, accuracy, and acceptance rate.

attributes.name: data_completeness_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of required data elements that were populated in this EDPS submission file.

attributes.name: acceptance_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of encounter records from this submission that were accepted by CMS without errors.

attributes.name: submission_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this EDPS submission for processing and monitoring purposes.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times this EDPS submission has been retried due to transmission failures or technical issues.

attributes.name: last_retry_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent retry attempt for this EDPS submission.

attributes.name: archived_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this EDPS submission has been archived for long-term retention.

attributes.name: archive_date
attributes.description: Date when this EDPS submission was moved to archived storage.

attributes.name: retention_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this EDPS submission record is eligible for deletion based on data retention policies.

attributes.name: model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.model_version. Business justification: edps_submission stores risk_adjustment_model_version as STRING. Adding FK to model_version reference table establishes authoritative link to the CMS model version used for EDPS submission. No columns

attributes.name: adjustment_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_adjustment_submission. Business justification: edps_submission is a specialized type of risk adjustment submission. Adding FK to parent risk_adjustment_submission table establishes submission hierarchy and allows unified tracking of all submission

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to eligibility.coverage. Business justification: EDPS (Encounter Data Processing System) submissions require validated coverage and benefit package information for ACA risk adjustment. Coverage gaps invalidate diagnosis submissions.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: EDPS encounter submissions must identify the specific Medicare Advantage plan. CMS processes risk adjustment based on plan-level enrollment and diagnosis data submitted via EDPS.

attributes.name: program_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_eligibility. Business justification: EDPS (Encounter Data Processing System) submissions require program eligibility context to submit encounter data to CMS for Medicare Advantage risk adjustment and payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: alert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.alert. Business justification: EDPS submission errors generate alerts for data quality issues or CMS rejections. Operations teams use alerts to track and resolve submission problems before deadlines.

products.name: chart_review
products.description: Operational record of chart review activities performed to validate HCC coding and resolve discrepancies.

attributes.name: chart_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chart review activity record.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Standards

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member whose medical chart is being reviewed.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: CMS-assigned contract identifier for the Medicare Advantage plan under which the member is enrolled.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which risk adjustment payment is being calculated and validated.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the chart review activity indicating the purpose and scope of the review.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the chart review activity in the workflow lifecycle.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chart review activity is scheduled to be performed.

attributes.name: started_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the chart review activity was initiated by the reviewer.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the chart review activity was completed and finalized.

attributes.name: team_member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical coder or physician who performed the chart review.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the clinical coder or physician who performed the chart review.

attributes.name: reviewer_credential
attributes.description: Professional certification or credential held by the reviewer (e.g., Certified Professional Coder, Certified Coding Specialist, Medical Doctor).

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Internal identifier for the healthcare provider whose medical records are being reviewed.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to the healthcare provider whose records are under review.

attributes.name: provider_tin
attributes.description: The Tax Identification Number of the provider organization whose medical records are being reviewed.

attributes.name: service_from_date
attributes.description: The start date of the service period for which medical records are being reviewed.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: service_to_date
attributes.description: The end date of the service period for which medical records are being reviewed.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: encounter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific healthcare encounter or visit being reviewed.

attributes.name: encounter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the healthcare encounter setting where services were rendered.

attributes.name: chart_source
attributes.description: The format or medium from which the medical chart was obtained for review.

attributes.name: chart_retrieval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical chart was retrieved from the provider or medical records system.

attributes.name: chart_pages_reviewed
attributes.description: The total number of pages in the medical chart that were reviewed during the chart review activity.

attributes.name: original_hcc_count
attributes.description: The number of HCC codes originally submitted for the member prior to the chart review.

attributes.name: validated_hcc_count
attributes.description: The number of HCC codes validated and confirmed as supported by medical record documentation after the chart review.

attributes.name: added_hcc_count
attributes.description: The number of new HCC codes identified and added as a result of the chart review that were not originally submitted.

attributes.name: deleted_hcc_count
attributes.description: The number of originally submitted HCC codes that were invalidated and removed as a result of the chart review due to insufficient documentation.

attributes.name: original_raf_score
attributes.description: The member's risk adjustment factor score prior to the chart review, used to calculate Medicare Advantage capitation payments.

attributes.name: validated_raf_score
attributes.description: The member's risk adjustment factor score after the chart review validation, reflecting only HCCs supported by medical documentation.

attributes.name: raf_score_variance
attributes.description: The difference between the original RAF score and the validated RAF score, indicating the impact of the chart review on risk score.

attributes.name: discrepancy_found_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether any discrepancies were identified between originally submitted HCC codes and medical record documentation.

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of discrepancy identified during the chart review process.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: discrepancy_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the discrepancy identified during the chart review, including specific documentation issues.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether an appeal has been filed in response to the chart review findings.

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: The date on which an appeal was filed in response to the chart review findings.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the appeal filed in response to the chart review findings.

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeal was resolved with a final determination.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Quality assessment score assigned to the chart review based on completeness, accuracy, and adherence to coding guidelines, typically expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: audit_sample_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this chart review was selected as part of a CMS RADV audit sample.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: radv_audit_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Year
attributes.description: The year in which the CMS RADV audit was conducted for which this chart review was performed.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: The system through which risk adjustment data was submitted to CMS (RAPS for Risk Adjustment Processing System, EDPS for Encounter Data Processing System, EDE for Encounter Data Exchange).

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original risk adjustment data was submitted to CMS prior to the chart review.

attributes.name: resubmission_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether risk adjustment data must be resubmitted to CMS based on the chart review findings.

attributes.name: resubmission_date
attributes.description: The date on which corrected risk adjustment data was resubmitted to CMS following the chart review.

attributes.name: payment_impact_amount
attributes.description: The estimated financial impact on Medicare Advantage capitation payments resulting from the chart review findings, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: review_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total time in minutes spent conducting the chart review activity from start to completion.

attributes.name: coding_guidelines_version
attributes.description: The version of ICD-10-CM coding guidelines and CMS HCC model used during the chart review.
attributes.references: CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and observations documented by the reviewer during the chart review process.

attributes.name: supervisor_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the chart review findings require secondary review and approval by a supervisor or senior coder.

attributes.name: supervisor_team_member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supervisor who performed secondary review of the chart review findings.

attributes.name: supervisor_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supervisor approved the chart review findings.

attributes.name: education_opportunity_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the chart review findings identified an opportunity for provider education on documentation or coding practices.

attributes.name: education_topic

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system or application from which the chart review record was captured.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart review record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart review record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: reviewer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical coder or physician who performed the chart review.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Internal identifier for the healthcare provider whose medical records are being reviewed.

attributes.name: supervisor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supervisor who performed secondary review of the chart review findings.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.data_quality_issue. products.name: payment
products.description: Transactional record of risk-adjusted payment amounts received from CMS for each contract/plan year.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each risk-adjusted payment transaction record received from CMS.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Three-digit CMS identifier for the specific benefit package within the contract.

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the risk-adjusted payment applies.

attributes.name: month
attributes.description: Month within the payment year for which the risk-adjusted payment was received (1-12).

attributes.name: hicn
attributes.description: Medicare beneficiary identifier used for payment reconciliation (being replaced by MBI).

attributes.name: mbi
attributes.description: New Medicare beneficiary identifier replacing HICN, used for payment reconciliation.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act (MACRA)

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Internal plan member identifier linking the payment to the enrolled beneficiary.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Member enrollment status at the time of payment calculation.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the risk-adjusted payment transaction (e.g., monthly capitation, retroactive adjustment, reconciliation).

attributes.name: raf_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score for the member reflecting expected healthcare costs relative to average beneficiary.
attributes.references: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: community_raf_score
attributes.description: RAF score component for community-dwelling (non-institutionalized) beneficiaries.

attributes.name: institutional_raf_score
attributes.description: RAF score component for institutionalized beneficiaries (nursing home residents).

attributes.name: esrd_raf_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: End Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) Score
attributes.description: RAF score component for beneficiaries with End Stage Renal Disease.

attributes.name: normalization_factor
attributes.description: CMS-applied factor to normalize risk scores and ensure budget neutrality across the program.

attributes.name: coding_intensity_adjustment
attributes.description: CMS adjustment factor applied to account for differences in diagnostic coding practices between MA and Fee-for-Service.

attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: CMS county-level base payment rate before risk adjustment, reflecting local healthcare costs.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the county for payment rate determination.

attributes.name: demographic_factor
attributes.description: Risk score component based on member age, gender, and Medicaid eligibility status.

attributes.name: disease_factor
attributes.description: Risk score component based on diagnosed Hierarchical Condition Categories (HCCs).

attributes.name: base_payment_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount before risk adjustment (base rate only).

attributes.name: risk_adjusted_amount
attributes.description: Incremental payment amount attributable to risk adjustment (RAF score application).

attributes.name: part_a_payment
attributes.description: Portion of payment attributable to Medicare Part A (hospital insurance) benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part A Payment Rules

attributes.name: part_b_payment
attributes.description: Portion of payment attributable to Medicare Part B (medical insurance) benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part B Payment Rules

attributes.name: part_d_payment
attributes.description: Portion of payment attributable to Medicare Part D (prescription drug) benefits if applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Payment Rules

attributes.name: rebate_amount
attributes.description: Rebate amount earned by the plan based on bid performance relative to benchmark.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Bidding and Rebate Rules

attributes.name: quality_bonus_amount
attributes.description: Additional payment amount earned through CMS Star Ratings quality bonus program.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings and Quality Bonus Payment

attributes.name: sequestration_amount
attributes.description: Payment reduction amount applied due to federal budget sequestration requirements.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net adjustment amount for retroactive corrections, reconciliations, or payment disputes.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Final net payment amount after all adjustments, rebates, and deductions.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: CMS HCC risk adjustment model version used for payment calculation (e.g., V24, V28).
attributes.references: CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model Documentation

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system for diagnosis data used in risk score calculation: RAPS (Risk Adjustment Processing System) or EDPS (Encounter Data Processing System).
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Submission Requirements

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Type of data submission that generated the payment (initial, correction, deletion, replacement).
attributes.references: CMS RAPS and EDPS Submission Guidelines

attributes.name: diagnosis_data_year
attributes.description: Year from which diagnosis data was collected for risk score calculation.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Collection Period

attributes.name: hcc_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct HCCs identified for the member contributing to the risk score.

attributes.name: dual_eligibility_status
attributes.description: Member eligibility status for both Medicare and Medicaid benefits (full dual, partial dual, non-dual).

attributes.name: medicaid_status_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code indicating the member's Medicaid eligibility status for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: original_reason_entitlement_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the original reason for Medicare entitlement (0=OASDI, 1=DIB, 2=ESRD, 3=Both DIB and ESRD).

attributes.name: age_group
attributes.description: Member age group category used in demographic risk adjustment.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Member gender used in demographic risk adjustment.

attributes.name: disabled_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the member is entitled to Medicare due to disability.

attributes.name: hospice_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the member was enrolled in hospice during the payment period.

attributes.name: institutional_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the member resided in a long-term care institution during the payment period.

attributes.name: new_enrollee_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the member is a new enrollee with insufficient diagnosis history for full risk adjustment.

attributes.name: months_enrolled
attributes.description: Number of months the member was enrolled in the plan during the payment year.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Stage of payment reconciliation process (preliminary, interim, final, reopened).

attributes.name: reconciliation_year
attributes.description: Year in which payment reconciliation was performed for this payment record.

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this payment record has been flagged for CMS audit or RADV review.

products.name: rule
products.description: Reference definition of business rules governing HCC eligibility, grouping, and RAF factor application.

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk adjustment rule definition. Primary key for the risk rule reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique business code identifying the risk adjustment rule. Used for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the risk adjustment rule for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the risk adjustment rule logic, including conditions, eligibility criteria, and application scope.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the risk adjustment rule indicating its functional purpose within the risk adjustment processing workflow.

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: The specific HCC code that this rule applies to or generates. HCCs are condition categories used in CMS risk adjustment models to predict healthcare costs.

attributes.name: hcc_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the HCC condition category associated with this rule.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The CMS risk adjustment model version that this rule belongs to (e.g., V24, V28). Different model versions have different HCC structures and RAF coefficients.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this risk adjustment rule is applicable. CMS updates risk models annually.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: The year in which risk-adjusted payments based on this rule will be made. Typically follows the data collection year.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The insurance product line to which this risk adjustment rule applies. Different LOBs may use different risk models.

attributes.name: population_segment
attributes.description: The member population segment to which this rule applies. CMS uses different risk models for different population segments.

attributes.name: raf_coefficient
attributes.description: The numeric coefficient value applied in RAF score calculation for this rule. Represents the relative cost weight for the condition or demographic factor.

attributes.name: coefficient_type
attributes.description: Classification of the RAF coefficient indicating whether it represents a disease burden, demographic factor, interaction term, or payment adjustment.

attributes.name: icd10_code_pattern
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Code Pattern
attributes.description: The ICD-10 diagnosis code or code range pattern that triggers this risk adjustment rule. May include wildcards for code ranges.

attributes.name: diagnosis_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this diagnosis within the HCC hierarchy. Higher severity diagnoses supersede lower severity diagnoses in the same hierarchy.

attributes.name: superseding_hcc_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of HCC codes that supersede this HCC in the diagnosis hierarchy. Used to prevent double-counting of related conditions.

attributes.name: interaction_hcc_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of HCC codes that must co-occur for this interaction rule to apply. Interaction terms capture additional risk from multiple conditions.

attributes.name: age_range_min
attributes.description: The minimum age (in years) for which this risk adjustment rule is applicable. Used for age-specific risk factors.

attributes.name: age_range_max
attributes.description: The maximum age (in years) for which this risk adjustment rule is applicable. Used for age-specific risk factors.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The gender to which this risk adjustment rule applies. Some demographic factors are gender-specific.

attributes.name: medicaid_status
attributes.description: The Medicaid eligibility status to which this rule applies. Dual-eligible members may have different risk factors.

attributes.name: originally_disabled_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule applies to members who originally qualified for Medicare due to disability. Used for demographic risk factors.

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS) / Encounter Data Processing System (EDPS) Submission Type
attributes.description: Indicates which CMS submission system this rule applies to. RAPS is legacy, EDPS is the current encounter-based system.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System Documentation

attributes.name: data_source_type
attributes.description: The type of data source from which diagnoses for this rule can be captured. Chart reviews may identify additional diagnoses not in claims.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: The category of healthcare service from which diagnoses for this rule can be captured. Some diagnoses are only valid from specific service types.

attributes.name: diagnosis_position_requirement
attributes.description: Specifies whether the diagnosis must appear in a specific position on the claim (primary, secondary, or any) to qualify for this rule.

attributes.name: minimum_diagnosis_count
attributes.description: The minimum number of times a diagnosis must appear during the data collection period for this rule to apply. Used to ensure diagnosis validity.

attributes.name: lookback_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months to look back for diagnosis history when evaluating this rule. Used for chronic condition validation.

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Text description of conditions or circumstances that would exclude a member or diagnosis from this rule, even if other criteria are met.

attributes.name: inclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Text description of conditions or circumstances that must be present for this rule to apply to a member or diagnosis.

attributes.name: validation_rule_logic
attributes.description: Detailed technical specification of the validation logic applied to determine if this rule should be triggered. May include complex conditional expressions.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the order in which this rule should be evaluated when multiple rules could apply. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the risk adjustment rule. Only active rules are applied in production risk score calculations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk adjustment rule becomes effective and should begin being applied in risk score calculations.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk adjustment rule is no longer effective and should cease being applied. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: cms_announcement_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Announcement Date
attributes.description: The date on which CMS officially announced or published this risk adjustment rule or model change.

attributes.name: cms_final_rule_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Final Rule Reference
attributes.description: Citation reference to the CMS final rule document that established or modified this risk adjustment rule.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The government entity or regulatory body that has authority over this risk adjustment rule.

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule is subject to special audit scrutiny or validation requirements due to high payment impact or fraud risk.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Program

attributes.name: radv_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether diagnoses captured under this rule are eligible for inclusion in CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation audits.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Program

attributes.name: chart_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical chart documentation review is required to validate diagnoses captured under this rule.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Program

attributes.name: documentation_requirements
attributes.description: Detailed description of the medical documentation required to support diagnoses captured under this rule for audit purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Program

attributes.name: payment_impact_category
attributes.description: Classification of the financial impact this rule has on risk-adjusted payments. High-impact rules receive additional scrutiny.

attributes.name: estimated_pmpm_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Per Member Per Month (PMPM) Impact
attributes.description: The estimated average per member per month payment impact when this rule is triggered. Used for financial forecasting and analysis.

attributes.name: prevalence_rate
attributes.description: The expected prevalence rate of this condition or rule trigger in the member population, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0523 for 5.23%).

attributes.name: coding_intensity_factor
attributes.description: Adjustment factor applied to account for differences in diagnosis coding practices across plans. Used in risk score normalization.

attributes.name: normalization_factor
attributes.description: Factor applied to normalize risk scores across different model versions or population segments to ensure budget neutrality.

attributes.name: quality_measure_alignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of HEDIS or Star Ratings measures that are related to or impacted by this risk adjustment rule.
attributes.references: HEDIS and CMS Star Ratings Program

attributes.name: clinical_specialty
attributes.description: The medical specialty most commonly associated with diagnosing or treating conditions covered by this rule. Used for provider education.

attributes.name: disease_category
attributes.description: High-level clinical disease category for conditions covered by this rule. Used for clinical reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule applies to chronic conditions that persist across multiple years versus acute conditions.

attributes.name: recapture_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether diagnoses under this rule are eligible for recapture in subsequent years if the condition persists but is not re-documented.

attributes.name: suspecting_logic
attributes.description: Description of the logic used to identify members who may have this condition but lack current year diagnosis documentation. Used for gap closure programs.

attributes.name: gap_closure_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for targeting members with suspected but undocumented conditions covered by this rule in gap closure outreach programs.

attributes.name: provider_education_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule requires special provider education due to complexity, frequent coding errors, or high audit risk.

attributes.name: coding_guidance_url
attributes.description: URL link to detailed coding guidance, documentation requirements, or educational materials for this risk adjustment rule.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this rule definition. Incremented when rule logic, coefficients, or criteria are modified.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the most recent change to this rule, including regulatory updates, model recalibration, or error corrections.

attributes.name: predecessor_rule_code
attributes.description: The rule code of the previous version of this rule that this version replaces or supersedes. Used for historical tracking.

attributes.name: successor_rule_code
attributes.description: The rule code of the next version of this rule that will replace this version. Used for transition planning.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rule definition was last reviewed and validated for accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next review and validation of this rule definition to ensure continued accuracy and compliance.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: The internal department or team responsible for maintaining and updating this risk adjustment rule definition.

attributes.name: subject_matter_expert
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the subject matter expert responsible for clinical or technical guidance on this risk adjustment rule.

attributes.name: model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.model_version. Business justification: risk_rule stores model_version as STRING. Adding FK to model_version reference table establishes authoritative link to the CMS model version for which this rule applies. No columns to remove as model_

products.name: model_version

attributes.name: model_version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each version of the CMS risk adjustment model. Primary key for the model version reference table.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this risk adjustment model version is applicable. Represents the payment year for Medicare Advantage risk-based payments.

attributes.name: model_type
attributes.description: The type of risk adjustment model. Indicates which CMS risk adjustment methodology is used for calculating risk scores and payments.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The specific version identifier assigned by CMS to this model release. May include major and minor version designations.

attributes.name: version_name
attributes.description: The descriptive name or label for this model version, often including the year and model type for easy reference.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this model version becomes active and should be used for risk score calculations and payment determinations.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when this model version is no longer active and is superseded by a newer version. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current operational status of this model version. Indicates whether the model is currently in use, has been retired, or is pending implementation.

attributes.name: cms_publication_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Publication Date
attributes.description: The date when CMS officially published or released this model version to the public and health plans.

attributes.name: cms_announcement_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Announcement Number
attributes.description: The official CMS announcement or memorandum number associated with the release of this model version.

attributes.name: rate_announcement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the CMS Rate Announcement document that contains the payment parameters and coefficients for this model version.

attributes.name: hcc_count
attributes.description: The total number of HCC categories defined in this model version. Represents the complete set of condition categories used for risk scoring.

attributes.name: diagnosis_mapping_version

attributes.name: icd_version

attributes.name: disease_interaction_flag

attributes.name: disabled_model_segment_flag

attributes.name: esrd_model_segment_flag

attributes.name: institutional_model_segment_flag

attributes.name: new_enrollee_model_flag

attributes.name: partial_year_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version includes adjustments for members enrolled for less than a full year.

attributes.name: frailty_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version includes frailty indicators or adjustments for institutionalized or frail beneficiaries.

attributes.name: prescription_drug_model_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version includes RxHCC categories for Medicare Part D prescription drug risk adjustment.

attributes.name: software_version
attributes.description: The version identifier for the CMS risk adjustment software or calculation engine that implements this model version.

attributes.name: coefficient_file_name
attributes.description: The name of the coefficient file containing the risk weights and parameters for this model version. Used for risk score calculation.

attributes.name: coefficient_file_location
attributes.description: The storage location or path where the coefficient file for this model version is maintained.

attributes.name: mapping_file_name
attributes.description: The name of the ICD-10 to HCC mapping file used by this model version for diagnosis code translation.

attributes.name: mapping_file_location
attributes.description: The storage location or path where the diagnosis mapping file for this model version is maintained.

attributes.name: documentation_url
attributes.description: The web address or link to the official CMS documentation for this model version, including technical specifications and user guides.

attributes.name: implementation_guide_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the implementation guide document that provides instructions for adopting and using this model version.

attributes.name: change_summary
attributes.description: A summary of the key changes and updates introduced in this model version compared to the previous version. Includes new HCCs, deleted HCCs, and coefficient changes.

attributes.name: major_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version represents a major revision with significant structural changes versus a minor update or recalibration.

attributes.name: recalibration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version includes recalibrated coefficients based on updated claims and cost data.

attributes.name: baseline_data_year
attributes.description: The year of the claims and cost data used to calibrate the coefficients in this model version.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: The validation status of this model version within the organization's risk adjustment system. Indicates whether the model has been tested and approved for production use.

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: The date when this model version was validated and approved for use in production risk adjustment calculations.

attributes.name: production_deployment_date
attributes.description: The date when this model version was deployed to the production risk adjustment processing environment.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date when this model version was retired from production use and replaced by a newer version.

attributes.name: raps_submission_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version is used for RAPS diagnosis submissions to CMS for risk adjustment payment.

attributes.name: edps_submission_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version is used for EDPS encounter data submissions to CMS for risk adjustment payment.

attributes.name: aca_model_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version is applicable to ACA marketplace plans and risk adjustment transfers.
attributes.references: CMS ACA Risk Adjustment Model Documentation

attributes.name: medicaid_model_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version is applicable to Medicaid managed care risk adjustment.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_model_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version includes specific adjustments or segments for dual eligible beneficiaries enrolled in both Medicare and Medicaid.

attributes.name: pace_model_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) Model Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version is applicable to PACE organizations serving frail elderly beneficiaries.

attributes.name: default_model_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the default model version to be used when no specific model version is specified for risk score calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this model version. May include implementation considerations or known issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this model version record was created in the system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this model version record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: plan_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_type. Business justification: CMS risk adjustment models vary by plan type (MA, PACE, ESRD). Model version must reference plan type as different HCC models apply to different product lines.

products.name: exception
products.description: Transactional record of exceptions (e.g., coding overrides, data quality issues) that affect risk score calculations.

attributes.name: exception_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk exception record. Primary key for tracking exceptions that affect risk score calculations in Medicare Advantage risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with this risk exception. Links to the member whose risk score calculation was affected by this exception.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: CMS-assigned five-character contract identifier for the Medicare Advantage or Part D plan under which this exception occurred.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Three-digit Plan Benefit Package identifier that specifies the specific benefit plan design within the contract.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which the risk adjustment payment applies. Risk scores calculated in one year determine payments for the following year.

attributes.name: service_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the medical services or diagnoses associated with this exception were provided or documented.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the exception that affected risk score calculation. Identifies the nature of the issue requiring manual intervention or override.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the exception. Tracks the exception through its lifecycle from identification to resolution.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity classification indicating the impact of the exception on risk score accuracy and financial implications. Critical exceptions require immediate attention.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The system, process, or activity that identified and generated this exception record. Indicates where in the risk adjustment workflow the exception was detected.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis code associated with this exception. The specific diagnosis that was subject to override, rejection, or other exception processing.

attributes.name: diagnosis_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the ICD-10 diagnosis code. Provides clinical context for the diagnosis involved in the exception.

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category code that maps from the diagnosis code. HCCs are used to calculate risk adjustment factor scores for payment.

attributes.name: hcc_description
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the HCC category. Provides clinical and business context for the condition category affected by this exception.

attributes.name: hcc_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight assigned to the HCC in the CMS risk adjustment model. Represents the relative cost impact of the condition on expected healthcare expenditures.

attributes.name: original_raf_score
attributes.description: The member's RAF score before the exception was applied. Baseline risk score used for comparison to measure the impact of the exception.

attributes.name: adjusted_raf_score
attributes.description: The member's RAF score after the exception was processed and applied. Reflects the corrected risk score following exception resolution.

attributes.name: raf_score_impact
attributes.description: The net change in RAF score resulting from this exception. Calculated as adjusted RAF score minus original RAF score. Positive values indicate score increases.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated dollar impact of the exception on risk-based payments. Calculated by multiplying RAF score impact by the applicable payment rate.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the healthcare claim associated with this exception. Links the exception to the source claim transaction that contained the diagnosis.

attributes.name: encounter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the healthcare encounter record associated with this exception. Used for Medicare Advantage encounter data submissions.

attributes.name: service_from_date
attributes.description: The start date of the medical service or encounter during which the diagnosis was documented. Used to determine the applicable service year for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: service_through_date
attributes.description: The end date of the medical service or encounter during which the diagnosis was documented. For single-day services, matches the service from date.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier for the healthcare provider who documented the diagnosis associated with this exception.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the healthcare provider or facility associated with the diagnosis documentation. Used for provider-level exception tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: provider_specialty
attributes.description: Medical specialty or taxonomy classification of the provider who documented the diagnosis. Used to analyze exception patterns by provider type.

attributes.name: provider_tin
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number for the provider organization. Used for provider identification and payment processing.

attributes.name: chart_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the medical chart review activity that generated or validated this exception. Links to retrospective chart review processes.

attributes.name: chart_review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the chart review activity that identified or validated this exception. Indicates the timing and purpose of the medical record review.

attributes.name: chart_review_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the chart review validation process. Indicates whether the diagnosis was supported by medical record documentation.

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Type of risk adjustment data submission affected by this exception. RAPS (Risk Adjustment Processing System) or EDPS (Encounter Data Processing System).

attributes.name: submission_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch submission to CMS that included the diagnosis data affected by this exception. Used for tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk adjustment data was submitted to CMS. Used to track submission timeliness and reconciliation periods.

attributes.name: cms_response_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Response Code
attributes.description: Response code returned by CMS for the risk adjustment data submission. Indicates acceptance, rejection, or error conditions.

attributes.name: cms_response_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Response Description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the CMS response code. Provides context for submission acceptance or rejection reasons.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for manual override of automated risk adjustment processing. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: override_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the override was necessary. Provides business justification for exception processing decisions.

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the automated validation rule that triggered this exception. Links to the specific business rule or edit check that detected the issue.

attributes.name: validation_rule_description
attributes.description: Description of the validation rule that identified this exception. Explains the business logic or compliance requirement that was violated.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: System-generated error code associated with the exception. Used for technical troubleshooting and error pattern analysis.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message describing the exception condition. Provides technical details for resolution and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: The action taken to resolve the exception. Documents how the exception was addressed in the risk adjustment workflow.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the resolution process and decision rationale. Provides audit trail and context for exception handling.

attributes.name: assigned_to_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the user or team member assigned to review and resolve this exception. Used for workload management and accountability.

attributes.name: assigned_to_user_name
attributes.description: Name of the user assigned to resolve this exception. Provides human-readable identification for workflow tracking.

attributes.name: assigned_to_team
attributes.description: Name of the team or department responsible for resolving this exception. Used for organizational workload distribution and reporting.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for exception resolution. Determines the order and urgency of exception processing in the work queue.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the exception must be resolved. Based on CMS submission deadlines and internal service level agreements.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that the exception has been escalated to management or specialized review. True when exception requires higher-level attention.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the exception was escalated. Used to track escalation timeliness and management involvement.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the exception required escalation. Documents the business justification for management review.

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that this exception is subject to audit review. True when the exception requires additional compliance validation or external audit.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit activity associated with this exception. Identifies the source and scope of audit review.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Date when the audit review was conducted. Used for audit tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: audit_finding
attributes.description: Summary of the audit finding related to this exception. Documents compliance issues or validation results from audit review.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that this exception has compliance implications. True when the exception relates to regulatory requirements or CMS guidelines.

attributes.name: compliance_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the compliance risk associated with this exception. Indicates potential regulatory or audit exposure.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that this exception is a recurring issue for the same member or provider. True when similar exceptions have occurred previously.

attributes.name: recurrence_count
attributes.description: Number of times a similar exception has occurred for the same member, provider, or diagnosis. Used to identify systemic issues.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the underlying cause of the exception. Used for trend analysis and process improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the root cause identified through exception analysis. Documents the underlying reason for the exception occurrence.

attributes.name: corrective_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken to prevent recurrence of similar exceptions. Documents process improvements or system changes.

attributes.name: preventive_action
attributes.description: Description of preventive measures implemented to avoid similar exceptions in the future. Documents proactive quality improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: documentation_link
attributes.description: URL or file path to supporting documentation for this exception. Links to medical records, audit reports, or other reference materials.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes about the exception. Provides supplementary context not captured in other structured fields.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception record was initially created in the system. Marks the beginning of the exception lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created the exception record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the exception record.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified the exception record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception was reviewed by an analyst or supervisor. Marks when the exception entered active review status.

attributes.name: reviewed_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who reviewed the exception. Used for quality assurance and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception resolution was approved. Marks formal acceptance of the exception handling decision.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the exception resolution. Used for authorization tracking and compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception was fully resolved and closed. Marks the completion of the exception lifecycle.

attributes.name: resolved_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who resolved and closed the exception. Used for productivity tracking and quality metrics.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception record was formally closed in the system. May differ from resolved timestamp if additional administrative steps are required.

attributes.name: closed_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who closed the exception record. Used for workflow completion tracking.

attributes.name: turnaround_time_hours
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in hours from exception creation to resolution. Used for service level agreement monitoring and process efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the exception was resolved within the defined service level agreement timeframe. True when SLA was met.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The Medicare product line associated with this exception. Identifies the specific type of Medicare plan affected by the risk adjustment exception.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version of the CMS HCC risk adjustment model used for this exception. CMS updates the model periodically with new diagnosis mappings and weights.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or data feed from which the diagnosis data originated. Identifies where the risk adjustment data was captured.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with this risk exception. Links to the member whose risk score calculation was affected by this exception.

attributes.name: validation_rule_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the automated validation rule that triggered this exception. Links to the specific business rule or edit check that detected the issue.

attributes.name: model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.model_version. Business justification: risk_exception stores model_version as STRING. Adding FK to model_version reference table establishes authoritative link to the CMS model version context for this exception. No columns to remove as mo

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.case. Business justification: Risk exceptions (coding errors, invalid HCCs, submission rejections) trigger case management workflows. Operations teams manage these cases through investigation and resolution processes.

attributes.name: compliance_exception_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_exception. Business justification: Risk adjustment exceptions (e.g., accepting diagnoses without proper documentation temporarily) require formal compliance exception approval with documented justification, approval workflow, and expir

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: Preferred language for broker communications and support. Supports multilingual broker engagement.

attributes.name: specialization
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of broker specializations or focus areas (e.g., Small Business, Large Group, Senior Market, Hispanic Market, Union Groups).

attributes.name: years_in_business
attributes.description: Number of years the broker has been operating in the insurance industry. Used for experience-based segmentation.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Number of employees working for the brokerage firm. Indicates agency size and capacity.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_range
attributes.description: Estimated annual revenue range for the brokerage firm. Used for broker segmentation and relationship management.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker has opted in to receive marketing communications, newsletters, and promotional materials from  health Care.

attributes.name: portal_access_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker has active access to  health Care broker portal systems for quoting, enrollment, and commission reporting.

attributes.name: portal_user_id
attributes.description: Unique user ID for the broker's access to  health Care broker portal systems.

attributes.name: last_login_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the broker's most recent login to  health Care broker portal systems. Used for engagement tracking.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score rating provided by the broker indicating satisfaction with  health Care partnership. Scale of -100 to 100.

attributes.name: last_survey_date
attributes.description: Date when the broker last completed a satisfaction or feedback survey.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score for the broker based on compliance history, complaint patterns, and fraud indicators. Used for monitoring and oversight.

attributes.name: complaint_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal complaints filed against the broker by members or regulators. Used for risk assessment.

attributes.name: last_complaint_date
