attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the broker relationship with  health Care. Determines eligibility for sales and commissions.

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason or explanation for the current broker status, especially for inactive, suspended, or terminated statuses.

attributes.name: status_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current broker status became effective.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the broker completed the onboarding process and became eligible to sell  health Care products.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the broker's most recent sales activity, enrollment submission, or system interaction. Used for engagement tracking.

attributes.name: record_created_date
attributes.description: Date when the broker record was originally created in  health Care systems.

attributes.name: record_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the broker record was last updated in  health Care systems.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the broker record originated (e.g., Salesforce Health Cloud, QNXT, Legacy Broker System).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the broker relationship.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_party. Business justification: Brokers are contractual parties with formal agreements defining commission structures, appointment status, and compliance obligations. Contracting and sales reference this for broker management and pa

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_record. Business justification: Health insurance brokers must complete mandatory compliance training (HIPAA, ACA, state regulations) annually. Sales operations verify broker certification status before allowing sales activities.

products.name: opportunity
products.description: Transactional record of a sales opportunity, tracking potential revenue, product interest, stage, probability, expected close date, and linked broker or sales rep.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales opportunity record.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the sales opportunity, typically including prospect organization name and product interest.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the opportunity based on the nature of the sales engagement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the opportunity record.

attributes.name: probability_percent
attributes.description: Estimated probability of winning the opportunity, expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Total estimated revenue value of the opportunity if won, typically representing annual premium or contract value.

attributes.name: expected_revenue
attributes.description: Probability-weighted revenue calculated as opportunity amount multiplied by win probability, used for pipeline forecasting.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Primary line of business or product category for the opportunity, indicating the insurance market segment.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Specific health plan product type being offered in the opportunity.

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the marketing campaign associated with the opportunity, if applicable.

attributes.name: expected_close_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the opportunity is expected to close, either won or lost.

attributes.name: actual_close_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the opportunity was closed, either won or lost.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Proposed or actual effective date when coverage would begin if the opportunity is won.

attributes.name: enrollment_period
attributes.description: Type of enrollment period during which the opportunity is being pursued, particularly relevant for Medicare and Marketplace sales.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the opportunity is expected to close or contribute revenue.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter in which the opportunity is expected to close.

attributes.name: group_size
attributes.description: Number of eligible employees or members in the prospect group, applicable for employer group sales.

attributes.name: estimated_member_count
attributes.description: Projected number of members who would enroll if the opportunity is won.

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: Proposed or quoted premium rate per member per month.

attributes.name: pepm_rate
attributes.description: Proposed or quoted premium rate per employee per month for group plans.

attributes.name: quote_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the formal quote or proposal associated with the opportunity.

attributes.name: quote_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal quote or proposal was generated and presented to the prospect.

attributes.name: quote_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the quote or proposal expires and is no longer valid.

attributes.name: proposal_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal proposal was submitted to the prospect for consideration.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the prospect is expected to make or has made their final decision.

attributes.name: next_step
attributes.description: Description of the next action or milestone required to advance the opportunity.

attributes.name: next_step_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next action or follow-up activity.

attributes.name: loss_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason why the opportunity was lost, if applicable.

attributes.name: loss_reason_detail
attributes.description: Additional details or notes explaining why the opportunity was lost.

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary competitor involved in the sales opportunity, if known.

attributes.name: win_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason why the opportunity was won, if applicable.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the opportunity, including prospect needs, requirements, and context.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the opportunity based on strategic importance, revenue potential, or urgency.

attributes.name: forecast_category
attributes.description: Sales forecast category indicating confidence level in closing the opportunity.

attributes.name: is_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity represents a renewal of an existing policy or contract.

attributes.name: is_competitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity involves competition from other carriers.

attributes.name: requires_underwriting
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity requires formal underwriting review and approval.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applicable to the opportunity for broker or agent compensation.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual commission amount payable if the opportunity is won.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the prospect is located or where coverage would be provided.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the prospect location.

attributes.name: industry_code
attributes.description: Standard industry classification code for the prospect organization, applicable for group sales.

attributes.name: industry_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the industry sector for the prospect organization.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit SIC code classifying the prospect organization's business activity.

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Length of the proposed contract term in months.

attributes.name: renewal_month
attributes.description: Month of the year when the contract would renew, represented as 1-12.

attributes.name: funding_type
attributes.description: Type of funding arrangement for the group plan.

attributes.name: minimum_participation_percent
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of eligible employees required to participate for group coverage.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of premium that the employer will contribute for group coverage.

attributes.name: includes_dental
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity includes dental coverage.

attributes.name: includes_vision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity includes vision coverage.

attributes.name: includes_pharmacy
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity includes pharmacy benefits.

attributes.name: includes_behavioral_health
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity includes behavioral health or mental health coverage.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Provider network tier or breadth being offered in the opportunity.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount for the proposed plan.

attributes.name: oop_max_amount
attributes.description: Maximum out-of-pocket amount for the proposed plan.

attributes.name: copay_primary_care
attributes.description: Copay amount for primary care physician visits in the proposed plan.

attributes.name: copay_specialist
attributes.description: Copay amount for specialist physician visits in the proposed plan.

attributes.name: coinsurance_percent
attributes.description: Coinsurance percentage for covered services in the proposed plan.

attributes.name: hsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proposed plan is HSA-eligible.

attributes.name: metallic_tier
attributes.description: ACA metallic tier classification for marketplace plans.

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: CMS Star Rating for Medicare Advantage plans, if applicable.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the opportunity record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the opportunity record was last modified.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sales activity or interaction related to the opportunity.

attributes.name: days_in_stage
attributes.description: Number of days the opportunity has been in its current sales stage.

attributes.name: age_days
attributes.description: Total number of days since the opportunity was created.

attributes.name: is_closed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity has been closed (won or lost).

attributes.name: is_won
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity was closed and won.

attributes.name: sales_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_channel. Business justification: Opportunity has channel (STRING) but needs FK to sales_channel reference table for standardized channel management and reporting.

attributes.name: lead_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.lead_source. Business justification: Opportunity has lead_source (STRING) but needs FK to lead_source reference table for lead attribution and ROI tracking.

attributes.name: stage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity_stage. Business justification: Opportunity has stage (STRING) but needs FK to opportunity_stage reference table for standardized stage definitions and probability mapping.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_region. Business justification: Opportunity has region and territory_code but needs FK to sales_region for hierarchical territory management and quota assignment.

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.product_catalog. Business justification: Opportunity references product offerings. FK to product_catalog enables product-specific opportunity tracking and plan details.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment_channel. Business justification: Sales opportunities track expected enrollment channel (direct, broker, exchange) for forecasting and channel strategy. Sales operations analyzes conversion rates by channel.

attributes.name: program_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_eligibility. Business justification: Sales opportunities for government programs track member eligibility status. Brokers verify Medicare/Medicaid eligibility before pursuing enrollment opportunities during AEP/OEP periods.

attributes.name: lead_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.lead. Business justification: Opportunities are created from qualified leads. Sales teams track lead-to-opportunity conversion to measure pipeline effectiveness and attribute revenue to marketing campaigns and lead sources.

products.name: quote
products.description: Transactional artifact representing a price quote generated for a prospect, including plan selection, premium calculations, discounts, and validity period.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quote record. Primary key for the quote entity.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique quote number displayed to prospects and brokers for reference and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the quote to track revisions and changes made to the original quote.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the quote in the sales lifecycle indicating its stage from creation to final disposition.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the quote indicating whether it is for new business, renewal of existing coverage, amendment to existing policy, or reinstatement.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business or market segment for which the quote is generated, such as Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace, or Individual.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The type of health insurance product being quoted, such as Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug (MA-PD), Prescription Drug Plan (PDP), Special Needs Plan (SNP), Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP), Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan (C-SNP), Institutional Special Needs Plan (I-SNP), or Qualified Health Plan (QHP).

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: The marketing name of the health plan being quoted to the prospect.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Internal system code uniquely identifying the health plan product in the benefits administration system.

attributes.name: metal_tier
attributes.description: The actuarial value tier of the plan as defined by the Affordable Care Act (ACA) for Marketplace plans, indicating the level of coverage (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, or Catastrophic).

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the health insurance coverage would become effective if the quote is accepted and converted to a policy.

attributes.name: coverage_termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the health insurance coverage would terminate, typically the end of the plan year or contract period.

attributes.name: generated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the quote was initially generated in the system.

attributes.name: generated_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the quote was generated in the system, including timezone information.

attributes.name: sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the quote was sent or delivered to the prospect or broker.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which the quote is no longer valid and cannot be accepted without regeneration or reapproval.

attributes.name: accepted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the prospect formally accepted the quote, triggering conversion to a policy or enrollment.

attributes.name: validity_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days from generation date during which the quote remains valid and can be accepted.

attributes.name: prospect_type
attributes.description: Classification of the prospect receiving the quote, such as individual consumer, employer group, or government entity.

attributes.name: group_size
attributes.description: The number of eligible employees or members in the group for group quotes, used for rating and underwriting purposes.

attributes.name: group_sic_code
attributes.description: The four-digit Standard Industrial Classification code representing the industry sector of the employer group, used for risk assessment and rating.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor SIC Manual

attributes.name: group_naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Group North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: The six-digit North American Industry Classification System code representing the industry sector of the employer group, used for risk assessment and rating.

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: The enrollment model for group coverage, indicating whether participation is voluntary, mandatory, contributory (employee pays portion), or non-contributory (employer pays all).

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: The financial arrangement for the health plan, such as fully insured, Administrative Services Only (ASO), level funded, or self-funded.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: The total premium amount quoted for the coverage period, including all tiers and members.

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which premium payments are due, such as monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, or annually.

attributes.name: employee_premium_amount
attributes.description: The premium amount for employee-only coverage tier.

attributes.name: employee_spouse_premium_amount
attributes.description: The premium amount for employee plus spouse coverage tier.

attributes.name: employee_children_premium_amount
attributes.description: The premium amount for employee plus children coverage tier.

attributes.name: family_premium_amount
attributes.description: The premium amount for family coverage tier including employee, spouse, and children.

attributes.name: individual_premium_amount
attributes.description: The premium amount for individual coverage in individual market quotes.

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: The premium rate calculated on a per member per month basis, commonly used in group and government program pricing.

attributes.name: pepm_rate
attributes.description: The premium rate calculated on a per employee per month basis, commonly used in employer group pricing.

attributes.name: deductible_individual
attributes.description: The annual deductible amount that an individual member must pay out-of-pocket before the plan begins to pay benefits.

attributes.name: deductible_family
attributes.description: The annual deductible amount that a family must collectively pay out-of-pocket before the plan begins to pay benefits.

attributes.name: oop_max_individual
attributes.description: The maximum amount an individual member will pay out-of-pocket for covered services in a plan year, after which the plan pays 100% of covered expenses.

attributes.name: oop_max_family
attributes.description: The maximum amount a family will collectively pay out-of-pocket for covered services in a plan year, after which the plan pays 100% of covered expenses.

attributes.name: copay_primary_care
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount a member pays for a primary care physician (PCP) office visit.

attributes.name: copay_specialist
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount a member pays for a specialist physician office visit.

attributes.name: copay_emergency_room
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount a member pays for an emergency room visit.

attributes.name: copay_urgent_care
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount a member pays for an urgent care facility visit.

attributes.name: copay_generic_drug
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount a member pays for a generic prescription drug.

attributes.name: copay_preferred_brand_drug
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount a member pays for a preferred brand prescription drug.

attributes.name: copay_non_preferred_brand_drug
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount a member pays for a non-preferred brand prescription drug.

attributes.name: coinsurance_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of covered medical expenses that the member is responsible for paying after the deductible is met.

attributes.name: hsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is eligible for pairing with a Health Savings Account (HSA) under IRS regulations.

attributes.name: hsa_employer_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Savings Account (HSA) Employer Contribution Amount
attributes.description: The amount the employer will contribute to the employee's Health Savings Account (HSA) if the plan is HSA-eligible.

attributes.name: hra_employer_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) Employer Contribution Amount
attributes.description: The amount the employer will contribute to the employee's Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA).

attributes.name: pcp_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan requires members to select a Primary Care Physician (PCP) for care coordination.

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan requires a referral from a Primary Care Physician (PCP) to see a specialist.

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan provides any coverage for services received from out-of-network providers.

attributes.name: prescription_drug_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes prescription drug coverage benefits.

attributes.name: dental_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes dental coverage benefits.

attributes.name: vision_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes vision coverage benefits.

attributes.name: wellness_program_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes access to wellness programs and preventive care services.

attributes.name: telemedicine_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes telemedicine or virtual care services.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of discount applied to the total premium for this quote.

attributes.name: discount_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or justification for applying a discount to the quote, such as multi-year commitment, large group size, or promotional campaign.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The percentage commission rate that will be paid to the broker or agent if the quote is accepted and converted to a policy.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of commission that will be paid to the broker or agent if the quote is accepted and converted to a policy.

attributes.name: underwriting_decision
attributes.description: The underwriting decision status for the quote, indicating whether it has been approved, declined, is pending review, or approved with conditions.

attributes.name: underwriting_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the underwriting team regarding risk assessment, conditions, or special considerations for the quote.

attributes.name: medical_underwriting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical underwriting and health questionnaires are required for this quote, typically applicable to certain individual and small group markets.

attributes.name: rate_guarantee_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which the quoted premium rates are guaranteed not to increase, commonly offered in group sales.

attributes.name: renewal_rate_cap_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum percentage by which premiums can increase at renewal, if a rate cap is included in the quote terms.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter U.S. state code where the coverage will be provided, critical for regulatory compliance and rate filing.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: The county name where the coverage will be provided, used for rating and network determination.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: The ZIP code where the coverage will be provided, used for rating, network determination, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: rating_area
attributes.description: The geographic rating area code used for premium calculation as defined by state insurance regulations and ACA requirements.

attributes.name: tobacco_use_surcharge_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tobacco use surcharge has been applied to the premium rates in accordance with ACA regulations.

attributes.name: tobacco_surcharge_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage surcharge applied to premiums for tobacco users, up to the maximum allowed by ACA regulations (typically 50%).

attributes.name: age_rating_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether age-based rating has been applied to the premium calculation in accordance with ACA 3:1 age rating rules.

attributes.name: composite_rating_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether composite rating (single blended rate for all members) has been applied instead of age-banded rating.

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days new employees must wait before becoming eligible for coverage under the group plan.

attributes.name: minimum_participation_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of eligible employees that must enroll in the plan for the group to qualify for coverage.

attributes.name: minimum_employer_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of premium that the employer must contribute for the group to qualify for coverage.

attributes.name: aca_subsidy_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual or family is eligible for premium tax credits or cost-sharing reductions under the Affordable Care Act (ACA).

attributes.name: medicare_enrollment_period
attributes.description: The type of Medicare enrollment period during which the quote was generated: Annual Enrollment Period (AEP), Open Enrollment Period (OEP), Initial Enrollment Period (IEP), or Special Enrollment Period (SEP).

attributes.name: special_enrollment_reason
attributes.description: The qualifying life event or reason that makes the prospect eligible for a Special Enrollment Period (SEP) outside of standard enrollment windows.

attributes.name: cobra_continuation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Continuation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quote is for COBRA continuation coverage for a former employee or dependent.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language in which the quote document and materials are provided to the prospect, using ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: The URL or file path where the generated quote document (PDF or other format) is stored for retrieval and distribution.

attributes.name: sbc_document_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Document URL
attributes.description: The URL or file path where the Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) document is stored, as required by ACA regulations.

attributes.name: proposal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments added by the sales representative regarding the proposal, special considerations, or prospect preferences.

attributes.name: competitor_comparison_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quote includes a comparison with competitor plans and pricing.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system or application that generated the quote, such as Salesforce, rating engine, or broker portal.

attributes.name: generated_by_user_id
attributes.description: The system user identifier of the sales representative, broker, or automated process that generated the quote.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: The system user identifier of the manager or underwriter who approved the quote for distribution.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the quote was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.broker. Business justification: Quote needs FK to broker master to link quotes to the broker who generated them for commission tracking and broker performance.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Quote is generated from opportunity. FK enables tracking quote-to-opportunity conversion and opportunity lifecycle.

attributes.name: sales_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_channel. Business justification: Quote has sales_channel (STRING) but needs FK to sales_channel reference table for channel-specific quote rules and reporting.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_region. Business justification: Quote has sales_region (STRING) but needs FK to sales_region for region-specific pricing rules and territory management.

attributes.name: network_affiliation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.network_affiliation. Business justification: Quotes must specify which provider network is included in the plan offering. Sales teams reference network affiliations daily when pricing and presenting plan options to prospects.

attributes.name: premium_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_rate. Business justification: Sales quotes must reference actual premium rate tables from billing to ensure quoted prices match billable rates. Prevents quote-to-bill discrepancies and ensures pricing accuracy at point of sale.

attributes.name: benefit_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.benefit_pharmacy. Business justification: Quotes include specific pharmacy benefit designs with formulary tiers and cost-sharing. Sales quotes pricing based on actual pharmacy benefit configurations that drive utilization and cost projections

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Quotes for group health plans must reference the employer agreement that defines available plan options, pricing structures, and negotiated rates. Underwriting uses this to generate accurate quotes.

attributes.name: plan_option_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.plan_option. Business justification: Quotes reference specific plan options from the enrollment system to ensure accurate pricing and benefits. Sales teams generate quotes using actual plan configurations.

attributes.name: hedis_score_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.hedis_score. Business justification: Large employer quotes often reference HEDIS scores to demonstrate network quality and clinical performance. Brokers use these scores to justify premium rates and differentiate Healthcare from co

attributes.name: member_risk_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.member_risk_profile. Business justification: Premium quotes are calculated based on member risk profiles. Sales teams use risk scores to generate accurate pricing for individual and group policies during sales process.

attributes.name: benefit_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.benefit_design. Business justification: Quotes for government program plans reference specific benefit designs. Sales generates quotes using standardized Medicare/Medicaid benefit configurations approved by regulators.

attributes.name: offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.offer. Business justification: Quotes must include marketing offers that prospects responded to. Sales applies offer terms (discounts, incentives) when generating premium quotes to honor marketing commitments.

attributes.name: privacy_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_notice. Business justification: HIPAA requires providing Notice of Privacy Practices before collecting protected health information during quoting. Sales must document which privacy notice version was presented to prospect.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.rate_schedule. Business justification: Quotes must reference approved rate schedules to calculate premiums accurately. Underwriting and sales teams use this to ensure regulatory compliance and pricing consistency across all quotes.

products.name: proposal
products.description: Transactional record of a formal sales proposal sent to a broker or employer, detailing plan benefits, pricing, and contractual terms.

attributes.name: proposal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales proposal record.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the proposal, used for tracking and reference in communications with brokers and employers.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the proposal, typically including employer name and plan year.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the proposal indicating whether it is for new business, renewal, amendment, quote only, or RFP response.

attributes.name: lob

attributes.description: Indicator of whether the subscriber is eligible for Medicare coverage.

attributes.name: medicare_number
attributes.description: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier number for subscribers enrolling in Medicare Advantage or Part D plans.

attributes.name: medicaid_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the subscriber is eligible for Medicaid coverage.

attributes.name: medicaid_id
attributes.description: State-issued Medicaid identification number for dual-eligible or Medicaid enrollments.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the subscriber is eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid coverage.

attributes.name: lis_level
attributes.description: Level of Low Income Subsidy assistance for Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage.

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the subscriber has End Stage Renal Disease affecting Medicare eligibility and plan options.

attributes.name: institutional_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the subscriber resides in an institutional setting such as a nursing home affecting Special Needs Plan eligibility.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the subscriber has qualifying chronic conditions for Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan enrollment.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code indicating the subscriber preferred language for communication.

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method of communication selected by the subscriber for plan correspondence.

attributes.name: paperless_enrollment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the subscriber opted for paperless electronic communications and documents.

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_signed_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Signed Indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the subscriber signed the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) authorization form.

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Date
attributes.description: Date when the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) authorization was signed.

attributes.name: consent_to_contact_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the subscriber provided consent to be contacted for marketing and outreach purposes.

attributes.name: electronic_signature_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the enrollment application was signed electronically.

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment application was signed by the subscriber.

attributes.name: application_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the completed enrollment application was received by the carrier.

attributes.name: underwriting_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of whether medical underwriting is required for this enrollment request.

attributes.name: underwriting_status
attributes.description: Current status of the medical underwriting process if required.

attributes.name: underwriting_decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the underwriting decision was made for the enrollment request.

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of eligibility verification process for the enrollment request.

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when eligibility verification was completed for the enrollment request.

attributes.name: marketplace_application_id
attributes.description: Unique application identifier from the Federally Facilitated Marketplace or State Based Marketplace for marketplace enrollments.

attributes.name: marketplace_type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance marketplace through which the enrollment was submitted including Federally Facilitated Marketplace (FFM) or State Based Marketplace (SBM).

attributes.name: qhp_id
attributes.description: Fourteen-digit Qualified Health Plan identifier assigned by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) for marketplace plans.

attributes.name: rating_area
attributes.description: Geographic rating area code used for premium calculation based on subscriber location.

attributes.name: household_income_amount
attributes.description: Annual household income amount used for subsidy eligibility determination.

attributes.name: household_size
attributes.description: Number of individuals in the household for subsidy eligibility calculation.

attributes.name: federal_poverty_level_percentage
attributes.description: Household income as a percentage of the Federal Poverty Level used for subsidy determination.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for rejection if the enrollment request was not approved.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason for rejection of the enrollment request.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment request was rejected.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment request was approved and accepted.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who approved the enrollment request.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment request processing was completed and member record was created.

attributes.name: member_id_assigned
attributes.description: Unique member identifier assigned to the subscriber upon successful enrollment completion.

attributes.name: policy_number_assigned
attributes.description: Policy number assigned to the enrollment upon successful completion.

attributes.name: group_policy_number
attributes.description: Master group policy number for employer-sponsored group enrollments.

attributes.name: edi_834_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier for the Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) 834 benefit enrollment transaction sent to the carrier system.

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or platform from which the enrollment request originated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the enrollment request for internal reference.

attributes.name: employer_group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employer group if this is a group enrollment request.

attributes.name: broker_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier for the broker or agent if applicable.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Enrollment_request originates from opportunity. FK enables tracking opportunity-to-enrollment conversion.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: Enrollment_request references quote. FK enables linking enrollment to quoted rates and plan details.

attributes.name: proposal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.proposal. Business justification: Enrollment_request references proposal. FK enables linking enrollment to accepted proposal.

attributes.name: sales_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_channel. Business justification: Enrollment_request has request_channel (STRING) but needs FK to sales_channel for channel-specific enrollment workflows.

attributes.name: lead_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.lead_source. Business justification: Enrollment_request needs FK to lead_source for lead-to-enrollment conversion tracking and marketing attribution.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_region. Business justification: Enrollment_request needs FK to sales_region for regional enrollment reporting and territory management.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Enrollment requests must establish or link to billing accounts before policy activation. Sales cannot complete enrollment without valid billing account setup for premium collection.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.care_plan. Business justification: Enrollment requests specify which care management program the member is enrolling into. Sales operations process enrollment requests that reference specific care plans like diabetes management or chro

attributes.name: benefit_pharmacy_id

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Member enrollment requests must link to the employer or group agreement that defines eligibility, coverage options, and enrollment rules. Enrollment processing validates against agreement terms daily.

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment. Business justification: Sales enrollment requests link to actual enrollment records once processed. Sales operations tracks fulfillment status and reconciles sold policies with active enrollments.

attributes.name: plan_option_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.plan_option. Business justification: Enrollment requests specify which plan option was sold. Underwriting and enrollment teams validate the requested plan matches product catalog and eligibility rules.

attributes.name: program_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_eligibility. Business justification: Enrollment requests for Medicare/Medicaid members must reference verified program eligibility. Sales operations validate eligibility before processing enrollment daily.

attributes.name: offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.offer. Business justification: Enrollment requests reference specific marketing offers (e.g., first month free, reduced premium). Sales must apply the correct offer terms during enrollment processing and premium calculation.

attributes.name: consent_form_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.consent_form. Business justification: Every enrollment requires signed consent forms (HIPAA authorization, scope of appointment, enrollment application). Sales cannot process enrollment without documented member consent per CMS regulation

attributes.name: eligibility_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.eligibility_rule. Business justification: Enrollment requests are validated against eligibility rules to determine coverage qualification. Enrollment teams apply these rules daily to approve/deny member additions based on employment status an

products.name: incentive_program
products.description: Reference table defining sales incentive programs, bonus structures, eligibility criteria, and performance periods.

attributes.name: incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales incentive program. Primary key for the incentive program entity.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the incentive program for reference and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the sales incentive program.

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the incentive program including objectives, target behaviors, and expected outcomes.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the incentive program structure (e.g., commission-based, bonus, special performance incentive fund, override, residual, accelerator, contest, recognition).

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business this incentive program applies to, such as Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace, Dual Eligible, Individual, or Group.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare and Medicaid Program Standards

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The health insurance product category targeted by this incentive program (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, Medicare Advantage, PDP, SNP, QHP, Supplemental).

attributes.name: participant_role
attributes.description: The sales role or position eligible to participate in this incentive program.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed criteria defining which sales personnel are eligible to participate in this incentive program, including tenure requirements, performance thresholds, territory assignments, or licensing requirements.

attributes.name: performance_metric
attributes.description: The primary performance metric used to measure achievement for this incentive program (enrollment count, premium volume, member retention, new group sales, cross-sell, quality score, persistency, ASO conversion).

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: The frequency or type of performance measurement period for the incentive program (monthly, quarterly, annual, enrollment period, campaign-based, rolling).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the incentive program becomes active and eligible for participant enrollment and performance tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the incentive program expires or is scheduled to terminate.

attributes.name: enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: The date when eligible sales personnel can begin enrolling or opting into the incentive program.

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: The last date when eligible sales personnel can enroll in the incentive program.

attributes.name: performance_period_start_date
attributes.description: The date when performance measurement begins for calculating incentive payouts.

attributes.name: performance_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when performance measurement ends for calculating incentive payouts.

attributes.name: payout_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which incentive payments are disbursed to participants (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, upon achievement, deferred).

attributes.name: payout_timing_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the performance period ends when incentive payments are processed and disbursed.

attributes.name: base_commission_rate
attributes.description: The baseline commission rate or percentage applied to qualifying sales for this incentive program.

attributes.name: commission_rate_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for the commission rate (percentage of premium, flat amount, Per Member Per Month, Per Employee Per Month, per enrollment, tiered structure).

attributes.name: threshold_type
attributes.description: The type of performance threshold required for incentive eligibility (minimum threshold, quota-based, stretch goal, accelerator tier, or no threshold).

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: The numeric value of the performance threshold that must be achieved for incentive eligibility or tier qualification.

attributes.name: threshold_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for the performance threshold (enrollment count, premium dollars, member months, policies, groups, percentage of quota).

attributes.name: cap_amount
attributes.description: The maximum incentive payout amount per participant per performance period, if applicable.

attributes.name: cap_type
attributes.description: The type of cap applied to incentive payouts (per performance period, per enrollment, annual, lifetime, or no cap).

attributes.name: accelerator_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incentive program includes accelerator provisions that increase payout rates when performance exceeds defined thresholds.

attributes.name: accelerator_threshold
attributes.description: The performance level at which accelerated commission rates begin to apply.

attributes.name: accelerator_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the base commission rate when performance exceeds the accelerator threshold.

attributes.name: clawback_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incentive program includes clawback provisions that allow recovery of incentive payments under specified conditions (e.g., member cancellation, policy lapse).

attributes.name: clawback_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months after initial payout during which clawback provisions may be applied if triggering conditions occur.

attributes.name: clawback_trigger_condition
attributes.description: Detailed description of the conditions that trigger clawback of incentive payments (e.g., member cancellation within 90 days, policy non-payment, fraud detection).

attributes.name: residual_payment_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incentive program includes ongoing residual payments for retained members or renewed policies beyond the initial sale period.

attributes.name: residual_payment_duration_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which residual payments continue after the initial sale, if applicable.

attributes.name: residual_payment_rate
attributes.description: The commission rate or percentage applied to residual payments for retained members or renewed policies.

attributes.name: split_commission_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether commission splitting among multiple sales participants is permitted under this incentive program.

attributes.name: override_commission_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sales managers or supervisors are eligible for override commissions on their team's sales under this program.

attributes.name: override_commission_rate
attributes.description: The commission rate or percentage applied to override commissions for sales managers or supervisors.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic scope or coverage area for which this incentive program is applicable (national, regional, state-specific, territory-based, market-specific).

attributes.name: state_restriction_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of state codes where this incentive program is restricted or not applicable due to regulatory or business constraints.

attributes.name: enrollment_season_type
attributes.description: The enrollment period type this incentive program targets (Annual Enrollment Period, Open Enrollment Period, Special Enrollment Period, year-round, campaign-specific).

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The total budget allocated for this incentive program for the defined performance period.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO currency code for the budget amount (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The organizational department or cost center providing funding for this incentive program.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The accounting cost center code to which incentive program expenses are charged.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code used for recording incentive program expenses in the financial system.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the incentive program in the governance workflow (draft, pending approval, approved, rejected, suspended, terminated).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the incentive program was officially approved by authorized management.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: The name of the executive or manager who approved the incentive program.

attributes.name: program_owner_name
attributes.description: The name of the sales operations or compensation manager responsible for administering this incentive program.

attributes.name: program_owner_email
attributes.description: The email address of the program owner for inquiries and administration.

attributes.name: compliance_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this incentive program requires compliance or legal review before activation due to regulatory considerations.

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: The date when compliance or legal review of the incentive program was completed.

attributes.name: compliance_reviewer_name
attributes.description: The name of the compliance officer or legal reviewer who assessed the incentive program for regulatory adherence.

attributes.name: regulatory_constraint_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any regulatory constraints, limitations, or special considerations applicable to this incentive program (e.g., CMS marketing guidelines, state insurance regulations, Anti-Kickback Statute considerations).
attributes.references: CMS Marketing Guidelines, State Insurance Regulations, Anti-Kickback Statute

attributes.name: communication_plan_description
attributes.description: Description of the communication strategy and channels used to inform eligible participants about the incentive program details and requirements.

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participants must complete specific training or certification before becoming eligible for the incentive program.

attributes.name: quality_assurance_criteria
attributes.description: Description of quality assurance standards or compliance requirements that sales must meet to qualify for incentive payments (e.g., complete enrollment documentation, member satisfaction scores, audit compliance).
attributes.references: NCQA Quality Standards, Internal Quality Assurance Policy

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed criteria defining sales transactions or participants that are explicitly excluded from incentive eligibility (e.g., internal transfers, family members, test enrollments).

attributes.name: stacking_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participants can earn incentives from multiple programs simultaneously for the same sales transaction (stacking permitted or prohibited).

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which performance reports and incentive tracking updates are provided to participants (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, on-demand).

attributes.name: dashboard_url
attributes.description: The web URL where participants can access their real-time performance dashboard and incentive tracking for this program.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: The web URL or document repository location where the complete terms and conditions of the incentive program are published.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version number of the incentive program document or configuration, used to track changes and updates over time.

attributes.name: previous_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the incentive_program_id of the previous version of this program, if this is an updated or revised version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the incentive program (active, inactive, pending launch, suspended, expired, cancelled).

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason for the current program status, particularly for suspended, expired, or cancelled programs.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The date when the incentive program record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_name
attributes.description: The name of the user or administrator who last modified the incentive program record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the incentive program administration.

attributes.name: sales_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_channel. Business justification: Incentive_program has sales_channel (STRING) but needs FK to sales_channel for channel-specific incentive programs.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_region. Business justification: Incentive_program needs FK to sales_region for region-specific incentive programs and geographic scope management.

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.product_catalog. Business justification: Incentive_program applies to specific products. FK to product_catalog enables product-specific incentive tracking.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Sales incentive programs require approved budgets. Finance controls spending against budget, tracks variances, and reports on incentive compensation expenses quarterly.

products.name: lead_source
products.description: Reference list of lead sources such as digital marketing, referrals, events, and partner portals.

attributes.name: lead_source_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lead source record. Primary key for the lead source reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the lead source for system integration and reporting purposes. Used as a business key for referencing lead sources across systems.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the lead source. Human-readable identifier used in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the lead source including its purpose, typical use cases, and any special handling requirements.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the lead source type. Groups similar lead sources together for strategic analysis and budget allocation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which the lead source operates. Distinguishes between digital, physical, and hybrid acquisition channels.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Primary line of business that this lead source targets. Indicates which product portfolio the lead source is optimized for.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations, ACA Marketplace Requirements

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Specific health plan product types that this lead source typically generates leads for. May be 'all' if the source is product-agnostic.
attributes.references: NAIC Health Insurance Model Acts, ACA Qualified Health Plan Standards

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Target market segment that the lead source is designed to reach. Defines the customer demographic and organizational size focus.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the lead source. Determines whether new leads can be attributed to this source.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the lead source became or will become active and available for lead attribution.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the lead source is scheduled to expire or was retired. Null if the source has no planned end date.

attributes.name: cost_per_lead
attributes.description: Average cost incurred to acquire a single lead from this source. Used for Return on Investment (ROI) analysis and budget planning.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost per lead amount. Typically USD for  health Care operations.

attributes.name: conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Historical conversion rate from lead to enrolled member for this source, expressed as a percentage. Used for lead quality assessment and forecasting.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numerical ranking indicating the strategic priority or preference for this lead source. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: attribution_method
attributes.description: Method used to attribute leads to this source when multiple touchpoints exist. Defines how credit is assigned in multi-channel journeys.

attributes.name: tracking_code
attributes.description: Unique tracking identifier or UTM parameter used to identify leads originating from this source in digital systems.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external vendor or partner organization that provides or manages this lead source. Null for internal sources.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_number
attributes.description: Contract or agreement number with the vendor for this lead source. Used for vendor management and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Type of sales campaign or enrollment period that this lead source is associated with. Annual Enrollment Period (AEP), Open Enrollment Period (OEP), and Special Enrollment Period (SEP) are key Medicare and Marketplace timeframes.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Marketing Guidelines, ACA Special Enrollment Period Rules

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage area for the lead source. Indicates whether the source generates leads across all markets or is limited to specific regions.

attributes.name: state_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of state codes where this lead source is restricted or not available due to regulatory or operational constraints.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance Regulations, NAIC Guidelines

attributes.name: compliance_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether leads from this source require additional compliance review or approval before sales engagement. True for high-risk or regulated sources.
attributes.references: CMS Marketing Guidelines, State Insurance Regulations, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: compliance_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the lead source received compliance and legal approval for use in sales and marketing activities.
attributes.references: CMS Marketing Guidelines, State Insurance Department Approvals

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) or data sharing agreement is required for this lead source due to Protected Health Information (PHI) or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) handling.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, HIPAA Security Rule, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: lead_quality_score
attributes.description: Calculated quality score for leads from this source on a scale of 0.00 to 5.00. Based on historical conversion rates, engagement levels, and member retention.

attributes.name: average_time_to_conversion_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Time to Conversion in Days
attributes.description: Average number of days from lead creation to enrollment conversion for this source. Used for sales cycle forecasting and resource planning.

attributes.name: broker_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether leads from this source can be assigned to licensed brokers for commission-based sales. False for direct-only or non-commissionable sources.
attributes.references: State Insurance Licensing Requirements, CMS Agent/Broker Regulations

attributes.name: commission_structure
attributes.description: Type of commission structure applicable to leads from this source. Defines how brokers or agents are compensated for conversions.
attributes.references: CMS Compensation Rules, State Insurance Department Guidelines

attributes.name: lead_routing_rule
attributes.description: Automated routing rule that determines how leads from this source are distributed to sales representatives or brokers.

attributes.name: auto_assignment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether leads from this source are automatically assigned to sales representatives or require manual assignment.

attributes.name: contact_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consent for contact has been obtained from leads originating from this source. Critical for Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) compliance.
attributes.references: TCPA Regulations, CMS Marketing Guidelines, State Do Not Call Laws

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Type of consent obtained for contacting leads from this source. Express written consent is required for certain marketing activities under TCPA.

attributes.name: marketing_material_code
attributes.description: Reference code for the approved marketing materials or creative assets associated with this lead source. Used for CMS File and Use compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Marketing Guidelines, CMS File and Use Requirements

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Primary language preference for leads generated from this source. Used for appropriate sales representative assignment and communication.
attributes.references: ACA Language Access Requirements, CMS Multi-Language Requirements

attributes.name: accessibility_accommodations
attributes.description: Description of any accessibility accommodations or special needs considerations for leads from this source, such as TTY/TDD requirements or large print materials.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Section 504 Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: lead_volume_monthly_target
attributes.description: Target number of leads expected to be generated from this source per month. Used for capacity planning and performance monitoring.

attributes.name: lead_volume_annual_target
attributes.description: Target number of leads expected to be generated from this source annually. Used for strategic planning and budget allocation.

attributes.name: budget_allocated
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for this lead source for the current fiscal period. Used for financial planning and Return on Investment (ROI) tracking.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budget allocated amount.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Department or business unit responsible for managing and optimizing this lead source. Examples include Medicare Sales, Commercial Marketing, or Broker Relations.

attributes.name: owner_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary business contact or owner responsible for this lead source. Used for operational inquiries and issue resolution.

attributes.name: owner_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact or owner for this lead source.

attributes.name: integration_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or platform that provides lead data for this source. Examples include Salesforce Health Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or custom web forms.

attributes.name: integration_method
attributes.description: Technical method used to integrate lead data from this source into the sales pipeline management system.

attributes.name: data_quality_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable data quality score for leads from this source, expressed as a percentage. Leads below this threshold may be rejected or flagged for review.

attributes.name: duplicate_check_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated duplicate detection is enabled for leads from this source to prevent multiple contacts with the same prospect.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the lead source record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the lead source record was last updated or modified.

products.name: region
products.description: Reference hierarchy of geographic sales regions, territories, and sub‑territories used for reporting and quota assignment.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales region. Primary key for the sales region entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the sales region for quick reference and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the sales region (e.g., Northeast Region, California South).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the region within the sales hierarchy (national, regional, territory, sub-territory, district, zone).

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the sales region hierarchy where 1 is the highest (national) and higher numbers represent deeper levels.

attributes.name: parent_region_code
attributes.description: Code of the parent region in the hierarchy. Null for top-level regions.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Description of the geographic area covered by this sales region (e.g., states, counties, zip codes included).

attributes.name: state_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of US state codes (two-letter abbreviations) included in this sales region.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the primary country of this sales region.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Primary time zone for the sales region (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago).

attributes.name: lob_coverage
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Lines of Business (LOB) that this region supports (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace).

attributes.name: channel_coverage
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sales channels active in this region (e.g., Broker, Direct, Online, Employer Group).

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment focus for this sales region (large group, small group, individual, Medicare, Medicaid, dual eligible, specialty).

attributes.name: annual_quota_amount
attributes.description: Total annual sales quota assigned to this region in USD.

products.name: broker_program_appointment
products.description: This association product represents the appointment relationship between insurance brokers and government program participation contracts. It captures broker certifications, appointment dates, territory assignments, and commission structures specific to each broker-program combination. Each record links one broker to one provider program participation with attributes that exist only in the context of this appointment relationship.. Existence Justification: In the health insurance payer industry, brokers are appointed to sell multiple government programs (Medicare Advantage, Part D, Medicaid), and each government program has multiple certified brokers selling it across different territories. Healthcare actively manages these broker appointments as a core business process, tracking certifications, territories, commission structures, and appointment statuses specific to each broker-program combination.

products.name: broker_campaign_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between broker and campaign. It captures the operational assignment of insurance brokers to specific marketing campaigns with performance targets, territory coverage, and commission structures. Each record links one broker to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In Healthcare's operations, insurance brokers are assigned to participate in multiple marketing campaigns simultaneously (Medicare campaigns, employer group campaigns, individual marketplace campaigns), and each campaign engages multiple brokers across different territories and market segments. The business actively manages these assignments with broker-specific performance targets, territory coverage, commission rates, and performance tiers that vary by broker-campaign combination. This is an operational assignment process, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: channel_campaign_execution
products.description: This association product represents the operational execution of a marketing campaign through a specific sales channel. It captures the budget allocation, performance targets, and execution parameters that exist only when a campaign is deployed through a particular channel. Each record links one campaign to one sales channel with channel-specific execution details including budget, lead volume targets, priority, and active dates.. Existence Justification: In health insurance marketing operations, campaigns are routinely executed across multiple sales channels simultaneously (e.g., a Medicare AEP campaign runs through broker, direct enrollment, and call center channels concurrently), and each sales channel supports multiple campaigns throughout the year (e.g., the Broker Direct channel may run Commercial, Medicare, and Marketplace campaigns). Marketing teams actively manage channel-campaign execution as a distinct operational entity, allocating channel-specific budgets, setting channel-specific lead targets, and tracking performance by channel-campaign combination.

products.name: broker_program_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between insurance brokers and  health Care programs. It captures broker enrollment in certification programs, incentive programs, and training initiatives. Each record links one broker to one program with attributes that track certification status, performance metrics, and participation dates specific to that broker-program combination.. Existence Justification: In  health Care's broker management operations, brokers participate in multiple programs simultaneously (Medicare Stars certification, wellness initiative training, preferred partner tiers, AEP training programs), and each program has many participating brokers. The business actively manages these participation relationships, tracking certification status, performance tiers, and participation dates for each broker-program combination. This is an operational relationship that broker management teams create, update, and query regularly.
