attributes.name: skill_group_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether agents must possess specific skill groups to receive interactions from this queue.

attributes.name: primary_skill_group
attributes.description: The primary skill group or competency required for agents handling interactions from this queue (e.g., Claims, Eligibility, Benefits, Appeals).

attributes.name: secondary_skill_groups
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of secondary or optional skill groups that can handle overflow from this queue.

attributes.name: service_level_target_seconds
attributes.description: Target time in seconds within which a specified percentage of interactions should be answered (e.g., 80% in 20 seconds).

attributes.name: service_level_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of interactions that should be answered within the service level target time (e.g., 80%).

attributes.name: average_handle_time_target_seconds
attributes.description: Target average handle time in seconds for interactions in this queue, including talk time, hold time, and after-call work.
attributes.references: Contact Center Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Standards

attributes.name: maximum_wait_time_seconds
attributes.description: Maximum allowable wait time in seconds before an interaction is escalated, transferred, or offered callback.

attributes.name: abandon_threshold_seconds
attributes.description: Minimum time in seconds an interaction must wait in queue before being counted as an abandoned call if the caller disconnects.
attributes.references: Contact Center Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Standards

attributes.name: callback_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether members are offered the option to receive a callback instead of waiting in queue.

attributes.name: callback_threshold_seconds
attributes.description: Wait time threshold in seconds after which members are automatically offered a callback option.

attributes.name: overflow_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether interactions can overflow to secondary queues or skill groups when capacity is exceeded.

attributes.name: overflow_threshold_count
attributes.description: Number of interactions waiting in queue that triggers overflow routing to secondary queues.

attributes.name: overflow_threshold_seconds
attributes.description: Wait time in seconds that triggers overflow routing to secondary queues or skill groups.

attributes.name: escalation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether interactions can be escalated to supervisor or specialized teams based on wait time or complexity.

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_seconds
attributes.description: Wait time in seconds after which interactions are automatically escalated to supervisor or specialized queues.

attributes.name: recording_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether interactions in this queue are recorded for quality assurance, compliance, and training purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, State Call Recording Laws

attributes.name: recording_retention_days
attributes.description: Number of days that interaction recordings are retained before archival or deletion per compliance requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: quality_monitoring_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether interactions from this queue are subject to quality monitoring and scoring.

attributes.name: whisper_message_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether agents receive a whisper message announcing the queue name or interaction type before connecting.

attributes.name: whisper_message_text
attributes.description: Text content of the whisper message played to agents before connecting to the member or provider.

attributes.name: music_on_hold_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether music or messages are played to callers while waiting in queue.

attributes.name: estimated_wait_time_announcement
attributes.description: Indicates whether callers are provided with estimated wait time announcements while in queue.

attributes.name: position_in_queue_announcement
attributes.description: Indicates whether callers are informed of their position in the queue while waiting.

attributes.name: business_hours_schedule
attributes.description: Operating hours schedule for this queue (e.g., 24x7, Monday-Friday 8AM-8PM ET, etc.).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone in which the queue operates and business hours are defined.

attributes.name: holiday_schedule_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether this queue follows organizational holiday schedules for closure or reduced hours.

attributes.name: after_hours_routing
attributes.description: Routing behavior for interactions received outside of business hours (voicemail, IVR menu, emergency queue, etc.).

attributes.name: language_support
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages supported by agents in this queue (e.g., English, Spanish, Mandarin).
attributes.references: Title VI of the Civil Rights Act, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: interpreter_services_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether professional interpreter services are available for members requiring language assistance.
attributes.references: Title VI of the Civil Rights Act, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: tty_tdd_support
attributes.business_glossary_term: Teletypewriter (TTY) Telecommunications Device for the Deaf (TDD) Support Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this queue supports TTY/TDD services for hearing-impaired members.

attributes.name: case_management_integration
attributes.description: Indicates whether interactions from this queue are automatically integrated with case management systems for tracking and resolution.

attributes.name: auto_case_creation
attributes.description: Indicates whether a case is automatically created in the case management system for every interaction from this queue.

attributes.name: case_category
attributes.description: Default case category assigned to interactions from this queue for classification and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Contact Center Operations Standards, CMS Grievance and Appeal Regulations

attributes.name: grievance_appeal_queue
attributes.description: Indicates whether this queue handles member grievances and appeals requiring regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether interactions from this queue must be included in regulatory reporting to CMS, state agencies, or other governing bodies.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: fcr_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of interactions that should be resolved on the first contact without requiring follow-up.
attributes.references: Contact Center Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Standards

attributes.name: nps_tracking_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Tracking Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members are surveyed for Net Promoter Score after interactions from this queue.
attributes.references: Contact Center Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Standards

attributes.name: csat_survey_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether post-interaction customer satisfaction surveys are sent to members after queue interactions.
attributes.references: Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS)

attributes.name: survey_sample_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of interactions from this queue that are randomly selected for post-interaction surveys.
attributes.references: Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS)

attributes.name: screen_pop_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether member or provider information automatically displays (screen pop) when agents receive interactions from this queue.

attributes.name: crm_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this queue is integrated with CRM systems for member history and interaction tracking.

attributes.name: ivr_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interactive Voice Response (IVR) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this queue receives interactions from IVR systems with collected data passed to agents.

attributes.name: ani_dnis_capture
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automatic Number Identification (ANI) Dialed Number Identification Service (DNIS) Capture Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether caller phone number (ANI) and dialed number (DNIS) are captured for interactions in this queue.

attributes.name: outbound_campaign_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this queue is used for outbound calling campaigns (e.g., care management outreach, appointment reminders).

attributes.name: predictive_dialer_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether predictive dialing technology is used for outbound interactions from this queue.

attributes.name: do_not_call_list_check
attributes.business_glossary_term: Do Not Call List Check Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether outbound interactions from this queue are screened against internal and regulatory do-not-call lists.
attributes.references: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA), National Do Not Call Registry

attributes.name: consent_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether agent must verify member consent before proceeding with outbound interactions from this queue.
attributes.references: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA), HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: maximum_daily_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of interactions this queue can handle per day based on staffing and operational capacity.

attributes.name: concurrent_interaction_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of interactions that can be active in this queue simultaneously before new interactions are queued or overflowed.

attributes.name: agent_occupancy_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of time agents should be actively handling interactions versus idle time.
attributes.references: Contact Center Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Standards

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which operational expenses for this queue are allocated.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department responsible for managing and operating this queue.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the manager or supervisor responsible for this queue and its performance.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the manager or supervisor responsible for this queue.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this queue configuration became or will become active and operational.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this queue configuration is scheduled to be deactivated or retired.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this queue configuration record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this queue configuration record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.sla. Business justification: Service queues are configured with specific SLA targets (e.g., Medicare inquiries within 30 days). Queue management systems use SLA references to prioritize work and alert supervisors of breaches.

products.name: category
products.description: Reference list of service issue categories (billing, eligibility, claims, pharmacy, technical, etc.) with hierarchical parent/child relationships.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service issue category. Primary key for the category reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the service issue category for system integration and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the service issue category used for display and reporting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the service issue category including scope, examples, and usage guidelines for contact center agents and case management systems.

attributes.name: parent_category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent category in the hierarchical category structure. Null for top-level categories.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the category hierarchy where 1 represents top-level categories and higher numbers represent deeper subcategories.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full hierarchical path from root to current category using category codes separated by forward slashes (e.g., BILLING/PREMIUM/PAYMENT_ISSUE).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the service issue category aligned with major operational domains in health insurance.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the category indicating whether it is available for use in case management and contact center systems.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Default priority level assigned to service issues in this category for routing and Service Level Agreement (SLA) management.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Default severity classification for issues in this category indicating business impact and urgency of resolution.

attributes.name: sla_response_hours
attributes.description: Target number of hours for initial response to service issues in this category as defined by SLA commitments.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Customer Service Requirements

attributes.name: sla_resolution_hours
attributes.description: Target number of hours for complete resolution of service issues in this category as defined by SLA commitments.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Customer Service Requirements

attributes.name: routing_queue
attributes.description: Default contact center queue or team to which service issues in this category should be routed for handling.

attributes.name: escalation_queue
attributes.description: Secondary queue or specialized team for escalated service issues in this category requiring advanced expertise or management intervention.

attributes.name: requires_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category require Prior Authorization (PA) or Utilization Management (UM) review.

attributes.name: requires_clinical_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category require review by clinical staff such as nurses or medical directors.

attributes.name: requires_supervisor_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether resolution of service issues in this category requires supervisor or management approval before closure.

attributes.name: is_grievance_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category can be classified as formal grievances under CMS and state regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Managed Care Manual Chapter 13

attributes.name: is_appeal_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category can be escalated to formal appeals process under CMS and state regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Managed Care Manual Chapter 13

attributes.name: is_reportable_to_cms
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reportable to Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category must be reported to CMS for Medicare Advantage, Part D, or Medicaid programs.

attributes.name: is_reportable_to_state
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reportable to State Department of Insurance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category must be reported to state departments of insurance or regulatory agencies.

attributes.name: impacts_hedis
attributes.business_glossary_term: Impacts Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category may impact HEDIS quality measures and reporting.

attributes.name: impacts_cahps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Impacts Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category may impact CAHPS member satisfaction survey results.

attributes.name: impacts_star_rating
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category may impact CMS Medicare Star Ratings for Medicare Advantage and Part D plans.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Specific line of business to which this service issue category applies, or 'all' if applicable across all LOBs.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Specific health plan product type to which this service issue category applies, or 'all' if applicable across all product types.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary service channel through which issues in this category are typically received and handled.

attributes.name: contact_reason
attributes.description: Standardized contact reason description used for call center reporting and analytics aligned with industry best practices.

attributes.name: resolution_script_url
attributes.description: URL or reference to knowledge base article or resolution script for contact center agents handling issues in this category.

attributes.name: knowledge_base_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary knowledge base article providing guidance for resolving issues in this category.

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialized training is required for contact center agents to handle service issues in this category.

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether agents must hold specific certifications (e.g., Medicare, HIPAA) to handle service issues in this category.

attributes.name: average_handle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Target or historical average handle time in minutes for service issues in this category used for capacity planning and performance management.

attributes.name: first_call_resolution_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage for first call resolution of service issues in this category as a key performance indicator.

attributes.name: member_satisfaction_target_score
attributes.description: Target member satisfaction score (e.g., Net Promoter Score or CSAT) for service interactions in this category.

attributes.name: regulatory_timeframe_days
attributes.description: Regulatory-mandated timeframe in days for resolution of service issues in this category as required by CMS or state regulations.

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must receive formal written notification of resolution for service issues in this category.

attributes.name: documentation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal documentation or case notes are required for audit and compliance purposes for service issues in this category.

attributes.name: audit_retention_years
attributes.description: Number of years that service issue records in this category must be retained for audit and regulatory compliance purposes.

attributes.name: financial_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category typically involve financial adjustments, refunds, or payment corrections.

attributes.name: external_vendor_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether resolution of service issues in this category typically requires coordination with external vendors or Third Party Administrators (TPA).

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value used to control the display order of categories in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this service issue category became or will become active and available for use in case management systems.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this service issue category was or will be retired and no longer available for new service issues.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this service issue category record was originally created in the reference data system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this service issue category record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: deprecated_date
attributes.description: Date when this service issue category was marked as deprecated and scheduled for retirement.

attributes.name: replacement_category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the replacement category to be used when this category is deprecated or retired.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of service cases or inquiries that have been classified under this category for analytics and optimization purposes.

attributes.name: is_visible_to_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service issue category is visible to members in self-service portals and mobile applications.

attributes.name: is_visible_to_provider
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service issue category is visible to providers in provider portals for submitting inquiries.

attributes.name: allows_attachments
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category allow or require document attachments for resolution.

attributes.name: auto_close_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether service issues in this category are eligible for automated closure based on predefined business rules.

attributes.name: auto_close_days
attributes.description: Number of days of inactivity after which service issues in this category are automatically closed if auto-close is enabled.

attributes.name: knowledge_article_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary knowledge base article providing guidance for resolving issues in this category.

products.name: priority
products.description: Standard priority levels (P1‑Critical, P2‑High, P3‑Medium, P4‑Low) with description and escalation timeframes.

attributes.name: priority_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the priority level record. Primary key for the priority entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standard priority code designation (P1, P2, P3, P4) used across service operations to classify urgency and response requirements.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name for the priority level (Critical, High, Medium, Low) used in customer-facing communications and reporting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the priority level including criteria for assignment, typical use cases, and business impact considerations.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Numeric severity ranking from 1 (most severe) to 4 (least severe) used for system sorting and escalation logic.

attributes.name: response_time_minutes
attributes.description: Target time in minutes for initial response to member or provider inquiry based on priority level. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking and First Call Resolution (FCR) metrics.

attributes.name: resolution_time_hours
attributes.description: Target time in hours for complete resolution of the case or inquiry based on priority level. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance and Turnaround Time (TAT) reporting.

attributes.name: escalation_time_hours
attributes.description: Maximum time in hours before automatic escalation to higher support tier or management if case remains unresolved.

attributes.name: auto_escalation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic escalation is enabled for this priority level when escalation time threshold is exceeded.

attributes.name: business_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of business impact associated with this priority level, considering member satisfaction, regulatory risk, financial exposure, and operational disruption.

attributes.name: member_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of impact on member experience and satisfaction, used for Net Promoter Score (NPS) correlation and member advocacy prioritization.

attributes.name: regulatory_risk
attributes.description: Assessment of regulatory compliance risk associated with this priority level, considering Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and state insurance department requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Compliance Standards, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: financial_impact_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount threshold that qualifies a case for this priority level based on potential financial exposure or claim value.

attributes.name: applies_to_grievances
attributes.description: Indicates whether this priority level is applicable to member grievance cases, which have specific regulatory timeframes under Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and state regulations.

attributes.name: applies_to_appeals
attributes.description: Indicates whether this priority level is applicable to member appeal cases, which have mandated resolution timeframes under Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and Affordable Care Act (ACA) regulations.
attributes.references: CMS Grievance and Appeals Requirements, ACA Compliance

attributes.name: applies_to_inquiries
attributes.description: Indicates whether this priority level is applicable to general member or provider inquiries handled through contact center operations.

attributes.name: applies_to_complaints
attributes.description: Indicates whether this priority level is applicable to member complaints that do not rise to the level of formal grievances but require tracking and resolution.

attributes.name: requires_management_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether cases assigned this priority level require immediate notification to management or executive leadership.

attributes.name: requires_member_outreach
attributes.description: Indicates whether this priority level requires proactive outreach to the member to acknowledge receipt and provide status updates.

attributes.name: contact_channel_preference
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for member contact based on priority level, supporting omnichannel support strategy.

attributes.name: queue_assignment_rule
attributes.description: Rule for assigning cases of this priority to contact center queues, determining whether dedicated resources or standard queues are used.

attributes.name: skill_level_required
attributes.description: Minimum skill level required for service representatives handling cases at this priority level, used for workforce management and routing.

attributes.name: after_hours_support_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this priority level requires 24/7 support coverage including after-hours and weekend availability.

attributes.name: display_icon
attributes.description: Icon identifier or name used for visual representation of priority level in user interfaces and reporting dashboards.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value used for sorting priority levels in user interfaces and reports, with lower numbers indicating higher priority.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this priority level is currently active and available for assignment to new cases.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this priority level configuration became effective and available for use in service operations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this priority level configuration is no longer effective and should not be assigned to new cases.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this priority level record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this priority level record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this priority level configuration, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Compliance Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage for Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance for cases at this priority level, used for Key Performance Indicator (KPI) tracking and performance management.

attributes.name: fcr_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage for First Call Resolution (FCR) for cases at this priority level, measuring ability to resolve member issues on initial contact.

attributes.name: aht_target_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Handle Time (AHT) Target in Minutes
attributes.description: Target Average Handle Time (AHT) in minutes for cases at this priority level, balancing efficiency with quality resolution.

attributes.name: nps_impact_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor for Net Promoter Score (NPS) impact calculation, reflecting how cases at this priority level influence overall member satisfaction scores.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether cases at this priority level require reporting to regulatory bodies such as Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) or state insurance departments.
attributes.references: CMS Compliance Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: quality_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether cases at this priority level require quality assurance review before closure to ensure compliance and member satisfaction.

attributes.name: supervisor_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether case resolution at this priority level requires supervisor approval before closure.

attributes.name: documentation_requirements
attributes.description: Level of documentation detail required for cases at this priority level, ensuring adequate audit trail and compliance evidence.
attributes.references: Internal Service Operations Standards, HIPAA Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: applies_to_lob
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of Lines of Business (LOB) to which this priority level applies, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicaid, or all lines.

products.name: service_status_code
products.description: Reference table of case status values (New, In Progress, Pending, Resolved, Closed, Escalated).

attributes.name: service_status_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service status code reference record.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the service case status (e.g., NEW, INPROG, PEND, RSLVD, CLSD, ESC).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the service case status (e.g., New, In Progress, Pending, Resolved, Closed, Escalated).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of what the status represents in the service case lifecycle and when it should be applied.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the status for reporting and workflow management purposes.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status code is currently active and available for use in service case management.

attributes.name: is_terminal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status represents a final state in the service case lifecycle (e.g., Closed, Resolved) where no further transitions are expected.

attributes.name: is_reopenable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a case in this status can be reopened or transitioned back to an active state.

attributes.name: requires_action
attributes.description: Indicates whether cases in this status require immediate action or follow-up from service representatives.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the sort order for displaying status codes in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used for visual representation of the status in dashboards and reports (e.g., #FF0000 for escalated, #00FF00 for resolved).

attributes.name: icon_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the icon used to visually represent this status in user interfaces.

attributes.name: sla_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Service Level Agreement timers and metrics apply to cases in this status.

attributes.name: sla_pause
attributes.description: Indicates whether SLA timers should be paused when a case enters this status (e.g., Pending Member Response).

attributes.name: auto_close_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether cases in this status are eligible for automatic closure based on configured business rules.

attributes.name: auto_close_days
attributes.description: Number of days of inactivity after which cases in this status will be automatically closed, if auto-close is enabled.

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether member or provider notification is required when a case transitions to this status.

attributes.name: notification_template
attributes.description: Identifier of the communication template to be used for notifications when cases enter this status.

attributes.name: escalation_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether cases in this status can be escalated to higher support tiers or management.

attributes.name: fcr_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether cases resolved in this status count toward First Call Resolution metrics.

attributes.name: nps_survey_trigger
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Survey Trigger Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether transitioning to this status should trigger an NPS survey to be sent to the member.

attributes.name: satisfaction_survey_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether transitioning to this status should trigger a member satisfaction survey.

attributes.name: workflow_stage
attributes.description: The stage in the service case workflow that this status represents for process tracking and analytics.

attributes.name: allowed_transitions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of status codes to which cases can transition from this status, enforcing workflow rules.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether cases in this status must be included in regulatory reporting to CMS, state departments of insurance, or other governing bodies.

attributes.name: grievance_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status is applicable to formal grievance cases requiring special handling under regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: appeal_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status is applicable to appeal cases requiring adherence to regulatory timelines and processes.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: tat_hours
attributes.description: Standard turnaround time in hours expected for cases in this status before transition to the next stage.

attributes.name: priority_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight used in prioritization algorithms to determine case handling urgency when in this status.

attributes.name: aging_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of days after which a case in this status is considered aged and requires management attention or escalation.

attributes.name: system_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status can only be set by automated system processes rather than manual user action.

attributes.name: user_selectable
attributes.description: Indicates whether service representatives can manually select this status when updating cases.

attributes.name: requires_reason_code
attributes.description: Indicates whether a reason code or explanation must be provided when transitioning a case to this status.

attributes.name: requires_supervisor_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether supervisor approval is required before a case can be transitioned to this status.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit trail logging is required for all transitions to and from this status.

attributes.name: external_status_mapping
attributes.description: Mapping code used to translate this internal status to equivalent status codes in external systems or partner interfaces.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this status code became active and available for use in the system.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this status code is no longer valid for new case assignments, though existing cases may retain it.

attributes.name: created_date

attributes.name: escalated_from_team

attributes.name: escalated_to_team

attributes.name: escalated_to_queue

attributes.name: member_profile_id

attributes.name: member_name

attributes.name: provider_id

attributes.name: provider_npi

attributes.name: provider_name

attributes.name: claim_number

attributes.name: request_id

attributes.name: authorization_number

attributes.name: complaint_id

attributes.name: appeal_id

attributes.name: contact_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel through which the member or provider initiated contact that led to the escalation (e.g., phone call, web portal, mobile app).

attributes.name: contact_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for the member or provider contact that resulted in the case escalation (e.g., claim inquiry, benefit question, complaint, authorization status).

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health insurance product line or market segment associated with the member's coverage (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Marketplace).

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific health plan product or benefit design associated with the member's coverage.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health insurance plan structure (HMO=Health Maintenance Organization, PPO=Preferred Provider Organization, EPO=Exclusive Provider Organization, POS=Point of Service, HDHP=High Deductible Health Plan, SNP=Special Needs Plan).

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Market category or customer segment classification for the member's coverage (e.g., Large Group, Small Group, Individual, Medicare, Medicaid).

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the case was escalated to the higher tier or specialized team, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the escalation occurred, used for daily reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the escalated case was assigned to a specific user or team for resolution.

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the receiving party acknowledged receipt of the escalated case and began review.

attributes.name: first_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the escalation recipient provided the first substantive response or action on the escalated case.

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the escalated case was marked as resolved with a final disposition or solution.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the escalation record was formally closed and removed from active work queues.

attributes.name: target_resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time by which the escalated case must be resolved according to Service Level Agreement (SLA) commitments based on priority and escalation level.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation resolution exceeded the committed SLA timeframe (true=breached, false=met SLA).

attributes.name: sla_breach_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the SLA was breached, including root cause and contributing factors for process improvement analysis.

attributes.name: resolution_time_hours
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in hours from escalation timestamp to resolved timestamp, used for performance measurement and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: business_days_to_resolution
attributes.description: Number of business days (excluding weekends and holidays) from escalation to resolution, used for operational reporting.

attributes.name: resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the type of resolution or outcome for the escalated case (e.g., APPROVED, DENIED, OVERTURNED, REFERRED, WITHDRAWN).

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text explanation of how the escalated case was resolved, including actions taken and final outcome.

attributes.name: resolution_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the escalation outcome for reporting and trend analysis purposes.

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the underlying root cause that necessitated the escalation (e.g., SYSTEM_ERROR, POLICY_EXCEPTION, TRAINING_GAP, PROCESS_FAILURE).

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the root cause analysis findings for the escalation, used for process improvement and training purposes.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation identified systemic issues requiring corrective action or process changes (true=action required, false=no action needed).

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions taken or planned to address the root cause and prevent future similar escalations.

attributes.name: member_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Member-reported satisfaction rating for the escalation resolution on a scale of 1 to 5 (1=very dissatisfied, 5=very satisfied), collected through post-resolution surveys.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Member likelihood to recommend Healthcare based on escalation handling experience, rated 0-10 (0=not at all likely, 10=extremely likely).

attributes.name: member_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text comments and feedback provided by the member regarding their experience with the escalation process and resolution.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation must be reported to regulatory bodies such as state insurance departments or CMS (true=reportable, false=not reportable).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Managed Care Manual Chapter 13

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the escalation was reported to the applicable regulatory authority, if required.

attributes.name: regulatory_category
attributes.description: Classification of the escalation according to regulatory reporting categories defined by CMS or state insurance departments.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Managed Care Manual Chapter 13

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the financial impact resulting from the escalation resolution (e.g., claim payment adjustment, refund issued, penalty assessed).

attributes.name: financial_impact_type
attributes.description: Category of financial impact resulting from the escalation resolution for accounting and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: escalation_notes
attributes.description: Comprehensive free-text notes documenting the escalation details, actions taken, communications, and decision rationale for audit trail and knowledge management.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal-only notes and comments not shared with members or providers, used for staff communication and operational coordination.

attributes.name: communication_method
attributes.description: Method used to communicate the escalation resolution to the member or provider (e.g., mail, email, phone call, member portal notification).

attributes.name: communication_date
attributes.description: Date when the escalation resolution communication was sent to the member or provider.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether additional follow-up actions or monitoring are required after escalation resolution (true=follow-up needed, false=no follow-up).

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for follow-up action or review of the escalated case to ensure sustained resolution.

attributes.name: reopened_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation was reopened after initial closure due to unresolved issues or new information (true=reopened, false=not reopened).

attributes.name: reopened_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the escalation was reopened after initial closure.

attributes.name: reopened_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the escalation was reopened, including new information or unresolved issues that emerged after initial closure.

attributes.name: escalation_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application where the escalation was initiated (e.g., Salesforce Health Cloud, ServiceNow, Pegasystems).

attributes.name: escalation_source_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the escalation record in the source system for cross-system traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: quality_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation requires quality assurance review by a supervisor or quality team (true=review required, false=no review needed).

attributes.name: quality_review_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the required quality assurance review has been completed (true=completed, false=pending).

attributes.name: quality_review_score
attributes.description: Quality assurance score assigned to the escalation handling on a scale of 0-100, evaluating adherence to policies, documentation quality, and resolution effectiveness.

attributes.name: quality_review_comments
attributes.description: Feedback and comments from the quality assurance reviewer regarding the escalation handling, including strengths and areas for improvement.

attributes.name: training_opportunity_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation identified a training need or coaching opportunity for staff development (true=training needed, false=no training needed).

attributes.name: training_topic
attributes.description: Subject area or skill gap identified through the escalation that requires training or coaching intervention.

attributes.name: peer_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation requires clinical peer review by a medical director or clinical specialist (true=peer review required, false=not required).

attributes.name: peer_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the clinical peer reviewer (physician or clinical specialist) who conducted medical necessity review for the escalation.

attributes.name: peer_review_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the clinical peer review process indicating whether the original decision was upheld, overturned, or modified.

attributes.name: external_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation requires independent external review by a third-party organization as mandated by ACA or state regulations (true=external review required, false=not required).

attributes.name: external_review_organization
attributes.description: Name of the independent review organization (IRO) conducting the external review of the escalation.

attributes.name: external_review_outcome
attributes.description: Final decision rendered by the independent external review organization regarding the escalation.

attributes.name: legal_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation requires legal department review due to potential litigation risk or regulatory compliance concerns (true=legal review required, false=not required).

attributes.name: compliance_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the escalation requires compliance department review for regulatory adherence verification (true=compliance review required, false=not required).

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag

attributes.name: language_preference

attributes.name: interpreter_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether language interpretation services were required for escalation communication (true=interpreter used, false=no interpreter needed).

attributes.name: vulnerable_population_flag

attributes.name: member_risk_profile_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: program_claim_id

products.name: nps_score
products.description: Transactional record of NPS scores collected via surveys, including promoter score, detractor reason, and calculation date.

attributes.name: nps_score_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each NPS score record collected via member or provider surveys.

attributes.name: survey_response_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this NPS score to the originating survey response record in the survey management system.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member who provided the NPS score.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier for the provider being rated, if the survey pertains to provider experience.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Standards, HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: respondent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the survey respondent indicating whether they are a member, provider, employer group contact, broker, or caregiver.

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Classification of the survey indicating whether it is transactional (event-triggered), relationship-based (periodic), or tied to specific touchpoints like claims or enrollment.

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the NPS survey was sent or made available to the respondent.

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the respondent completed and submitted the NPS survey.

attributes.name: response_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the respondent submitted the NPS survey response, including timezone offset.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The numeric score provided by the respondent on a scale of 0 to 10, indicating their likelihood to recommend the health plan or service to others.
attributes.references: Net Promoter Score Methodology, Customer Experience Standards

attributes.name: nps_category
attributes.description: Classification of the respondent based on their NPS score: Promoter (9-10), Passive (7-8), or Detractor (0-6).

attributes.name: promoter_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to true if the respondent is classified as a Promoter (score 9-10), false otherwise.

attributes.name: detractor_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to true if the respondent is classified as a Detractor (score 0-6), false otherwise.

attributes.name: detractor_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the primary reason provided by a detractor for their low NPS score.
attributes.references: Customer Service Taxonomy, Voice of Customer Standards

attributes.name: detractor_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the reason provided by a detractor for their low NPS score, captured from open-ended survey responses.

attributes.name: feedback_comment
attributes.description: Open-ended textual feedback provided by the respondent explaining their NPS score or providing additional context about their experience.

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: Numeric sentiment analysis score derived from the feedback comment text, typically ranging from -1.00 (very negative) to +1.00 (very positive).
attributes.references: Text Analytics Standards, Natural Language Processing

attributes.name: sentiment_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the sentiment expressed in the feedback comment, derived from text analytics.

attributes.name: touchpoint_type
attributes.description: The specific type of member or provider interaction or service touchpoint that triggered the transactional NPS survey.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific customer service interaction, claim, or transaction that triggered the NPS survey.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Unique case management identifier if the NPS survey was triggered by a customer service case, grievance, or appeal.
attributes.references: Case Management Standards, Salesforce Health Cloud

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Unique claim identifier if the NPS survey was triggered by a claims processing event or post-claim experience.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The health insurance line of business associated with the member or provider being surveyed.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The specific health plan product type associated with the member being surveyed, such as HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, or Medicare SNP.
attributes.references: Health Insurance Product Standards, CMS Plan Types

attributes.name: member_tenure_months
attributes.description: The number of months the member has been enrolled with Healthcare at the time of the NPS survey.

attributes.name: member_age
attributes.description: The age of the member in years at the time of the NPS survey response.

attributes.name: member_gender
attributes.description: The gender of the member as recorded in the member management system at the time of the NPS survey.
attributes.references: Member Demographics Standards, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: member_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code representing the member's primary residence state at the time of the NPS survey.

attributes.name: member_zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit ZIP code of the member's primary residence at the time of the NPS survey.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employer group if the member is enrolled through a group health plan.

attributes.name: employer_group_name
attributes.description: Name of the employer group or organization sponsoring the member's health plan.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer service agent or representative who handled the interaction that triggered the NPS survey.

attributes.name: agent_name
attributes.description: Name of the customer service agent or representative who handled the interaction that triggered the NPS survey.

attributes.name: contact_center_location
attributes.description: Geographic location or site identifier of the contact center where the interaction occurred.

attributes.name: service_team
attributes.description: The specific service team or department responsible for the interaction that triggered the NPS survey (e.g., Claims, Enrollment, Appeals).

attributes.name: first_call_resolution_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to true if the member's issue was resolved on the first contact without requiring follow-up.
attributes.references: Contact Center Quality Standards, First Call Resolution (FCR) Metrics

attributes.name: survey_language
attributes.description: The language in which the NPS survey was presented and completed by the respondent.
attributes.references: Language Access Standards, Title VI Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: survey_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the specific NPS survey instrument used, enabling tracking of survey changes over time.

attributes.name: survey_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor or platform used to administer the NPS survey, if applicable.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the NPS score and category were calculated and recorded in the system.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The reporting period (year, quarter, or month) to which this NPS score is attributed for aggregation and trending analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the NPS survey response was collected, used for financial and operational reporting alignment.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) in which the NPS survey response was collected.

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: Status of the survey response indicating whether it was completed in full, partially completed, abandoned, or deemed invalid.

attributes.name: response_validity_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to true if the survey response passed all quality and validity checks, false if flagged as potentially fraudulent or invalid.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to true if the NPS response indicates a need for immediate follow-up action by customer service or care management teams.

attributes.name: follow_up_case_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the follow-up case created in response to a detractor NPS score or critical feedback.

attributes.name: follow_up_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which follow-up action was completed in response to the NPS feedback.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to true if the NPS response triggered an escalation to senior management or specialized teams due to severity of feedback.

attributes.name: benchmark_comparison_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the peer group or industry benchmark cohort used to compare this NPS score against industry standards.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or platform from which the NPS survey data was extracted (e.g., Qualtrics, Medallia, Salesforce).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NPS score record was first created in the data product, including timezone offset.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this NPS score record, including timezone offset.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member who provided the NPS score.

attributes.name: employer_group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employer group if the member is enrolled through a group health plan.

attributes.name: interaction_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration in seconds of the customer service interaction that triggered the NPS survey, if applicable.
attributes.references: Contact Center Metrics, Average Handle Time (AHT) Standards

attributes.name: service_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_channel. Business justification: Nps_score.survey_channel (STRING) should link to service_channel master table to analyze NPS by channel type and channel characteristics. Removes denormalized channel code.

products.name: knowledge_base

attributes.name: article_number

attributes.name: title

attributes.name: summary

attributes.name: category

attributes.name: subcategory

attributes.name: article_type

attributes.name: keywords

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: published_date

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.name: author_name

attributes.name: author_department

attributes.name: reviewer_name

attributes.name: approver_name

attributes.name: access_level

attributes.name: regulatory_reference

attributes.name: related_policy_number

attributes.name: priority

attributes.name: view_count

attributes.name: helpful_votes

attributes.name: not_helpful_votes

attributes.name: search_rank_score

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: translation_available

attributes.name: parent_article_id

attributes.name: attachment_count

attributes.name: video_url

attributes.name: external_link

attributes.name: internal_notes

attributes.name: change_log

attributes.name: seo_meta_description

attributes.name: featured_article
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the article is featured or highlighted for prominent display to users.

attributes.name: archived_date

attributes.name: retirement_reason

attributes.name: replacement_article_id
attributes.description: Reference to the knowledge base article identifier that replaces or supersedes this article if it has been retired.

attributes.name: compliance_validated

attributes.name: compliance_validation_date

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant

attributes.name: cms_approved

products.name: knowledge_usage
products.description: Transactional log of article views and searches by members or agents, capturing article ID, user ID, channel, and timestamp.

attributes.name: knowledge_usage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each knowledge article usage event. Primary key for the knowledge usage transaction log.

attributes.name: knowledge_base_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base article that was accessed or searched. Links to the knowledge repository system.

attributes.name: article_title
attributes.description: The title or headline of the knowledge article accessed by the user.

attributes.name: article_category
attributes.description: The primary category or topic area of the knowledge article, aligned with service domain taxonomy.

attributes.name: article_subcategory
attributes.description: The secondary classification or subcategory of the knowledge article for more granular topic identification.

attributes.name: user_agent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the user who accessed the knowledge article. May represent a member, provider, or internal agent.

attributes.name: user_type
attributes.description: Classification of the user accessing the knowledge article, indicating whether they are a member, provider, internal agent, or other user type.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member if the user is a member. Null for non-member users.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer service agent if the user is an internal agent. Null for non-agent users.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier if the user is a healthcare provider. Null for non-provider users.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry, HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used to access the knowledge article.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the user session during which the knowledge article was accessed, enabling session-level analysis.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer service interaction or case associated with this knowledge usage event. Null if not part of a tracked interaction.

attributes.name: usage_type
attributes.description: The type of action performed on the knowledge article, such as viewing, searching, downloading, or providing feedback.

attributes.name: search_query
attributes.description: The search terms or query text entered by the user that led to the article being accessed. Null for direct article views.

attributes.name: search_result_position
attributes.description: The position or rank of the article in the search results list when accessed via search. Null for non-search access.

attributes.name: search_result_count
attributes.description: The total number of articles returned in the search results. Null for non-search access.

attributes.name: access_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the knowledge article was accessed by the user, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: access_date
attributes.description: The calendar date when the knowledge article was accessed, in format yyyy-MM-dd, for date-based reporting and aggregation.

attributes.name: time_spent_seconds
attributes.description: The duration in seconds that the user spent viewing or interacting with the knowledge article.

attributes.name: article_version
attributes.description: The version number or identifier of the knowledge article at the time it was accessed, supporting version tracking and content evolution analysis.

attributes.name: article_language
attributes.description: The language in which the knowledge article was presented to the user, using 3-letter language codes.

attributes.name: helpful_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the user marked the article as helpful. Null if no feedback was provided.

attributes.name: rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric rating score provided by the user for the knowledge article, typically on a scale of 1-5. Null if no rating was provided.

attributes.name: feedback_comment
attributes.description: Free-text feedback or comment provided by the user about the knowledge article. Null if no comment was provided.

attributes.name: resolved_issue_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the knowledge article successfully resolved the user's issue or inquiry. Null if not tracked or not applicable.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the user escalated to live agent support after accessing the knowledge article, indicating article insufficiency.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business or product line associated with the user or the context of the knowledge article access.

attributes.name: geography
attributes.description: The geographic region or country associated with the user accessing the knowledge article, using 3-letter country codes.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code associated with the user or the context of the knowledge article access. Null for non-US users.

attributes.name: referrer_url
attributes.description: The URL or page from which the user navigated to access the knowledge article, supporting navigation path analysis.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the device used to access the knowledge article, for security and analytics purposes.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The user agent string identifying the browser and operating system used to access the knowledge article.

attributes.name: article_status
attributes.description: The publication status of the knowledge article at the time it was accessed.

attributes.name: article_author
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person or team who authored the knowledge article.

attributes.name: article_published_date
attributes.description: The date when the knowledge article was originally published, in format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: article_last_updated_date
attributes.description: The date when the knowledge article was last updated or revised, in format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: article_view_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of times the article has been viewed at the time of this access event, supporting popularity analysis.

attributes.name: article_helpful_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of times the article has been marked as helpful at the time of this access event.

attributes.name: article_unhelpful_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of times the article has been marked as unhelpful at the time of this access event.

attributes.name: article_average_rating
attributes.description: The average rating score of the article at the time of this access event, typically on a scale of 1.00 to 5.00.

attributes.name: access_method
attributes.description: The method by which the user discovered or accessed the knowledge article.

attributes.name: recommendation_engine
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the recommendation engine or algorithm that suggested the article, if applicable. Null for non-recommended access.

attributes.name: recommendation_score
attributes.description: The relevance or confidence score assigned by the recommendation engine, typically between 0.0000 and 1.0000. Null for non-recommended access.

attributes.name: case_type
attributes.description: The type of customer service case or interaction associated with this knowledge usage event. Null if not part of a case.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: The status of the customer service case at the time the knowledge article was accessed. Null if not part of a case.

attributes.name: case_priority
attributes.description: The priority level of the customer service case associated with this knowledge usage event. Null if not part of a case.

attributes.name: fcr_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the knowledge article contributed to first call resolution of the customer inquiry. Null if not tracked or not applicable.

attributes.name: aht_seconds
attributes.description: The average handle time in seconds for the interaction during which the knowledge article was accessed. Null if not part of an agent interaction.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The Net Promoter Score provided by the member following the interaction where the knowledge article was used, typically on a scale of 0-10. Null if not collected.

attributes.name: satisfaction_score
attributes.description: The customer satisfaction score provided by the member following the interaction where the knowledge article was used. Null if not collected.

attributes.name: article_tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of tags or keywords associated with the knowledge article for categorization and search optimization.

attributes.name: article_format
attributes.description: The format or media type of the knowledge article content.

attributes.name: article_length_words
attributes.description: The length of the knowledge article measured in word count, for content analysis purposes.

attributes.name: article_readability_score
attributes.description: The readability score of the knowledge article, typically using Flesch-Kincaid or similar metrics, indicating content accessibility.

attributes.name: mobile_optimized_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the knowledge article is optimized for mobile device viewing.

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the knowledge article meets accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1 AA.

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the knowledge article content and access method comply with HIPAA privacy and security requirements.

products.name: policy_acknowledgment
products.description: This association product represents the acknowledgment event between agent and compliance_policy. It captures the formal record of when each agent acknowledged each version of each compliance policy, required for regulatory audit trails and compliance tracking. Each record links one agent to one compliance_policy with attributes that exist only in the context of this acknowledgment relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, agents must acknowledge multiple compliance policies (HIPAA, Privacy, Fraud Prevention, ACA, state-specific regulations), and each policy requires acknowledgment from all agents who handle member data or perform regulated activities. The business actively manages this relationship through compliance tracking systems that monitor acknowledgment status, send reminders for overdue acknowledgments, and maintain audit trails for regulatory inspections. When policies are updated, all agents must re-acknowledge the new version, creating a historical record of acknowledgments over time.

attributes.name: policy_id

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the agent formally acknowledged this compliance policy version. Critical for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the acknowledgment indicating whether the agent has completed the acknowledgment, is pending, overdue, or if the acknowledgment has expired requiring re-acknowledgment.

attributes.name: version_acknowledged
attributes.description: The specific version number of the compliance policy that was acknowledged by the agent. Critical for tracking when policy updates require new acknowledgments.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when this agent must re-acknowledge or review this compliance policy. Calculated based on the policy's attestation frequency requirements.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the agent acknowledged the policy, used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: ip_address

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this acknowledgment record was last updated.

products.name: certification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between service agents and health insurance programs. It captures the training, certification, and authorization status required for agents to service specific programs (Medicare, Medicaid, ACA, Commercial). Each record links one agent to one program with certification dates, specialization levels, and active status that exist only in the context of this agent-program pairing.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, service agents must be certified to handle specific programs (Medicare, Medicaid, ACA, Commercial) due to regulatory requirements and product complexity. A single agent is typically certified for multiple programs to provide flexible workforce coverage, and each program requires multiple certified agents to handle member inquiries and service requests. The business actively manages these certifications with training dates, specialization levels, expiration tracking, and active status to ensure compliance and proper call routing.

products.name: article_program_applicability
products.description: This association product represents the applicability relationship between knowledge base articles and programs. It captures which support articles, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides are applicable to which health insurance programs (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial, etc.), including version control and approval tracking for compliance purposes. Each record links one knowledge base article to one program with effective dates, version tracking, and approval status that exist only in the context of this program-specific applicability.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, knowledge base articles (FAQs, troubleshooting guides, policy explanations) must be applicable to multiple programs simultaneously because the same content often applies across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business. Conversely, each program requires multiple knowledge articles covering different topics (enrollment, benefits, claims, appeals). The business actively manages this relationship for regulatory compliance, requiring program-specific approval, version control, and effective dating because CMS and state regulators require documented evidence that member-facing content is approved for each specific program context.

products.name: sanction_type

attributes.name: sanction_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sanction type reference record.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the sanction type for system processing and reporting (e.g., OIG_EXCL, SAM_EXCL, STATE_SANC).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the sanction type (e.g., Office of Inspector General Exclusion, System for Award Management Exclusion, State Medical Board Sanction).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the sanction type, including its purpose, scope, and implications for provider credentialing and network participation.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the sanction type by jurisdiction or nature (federal, state, professional board, regulatory agency, criminal, civil, administrative).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification indicating the impact of this sanction type on provider eligibility and credentialing decisions (critical sanctions result in automatic disqualification).

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency, regulatory body, or professional organization that issues this type of sanction (e.g., Office of Inspector General, General Services Administration, State Medical Board).

attributes.name: authority_type
attributes.description: Classification of the issuing authority by organizational type (federal agency, state agency, professional board, licensing board, law enforcement, court).

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic or regulatory jurisdiction where this sanction type applies (e.g.,  States, specific state abbreviation, or multi-state compact).
