attributes.name: screening_source
attributes.description: Primary data source or database used to screen for this sanction type during credentialing (e.g., OIG LEIE, SAM.gov, NPDB, State Licensing Board Database).

attributes.name: screening_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for screening providers against this sanction type (monthly, quarterly, annually, initial credentialing only, or continuous monitoring).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, CMS Provider Enrollment Requirements, 42 CFR 455.436

attributes.name: mandatory_screening_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether screening for this sanction type is mandatory for provider credentialing and network participation (true) or optional/supplementary (false).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, CMS Provider Enrollment Requirements, 42 CFR 455.436

attributes.name: auto_disqualification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a match on this sanction type results in automatic disqualification from network participation (true) or requires credentialing committee review (false).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, Internal Credentialing Policy

attributes.name: committee_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a match on this sanction type requires review and decision by the credentialing committee (true) or can be processed administratively (false).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, Internal Credentialing Policy

attributes.name: network_participation_impact
attributes.description: Standard impact of this sanction type on provider network participation status (disqualification, suspension, restriction, enhanced monitoring, or no impact).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, Internal Network Management Policy

attributes.name: cms_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reportable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sanction type must be reported to CMS for Medicare Advantage and Part D compliance (true) or is not subject to CMS reporting requirements (false).
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Requirements, 42 CFR 422.222, 42 CFR 423.120

attributes.name: state_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sanction type must be reported to state insurance departments or Medicaid agencies (true) or is not subject to state reporting requirements (false).
attributes.references: State Insurance Regulations, State Medicaid Managed Care Requirements

attributes.name: ncqa_requirement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Requirement Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether screening for this sanction type is required for NCQA accreditation compliance (true) or is supplementary to NCQA standards (false).

attributes.name: urac_requirement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Utilization Review Accreditation Commission (URAC) Requirement Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether screening for this sanction type is required for URAC accreditation compliance (true) or is supplementary to URAC standards (false).

attributes.name: exclusion_scope
attributes.description: Scope of exclusion or sanction applicability (all federal healthcare programs, Medicare and Medicaid only, state programs, specific program, or professional practice restrictions).
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Authority, 42 USC 1320a-7, State Licensing Laws

attributes.name: reinstatement_allowed_flag

attributes.name: lookback_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years to review historical records for this sanction type during initial credentialing and re-credentialing (e.g., 5 years for criminal history, 10 years for malpractice).

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Standard method used to verify or screen for this sanction type (automated database screening, manual verification, primary source verification, provider attestation, or third-party credentialing service).

attributes.name: primary_source_verification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether primary source verification is required for this sanction type (true) or secondary sources are acceptable (false).

attributes.name: caqh_data_element

attributes.name: npdb_reportable_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this sanction type is reportable to the National Practitioner Data Bank (true) or is not subject to NPDB reporting requirements (false).

attributes.name: hipdb_reportable_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this sanction type is reportable to the Healthcare Integrity and Protection Data Bank (true) or is not subject to HIPDB reporting requirements (false). Note: HIPDB was integrated into NPDB in 2013.

attributes.name: provider_type_applicability
attributes.description: Types of healthcare providers to which this sanction type applies (e.g., physicians, nurses, facilities, DME suppliers, all provider types). Pipe-separated list if multiple.

attributes.name: specialty_specific_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sanction type applies only to specific medical specialties or professional disciplines (true) or applies broadly to all provider types (false).
attributes.references: State Licensing Board Procedures, Professional Board Standards

attributes.name: documentation_required
attributes.description: Types of documentation required when this sanction type is identified during credentialing (e.g., court records, board orders, reinstatement letters, explanation letters).

attributes.name: appeal_process_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers have the right to appeal credentialing decisions based on this sanction type (true) or decisions are final (false).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, Internal Fair Hearing Policy

attributes.name: notification_requirement
attributes.description: Required timeframe for notifying relevant parties (provider, network operations, compliance, CMS) when this sanction type is identified (immediate, within 24 hours, within 5 days, within 30 days, or no specific requirement).

attributes.name: legal_basis

attributes.name: replacement_sanction_type_code
attributes.description: Code of the sanction type that replaces this one if this type has been deprecated or consolidated (null if not replaced).

attributes.name: screening_method

attributes.name: next_screening_due_date

products.name: credentialing_network_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation contract between a credentialed provider and a government benefit design. It captures the terms under which a provider participates in a specific government program's network, including tiering, reimbursement modifiers, and participation status. Each record links one credential to one benefit_design with attributes that exist only in the context of this network participation relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, a credentialed provider participates in multiple government benefit designs (Medicare Advantage plans, Medicaid products, etc.) simultaneously, and each benefit design has hundreds to thousands of participating providers. Network management teams actively manage these participation relationships as distinct operational entities, tracking provider-specific tiering, reimbursement modifiers, and participation status for each credential-benefit design combination. This is a core operational process for provider directory accuracy, claims payment, and member access.

attributes.name: credentialing_network_participation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the network_participation association

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the provider credential record that is participating in the network

attributes.name: benefit_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the government benefit design in which the provider is participating

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider's participation in this specific benefit design network becomes effective. This is distinct from the credential effective date as it represents when participation in this particular government program begins.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider's participation in this specific benefit design network ends. Allows tracking of historical participation and network changes over time.

attributes.name: participation_tier
attributes.description: Tiering classification for this provider within this specific benefit design network, affecting member cost-sharing and access. A provider may be Tier 1 in one plan and Tier 2 in another based on contract negotiations and quality metrics.

attributes.name: reimbursement_rate_modifier
attributes.description: Percentage modifier applied to standard reimbursement rates for this provider-benefit design combination. Represents negotiated rate adjustments specific to this participation agreement (e.g., 1.05 for 5% above standard, 0.95 for 5% below).

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the provider's participation in this specific benefit design network. Tracks whether the provider is actively accepting members from this plan.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patient enrollments from this specific benefit design. A provider may accept new patients in some networks but not others based on panel capacity.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number to the legal contract document governing this provider's participation in this benefit design network.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this network participation record.

attributes.name: updated_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last updated this participation record.

products.name: provider_training_completion
products.description: This association product represents the completion event between a provider credential and a compliance training requirement. It captures the fulfillment of mandatory training requirements as part of the credentialing and recredentialing process. Each record links one credential to one training_record with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific completion event.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, providers must complete multiple mandatory compliance trainings (HIPAA, fraud/waste/abuse, cultural competency, etc.) as part of both initial credentialing and ongoing recredentialing cycles. Each provider credential requires multiple training completions, and the same training module is completed by multiple providers. The credentialing team actively manages these training requirements as a prerequisite for credential approval and tracks completion status, scores, expiration dates, and attestations for each provider-training combination.

products.name: credential_policy_acknowledgment
products.description: This association product represents the acknowledgment event between a provider credential and a compliance policy. It captures the formal attestation by providers to specific compliance policies during credentialing and recredentialing processes. Each record links one credential to one compliance policy with acknowledgment date, version, status, and signature details that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer credentialing operations, providers must formally acknowledge multiple compliance policies (Code of Conduct, Privacy Policy, HIPAA, Fraud Prevention, etc.) during initial credentialing and every recredentialing cycle (typically every 36 months). Each provider-policy acknowledgment is tracked as a distinct operational record with acknowledgment date, policy version, signature, and status. Conversely, each compliance policy is acknowledged by thousands of providers across the network, creating a true many-to-many operational relationship.

products.name: committee_policy_governance
products.description: This association product represents the governance relationship between credentialing committees and compliance policies. It captures which committees have adopted and oversee which compliance policies, including adoption decisions, review schedules, and governance accountability. Each record links one credentialing committee to one compliance policy with attributes that exist only in the context of this governance relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, credentialing committees are governance bodies that adopt and oversee multiple compliance policies (credentialing standards, peer review protocols, quality thresholds). Each committee-policy relationship represents a formal governance assignment with adoption decisions, review schedules, and accountability tracking. Multiple committees (medical, dental, behavioral health) may govern the same policy from different specialty perspectives, and each committee governs multiple policies within their scope of authority.

products.name: credentialing_provider_program_participation

It captures the operational enrollment and participation status of providers across multiple programs (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, commercial networks, specialty programs). Each record links one provider credential to one program with enrollment dates, participation status, and tier levels that exist only in the context of this specific provider-program relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, providers are credentialed to participate in multiple distinct programs simultaneously (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, commercial PPO/HMO networks, specialty programs like behavioral health or oncology centers of excellence). Each provider-program participation is an operational business entity managed by network operations with its own enrollment date, participation status, tier level, and effective/termination dates. products.name: workflow_step_sla
products.description: This association product represents the SLA assignment between credentialing workflow steps and service level agreements. It captures the specific SLA targets, escalation thresholds, and business priorities that apply when a particular workflow step must meet a particular SLA. Each record links one workflow step to one SLA with attributes that define the operational performance expectations for that specific combination.. Existence Justification: In Healthcare's credentialing operations, workflow steps can be governed by multiple SLAs simultaneously (standard processing, expedited review, regulatory compliance timeframes), and each SLA definition applies to multiple workflow steps across the credentialing process. Operations teams actively configure and manage these assignments, tracking compliance metrics, escalation thresholds, and business priorities specific to each workflow step-SLA combination. This is an operational configuration that credentialing managers create, update, and monitor as part of performance management.

attributes.name: ledger_type
attributes.description: The type or classification of the ledger, indicating whether it is a primary ledger, secondary ledger, adjustment ledger, consolidation ledger, statutory ledger, or management ledger.

attributes.name: legal_entity
attributes.description: The legal entity name for which the trial balance is prepared, representing a distinct corporate or organizational unit within Health Care.

attributes.name: legal_entity_code
attributes.description: The unique code or identifier assigned to the legal entity for which the trial balance is prepared.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the chart of accounts structure used for this trial balance, enabling tracking of changes to the account structure over time.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The unique account number from the chart of accounts for which the trial balance entry is recorded.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center code associated with the account, representing the organizational unit responsible for the costs or revenues recorded in the account.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The department name or code associated with the account, indicating the functional area within the organization.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business segment associated with the account, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual Marketplace, Employer Group, Government Programs, or Specialty products.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The specific product line within the line of business, providing more granular product segmentation for financial analysis.

attributes.name: geography
attributes.description: The geographic region or market associated with the account, enabling regional financial analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: beginning_balance_debit
attributes.description: The debit balance of the account at the beginning of the accounting period, representing the opening debit position.

attributes.name: beginning_balance_credit
attributes.description: The credit balance of the account at the beginning of the accounting period, representing the opening credit position.

attributes.name: period_debit_activity
attributes.description: The total debit transactions posted to the account during the accounting period, representing increases to debit-normal accounts or decreases to credit-normal accounts.

attributes.name: period_credit_activity
attributes.description: The total credit transactions posted to the account during the accounting period, representing increases to credit-normal accounts or decreases to debit-normal accounts.

attributes.name: ending_balance_debit
attributes.description: The debit balance of the account at the end of the accounting period, calculated as beginning balance plus period activity, representing the closing debit position.

attributes.name: ending_balance_credit
attributes.description: The credit balance of the account at the end of the accounting period, calculated as beginning balance plus period activity, representing the closing credit position.

attributes.name: net_balance
attributes.description: The net balance of the account, calculated as the difference between total debits and total credits, representing the account's net position.

attributes.name: balance_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account has a net debit balance, net credit balance, or zero balance at the end of the period.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the account balances are denominated, such as USD for US Dollars.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The functional currency code of the legal entity, representing the primary currency in which the entity conducts its business operations.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency code in which the trial balance is reported for consolidated financial statements, typically the parent company's functional currency.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert foreign currency balances to the reporting currency, if applicable.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_type
attributes.description: The type of exchange rate applied for currency conversion, such as spot rate, average rate, historical rate, or closing rate.

attributes.name: balance_in_reporting_currency
attributes.description: The account balance converted to the reporting currency using the applicable exchange rate, used for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.description: The total amount of adjusting journal entries posted to the account during the period, including accruals, deferrals, reclassifications, and corrections.

attributes.name: adjustment_count
attributes.description: The number of adjusting journal entries posted to the account during the period, providing insight into the volume of adjustments.

attributes.name: is_balanced
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the trial balance is in balance, meaning total debits equal total credits across all accounts.

attributes.name: balance_variance
attributes.description: The difference between total debits and total credits in the trial balance, which should be zero if the trial balance is properly balanced.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the account is currently active and available for posting transactions.

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the account has been reconciled for the period, confirming that the balance has been verified against supporting documentation.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the account reconciliation was completed for the period.

attributes.name: is_closed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the accounting period has been closed for this account, preventing further postings to the period.

attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the account is used for statutory financial reporting required by regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_account
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the account is subject to specific regulatory reporting requirements, such as CMS financial reporting or state insurance department filings.

attributes.name: mlr_category

attributes.name: risk_based_capital_category

attributes.name: financial_statement_type
attributes.description: The type of financial statement on which the account is reported: balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, statement of equity, or not applicable.

attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the account is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley internal control requirements due to materiality or risk.

attributes.description: The date of the most recent actuarial valuation for reserve accounts, indicating when the reserve balance was last assessed by actuaries.

attributes.description: The name or identifier of the individual or system that prepared the trial balance record.

attributes.description: The date on which the trial balance was reviewed and approved.

attributes.description: The name of the source system from which the trial balance data was extracted, such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Financials, or other general ledger systems.

attributes.name: total_income_amount

attributes.name: taxable_income_amount

attributes.name: net_tax_due_amount

attributes.name: overpayment_amount

attributes.name: refund_amount

attributes.name: credit_forward_amount

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Total penalties assessed for late filing, late payment, or underpayment of estimated tax.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Interest charged on underpayment or late payment of tax.

attributes.name: total_amount_due

attributes.name: payment_due_date

attributes.name: payment_date

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to remit tax payment (e.g., Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS), wire transfer, check).

attributes.name: payment_reference_number

attributes.name: consolidated_return_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this return is filed as part of a consolidated group of corporations.

attributes.name: parent_company_ein

attributes.name: amended_return_indicator

attributes.name: original_return_filing_date
attributes.description: Filing date of the original return if this is an amended return.

attributes.name: extension_requested_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a filing extension was requested for this return.

attributes.name: extension_approval_date

attributes.name: preparer_name

attributes.name: preparer_ptin

attributes.name: preparer_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the accounting or tax preparation firm that prepared the return.

attributes.name: preparer_firm_ein
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tax Preparer Firm Employer Identification Number (EIN)
attributes.description: EIN of the tax preparation firm.

attributes.name: signing_officer_name

attributes.name: signing_officer_title
attributes.description: Title of the corporate officer who signed the return (e.g., Chief Financial Officer, President, Treasurer).

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date the authorized officer signed the tax return.

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the tax return in the filing lifecycle.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date the tax authority accepted the filed return.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date the tax authority rejected the filed return.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for return rejection by the tax authority.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax return is currently under audit by the tax authority.

attributes.name: audit_start_date
attributes.description: Date the tax audit commenced.

attributes.name: audit_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the tax audit was completed.

attributes.name: audit_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of tax adjustments resulting from the audit.

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Date after which the tax authority can no longer assess additional tax for this return (typically 3 years from filing).

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health insurance line of business to which this tax return relates (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid).

attributes.name: business_unit_code

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_number

attributes.name: sox_control_flag

attributes.name: naic_company_code

attributes.name: state_filing_requirement_indicator

attributes.name: apportionment_percentage

attributes.name: alternative_minimum_tax_amount

attributes.name: deferred_tax_liability_amount
attributes.description: Amount of deferred tax liabilities recognized for temporary differences.

attributes.name: uncertain_tax_position_amount
attributes.description: Amount of tax benefit not recognized due to uncertainty under FIN 48 (ASC 740-10).

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Effective tax rate calculated as total tax expense divided by pre-tax income (expressed as decimal).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

products.name: mlr_calculation
products.description: Transactional process record calculating the ratio of medical claims paid to earned premiums for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: mlr_calculation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the MLR calculation record.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The market segment or product line for which the MLR is calculated, as defined by ACA regulations.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the insurance business was conducted for this MLR calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC State Reporting Requirements, CMS MLR Reporting

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: The market classification for the insurance products included in this MLR calculation.

attributes.name: total_earned_premium_amount
attributes.description: The total premium revenue earned during the calculation period, including member premiums and employer contributions.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2718, 45 CFR 158.130, GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: federal_and_state_taxes_amount
attributes.description: The amount of federal and state taxes and licensing or regulatory fees paid during the calculation period, excluded from earned premium for MLR calculation.

attributes.name: adjusted_earned_premium_amount
attributes.description: The earned premium after deducting federal and state taxes, used as the denominator in the MLR calculation.

attributes.name: incurred_claims_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of medical claims incurred during the calculation period, including paid claims and changes in claim reserves.

attributes.name: paid_claims_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of medical claims paid during the calculation period.

attributes.name: claim_reserves_beginning_balance
attributes.description: The claim reserves balance at the beginning of the calculation period, used to calculate incurred claims.

attributes.name: claim_reserves_ending_balance
attributes.description: The claim reserves balance at the end of the calculation period, used to calculate incurred claims.

attributes.name: quality_improvement_expenses_amount
attributes.description: The amount spent on activities that improve health care quality, which can be included in the MLR numerator.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 158.150, CMS Quality Improvement Activity Guidelines

attributes.name: fraud_reduction_expenses_amount
attributes.description: The amount spent on fraud, waste, and abuse detection and prevention activities that qualify for MLR numerator inclusion.

attributes.name: care_coordination_expenses_amount
attributes.description: The amount spent on care coordination and management programs that qualify as quality improvement activities.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 158.150, CMS Quality Improvement Activity Guidelines

attributes.name: total_quality_improvement_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of quality improvement expenses that can be added to the MLR numerator, subject to regulatory caps.

attributes.name: mlr_numerator_amount
attributes.description: The sum of incurred claims and allowable quality improvement expenses, used as the numerator in the MLR calculation.

attributes.name: mlr_percentage
attributes.description: The calculated MLR percentage, representing the proportion of premium revenue spent on medical claims and quality improvement.

attributes.name: mlr_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum MLR percentage required by regulation for this line of business and market (typically 80% or 85%).

attributes.name: mlr_shortfall_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage by which the calculated MLR falls short of the regulatory threshold, if applicable.

attributes.name: rebate_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of rebates owed to policyholders due to MLR shortfall.

attributes.name: credibility_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: The credibility factor applied to the MLR calculation based on the number of member months, as defined by CMS regulations.

attributes.name: credibility_adjusted_mlr_percentage
attributes.description: The MLR percentage after applying the credibility adjustment for small sample sizes.

attributes.name: risk_corridor_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The adjustment amount related to the ACA risk corridor program, if applicable to the calculation period.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The risk adjustment transfer amount (payment or charge) that affects the MLR calculation.

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoveries_amount
attributes.description: The amount recovered from reinsurance arrangements during the calculation period, which reduces net incurred claims.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_reduction_amount
attributes.description: The amount of cost-sharing reductions provided to eligible members under ACA marketplace plans.

attributes.name: administrative_expenses_amount
attributes.description: The total administrative expenses incurred during the calculation period, used to assess compliance with MLR requirements.

attributes.name: profit_margin_amount
attributes.description: The profit or loss amount for the calculation period, derived from premium revenue minus claims, quality improvement, and administrative expenses.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Reporting, NAIC Statutory Accounting

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the MLR calculation in the regulatory reporting workflow.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the MLR calculation was submitted to regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned by the regulatory authority for this MLR filing.
attributes.references: CMS HIOS System, State DOI Filing Systems

attributes.name: issuer_hios_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Issuer Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS) ID
attributes.description: The five-digit HIOS issuer identifier assigned by CMS for the insurance carrier.

attributes.name: experience_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months of experience included in the MLR calculation period.

attributes.name: is_grandfathered_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plans included in this MLR calculation are grandfathered under ACA provisions.

attributes.name: is_student_health_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MLR calculation applies to student health insurance coverage.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 158.103, CMS Student Health Plan Guidance

attributes.name: is_mini_med_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plans included are limited benefit or mini-med plans subject to different MLR thresholds.

attributes.name: is_expatriate_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MLR calculation applies to expatriate health plans.

attributes.name: rebate_distribution_method
attributes.description: The method by which MLR rebates will be distributed to policyholders or subscribers.

attributes.name: rebate_payment_deadline_date
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline by which MLR rebates must be paid to policyholders (typically September 30).

attributes.name: attestation_officer_name
attributes.description: The name of the company officer who attested to the accuracy of the MLR calculation and filing.

attributes.name: attestation_officer_title
attributes.description: The title of the company officer who attested to the MLR calculation.

attributes.name: attestation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company officer attested to the accuracy of the MLR calculation.

attributes.name: external_audit_firm_name
attributes.description: The name of the independent auditing firm that reviewed the MLR calculation, if applicable.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, NAIC Model Audit Rule

attributes.name: audit_opinion
attributes.description: The opinion issued by the external auditor regarding the MLR calculation and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: audit_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the external audit of the MLR calculation was completed.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, NAIC Model Audit Rule

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for amending a previously submitted MLR calculation.
attributes.references: CMS MLR Reporting Instructions, State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The date on which an amended MLR calculation was submitted to regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: original_submission_date
attributes.description: The date of the original MLR calculation submission, if this record represents an amendment.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the MLR calculation methodology and business rules applied.
attributes.references: Internal Process Standard, CMS MLR Guidance Updates

attributes.name: regulatory_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or explanations provided to regulatory authorities regarding the MLR calculation.
attributes.references: CMS MLR Reporting Instructions, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_review_status
attributes.description: The status of the internal compliance review of the MLR calculation before regulatory submission.

attributes.name: compliance_reviewer_name
attributes.description: The name of the compliance officer who reviewed the MLR calculation.

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance review of the MLR calculation was completed.

attributes.name: actuarial_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether actuarial certification is required for this MLR calculation based on regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: actuary_name
attributes.description: The name of the qualified actuary who certified the MLR calculation and reserves.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: actuary_certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the actuary certified the MLR calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The primary source system from which the MLR calculation data was extracted (e.g., Facets, QNXT, SAP).

attributes.name: calculation_run_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the MLR calculation was executed in the system.

attributes.name: calculation_engine_version
attributes.description: The version of the calculation engine or software used to compute the MLR.

attributes.name: is_final_calculation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final MLR calculation for the reporting period or a preliminary/draft calculation.

attributes.name: prior_year_carryforward_amount
attributes.description: The amount of MLR deficit or surplus carried forward from the prior reporting year, if applicable.

attributes.name: pharmacy_claims_amount
attributes.description: The portion of incurred claims attributable to pharmacy benefits during the calculation period.

attributes.name: medical_claims_amount
attributes.description: The portion of incurred claims attributable to medical services (excluding pharmacy) during the calculation period.

attributes.name: capitation_payments_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of capitation payments made to providers during the calculation period, included in incurred claims.

attributes.name: incentive_payments_amount
attributes.description: The amount of quality-based or performance-based incentive payments made to providers, included in incurred claims.

attributes.name: subrogation_recoveries_amount
attributes.description: The amount recovered through subrogation during the calculation period, which reduces net incurred claims.

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_recoveries_amount
attributes.description: The amount recovered through coordination of benefits with other insurers, which reduces net incurred claims.

attributes.name: prescription_drug_rebates_amount
attributes.description: The amount of manufacturer rebates received for prescription drugs, which reduces net pharmacy claims.

products.name: actuarial_reserve
products.description: Master entity representing reserves set aside for future claim payments, with assumptions, methodology, and periodic adjustments.

attributes.name: actuarial_reserve_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the actuarial reserve record. Primary key for the actuarial reserve entity.

attributes.name: reserve_type
attributes.description: Classification of the actuarial reserve indicating the nature and purpose of the reserve (e.g., IBNR - Incurred But Not Reported, case reserves, bulk reserves, ULAE, ALAE).
attributes.references: NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP), CMS Medicare Advantage Financial Reporting

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or business segment to which this reserve applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual ACA marketplace, ASO).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, CMS Program Requirements

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the actuarial reserve set aside for future claim payments and obligations, expressed in the reporting currency.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944, NAIC SAP, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reserve_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code indicating the currency in which the reserve amount is denominated.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the actuarial reserve was calculated and valued, typically the end of an accounting period.

attributes.name: reserve_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the actuarial reserve calculation indicating whether it is draft, preliminary, finalized, approved, or has been adjusted or superseded.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The actuarial methodology used to calculate the reserve (e.g., Chain Ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Expected Loss Ratio, Frequency-Severity, Cape Cod method).
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43, CAS Statement of Principles

attributes.name: development_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months of claims development history used in the reserve calculation, representing the maturity period for claims runout analysis.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level (as a percentage) associated with the reserve estimate, indicating the probability that actual claims will not exceed the reserve amount.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43, NAIC Risk-Based Capital Requirements

attributes.name: expected_payout_date
attributes.description: The anticipated date by which the reserved funds are expected to be paid out for claims settlement.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: claim_count
attributes.description: The number of claims (reported or estimated) underlying this actuarial reserve calculation.

attributes.name: member_months
attributes.description: The total member months of exposure used as the basis for calculating the reserve, representing the aggregate time members were covered under the plan.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Reporting, NAIC Health Annual Statement

attributes.name: incurred_claims_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of claims incurred (both paid and unpaid) during the period covered by this reserve calculation.

attributes.name: paid_claims_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of claims that have been paid as of the valuation date, used in the reserve calculation.

attributes.name: outstanding_claims_amount
attributes.description: The amount of reported claims that remain unpaid as of the valuation date, representing case reserves.

attributes.name: ibnr_amount
attributes.description: The estimated amount of claims that have been incurred but not yet reported to the insurer as of the valuation date.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944, NAIC SAP, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: loss_adjustment_expense_amount
attributes.description: The estimated or actual costs associated with investigating, defending, and settling claims, including both allocated and unallocated loss adjustment expenses.

attributes.name: discount_rate_percent
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to future claim payments to calculate the present value of the reserve, if discounting is used.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 20

attributes.name: risk_margin_amount
attributes.description: An additional amount added to the best estimate reserve to account for uncertainty and variability in the reserve calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital Requirements, Solvency II (for international operations)

attributes.name: prior_period_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The reserve amount established in the previous valuation period for comparison and reserve development analysis.

attributes.name: reserve_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The amount by which the current reserve differs from the prior period reserve, representing reserve development (favorable or unfavorable).
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944, NAIC SAP, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reserve_development_percent
attributes.description: The percentage change in the reserve from the prior period, indicating reserve adequacy or deficiency.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: medical_loss_ratio_percent
attributes.description: The ratio of incurred claims and quality improvement expenses to earned premium, used to assess reserve adequacy in relation to premium revenue.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2718, CMS MLR Reporting Requirements, 45 CFR Part 158

attributes.name: earned_premium_amount
attributes.description: The portion of premium that has been earned during the period covered by this reserve, used in MLR and reserve adequacy calculations.

attributes.name: claim_frequency_rate
attributes.description: The rate of claim occurrences per unit of exposure (e.g., per 1,000 member months), used in frequency-severity reserve methodologies.

attributes.name: average_claim_severity_amount
attributes.description: The average cost per claim used in frequency-severity reserve calculations.

attributes.name: completion_factor
attributes.description: The estimated percentage of ultimate claims that have been reported or paid as of the valuation date, used in reserve development calculations.

attributes.name: tail_factor
attributes.description: The factor applied to project claims development beyond the observed development period in chain ladder and similar methodologies.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43, CAS Loss Reserving Principles

attributes.name: credibility_weight
attributes.description: The weight assigned to actual experience versus expected or industry benchmarks in the reserve calculation, reflecting the statistical credibility of the data.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: The category of healthcare services to which this reserve applies (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, professional, pharmacy, behavioral health).
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes, NAIC Health Annual Statement

attributes.name: diagnosis_category
attributes.description: The clinical diagnosis category or condition group (e.g., HCC category, chronic condition) for which this reserve is established, if applicable.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or market to which this reserve applies (e.g., state, region, service area).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code or equivalent jurisdiction code where the reserve applies, used for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The type of health insurance plan to which this reserve applies (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, SNP).
attributes.references: CMS Plan Type Definitions, NAIC Health Plan Classifications

attributes.name: funding_arrangement
attributes.description: The funding model for the plan to which this reserve applies (e.g., fully insured, ASO - Administrative Services Only, self-funded, level funded).

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the insurance contract or group policy to which this reserve applies.
attributes.references: CMS Contract Reporting, Internal Policy Administration

attributes.name: actuarial_assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the set of actuarial assumptions (trend rates, completion factors, development patterns) used in this reserve calculation.

attributes.name: trend_rate_percent
attributes.description: The annual medical cost trend rate assumption used to project future claim costs in the reserve calculation.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43, CMS Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: seasonality_factor
attributes.description: Adjustment factor applied to account for seasonal variations in claim patterns (e.g., higher utilization in winter months).

products.name: cost_center_contract_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the financial allocation relationship between cost centers and contracts. It captures how contract costs are distributed across multiple organizational cost centers for P&L reporting and financial performance tracking. Each record links one cost center to one contract with allocation percentages and methods that exist only in the context of this financial distribution.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, provider and vendor contracts frequently span multiple organizational cost centers (regions, lines of business, departments) for financial reporting purposes. Finance teams actively manage allocation rules that distribute contract costs across cost centers using specific percentages and methods. This is an operational financial management process where allocation records are created, updated, and tracked over time with specific effective dates and allocation methods.

products.name: budget_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of budget amounts to specific programs. It captures the financial planning and tracking relationship between budgets and programs, recording how much of each budget is allocated to each program, when the allocation was made, and its approval status. Each record links one budget to one program with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, a single budget line (e.g., Medical Management Operating Budget) is routinely allocated across multiple programs (Diabetes Management, COPD Care, Preventive Wellness), and conversely, a single program typically receives funding from multiple budget sources (operating budget, medical expense budget, administrative budget, grant funding). Finance actively manages these allocations as discrete records with specific amounts, approval workflows, and fiscal year tracking.
