attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: Name or description of the risk assessment methodology or framework used (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, proprietary).

attributes.name: questionnaire_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the vendor completed the required risk assessment questionnaire.

attributes.name: questionnaire_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor completed and submitted the risk assessment questionnaire.

attributes.name: documentation_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether supporting documentation (policies, certifications, audit reports) was reviewed as part of the assessment.

attributes.name: incident_history_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the vendor's security incident and breach history was reviewed.

attributes.name: prior_incidents_count
attributes.description: Number of security incidents or breaches reported by or involving this vendor in the past 24 months.

attributes.name: breach_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the vendor is contractually required to notify Healthcare of security breaches within specified timeframes.

attributes.name: right_to_audit_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the contract includes a right-to-audit clause allowing Healthcare to audit vendor controls.

attributes.name: data_return_destruction_clause_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Return and Destruction Clause Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the contract includes provisions for data return or destruction upon contract termination.

attributes.name: subcontractor_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the vendor is required to disclose and obtain approval for subcontractors.

attributes.name: subcontractors_count
attributes.description: Number of subcontractors disclosed by the vendor who have access to Healthcare data or systems.

attributes.name: fourth_party_risk_assessed_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether risks from vendor subcontractors (fourth parties) have been assessed.

attributes.name: continuous_monitoring_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether continuous monitoring tools or services are in place for this vendor.

attributes.name: monitoring_tool_name
attributes.description: Name of the continuous monitoring or vendor risk management tool used to monitor this vendor.

attributes.name: exit_strategy_documented_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether an exit strategy or transition plan has been documented for this vendor relationship.

attributes.name: alternative_vendor_identified_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether alternative vendors have been identified for business continuity purposes.

attributes.name: vendor_concentration_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this vendor represents a concentration risk due to dependency or lack of alternatives.

attributes.name: regulatory_examination_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this vendor relationship has been subject to regulatory examination or inquiry.

attributes.name: regulatory_findings_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether regulatory findings or deficiencies have been identified related to this vendor.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the vendor relationship based on risk assessment outcomes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved the vendor relationship or risk assessment.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor relationship or risk assessment was formally approved.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes from the risk assessment providing additional context or observations.

attributes.name: assessment_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the risk assessment was completed and finalized.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the risk assessment record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider. Business justification: Providers represent third-party risk requiring assessment (data security, financial stability, quality). Risk management evaluates provider-specific risks for network inclusion and ongoing monitoring.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Third-party risk assessments are performed on entities with formal agreements (subcontractors, delegates, vendors). Risk management evaluates PHI access, financial stability, and regulatory compliance

products.name: consent_form
products.description: Master repository of patient/member consent forms, with consent ID, form type, effective date, and version.

attributes.name: consent_form_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the consent form record. Primary key for the consent form entity.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member or patient who provided the consent. Links to the member master record.

attributes.name: form_type
attributes.description: The type or category of consent form. Indicates the specific purpose and scope of the consent being documented.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: form_version
attributes.description: Version number or identifier of the consent form template used. Tracks revisions to consent language and requirements over time.

attributes.name: form_title
attributes.description: The official title or name of the consent form as presented to the member.

attributes.name: form_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the consent form purpose, scope, and what the member is consenting to.

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of the consent. Indicates whether the consent is currently valid and enforceable.

attributes.name: consent_decision
attributes.description: The member's decision regarding the consent request. Indicates whether consent was granted, denied, or granted with conditions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent becomes effective and enforceable. Consent cannot be used prior to this date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent expires and is no longer valid. After this date, new consent must be obtained.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member signed or provided the consent.

attributes.name: signed_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the member signed or provided the consent. Used for audit trail and legal documentation.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member revoked or withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the member for revoking their consent. Free text field for documentation purposes.

attributes.name: signature_method
attributes.description: The method by which the consent was signed or provided by the member.
attributes.references: ESIGN Act, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: signature_location
attributes.description: The physical or digital location where the consent was signed (e.g., clinic name, online portal, mobile app).

attributes.name: witness_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a witness signature is required for this consent form type.

attributes.name: witness_name
attributes.description: The full name of the witness who observed the member signing the consent form. Required for certain consent types.

attributes.name: witness_signature_date
attributes.description: The date on which the witness signed the consent form.

attributes.name: guardian_name
attributes.description: The full name of the legal guardian or authorized representative who provided consent on behalf of the member. Used for minors or incapacitated individuals.

attributes.name: guardian_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the guardian or authorized representative to the member.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The language in which the consent form was presented to and signed by the member. ISO 639-2 three-letter language code.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1557, Title VI Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: interpreter_used_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an interpreter was used to explain the consent form to the member.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1557, Title VI Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: interpreter_name
attributes.description: The full name of the interpreter who assisted with the consent process.

attributes.name: scope_of_consent
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the member is consenting to, including specific uses, disclosures, or activities covered by the consent.

attributes.name: purpose_of_use
attributes.description: The specific purpose for which the Protected Health Information (PHI) or Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) may be used or disclosed under this consent.

attributes.name: phi_categories_covered
attributes.description: The categories or types of Protected Health Information (PHI) covered by this consent (e.g., medical records, lab results, mental health records, substance abuse treatment records).

attributes.name: recipient_organization
attributes.description: The name of the organization or entity to whom the Protected Health Information (PHI) may be disclosed under this consent.

attributes.name: recipient_npi
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the healthcare provider or organization to whom information may be disclosed.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: recipient_tin
attributes.description: The Tax Identification Number (TIN) of the organization to whom information may be disclosed.

attributes.name: disclosure_restrictions
attributes.description: Any specific restrictions or limitations on the disclosure of information under this consent.

attributes.name: right_to_revoke_acknowledged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was informed of and acknowledged their right to revoke the consent at any time.

attributes.name: consequences_of_refusal_explained_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was informed of any consequences of refusing to provide consent.

attributes.name: treatment_conditional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether treatment, payment, enrollment, or eligibility for benefits is conditional on providing this consent.

attributes.name: research_study_name
attributes.description: The name of the research study for which consent is being obtained. Applicable only for research consent forms.
attributes.references: 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule), FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: research_protocol_number
attributes.description: The protocol number or identifier for the research study. Applicable only for research consent forms.
attributes.references: 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule), FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: irb_approval_number
attributes.description: The Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval number for the research study. Required for research consent forms.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive marketing communications. Applicable for marketing consent forms.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, CAN-SPAM Act, TCPA

attributes.name: marketing_channels_authorized
attributes.description: The specific marketing channels the member has authorized for communications (e.g., email, phone, SMS, mail).
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, CAN-SPAM Act, TCPA

attributes.name: financial_remuneration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI) involves financial remuneration to the covered entity. Required disclosure under HIPAA.

attributes.name: document_storage_location
attributes.description: The physical or digital location where the original signed consent form is stored (e.g., file path, document management system reference).

attributes.name: document_format
attributes.description: The format in which the consent form document is stored.

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years the consent form must be retained per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.530, State Medical Records Laws

attributes.name: destruction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent form document is scheduled for destruction per retention policies.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the detailed audit trail for this consent form, tracking all access and modifications.

attributes.name: compliance_review_status
attributes.description: The status of compliance review for this consent form. Indicates whether the form meets all regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: compliance_reviewer_name
attributes.description: The name of the compliance officer or staff member who reviewed this consent form for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent form was reviewed for compliance with regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Notes or comments from the compliance review process, including any issues identified or corrective actions required.

attributes.name: state_specific_requirements_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent form meets any applicable state-specific consent requirements beyond federal HIPAA regulations.
attributes.references: State Medical Consent Laws, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The state whose laws govern this consent form. Two-letter state code (e.g., CA, NY, TX).

attributes.name: minor_consent_age_threshold
attributes.description: The age threshold below which parental or guardian consent is required. Varies by state and consent type.

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent form constitutes a valid Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) authorization for use and disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI).

attributes.name: psychotherapy_notes_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent covers the use or disclosure of psychotherapy notes, which require separate authorization under HIPAA.

attributes.name: substance_abuse_records_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent covers substance abuse treatment records, which are subject to additional federal protections under 42 CFR Part 2.

attributes.name: hiv_aids_records_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Human Immunodeficiency Virus/Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (HIV/AIDS) Records Covered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent covers Human Immunodeficiency Virus/Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (HIV/AIDS) related records, which may be subject to additional state-specific protections.
attributes.references: State HIV/AIDS Confidentiality Laws, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: genetic_information_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent covers genetic information, which is subject to additional protections under the Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act (GINA).

attributes.name: mental_health_records_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent covers mental health treatment records, which may be subject to additional state-specific protections.
attributes.references: State Mental Health Confidentiality Laws, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: electronic_signature_ip_address
attributes.description: The Internet Protocol (IP) address from which the electronic signature was submitted. Used for audit and verification purposes.
attributes.references: ESIGN Act, HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312

attributes.name: electronic_signature_device_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the device used to provide the electronic signature.
attributes.references: ESIGN Act, HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312

attributes.name: electronic_signature_user_agent
attributes.description: The browser or application user agent string from which the electronic signature was submitted.
attributes.references: ESIGN Act, HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312

attributes.name: consent_obtained_by_name
attributes.description: The name of the staff member or representative who obtained the consent from the member.

attributes.name: consent_obtained_by_role
attributes.description: The role or title of the staff member who obtained the consent (e.g., nurse, physician, enrollment specialist, customer service representative).

attributes.name: consent_obtained_by_npi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consent Obtained By National Provider Identifier (NPI)
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the healthcare provider who obtained the consent, if applicable.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: The name of the healthcare facility, clinic, or office where the consent was obtained.

attributes.name: facility_npi
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the facility where the consent was obtained.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The Line of Business (LOB) or product line associated with the member's coverage at the time consent was obtained.

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the health plan or benefit plan under which the member is enrolled at the time consent was obtained.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The employer or group number associated with the member's coverage, if applicable.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number associated with the member's coverage at the time consent was obtained.

attributes.name: superseded_by_consent_form_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the newer consent form that supersedes this consent form. Used to track consent form version history.

attributes.name: supersedes_consent_form_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the older consent form that this consent form supersedes. Used to track consent form version history.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a notification or confirmation was sent to the member regarding their consent.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which notification or confirmation was sent to the member regarding their consent.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The method by which notification or confirmation was sent to the member.

attributes.name: member_copy_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a copy of the signed consent form was provided to the member. Required under HIPAA for authorizations.

attributes.name: member_copy_provided_date
attributes.description: The date on which a copy of the signed consent form was provided to the member.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent form must be included in regulatory reporting to Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), state Departments of Insurance (DOI), or other governing bodies.
attributes.references: CMS Program Requirements, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: cms_reporting_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reporting Category
attributes.description: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) reporting category or classification for this consent form, if applicable to Medicare Advantage (MA) or Medicaid programs.

attributes.name: last_accessed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent form record was last accessed or viewed. Used for audit and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: last_accessed_by_user_id
attributes.description: The user identifier of the person who last accessed or viewed the consent form record.

attributes.name: access_count
attributes.description: The total number of times the consent form record has been accessed or viewed. Used for audit and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system or application from which the consent form data originated (e.g., Salesforce Health Cloud, Pegasystems, document management system).

attributes.name: source_system_record_id
attributes.description: The unique record identifier from the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent form record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent form record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: record_active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent form record is currently active in the system. Used for soft deletes and record lifecycle management.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member or patient who provided the consent. Links to the member master record.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the health plan or benefit plan under which the member is enrolled at the time consent was obtained.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Consent forms implement compliance policies (e.g., HIPAA authorization policy, research consent policy). This FK links forms to their governing policies.

attributes.name: privacy_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_notice. Business justification: Consent forms reference privacy notices to inform members of their rights. This FK links consent forms to the privacy notices they reference, ensuring consistency.

products.name: privacy_notice
products.description: Versions of privacy notices provided to members, including notice ID, effective date, distribution channel, and regulatory reference.

attributes.name: privacy_notice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the privacy notice version. Primary key for the privacy notice data product.

attributes.name: notice_version
attributes.description: Version number of the privacy notice document following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0).

attributes.name: notice_title
attributes.description: Official title of the privacy notice document as displayed to members and regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: notice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the privacy notice based on regulatory requirement or purpose (e.g., HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices, state-specific privacy notice, ACA notice, Medicare Advantage notice, CCPA notice).
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.520, CCPA, State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the privacy notice becomes legally effective and enforceable.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the privacy notice is superseded or expires, if applicable. Null if currently active without planned expiration.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Primary method or channel through which the privacy notice is delivered to members (e.g., mail, email, member portal, enrollment packet, provider office).

attributes.name: distribution_method
attributes.description: Format in which the privacy notice is distributed (electronic, paper, or both).

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language in which the privacy notice is written (e.g., en for English, es for Spanish).

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business to which this privacy notice applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual, Group, ASO, Marketplace).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, State Medicaid Regulations

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Specific health plan product type covered by this privacy notice (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, SNP, MA-PD).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code if this privacy notice is state-specific. Null if federal or multi-state.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Market segment to which this privacy notice applies (e.g., large group, small group, individual, government, military, exchange).

attributes.name: notice_content
attributes.description: Full text content of the privacy notice document, including all required disclosures, member rights, and contact information.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path where the official privacy notice document is stored and accessible for retrieval.

attributes.name: document_format
attributes.description: File format of the privacy notice document (e.g., PDF, HTML, DOCX, TXT).

attributes.name: document_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the privacy notice document file in bytes.

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages in the privacy notice document.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval and lifecycle status of the privacy notice (e.g., draft, pending legal review, pending compliance review, approved, active, superseded, withdrawn).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role who provided final approval for this privacy notice version.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this privacy notice version received final approval for distribution.

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date when legal department completed review of this privacy notice version.

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: Date when compliance department completed review of this privacy notice version.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this privacy notice must be filed with state Department of Insurance or other regulatory body.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when this privacy notice was filed with the regulatory authority, if required.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory authority approved this privacy notice, if approval was required.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_number
attributes.description: Official filing or tracking number assigned by the regulatory authority for this privacy notice submission.

attributes.name: material_modification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this version represents a material modification to privacy practices requiring special notification to members per HIPAA.

attributes.name: modification_description
attributes.description: Description of changes made in this version compared to the previous version, particularly material modifications.

attributes.name: previous_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the privacy_notice_id of the immediately preceding version that this notice supersedes.

attributes.name: distribution_start_date
attributes.description: Date when distribution of this privacy notice to members began.

attributes.name: distribution_end_date
attributes.description: Date when distribution of this privacy notice to members ended, typically when superseded by a new version.

attributes.name: total_distributed_count
attributes.description: Total number of privacy notices distributed to members for this version.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether members are required to acknowledge receipt or review of this privacy notice.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_method
attributes.description: Method by which member acknowledgment of the privacy notice is captured (e.g., signature, electronic consent, verbal confirmation).

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years this privacy notice version must be retained per regulatory requirements (typically 6 years under HIPAA).

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the privacy officer or contact person listed in the notice for member inquiries.

attributes.name: contact_title
attributes.description: Title or role of the privacy officer or contact person listed in the notice.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for the privacy officer or contact person listed in the notice for member inquiries.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the privacy officer or contact person listed in the notice for member inquiries.

attributes.name: contact_address
attributes.description: Mailing address for the privacy officer or contact person listed in the notice for member inquiries.

attributes.name: complaint_procedure_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the notice includes the required complaint procedure information per HIPAA.

attributes.name: ocr_contact_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office for Civil Rights (OCR) Contact Included Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the notice includes contact information for the HHS Office for Civil Rights as required by HIPAA.

attributes.name: member_rights_section_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the notice includes a comprehensive section describing member privacy rights under HIPAA.

attributes.name: uses_disclosures_section_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uses and Disclosures Section Included Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the notice includes required descriptions of uses and disclosures of PHI.

attributes.name: breach_notification_section_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the notice includes information about breach notification procedures as required by HITECH.
attributes.references: HITECH Act Breach Notification Rule 45 CFR 164.404

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the privacy notice meets accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG 2.0 AA for electronic versions, large print availability).
attributes.references: ACA Section 1557, Americans with Disabilities Act

attributes.name: readability_grade_level
attributes.description: Flesch-Kincaid or similar readability grade level score for the privacy notice content, indicating comprehension difficulty.
attributes.references: Plain Writing Act, ACA Consumer Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: translation_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether translations of this privacy notice are available in other languages.

attributes.name: tagline_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the notice includes required multilingual taglines informing members of language assistance services.

attributes.name: audit_trail_maintained
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complete audit trail of changes and distributions is maintained for this privacy notice version.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this privacy notice record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this privacy notice record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this privacy notice record.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this privacy notice record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes or comments about this privacy notice version for compliance and legal team reference.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Privacy notices implement compliance policies (e.g., HIPAA privacy policy, state privacy laws). This FK links notices to their governing policies. The regulatory_reference can be retrieved from compli

products.name: control
products.description: Reference list of internal controls required for regulatory compliance, with control ID, description, control type, and associated regulation.

attributes.name: control_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the internal control within the compliance management system.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable control reference number used for documentation and audit tracking (e.g., HIPAA-001, ACA-1095).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the internal control.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the control objective, scope, and implementation requirements.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the control based on its primary function in the control framework.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is executed or reviewed.

attributes.name: regulation_code
attributes.description: Primary regulatory requirement or statute that mandates this control.

attributes.name: regulation_name
attributes.description: Full name of the regulation or compliance requirement (e.g., Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act).

attributes.name: regulation_section
attributes.description: Specific section, article, or clause of the regulation that this control addresses (e.g., HIPAA Privacy Rule 164.502).

attributes.name: governing_body
attributes.description: Regulatory or standards body that oversees compliance with this control requirement.

attributes.name: domain
attributes.description: Business or operational domain to which this control applies.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk level if this control fails or is not properly implemented.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: The specific risk or compliance objective that this control is designed to mitigate or achieve.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual or department responsible for implementing and maintaining this control.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or business unit responsible for the control (e.g., Compliance, IT Security, Claims Operations).

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Current state of control implementation within the organization.

attributes.name: effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of how effectively the control is operating based on testing and monitoring results.

attributes.name: testing_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is tested or audited for effectiveness.

attributes.name: last_test_date
attributes.description: Date when the control was most recently tested or audited.

attributes.name: next_test_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next control testing or audit activity.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the control documentation and design were last reviewed for adequacy.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of control design and documentation.

attributes.name: automated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control is fully or partially automated through system workflows or scripts.

attributes.name: key_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a key control that is critical to mitigating significant risks or meeting regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: sox_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act financial reporting requirements.

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control is required for HIPAA Privacy Rule or Security Rule compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, HIPAA Security Rule

products.name: asset_compliance_review
products.description: This association product represents the compliance review relationship between compliance policies and marketing assets. It captures the regulatory review and approval process required before marketing materials can be used in campaigns. Each record links one compliance policy to one marketing asset with review tracking attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory assessment.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, marketing assets must undergo compliance review against multiple regulatory policies (HIPAA privacy rules, CMS marketing guidelines, state-specific insurance advertising regulations, ADA accessibility standards). Each asset-policy combination requires independent review tracking because a single asset may be compliant with HIPAA but non-compliant with a specific state regulation, or may receive an exception for one policy but not another. The compliance team actively manages these reviews as operational records with review dates, reviewer assignments, approval statuses, and exception grants.

products.name: benefit_compliance_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory compliance requirements that apply to government benefit designs. It captures the specific compliance obligations, attestation status, and review cycles for each benefit design-policy pairing. Each record links one compliance policy to one benefit design with attributes that track compliance status, effective dates, and requirement types that exist only in the context of this regulatory relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, government benefit designs (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Part D plans) must comply with multiple regulatory policies simultaneously—CMS coverage mandates, formulary requirements, network adequacy standards, prior authorization protocols, and cost-sharing limits. Each benefit design is subject to multiple compliance policies, and each compliance policy applies across multiple benefit designs spanning different programs, plan years, and service areas. Compliance teams actively manage these mappings, tracking attestation status, review cycles, and audit findings for each benefit-policy pairing.

products.name: campaign_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment of a member risk profile into a marketing campaign. It captures the operational relationship between risk-stratified members and targeted campaigns, tracking when each member was enrolled, their response to campaign outreach, eligibility reasoning, and priority scoring for outreach sequencing. Each record links one member risk profile to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, member risk profiles are actively enrolled into multiple marketing campaigns simultaneously (e.g., care gap closure, wellness programs, disease management outreach), and each campaign targets multiple member risk profiles based on risk stratification criteria. Campaign enrollment is an operational business process managed by marketing teams who create enrollment records, track member responses, prioritize outreach sequences, and document eligibility reasoning for each member-campaign combination.

products.name: campaign_content

Each record links one knowledge_base article to one campaign with usage metrics that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance marketing operations, campaigns require multiple knowledge base articles to support agents handling campaign-specific inquiries (Medicare enrollment campaigns need articles on eligibility, enrollment periods, plan comparisons, etc.), and knowledge base articles are reused across multiple campaigns (an article on 'Medicare Part D enrollment' supports annual enrollment campaigns, special enrollment campaigns, and supplemental insurance campaigns). The business actively manages which articles are assigned to which campaigns for agent training and tracks usage metrics per campaign-article combination.

products.name: campaign_benefit_promotion
products.description: This association product represents the promotional relationship between marketing campaigns and government benefit designs. It captures which benefit plans are featured in which marketing campaigns during specific enrollment periods, with targeted enrollment goals and campaign priority. Each record links one campaign to one benefit_design with attributes that exist only in the context of this promotional relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance marketing operations, a single marketing campaign routinely promotes multiple benefit designs simultaneously (e.g., a Medicare Annual Enrollment Period campaign features PPO, HMO, and SNP plan options across different regions). Conversely, each benefit design appears in multiple campaigns throughout the year (AEP campaigns, Special Enrollment Period campaigns, year-round acquisition campaigns). Marketing teams actively manage these promotional relationships by setting enrollment targets, priority levels, and tracking which plans are featured in which campaigns during specific enrollment periods.

products.name: campaign_survey_distribution
products.description: This association product represents the distribution event between campaign and survey. It captures the operational deployment of specific surveys within marketing campaigns to targeted member populations. Each record links one campaign to one survey with attributes that track distribution timing, response metrics, and audience targeting that exist only in the context of this specific campaign-survey deployment.. Existence Justification: In health insurance marketing operations, campaigns routinely distribute multiple survey types (CAHPS satisfaction surveys, needs assessments, enrollment intent surveys) to measure different aspects of campaign effectiveness and member engagement. Conversely, standardized survey instruments (especially regulatory-required CAHPS surveys) are reused across multiple campaigns targeting different member segments, time periods, and lines of business. Marketing teams actively manage these campaign-survey distributions as operational records, tracking distribution dates, response rates, target audience sizes, and survey purposes specific to each campaign-survey pairing.

products.name: offer_eligibility_rule
products.description: This association product represents the configuration relationship between marketing offers and eligibility rules. It captures which eligibility rules are applied to which offers, with context-specific metadata about how and when each rule is applied to determine member qualification for promotional offers. Each record links one offer to one eligibility rule with attributes that govern the rule's application in the context of that specific offer.. Existence Justification: In health insurance marketing operations, offers require complex eligibility determination through multiple rules (age, geography, income, medical conditions), and each eligibility rule is reusable across multiple offers. Product teams actively configure which rules apply to which offers, setting offer-specific priorities, effective dates, and application contexts. This is an operational configuration relationship that the business actively manages, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: program_eligibility
products.description: Real‑time eligibility check for a member against a government program, capturing request timestamp, response codes, benefit details, and eligibility status.

attributes.name: program_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the program eligibility check transaction.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member whose eligibility is being checked.

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the primary subscriber on the policy, may differ from member if member is a dependent.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Type of government program for which eligibility is being verified.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Specific code identifying the government program or plan within the program type.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Contract Number
attributes.description: CMS-assigned contract number for the Medicare Advantage or Part D plan.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific benefit package within the CMS contract.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Segment identifier within the plan benefit package, used for Medicare Advantage plans.

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eligibility check request was initiated.

attributes.name: response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eligibility check response was received.

attributes.name: eligibility_status
attributes.description: Current eligibility status of the member for the specified government program.

attributes.name: eligibility_status_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the eligibility status returned in the response.

attributes.name: response_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the result of the eligibility check request (e.g., approved, denied, error).

attributes.name: response_description
attributes.description: Detailed description or message accompanying the eligibility response code.

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's coverage under the government program becomes effective.

attributes.name: coverage_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's coverage under the government program terminates or is scheduled to terminate.

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_date
attributes.description: Date for which eligibility is being verified, may differ from request date for retroactive or future checks.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business category for the government program.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_type
attributes.description: Type of benefit plan structure for the government program (e.g., HMO, PPO, SNP).

attributes.name: snp_type

attributes.name: medicaid_eligibility_indicator

attributes.name: medicaid_id

attributes.name: medicare_beneficiary_identifier

attributes.name: part_a_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of Medicare Part A (hospital insurance) coverage for the member.

attributes.name: part_b_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of Medicare Part B (medical insurance) coverage for the member.

attributes.name: part_d_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of Medicare Part D (prescription drug) coverage for the member.

attributes.name: hospice_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is currently enrolled in hospice care, which affects certain benefit eligibilities.

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has End Stage Renal Disease, affecting Medicare Advantage eligibility.

attributes.name: low_income_subsidy_level
attributes.description: Level of Low Income Subsidy (Extra Help) the member receives for Part D prescription drug costs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Low Income Subsidy Program

attributes.name: copay_category
attributes.description: Copayment category for members receiving Low Income Subsidy, determining cost-sharing amounts.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Monthly premium amount the member is responsible for paying for the government program coverage.

attributes.name: premium_withhold_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member's premium is withheld from Social Security benefits.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount the member must meet before certain benefits are covered.

attributes.name: deductible_met_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the annual deductible that has been met as of the eligibility verification date.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum out-of-pocket amount the member is responsible for paying in the plan year.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_met_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the out-of-pocket maximum that has been met as of the eligibility verification date.

attributes.name: pcp_assignment_required_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) Assignment Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is required to have a Primary Care Physician assigned under the plan.

attributes.name: pcp_npi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) National Provider Identifier (NPI)
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the member's assigned Primary Care Physician.

attributes.name: pcp_name
attributes.description: Name of the member's assigned Primary Care Physician.

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Network status of the provider for whom eligibility is being checked, if applicable.

attributes.name: referral_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a referral from the PCP is required for specialist services under the plan.

attributes.name: service_type_code

attributes.name: benefit_coverage_level

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_indicator

attributes.name: other_insurance_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has other insurance coverage that may affect benefit coordination.

attributes.name: third_party_liability_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a third party (e.g., auto insurance, workers compensation) may be liable for costs.

attributes.name: enrollment_source

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Type of enrollment transaction that established the member's coverage.

attributes.name: election_period_type
attributes.description: Type of election period during which the member enrolled: Annual Election Period (AEP), Open Enrollment Period (OEP), Special Election Period (SEP), Initial Coverage Election Period (ICEP), or Open Enrollment Period for Institutionalized Individuals (OEPI).

attributes.name: special_election_period_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for the Special Election Period if applicable.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Risk Adjustment Factor score for the member, used in CMS payment calculations based on health status.

attributes.name: hcc_count
attributes.description: Number of Hierarchical Condition Categories assigned to the member for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: institutional_status_code
attributes.description: Code indicating whether the member resides in an institutional setting (relevant for I-SNP eligibility).

attributes.name: ltss_eligibility_indicator

attributes.name: pharmacy_benefit_manager

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the prescription drug formulary applicable to the member's Part D coverage.

attributes.name: coverage_gap_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is currently in the Part D coverage gap (donut hole) phase.

attributes.name: catastrophic_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has reached the catastrophic coverage phase of Part D benefits.

attributes.name: true_out_of_pocket_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative True Out of Pocket costs for Part D that count toward the catastrophic coverage threshold.

attributes.name: requesting_provider_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the provider or entity requesting the eligibility verification.

attributes.description: Tax Identification Number of the provider or entity requesting the eligibility verification.

attributes.name: transaction_control_number
attributes.description: Unique control number assigned to the eligibility transaction for tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: trace_number

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payer organization responding to the eligibility request.

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: Name of the payer organization responding to the eligibility request.

attributes.name: trading_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the trading partner or clearinghouse through which the eligibility transaction was routed.

attributes.name: transmission_method
attributes.description: Method used to transmit the eligibility request and receive the response.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: Error code returned if the eligibility check encountered an error or rejection.

attributes.name: error_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the error if the eligibility check was unsuccessful.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejection if the eligibility request was not processed successfully.

attributes.name: response_time_milliseconds
attributes.description: Time elapsed in milliseconds between the eligibility request and response, used for performance monitoring.

attributes.name: service_area_code
attributes.description: Geographic service area code where the member's coverage is valid.

attributes.name: county_code

attributes.name: state_code

attributes.name: zip_code

attributes.name: language_preference

attributes.name: communication_preference

attributes.name: verification_source

attributes.name: last_verification_date

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date

attributes.name: retroactive_eligibility_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the eligibility check includes retroactive coverage periods.

attributes.name: retroactive_effective_date
attributes.description: Start date of retroactive coverage if retroactive eligibility applies.

attributes.name: plan_year

attributes.name: benefit_period
attributes.description: Specific benefit period within the plan year for which eligibility is being verified.

attributes.name: cms_transaction_id

attributes.name: audit_log_id

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member whose eligibility is being checked.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the primary subscriber on the policy, may differ from member if member is a dependent.

attributes.name: audit_trail_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for audit trail purposes, linking this eligibility check to compliance and monitoring records.

attributes.name: claim_number

attributes.name: claim_status

attributes.name: line_of_business

attributes.name: contract_number

attributes.name: plan_benefit_map_id
attributes.description: CMS Plan Benefit Package identifier specifying the exact benefit design and coverage rules applicable to this claim.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member enrolled in the government program who received the healthcare services.

attributes.name: medicare_beneficiary_identifier

attributes.name: medicaid_id
attributes.description: State-issued Medicaid identification number for dual-eligible or Medicaid-only members, required for coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: subscriber_member_profile_id

attributes.name: rendering_provider_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier for the healthcare provider who rendered the services to the member.

attributes.name: billing_provider_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier for the healthcare provider or organization submitting the claim for payment.

attributes.name: billing_provider_tin
attributes.description: IRS Tax Identification Number for the billing provider, used for payment processing and tax reporting.

attributes.name: referring_provider_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier for the provider who referred the member for the services, if applicable.

attributes.name: facility_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier for the facility where services were rendered, applicable for institutional claims.

attributes.name: service_from_date

attributes.name: service_to_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period for which the claim is submitted, representing when healthcare services concluded.

attributes.name: admission_date

attributes.name: discharge_date
attributes.description: Date the member was discharged from the facility after inpatient services, applicable for institutional claims.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date the claim was received by the health plan for processing, used for timeliness tracking and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: processed_date
attributes.description: Date the claim adjudication was completed and payment determination was made.

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was issued to the provider for approved claim amounts.

attributes.name: primary_diagnosis_code

attributes.name: secondary_diagnosis_codes

attributes.name: primary_procedure_code

attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CPT or HCPCS codes representing all procedures and services performed on the claim.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards and CMS HCPCS Coding Standards

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Group code used for inpatient hospital claim payment classification.

attributes.name: revenue_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of revenue codes identifying specific accommodation, ancillary service, or billing calculation for institutional claims.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the location where healthcare services were rendered.

attributes.name: type_of_bill_code

attributes.name: allowed_amount

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount paid by the health plan to the provider after applying all adjustments, deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Amount applied to the member's deductible for this claim, representing member cost-sharing responsibility.

attributes.name: copayment_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member is responsible for paying as defined in the benefit plan.

attributes.name: coinsurance_amount
attributes.description: Percentage-based amount the member is responsible for paying after the deductible is met.

attributes.name: member_responsibility_amount
attributes.description: Total amount the member is responsible for paying, including deductible, copayment, coinsurance, and any non-covered amounts.

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_amount

attributes.name: medicare_paid_amount

attributes.name: medicaid_paid_amount
attributes.description: Amount paid by Medicaid for dual-eligible members where Medicaid provides supplemental coverage.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of adjustments applied to the claim, including contractual adjustments, denials, and other reductions.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code

attributes.name: denial_reason_description

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of standardized codes explaining adjustments made to the claim during adjudication.

attributes.name: remark_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of codes providing additional information or clarification about claim processing decisions.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_number

attributes.name: referral_number

attributes.name: claim_frequency_code
attributes.description: Code indicating whether the claim is an original submission, replacement, or void, used for claim resubmission tracking.

attributes.name: original_claim_number

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the claim was submitted to the health plan for processing.

attributes.name: claim_source
attributes.description: Origin of the claim submission, identifying who submitted the claim to the health plan.

attributes.name: network_status

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the type of healthcare service provided, used for utilization reporting and benefit management.

attributes.name: units_of_service

attributes.name: days_supply

attributes.name: ndc_code

attributes.name: prescription_number

attributes.name: dispense_as_written_indicator

attributes.name: formulary_status

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim contains diagnosis codes eligible for CMS risk adjustment and Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) scoring.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Risk score calculated from HCC codes on the claim, used to determine CMS payment adjustments for member health status.

attributes.name: encounter_data_submitted

attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim has been submitted to CMS as encounter data for risk adjustment and quality reporting purposes.

attributes.name: encounter_submission_date
attributes.description: Date the encounter data was submitted to CMS for risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: encounter_acceptance_status
attributes.description: Status of the encounter data submission to CMS, indicating whether it was accepted for risk adjustment processing.

attributes.name: quality_measure_eligible

attributes.name: hedis_measure_codes

attributes.name: star_rating_eligible

attributes.name: fraud_flag

attributes.name: fraud_investigation_status

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Check Number or Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Trace Number
attributes.description: Check number or EFT trace number for the payment issued to the provider.
