products.name: provider_program_participation
products.description: Reference data indicating a provider's participation status (active, inactive, suspended) for each government program, with effective dates and reason codes.

attributes.name: provider_program_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each provider's participation record in a government program. Primary key for the provider program participation entity.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned to the healthcare provider by CMS. Used to uniquely identify the provider across all government programs.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The provider organization's Tax Identification Number used for billing and payment purposes in government programs.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: The type of government healthcare program in which the provider is participating. Indicates whether this is Medicare Advantage, Part D, Medicaid, CHIP, or other government program.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: The specific name or identifier of the government program contract under which the provider is participating.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: The Plan Benefit Package identifier that specifies the particular benefit design within the government program contract.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Plan Benefit Package Requirements

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's participation in the government program. Active indicates the provider is currently accepting members and providing services; inactive indicates participation has ended; suspended indicates temporary restriction.

attributes.name: participation_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's participation in the government program became or will become effective. Used to determine eligibility for claims adjudication.

attributes.name: participation_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's participation in the government program ended or will end. Null if participation is ongoing.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for termination or suspension of the provider's participation in the government program.

attributes.name: termination_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the reason for termination or suspension of provider participation, providing additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The tier or level within the provider network that determines member cost-sharing and access. Tier 1 typically has lowest member cost-sharing.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new government program members. True means accepting, false means closed to new patients.

attributes.name: pcp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is designated as a Primary Care Physician who can serve as a member's PCP in the government program. Relevant for Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) and Point of Service (POS) plans.

attributes.name: specialist_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is designated as a specialist requiring referral or prior authorization in the government program.

attributes.name: provider_specialty_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the provider's primary medical specialty or service type for this government program participation (e.g., family practice, cardiology, orthopedic surgery).
attributes.references: CMS Provider Specialty Taxonomy, NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: provider_specialty_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the provider's primary medical specialty or service type for this government program participation.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Specialty Taxonomy, NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the provider entity type participating in the government program (individual practitioner, facility, supplier, etc.).

attributes.name: service_area_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code indicating the primary state where the provider delivers services under this government program participation.

attributes.name: service_area_county
attributes.description: County name where the provider delivers services under this government program participation. Used for network adequacy and access analysis.

attributes.name: service_area_zip_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ZIP codes that define the geographic service area where the provider accepts government program members.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's credentialing process for participation in the government program. Credentialing verifies provider qualifications, licenses, and quality standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, CMS Provider Enrollment Requirements

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider was most recently credentialed or approved for participation in the government program.

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the provider must complete recredentialing to maintain active participation status in the government program. Typically occurs every 3 years.

attributes.name: risk_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The financial risk arrangement or payment model under which the provider participates in the government program (e.g., fee-for-service, capitation, value-based care).
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Payment Models, Value-Based Care Regulations

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: The monthly capitation payment amount per member assigned to this provider under the government program, if applicable. Used for capitated payment arrangements.

attributes.name: quality_tier_status
attributes.description: Classification of the provider's quality performance tier within the government program, based on Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) measures, Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) scores, and other quality metrics.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings, HEDIS, NCQA Quality Standards

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Star Rating
attributes.description: The CMS Star Rating assigned to the provider or provider group for quality performance in the government program, on a scale of 1.0 to 5.0 stars.

attributes.name: hedis_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is required to submit HEDIS quality measure data for this government program participation.

attributes.name: cultural_competency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has completed cultural competency training required for serving diverse government program populations.

attributes.name: language_services_available
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages in which the provider can deliver services or has interpreter services available for government program members.
attributes.references: CMS Language Access Requirements, Title VI Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: telehealth_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers telehealth or telemedicine services to government program members.

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessibility Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's facilities meet ADA accessibility requirements for government program members with disabilities.

attributes.name: medicare_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has opted out of Medicare participation entirely. If true, provider cannot bill Medicare or Medicare Advantage plans.

attributes.name: medicaid_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is enrolled in the state Medicaid program, which may be required for Medicaid managed care participation.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_specialist_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP) Specialist Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has specialized training or designation to serve dual-eligible members (Medicare and Medicaid) in Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans (D-SNP).

attributes.name: snp_type_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates which types of Special Needs Plans the provider is eligible to serve: Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP), Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan (C-SNP), Institutional Special Needs Plan (I-SNP), or all types.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_specialties
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of chronic conditions for which the provider has specialized expertise relevant to Chronic Condition Special Needs Plans (C-SNP), such as diabetes, heart failure, End Stage Renal Disease (ESRD).

attributes.name: ltss_provider_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Term Services and Supports (LTSS) Provider Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider delivers Long Term Services and Supports for government program members requiring assistance with Activities of Daily Living (ADL) or Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADL).

attributes.name: behavioral_health_provider_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider specializes in behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder services for government program members.

attributes.name: pharmacy_network_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider (pharmacy) participates in the Medicare Part D or Medicaid pharmacy network for prescription drug benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements

attributes.name: dme_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is an approved supplier of Durable Medical Equipment for government program members.

attributes.name: home_health_provider_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider delivers home health services to government program members in their residences.
attributes.references: CMS Home Health Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: snf_provider_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider operates a Skilled Nursing Facility participating in government programs.

attributes.name: hospital_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the hospital or health system with which the provider is affiliated for government program participation and care coordination.

attributes.name: aco_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider participates in an Accountable Care Organization under Medicare Shared Savings Program or other Alternative Payment Model (APM).
attributes.references: CMS ACO Regulations, Medicare Shared Savings Program

attributes.name: aco_name
attributes.description: Name of the Accountable Care Organization in which the provider participates, if applicable.

attributes.name: pcmh_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider practice is certified as a Patient Centered Medical Home by National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) or equivalent body.

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must obtain a referral from their Primary Care Physician (PCP) to see this provider under the government program plan design.

attributes.name: claims_submission_method
attributes.description: The method by which the provider submits claims for government program services (Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) 837, paper Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)-1500, portal, etc.).

attributes.name: electronic_remittance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider receives electronic remittance advice (835 transactions) for government program claim payments.

attributes.name: eft_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is enrolled to receive claim payments via Electronic Funds Transfer for government program services.

attributes.name: contract_amendment_number
attributes.description: The amendment or version number of the government program contract under which the provider is currently participating, if applicable.

attributes.name: participation_agreement_signed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider signed the participation agreement for the government program.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this provider program participation record was last updated in the system, used for data synchronization and audit purposes.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this provider program participation record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).

attributes.name: cms_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Certification Number
attributes.description: The CMS certification number assigned to institutional providers (hospitals, Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNF), home health agencies) for Medicare participation.

attributes.name: state_medicaid_provider_id
attributes.description: The state-specific Medicaid provider identifier assigned by the state Medicaid agency for providers participating in Medicaid managed care programs.

attributes.name: exclusion_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is excluded from participation in federal healthcare programs by Office of Inspector General (OIG), System for Award Management (SAM), or state agencies due to fraud, abuse, or quality issues.
attributes.references: OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE), SAM.gov

attributes.name: exclusion_check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider was last screened against federal and state exclusion lists to ensure compliance with government program participation requirements.

attributes.name: sanctions_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has any active sanctions, corrective action plans, or quality improvement requirements imposed by CMS or state agencies.

attributes.name: sanctions_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any active sanctions, penalties, or corrective actions imposed on the provider by government program regulators.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_category
attributes.description: Classification of the provider's role in meeting CMS network adequacy standards, such as Essential Community Provider or Critical Access designation.

attributes.name: provider_directory_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider should be displayed in the public-facing provider directory for government program members to search and select.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the provider's government program participation.

attributes.name: program_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to government.program_provider_contract. Business justification: Provider participation records should reference the master provider contract. Participation status (active, inactive, suspended) is the operational manifestation of the underlying contract. The contra

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Provider participation in Medicare Advantage/Medicaid requires valid credentials. Network operations verifies credential status before enrolling providers in government programs - used in eligibility

products.name: program_risk_adjustment
products.description: Transactional record of risk‑adjustment data (RAF scores, HCC codes) submitted for a member under a government program for CMS reporting.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the program risk adjustment record.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member enrolled in the government program.

attributes.name: hic_number

attributes.description: Five-character CMS-assigned contract identifier for the Medicare Advantage or Part D plan.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: CMS-assigned identifier for the specific benefit package under the contract.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the risk adjustment payment applies.

attributes.description: Source system for risk adjustment data submission: RAPS (Risk Adjustment Processing System) or EDPS/EDS (Encounter Data Processing System/Encounter Data System).

attributes.name: submission_date

attributes.name: submission_type

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_version

attributes.name: rxhcc_code

attributes.description: CMS RxHCC code used for Part D risk adjustment based on diagnosis data.

attributes.name: rxhcc_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Hierarchical Condition Category (RxHCC) Description
attributes.description: Textual description of the RxHCC category.

attributes.name: raf_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk adjustment factor score for the member based on demographic and health status factors.

attributes.name: raf_score_type
attributes.description: Type of RAF score model applied based on member enrollment status and health condition.

attributes.name: service_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the service period during which the diagnosis was documented.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Standards

attributes.name: service_through_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period during which the diagnosis was documented.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Standards

attributes.name: encounter_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare encounter where the diagnosis was documented.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier for the rendering provider who documented the diagnosis.

attributes.name: provider_tin
attributes.description: Nine-digit Tax Identification Number for the provider organization.

attributes.name: provider_specialty_code
attributes.description: CMS provider specialty code indicating the type of healthcare provider.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the location where the service was rendered.
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Type of claim submitted (institutional, professional, pharmacy, or dental).

attributes.name: medical_record_number
attributes.description: Provider-assigned medical record number for the member.

attributes.name: chart_review_status
attributes.description: Status of medical record chart review for RADV audit validation.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Protocol

attributes.name: chart_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the medical record chart review was completed.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Protocol

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: CMS validation status for the submitted risk adjustment data.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for rejection of the risk adjustment data by CMS.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Error Code List

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the rejection reason.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Error Code List

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: CMS payment amount associated with the risk adjustment factor for this record.

attributes.name: payment_month
attributes.description: Year and month (YYYY-MM) for which the risk adjustment payment applies.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Government program line of business: Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug (MA-PD), Prescription Drug Plan (PDP), Medicaid, CHIP, or Special Needs Plan (SNP) types.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Type of government healthcare program under which the risk adjustment applies.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_status
attributes.description: Member dual eligibility status for Medicare and Medicaid benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP) Standards

attributes.name: medicaid_id
attributes.description: State-assigned Medicaid identifier for dual-eligible or Medicaid-only members.

attributes.name: esrd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator whether the member has End Stage Renal Disease status.

attributes.name: hospice_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator whether the member is enrolled in hospice care.

attributes.name: institutional_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator whether the member resides in an institutional setting (nursing home, long-term care facility).
attributes.references: CMS Institutional Special Needs Plan (I-SNP) Standards

attributes.name: new_enrollee_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator whether the member is a new enrollee with insufficient claims history for full risk adjustment.
attributes.references: CMS New Enrollee Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: age_as_of_date
attributes.description: Member age as of the risk adjustment calculation date (typically February 1 of payment year).

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Member gender used for risk adjustment calculation (M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown).

attributes.name: original_reason_for_entitlement
attributes.description: Original reason for Medicare entitlement: Old Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI), Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB), End Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), or combination.

attributes.name: medicaid_dual_status_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code indicating the level of Medicaid benefits for dual-eligible members.

attributes.name: part_c_premium_amount
attributes.description: Monthly Medicare Part C (Medicare Advantage) premium amount for the member.

attributes.name: part_d_premium_amount
attributes.description: Monthly Medicare Part D prescription drug premium amount for the member.

attributes.name: low_income_subsidy_level
attributes.description: Percentage of Part D cost-sharing subsidy for low-income members.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Low Income Subsidy Standards

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_model_version
attributes.description: Version of the CMS risk adjustment model used for calculation (e.g., V24, V28).

attributes.name: diagnosis_cluster
attributes.description: Grouping of related diagnoses for risk adjustment purposes.

attributes.name: disease_interaction_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this diagnosis participates in a disease interaction that increases the RAF score.

attributes.name: disabled_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator whether the member is entitled to Medicare due to disability status.

attributes.name: frailty_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator whether the member meets frailty criteria for institutional SNP eligibility.
attributes.references: CMS Institutional Special Needs Plan (I-SNP) Standards

attributes.name: chronic_condition_count
attributes.description: Number of chronic conditions identified for the member in the risk adjustment period.

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this record was selected for CMS RADV audit.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Protocol

attributes.name: audit_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the RADV audit sample if this record was selected.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Protocol

attributes.name: corrected_hcc_code
attributes.description: Corrected HCC code after audit or chart review validation.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Protocol

attributes.name: payment_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Payment adjustment amount resulting from audit findings or data corrections.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of payment reconciliation for this risk adjustment record.

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Method by which the diagnosis data was collected for risk adjustment submission.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Submission Standards

attributes.name: supplemental_data_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this record was submitted as supplemental diagnosis data outside of claims.

attributes.name: attestation_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider attested to the accuracy of the diagnosis documentation.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Standards

attributes.name: attestation_provider_npi
attributes.description: NPI of the provider who attested to the diagnosis documentation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the internal system that generated or processed this risk adjustment record.

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Internal processing status of the risk adjustment record.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: Internal error code if the record encountered processing issues.

attributes.name: error_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the processing error.

attributes.name: resubmission_count
attributes.description: Number of times this risk adjustment record has been resubmitted to CMS.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Submission Standards

attributes.name: last_resubmission_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent resubmission to CMS.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Submission Standards

attributes.name: cms_response_date
attributes.description: Date when CMS provided a response or acknowledgment for this submission.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Standards

attributes.name: cms_transaction_id
attributes.description: CMS-assigned transaction identifier for tracking the submission.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Submission Standards

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk adjustment record became effective.

attributes.name: record_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk adjustment record was superseded or became inactive.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this is the current active version of the risk adjustment record.

attributes.name: deleted_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this risk adjustment record has been logically deleted.

attributes.name: deletion_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk adjustment record was deleted.

attributes.name: deletion_reason

products.name: benefit_eligibility_rule
products.description: This association product represents the configuration relationship between benefit designs and eligibility rules in government health insurance programs. It captures which eligibility rules are applied to each benefit design, with rule-specific precedence, effective dates, and override capabilities. Each record links one benefit design to one eligibility rule with attributes that govern how that rule is evaluated for that specific benefit plan.. Existence Justification: In government health insurance programs, a single benefit design (e.g., Medicare Advantage plan) must apply multiple eligibility rules simultaneously (age 65+, ESRD eligibility, disability status, residency requirements, SNP criteria). Conversely, the same eligibility rule (e.g., age 65+ for Medicare) is reused across hundreds of different benefit designs. Product configuration teams actively manage these rule assignments with design-specific effective dates, rule precedence, and override flags.

attributes.description: Primary key for the benefit_eligibility_rule association

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the government benefit design configuration

attributes.business_glossary_term: Benefit Eligibility Rule - Eligibility Rule Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the eligibility rule being applied to this benefit design

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this eligibility rule becomes active for this specific benefit design, may differ from the rule's global effective date

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this eligibility rule is no longer applied to this benefit design, may differ from the rule's global expiration date

attributes.name: rule_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority for evaluating this rule within the context of this specific benefit design, overrides the rule's default priority when multiple rules apply to the same design

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule assignment overrides default eligibility logic or other rules for this benefit design

attributes.description: Current operational status of this rule assignment for this benefit design

attributes.description: Date-time when this benefit-eligibility rule assignment was created

attributes.description: User or process identifier that created this assignment

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User or process identifier that performed the last update to this assignment

products.name: contract_sla
products.description: This association product represents the Service Level Agreement commitment between a government program provider contract and a specific SLA definition. It captures the contractual performance obligations, measurement periods, compliance tracking, and penalty enforcement for each contract-SLA combination. Each record links one program_provider_contract to one sla with attributes that exist only in the context of this contractual commitment.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, government program provider contracts (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care) include multiple distinct SLA obligations covering different service areas (claims processing turnaround, prior authorization response time, member access standards, grievance resolution, provider directory accuracy). Each SLA is a standardized template that applies to multiple contracts across the provider network. Network operations and contract management teams actively track compliance, measure performance, assess penalties, and report on each contract-SLA combination as a managed business entity.

attributes.name: public_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the filing or portions of it are subject to public disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: Transparency in Coverage Rule, State Public Records Laws

attributes.name: confidential_treatment_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submitting organization has requested confidential treatment or trade secret protection for portions of the filing.
attributes.references: State Public Records Laws, NAIC Confidentiality Standards

attributes.name: confidential_justification
attributes.description: Justification or rationale for requesting confidential treatment of filing information.

attributes.name: document_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents or attachments included with the filing.

attributes.name: document_repository_path
attributes.description: File path or URL to the repository location where filing documents are stored.

attributes.name: filing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the filing fee paid to the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: fee_payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the filing fee was paid to the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: fee_payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to pay the filing fee (e.g., check, wire transfer, credit card, ACH).

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or tracking number provided by the regulatory agency upon receipt of the filing.

attributes.name: serff_tracking_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing (SERFF) Tracking Number
attributes.description: Unique tracking number assigned by the SERFF system for electronic filings.

attributes.name: internal_tracking_number
attributes.description: Internal tracking or reference number used by the submitting organization for filing management.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or division within the organization responsible for the filing (e.g., Commercial Markets, Medicare, Medicaid).

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center or department code associated with the filing for financial tracking purposes.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Project code or initiative identifier associated with the filing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments about the filing for internal reference or communication.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the filing record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the filing record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the filing record.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to authorization.auth_template. Business justification: Regulatory filings document authorization processes. State insurance departments require submission of authorization templates and criteria - filings reference specific templates to demonstrate compli

products.name: audit
products.description: This data product originally existed in compliance and government. Consolidated audit from compliance and government domains. Original: Master record of internal and external compliance audits, with audit ID, scope, auditor, start/end d... Also includes: Record of an audit or investigation performed on a government program transaction or contract, captu... Also consolidates: quality.accreditation_audit, compliance.audit.

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audit record. Primary key for the audit entity.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit based on its purpose and scope. Indicates whether the audit is internal, external, regulatory, compliance-focused, quality-focused, or specific to a functional area such as claims, pharmacy, or government programs.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, CMS Audit Protocols, HIPAA Audit Program

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the audit engagement. Provides a human-readable identifier for the audit.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope of the audit, including the areas, processes, systems, or populations being audited. Defines the boundaries and focus of the audit engagement.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: The primary objective or purpose of the audit. Describes what the audit aims to achieve, such as compliance verification, quality assessment, fraud detection, or operational improvement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the audit engagement in its lifecycle. Tracks the progression from planning through completion and remediation.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the lead auditor or audit firm responsible for conducting the audit. For external audits, this is the auditing organization or individual auditor assigned.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or entity conducting the audit. For internal audits, this may be the internal audit department. For external audits, this is the external auditing firm or regulatory body.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: auditor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the auditor based on their relationship to the organization. Indicates whether the audit is conducted by internal staff, external consultants, regulatory agencies, or independent third parties.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory or governing body mandating or overseeing the audit, if applicable. Examples include CMS, state departments of insurance, NCQA, URAC, or OCR.
attributes.references: CMS Regulations, State Insurance Departments, NCQA Standards, URAC Standards

attributes.name: program
attributes.description: Name of the audit program or initiative under which this audit is conducted. Examples include CMS RADV (Risk Adjustment Data Validation), HEDIS Audit, NCQA Accreditation Survey, or internal compliance audit program.
attributes.references: CMS Audit Protocols, NCQA HEDIS Audit Standards

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: The calendar year or fiscal year for which the audit is being conducted. Represents the period under review.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period being audited. Defines the beginning of the timeframe for which data, transactions, or activities are being reviewed.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period being audited. Defines the conclusion of the timeframe for which data, transactions, or activities are being reviewed.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: The planned or scheduled date for the audit engagement to begin. Represents when audit fieldwork or activities are expected to commence.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the audit engagement began. Captures when audit fieldwork or activities actually commenced.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: The planned or scheduled date for the audit engagement to be completed. Represents when audit fieldwork or activities are expected to conclude.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the audit engagement was completed. Captures when audit fieldwork or activities actually concluded.

attributes.name: fieldwork_start_date
attributes.description: The date when on-site or detailed audit fieldwork began. Represents the commencement of evidence gathering and testing activities.

attributes.name: fieldwork_end_date
attributes.description: The date when on-site or detailed audit fieldwork concluded. Represents the completion of evidence gathering and testing activities.

attributes.name: report_issue_date
attributes.description: The date when the final audit report was issued or published. Represents the official completion and communication of audit findings.

attributes.name: report_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the audit report is required to be completed and submitted. Represents regulatory or contractual deadlines for audit reporting.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business or product line being audited. Indicates whether the audit focuses on commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, individual, group, or other product lines.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit, division, or department within the organization that is the subject of the audit. Identifies the organizational area being audited.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic area or region covered by the audit. May include specific states, regions, or national scope.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: The number of records, transactions, or cases included in the audit sample. Represents the volume of items reviewed during the audit.
attributes.references: CMS RADV Audit Protocols, NCQA HEDIS Audit Standards

attributes.name: population_size
attributes.description: The total number of records, transactions, or cases in the population from which the audit sample was drawn. Represents the universe of items eligible for audit.
attributes.references: CMS RADV Audit Protocols, NCQA HEDIS Audit Standards

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: The statistical or judgmental method used to select the audit sample. Describes how items were chosen for review from the population.
attributes.references: CMS RADV Audit Protocols, NCQA HEDIS Audit Standards

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level used in the audit sampling methodology, expressed as a percentage. Represents the degree of certainty in the audit results.
attributes.references: CMS RADV Audit Protocols, Statistical Sampling Standards

attributes.name: error_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of errors or exceptions identified in the audit sample. Calculated as the number of errors divided by the sample size.
attributes.references: CMS RADV Audit Protocols, NCQA HEDIS Audit Standards

attributes.name: projected_error_rate
attributes.description: The estimated error rate for the entire population based on the audit sample results. Represents the extrapolated error rate from sample to population.
attributes.references: CMS RADV Audit Protocols, Statistical Sampling Standards

attributes.name: findings_count
attributes.description: The total number of audit findings, observations, or exceptions identified during the audit. Represents the volume of issues discovered.

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: The number of critical or high-severity findings identified during the audit. Represents issues requiring immediate attention or remediation.

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: The number of major or significant findings identified during the audit. Represents issues of moderate severity requiring remediation.

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: The number of minor or low-severity findings identified during the audit. Represents issues of lesser significance or opportunities for improvement.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The overall rating or conclusion assigned to the audit. Represents the auditor's assessment of compliance, quality, or performance.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: A numerical score representing the level of compliance or conformance identified during the audit, expressed as a percentage or score. Higher scores indicate better compliance.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: The accreditation status resulting from the audit, if applicable. Relevant for NCQA, URAC, or other accreditation audits.

attributes.name: accreditation_level
attributes.description: The level or tier of accreditation awarded as a result of the audit. Represents the degree of achievement in meeting accreditation standards.

attributes.name: accreditation_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the accreditation status expires and renewal or re-audit is required. Relevant for accreditation audits.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: The estimated or actual financial impact of audit findings, expressed in dollars. May represent overpayments, underpayments, penalties, or cost of remediation.
attributes.references: CMS RADV Audit Protocols, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: overpayment_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of overpayments identified during the audit. Represents funds paid in excess of what was due.
attributes.references: CMS RADV Audit Protocols, False Claims Act

attributes.name: underpayment_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of underpayments identified during the audit. Represents funds that should have been paid but were not.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of penalties, fines, or sanctions assessed as a result of audit findings. Represents financial consequences of non-compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Regulations, False Claims Act, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action or remediation is required as a result of the audit findings. True if corrective action is mandated.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which a corrective action plan must be submitted in response to audit findings. Represents regulatory or contractual deadlines for remediation planning.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completion_date
attributes.description: The date by which all corrective actions must be completed and verified. Represents the deadline for full remediation of audit findings.

attributes.name: follow_up_audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up audit is required to verify remediation of findings. True if a subsequent audit is mandated.

attributes.name: follow_up_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date of the follow-up audit to verify remediation. Represents when re-audit activities will occur.

attributes.name: methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology, framework, or approach used to conduct the audit. May reference specific audit standards, protocols, or procedures.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards, NCQA Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: criteria
attributes.description: The standards, regulations, policies, or benchmarks against which the audit subject was evaluated. Defines the basis for audit assessment.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: The overall risk level or risk rating assigned to the audit area or findings. Represents the severity of risk exposure identified.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards, Enterprise Risk Management

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: The category or type of risk associated with the audit findings. Classifies risk by its nature or impact area.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards, Enterprise Risk Management

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: The frequency or cadence at which this type of audit is conducted. Indicates how often the audit is repeated.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The origin or trigger for the audit. Indicates what prompted the audit to be conducted.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards, CMS Audit Protocols

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The plan year or benefit year being audited. Represents the coverage period under review for health plan audits.

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: The measurement year for quality metrics or HEDIS measures being audited. Represents the year for which performance is being assessed.

attributes.name: hedis_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure
attributes.description: The specific HEDIS measure or set of measures being audited. Relevant for HEDIS compliance audits.

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier or reference number assigned to the audit report. Used for tracking and referencing audit documentation.

attributes.name: report_title
attributes.description: The title of the audit report. Provides a descriptive name for the audit documentation.

attributes.name: executive_summary
attributes.description: A high-level summary of the audit findings, conclusions, and recommendations. Provides an overview for executive leadership.

attributes.name: opinion
attributes.description: The formal opinion or conclusion issued by the auditor regarding the subject matter. Represents the auditor's professional judgment.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards, External Audit Standards

attributes.name: management_response
attributes.description: The formal response from management to the audit findings and recommendations. Documents management's agreement, disagreement, or planned actions.

attributes.name: management_response_date
attributes.description: The date when management's formal response to the audit was received or submitted.

attributes.name: committee_review_date
attributes.description: The date when the audit results were reviewed by the audit committee or board of directors. Represents governance oversight of audit findings.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_date
attributes.description: The date when the audit report or results were submitted to the regulatory body, if required. Relevant for regulatory audits.

attributes.name: regulatory_response_date
attributes.description: The date when the regulatory body provided a response or decision regarding the audit. Represents regulatory feedback or action.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an appeal or dispute was filed in response to the audit findings or penalties. True if an appeal was submitted.
attributes.references: CMS Appeal Procedures, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: The date when an appeal or dispute was filed in response to the audit findings. Represents the initiation of the appeal process.
attributes.references: CMS Appeal Procedures, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: The current status of the appeal or dispute filed in response to the audit. Tracks the progression of the appeal process.
attributes.references: CMS Appeal Procedures, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date when the appeal or dispute was resolved or a final decision was issued. Represents the conclusion of the appeal process.
attributes.references: CMS Appeal Procedures, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The primary data source or system from which audit data was extracted. Identifies the origin of the data being audited.

attributes.name: tool
attributes.description: The software tool, platform, or application used to conduct the audit or analyze audit data. Examples include audit management systems, data analytics tools, or specialized audit software.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: The confidentiality or sensitivity classification of the audit report and findings. Determines who may access the audit documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, Information Security Standards

attributes.name: distribution_list
attributes.description: The list of individuals, roles, or departments to whom the audit report was distributed. Documents the recipients of audit findings.

attributes.name: lead_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person or audit lead within the organization for this audit. Identifies the internal point of contact for audit coordination.

attributes.name: lead_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the primary contact person or audit lead within the organization for this audit.

attributes.name: lead_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary contact person or audit lead within the organization for this audit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the audit record was initially created in the system. Represents the audit record creation event.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the audit record was last updated or modified. Tracks the most recent change to the audit record.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current status of the audit record in the system. Indicates whether the record is active, inactive, archived, or deleted.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.contract. Business justification: Audits frequently examine specific contracts (provider reimbursement contracts, vendor contracts, sales contracts). The contract_number STRING attribute should be replaced with FK to contract table to

products.name: risk_score
products.description: This data product originally existed in care and member. Consolidated risk_score from member and care domains. Original: Calculated risk adjustment score (e.g., HCC/RAF) associated with a member for Medicare Advantage.... Also includes: Periodic HCC risk score for a member, including RAF score, calculation date, and contributing diagno... Also consolidates: risk.risk_score, member.risk_score.

attributes.name: risk_score_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk score record.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with this risk score.

attributes.name: hcc_score
attributes.description: The calculated HCC risk score representing the expected cost of care for the member relative to the average Medicare beneficiary.

attributes.name: raf_score
attributes.description: The Risk Adjustment Factor score used to adjust capitation payments based on member health status and demographic factors.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the risk score was calculated or computed.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the risk score becomes effective for payment and utilization management purposes.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the risk score is no longer effective or valid.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which the risk score is used to determine capitation payments.

attributes.name: data_year
attributes.description: The calendar year during which the diagnosis and utilization data used for risk score calculation was collected.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: model_type
attributes.description: The type of risk adjustment model applied based on member enrollment and health status (Community, Institutional, New Enrollee, ESRD, etc.).

attributes.name: demographic_score
attributes.description: The portion of the risk score attributable to demographic factors such as age, gender, and Medicaid eligibility.

attributes.name: disease_score
attributes.description: The portion of the risk score attributable to diagnosed chronic conditions and HCC categories.

attributes.name: interaction_score
attributes.description: The portion of the risk score attributable to interactions between multiple chronic conditions or demographic factors.

attributes.name: normalization_factor
attributes.description: The factor applied to normalize risk scores to ensure budget neutrality across the Medicare Advantage program.
attributes.references: CMS Rate Announcement and Call Letter

attributes.name: coding_intensity_adjustment
attributes.description: The adjustment factor applied to account for differences in diagnostic coding patterns between Medicare Advantage and Fee-for-Service Medicare.
attributes.references: CMS Rate Announcement and Call Letter

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or business segment for which the risk score applies (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial, etc.).

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the health insurance plan under which the member is enrolled.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned contract number for the Medicare Advantage or Part D plan.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: The segment identifier within a CMS contract representing a specific benefit package or plan variation.

attributes.name: age_group
attributes.description: The age group category of the member used in risk score calculation.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The gender of the member as used in risk adjustment calculations.

attributes.name: medicaid_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid benefits, which affects risk score calculation.

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is entitled to Medicare due to disability rather than age.

attributes.name: esrd_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has End Stage Renal Disease, which requires a specialized risk adjustment model.

attributes.name: institutional_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member resides in a long-term care or institutional setting, affecting risk model selection.

attributes.name: new_enrollee_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is a new enrollee without sufficient diagnosis history, requiring use of the new enrollee risk model.

attributes.name: months_enrolled
attributes.description: The number of months the member was enrolled during the data collection period used for risk score calculation.

attributes.name: hcc_count
attributes.description: The total number of distinct HCC categories assigned to the member based on documented diagnoses.

attributes.name: hcc_list
attributes.description: A comma-separated list of HCC codes assigned to the member (e.g., HCC18, HCC85, HCC111).

attributes.name: diagnosis_count
attributes.description: The total number of ICD-10 diagnosis codes that contributed to the member's risk score calculation.

attributes.name: encounter_count
attributes.description: The total number of healthcare encounters (claims or encounter records) that contributed diagnoses to the risk score.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the risk score record in the calculation and payment lifecycle.

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: The type of data submission used to calculate the risk score (RAPS, EDPS, Encounter Data).
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Submission Requirements

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The primary source of diagnosis data used in the risk score calculation (claims, encounters, chart reviews, health risk assessments).
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the risk score has been validated through RADV or internal audit processes.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk score record has been flagged for audit or review due to anomalies or compliance requirements.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The monthly capitation payment amount calculated based on the risk score and applicable payment rates.

attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: The base per-member-per-month payment rate before risk adjustment is applied.
attributes.references: CMS Rate Announcement and Call Letter

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: The five-digit FIPS code for the county where the member resides, used to determine geographic payment rates.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state abbreviation for the member's residence location.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: The CMS-defined payment region code used for rate determination.

attributes.name: benchmark_rate
attributes.description: The county-level benchmark payment rate established by CMS for Medicare Advantage plans.
attributes.references: CMS Rate Announcement and Call Letter

attributes.name: rebate_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of savings between the plan bid and benchmark that is returned as member benefits or rebates.

attributes.name: quality_bonus_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage increase in benchmark payment based on the plan's Star Rating quality performance.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings and Quality Bonus Payment Methodology

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: The overall Star Rating (1.0 to 5.0) assigned to the plan based on quality and performance measures.

attributes.name: prospective_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a prospective risk score used for payment in the current year based on prior year data.

attributes.name: retrospective_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a retrospective risk score calculated after the payment year for reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: reconciliation_amount
attributes.description: The amount of payment adjustment resulting from reconciliation between prospective and retrospective risk scores.

attributes.name: frailty_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member meets criteria for frailty, which may affect risk model selection and care management.
attributes.references: CMS PACE and Frailty Assessment Guidelines

attributes.name: hospice_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was enrolled in hospice care during the risk score calculation period.

attributes.name: part_d_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage, which may affect risk adjustment.

attributes.name: rxhcc_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Hierarchical Condition Category (RxHCC) Score
attributes.description: The risk score calculated using the RxHCC model for Part D prescription drug payment adjustment.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: rxhcc_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Hierarchical Condition Category (RxHCC) Count
attributes.description: The total number of distinct RxHCC categories assigned to the member for Part D risk adjustment.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: low_income_subsidy_level
attributes.description: The level of low-income subsidy assistance the member receives for Part D prescription drug costs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Low Income Subsidy Program

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: A categorical classification of the member's risk level based on the calculated risk score for care management stratification.

attributes.name: predicted_cost
attributes.description: The predicted annual healthcare cost for the member based on the risk score and historical cost data.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the risk score (CMS standard model, proprietary algorithm, hybrid approach).

attributes.name: score_change_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change in risk score compared to the previous calculation period.

attributes.name: previous_score
attributes.description: The risk score from the immediately preceding calculation period for trend analysis.

attributes.name: score_percentile
attributes.description: The percentile ranking of the member's risk score within the plan population (1-100).

attributes.name: chronic_condition_count
attributes.description: The total number of distinct chronic conditions documented for the member that contribute to risk scoring.

attributes.name: gap_closure_opportunity
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Score Gap Closure Opportunity Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there are potential diagnosis gaps or documentation opportunities that could affect the risk score.

attributes.name: suspect_condition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there are suspected conditions based on historical data that have not been documented in the current period.

attributes.name: chart_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical chart review is required to validate or enhance the risk score documentation.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: last_chart_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent medical chart review conducted for this member's risk score validation.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Provider National Provider Identifier (NPI)
attributes.description: The 10-digit NPI of the primary care provider responsible for the member's care and diagnosis documentation.

attributes.name: attribution_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to attribute the member to a primary care provider for risk score and quality reporting purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Payment Program Attribution Methodology

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of this risk score record, incremented when recalculations or adjustments are made.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the risk score calculation was executed.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this risk score record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the risk score calculation, validation, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with this risk score.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the health insurance plan under which the member is enrolled.

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.risk_score_type. Business justification: Risk scores (member-specific values) must reference the scoring type/model used (HCC RAF, predictive analytics). Type defines methodology; risk_score stores calculated values for each member.

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment. Business justification: Risk adjustment scores are calculated per enrolled member for CMS reimbursement and actuarial analysis. Finance and actuarial teams link risk_score to enrollment_id for accurate premium calculations.

products.name: fee_schedule
products.description: This data product originally existed in contract and provider. Consolidated fee_schedule from contract and provider domains. Original: Master table for fee‑for‑service pricing structures referenced by contracts.... Also includes: Fee schedule entries defining reimbursement rates, RVUs, and pricing rules for services rendered by ...

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fee schedule record. Primary key for the fee schedule entity.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the fee schedule used for identification and reference purposes.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the fee schedule for system reference and lookup.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the fee schedule based on the type of healthcare service or provider category it applies to.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the fee schedule to track updates and revisions over time.

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the formulary record. Primary key for the formulary data product.

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: Unique 11-digit identifier assigned by the FDA to each drug product, formatted as 5-4-2 or 11 continuous digits. Identifies the labeler, product, and package size.

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the prescription drug as it appears on the formulary.

attributes.name: generic_name
attributes.description: The non-proprietary or generic name of the drug, typically the active pharmaceutical ingredient name.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The proprietary or brand name under which the drug is marketed by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: therapeutic_class
attributes.description: Classification of the drug based on its therapeutic use and pharmacological action (e.g., Antihypertensives, Antidiabetics, Statins).

attributes.name: drug_class_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the drug classification category for grouping and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: The cost-sharing tier assigned to the drug (typically 1-5), where lower tiers have lower member cost-sharing and higher tiers have higher cost-sharing.

attributes.name: tier_description
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the formulary tier indicating the cost-sharing category (e.g., Preferred Generic, Specialty).

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether prior authorization from the health plan is required before the drug can be dispensed.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member must try lower-cost alternative drugs before this drug will be covered.

attributes.name: quantity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of the drug that can be dispensed per prescription fill or time period.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the quantity limit applies (e.g., per fill, per month).

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form in which the drug is manufactured and dispensed (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, liquid).

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The amount of active ingredient per dosage unit (e.g., 10mg, 500mg/5mL).

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical, inhalation).

attributes.name: mail_order_eligible

attributes.name: preferred_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the drug is on the preferred drug list with lower cost-sharing for members.

attributes.name: ahfs_code

attributes.references: State Medicaid Program Standards, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: converted_member_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the member record created when this lead successfully enrolled in coverage.

attributes.name: risk_score_id

products.name: program
