attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the program across marketing, care management, and government programs.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to reference the program in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the program (e.g., Annual Enrollment Period Acquisition, Diabetes Management Program, Medicare Advantage Outreach).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the program's purpose, objectives, and scope.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the program by its primary functional area (marketing, care management, government, wellness, etc.).

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business this program serves (Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual, Group, ASO, etc.).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations, State Medicaid Managed Care Regulations

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the program indicating whether it is actively enrolling or serving members.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the program officially began or is scheduled to begin operations.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the program is scheduled to end or was terminated.

attributes.name: enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: The date when member enrollment into the program begins.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: The date when member enrollment into the program closes.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: target_population
attributes.description: Description of the member population the program is designed to serve (e.g., diabetic members, high-risk seniors, new enrollees).

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed criteria that members must meet to be eligible for enrollment in the program.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: The method by which members are enrolled into the program (automatic, opt-in, referral, etc.).

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether participation in the program is mandatory for eligible members.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The total budget allocated for the program in US dollars.

attributes.name: budget_period
attributes.description: The time period over which the budget amount is allocated.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The financial cost center code to which program expenses are charged.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or department responsible for managing and overseeing the program.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: The department or business unit that owns and manages the program.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for program-related inquiries and communications.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for program-related inquiries and support.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external vendor or partner organization supporting program delivery, if applicable.

attributes.name: clinical_protocol_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical guidelines or protocols that govern care management programs (e.g., InterQual, MCG guidelines).
attributes.references: InterQual Clinical Decision Support, MCG Care Guidelines

attributes.name: hedis_measure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Code
attributes.description: The HEDIS measure code associated with quality improvement programs (e.g., CDC for Diabetes Care, CBP for Blood Pressure Control).

attributes.name: cms_program_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Program Code
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned code for government programs such as Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or Special Needs Plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: star_rating_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the level of impact this program has on CMS Star Ratings for Medicare Advantage plans.

attributes.name: target_enrollment_count
attributes.description: The target number of members the program aims to enroll.

attributes.name: max_enrollment_capacity
attributes.description: The maximum number of members that can be enrolled in the program due to resource or regulatory constraints.

attributes.name: intervention_type
attributes.description: The primary method of intervention or member engagement used by the program.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which program activities or member touchpoints occur.

attributes.name: duration_weeks
attributes.description: The typical duration of member participation in the program, measured in weeks.

attributes.name: is_hipaa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program adheres to HIPAA privacy and security requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule and Security Rule

attributes.name: is_aca_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program complies with ACA requirements and regulations.

attributes.name: is_ncqa_accredited
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Accredited Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program has received NCQA accreditation for quality standards.

attributes.name: roi_target_percentage
attributes.description: The target return on investment percentage expected from the program.

attributes.name: pmpm_cost_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Per Member Per Month (PMPM) Cost Target
attributes.description: The target cost per member per month for program operations and interventions.

attributes.name: marketing_channel
attributes.description: The primary marketing channel used to promote the program to potential enrollees.

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: The marketing campaign code associated with program promotion and member acquisition efforts.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The strategic priority level assigned to the program by organizational leadership.

attributes.name: risk_stratification_level
attributes.description: The risk level of the target population for care management programs based on clinical and utilization data.

attributes.name: hcc_category
attributes.description: The HCC category or categories targeted by the program for risk adjustment purposes.

attributes.name: quality_measure_target
attributes.description: The specific quality measure or performance target the program aims to improve (e.g., HbA1c control, medication adherence).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Standards, CMS Star Ratings

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which program performance and outcomes are reported to stakeholders.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The primary operational system from which program data originates (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Pegasystems, Salesforce Health Cloud).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the program was officially approved by leadership or governance committee.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or committee that approved the program.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when the program was last reviewed for effectiveness and compliance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next program review or evaluation.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason why the program was terminated or discontinued, if applicable.

attributes.name: language_support
attributes.description: Languages in which program materials and support are available (e.g., English, Spanish, Mandarin).

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic area or market where the program is available.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the program operates, if applicable to a specific state.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_number
attributes.description: The filing number assigned by state or federal regulators for programs requiring regulatory approval.

attributes.name: is_value_based_care
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program is part of a value-based care or alternative payment model initiative.

attributes.name: apm_model_type
attributes.description: The type of alternative payment model associated with the program, if applicable.

attributes.name: member_incentive_type
attributes.description: The type of incentive offered to members for program participation or goal achievement.

attributes.name: member_incentive_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of incentives provided to members for program participation.

attributes.name: provider_incentive_type
attributes.description: The type of incentive offered to providers for supporting program goals and member outcomes.

attributes.name: technology_platform
attributes.description: The technology platform or application used to deliver program services (e.g., mobile app, web portal, telehealth platform).

attributes.name: integration_method
attributes.description: The method used to integrate program data with core administrative systems.

attributes.name: sla_response_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time in Hours
attributes.description: The maximum response time in hours guaranteed by the program for member inquiries or interventions.

attributes.name: nps_target_score
attributes.description: The target Net Promoter Score the program aims to achieve for member satisfaction.

attributes.name: is_pilot_program
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a pilot or test program before full-scale rollout.

attributes.name: pilot_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled end date for the pilot phase of the program.

attributes.name: success_criteria
attributes.description: The measurable criteria used to evaluate program success and effectiveness.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.contract. Business justification: Programs (care management, disease management, wellness) are often delivered by external vendors under contract. The vendor_contract_number STRING should be replaced with FK to contract table to link

products.name: survey
products.description: This data product originally existed in quality and service. Consolidated survey from service and quality domains. Also includes: Definition of CAHPS survey questions, response options, and scoring methodology....

attributes.name: survey_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the survey instance. Primary key for the survey data product.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The official title or name of the survey used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the survey based on its purpose and target audience. CAHPS surveys are standardized for quality measurement.
attributes.references: CAHPS (Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems) Survey Protocols, NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance) Standards

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The insurance product line or business segment to which this survey applies, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage, or Medicaid.
attributes.references: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) Program Requirements

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the survey purpose, scope, and objectives.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the survey instrument to track changes and updates over time.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the survey indicating whether it is available for distribution.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Primary language in which the survey is administered, using ISO 639-3 language codes.
attributes.references: ISO 639-3 Language Codes, HIPAA Language Access Requirements

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the survey is distributed to respondents.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor or organization administering the survey, if applicable.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the survey vendor in the vendor management system.

attributes.name: question_count
attributes.description: Total number of questions included in the survey instrument.

attributes.name: estimated_completion_minutes
attributes.description: Expected time in minutes for a respondent to complete the survey.

attributes.name: target_population
attributes.description: The specific member or stakeholder population segment targeted for this survey.

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: Statistical sampling methodology used to select survey respondents from the target population.
attributes.references: CAHPS Survey Sampling Guidelines, NCQA Sampling Standards

attributes.name: sample_size_target
attributes.description: Planned number of survey invitations to be distributed to achieve statistical validity.

attributes.name: response_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of survey responses needed to meet statistical validity and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: CAHPS Survey Response Rate Standards, NCQA Requirements

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: How often the survey is administered or repeated.
attributes.references: HEDIS Annual Reporting Cycle, CAHPS Survey Protocols

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: The specific business event that initiates distribution of this survey to a member or stakeholder.

attributes.name: trigger_delay_days
attributes.description: Number of days to wait after the trigger event before distributing the survey.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the survey becomes active and available for distribution.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the survey is no longer active for distribution.

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which survey results are reported, particularly relevant for HEDIS and CAHPS reporting.
attributes.references: HEDIS Measurement Year Standards, NCQA Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period during which survey responses are collected for reporting purposes.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period during which survey responses are collected for reporting purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this survey is mandated by regulatory or accreditation requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The governing body or regulatory authority requiring this survey, if applicable.
attributes.references: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services), NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance), State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: hedis_measure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Code
attributes.description: HEDIS measure code associated with this survey for quality reporting purposes.
attributes.references: HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set) Technical Specifications

attributes.name: cahps_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) Version
attributes.description: Version of the CAHPS survey instrument if this survey follows CAHPS protocols.
attributes.references: CAHPS (Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems) Survey Protocols

attributes.name: cahps_product_line
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) Product Line
attributes.description: CAHPS product line classification for standardized survey administration and reporting.

attributes.name: scoring_methodology
attributes.description: The method used to calculate scores and metrics from survey responses.
attributes.references: CAHPS Scoring Guidelines, NPS (Net Promoter Score) Standards

attributes.name: case_mix_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether survey results are adjusted for case mix variables such as age, health status, and education.

attributes.name: composite_measure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this survey produces composite measures combining multiple questions.

attributes.name: anonymity_level
attributes.description: Level of respondent anonymity maintained in survey responses.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, Survey Research Ethics Standards

attributes.name: consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consent is required from respondents before survey participation.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, Informed Consent Standards

attributes.name: phi_collected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the survey collects Protected Health Information requiring HIPAA safeguards.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, PHI (Protected Health Information) Standards

attributes.name: incentive_offered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether respondents are offered incentives for survey completion.

attributes.name: incentive_type
attributes.description: Type of incentive offered to survey respondents, if applicable.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the incentive offered to survey respondents.

attributes.name: reminder_count
attributes.description: Number of reminder communications sent to non-respondents to improve response rates.

attributes.name: reminder_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days between reminder communications to survey non-respondents.

attributes.name: response_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days respondents have to complete the survey after initial distribution.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: The internal department or business unit responsible for this survey.

attributes.name: owner_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person responsible for survey administration and results.

attributes.name: owner_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person responsible for the survey.

attributes.name: cost_per_survey
attributes.description: Average cost to administer one survey instance, including vendor fees, incentives, and operational costs.
attributes.references: Survey Budget and Cost Management Standards

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for survey administration during the measurement period.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the survey instrument before activation.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who approved the survey for distribution.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the survey was officially approved for distribution.

attributes.name: pilot_test_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this survey underwent pilot testing before full deployment.

attributes.name: pilot_test_date
attributes.description: Date when pilot testing of the survey was conducted.

attributes.name: pilot_sample_size
attributes.description: Number of respondents included in the pilot test of the survey.

attributes.name: data_retention_years
attributes.description: Number of years survey data must be retained per regulatory and business requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Record Retention Requirements, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: public_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether survey results are publicly reported on Medicare.gov, state exchanges, or other public platforms.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings, Medicare Plan Finder, Transparency in Coverage Rule

attributes.name: star_rating_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this survey contributes to CMS Star Ratings for Medicare Advantage or Part D plans.

attributes.name: quality_improvement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether survey results are used for internal quality improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: benchmark_source
attributes.description: Source of benchmark data used to compare survey results against industry or regulatory standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the survey record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the survey record was last updated.

attributes.name: retired_date
attributes.description: Date when the survey was retired and is no longer available for distribution.

attributes.name: retired_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the survey was retired or discontinued.

products.name: survey_response
products.description: This data product originally existed in quality and service. Consolidated survey_response from service and quality domains. Original: Transactional capture of individual member responses to satisfaction surveys, with question ID, answ... Also includes: Individual member responses to CAHPS surveys, including timestamps and raw scores....

attributes.name: survey_response_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each individual survey response record. Primary key for the survey response entity.

attributes.name: survey_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the survey instrument or campaign to which this response belongs. Links to the specific survey template or version administered.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan member who provided this survey response. Links to member enrollment records.

attributes.name: survey_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the survey instrument administered to the member.

attributes.name: question_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific survey question being answered within the survey instrument.

attributes.name: question_text
attributes.description: Full text of the survey question as presented to the member. Captures the exact wording used in the survey administration.

attributes.name: question_category
attributes.description: Thematic category or domain that the survey question addresses, used for grouping and analysis of responses.
attributes.references: CAHPS Survey Protocols, NCQA HEDIS Standards

attributes.name: response_value
attributes.description: Raw response value provided by the member. May be numeric score, text response, or selected option depending on question type.

attributes.name: response_score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned to the response for quantitative analysis. Standardized scoring based on survey methodology.

attributes.name: response_type
attributes.description: Format or data type of the response expected for this question. Indicates whether response is numeric, categorical, or free text.

attributes.name: response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the member submitted this specific survey response. Captures precise moment of response submission.

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the survey response was submitted by the member, used for date-based reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: survey_administration_date
attributes.description: Date when the survey was initially sent or made available to the member for completion.

attributes.name: survey_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the member completed the entire survey instrument, marking the final submission of all responses.

attributes.name: response_channel
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the member submitted the survey response. Indicates the interface used for survey completion.

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: Status of the individual response indicating whether it was completed, skipped, or has validation issues.

attributes.name: is_required_question
attributes.description: Indicates whether this question was mandatory for survey completion. True if response was required, false if optional.

attributes.name: is_validated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the response has passed data quality validation rules and is approved for analysis.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of data quality validation checks performed on the response. Indicates whether response meets quality standards.

attributes.name: validation_error_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific validation rule that failed if response did not pass quality checks.

attributes.name: validation_error_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the validation error or data quality issue identified with this response.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Health insurance line of business for the member at the time of survey response. Indicates product type and regulatory context.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, State Medicaid Requirements

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Specific health plan product type enrolled by the member. Indicates network structure and benefit design model.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: product_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific health plan or benefit package the member was enrolled in at time of survey.
attributes.references: CMS Contract and Plan Identification Standards

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: CMS contract identifier for Medicare Advantage or Part D plans, or internal contract identifier for commercial plans.

attributes.name: member_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the member originally enrolled in the health plan, used to calculate tenure at time of survey.

attributes.name: member_tenure_months
attributes.description: Number of months the member has been continuously enrolled in the plan at the time of survey response.

attributes.name: member_age
attributes.description: Age of the member in years at the time of survey administration, used for demographic analysis and stratification.

attributes.name: member_age_group
attributes.description: Age range category of the member for demographic reporting and analysis. Standard age bands used in CAHPS reporting.

attributes.name: member_gender
attributes.description: Gender of the member as recorded in enrollment records, used for demographic stratification of survey results.

attributes.name: member_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code of the member's primary residence at time of survey. Used for geographic analysis.

attributes.name: member_zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit ZIP code of the member's primary residence. Used for geographic and socioeconomic analysis.

attributes.name: member_language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for member communications as indicated in enrollment records. Used to ensure culturally appropriate survey administration.
attributes.references: CAHPS Survey Cultural Competency Standards, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: pcp_assigned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member had an assigned Primary Care Physician at the time of survey. Relevant for HMO and POS plans.

attributes.name: pcp_npi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) National Provider Identifier (NPI)
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier of the member's assigned Primary Care Physician at time of survey.

attributes.name: care_management_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member was enrolled in a care management or disease management program at time of survey.

attributes.name: care_management_program
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the specific care management program in which the member was enrolled, if applicable.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_count
attributes.description: Number of chronic conditions documented for the member at time of survey. Used for risk stratification and analysis.

attributes.name: hcc_score
attributes.description: Risk adjustment score based on Hierarchical Condition Categories for the member. Indicates clinical complexity and expected cost.

attributes.name: prior_year_claims_count
attributes.description: Total number of claims submitted for the member in the 12 months prior to survey administration. Indicates utilization level.

attributes.name: prior_year_total_paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the plan for member claims in the 12 months prior to survey. Used for cost-based stratification.

attributes.name: grievance_filed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member filed a grievance or complaint in the 12 months prior to survey administration.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Managed Care Manual Chapter 13

attributes.name: appeal_filed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member filed an appeal of a coverage determination in the 12 months prior to survey.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Managed Care Manual Chapter 13

attributes.name: customer_service_contact_count
attributes.description: Number of times the member contacted customer service in the 12 months prior to survey administration.

attributes.name: survey_sample_type
attributes.description: Sampling methodology used to select this member for survey participation. Indicates whether random, stratified, or targeted sampling.

attributes.name: survey_wave
attributes.description: Identifier for the survey administration wave or batch in which this response was collected. Used for tracking survey campaigns.

attributes.name: survey_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor or internal department that administered the survey to the member.

attributes.name: incentive_offered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial or non-financial incentive was offered to the member for completing the survey.

attributes.name: incentive_type
attributes.description: Type of incentive offered to the member for survey completion, if any incentive was provided.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the incentive offered for survey completion, if applicable. Expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: reminder_count
attributes.description: Number of reminder communications sent to the member before survey completion. Used to track engagement efforts.

attributes.name: response_time_seconds
attributes.description: Time in seconds taken by the member to answer this specific question. Used for quality assessment and fraud detection.

attributes.name: survey_completion_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes taken by the member to complete the entire survey from start to submission.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the survey response was submitted, if collected. Used for fraud detection and validation.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the member to complete the survey, if response was submitted electronically.

attributes.name: browser_type
attributes.description: Web browser used by the member to complete the survey, if response was submitted via web interface.

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system of the device used to complete the survey, if response was submitted electronically.

attributes.name: response_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application from which the survey response data was captured and loaded.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score value if this response is for an NPS question. Typically on 0-10 scale measuring likelihood to recommend.

attributes.name: nps_category
attributes.description: Classification of NPS response into promoter (9-10), passive (7-8), or detractor (0-6) categories.

attributes.name: cahps_composite_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) Composite Measure
attributes.description: CAHPS composite measure category to which this question belongs, if applicable. Used for HEDIS and Star Ratings reporting.
attributes.references: CAHPS Survey Protocols, NCQA HEDIS Standards

attributes.name: star_rating_measure
attributes.description: CMS Star Rating measure identifier to which this survey response contributes, if applicable to Medicare Advantage plans.

attributes.name: hedis_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure
attributes.description: HEDIS measure identifier to which this survey response contributes for quality reporting purposes.

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this survey response will be included in quality measure reporting and Star Ratings calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings Technical Notes, NCQA HEDIS Standards

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: Specific reporting period or measurement year to which this survey response applies for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Star Ratings Technical Notes, NCQA HEDIS Standards

attributes.name: excluded_from_reporting
attributes.description: Indicates whether this response has been excluded from quality measure reporting due to validation issues or sampling criteria.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Reason why this survey response was excluded from quality measure reporting, if applicable.

attributes.name: weight_factor
attributes.description: Statistical weight applied to this response for population-level analysis and reporting. Adjusts for sampling methodology.
attributes.references: CAHPS Survey Sampling and Weighting Standards

attributes.name: comment_text
attributes.description: Free-text comment or feedback provided by the member in response to open-ended survey questions.

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: Automated sentiment analysis score derived from free-text comments. Indicates positive, neutral, or negative sentiment.

attributes.name: sentiment_category
attributes.description: Classification of member sentiment based on analysis of free-text comments into positive, neutral, or negative categories.

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to collect survey responses from the member. May differ from response channel for mixed-mode surveys.

attributes.name: survey_mode

attributes.name: status_history_id

attributes.description: Type of entity for which the status change is being tracked (e.g., credential, member, fraud case).

attributes.name: entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific entity (credential ID, member ID, case ID) whose status changed.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: Status value before the change occurred. Values vary by entity type (e.g., active, pending, suspended, terminated for members; open, investigating, closed for fraud cases).

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: Status value after the change occurred. Values vary by entity type and represent the current state following the transition.

attributes.name: status_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the new status became effective for business purposes.

attributes.name: status_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the status change became effective, including time zone information.

attributes.name: status_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the status ceased to be effective, marking the end of this status period. Null if current status.

attributes.name: status_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the status period ended, including time zone information. Null if current status.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the status change (e.g., voluntary termination, non-payment, investigation complete).

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of why the status change occurred, providing context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the nature of the status change for reporting and analysis purposes.

attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that initiated the status change.

attributes.description: Name of the user who approved the status change for audit and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the status change was approved, if approval workflow was required.

attributes.description: Name of the operational system that recorded the status change (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Pegasystems, Salesforce Health Cloud).

attributes.name: source_transaction_id
attributes.description: Transaction or event identifier from the source system that triggered the status change.

attributes.name: is_current_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status record represents the current active status for the entity (true) or a historical status (false).

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days the entity remained in this status, calculated from effective date to end date. Null if current status.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order of this status change within the entity's status history (1 for first status, 2 for second, etc.).

attributes.description: Method used to notify relevant parties about the status change.

attributes.description: Date when this status change was reported to regulatory authorities, if applicable.

attributes.description: Identifier of the subsequent status history record that reversed this status change, if applicable.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this status change was reversed, if applicable.

attributes.description: Identifier of the business workflow or process instance that resulted in this status change.

attributes.description: Specific step or stage within the workflow that triggered the status change.

attributes.description: Business unit or division responsible for managing the entity whose status changed (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid).

attributes.description: Line of business associated with the entity whose status changed, indicating the product or market segment.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market where the entity operates or is registered.

attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the entity is registered or the status change occurred.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this status change was made to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements or contractual obligations.

products.name: contract_quality_metric
products.description: This association product represents the quality-based performance arrangement between clinical quality metrics and value-based contracts. It captures the specific performance thresholds, incentive payment structures, and measurement parameters that apply when a particular clinical metric is included in a contract's quality incentive program. Each record links one clinical metric to one contract with the contract-specific performance targets and payment terms.. Existence Justification: In value-based care contracting, Health Care negotiates quality incentive programs where multiple clinical quality metrics (HbA1c control, readmission rates, etc.) are included in a single provider or broker contract, and each metric appears across multiple contracts with different performance thresholds and payment amounts. The business actively manages these contract-metric arrangements as operational entities, tracking contract-specific performance targets, incentive payments, measurement periods, and payment tiers for each metric-contract combination.

attributes.name: performance_threshold

This is specific to each contract-metric combination as different contracts negotiate different performance expectations.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the quality incentive payment associated with achieving the performance threshold for this metric under this specific contract. Amount varies by contract negotiation and metric importance.

attributes.name: measurement_period
attributes.description: The specific time period over which performance on this metric will be measured for this contract (e.g., annual, quarterly). May differ from the metric's standard measurement period based on contract terms.

attributes.description: The weighting factor applied to this metric within the overall quality incentive calculation for this contract. Represents the relative importance of this metric in the contract's total quality score.

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The target performance value negotiated in the contract for this metric. May differ from performance_threshold if tiered incentives exist.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency

products.name: shared_program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment of a health plan member into a care management or wellness program. It captures the participation relationship between a member's health plan enrollment and specific programs (e.g., Diabetes Management, COPD Care, Weight Management). Each record links one enrollment to one program with attributes that track participation status, enrollment timing, completion, and engagement level.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, members (via their enrollments) can simultaneously participate in multiple care management and wellness programs (e.g., a diabetic member may be enrolled in Diabetes Management, Weight Management, and Preventive Care programs concurrently). Conversely, each program serves many enrolled members across the health plan. Care management teams actively manage these program enrollments as operational entities, tracking enrollment dates, participation status, completion, and engagement levels for each member-program combination.

products.name: contract_audit
products.description: This association product represents the audit review relationship between provider audits and contracts. It captures which specific contracts were reviewed during a provider audit, the scope of review for each contract, the compliance findings, and the specific contract clauses examined. Each record links one provider audit to one contract with attributes that exist only in the context of this audit-contract relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, provider audits routinely review multiple contracts simultaneously because providers typically have multiple contractual agreements with Health Care (e.g., professional services contract, facility contract, ancillary services contract, different lines of business). Conversely, each contract undergoes multiple audits over its lifecycle (annual compliance audits, triggered audits based on billing anomalies, random sample audits, renewal audits). Network operations and fraud teams actively manage the audit-contract relationship by tracking which specific contract terms were reviewed, the compliance status per contract, and the audit findings attributable to each contract.

attributes.name: reviewer_name

products.name: program_diagnosis_mapping
products.description: This association product represents the configuration mapping between diagnosis codes and quality/care programs. It captures the business rules that define which diagnosis codes are tracked by which programs, along with program-specific weights, reporting requirements, and quality measure indicators. Each record links one diagnosis code to one program with attributes that define how that diagnosis is evaluated within the program context.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, diagnosis codes are mapped to multiple quality and care management programs simultaneously (e.g., a diabetes diagnosis code impacts HEDIS diabetes measures, Star Ratings, and disease management programs), and each program tracks multiple diagnosis codes with program-specific weights and reporting rules. This is a configuration-driven operational relationship where the business actively manages which diagnoses are tracked by which programs, with relationship-specific attributes like program_weight, reporting_requirement, and quality_measure_indicator that vary by the diagnosis-program combination.

products.name: program_credentialing_policy
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of credentialing policies to specific programs within  health Care. It captures program-specific credentialing requirements and policy variations that exist only in the context of a particular program's compliance framework. Each record links one credentialing policy to one program with effective dates and program-specific requirement overrides.. Existence Justification: In  health Care's operations, credentialing policies must be applied across multiple programs (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial) because each program has distinct regulatory requirements and compliance frameworks. A single base credentialing policy (e.g., primary care physician credentialing) is referenced by multiple programs, but each program applies it with program-specific variations, effective dates, and override requirements. The compliance team actively manages these program-policy assignments as operational records, tracking when policies become effective for each program and what program-specific modifications apply.

products.name: contract_journal_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between journal entries and contracts. It captures how financial journal entries are attributed to specific provider or broker contracts for profitability analysis, cost tracking, and audit trails. Each record links one journal entry to one contract with allocation details that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, large provider and broker contracts generate multiple journal entries across accounting periods for various financial events (capitation payments, risk settlements, quality incentives, commissions). Finance teams actively manage the allocation of journal entries to contracts for contract profitability analysis, cost tracking, and audit compliance. A single journal entry can be split across multiple contracts (e.g., shared administrative costs), and each contract accumulates many journal entries over its lifecycle.

attributes.description: Primary key for letter_template

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the template used for identification.

attributes.name: template_type
attributes.description: Category of the letter template indicating its business purpose.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version of the template; higher numbers indicate newer revisions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the template becomes active for use.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the template should no longer be used.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the template.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter code representing the language of the template content.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Medium through which the letter is delivered to the member.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Subject line used for email or portal notifications.

attributes.name: body
attributes.description: Main content of the template, may contain placeholder tokens.

attributes.name: placeholders
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of placeholder tokens that will be replaced with member-specific data.

attributes.name: audience_segment
attributes.description: Intended recipient segment for the template.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority used when multiple templates match; lower numbers have higher priority.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this template is the default for its type and segment.

attributes.name: document_format
attributes.description: File format of the generated letter.

attributes.name: signature_line
attributes.description: Text displayed as the signature at the end of the letter.

attributes.name: legal_disclaimer
attributes.description: Standard legal disclaimer appended to the letter.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the template has been reviewed and approved for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the template record was created.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the template.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the employee who created the template.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the employee who last modified the template.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the template.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the template was approved.

products.name: business_associate
products.description: Master reference table for business_associate. Referenced by business_associate_id.

attributes.name: business_associate_id
attributes.description: Primary key for business_associate

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Legal name of the business associate entity.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the associate relationship.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the associate.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship commenced.

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship ended or is scheduled to end.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for termination of the business associate relationship.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary point of contact at the associate.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the associate's mailing address.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the associate's mailing address (optional).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the associate's address.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the associate's address.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the associate's address.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the associate's location.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the associate.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet unique identifier for the associate.

attributes.name: ein_number
attributes.description: US federal tax identifier for the associate.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the master contract governing the relationship.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract became effective.

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract expires.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms agreed with the associate.

attributes.name: primary_service_category
attributes.description: Main category of services provided by the associate.

attributes.name: secondary_service_category
attributes.description: Additional service categories offered by the associate.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment rating for the associate.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status with regulatory and internal policies.

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Classification level of data shared with the associate.

attributes.name: confidentiality_agreement_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a confidentiality agreement is in place.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the business associate record was created.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional remarks about the associate.

products.name: workgroup
products.description: Master reference table for workgroup. Referenced by assigned_to_workgroup_id.

attributes.name: workgroup_id
attributes.description: Primary key for workgroup

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the workgroup used for display and reporting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the purpose and scope of the workgroup.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of the workgroup based on functional area.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the workgroup.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the workgroup becomes active.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the workgroup is scheduled to be retired or become inactive.

attributes.name: owner_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary owner (user) responsible for the workgroup.

attributes.name: manager_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager overseeing the workgroup.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center code associated with the workgroup for budgeting.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit within Health to which the workgroup belongs.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO region code indicating the primary geographic region of the workgroup.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this workgroup is the default assignment for new users or processes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the workgroup record was created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the workgroup record.

attributes.name: workflow_category
attributes.description: High-level workflow category the workgroup participates in.

attributes.name: external_reference_id
attributes.description: Identifier used to map the workgroup to external systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level assigned to the workgroup.
